# 数据底座四 · F4 判断层框架 实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 落地规格 `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-judgment-framework-design.md`（第 7 稿 = 第 6 稿 + 计划审计第一轮 P1-03/P1-09/P1-10 修订 + 第二轮 Q1-01/Q1-02/Q1-03/Q1-05 修订，审计见 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-judgment-framework-plan/01-codex-plan-round1.md`、`02-codex-plan-round2.md`；第 6 稿的 Codex 第五轮处方见 `docs/audits/2026-11-04-judgment-framework/03-disposition.md` 第五轮节）：公共判断表家族（九表 + RPC + 按 `publishable` 的 RLS）、方法注册表与 `formula_hash`、冻结输入的登记与回放、结算队列与三个 resolver、校准与显示门控、读接口与 UI、首批生产者 `macro_regime@v1`（夹具对接宏观接口）与 `recommendation_call@v1`（私有只读适配器）。

**Architecture:** 一个迁移 `20261109150000_judgments.sql` 建九表、触发器、RLS、全部 §5.6 函数；`src/lib/judgments/db.ts` 的 `JudgmentsDb` 契约有 Supabase（rpc）/ 内存 / pg 三实现；`JudgmentInputsDb` 只走 anon 公共读路径与 K 线适配器；登记、回放、结算、校准、显示全是依赖注入的纯核心 + 薄路由；宏观工作台尚不存在，F4 定义 `MacroReadApi` 接口并用夹具实现。

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 15 App Router、TypeScript、Supabase（PostgreSQL 17 + PostgREST + Storage）、vitest、`pg`（集成测试）、`tsx` 脚本、`ajv` 8（条件参数 schema）。计划一的 `TableClient`、`startBatch/finishBatch`、`quarantine()`、`recordAttempt` 用于批次 / 隔离 / 新鲜度；计划二的 `FactsDb.readFacts`、`deriveMetrics` 用于事实输入与结算。

实施按 owner 规则：Opus 5.5 指挥，**Sonnet 5.5 子代理逐任务写代码**，每个任务经 Opus 规格复审、质量复审与 Codex（gpt-6-astra，medium）审计；记录写 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-judgment-framework/implementation-log.md`。

## 仓库约定（动手前必读）

- **工作树**：`/Volumes/AIMATE_WORK/Developer/CodeX/OsbornAlpha/.claude/worktrees/judgment-framework-50f9e1`。不要 `cd` 出去；不要用裸 `git stash`（栈与其他工作树共享）。
- **并行工作树协调**（计划三、F3 文档、F6 评测、行业研究在别的工作树里同时开发）：
  - 只拥有 `src/lib/judgments/**`、`src/app/api/judgments/**`、`src/app/api/methodologies/**`、`src/app/api/admin/judgments/**`、`src/app/api/cron/judgments-*/**`、`src/components/judgments/**`、`src/app/(app)/intel/methods/**`、`src/app/(app)/admin/judgments/**`、`scripts/judgments/**`、`docs/methodologies/**`、`fixtures/judgments/**`、`messages/{zh,en}/judgments.json`、`src/lib/dq/judgments-resolver.ts`。
  - **不得修改** `src/lib/facts/*`、`src/lib/entities/*`、其他模块目录。
  - 共享文件的改动放进 `// F4` … `// /F4` 注释围栏（SQL 用 `-- F4`；JSON 无注释的 `vercel.json` 只追加条目，不改已有条目）：`src/lib/dq/batches.ts`、`src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts`、`scripts/ci/research-checks.ts`（`criticalSuites`）、`vercel.json`、`src/i18n/request.ts`（`MESSAGE_DOMAINS`）、`src/app/api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]/route.ts`、`src/lib/data/sources/eastmoney.ts`、`src/lib/data/sources/datagateway.ts`、`src/lib/research/s4/ledger.ts`（只把 uuid 格式化换成 `uuidV8()` 调用）、`src/app/api/analyst/book/route.ts`、`src/app/api/analyst/recommendations/route.ts`、`src/app/(app)/analyst/**` 中改动的文件、`next.config.mjs`（Task 18：`outputFileTracingIncludes` 打包 `docs/methodologies/**`）。
  - 迁移时间戳只能是 `20261109HHMMSS_*`；本计划只建一个：`supabase/migrations/20261109150000_judgments.sql`。
- **迁移**：可重放（`create table if not exists`、`create or replace function`、`drop policy if exists` 后 `create policy`、`drop trigger if exists` 后 `create trigger`）。`supabase/migrations.lock.json` 只在 **Task 22** 追加 `{file, sha256}`（已锁文件不可再改；`scripts/ci/research-checks.ts::migrationInventory` 只要求未锁迁移的时间戳晚于已锁最新 `20261106090000`，所以开发期间不锁）。本地 harness 只建了 `storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types)`：迁移里桶只能 `insert into storage.buckets … on conflict (id) do update`，不得引用 `storage.objects`。
- **托管 PostgreSQL 17，`postgres` 非超级用户**：`security definer` 函数 owner 即迁移角色；函数 `set search_path = ''`，函数体内一律写全限定名（`public.judgments`、`pg_catalog.now()`）；不要 `alter function … owner to`。Supabase 默认给 `anon/authenticated` 新函数 EXECUTE：每个函数后显式 `revoke execute on function … from public, anon, authenticated` 再按组 `grant`。
- **`test:db`**（`scripts/ci/research-db.ts`）启动本地 PostgreSQL 17、按序执行全部迁移再跑 vitest；集成测试用 `process.env.S4_TEST_STATE` 读 `adminUrl`，`describe.skipIf(!enabled)`。**任何包含字符串 `S4_TEST_STATE` 的 `.test.ts` 都必须加进 `criticalSuites`**，否则 `test:db` 报 "Database suite inventory drift"。重放迁移用 `src/lib/facts/facts.integration.test.ts` 里的 `replayMigration` 写法（复制，不 import）。角色测试：本地 harness 建有 `anon`、`authenticated`、`service_role` 角色，用 `set local role anon` 在事务内切换（照 `src/lib/facts/facts.integration.test.ts` 的 RLS 用例写法）。
- **单文件数据库测试**：`.claude/scratch/db-one.ts`（未提交；内容见交接文档 §5），`LC_ALL=C PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH npx tsx .claude/scratch/db-one.ts <file>`。`LC_ALL=C` 只给 `test:db`/`test:migrations`/`db-one`，不要导出给 `npm test`。
- **命令**：`npm test -- <path>`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint`（`--max-warnings=0`）、`npm run test:db`、`npm run test:migrations`、`npm run build`（Task 21/22）。
- **提交**：`git commit` 单独一条命令（仓库钩子拦截同一命令里任何 `-n` 记号，含 `grep -n`、`head -n`）；不 `--no-verify`；信息末尾 `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`（实施者用自己的模型名）。
- **客户端**：管理员门禁 `requireAdminUser()`（`src/lib/admin/auth.ts`）；服务端写 `getAdminSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/admin.ts`）；公共读 `getAnonSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/anon.ts`，RLS 生效）。新 RPC **不登记**到 `database.types.ts` 的 `Functions`：调用处 `(client.rpc as unknown as RpcFn)('name', args)`，`RpcFn` 在 `src/lib/judgments/db.ts` 定义（Task 4）。
- **内容寻址**：`canonicalize` / `digest` / `sha256` 来自 `src/lib/research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js`（RFC 8785，`digest = sha256(canonicalize(v))`，hex）；F4 只经 `src/lib/judgments/canonical.ts` 包装调用（Task 1）。
- **代码风格**：沿用 `src/lib/dq`、`src/lib/facts` 的紧凑风格（单空格缩进、少空行、分号）；每个新文件顶部一段注释说明职责与规格条目（`spec §x.y`）。React 组件沿用 `src/components` 现有风格（两空格缩进、`'use client'` 仅在需要时）。
- **环境变量**：`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`、`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`、`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`、`CRON_SECRET`、`VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`（缺省用 `git rev-parse HEAD` 的脚本版本；见 Task 14 `resolveCodeVersion`）、DataGateway 配置沿用 `datagatewayConfig()`。
- **owner 默认值（规格 §17，本计划取默认，PR 里列为假设）**：O1 首批 = `macro_regime@v1` + `recommendation_call@v1`，不接 `decisions`；O2 `threshold_n=100`、`ece_max=0.10`、`window_years=3`；O3 宏观标签 = 同函数截止 vintage 重算，`macro_regime_asset_pair` 不实现；O4 `trading_sessions` 用 K 线序号；O5 `/analyst` 信心列改带状 + 自评，不建私有结算证据表；O6 未验证复权的市场 `void(adjustment_unsupported)`；O7 补登记不恢复前瞻资格；所有方法 `publishable=false`（许可未确认）。
- **宏观工作台不存在**：`macro_observations / macro_snapshots / regime.ts` 都不在仓库里。F4 在 `src/lib/judgments/macro-api.ts` 定义 `MacroReadApi`（规格 §12.1）与 `fixtureMacroReadApi(fixture)`；生产装配（Task 14 `deps.ts`）在宏观模块落地前用 `unavailableMacroReadApi()`（每个方法抛 `MacroUnavailable`，结算 → `Unavailable(macro_unavailable)`；补偿扫描 → 跳过并写信息码 `macro_unavailable`）。`macro_regime@v1` 的 `regime.ts` 依赖由夹具里的 `classify` 函数替身表达，方法 `status='draft'`（Task 19 说明）。

## 共享契约（所有任务必须用这些名字；`src/lib/judgments/types.ts` 原样落地，Task 1）

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/types.ts
// Shared contract of the judgment layer (plan F4 §共享契约; spec §3–§5.7, §7.2, §9). Every task uses
// these names verbatim. JudgmentsDb has three implementations: supabaseJudgmentsDb (db.ts, rpc),
// memoryJudgmentsDb (memory-judgments-db.ts, unit tests), pgJudgmentsDb (pg-judgments-db.ts, integration tests).
import type {KlineSourceName,SourceKlineSeries} from '@/lib/data/kline/types';
import type {FactRow,MetricRow,ReadFactsResult,FilingRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';

// ── markets (spec §3.3 S06) ──
export type FactsMarket='US'|'CN';
export type PriceMarket='A'|'HK'|'US';
export type Adjustment='qfq'|'hfq';

// ── subject (spec §3.1) ──
export type SubjectType='issuer'|'industry'|'macro_region'|'macro_series'|'security'|'document';
export const PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES=['issuer','industry','macro_region','macro_series'] as const;
export type PublicSubjectType=typeof PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES[number];
export interface Subject{type:SubjectType;key:string}

// ── kinds, producers, types (spec §3.2, §3.6, §4.3) ──
export type Kind='probability'|'categorical'|'score'|'interval';
export type ProducerKind='rule'|'model'|'human'|'third_party';
export const PUBLIC_PRODUCER_KINDS=['rule','model'] as const;
export type JudgmentType='macro_regime'|'macro_regime_asset_pair'|'recommendation_call'|'industry_lifecycle_stage'|'industry_prosperity'|'valuation_verdict'|'thesis_win_rate'|'return_range'|'sellside_rating'|'sellside_target_price'|'synthetic_fact_metric';
export interface Bilingual{zh:string;en:string}

// ── claims (spec §3.2) ──
export interface ProbabilityClaim{p:number;event:Bilingual}
export interface CategoricalClaim{selected:string;classes:string[];distribution?:Record<string,number>;scores_are_not_probabilities:boolean;margin_pp?:number;catalog_version?:string}
export interface ScoreDim{id:string;value:number|null;weight:number;coverage:boolean}
export interface ScoreClaim{value:number;scale:{min:number;max:number};dims:ScoreDim[];coverage:number;realized_metric:string}
export interface Scenario{label:string;p:number;value:number}
export interface IntervalClaim{metric:string;low:number;high:number;unit:string;nominal_coverage:number;scenarios?:Scenario[];scenario_event_hash?:string}
export type Claim=ProbabilityClaim|CategoricalClaim|ScoreClaim|IntervalClaim;
export interface Abstained{abstained:true;reason:string;missing?:string[]}

// ── conditions (spec §3.3) ──
export type NumOp='>'|'>='|'<'|'<='|'between';
export interface NumPredicate{op:NumOp;rhs:number|[number,number]}
export type Regime='recovery'|'overheat'|'stagflation'|'recession';
export interface PriceReturnParams{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket;adjustment:Adjustment;source:KlineSourceName;base_date:string;benchmark?:{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket}}
export interface FactMetricParams{issuer_id:string;market:FactsMarket;metric:string;period_start:string;period_end:string;duration:string;unit:string;input_unit:string;basis:string;formula_version:string;compare:'value'|'yoy'}
export interface MacroRegimeReplayParams{region:'US'|'CN';reference_period:string;macro_methodology_version:string;catalog_version:string}
export type Condition=
 |{resolver:'price_return';params:PriceReturnParams;predicate:NumPredicate;text:Bilingual}
 |{resolver:'fact_metric';params:FactMetricParams;predicate:NumPredicate;text:Bilingual}
 |{resolver:'macro_regime_replay';params:MacroRegimeReplayParams;predicate:{op:'eq';rhs:Regime};text:Bilingual}
 |{resolver:'industry_aggregate';params:Record<string,string|number>;predicate:NumPredicate|{op:'eq';rhs:string};text:Bilingual}
 |{resolver:'recommendation_hit';params:{recommendation_id:string};predicate:{op:'eq';rhs:true};text:Bilingual};
export type ResolverName=Condition['resolver'];
export const PUBLIC_RESOLVERS=['price_return','fact_metric','macro_regime_replay','industry_aggregate'] as const;

// ── horizon / target / label policy (spec §3.4) ──
export interface Horizon{unit:'trading_sessions'|'calendar_days'|'calendar_months'|'fiscal_quarters';n:number}
export type Target=
 |{kind:'session_index';base_date:string;n:number}
 |{kind:'date';date:string}
 |{kind:'period';period:string}
 |{kind:'fiscal_period';period_end:string;calendar:{anchor_period_end:string;months:3};extrapolated:boolean};
export type LabelPolicy='first_observed'|'cutoff_vintage';

// ── inputs (spec §3.5) ──
/** License status is NOT part of an origin (commander decision D3): it lives in docs/methodologies/licenses.json, read only by the sync script. */
export interface Origin{publisher:string;adapter:string;locator:string;transform?:string}
export interface InputRef<K extends string,R,S>{kind:K;ref:R;snapshot:S;hash:string;available_at:string;origin:Origin}
export interface FactProjection{fact_id:string;issuer_id:string;market:FactsMarket;concept:string;period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:string;value_text:string;unit:string;consolidation:string;available_date:string;filing_id:string;mapping_gen:number}
/** Every FactRow field the derive kernel reads (spec §3.5 S04); value is restored from value_text. */
export interface DerivationRow extends FactProjection{status:string;created_at:string;disclosure_seq:number|null;is_current:boolean|null;is_revision:boolean|null}
export interface MetricKey{issuer_id:string;market:FactsMarket;metric:string;period_start:string;period_end:string;input_unit:string;basis:string;formula_version:string}
export interface MetricSnapshot extends MetricKey{value_text:string;unit:string;duration:string;as_of:string;based_on_rev:number;lineage:MetricRow['inputs'];derivation:{formula_version:string;as_of:string;state_rev:number;rows:DerivationRow[]}}
export interface MacroObservationSnapshot{series_id:string;period_end:string;value:number;unit:string;vintage_id:string;available_at:string}
export interface MacroSnapshotSnapshot{snapshot_id:string;region:'US'|'CN';as_of:string;methodology_version:string;catalog_version:string;observation_ids:string[];primary_state:Regime|null;secondary_state:Regime|null;scores:Record<Regime,number>;norm:Record<Regime,number>;coverage:number;margin_pp:number|null;growth_axis:number|null;inflation_axis:number|null}
export interface PriceBarSnapshot{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket;date:string;source:KlineSourceName;adjustment:Adjustment;open:number|null;high:number|null;low:number|null;close:number;volume:number|null;amount:number|null;fields_present:string[]}
export const PUBLIC_TABLES=['issuer_industry_memberships','industry_classifications','macro_series'] as const;
export type PublicTable=typeof PUBLIC_TABLES[number];
export type Input=
 |InputRef<'financial_fact',{fact_id:string},FactProjection>
 |InputRef<'financial_metric',MetricKey,MetricSnapshot>
 |InputRef<'macro_observation',{series_id:string;period_end:string;vintage_id:string},MacroObservationSnapshot>
 |InputRef<'macro_snapshot',{snapshot_id:string},MacroSnapshotSnapshot>
 |InputRef<'price_bar',{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket;date:string;source:KlineSourceName;adjustment:Adjustment},PriceBarSnapshot>
 |InputRef<'table_rows',{table:PublicTable;natural_key:string},{table:PublicTable;natural_key:string;rows:Record<string,unknown>[]}>
 |InputRef<'judgment',{judgment_id:string},{judgment_id:string;claim:Claim;as_of:string}>
 |InputRef<'legacy_fill',{recommendation_id:string},{recommendation_id:string;fill_price:number;fill_date:string;market:PriceMarket;ticker:string}>
 |InputRef<'document_span',Record<string,string>,Record<string,unknown>>;
export type InputKind=Input['kind'];
export const PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS=['financial_fact','financial_metric','macro_observation','macro_snapshot','price_bar','table_rows','judgment'] as const;

// ── producer (spec §3.6) ──
export type ProducerRef=Record<string,never>|{model:string;prompt_sha256:string;run_id:string}|{analyst_id:string;source_record:{table:string;id:string}}|{institution:string;document_id:string;version_hash:string};

// ── rows (spec §5.1–§5.5b) ──
export type MethodologyStatus='draft'|'active'|'retired';
export interface MethodologyRow{methodology_id:string;version:string;judgment_type:JudgmentType;kind:Kind;producer_kind:ProducerKind;subject_types:SubjectType[];input_kinds:InputKind[];markets:PriceMarket[]|null;title_zh:string;title_en:string;doc_path:string;doc_sha256:string;implementation_sha256:string;params:Record<string,number|string>;params_json:Record<string,unknown>;horizon:Horizon;upstream:Record<string,string>;deps_sha256:string;formula_hash:string;status:MethodologyStatus;publishable:boolean;code_version:string;created_at:string;synced_at:string}
export type MethodologyEventKind='registered'|'status_changed'|'publishable_changed'|'resynced';
export interface MethodologyEvent{event_id:string;methodology_id:string;version:string;seq:number;event:MethodologyEventKind;status:MethodologyStatus;publishable:boolean;formula_hash:string;code_version:string;actor:string;reason:string|null;occurred_at:string}
export interface JudgmentRow{judgment_id:string;subject_type:PublicSubjectType;subject_key:string;judgment_type:JudgmentType;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;kind:Kind;producer_kind:'rule'|'model';producer_ref:ProducerRef;producer_nonce:string;as_of:string;registered_at:string;retrospective:boolean;inputs:Input[];inputs_hash:string;abstained:boolean;abstain_reason:string|null;claim:Claim|null;condition:Condition|null;horizon:Horizon|null;target:Target|null;label_policy:LabelPolicy|null;settle_after:string|null;settle_by:string|null;code_version:string;batch_id:string;created_at:string}
/** register_judgment input: registered_at/retrospective/created_at are set by the RPC (spec §5.6). */
export type JudgmentInsert=Omit<JudgmentRow,'registered_at'|'retrospective'|'created_at'>&{retrospective_hint:{label_available_at:string|null}};
export type SettlementKind='settled'|'void'|'withdrawn'|'reopened';
export interface Realized{value:number|string|boolean;label?:string;unit:string|null;from:string|null;to:string|null;label_policy:LabelPolicy}
export interface SettlementRow{settlement_id:string;judgment_id:string;seq:number;kind:SettlementKind;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;realized:Realized|null;evidence:Record<string,unknown>;resolver:string;resolver_version:string;reason:string|null;actor:string;settled_at:string;request_key:string;request_digest:string;code_version:string;batch_id:string}
/** append_settlement payload; the RPC assigns settlement_id/seq/settled_at (spec §5.6). */
export type SettlementInsert=Pick<SettlementRow,'kind'|'outcome'|'realized'|'evidence'|'resolver'|'resolver_version'|'reason'|'actor'|'code_version'|'batch_id'>;
export type QueueStatus='pending'|'unavailable'|'inconsistent'|'error';
/** cutoff = the resolution cutoff of the quarantine it accepts (payload.cutoff); a cutoff_vintage override is used only at that same cutoff (plan audit P1-03). */
export interface QuarantineOverride{reason_code:string;resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched';evidence_hash:string;evidence:Record<string,unknown>}|{kind:'choose_fact';chosen:Record<string,unknown>};evidence_hash:string;resolved_by:string;at:string;cutoff:string}
export interface QueueRow{judgment_id:string;settle_after:string;settle_by:string;label_policy:LabelPolicy;next_attempt_at:string;attempts:number;last_status:QueueStatus|null;last_detail:Record<string,unknown>;leased_until:string|null;lease_token:string|null;override:QuarantineOverride|null;closed_at:string|null;updated_at:string}
export interface QueuePatch{last_status:QueueStatus;last_detail:Record<string,unknown>;next_attempt_at:string;attempts_increment:0|1}
export type CalibrationState='insufficient'|'failed'|'calibrated'|'evaluated'|'self_assessed';
export type ScopeType='all'|'market'|'subject_type';
export interface CalibrationScope{scope_type:ScopeType;scope_key:string}
/** frozen_at / n: the freeze_calibration_cohort snapshot of the generation (plan audit P1-10); registered_at_lte = settled_at_lte = frozen_at. */
export interface QueryBounds{window_from:string;window_to:string;registered_at_lte:string;settled_at_lte:string;frozen_at:string;n:number}
export interface CalibrationRow{calibration_id:string;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;scope_type:ScopeType;scope_key:string;window_from:string;window_to:string;n_registered:number;n_settled:number;n_independent:number;n_void:number;n_retrospective_excluded:number;threshold_n:number;ece_max:number;kind:Kind;state:Exclude<CalibrationState,'self_assessed'>;valid_until:string;validity_revision:number;metrics:Record<string,unknown>;reliability:ReliabilityBin[];isotonic_segments:{x_min:number;x_max:number;p:number}[]|null;cohort_path:string;cohort_sha256:string;query_bounds:QueryBounds;fingerprint:string;algorithm_version:string;code_version:string;computed_at:string;batch_id:string}
export interface ReliabilityBin{bin_low:number;bin_high:number;n:number;mean_p:number|null;hit_rate:number|null;wilson_low:number|null;wilson_high:number|null}
/** latest_judgment_cards / judgment_history / calibration_cohort* row (spec §5.6 judgment_envelope). */
export interface Envelope{judgment:JudgmentRow;settlement:SettlementRow|null;calibration:CalibrationRow|null;calibration_valid:boolean;methodology_state:MethodologyEvent|null}
export type CardView='latest'|'as_known';
export type AppendStatus='applied'|'already_applied'|'already_final'|'request_key_conflict';

// ── data access (spec §5.7) ──
export interface JudgmentsDb{
 serverTime():Promise<string>;
 methodology(id:string,version:string):Promise<MethodologyRow|null>;
 subjectExists(subject:Subject):Promise<'active'|'inactive'|'missing'>;
 getJudgment(id:string):Promise<JudgmentRow|null>;
 /** Inputs containment lookup (GIN): judgments whose inputs contain {kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id}} (spec §7.1). */
 judgmentsBySnapshot(snapshotId:string):Promise<string[]>;
 registerJudgment(row:JudgmentInsert,queue:{settle_after:string;settle_by:string;label_policy:LabelPolicy}|null):Promise<{registered_at:string;retrospective:boolean}>;
 latestCards(subject:Subject,opts:{types?:JudgmentType[];view:CardView;cutoff?:string}):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 historyOf(subject:Subject,type:JudgmentType,methodology:{id:string;version:string},opts:{view:CardView;cutoff?:string;before?:string;limit:number}):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 claimDue(limit:number,leaseSeconds:number):Promise<QueueRow[]>;
 releaseLease(judgmentId:string,leaseToken:string,patch:QueuePatch):Promise<void>;
 queueRow(judgmentId:string):Promise<QueueRow|null>;
 queueList(opts:{filter:'due'|'backoff'|'leased'|'all';limit:number;after?:string}):Promise<QueueRow[]>;
 settlementsOf(judgmentIds:string[]):Promise<SettlementRow[]>;
 appendSettlement(judgmentId:string,leaseToken:string|null,requestKey:string,row:SettlementInsert):Promise<{seq:number;status:AppendStatus}>;
 /** Lease-checked quarantine publish (plan audit Q1-02): ONE transaction locks the queue row, checks the lease, upserts the open
  *  dq_quarantine item ('judgments' / 'judgment_settlements' / judgment_id / reasonCode) with payload, writes last_status
  *  'inconsistent' + last_detail ∪ {quarantine_id} (quarantined_at kept while the incident is unresolved, Q1-01) + next_attempt_at,
  *  clears the lease; attempts unchanged. A lost lease writes nothing. */
 quarantineSettlement(judgmentId:string,leaseToken:string,reasonCode:string,payload:Record<string,unknown>,patch:QueuePatch,batchId:string):Promise<{status:'quarantined'|'lease_lost';quarantine_id:string|null}>;
 /** Atomic acceptance (plan audit P1-04): locks queue then item; only for the open queue's current inconsistency. override.evidence_hash /
  *  override.cutoff are the identity the hook read: both must equal the locked queue last_detail AND the locked item payload (Q1-03). */
 applyQuarantineOverride(judgmentId:string,override:QuarantineOverride,quarantineId:string,audit:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<'applied'|'stale'|'closed'|'item_not_open'>;
 /** Atomic rejection (plan audit P1-05): void + item resolved_reject + audit in one transaction; replay-safe on requestKey. expected = the
  *  evidence_hash / cutoff the hook read; any difference from the locked queue last_detail or item payload → 'stale' (Q1-03). */
 rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgmentId:string,quarantineId:string,expected:{evidence_hash:string;cutoff:string},requestKey:string,row:SettlementInsert,audit:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<{seq:number;status:AppendStatus|'stale'|'item_not_open'}>;
 /** Public envelope by id (plan audit P2-01; RLS-gated, judgment_history view semantics). */
 envelopeById(id:string,opts:{view:CardView;cutoff?:string}):Promise<Envelope|null>;
 calibrationCohort(methodology:string,version:string,window:{from:string;to:string},cutoff:string,after:string|null,limit:number):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 calibrationCohortInternal(methodology:string,version:string,window:{from:string;to:string},cutoff:string,after:string|null,limit:number):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 /** Freezes a calibration generation's cohort in one statement (plan audit P1-10). The generation is claimed first (marker
  *  cohort:<generation>, Q1-05): an already claimed generation — even an empty one — returns already_frozen with its stored
  *  frozen_at / n and inserts nothing. */
 freezeCalibrationCohort(generation:string,methodology:string,version:string,window:{from:string;to:string}):Promise<{status:'frozen'|'already_frozen';frozen_at:string;n:number}>;
 /** The frozen members of a generation, keyset on judgment_id; settlement = the one frozen with it. */
 cohortMembers(generation:string,after:string|null,limit:number):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 /** Deletes the generation's members and its marker; returns the member rows deleted. */
 clearCalibrationGeneration(generation:string):Promise<number>;
 latestCalibration(methodology:string,version:string,scope:CalibrationScope):Promise<{row:CalibrationRow;valid:boolean}|null>;
 calibrationValidity(methodology:string,version:string):Promise<{revision:number}>;
 insertCalibration(row:CalibrationRow,expectedRevision:number):Promise<'inserted'|'duplicate'|'stale_revision'>;
 syncMethodology(row:Omit<MethodologyRow,'created_at'|'synced_at'>,actor:string,reason:string|null):Promise<{changed:boolean;seq:number}>;
 listMethodologies(status?:MethodologyStatus):Promise<MethodologyRow[]>;
 methodologyStateAt(id:string,version:string,cutoff:string):Promise<MethodologyEvent|null>;
 jobState(job:string):Promise<{state:Record<string,unknown>;updated_at:string}|null>;
 setJobState(job:string,expectedUpdatedAt:string|null,state:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<boolean>;
 repairStaleBatches(dataset:string,olderThanSeconds:number):Promise<number>;
}

// ── macro read interface (spec §12.1; implemented by the macro workbench later, by fixtures now) ──
export interface RegimeResult{primary_state:Regime;secondary_state:Regime|null;scores:Record<Regime,number>;norm:Record<Regime,number>;coverage:number;margin_pp:number;growth_axis:number|null;inflation_axis:number|null}
export interface MacroSnapshotRow{snapshot_id:string;region:'US'|'CN';as_of:string;methodology_version:string;catalog_version:string;observation_ids:string[];regime:RegimeResult|null;created_at:string;status:'active'|'superseded'|'failed'}
export interface MacroObservationRef{series_id:string;period_end:string;vintage_id:string;value:number;unit:string;available_at:string}
export interface MacroReadApi{
 observation(observationId:string):Promise<MacroObservationRef|null>;
 snapshot(snapshotId:string):Promise<MacroSnapshotRow|null>;
 snapshotsSince(marker:{created_at:string;snapshot_id:string}|null,limit:number):Promise<MacroSnapshotRow[]>;
 seriesCatalog(region:'US'|'CN'):Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>;
 classifyAsOf(region:'US'|'CN',referencePeriod:string,cutoff:string,macroMethodologyVersion:string):Promise<{regime:RegimeResult|null;observation_refs:MacroObservationRef[];catalog:{version:string;weights:Record<string,number>;rules_version:string}}>;
}

// ── inputs db (spec §5.7) ──
export type KlineFailure={failure:'unsupported'|'empty'|'not_found'|'rate_limited'|'transient'|'protocol'|'invalid_data'|'timeout'};
export interface KlineRangeRequest{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket;adjustment:Adjustment;source:KlineSourceName;from:string;to:string;signal:AbortSignal}
export interface DeriveAsOfResult{metrics:MetricRow[];envelope:ReadFactsResult}
export interface JudgmentInputsDb{
 facts:{readFacts(issuer:string,market:FactsMarket,opts:{concepts:string[];asOf:string;history?:boolean}):Promise<ReadFactsResult>;factsByIds(ids:string[]):Promise<FactRow[]>;filingsOfIssuer(issuer:string,market:FactsMarket,opts:{to?:string;limit?:number}):Promise<FilingRow[]>};
 deriveMetricsAsOf(issuer:string,market:FactsMarket,asOf:string,formulaVersion:string):Promise<DeriveAsOfResult>;
 macro:MacroReadApi;
 tableRows(table:PublicTable,naturalKey:string):Promise<Record<string,unknown>[]>;
 /** Public judgment lookup (anon; publishable only). */
 publicJudgment(id:string):Promise<JudgmentRow|null>;
 kline(req:KlineRangeRequest):Promise<SourceKlineSeries|KlineFailure>;
 issuerPrimarySecurity(issuerId:string,on:string):Promise<{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket}|null>;
}

// ── methodology module (spec §4.1) ──
export type Active<C extends Claim>={abstained:false;claim:C};
export interface WorkItem{subject:Subject;asOf:string;binding?:Record<string,string>}
export interface Methodology<C extends Claim=Claim>{
 id:string;version:string;judgment_type:JudgmentType;kind:Kind;producer_kind:ProducerKind;
 subject_types:SubjectType[];markets?:PriceMarket[];input_kinds:InputKind[];
 upstream?:{macro_methodology_version?:string;facts_formula_version?:string};
 title:Bilingual;doc:string;params:Record<string,number|string>;params_json?:Record<string,unknown>;horizon:Horizon;
 /** Non-import dependencies hashed into formula_hash (data files, rule tables). Paths relative to repo root. */
 deps:string[];
 /** Absolute repo-relative path of this module file (import-closure root for implementation_sha256). */
 module:string;
 status:MethodologyStatus;
 gather(item:WorkItem,db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Input[]|Abstained>;
 resolveTarget(item:WorkItem,inputs:Input[],db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Target|Abstained>;
 compute(subject:Subject,inputs:Input[]):Active<C>|Abstained;
 condition(subject:Subject,inputs:Input[],claim:C):Condition;
}

// ── resolvers (spec §7.2–§7.3) ──
export type ResolverResult=
 |{status:'resolved';value:number|string|boolean;label?:string;unit:string|null;from:string|null;to:string|null;label_available_at:string;evidence:Record<string,unknown>}
 |{status:'pending';reason:string;estimated_at?:string}
 |{status:'unavailable';failure:string}
 |{status:'inconsistent';reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch'|'settlement_ambiguous_fact'|'settlement_base_bar_missing'|'settlement_benchmark_gap';detail:Record<string,unknown>;evidence_hash:string;evidence:Record<string,unknown>};
export interface ResolveContext{judgment:JudgmentRow;cutoff:string;now:string;inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb;signal:AbortSignal}
export interface Resolver{
 name:ResolverName;version:string;
 validateParams(params:unknown):boolean;
 /** Estimated earliest instant the label can be known (spec §3.4 retrospective rule 3); null = unknown. */
 labelAvailableAt(params:unknown,target:Target):string|null;
 /** Worst-case fetch time per judgment, for the cron budget (spec §7.1). */
 maxFetchMs:number;
 resolve(ctx:ResolveContext):Promise<ResolverResult>;
 /** Build the Resolved result from a quarantine override's frozen evidence (spec §7.6); no reads. */
 fromOverride(judgment:JudgmentRow,override:QuarantineOverride):ResolverResult;
}

// ── display (spec §9) ──
export type Lifecycle='abstained'|'open'|'settled'|'void'|'withdrawn'|'pending_fill';
export interface JudgmentCard{
 judgment_id:string;subject:Subject;judgment_type:JudgmentType;kind:Kind;
 lifecycle:Lifecycle;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;calibration:CalibrationState;retrospective:boolean;
 as_of:string;registered_at:string;
 methodology:{id:string;version:string;title:Bilingual;href:string};
 display:{headline:Bilingual;percent:number|null;value:number|string|[number,number]|null;scale?:{min:number;max:number};dims?:{id:string;label:Bilingual;value:number|null;coverage:boolean}[];band?:'low'|'mid'|'high';nominal_coverage?:number};
 condition:{text:Bilingual;horizon:Horizon;target:Target;label_policy:LabelPolicy;settle_after:string;settle_by:string}|null;
 settlement:{kind:SettlementKind;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;realized:Realized|null;settled_at:string;evidence_summary:Bilingual}|null;
 calibration_summary:{n_independent:number;n_total:number;threshold_n:number;brier:number|null;brier_skill:number|null;ece_raw_holdout:number|null;valid_until:string;hit_rate:{rate:number;low:number|null;high:number|null}|null;accuracy?:number|null;coverage?:number|null;spearman?:number|null;href:string}|null;
 inputs:{kind:InputKind;ref:unknown;available_at:string;origin:Origin;href:string|null}[];
 abstain_reason?:string;missing?:string[];
 merged_from?:string;
}
export interface PrivateJudgmentCard extends JudgmentCard{source:'recommendation'}
```

契约补充（实施者必须遵守）：
- 所有时间戳是 ISO 8601 UTC 字符串（`toISOString()` 形状，毫秒精度）；`as_of`、`*_date`、`period_*` 是 `YYYY-MM-DD`；`period` 是 `YYYY-MM`。
- `JudgmentRow.inputs` 在数据库是 `jsonb`；`inputs_hash = digest(inputs 按 (kind, canonicalize(ref)) 升序后的 [kind, ref, hash] 数组)`（`canonical.ts::inputsHash`）。
- `judgment_id = uuidV8(digest({subject_type, subject_key, judgment_type, methodology_id, methodology_version, as_of, inputs_hash, producer_nonce}))`（`contract.ts::judgmentIdOf`）。
- `JudgmentInsert.retrospective_hint.label_available_at` 是 resolver `labelAvailableAt()` 的结果；`register_judgment` RPC 用它与 `now()` 判定 `retrospective`（规格 §3.4 三条规则在 SQL 里算，因为 `registered_at` 只有数据库知道）。
- `QueuePatch.next_attempt_at` 必须 ≥ 调用时的 `serverTime()`；RPC 把更早的值抬到 `now()`。
- `MacroSnapshotSnapshot.margin_pp` 是百分点（规格 §8.1 G28）。
- **结算窗口算术**（唯一 TS 实现是 `time.ts::settleWindowOf`，`target.ts::settleWindow` 只是它的别名；与 SQL 的 `register_judgment` 重算必须逐字一致，Task 3 对拍，规格 §3.4）：`settle_after` 是一个 UTC 日期 `D` 的 `00:00:00.000Z`，`D` = `session_index`: `base_date + n` 天；`date`: `target.date`；`period`: 该月最后一天 + 1 天（即下月 1 日）；`fiscal_period`: `period_end + 1` 天。`settle_by = settle_after + grace_days` 天（`grace_days` = 方法 `params.grace_days`，整数；方法未给时按 `horizon.unit` 取默认：`trading_sessions` 60、`calendar_days`/`calendar_months` 30、`fiscal_quarters` 120）。
- **retrospective**（SQL 里算，`registered_at = now()`）：`as_of < (registered_at at time zone 'UTC')::date` **或** `settle_after ≤ registered_at` **或** `retrospective_hint.label_available_at ≤ registered_at`。
- **数据库角色与客户端**：`supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon, admin})` 接两个客户端——`latestCards / historyOf / envelopeById / calibrationCohort / methodologyStateAt / listMethodologies / latestCalibration / serverTime` 走 `anon`（RLS 生效，发布门控），其余全部走 `admin`（service_role，只经 RPC 写）。`memoryJudgmentsDb()` 在公共读方法上复刻 `publishable` 门控；`pgJudgmentsDb(pool)` 的公共读在事务内 `set local role anon`。
- **隔离数据集名**：判断层隔离项的 `dataset` 一律 `'judgments'`，`table_name` = `'judgments'`（登记冲突）或 `'judgment_settlements'`（结算类），`natural_key` = `judgment_id`；批次 `dataset`：`judgments.produce.<methodology_id>`、`judgments.settle`、`judgments.calibrate`；`producer` = `'ts-judgments'`。
- 校准续跑的崩溃 / 并发测试（规格 §14.2 的 R02、S01、R05 清空重试）属于应用层，在 **Task 16** 用 `pgJudgmentsDb` + 内存 `CohortStore` 写；Task 3 只测 SQL 函数本身。

规格偏差（记入实施记录）：
- §3.1 `validateSubject` 的格式错误规格没有专门的码；本计划用 `subject_missing`（消息 `invalid_subject_key:<type>`）——格式不对的主体在库里必然不存在。
- §3.2 claim 校验拒绝未知成员（claim 进登记行且参与 `idempotency_conflict` 比较，多余键会让"同语义不同字节"成为冲突），并加了两条规格隐含的一致性规则：`score.dims[i].coverage=false ⇔ value=null`（"缺维度就缺"）、`interval.scenarios` 的 `p` 之和与 1 相差 ≤ 1e-9。
- `job-keys.ts` 对 `scope_type='all'` 要求 `scope_key=''`，其余 scope 要求非空。

```ts
export interface JudgmentRow{judgment_id:string;subject_type:PublicSubjectType;subject_key:string;judgment_type:JudgmentType;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;kind:Kind;producer_kind:'rule'|'model';producer_ref:ProducerRef;producer_nonce:string;as_of:string;registered_at:string;retrospective:boolean;inputs:Input[];inputs_hash:string;abstained:boolean;abstain_reason:string|null;claim:Claim|null;condition:Condition|null;horizon:Horizon|null;target:Target|null;label_policy:LabelPolicy|null;settle_after:string|null;settle_by:string|null;code_version:string;batch_id:string;created_at:string}
/** register_judgment input: registered_at/retrospective/created_at are set by the RPC (spec §5.6). */

export type SettlementKind='settled'|'void'|'withdrawn'|'reopened';

export interface SettlementRow{settlement_id:string;judgment_id:string;seq:number;kind:SettlementKind;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;realized:Realized|null;evidence:Record<string,unknown>;resolver:string;resolver_version:string;reason:string|null;actor:string;settled_at:string;request_key:string;request_digest:string;code_version:string;batch_id:string}
/** append_settlement payload; the RPC assigns settlement_id/seq/settled_at (spec §5.6). */
export type SettlementInsert=Pick<SettlementRow,'kind'|'outcome'|'realized'|'evidence'|'resolver'|'resolver_version'|'reason'|'actor'|'code_version'|'batch_id'>;
export type QueueStatus='pending'|'unavailable'|'inconsistent'|'error';
/** cutoff = the resolution cutoff of the quarantine it accepts (payload.cutoff); a cutoff_vintage override is used only at that same cutoff (plan audit P1-03). */
export interface QuarantineOverride{reason_code:string;resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched';evidence_hash:string;evidence:Record<string,unknown>}|{kind:'choose_fact';chosen:Record<string,unknown>};evidence_hash:string;resolved_by:string;at:string;cutoff:string}
export interface QueueRow{judgment_id:string;settle_after:string;settle_by:string;label_policy:LabelPolicy;next_attempt_at:string;attempts:number;last_status:QueueStatus|null;last_detail:Record<string,unknown>;leased_until:string|null;lease_token:string|null;override:QuarantineOverride|null;closed_at:string|null;updated_at:string}
export interface QueuePatch{last_status:QueueStatus;last_detail:Record<string,unknown>;next_attempt_at:string;attempts_increment:0|1}
export type CalibrationState='insufficient'|'failed'|'calibrated'|'evaluated'|'self_assessed';

export interface CalibrationScope{scope_type:ScopeType;scope_key:string}
/** frozen_at / n: the freeze_calibration_cohort snapshot of the generation (plan audit P1-10); registered_at_lte = settled_at_lte = frozen_at. */
export interface QueryBounds{window_from:string;window_to:string;registered_at_lte:string;settled_at_lte:string;frozen_at:string;n:number}
export interface CalibrationRow{calibration_id:string;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;scope_type:ScopeType;scope_key:string;window_from:string;window_to:string;n_registered:number;n_settled:number;n_independent:number;n_void:number;n_retrospective_excluded:number;threshold_n:number;ece_max:number;kind:Kind;state:Exclude<CalibrationState,'self_assessed'>;valid_until:string;validity_revision:number;metrics:Record<string,unknown>;reliability:ReliabilityBin[];isotonic_segments:{x_min:number;x_max:number;p:number}[]|null;cohort_path:string;cohort_sha256:string;query_bounds:QueryBounds;fingerprint:string;algorithm_version:string;code_version:string;computed_at:string;batch_id:string}

// ── data access (spec §5.7) ──
export interface JudgmentsDb{
 serverTime():Promise<string>;
 methodology(id:string,version:string):Promise<MethodologyRow|null>;
 subjectExists(subject:Subject):Promise<'active'|'inactive'|'missing'>;
 getJudgment(id:string):Promise<JudgmentRow|null>;
 /** Inputs containment lookup (GIN): judgments whose inputs contain {kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id}} (spec §7.1). */
 judgmentsBySnapshot(snapshotId:string):Promise<string[]>;
 registerJudgment(row:JudgmentInsert,queue:{settle_after:string;settle_by:string;label_policy:LabelPolicy}|null):Promise<{registered_at:string;retrospective:boolean}>;
 latestCards(subject:Subject,opts:{types?:JudgmentType[];view:CardView;cutoff?:string}):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 historyOf(subject:Subject,type:JudgmentType,methodology:{id:string;version:string},opts:{view:CardView;cutoff?:string;before?:string;limit:number}):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 claimDue(limit:number,leaseSeconds:number):Promise<QueueRow[]>;
 releaseLease(judgmentId:string,leaseToken:string,patch:QueuePatch):Promise<void>;
 queueRow(judgmentId:string):Promise<QueueRow|null>;
 queueList(opts:{filter:'due'|'backoff'|'leased'|'all';limit:number;after?:string}):Promise<QueueRow[]>;
 settlementsOf(judgmentIds:string[]):Promise<SettlementRow[]>;
 appendSettlement(judgmentId:string,leaseToken:string|null,requestKey:string,row:SettlementInsert):Promise<{seq:number;status:AppendStatus}>;
 /** Lease-checked quarantine publish (plan audit Q1-02): ONE transaction locks the queue row, checks the lease, upserts the open
  *  dq_quarantine item ('judgments' / 'judgment_settlements' / judgment_id / reasonCode) with payload, writes last_status
  *  'inconsistent' + last_detail ∪ {quarantine_id} (quarantined_at kept while the incident is unresolved, Q1-01) + next_attempt_at,
  *  clears the lease; attempts unchanged. A lost lease writes nothing. */
 quarantineSettlement(judgmentId:string,leaseToken:string,reasonCode:string,payload:Record<string,unknown>,patch:QueuePatch,batchId:string):Promise<{status:'quarantined'|'lease_lost';quarantine_id:string|null}>;
 /** Atomic acceptance (plan audit P1-04): locks queue then item; only for the open queue's current inconsistency. override.evidence_hash /
  *  override.cutoff are the identity the hook read: both must equal the locked queue last_detail AND the locked item payload (Q1-03). */
 applyQuarantineOverride(judgmentId:string,override:QuarantineOverride,quarantineId:string,audit:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<'applied'|'stale'|'closed'|'item_not_open'>;
 /** Atomic rejection (plan audit P1-05): void + item resolved_reject + audit in one transaction; replay-safe on requestKey. expected = the
  *  evidence_hash / cutoff the hook read; any difference from the locked queue last_detail or item payload → 'stale' (Q1-03). */
 rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgmentId:string,quarantineId:string,expected:{evidence_hash:string;cutoff:string},requestKey:string,row:SettlementInsert,audit:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<{seq:number;status:AppendStatus|'stale'|'item_not_open'}>;
 /** Public envelope by id (plan audit P2-01; RLS-gated, judgment_history view semantics). */
 envelopeById(id:string,opts:{view:CardView;cutoff?:string}):Promise<Envelope|null>;
 calibrationCohort(methodology:string,version:string,window:{from:string;to:string},cutoff:string,after:string|null,limit:number):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 calibrationCohortInternal(methodology:string,version:string,window:{from:string;to:string},cutoff:string,after:string|null,limit:number):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 /** Freezes a calibration generation's cohort in one statement (plan audit P1-10). The generation is claimed first (marker
  *  cohort:<generation>, Q1-05): an already claimed generation — even an empty one — returns already_frozen with its stored
  *  frozen_at / n and inserts nothing. */
 freezeCalibrationCohort(generation:string,methodology:string,version:string,window:{from:string;to:string}):Promise<{status:'frozen'|'already_frozen';frozen_at:string;n:number}>;
 /** The frozen members of a generation, keyset on judgment_id; settlement = the one frozen with it. */
 cohortMembers(generation:string,after:string|null,limit:number):Promise<Envelope[]>;
 /** Deletes the generation's members and its marker; returns the member rows deleted. */
 clearCalibrationGeneration(generation:string):Promise<number>;
 latestCalibration(methodology:string,version:string,scope:CalibrationScope):Promise<{row:CalibrationRow;valid:boolean}|null>;
 calibrationValidity(methodology:string,version:string):Promise<{revision:number}>;
 insertCalibration(row:CalibrationRow,expectedRevision:number):Promise<'inserted'|'duplicate'|'stale_revision'>;
 syncMethodology(row:Omit<MethodologyRow,'created_at'|'synced_at'>,actor:string,reason:string|null):Promise<{changed:boolean;seq:number}>;
 listMethodologies(status?:MethodologyStatus):Promise<MethodologyRow[]>;
 methodologyStateAt(id:string,version:string,cutoff:string):Promise<MethodologyEvent|null>;
 jobState(job:string):Promise<{state:Record<string,unknown>;updated_at:string}|null>;
 setJobState(job:string,expectedUpdatedAt:string|null,state:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<boolean>;
 repairStaleBatches(dataset:string,olderThanSeconds:number):Promise<number>;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/canonical.test.ts
// canonical.ts wraps pa-v1/json.js unchanged (RFC 8785) and adds inputsHash (spec §3.5): free of input
// order, sensitive to every kind/ref/hash; jsonClean drops undefined members the way JSON storage does.
// errors.ts: the code table covers spec §13 plus the plan's codes.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {canonicalize as jcs,digest as jcsDigest} from '../research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js';
import {canonicalize,digest,inputsHash,jsonClean,sha256} from './canonical';
import {JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES,JudgmentError,isJudgmentError} from './errors';

const obs=(series:string,hash='a'.repeat(64))=>({kind:'macro_observation' as const,ref:{series_id:series,period_end:'2026-01-31',vintage_id:'v1'},hash});

describe('canonical',()=>{
 it('is the pa-v1 RFC 8785 implementation',()=>{
  const v={b:[1,'x',null,true],a:{d:0.1,c:'中'}};
  expect(canonicalize(v)).toBe(jcs(v));
  expect(canonicalize(v)).toBe('{"a":{"c":"中","d":0.1},"b":[1,"x",null,true]}');
  expect(digest(v)).toBe(jcsDigest(v));
  expect(sha256('abc')).toBe(createHash('sha256').update('abc').digest('hex'));
  expect(()=>canonicalize({x:undefined})).toThrow('invalid_schema');
 });
 it('jsonClean drops undefined object members recursively and keeps everything else',()=>{
  expect(jsonClean({a:1,b:undefined,c:{d:undefined,e:[1,{f:undefined,g:null}]}})).toEqual({a:1,c:{e:[1,{g:null}]}});
  expect(digest(jsonClean({a:1,b:undefined}))).toBe(digest({a:1}));
  expect(jsonClean(null)).toBeNull();
  expect(jsonClean('x')).toBe('x');
 });
 it('inputsHash ignores input order and changes with any kind, ref or hash',()=>{
  const a=obs('CPI'),b=obs('GDP'),c={kind:'financial_fact' as const,ref:{fact_id:'f1'},hash:'b'.repeat(64)};
  const h=inputsHash([a,b,c]);
  expect(h).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  expect(inputsHash([c,b,a])).toBe(h);
  expect(inputsHash([b,c,a])).toBe(h);
  expect(inputsHash([a,b,{...c,hash:'c'.repeat(64)}])).not.toBe(h);
  expect(inputsHash([a,b,{...c,ref:{fact_id:'f2'}}])).not.toBe(h);
  expect(inputsHash([a,b,{...c,kind:'financial_metric' as const}])).not.toBe(h);
  expect(inputsHash([a,obs('GDP','d'.repeat(64)),c])).not.toBe(h);
  expect(inputsHash([])).toBe(digest([]));
  expect(inputsHash([a])).toBe(digest([['macro_observation',a.ref,a.hash]]));
 });
 it('inputsHash is order-free even for repeated (kind, ref) pairs and canonical in ref key order',()=>{
  const x=obs('CPI','1'.repeat(64)),y=obs('CPI','2'.repeat(64));
  expect(inputsHash([x,y])).toBe(inputsHash([y,x]));
  expect(inputsHash([{kind:'macro_observation',ref:{vintage_id:'v1',period_end:'2026-01-31',series_id:'CPI'},hash:'a'.repeat(64)}])).toBe(inputsHash([obs('CPI')]));
 });
});

describe('errors',()=>{
 it('covers every spec §13 code and every plan code',()=>{
  const spec13=['methodology_unavailable','subject_missing','subject_inactive','subject_type_not_public','input_not_allowed','input_snapshot_mismatch','input_not_public','input_origin_unknown','lease_lost','stale_revision','request_key_conflict','job_state_conflict','formula_hash_drift','lookahead','idempotency_conflict','invalid_claim','invalid_condition','code_version_missing','input_hash_mismatch','invalid_parameter','unknown_judgment','unknown_methodology','settlement_sequence','resolution_not_applicable'];
  const plan=['unsupported_formula_version','metric_not_reproducible','market_unsupported','target_unresolvable','macro_unavailable','read_truncated','methodology_mismatch','settle_window_mismatch','duplicate_key','item_not_open','unknown',
   'input_unavailable','snapshot_unclassified','binding_not_referenced','override_mismatch'];   // integrator (D5): every code a later task throws
  for(const c of [...spec13,...plan])expect(JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES).toContain(c);
  expect(new Set(JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES).size).toBe(JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES.length);
 });
 it('carries code, message and detail; isJudgmentError narrows by code',()=>{
  const e=new JudgmentError('lookahead','late input',{input:0});
  expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(Error);expect(e.name).toBe('JudgmentError');
  expect(e.code).toBe('lookahead');expect(e.message).toBe('late input');expect(e.detail).toEqual({input:0});
  expect(new JudgmentError('unknown').message).toBe('unknown');
  expect(isJudgmentError(e)).toBe(true);expect(isJudgmentError(e,'lookahead')).toBe(true);
  expect(isJudgmentError(e,'lease_lost')).toBe(false);expect(isJudgmentError(new Error('lookahead'))).toBe(false);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/contract.test.ts
// spec §3.1–§3.4, §3.6, §6.1: subject formats and the public subset, claims per kind, horizon bounds,
// Active|Abstained discrimination, nonce per producer kind, the three retrospective rules, and the
// content-addressed id (golden value computed from pa-v1/json.js before this task).
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {uuidV8} from './uuid-v8';
import {digest} from './canonical';
import {isAbstained,isRetrospective,judgmentIdOf,producerNonceOf,validateClaim,validateHorizon,validateSubject} from './contract';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';

const ISSUER='3f2504e0-4f89-41d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301';
const code=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();return 'ok';}catch(e){return e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:`other:${String(e)}`;}};

describe('validateSubject',()=>{
 it('accepts the four public formats and returns only type and key',()=>{
  expect(validateSubject({type:'issuer',key:ISSUER})).toEqual({type:'issuer',key:ISSUER});
  expect(validateSubject({type:'industry',key:'sw2021:2021:801010'})).toEqual({type:'industry',key:'sw2021:2021:801010'});
  expect(validateSubject({type:'macro_region',key:'CN'})).toEqual({type:'macro_region',key:'CN'});
  expect(validateSubject({type:'macro_series',key:'US.CPIAUCSL'})).toEqual({type:'macro_series',key:'US.CPIAUCSL'});
  expect(validateSubject({type:'macro_region',key:'US',extra:1})).toEqual({type:'macro_region',key:'US'});
 });
 it('refuses security and document on the public table and accepts them for private adapters',()=>{
  expect(code(()=>validateSubject({type:'security',key:'US:AAPL'}))).toBe('subject_type_not_public');
  expect(code(()=>validateSubject({type:'document',key:'doc-1'}))).toBe('subject_type_not_public');
  expect(validateSubject({type:'security',key:'A:600519'},{publicOnly:false})).toEqual({type:'security',key:'A:600519'});
  expect(validateSubject({type:'document',key:'doc-1'},{publicOnly:false})).toEqual({type:'document',key:'doc-1'});
 });
 it('refuses malformed keys and unknown types with subject_missing',()=>{
  const bad:unknown[]=[{type:'issuer',key:'not-a-uuid'},{type:'issuer',key:ISSUER.toUpperCase()},{type:'industry',key:'sw2021:2021'},{type:'industry',key:'nope:2021:801010'},{type:'industry',key:'sw2021::801010'},{type:'industry',key:'sw2021:2021:801 010'},
   {type:'macro_region',key:'HK'},{type:'macro_series',key:''},{type:'macro_series',key:'x'.repeat(129)},{type:'macro_series',key:' CPI'},{type:'planet',key:'x'},{type:'issuer'},null,'issuer'];
  for(const s of bad)expect({s,c:code(()=>validateSubject(s))}).toEqual({s,c:'subject_missing'});
  for(const s of [{type:'security',key:'JP:7203'},{type:'security',key:'US:'},{type:'security',key:'AAPL'}])expect({s,c:code(()=>validateSubject(s,{publicOnly:false}))}).toEqual({s,c:'subject_missing'});
 });
});

const P={p:0.6,event:{zh:'上涨',en:'up'}};
const C={selected:'recovery',classes:['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'],distribution:{recovery:0.4,overheat:0.3,stagflation:0.2,recession:0.1},scores_are_not_probabilities:true,margin_pp:10,catalog_version:'cat/1'};
const S={value:62,scale:{min:0,max:100},dims:[{id:'growth',value:70,weight:0.5,coverage:true},{id:'valuation',value:null,weight:0.5,coverage:false}],coverage:0.5,realized_metric:'revenue_cagr_3y'};
const I={metric:'price_return',low:-0.1,high:0.2,unit:'ratio',nominal_coverage:0.8,scenarios:[{label:'bear',p:0.2,value:-0.1},{label:'base',p:0.5,value:0.05},{label:'bull',p:0.3,value:0.2}],scenario_event_hash:'e'.repeat(64)};

describe('validateClaim',()=>{
 it('accepts a valid claim of each kind and returns it unchanged',()=>{
  expect(validateClaim('probability',P)).toEqual(P);
  expect(validateClaim('probability',{...P,p:0})).toEqual({...P,p:0});
  expect(validateClaim('probability',{...P,p:1})).toEqual({...P,p:1});
  expect(validateClaim('categorical',C)).toEqual(C);
  expect(validateClaim('categorical',{selected:'a',classes:['a','b'],scores_are_not_probabilities:false})).toEqual({selected:'a',classes:['a','b'],scores_are_not_probabilities:false});
  expect(validateClaim('score',S)).toEqual(S);
  expect(validateClaim('interval',I)).toEqual(I);
  expect(validateClaim('interval',{metric:'m',low:1,high:1,unit:'x',nominal_coverage:0.5})).toEqual({metric:'m',low:1,high:1,unit:'x',nominal_coverage:0.5});
 });
 it('probability: p in [0,1], bilingual event, no unknown members',()=>{
  for(const c of [{...P,p:1.01},{...P,p:-0.01},{...P,p:Number.NaN},{...P,p:'0.5'},{...P,event:{zh:'x'}},{...P,event:{zh:'',en:'x'}},{...P,event:{zh:'x',en:'y',fr:'z'}},{...P,extra:1},{p:0.5},null,[]])
   expect({c,r:code(()=>validateClaim('probability',c))}).toEqual({c,r:'invalid_claim'});
 });
 it('categorical: selected in unique classes, distribution keys in classes and non-negative, flag required',()=>{
  for(const c of [{...C,selected:'boom'},{...C,classes:['a','a']},{...C,classes:[]},{...C,distribution:{boom:1}},{...C,distribution:{recovery:-0.1}},{...C,scores_are_not_probabilities:undefined},{...C,margin_pp:-1},{...C,catalog_version:''},{...C,extra:true}])
   expect({c,r:code(()=>validateClaim('categorical',c))}).toEqual({c,r:'invalid_claim'});
 });
 it('score: value inside the scale, missing dimensions stay missing, coverage in [0,1]',()=>{
  const dims=S.dims;
  for(const c of [{...S,value:101},{...S,scale:{min:5,max:5}},{...S,dims:[{...dims[0],value:null}]},{...S,dims:[{...dims[1],value:50}]},{...S,dims:[dims[0],dims[0]]},{...S,dims:[{...dims[0],weight:-1}]},{...S,coverage:1.5},{...S,realized_metric:''},{...S,dims:[{...dims[0],note:'x'}]}])
   expect({c,r:code(()=>validateClaim('score',c))}).toEqual({c,r:'invalid_claim'});
 });
 it('interval: low <= high, nominal coverage strictly inside (0,1), scenario probabilities sum to 1',()=>{
  for(const c of [{...I,low:0.3},{...I,nominal_coverage:0},{...I,nominal_coverage:1},{...I,scenarios:[{label:'a',p:0.5,value:1},{label:'b',p:0.4,value:2}]},{...I,scenarios:[]},{...I,scenarios:[{label:'',p:1,value:1}]},{...I,scenario_event_hash:'xyz'},{...I,unit:''},{...I,extra:1}])
   expect({c,r:code(()=>validateClaim('interval',c))}).toEqual({c,r:'invalid_claim'});
 });
});

describe('validateHorizon, isAbstained',()=>{
 it('accepts each unit inside its bounds (calendar_months allows n=0) and refuses everything else',()=>{
  expect(validateHorizon({unit:'trading_sessions',n:5})).toEqual({unit:'trading_sessions',n:5});
  expect(validateHorizon({unit:'calendar_months',n:0})).toEqual({unit:'calendar_months',n:0});
  expect(validateHorizon({unit:'fiscal_quarters',n:12})).toEqual({unit:'fiscal_quarters',n:12});
  for(const h of [{unit:'trading_sessions',n:0},{unit:'calendar_days',n:1.5},{unit:'calendar_days',n:3661},{unit:'weeks',n:2},{unit:'calendar_days',n:3,extra:1},{unit:'fiscal_quarters'},null])
   expect({h,r:code(()=>validateHorizon(h))}).toEqual({h,r:'invalid_condition'});
 });
 it('discriminates Abstained from Active',()=>{
  expect(isAbstained({abstained:true,reason:'no_inputs'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isAbstained({abstained:false,claim:P})).toBe(false);
  for(const x of [null,'abstained',{abstained:'true'},{reason:'x'}])expect(isAbstained(x)).toBe(false);
 });
});

describe('judgmentIdOf, producerNonceOf, isRetrospective',()=>{
 const F={subject_type:'macro_region' as const,subject_key:'US',judgment_type:'macro_regime',methodology_id:'macro_regime',methodology_version:'v1',as_of:'2026-11-06',inputs_hash:'a'.repeat(64),producer_nonce:''};
 it('is uuidV8 of the digest of exactly the eight addressed fields (spec §6.1)',()=>{
  expect(judgmentIdOf(F)).toBe('e1b53b0d-831f-8a78-a4ce-42858ea12057');
  expect(judgmentIdOf(F)).toBe(uuidV8(digest(F)));
  expect(judgmentIdOf({...F,claim:{p:0.9}} as typeof F)).toBe(judgmentIdOf(F));   // claim is not addressed
  for(const k of Object.keys(F) as (keyof typeof F)[]){
   const v=k==='inputs_hash'?'b'.repeat(64):k==='subject_type'?'issuer':`${F[k]}x`;
   expect({k,same:judgmentIdOf({...F,[k]:v})===judgmentIdOf(F)}).toEqual({k,same:false});
  }
  expect(code(()=>judgmentIdOf({...F,inputs_hash:'abc'}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
 });
 it('derives the nonce per producer kind (spec §3.6)',()=>{
  expect(producerNonceOf('rule',{})).toBe('');
  expect(producerNonceOf('model',{model:'m1',prompt_sha256:'c'.repeat(64),run_id:'run-7'})).toBe('run-7');
  expect(producerNonceOf('human',{analyst_id:'a1',source_record:{table:'recommendations',id:'r9'}})).toBe('a1:recommendations:r9');
  expect(producerNonceOf('third_party',{institution:'GS',document_id:'d1',version_hash:'f'.repeat(64)})).toBe(`d1:${'f'.repeat(64)}`);
  expect(code(()=>producerNonceOf('rule',{x:1} as never))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>producerNonceOf('model',{model:'m1',prompt_sha256:'short',run_id:'r'}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>producerNonceOf('human',{analyst_id:'a1'} as never))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
 });
 it('applies the three retrospective rules of spec §3.4 against registered_at',()=>{
  const at='2026-11-06T03:00:00.000Z';
  const base={as_of:'2026-11-06',registered_at:at,settle_after:'2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z',label_available_at:null};
  expect(isRetrospective(base)).toBe(false);
  expect(isRetrospective({...base,as_of:'2026-11-05'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isRetrospective({...base,settle_after:at})).toBe(true);
  expect(isRetrospective({...base,settle_after:null})).toBe(false);
  expect(isRetrospective({...base,label_available_at:'2026-11-06T02:59:59.999Z'})).toBe(true);
  expect(isRetrospective({...base,label_available_at:'2026-11-06T03:00:00.001Z'})).toBe(false);
  expect(isRetrospective({...base,registered_at:'2026-11-06T23:59:59.999Z'})).toBe(false);   // UTC date of registered_at
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/job-keys.test.ts
// spec §5.5b R01: jobKey is the only constructor of judgment_job_state keys; every component is
// percent-encoded so 'v1', 'US', ':' and non-ASCII scope keys are all legal and never collide.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {jobKey,parseJobKey} from './job-keys';
import type {CalibrationScope} from './types';

const code=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();return 'ok';}catch(e){return e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:'other';}};

describe('jobKey',()=>{
 it('builds the produce and calibrate keys of spec §5.5b',()=>{
  expect(jobKey('produce','macro_regime','v1')).toBe('produce:macro_regime@v1');
  expect(jobKey('calibrate','macro_regime','v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''})).toBe('calibrate:macro_regime@v1:all:');
  expect(jobKey('calibrate','macro_regime','v1',{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'US'})).toBe('calibrate:macro_regime@v1:market:US');
  expect(jobKey('calibrate','x','v2',{scope_type:'subject_type',scope_key:'issuer'})).toBe('calibrate:x@v2:subject_type:issuer');
 });
 it('percent-encodes separators, % and non-ASCII in every component',()=>{
  expect(jobKey('calibrate','m','v1',{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'sw2021:2021:801010'})).toBe('calibrate:m@v1:market:sw2021%3A2021%3A801010');
  expect(jobKey('calibrate','m','v1',{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'港股'})).toBe('calibrate:m@v1:market:%E6%B8%AF%E8%82%A1');
  expect(jobKey('produce','a@b%c','v1')).toBe('produce:a%40b%25c@v1');
  expect(jobKey('calibrate_round')).toBe('calibrate_round');                               // P2-02: one global round cursor
  expect(parseJobKey('calibrate_round')).toEqual({kind:'calibrate_round'});
 });
 it('round-trips through parseJobKey and keeps distinct inputs distinct',()=>{
  const cases:{id:string;version:string;scope?:CalibrationScope}[]=[
   {id:'macro_regime',version:'v1'},{id:'macro_regime',version:'v1',scope:{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''}},{id:'m',version:'v1',scope:{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'US'}},
   {id:'m',version:'v1',scope:{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'a:b'}},{id:'m:1',version:'v1',scope:{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'b'}},{id:'m',version:'v1',scope:{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'港股'}},{id:'a@b%c',version:'v9'}];
  const keys=new Set<string>();
  for(const c of cases){
   const key=c.scope?jobKey('calibrate',c.id,c.version,c.scope):jobKey('produce',c.id,c.version);
   keys.add(key);
   expect(parseJobKey(key)).toEqual(c.scope?{kind:'calibrate',methodologyId:c.id,version:c.version,scope:c.scope}:{kind:'produce',methodologyId:c.id,version:c.version});
  }
  expect(keys.size).toBe(cases.length);
 });
 it('refuses empty components, a key on scope all, an empty key elsewhere, over-long keys and malformed input',()=>{
  expect(code(()=>jobKey('produce','','v1'))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>jobKey('produce','m',''))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>jobKey('calibrate','m','v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:'US'}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>jobKey('calibrate','m','v1',{scope_type:'market',scope_key:''}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>jobKey('calibrate','m','v1',{scope_type:'planet' as never,scope_key:'x'}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>jobKey('calibrate','m','v1',{scope_type:'market',scope_key:'港'.repeat(60)}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');   // 60 × 9 encoded chars > 512
  for(const k of ['produce:m','produce:m@v1:all:','calibrate:m@v1','calibrate:m@v1:all','other:m@v1','produce:m@v1%ZZ','calibrate_round:x','calibrate_round@v1'])expect({k,c:code(()=>parseJobKey(k))}).toEqual({k,c:'invalid_parameter'});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/time.test.ts
// spec §3.4 (settle window arithmetic, leap years, month ends), §3.7 S08 (exchange close instants via
// Intl, US DST switch days, consistency with forward.ts::exchangeDate), §3.3 S06 markets.ts.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {exchangeDate} from '@/lib/scoring/forward';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {factsMarketOf,isFactsMarket,isPriceMarket,priceMarketOf} from './markets';
import {DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS,EXCHANGE_CLOSE,addDaysIso,addMonthsPeriod,closeInstantUtc,endOfUtcDay,graceDaysOf,isIsoDate,monthEndIso,settleAfterDate,settleWindowOf} from './time';
import type {PriceMarket} from './types';

const code=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();return 'ok';}catch(e){return e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:'other';}};

describe('closeInstantUtc',()=>{
 it('converts the local close to UTC, including both US DST switch weeks of 2026',()=>{
  expect(closeInstantUtc('2026-11-06','A')).toBe('2026-11-06T07:00:00.000Z');
  expect(closeInstantUtc('2026-11-06','HK')).toBe('2026-11-06T08:00:00.000Z');
  expect(closeInstantUtc('2026-03-06','US')).toBe('2026-03-06T21:00:00.000Z');   // Friday, EST
  expect(closeInstantUtc('2026-03-09','US')).toBe('2026-03-09T20:00:00.000Z');   // Monday after DST start (Mar 8), EDT
  expect(closeInstantUtc('2026-10-30','US')).toBe('2026-10-30T20:00:00.000Z');   // Friday, EDT
  expect(closeInstantUtc('2026-11-02','US')).toBe('2026-11-02T21:00:00.000Z');   // Monday after DST end (Nov 1), EST
 });
 it('agrees with forward.ts exchangeDate for every market (same time zones, S08)',()=>{
  expect(Object.keys(EXCHANGE_CLOSE).sort()).toEqual(['A','HK','US']);
  for(const m of Object.keys(EXCHANGE_CLOSE) as PriceMarket[])
   for(const d of ['2026-01-02','2026-03-06','2026-03-08','2026-03-09','2026-06-30','2026-10-30','2026-11-01','2026-11-02','2028-02-29'])
    expect({m,d,got:exchangeDate(closeInstantUtc(d,m),m)}).toEqual({m,d,got:d});
 });
 it('refuses invalid dates and markets',()=>{
  expect(code(()=>closeInstantUtc('2026-02-30','US'))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>closeInstantUtc('2026-11-06','JP' as never))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
 });
});

describe('date arithmetic',()=>{
 it('endOfUtcDay, addDaysIso across month, year and leap boundaries, isIsoDate',()=>{
  expect(endOfUtcDay('2026-11-06')).toBe('2026-11-06T23:59:59.999Z');
  expect(addDaysIso('2028-02-28',1)).toBe('2028-02-29');
  expect(addDaysIso('2026-02-28',1)).toBe('2026-03-01');
  expect(addDaysIso('2026-12-31',1)).toBe('2027-01-01');
  expect(addDaysIso('2026-03-01',-1)).toBe('2026-02-28');
  expect(addDaysIso('2026-11-06',0)).toBe('2026-11-06');
  expect(isIsoDate('2028-02-29')).toBe(true);
  for(const v of ['2026-02-29','2026-13-01','2026-1-01','20261106',null,'0099-01-01'])expect({v,ok:isIsoDate(v)}).toEqual({v,ok:false});
  expect(code(()=>addDaysIso('2026-11-06',1.5))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(code(()=>endOfUtcDay('2026-11-31'))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
 });
 it('addMonthsPeriod and monthEndIso',()=>{
  expect(addMonthsPeriod('2026-11',3)).toBe('2027-02');
  expect(addMonthsPeriod('2026-01',-1)).toBe('2025-12');
  expect(addMonthsPeriod('2026-05',0)).toBe('2026-05');
  expect(addMonthsPeriod('2026-12',13)).toBe('2028-01');
  expect(monthEndIso('2028-02')).toBe('2028-02-29');
  expect(monthEndIso('2026-02')).toBe('2026-02-28');
  expect(monthEndIso('2026-12')).toBe('2026-12-31');
  for(const p of ['2026-13','2026-00','2026-1','202611'])expect({p,c:code(()=>monthEndIso(p))}).toEqual({p,c:'invalid_parameter'});
 });
});

describe('settleWindowOf (plan 契约补充 结算窗口算术; SQL twin in Task 3)',()=>{
 it('settle_after per target kind, settle_by = settle_after + default grace per horizon unit',()=>{
  expect(DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS).toEqual({trading_sessions:60,calendar_days:30,calendar_months:30,fiscal_quarters:120});
  expect(settleWindowOf({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2026-11-06',n:5},{unit:'trading_sessions',n:5},{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2026-11-11T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2027-01-10T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindowOf({kind:'date',date:'2026-12-01'},{unit:'calendar_days',n:25},{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2026-12-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2026-12-31T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindowOf({kind:'period',period:'2028-02'},{unit:'calendar_months',n:1},{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2028-03-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2028-03-31T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindowOf({kind:'period',period:'2026-12'},{unit:'calendar_months',n:0},{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2027-01-31T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindowOf({kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:'2026-12-31',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2026-09-30',months:3},extrapolated:true},{unit:'fiscal_quarters',n:1},{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2027-05-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
 });
 it('uses params.grace_days (integer >= 1, number or digit string) over the default',()=>{
  expect(settleWindowOf({kind:'date',date:'2026-12-01'},{unit:'calendar_days',n:25},{grace_days:7}).settle_by).toBe('2026-12-08T00:00:00.000Z');
  expect(graceDaysOf({grace_days:'14'},{unit:'calendar_days',n:1})).toBe(14);
  for(const g of [0,-1,1.5,'1.5','x'])expect({g,c:code(()=>graceDaysOf({grace_days:g},{unit:'calendar_days',n:1}))}).toEqual({g,c:'invalid_parameter'});
  expect(settleAfterDate({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2028-02-27',n:3})).toBe('2028-03-01');
  expect(code(()=>settleAfterDate({kind:'planet'} as never))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
 });
});

describe('markets (S06)',()=>{
 it('maps price markets to the facts domain and back; HK has no facts market',()=>{
  expect(factsMarketOf('A')).toBe('CN');expect(factsMarketOf('US')).toBe('US');expect(factsMarketOf('HK')).toBeNull();
  expect(priceMarketOf('CN')).toBe('A');expect(priceMarketOf('US')).toBe('US');
  expect(isPriceMarket('HK')).toBe(true);expect(isPriceMarket('JP')).toBe(false);expect(isPriceMarket(null)).toBe(false);
  expect(isFactsMarket('CN')).toBe(true);expect(isFactsMarket('A')).toBe(false);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/settlement-digest.test.ts
// spec §5.3 S02: request_digest = digest of the full semantic payload (judgment_id, kind, outcome,
// realized, evidence, resolver, resolver_version, reason, actor); run metadata is excluded.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {digest} from './canonical';
import {OPERATION_FIELDS,operationDigest,operationPayload} from './settlement-digest';
import type {SettlementInsert} from './types';

const J='1d5b6a9e-7f00-8a00-8000-000000000000';
const ROW:SettlementInsert={kind:'settled',outcome:'hit',realized:{value:0.12,unit:'ratio',from:'2026-01-02',to:'2026-02-02',label_policy:'first_observed'},evidence:{bars_sha256:'b'.repeat(64),bars:[{time:'2026-01-02',close:10}]},resolver:'price_return',resolver_version:'1.0.0',reason:null,actor:'cron',code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:'0b0e1d8e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'};

describe('operationDigest',()=>{
 it('is the RFC 8785 digest of exactly the nine semantic fields',()=>{
  expect(Object.keys(operationPayload(J,ROW)).sort()).toEqual([...OPERATION_FIELDS].sort());
  expect(operationDigest(J,ROW)).toBe(digest({judgment_id:J,kind:'settled',outcome:'hit',realized:ROW.realized,evidence:ROW.evidence,resolver:'price_return',resolver_version:'1.0.0',reason:null,actor:'cron'}));
 });
 it('changes when only resolver_version differs (S02)',()=>{
  expect(operationDigest(J,{...ROW,resolver_version:'1.0.1'})).not.toBe(operationDigest(J,ROW));
 });
 it('changes with every other semantic field and with the judgment id',()=>{
  const base=operationDigest(J,ROW);
  const variants:SettlementInsert[]=[{...ROW,kind:'void',outcome:null,realized:null,reason:'no_data'},{...ROW,outcome:'miss'},{...ROW,realized:{...ROW.realized!,value:0.13}},{...ROW,evidence:{}},{...ROW,resolver:'fact_metric'},{...ROW,reason:'x'},{...ROW,actor:'script'}];
  for(const v of variants)expect(operationDigest(J,v)).not.toBe(base);
  expect(operationDigest('1d5b6a9e-7f00-8a00-8000-000000000001',ROW)).not.toBe(base);
 });
 it('ignores run metadata, key order and undefined optional members',()=>{
  const base=operationDigest(J,ROW);
  expect(operationDigest(J,{...ROW,code_version:'1234567',batch_id:'0b0e1d8e-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'})).toBe(base);
  expect(operationDigest(J,{...ROW,realized:{label_policy:'first_observed',to:'2026-02-02',from:'2026-01-02',unit:'ratio',value:0.12,label:undefined}})).toBe(base);
  expect(operationDigest(J,{...ROW,evidence:{bars:[{close:10,time:'2026-01-02'}],bars_sha256:'b'.repeat(64)}})).toBe(base);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/uuid-v8.test.ts
// F4 spec §2.4 item 5: uuidV8 is the four lines formerly inside ledger.ts judgmentId(), unchanged:
// RFC 9562 v8 layout, version nibble 8, variant from hex[16]. ledger.test.ts stays untouched.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {judgmentId} from '../research/s4/ledger';
import {digest} from '../research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js';
import {uuidV8} from './uuid-v8';

describe('uuidV8',()=>{
 it('formats 64 hex characters as an RFC 9562 v8 uuid',()=>{
  expect(uuidV8('0'.repeat(64))).toBe('00000000-0000-8000-8000-000000000000');
  expect(uuidV8('f'.repeat(64))).toBe('ffffffff-ffff-8fff-bfff-ffffffffffff');
  expect(uuidV8('0123456789abcdef'.repeat(4))).toBe('01234567-89ab-8def-8123-456789abcdef');
 });
 it('gives ledger.judgmentId exactly the id it produced before the extraction',()=>{
  const key={snapshot_id:'a'.repeat(64),question_set_version:'qs/1',backend:'rule' as const,backend_model:'m',question_id:'q1'};
  expect(judgmentId(key)).toBe('8e7a59e6-ada7-8a6a-88de-27e55f2d6ab2');
  expect(uuidV8(digest(key))).toBe('8e7a59e6-ada7-8a6a-88de-27e55f2d6ab2');
 });
 it('refuses anything but 64 lowercase hex characters',()=>{
  for(const bad of ['','a'.repeat(63),'a'.repeat(65),'A'.repeat(64),'g'.repeat(64)])expect(()=>uuidV8(bad)).toThrow('invalid_schema');
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/uuid-v8.ts
// Content-addressed uuid formatting (RFC 9562 v8), extracted verbatim from ledger.ts judgmentId()
// for the F4 judgment layer (judgment framework spec §2.4 item 5). Version nibble = 8, variant bits
// from hex[16]; the first 128 bits of the digest are kept except hex[12] (replaced by the version).
// Behaviour for every 64-hex input is identical to the former inline code; anything else is refused.
// Lives in src/lib/judgments (F4-owned, plan audit P2-03); src/lib/research/s4/ledger.ts imports it inside its F4 fence.
import {fail} from '../research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js';

const HEX64=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
export function uuidV8(hex64:string):string{
 if(typeof hex64!=='string'||!HEX64.test(hex64))fail('invalid_schema');
 const variant=((parseInt(hex64[16],16)&0x3)|0x8).toString(16);
 return `${hex64.slice(0,8)}-${hex64.slice(8,12)}-8${hex64.slice(13,16)}-${variant}${hex64.slice(17,20)}-${hex64.slice(20,32)}`;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/errors.ts
// Judgment-layer error codes (spec §13 plus the plan's codes). Every failure inside src/lib/judgments
// throws JudgmentError; SQL functions raise with the same code as the message head and db.ts maps
// them back (toJudgmentError). Codes that are only batch information (pending_summary, …) live in
// src/lib/dq/batches.ts INFO_CODES, not here.
export const JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES=[
 'methodology_unavailable','methodology_mismatch','unknown_methodology','formula_hash_drift',
 'subject_missing','subject_inactive','subject_type_not_public',
 'input_not_allowed','input_snapshot_mismatch','input_not_public','input_origin_unknown','input_hash_mismatch','lookahead',
 'idempotency_conflict','duplicate_key','invalid_claim','invalid_condition','code_version_missing','settle_window_mismatch',
 'unsupported_formula_version','metric_not_reproducible','market_unsupported','target_unresolvable','macro_unavailable','read_truncated',
 'input_unavailable','snapshot_unclassified','binding_not_referenced','override_mismatch',
 'lease_lost','request_key_conflict','settlement_sequence','unknown_judgment','stale_revision','job_state_conflict','item_not_open','resolution_not_applicable',
 'invalid_parameter','unknown',
] as const;
export type JudgmentErrorCode=typeof JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES[number];
export class JudgmentError extends Error{
 constructor(public readonly code:JudgmentErrorCode,message?:string,public readonly detail?:Record<string,unknown>){super(message??code);this.name='JudgmentError';}
}
export const isJudgmentError=(e:unknown,code?:JudgmentErrorCode):e is JudgmentError=>e instanceof JudgmentError&&(code===undefined||e.code===code);
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/canonical.ts
// Content addressing of the judgment layer (spec §3.5, §6.1). The only entry point to the RFC 8785
// implementation in src/lib/research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js (imported the same way as
// src/lib/research/s4/ledger.ts; json.js has no .d.ts, allowJs infers loose types, so this wrapper
// pins the signatures). inputsHash = digest of the [kind, ref, hash] triples sorted by
// (kind, canonicalize(ref), hash) in UTF-16 order: the input order never changes the hash.
// jsonClean removes undefined object members (canonicalize refuses them, JSON storage drops them),
// so digests of objects with optional fields match what the database stores.
import {canonicalize as jcs,digest as jcsDigest,sha256 as jcsSha256} from '../research/ingest/pa-v1/json.js';
import type {InputKind} from './types';

export const canonicalize=(v:unknown):string=>jcs(v);
export const digest=(v:unknown):string=>jcsDigest(v);
export const sha256=(bytes:string|Uint8Array):string=>jcsSha256(bytes);

export function jsonClean<T>(v:T):T{
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(x=>jsonClean(x)) as T;
 if(v!==null&&typeof v==='object'){
  const out:Record<string,unknown>={};
  for(const [k,x] of Object.entries(v as Record<string,unknown>))if(x!==undefined)out[k]=jsonClean(x);
  return out as T;
 }
 return v;
}

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
export function inputsHash(inputs:readonly {kind:InputKind;ref:unknown;hash:string}[]):string{
 const rows=inputs.map(i=>({kind:i.kind,key:jcs(i.ref),hash:i.hash,triple:[i.kind,i.ref,i.hash]}));
 rows.sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.kind,b.kind)||cmp(a.key,b.key)||cmp(a.hash,b.hash));
 return jcsDigest(rows.map(r=>r.triple));
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/markets.ts
// The two market domains (spec §3.3 S06): FactsMarket 'US'|'CN' (facts layer) and PriceMarket
// 'A'|'HK'|'US' (K-line / scoring). Conditions, refs and hashes keep their own domain's value; the
// only conversion is here. HK has no facts market (the landed publicMarketOf refuses HK too): null
// makes gather abstain with market_unsupported.
import type {FactsMarket,PriceMarket} from './types';

const PRICE:readonly string[]=['A','HK','US'];
const FACTS:readonly string[]=['US','CN'];
export const isPriceMarket=(v:unknown):v is PriceMarket=>typeof v==='string'&&PRICE.includes(v);
export const isFactsMarket=(v:unknown):v is FactsMarket=>typeof v==='string'&&FACTS.includes(v);
export function factsMarketOf(p:PriceMarket):FactsMarket|null{return p==='A'?'CN':p==='US'?'US':null;}
export function priceMarketOf(f:FactsMarket):PriceMarket{return f==='CN'?'A':'US';}
```
