```ts
// src/lib/judgments/time.ts
// Date and instant arithmetic of the judgment layer (spec §3.4, §3.7 S08). Dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD',
// periods 'YYYY-MM', instants toISOString() UTC. EXCHANGE_CLOSE is F4's own map: forward.ts keeps
// EXCHANGE_TZ private and is not changed; time.test.ts asserts both agree through exchangeDate().
// closeInstantUtc converts the local close with Intl, so DST comes from the platform tz database.
// settleWindowOf is the TS twin of the SQL helpers public.judgments_settle_after /
// public.judgments_grace_days in 20261109150000_judgments.sql (plan 契约补充 结算窗口算术):
// session_index → base_date + n days; date → the date; period → first day of the next month;
// fiscal_period → period_end + 1; settle_by = settle_after + grace_days. Change both together.
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import type {Horizon,PriceMarket,Target} from './types';

export const EXCHANGE_CLOSE:Readonly<Record<PriceMarket,{tz:string;close:string}>>={A:{tz:'Asia/Shanghai',close:'15:00'},HK:{tz:'Asia/Hong_Kong',close:'16:00'},US:{tz:'America/New_York',close:'16:00'}};
export const DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS:Readonly<Record<Horizon['unit'],number>>={trading_sessions:60,calendar_days:30,calendar_months:30,fiscal_quarters:120};
const DAY=86_400_000;
const DATE=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/;
const PERIOD=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/;
const invalid=(what:string,v:unknown):never=>{throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`${what}:${String(v)}`);};

function ymd(date:string):[number,number,number]{
 const m=typeof date==='string'?DATE.exec(date):null;
 if(!m)return invalid('date',date);
 const y=Number(m[1]),mo=Number(m[2]),d=Number(m[3]);
 const t=new Date(Date.UTC(y,mo-1,d));
 if(y<1000||t.getUTCFullYear()!==y||t.getUTCMonth()!==mo-1||t.getUTCDate()!==d)return invalid('date',date);
 return [y,mo,d];
}
function ym(period:string):[number,number]{
 const m=typeof period==='string'?PERIOD.exec(period):null;
 const y=Number(m?.[1]),mo=Number(m?.[2]);
 if(!m||y<1000||mo<1||mo>12)return invalid('period',period);
 return [y,mo];
}
const dayOf=(ms:number)=>new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0,10);

export function isIsoDate(v:unknown):v is string{
 if(typeof v!=='string')return false;
 try{ymd(v);return true;}catch{return false;}
}
export function endOfUtcDay(date:string):string{ymd(date);return `${date}T23:59:59.999Z`;}
export function addDaysIso(date:string,n:number):string{
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n))invalid('days',n);
 const [y,m,d]=ymd(date);return dayOf(Date.UTC(y,m-1,d)+n*DAY);
}
export function addMonthsPeriod(period:string,n:number):string{
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n))invalid('months',n);
 const [y,m]=ym(period);const t=y*12+(m-1)+n;const ny=Math.floor(t/12);const nm=t-ny*12+1;
 return `${String(ny).padStart(4,'0')}-${String(nm).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
export function monthEndIso(period:string):string{const [y,m]=ym(period);return dayOf(Date.UTC(y,m,0));}

const formats=new Map<string,Intl.DateTimeFormat>();
/** The wall clock of instant `ms` in `tz`, read back as if it were UTC (ms). */
function wallClock(ms:number,tz:string):number{
 let f=formats.get(tz);
 if(!f){f=new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{timeZone:tz,hourCycle:'h23',year:'numeric',month:'2-digit',day:'2-digit',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});formats.set(tz,f);}
 const p:Record<string,number>={};
 for(const x of f.formatToParts(new Date(ms)))if(x.type!=='literal')p[x.type]=Number(x.value);
 return Date.UTC(p.year,p.month-1,p.day,p.hour,p.minute,p.second);
}
/** UTC instant of the exchange close on local trading date `date` (two-step offset fix-up). */
export function closeInstantUtc(date:string,market:PriceMarket):string{
 const c=EXCHANGE_CLOSE[market];
 if(!c)return invalid('market',market);
 const [y,m,d]=ymd(date);const [hh,mm]=c.close.split(':').map(Number);
 const local=Date.UTC(y,m-1,d,hh,mm);
 let t=local-(wallClock(local,c.tz)-local);
 t=local-(wallClock(t,c.tz)-t);
 return new Date(t).toISOString();
}

export function graceDaysOf(params:Record<string,number|string>,horizon:Horizon):number{
 const g=params.grace_days;
 if(g===undefined){const d=DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS[horizon.unit];return d===undefined?invalid('horizon_unit',horizon.unit):d;}
 const n=typeof g==='number'?g:/^\d+$/.test(g)?Number(g):Number.NaN;
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<1)return invalid('grace_days',g);
 return n;
}
export function settleAfterDate(target:Target):string{
 switch(target.kind){
  case 'session_index':return addDaysIso(target.base_date,target.n);
  case 'date':ymd(target.date);return target.date;
  case 'period':return addDaysIso(monthEndIso(target.period),1);
  case 'fiscal_period':return addDaysIso(target.period_end,1);
  default:return invalid('target_kind',(target as {kind?:unknown}).kind);
 }
}
export function settleWindowOf(target:Target,horizon:Horizon,params:Record<string,number|string>):{settle_after:string;settle_by:string}{
 const d=settleAfterDate(target);
 return {settle_after:`${d}T00:00:00.000Z`,settle_by:`${addDaysIso(d,graceDaysOf(params,horizon))}T00:00:00.000Z`};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/contract.ts
// Pure validators of the judgment contract (spec §3.1–§3.4, §3.6, §6.1). Every function throws
// JudgmentError with a spec §13 code and does no I/O; existence of a subject is
// JudgmentsDb.subjectExists. Claims are checked per kind and must not carry unknown members (the
// claim is stored and compared for idempotency_conflict, so stray keys are refused, not dropped).
// judgmentIdOf addresses exactly the eight §6.1 fields; isRetrospective is the TS twin of the three
// rules register_judgment evaluates in SQL against registered_at (plan 契约补充).
import {uuidV8} from './uuid-v8';
import {digest} from './canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES} from './types';
import type {Abstained,Claim,Horizon,Kind,ProducerKind,ProducerRef,Subject,SubjectType} from './types';

export const INDUSTRY_SCHEMES=['sw2021','sw2014','gics','csrc','custom'] as const;
const SUBJECT_TYPES:readonly string[]=['issuer','industry','macro_region','macro_series','security','document'];
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const HEX64=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const HORIZON:Readonly<Record<Horizon['unit'],[number,number]>>={trading_sessions:[1,2520],calendar_days:[1,3660],calendar_months:[0,120],fiscal_quarters:[1,40]};

type Code='invalid_claim'|'invalid_condition'|'invalid_parameter';
const fail=(code:Code|'subject_missing',msg:string):never=>{throw new JudgmentError(code,msg);};
const isObj=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);
const text=(v:unknown,max=256):v is string=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim().length>0&&v.length<=max;
const fin=(v:unknown):v is number=>typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v);
function obj(v:unknown,keys:readonly string[],code:Code,what:string):Record<string,unknown>{
 if(!isObj(v))return fail(code,`${what}: not an object`);
 const extra=Object.keys(v).find(k=>!keys.includes(k));
 if(extra!==undefined)fail(code,`${what}: unknown member ${extra}`);
 return v;
}
function need(ok:boolean,code:Code,msg:string):void{if(!ok)fail(code,msg);}

function industryOk(k:string):boolean{
 const p=k.split(':');
 return p.length===3&&(INDUSTRY_SCHEMES as readonly string[]).includes(p[0])&&p[1].length>=1&&p[1].length<=32&&p[2].length>=1&&p[2].length<=32&&!/\s/.test(k);
}
function securityOk(k:string):boolean{
 const i=k.indexOf(':');
 return i>0&&['A','HK','US'].includes(k.slice(0,i))&&/^[A-Za-z0-9.-]{1,32}$/.test(k.slice(i+1));
}
export function validateSubject(subject:unknown,opts:{publicOnly?:boolean}={}):Subject{
 if(!isObj(subject)||typeof subject.type!=='string'||!SUBJECT_TYPES.includes(subject.type))return fail('subject_missing','invalid_subject_type');
 const type=subject.type as SubjectType;const key=subject.key;
 if((opts.publicOnly??true)&&!(PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(type))throw new JudgmentError('subject_type_not_public',type);
 if(typeof key!=='string'||key.length<1||key.length>128||key.trim()!==key)return fail('subject_missing',`invalid_subject_key:${type}`);
 const ok=type==='issuer'?UUID.test(key)
  :type==='industry'?industryOk(key)
  :type==='macro_region'?key==='US'||key==='CN'
  :type==='macro_series'?/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$/.test(key)
  :type==='security'?securityOk(key)
  :/^\S{1,128}$/.test(key);
 if(!ok)fail('subject_missing',`invalid_subject_key:${type}`);
 return {type,key};
}

function bilingual(v:unknown,what:string):void{
 const b=obj(v,['zh','en'],'invalid_claim',what);
 need(text(b.zh,500)&&text(b.en,500),'invalid_claim',`${what}: zh and en required`);
}
export function validateClaim(kind:Kind,claim:unknown):Claim{
 if(kind==='probability'){
  const c=obj(claim,['p','event'],'invalid_claim','probability');
  need(fin(c.p)&&c.p>=0&&c.p<=1,'invalid_claim','probability: p must be in [0,1]');
  bilingual(c.event,'probability.event');
 }else if(kind==='categorical'){
  const c=obj(claim,['selected','classes','distribution','scores_are_not_probabilities','margin_pp','catalog_version'],'invalid_claim','categorical');
  const classes=c.classes;
  need(Array.isArray(classes)&&classes.length>0&&classes.every(x=>text(x,64))&&new Set(classes).size===classes.length,'invalid_claim','categorical: classes must be unique non-empty strings');
  need(typeof c.selected==='string'&&(classes as string[]).includes(c.selected),'invalid_claim','categorical: selected not in classes');
  need(typeof c.scores_are_not_probabilities==='boolean','invalid_claim','categorical: scores_are_not_probabilities required');
  if(c.distribution!==undefined){
   need(isObj(c.distribution)&&Object.entries(c.distribution).every(([k,x])=>(classes as string[]).includes(k)&&fin(x)&&x>=0),'invalid_claim','categorical: distribution keys must be classes with values >= 0');
  }
  if(c.margin_pp!==undefined)need(fin(c.margin_pp)&&c.margin_pp>=0,'invalid_claim','categorical: margin_pp must be >= 0');
  if(c.catalog_version!==undefined)need(text(c.catalog_version,64),'invalid_claim','categorical: catalog_version');
 }else if(kind==='score'){
  const c=obj(claim,['value','scale','dims','coverage','realized_metric'],'invalid_claim','score');
  const s=obj(c.scale,['min','max'],'invalid_claim','score.scale');
  need(fin(s.min)&&fin(s.max)&&s.min<s.max,'invalid_claim','score: scale min < max');
  need(fin(c.value)&&c.value>=(s.min as number)&&c.value<=(s.max as number),'invalid_claim','score: value outside scale');
  need(Array.isArray(c.dims),'invalid_claim','score: dims must be an array');
  const ids=new Set<string>();
  for(const d0 of c.dims as unknown[]){
   const d=obj(d0,['id','value','weight','coverage'],'invalid_claim','score.dims[]');
   need(text(d.id,64)&&!ids.has(d.id),'invalid_claim','score: dim ids must be unique');ids.add(d.id as string);
   need(fin(d.weight)&&d.weight>=0,'invalid_claim','score: dim weight >= 0');
   need(typeof d.coverage==='boolean','invalid_claim','score: dim coverage boolean');
   need(d.coverage?fin(d.value):d.value===null,'invalid_claim','score: a covered dim has a value, a missing dim has null');
  }
  need(fin(c.coverage)&&c.coverage>=0&&c.coverage<=1,'invalid_claim','score: coverage in [0,1]');
  need(text(c.realized_metric,64),'invalid_claim','score: realized_metric required');
 }else if(kind==='interval'){
  const c=obj(claim,['metric','low','high','unit','nominal_coverage','scenarios','scenario_event_hash'],'invalid_claim','interval');
  need(text(c.metric,64)&&text(c.unit,16),'invalid_claim','interval: metric and unit required');
  need(fin(c.low)&&fin(c.high)&&c.low<=c.high,'invalid_claim','interval: low <= high');
  need(fin(c.nominal_coverage)&&c.nominal_coverage>0&&c.nominal_coverage<1,'invalid_claim','interval: nominal_coverage in (0,1)');
  if(c.scenarios!==undefined){
   need(Array.isArray(c.scenarios)&&c.scenarios.length>0,'invalid_claim','interval: scenarios non-empty');
   let sum=0;
   for(const x0 of c.scenarios as unknown[]){
    const x=obj(x0,['label','p','value'],'invalid_claim','interval.scenarios[]');
    need(text(x.label,64)&&fin(x.p)&&x.p>=0&&x.p<=1&&fin(x.value),'invalid_claim','interval: scenario label, p in [0,1], value');
    sum+=x.p as number;
   }
   need(Math.abs(sum-1)<=1e-9,'invalid_claim','interval: scenario probabilities must sum to 1');
  }
  if(c.scenario_event_hash!==undefined)need(typeof c.scenario_event_hash==='string'&&HEX64.test(c.scenario_event_hash),'invalid_claim','interval: scenario_event_hash');
 }else fail('invalid_claim',`unknown kind ${String(kind)}`);
 return claim as Claim;
}

export function validateHorizon(h:unknown):Horizon{
 const o=obj(h,['unit','n'],'invalid_condition','horizon');
 const range=typeof o.unit==='string'?HORIZON[o.unit as Horizon['unit']]:undefined;
 need(range!==undefined,'invalid_condition','horizon: unknown unit');
 need(Number.isSafeInteger(o.n)&&(o.n as number)>=range![0]&&(o.n as number)<=range![1],'invalid_condition','horizon: n out of range');
 return {unit:o.unit as Horizon['unit'],n:o.n as number};
}

export const isAbstained=(x:unknown):x is Abstained=>isObj(x)&&x.abstained===true;

export type JudgmentIdFields={subject_type:SubjectType;subject_key:string;judgment_type:string;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;as_of:string;inputs_hash:string;producer_nonce:string};
export function judgmentIdOf(f:JudgmentIdFields):string{
 if(typeof f.inputs_hash!=='string'||!HEX64.test(f.inputs_hash))fail('invalid_parameter','inputs_hash');
 return uuidV8(digest({subject_type:f.subject_type,subject_key:f.subject_key,judgment_type:f.judgment_type,methodology_id:f.methodology_id,methodology_version:f.methodology_version,as_of:f.as_of,inputs_hash:f.inputs_hash,producer_nonce:f.producer_nonce}));
}

export function producerNonceOf(kind:ProducerKind,ref:ProducerRef):string{
 const r=ref as Record<string,unknown>;
 if(kind==='rule'){need(isObj(r)&&Object.keys(r).length===0,'invalid_parameter','producer_ref: rule takes {}');return '';}
 if(kind==='model'){
  const o=obj(r,['model','prompt_sha256','run_id'],'invalid_parameter','producer_ref');
  need(text(o.model)&&typeof o.prompt_sha256==='string'&&HEX64.test(o.prompt_sha256)&&text(o.run_id),'invalid_parameter','producer_ref: model');
  return o.run_id as string;
 }
 if(kind==='human'){
  const o=obj(r,['analyst_id','source_record'],'invalid_parameter','producer_ref');
  const s=obj(o.source_record,['table','id'],'invalid_parameter','producer_ref.source_record');
  need(text(o.analyst_id)&&text(s.table,64)&&text(s.id),'invalid_parameter','producer_ref: human');
  return `${o.analyst_id}:${s.table}:${s.id}`;
 }
 if(kind==='third_party'){
  const o=obj(r,['institution','document_id','version_hash'],'invalid_parameter','producer_ref');
  need(text(o.institution)&&text(o.document_id)&&text(o.version_hash),'invalid_parameter','producer_ref: third_party');
  return `${o.document_id}:${o.version_hash}`;
 }
 return fail('invalid_parameter',`producer_kind ${String(kind)}`);
}

export function isRetrospective(x:{as_of:string;registered_at:string;settle_after:string|null;label_available_at:string|null}):boolean{
 const at=Date.parse(x.registered_at);
 return x.as_of<new Date(at).toISOString().slice(0,10)
  ||(x.settle_after!==null&&Date.parse(x.settle_after)<=at)
  ||(x.label_available_at!==null&&Date.parse(x.label_available_at)<=at);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/job-keys.ts
// judgment_job_state keys (spec §5.5b R01): the ONLY constructor of job keys. Every component is
// percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent (':' '@' '%' and non-ASCII become %XX), so an id, version
// or scope key can never collide with the separators; parseJobKey is the exact inverse.
//   produce:<id>@<version>
//   calibrate:<id>@<version>:<scope_type>:<scope_key>     (scope_type all ⇔ scope_key '')
//   calibrate_round                                        (the calibration cron's round cursor; plan audit P2-02)
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import type {CalibrationScope,ScopeType} from './types';

const MAX=512;
const SCOPES:readonly string[]=['all','market','subject_type'];
const bad=(what:string):never=>{throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`job_key:${what}`);};
function enc(s:string,what:string,allowEmpty=false):string{
 if(typeof s!=='string'||(!allowEmpty&&s.length===0))bad(what);
 return encodeURIComponent(s);
}
export function jobKey(kind:'produce',methodologyId:string,version:string):string;
export function jobKey(kind:'calibrate',methodologyId:string,version:string,scope:CalibrationScope):string;
export function jobKey(kind:'calibrate_round'):string;
export function jobKey(kind:'produce'|'calibrate'|'calibrate_round',methodologyId?:string,version?:string,scope?:CalibrationScope):string{
 let key:string;
 if(kind==='calibrate_round')return 'calibrate_round';
 if(typeof methodologyId!=='string'||typeof version!=='string')return bad('methodology');
 if(kind==='produce')key=`produce:${enc(methodologyId,'methodology_id')}@${enc(version,'version')}`;
 else if(kind==='calibrate'){
  if(!scope||!SCOPES.includes(scope.scope_type))return bad('scope_type');
  if((scope.scope_type==='all')!==(scope.scope_key===''))bad('scope_key');
  key=`calibrate:${enc(methodologyId,'methodology_id')}@${enc(version,'version')}:${scope.scope_type}:${enc(scope.scope_key,'scope_key',true)}`;
 }else return bad('kind');
 if(key.length>MAX)bad('too_long');
 return key;
}

export type ParsedJobKey={kind:'produce';methodologyId:string;version:string}|{kind:'calibrate';methodologyId:string;version:string;scope:CalibrationScope}|{kind:'calibrate_round'};
const PARSE=/^(produce|calibrate):([^@:]+)@([^@:]+)(?::(all|market|subject_type):([^@:]*))?$/;
export function parseJobKey(key:string):ParsedJobKey{
 if(key==='calibrate_round')return {kind:'calibrate_round'};
 const m=PARSE.exec(key);
 if(!m||(m[1]==='produce')!==(m[4]===undefined))return bad('malformed');
 try{
  const id=decodeURIComponent(m[2]),version=decodeURIComponent(m[3]);
  if(m[1]==='produce')return {kind:'produce',methodologyId:id,version};
  return {kind:'calibrate',methodologyId:id,version,scope:{scope_type:m[4] as ScopeType,scope_key:decodeURIComponent(m[5])}};
 }catch{return bad('malformed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/settlement-digest.ts
// request_digest of judgment_settlements (spec §5.3 S02 / R06): the single implementation. The
// operation payload is every semantic field — judgment_id, kind, outcome, realized, evidence,
// resolver, resolver_version, reason, actor; run metadata (settlement_id, seq, settled_at,
// request_key, request_digest, code_version, batch_id) is excluded. Undefined optional members are
// dropped first (jsonClean) because JSON storage drops them. append_settlement stores this digest
// and, on replay, compares it AND the jsonb payload rebuilt from the stored columns (Task 3).
import {digest,jsonClean} from './canonical';
import type {SettlementInsert} from './types';

export const OPERATION_FIELDS=['judgment_id','kind','outcome','realized','evidence','resolver','resolver_version','reason','actor'] as const;
export function operationPayload(judgmentId:string,row:SettlementInsert):Record<string,unknown>{
 return jsonClean({judgment_id:judgmentId,kind:row.kind,outcome:row.outcome,realized:row.realized,evidence:row.evidence,resolver:row.resolver,resolver_version:row.resolver_version,reason:row.reason,actor:row.actor});
}
export const operationDigest=(judgmentId:string,row:SettlementInsert):string=>digest(operationPayload(judgmentId,row));
```

规格偏差（记入实施记录）：
- §5.5 `judgment_calibrations.state` 的 CHECK 引用 `kind`，写成命名表约束 `judgment_calibrations_state_by_kind`（语义不变；PostgreSQL 文档要求跨列检查用表约束）。
- §5.2 `judgments_active_has_inputs` 写成 `abstained or case when jsonb_typeof(inputs) = 'array' then jsonb_array_length(inputs) > 0 else false end`：PostgreSQL 按约束名字母序求值，原式在 `inputs` 不是数组时抛 22023 而不是约束违例。
- §5.6 RLS 之外，每张表另加 `"<t> service read"` 策略（`for select to service_role using (true)`）：托管 Supabase 的 `service_role` 本就 `bypassrls`，显式策略让未来换角色时不静默变空（计划二同做法）。
- §5 "`database.types.ts` 手工补 §5.6 全部 `Functions`"：按骨架约定**不登记** RPC（调用处用 `RpcFn`，Task 4）；Row 类型直接别名共享契约。
- 每张只追加表另加 `before truncate` 语句级触发器（规格只说 update/delete；`revoke all` 已拿走客户端角色的 TRUNCATE，触发器防的是迁移角色误操作）。
- 第九张表 `judgment_calibration_cohort_members`（规格第 7 稿 §5.5b，计划审计 P1-10）：校准代际开始时由 `freeze_calibration_cohort` 在**一条语句**（一个 MVCC 快照）里写入全部成员及其当时最新结算，之后只按代际分页读取；不是只追加表（`clear_calibration_generation` 删除整代），所以没有只追加触发器；无 anon / authenticated 授权。
- 三个触发器函数显式 `revoke execute … from public, anon, authenticated, service_role`（计划审计 P3-01；触发器触发时不检查 EXECUTE，撤销只让客户端无法直接调用）。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/judgments.integration.test.ts
// F4 Tasks 2–3 (spec §5.1–§5.6, §14.2, acceptance examples 7–10): the judgments migration on real
// PostgreSQL 17. Task 2 (first describe): nine tables, the judgments-calibration bucket, every check
// and trigger, RLS and grants with the real roles. Task 3 (second describe): every §5.6 function.
// Data is set up as the migration owner (the harness admin role bypasses RLS and grants); role
// behaviour is exercised with `set local role` inside a transaction that is always rolled back.
// Rows are never cleaned up (append-only by design; test:db creates a fresh database per run): every
// test uses its own methodology id. Active judgments that are not claimed carry the far-future
// target 2099-01-01, and every claim runs under pg_advisory_lock(F4_CLAIM_LOCK) so the other

import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';

import type {PoolClient} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const TRIGGER_FNS=['judgment_methodologies_limited_update()','judgments_append_only()','judgment_settlements_sequence()'];
const ROLES=['anon','authenticated','service_role'];
const F4_CLAIM_LOCK=20261109;
const JSONB=new Set(['producer_ref','inputs','claim','condition','horizon','target','realized','evidence','params','params_json','upstream','metrics','reliability','isotonic_segments','query_bounds','state','last_detail','override','retrospective_hint']);
const H=(c:string)=>c.repeat(64);
const hex64=()=>`${randomUUID()}${randomUUID()}`.replaceAll('-','');
const mid=()=>`ztest_${randomUUID().replaceAll('-','').slice(0,16)}`;
const INPUT={kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:'CPI',period_end:'2026-01-31',vintage_id:'v1'},snapshot:{series_id:'CPI',period_end:'2026-01-31',value:3.1,unit:'pct',vintage_id:'v1',available_at:'2026-02-10T13:30:00.000Z'},hash:H('1'),available_at:'2026-02-10T13:30:00.000Z',origin:{publisher:'BLS',adapter:'fixture',locator:'CPI'}};
const CONDITION={resolver:'macro_regime_replay',params:{region:'US',reference_period:'2026-01',macro_methodology_version:'v1',catalog_version:'c1'},predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:'recovery'},text:{zh:'复苏',en:'recovery'}};
const CLAIM={p:0.6,event:{zh:'复苏',en:'recovery'}};

// Same replay policy as facts.integration.test.ts (not exported there): one transaction, short
// lock_timeout, jittered retry on lock timeout (55P03) and deadlock (40P01).
const RETRYABLE=new Set(['55P03','40P01']);
async function replayMigration(pool:Pool,sql:string,attempts=10):Promise<void>{
 for(let attempt=1;;attempt++){
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{
   await c.query(`begin; set local lock_timeout='3s';\n${sql}\n;commit;`);
   return;
  }catch(e){
   await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});
   const code=(e as {code?:string}).code;
   if(attempt>=attempts||!code||!RETRYABLE.has(code))throw e;
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250*attempt+Math.floor(Math.random()*250)));
  }finally{c.release();}
 }
}
type PgErr={message:string;code?:string};
/** Resolves with the rejection (message + SQLSTATE) so tests can assert both. */
const fails=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>{throw new Error('expected rejection');},e=>e as PgErr);
/** Runs body as `role` in one transaction on its own connection; always rolls back. */
async function asRole<T>(pool:Pool,role:string,body:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>{
 const c=await pool.connect();
 try{await c.query('begin');await c.query(`set local role ${role}`);return await body(c);}
 finally{await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});c.release();}
}
/** Values for a parameterised insert: objects/arrays in jsonb columns are sent as JSON text; text[] columns get JS arrays; strings stay strings. */
const sqlArgs=(cols:Record<string,unknown>)=>{const k=Object.keys(cols);return {k,values:k.map(c=>JSONB.has(c)&&cols[c]!==null&&typeof cols[c]==='object'?JSON.stringify(cols[c]):cols[c])};};

 settle_after:active?'2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z':null,settle_by:active?'2099-01-31T00:00:00.000Z':null,code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:b});

 const batch=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset) values($1,'ts-judgments','judgments.ztest')`,[id]);return id;};
 const methodology=async(o:{kind?:string;status?:string;publishable?:boolean}={})=>{
  const cols=await insert('judgment_methodologies',methodologyCols(o));
  await q(`insert into public.judgment_calibration_validity(methodology_id,version) values($1,'v1')`,[cols.methodology_id]);
  return String(cols.methodology_id);
 };
 const judgment=async(m:string,b:string,active=true)=>(await insert('judgments',judgmentCols(m,b,active))).judgment_id as string;

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});
 });
 afterAll(async()=>{await admin?.end();});

 it('creates nine RLS tables, the private bucket, the spec indexes, select-only grants, trigger functions no client role can execute, and replays',async()=>{
  const rows=await q(`select c.relname,c.relrowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname=any($1)`,[TABLES]);
  expect(rows.map(r=>r.relname).sort()).toEqual([...TABLES].sort());for(const r of rows)expect(r.relrowsecurity).toBe(true);
  expect(await q(`select id,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types from storage.buckets where id='judgments-calibration'`)).toEqual([{id:'judgments-calibration',public:false,file_size_limit:'52428800',allowed_mime_types:['application/json']}]);
  const idx=(await q(`select indexdef from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and tablename=any($1)`,[TABLES])).map(r=>String(r.indexdef));
  for(const re of [/public\.judgments USING gin \(inputs jsonb_path_ops\)/,/public\.judgments USING btree \(subject_type, subject_key, judgment_type, as_of DESC, registered_at DESC, judgment_id\)/,/public\.judgments USING btree \(methodology_id, methodology_version, as_of\) WHERE \(NOT abstained\)/,
   /public\.judgment_settle_queue USING btree \(next_attempt_at, judgment_id\) WHERE \(closed_at IS NULL\)/,/public\.judgment_settlements USING btree \(settled_at DESC\)/,/public\.judgment_calibrations USING btree \(methodology_id, methodology_version, scope_type, scope_key, computed_at DESC\)/,/public\.judgment_methodology_events USING btree \(methodology_id, version, occurred_at\)/])
   expect({re:String(re),found:idx.some(d=>re.test(d))}).toEqual({re:String(re),found:true});
  const priv=(role:string,t:string,p:string)=>one(`select has_table_privilege($1,'public.'||$2,$3) v`,[role,t,p]);
  for(const role of ROLES)for(const t of TABLES)for(const p of ['INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE'])expect({role,t,p,ok:await priv(role,t,p)}).toEqual({role,t,p,ok:false});
  for(const t of TABLES)expect({t,ok:await priv('service_role',t,'SELECT')}).toEqual({t,ok:true});
  for(const role of ['anon','authenticated']){
   for(const t of [...OPEN_READ,...GATED])expect({role,t,ok:await priv(role,t,'SELECT')}).toEqual({role,t,ok:true});
   for(const t of PRIVATE)expect({role,t,ok:await priv(role,t,'SELECT')}).toEqual({role,t,ok:false});
  }
  // P3-01: the trigger functions are not callable by any client role (PUBLIC's default EXECUTE is revoked too).
  for(const f of TRIGGER_FNS){
   for(const role of ROLES)expect({f,role,ok:await one(`select has_function_privilege($1,$2,'EXECUTE') v`,[role,`public.${f}`])}).toEqual({f,role,ok:false});
   expect({f,public:await one(`select exists(select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a where p.oid=$1::regprocedure and a.grantee=0 and a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') v`,[`public.${f}`])}).toEqual({f,public:false});
  }
  await expect(replayMigration(admin,readFileSync(MIGRATION,'utf8'))).resolves.toBeUndefined();
 },30000);

 it('judgment_methodologies: only status, publishable, synced_at and code_version may change; created_at is immutable; no delete',async()=>{
  const m=await methodology();
  await q(`update public.judgment_methodologies set status='retired',publishable=true,synced_at=now()+interval '1 minute',code_version='bcdefa2' where methodology_id=$1`,[m]);
  expect((await q(`select status,publishable,code_version from public.judgment_methodologies where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))[0]).toEqual({status:'retired',publishable:true,code_version:'bcdefa2'});
  for(const set of [`title_en='x'`,`formula_hash='${H('f')}'`,`created_at=now()-interval '1 day'`,`params='{"grace_days":7}'`,`horizon='{"unit":"calendar_days","n":7}'`,`subject_types=array['issuer']`,`kind='score'`])
   expect({set,e:await fails(q(`update public.judgment_methodologies set ${set} where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))}).toMatchObject({set,e:{code:'23514',message:'append_only:judgment_methodologies'}});
  expect(await fails(q(`delete from public.judgment_methodologies where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))).toMatchObject({code:'23514',message:'append_only:judgment_methodologies'});
 });

 it('append-only: judgments, settlements, methodology events and calibrations refuse update, delete and truncate',async()=>{
  const m=await methodology();const b=await batch();const j=await judgment(m,b);
  const s=await insert('judgment_settlements',settlementCols(j,b,1,'settled'));
  const e=await insert('judgment_methodology_events',eventCols(m,1));
  const c=await insert('judgment_calibrations',calibrationCols(m,b));
  const cases:[string,string,string][]=[['judgments','judgment_id',j],['judgment_settlements','settlement_id',String(s.settlement_id)],['judgment_methodology_events','event_id',String(e.event_id)],['judgment_calibrations','calibration_id',String(c.calibration_id)]];
  for(const [t,k,id] of cases){
   expect(await fails(q(`update public.${t} set ${k}=${k} where ${k}=$1`,[id]))).toMatchObject({code:'23514',message:`append_only:${t}`});
   expect(await fails(q(`delete from public.${t} where ${k}=$1`,[id]))).toMatchObject({code:'23514',message:`append_only:${t}`});
  }
  // truncate: a statement-level trigger on all four; exercised (inside a rolled-back transaction) on the one table nothing references
  const truncTriggers=(await q(`select tgrelid::regclass::text t from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and (tgtype & 32) <> 0 and tgrelid = any(array['public.judgments','public.judgment_settlements','public.judgment_methodology_events','public.judgment_calibrations']::regclass[])`)).map(r=>r.t).sort();
  expect(truncTriggers).toEqual(['judgment_calibrations','judgment_methodology_events','judgment_settlements','judgments']);
  const conn=await admin.connect();
  try{
   await conn.query(`begin; set local lock_timeout='3s'`);
   expect(await fails(conn.query('truncate public.judgment_calibrations'))).toMatchObject({code:'23514',message:'append_only:judgment_calibrations'});
  }finally{await conn.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});conn.release();}
 });

 it('settlement_sequence: seq = 1 + max, the allowed transitions, admin-only ones by actor, never on an abstained judgment',async()=>{
  const m=await methodology();const b=await batch();const A=`admin:${randomUUID()}`;
  const ins=(j:string,seq:number,kind:string,actor='cron')=>insert('judgment_settlements',settlementCols(j,b,seq,kind,actor));
  const refused=async(p:Promise<unknown>)=>expect(await fails(p)).toMatchObject({code:'23514',message:expect.stringMatching(/^settlement_sequence/)});
  // spec §5.3 example: settled(1) → withdrawn(2) → reopened(3) → settled(4)
  const a=await judgment(m,b);
  await refused(ins(a,2,'settled'));
  await refused(ins(a,1,'withdrawn',A));await refused(ins(a,1,'reopened',A));
  await ins(a,1,'settled');
  await refused(ins(a,2,'settled'));await refused(ins(a,2,'void'));await refused(ins(a,2,'reopened',A));
  await refused(ins(a,2,'withdrawn'));await refused(ins(a,2,'withdrawn','script'));
  await refused(ins(a,3,'withdrawn',A));
  await ins(a,2,'withdrawn',A);
  await refused(ins(a,3,'settled'));await refused(ins(a,3,'reopened','script'));
  await ins(a,3,'reopened',A);
  await refused(ins(a,4,'withdrawn',A));await refused(ins(a,4,'reopened',A));
  await ins(a,4,'settled');
  expect((await q(`select seq,kind from public.judgment_settlements where judgment_id=$1 order by seq`,[a])).map(r=>`${r.seq}:${r.kind}`)).toEqual(['1:settled','2:withdrawn','3:reopened','4:settled']);
  // spec §5.3 example: void(1) → reopened(2) → settled(3); reopened → void is allowed as well
  const v=await judgment(m,b);
  await ins(v,1,'void');
  await refused(ins(v,2,'settled'));await refused(ins(v,2,'reopened'));await refused(ins(v,2,'withdrawn',A));
  await ins(v,2,'reopened',A);await ins(v,3,'void');await ins(v,4,'reopened',A);await ins(v,5,'settled');
  const ab=await judgment(m,b,false);
  await refused(ins(ab,1,'void'));
 });

 it('RLS with real roles: anon/authenticated read publishable rows only and never the queue or job state; no role writes directly (acceptance 7, denial half)',async()=>{
  const pub=await methodology({publishable:true});const hidden=await methodology();const b=await batch();
  const jp=await judgment(pub,b);const jq=await judgment(hidden,b);
  for(const j of [jp,jq]){await insert('judgment_settlements',settlementCols(j,b,1,'settled'));await insert('judgment_settle_queue',queueCols(j));}
  await insert('judgment_calibrations',calibrationCols(pub,b));await insert('judgment_calibrations',calibrationCols(hidden,b));
  await insert('judgment_methodology_events',eventCols(hidden,1));
  await insert('judgment_job_state',{job:`produce:${hidden}@v1`,state:{}});
  for(const role of ['anon','authenticated']){
   const seen=await asRole(admin,role,async c=>{
    const n=async(sql:string,v:unknown[])=>Number((await c.query(sql,v)).rows[0].n);
    return {
     jIds:(await c.query(`select judgment_id from public.judgments where judgment_id=any($1::uuid[])`,[[jp,jq]])).rows.map(r=>r.judgment_id),
     s:await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_settlements where judgment_id=any($1::uuid[])`,[[jp,jq]]),
     c:await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_calibrations where methodology_id=any($1)`,[[pub,hidden]]),
     m:await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_methodologies where methodology_id=any($1)`,[[pub,hidden]]),
     e:await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_methodology_events where methodology_id=$1`,[hidden]),
     v:await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_calibration_validity where methodology_id=any($1)`,[[pub,hidden]]),
    };
   });
   expect({role,...seen}).toEqual({role,jIds:[jp],s:1,c:1,m:2,e:1,v:2});
   for(const t of PRIVATE)expect({role,t,e:await fails(asRole(admin,role,c=>c.query(`select * from public.${t} limit 1`)))}).toMatchObject({role,t,e:{code:'42501'}});
   expect(await fails(asRole(admin,role,c=>c.query(`insert into public.judgments select * from public.judgments where judgment_id=$1`,[jp])))).toMatchObject({code:'42501'});
  }
  expect(await asRole(admin,'service_role',async c=>Number((await c.query(`select count(*) n from public.judgments where judgment_id=any($1::uuid[])`,[[jp,jq]])).rows[0].n))).toBe(2);
  for(const t of PRIVATE)await asRole(admin,'service_role',c=>c.query(`select * from public.${t} limit 1`));
  // acceptance example 7 (denial half; Task 3 adds the register_judgment half)
  const {k,values}=sqlArgs(judgmentCols(pub,b));
  expect(await fails(asRole(admin,'service_role',c=>c.query(`insert into public.judgments(${k.join(',')}) values(${k.map((_,i)=>`$${i+1}`).join(',')})`,values)))).toMatchObject({code:'42501'});
  for(const [t,set] of [['judgment_settle_queue','attempts=attempts'],['judgment_calibration_validity','revision=revision'],['judgment_job_state','state=state'],['judgment_methodologies','synced_at=synced_at']])
   expect({t,e:await fails(asRole(admin,'service_role',c=>c.query(`update public.${t} set ${set}`)))}).toMatchObject({t,e:{code:'42501'}});
  expect(await fails(asRole(admin,'service_role',c=>c.query(`delete from public.judgment_settle_queue where judgment_id=$1`,[jq])))).toMatchObject({code:'42501'});
  expect(await fails(asRole(admin,'service_role',c=>c.query(`insert into public.judgment_job_state(job,state) values('x','{}')`)))).toMatchObject({code:'42501'});
 });

 it('publishable toggles anon visibility of judgments, settlements and calibrations immediately (acceptance 8, direct select)',async()=>{
  const m=await methodology();const b=await batch();const j=await judgment(m,b);
  await insert('judgment_settlements',settlementCols(j,b,1,'settled'));await insert('judgment_calibrations',calibrationCols(m,b));
  const counts=()=>asRole(admin,'anon',async c=>{
   const n=async(sql:string)=>Number((await c.query(sql,[m,j])).rows[0].n);
   return [await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgments where methodology_id=$1 and judgment_id=$2`),await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_settlements where judgment_id=$2 and $1::text is not null`),await n(`select count(*) n from public.judgment_calibrations where methodology_id=$1 and $2::uuid is not null`)];
  });
  expect(await counts()).toEqual([0,0,0]);
  await q(`update public.judgment_methodologies set publishable=true where methodology_id=$1`,[m]);
  expect(await counts()).toEqual([1,1,1]);
  await q(`update public.judgment_methodologies set publishable=false where methodology_id=$1`,[m]);
  expect(await counts()).toEqual([0,0,0]);
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 写迁移（表、检查、索引、桶、触发器、RLS、授权）**

```sql
-- supabase/migrations/20261109150000_judgments.sql
-- F4 (judgment framework spec §5): the public judgment table family. Eight tables —
-- judgment_methodologies (code mirror; limited update) + judgment_methodology_events (append-only
-- status history, audit N3), judgments (append-only content-addressed registrations),
-- judgment_settlements (append-only evidence with a sequence/transition trigger),
-- judgment_settle_queue (mutable schedule, not evidence), judgment_calibrations (append-only
-- reports), judgment_calibration_validity and judgment_job_state (mutable run state, audit N2) —
-- and the private bucket judgments-calibration.
-- Read boundary (§5.6, audit N1): anon/authenticated SELECT through RLS; judgments, settlements and
-- calibrations are visible only while their methodology is publishable (the CURRENT value — licence
-- is not historical state). service_role selects all nine tables and writes NOTHING directly:
-- every write goes through the security definer functions at the end of this file (plan Task 3).
-- Errors: triggers raise 23514 with 'append_only:<table>' or 'settlement_sequence: …'; functions
-- raise with the error code as the message head (header of the functions section).
-- Hosted PostgreSQL 17, `postgres` is not a superuser: functions keep the migration role as owner,
-- set search_path = '' and qualify every relation (pg_catalog is always searched implicitly).
-- Replayable: guarded creates, create or replace, drop-then-create triggers and policies, guarded
-- type creation, bucket upsert. Only storage.buckets is referenced (local harness).

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.1 judgment_methodologies
create table if not exists public.judgment_methodologies (
  methodology_id        text not null check (methodology_id ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$'),
  version               text not null check (version ~ '^v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'),
  judgment_type         text not null,
  kind                  text not null check (kind in ('probability','categorical','score','interval')),
  producer_kind         text not null check (producer_kind in ('rule','model','human','third_party')),
  subject_types         text[] not null,
  input_kinds           text[] not null,
  markets               text[],
  title_zh              text not null,
  title_en              text not null,
  doc_path              text not null,
  doc_sha256            text not null check (doc_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  implementation_sha256 text not null check (implementation_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  params                jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(params) = 'object'),
  params_json           jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(params_json) = 'object'),
  horizon               jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(horizon) = 'object'),
  upstream              jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(upstream) = 'object'),
  deps_sha256           text not null check (deps_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  formula_hash          text not null check (formula_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  status                text not null check (status in ('draft','active','retired')),
  publishable           boolean not null default false,
  code_version          text not null,
  created_at            timestamptz not null default now(),   -- first sync, immutable (audit N3)
  synced_at             timestamptz not null default now(),   -- last sync (run metadata only)
  primary key (methodology_id, version)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.1b judgment_methodology_events
create table if not exists public.judgment_methodology_events (
  event_id        uuid primary key,
  methodology_id  text not null,
  version         text not null,
  seq             integer not null check (seq >= 1),
  event           text not null check (event in ('registered','status_changed','publishable_changed','resynced')),
  status          text not null check (status in ('draft','active','retired')),
  publishable     boolean not null,
  formula_hash    text not null,
  code_version    text not null,
  actor           text not null check (actor ~ '^(script|admin:[0-9a-f-]{36})$'),
  reason          text,
  occurred_at     timestamptz not null,
  unique (methodology_id, version, seq),
  foreign key (methodology_id, version) references public.judgment_methodologies(methodology_id, version)
);
create index if not exists judgment_methodology_events_at_idx on public.judgment_methodology_events(methodology_id, version, occurred_at);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.2 judgments
create table if not exists public.judgments (
  judgment_id          uuid primary key,
  subject_type         text not null check (subject_type in ('issuer','industry','macro_region','macro_series')),
  subject_key          text not null check (length(subject_key) between 1 and 128),
  judgment_type        text not null,
  methodology_id       text not null,
  methodology_version  text not null,
  kind                 text not null check (kind in ('probability','categorical','score','interval')),
  producer_kind        text not null check (producer_kind in ('rule','model')),
  producer_ref         jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(producer_ref) = 'object'),
  producer_nonce       text not null default '',
  as_of                date not null,
  registered_at        timestamptz not null,
  retrospective        boolean not null,
  inputs               jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(inputs) = 'array'),
  inputs_hash          text not null check (inputs_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  abstained            boolean not null,
  abstain_reason       text,
  claim                jsonb check (claim is null or jsonb_typeof(claim) = 'object'),
  condition            jsonb check (condition is null or jsonb_typeof(condition) = 'object'),
  horizon              jsonb check (horizon is null or jsonb_typeof(horizon) = 'object'),
  target               jsonb check (target is null or jsonb_typeof(target) = 'object'),
  label_policy         text check (label_policy in ('first_observed','cutoff_vintage')),
  settle_after         timestamptz,
  settle_by            timestamptz,
  code_version         text not null check (length(code_version) between 7 and 64),
  batch_id             uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  created_at           timestamptz not null default now(),
  foreign key (methodology_id, methodology_version) references public.judgment_methodologies(methodology_id, version) on delete restrict,
  constraint judgments_active_shape check (
    (abstained and claim is null and condition is null and horizon is null and target is null and label_policy is null
       and settle_after is null and settle_by is null and abstain_reason is not null)
    or (not abstained and claim is not null and condition is not null and horizon is not null and target is not null
       and label_policy is not null and settle_after is not null and settle_by is not null and abstain_reason is null)),
  constraint judgments_active_has_inputs check (abstained or case when jsonb_typeof(inputs) = 'array' then jsonb_array_length(inputs) > 0 else false end),
  constraint judgments_settle_order check (settle_by is null or settle_by > settle_after)
);
create index if not exists judgments_subject_idx on public.judgments(subject_type, subject_key, judgment_type, as_of desc, registered_at desc, judgment_id);
create index if not exists judgments_methodology_asof_idx on public.judgments(methodology_id, methodology_version, as_of) where not abstained;
create index if not exists judgments_inputs_gin_idx on public.judgments using gin (inputs jsonb_path_ops);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.3 judgment_settlements
create table if not exists public.judgment_settlements (
  settlement_id     uuid primary key,
  judgment_id       uuid not null references public.judgments(judgment_id) on delete restrict,
  seq               integer not null check (seq >= 1),
  kind              text not null check (kind in ('settled','void','withdrawn','reopened')),
  outcome           text check (outcome in ('hit','miss')),
  realized          jsonb check (realized is null or jsonb_typeof(realized) = 'object'),
  evidence          jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(evidence) = 'object'),
  resolver          text not null,
  resolver_version  text not null,
  reason            text,
  actor             text not null check (actor ~ '^(cron|script|admin:[0-9a-f-]{36})$'),
  settled_at        timestamptz not null,
  request_key       text not null check (length(request_key) between 8 and 128),
  request_digest    text not null check (request_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  code_version      text not null,
  batch_id          uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  unique (judgment_id, seq),
  unique (request_key),
  constraint settlements_outcome_iff_settled check ((kind = 'settled') = (outcome is not null) and (kind = 'settled') = (realized is not null)),
  constraint settlements_reason_unless_settled check (kind = 'settled' or reason is not null)
);
create index if not exists judgment_settlements_settled_at_idx on public.judgment_settlements(settled_at desc);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.4 judgment_settle_queue
create table if not exists public.judgment_settle_queue (
  judgment_id      uuid primary key references public.judgments(judgment_id) on delete restrict,
  settle_after     timestamptz not null,
  settle_by        timestamptz not null,
  label_policy     text not null,
  next_attempt_at  timestamptz not null,
  attempts         integer not null default 0,
  last_status      text check (last_status in ('pending','unavailable','inconsistent','error')),
  last_detail      jsonb not null default '{}',
  leased_until     timestamptz,
  lease_token      uuid,
  override         jsonb,
  closed_at        timestamptz,
  updated_at       timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists judgment_settle_queue_due_idx on public.judgment_settle_queue(next_attempt_at, judgment_id) where closed_at is null;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.5 judgment_calibrations
create table if not exists public.judgment_calibrations (
  calibration_id           uuid primary key,
  methodology_id           text not null,
  methodology_version      text not null,
  scope_type               text not null check (scope_type in ('all','market','subject_type')),
  scope_key                text not null default '',
  window_from              date not null,
  window_to                date not null,
  n_registered             integer not null,
  n_settled                integer not null,
  n_independent            integer not null,
  n_void                   integer not null,
  n_retrospective_excluded integer not null,
  threshold_n              integer not null,
  ece_max                  numeric not null,
  kind                     text not null check (kind in ('probability','categorical','score','interval')),
  state                    text not null,
  valid_until              timestamptz not null,
  validity_revision        bigint not null,
  metrics                  jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(metrics) = 'object'),
  reliability              jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(reliability) = 'array'),
  isotonic_segments        jsonb check (isotonic_segments is null or jsonb_typeof(isotonic_segments) = 'array'),
  cohort_path              text not null,
  cohort_sha256            text not null,
  query_bounds             jsonb not null,
  fingerprint              text not null,
  algorithm_version        text not null,
  code_version             text not null,
  computed_at              timestamptz not null,
  batch_id                 uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  unique (fingerprint),
  constraint judgment_calibrations_state_by_kind check (
    (kind = 'score' and state in ('insufficient','evaluated')) or
    (kind <> 'score' and state in ('insufficient','failed','calibrated')))
);
create index if not exists judgment_calibrations_latest_idx on public.judgment_calibrations(methodology_id, methodology_version, scope_type, scope_key, computed_at desc);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.5b validity + job state
create table if not exists public.judgment_calibration_validity (
  methodology_id  text not null,
  version         text not null,
  revision        bigint not null default 1,
  bumped_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  reason          text,
  primary key (methodology_id, version),
  foreign key (methodology_id, version) references public.judgment_methodologies(methodology_id, version)
);
create table if not exists public.judgment_job_state (
  job         text primary key check (length(job) between 1 and 512),
  state       jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(state) = 'object'),
  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.5b frozen calibration cohorts (spec 第 7 稿; plan audit P1-10)
-- The members of one calibration generation, materialised by freeze_calibration_cohort in ONE insert … select
-- statement (one MVCC snapshot): every eligible registration with its latest settlement at that snapshot. Read by
-- calibration_cohort_members (keyset on judgment_id), deleted by clear_calibration_generation. RPC-only writes.
create table if not exists public.judgment_calibration_cohort_members (
  generation     uuid not null,
  judgment_id    uuid not null references public.judgments(judgment_id) on delete restrict,
  settlement_id  uuid references public.judgment_settlements(settlement_id) on delete restrict,
  ord            bigint not null check (ord >= 1),
  primary key (generation, judgment_id)
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 8.3 bucket (calibration cohorts)
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types)
values ('judgments-calibration', 'judgments-calibration', false, 52428800, array['application/json'])
on conflict (id) do update
set public = false,
    file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit,
    allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- triggers
-- 5.1: the current methodology row may change status / publishable / synced_at / code_version only.
create or replace function public.judgment_methodologies_limited_update() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
declare v_mutable text[] := array['status','publishable','synced_at','code_version'];
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    raise exception 'append_only:judgment_methodologies' using errcode = '23514', detail = 'methodology rows are never deleted';
  end if;
  if (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(new) - v_mutable) is distinct from (pg_catalog.to_jsonb(old) - v_mutable) then
    raise exception 'append_only:judgment_methodologies' using errcode = '23514', detail = 'only status, publishable, synced_at and code_version may change';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists judgment_methodologies_limited_update on public.judgment_methodologies;
create trigger judgment_methodologies_limited_update before update or delete on public.judgment_methodologies
  for each row execute function public.judgment_methodologies_limited_update();

-- 5.1b / 5.2 / 5.3 / 5.5: append-only tables (row-level update/delete and statement-level truncate).
create or replace function public.judgments_append_only() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  raise exception 'append_only:%', tg_table_name using errcode = '23514';
end $$;
do $$ declare t text; begin
  foreach t in array array['judgments','judgment_settlements','judgment_methodology_events','judgment_calibrations'] loop
    execute format('drop trigger if exists %I on public.%I', t || '_append_only', t);
    execute format('create trigger %I before update or delete on public.%I for each row execute function public.judgments_append_only()', t || '_append_only', t);
    execute format('drop trigger if exists %I on public.%I', t || '_no_truncate', t);
    execute format('create trigger %I before truncate on public.%I for each statement execute function public.judgments_append_only()', t || '_no_truncate', t);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- 5.3: seq = 1 + max(seq) and the allowed transitions; void→reopened, settled→withdrawn and
-- withdrawn→reopened only by an admin:<uuid> actor; abstained judgments are never settled.
create or replace function public.judgment_settlements_sequence() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  v_seq integer; v_kind text; v_abstained boolean;
  v_admin boolean := new.actor like 'admin:%';
  v_ok boolean;
begin
  select j.abstained into v_abstained from public.judgments j where j.judgment_id = new.judgment_id;
  if v_abstained then
    raise exception 'settlement_sequence: abstained judgment % is never settled', new.judgment_id using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  select s.seq, s.kind into v_seq, v_kind from public.judgment_settlements s where s.judgment_id = new.judgment_id order by s.seq desc limit 1;
  if new.seq is distinct from coalesce(v_seq, 0) + 1 then
    raise exception 'settlement_sequence: seq % after %', new.seq, coalesce(v_seq, 0) using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  v_ok := case
    when v_kind is null then new.kind in ('settled','void')
    when v_kind = 'void' then new.kind = 'reopened' and v_admin
    when v_kind = 'reopened' then new.kind in ('settled','void')
    when v_kind = 'settled' then new.kind = 'withdrawn' and v_admin
    when v_kind = 'withdrawn' then new.kind = 'reopened' and v_admin
    else false end;
  if not v_ok then
    raise exception 'settlement_sequence: % -> % by %', coalesce(v_kind, 'none'), new.kind, new.actor using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
drop trigger if exists judgment_settlements_sequence on public.judgment_settlements;
create trigger judgment_settlements_sequence before insert on public.judgment_settlements
  for each row execute function public.judgment_settlements_sequence();

-- P3-01: no client role executes a trigger function directly (firing a trigger does not check EXECUTE).
revoke execute on function public.judgment_methodologies_limited_update() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
revoke execute on function public.judgments_append_only() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
revoke execute on function public.judgment_settlements_sequence() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5.6 table privileges and policies
do $$ declare t text; begin
  foreach t in array array['judgment_methodologies','judgment_methodology_events','judgments','judgment_settlements',
                           'judgment_settle_queue','judgment_calibrations','judgment_calibration_validity','judgment_job_state',
                           'judgment_calibration_cohort_members'] loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', t);
    execute format('revoke all on public.%I from public, anon, authenticated, service_role', t);
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to service_role', t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s service read" on public.%I', t, t);
    execute format('create policy "%s service read" on public.%I for select to service_role using (true)', t, t);
  end loop;
  foreach t in array array['judgment_methodologies','judgment_methodology_events','judgment_calibration_validity'] loop
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to anon, authenticated', t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s public read" on public.%I', t, t);
    execute format('create policy "%s public read" on public.%I for select to anon, authenticated using (true)', t, t);
  end loop;
  foreach t in array array['judgments','judgment_settlements','judgment_calibrations'] loop
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to anon, authenticated', t);
  end loop;
end $$;
drop policy if exists "judgments publishable read" on public.judgments;
create policy "judgments publishable read" on public.judgments for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.judgment_methodologies m
                 where m.methodology_id = judgments.methodology_id and m.version = judgments.methodology_version and m.publishable));
drop policy if exists "judgment_settlements publishable read" on public.judgment_settlements;
create policy "judgment_settlements publishable read" on public.judgment_settlements for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.judgments j
                 join public.judgment_methodologies m on m.methodology_id = j.methodology_id and m.version = j.methodology_version
                 where j.judgment_id = judgment_settlements.judgment_id and m.publishable));
drop policy if exists "judgment_calibrations publishable read" on public.judgment_calibrations;
create policy "judgment_calibrations publishable read" on public.judgment_calibrations for select to anon, authenticated
  using (exists (select 1 from public.judgment_methodologies m
                 where m.methodology_id = judgment_calibrations.methodology_id and m.version = judgment_calibrations.methodology_version and m.publishable));
```

```sql
public.judgment_operation_payload(uuid, jsonb) returns jsonb, public.judgment_settlement_payload(public.judgment_settlements) returns jsonb,
public.judgment_replay_status(public.judgment_settlements, uuid, text, jsonb) returns jsonb,
public.judgment_append_settlement_internal(uuid, uuid, text, jsonb) returns jsonb   -- the body of append_settlement, shared with reject_quarantined_settlement
```

**`request_digest` 的决定（规格 §5.3 S02 / R06，回答 brief 的问题）：RPC 信任并存储调用方算好的摘要，不在 SQL 里重算哈希；重放时比较"存储摘要 = 传入摘要" **且** "由存储列重建的 jsonb 操作载荷 = 由传入行重建的 jsonb 操作载荷"。** 理由：S02 要求摘要只有一个实现（`settlement-digest.ts::operationDigest`，RFC 8785）；SQL 无法逐字节复现 RFC 8785（`jsonb::text` 按键长排序、带空格、数字规范化不同），在 SQL 里另写一个"近似 canonical"会制造第二个实现、两边漂移。规格原文"RPC 内用 jsonb 规范化重算核对"落实为：用 `jsonb` 的规范化相等（键序、空白、数字写法无关）对**同一组 9 个语义字段**（含 `resolver_version`）重算并核对载荷。于是：载荷相同、摘要相同 → `already_applied`；任一不同（含只差 `resolver_version`、或调用方摘要算错而载荷相同）→ `request_key_conflict`。新操作的摘要格式（64 位小写十六进制）在 RPC 里校验；摘要与载荷是否对应由 TS 唯一实现保证（Task 4 的 `supabaseJudgmentsDb` / `pgJudgmentsDb` 在发送前用 `operationDigest` 计算，调用方无法自带摘要）。

规格偏差（记入实施记录）：
- 复合返回值改为 `jsonb` 对象：`sync_methodology → {changed, seq}`、`append_settlement → {seq, status}`、`register_judgment → {judgment_id, registered_at, retrospective}`（规格写 `→ uuid`；契约 `registerJudgment` 要 `{registered_at, retrospective}`，一次往返拿齐）；`insert_calibration → text`。原因：PostgREST 对 `returns table` 返回数组、plpgsql 的 OUT 参数名会与列名 `seq`/`status` 冲突。
- `append_settlement` 的 `request_digest` 放在 `p_row` 里（保持规格的四参签名）。
- `append_settlement` 的判定顺序：request_key 查找（命中即按上面规则返回，不查租约）→ 判断存在 → 锁队列行 → **锁内再查一次 request_key**（并发同键请求在等锁期间提交）→ 队列已 `closed_at` 且 `actor ∈ {cron, script}` → `already_final` → 租约校验（`p_lease_token` 为 null 时要求 `actor = admin:<uuid>`）→ 序号与转移（触发器）→ 插入 → 更新队列 → `withdrawn/reopened` 时 validity +1。规格把租约校验写在 `already_final` 之前；但先到者结算会清空租约，若先查租约，§14.2 要求的"后到者 `already_final`、不是错误"就变成 `lease_lost`。本计划按 §14.2 的可观察行为排序。
- 结算转移不合法时 RPC 抛 23514 `settlement_sequence: …`（触发器原样），弃权判断（无队列行）同样 `settlement_sequence`；判断不存在 `unknown_judgment`（P0002）。
- `release_lease` 只按 token 判定租约（不看 `leased_until` 是否过期）：过期后被别人重新领取时 token 已换，fencing 照样成立；没人重领时允许原 worker 收尾。
- `judgment_history` 的 keyset 顺序为 `as_of desc, registered_at desc, judgment_id desc`（三列同向才能用行比较做 keyset；`latest_judgment_cards` 仍按规格 `judgment_id` 升序作末位）。`judgment_history` 不做合并发行人展开（§12.4 只对 `latest_judgment_cards` 规定）。
- `repair_stale_batches` 只接受 `^judgments\.[a-z0-9_.]{1,54}$` 的单个数据集（精确匹配）且 `p_older_than ≥ 1 minute`；`errors` 追加 `{code:'stale_running', message}`。
- `set_job_state` 写 `updated_at = greatest(date_trunc('milliseconds', clock_timestamp()), 旧值 + 1 ms)`：毫秒精度让 ISO 字符串往返后仍能精确比较；严格递增避免同一毫秒内两次更新让陈旧的 `expected_updated_at` 误中（ABA）。
- **`apply_quarantine_override` 原子化**（计划审计 P1-04）：先锁队列行、再锁隔离项；返回 `text` 而不是抛错：项不存在 / 不属于该判断 / 已裁决 → `'item_not_open'`；队列已 `closed_at` → `'closed'`；队列 `last_status ≠ 'inconsistent'`、`last_detail.evidence_hash ≠ override.evidence_hash` 或 `last_detail.cutoff ≠ override.cutoff`、隔离项 `payload.evidence_hash ≠ override.evidence_hash` 或 `payload.cutoff ≠ override.cutoff` → `'stale'`（都不写任何行；`override.evidence_hash / cutoff` 就是钩子读到的证据身份，计划审计 Q1-03 要求它同时等于锁住的队列与锁住的项）；否则写 `override`、`next_attempt_at = now()`、**清空 `leased_until / lease_token`**（在途 worker 之后的 `release_lease` / `append_settlement` 得到 `lease_lost`，不能覆盖已接受的裁决）、翻转隔离项、写审计 → `'applied'`。队列行不存在仍抛 `unknown_judgment`（P0002），参数不合法仍抛 22023。
- **`reject_quarantined_settlement`**（计划审计 P1-05，新增服务写 RPC）：一个事务内先按 `request_key` 重放检查（命中 → `already_applied` / `request_key_conflict`，不看隔离项），再锁队列行、锁隔离项、锁内再查一次 `request_key`；项未开 → `item_not_open`；队列已关闭、不是 `inconsistent`，或钩子读到的 `p_expected.evidence_hash / cutoff` 与锁住的队列 `last_detail.evidence_hash / cutoff` **或**锁住的项 `payload.evidence_hash / cutoff` 任一不等 → `stale`（计划审计 Q1-03：钩子读到 A 之后 worker 把队列与项都刷新成 B，旧请求不再被接受）；否则经 `judgment_append_settlement_internal`（与 `append_settlement` 同一段逻辑，admin 行为人、无租约）追加 `void`，把项置 `resolved_reject`，写 `research_audit_log`（`action='dq.quarantine_resolve'`，`detail ∪ {judgment_id, decision:'reject', seq}`），返回 `{seq, status:'applied'}`。`p_row.kind` 必须是 `void`、`actor` 必须是 `admin:<uuid>`。
- **`quarantine_settlement`**（计划审计 Q1-02，新增服务写 RPC）：结算发布不一致的唯一写路径，替代 TS 侧 `quarantine()` + 刷新 payload + `release_lease` 三次写。一个事务内先锁队列行（不存在 → `unknown_judgment` P0002），租约 token 不等（含已关闭、已被吊销、已被新 worker 换新）→ 返回 `{status:'lease_lost', quarantine_id:null}` 且**什么都不写**；否则按 `quarantine()` 的语义 upsert 未结项（`dataset='judgments'`、`table_name='judgment_settlements'`、`natural_key = judgment_id`、`reason_code`；同键同原因的 open 项由 `dq_quarantine_open_key_uniq` 部分唯一索引保证至多一条：`insert … on conflict (dataset, table_name, natural_key, reason_code) where status = 'open' do update set payload = excluded.payload`，复用的项保留原 `id / batch_id / created_at / detail`），再写队列 `last_status='inconsistent'`、`last_detail = p_patch.last_detail ∪ {quarantine_id}`、`next_attempt_at = greatest(p_patch.next_attempt_at, now())`、`attempts` 不变、清空租约。`quarantined_at`（计划审计 Q1-01）：锁住的队列行已是 `inconsistent` 且带 `quarantined_at` → 保留旧值（同一未解决事件的复核期从第一次隔离起算），否则用 `p_patch.last_detail.quarantined_at`。参数：`p_patch.last_status` 必须是 `inconsistent`、`attempts_increment` 必须是 0，`p_payload` 必须带 64 位十六进制 `evidence_hash` 与 `cutoff`，且等于 `p_patch.last_detail` 的同名字段 → 否则 22023。于是过期 worker 在新 worker 之后刷新 → `lease_lost`、无写入；刷新与释放之间不再有崩溃窗口。
- `append_settlement` 的函数体移到内部函数 `judgment_append_settlement_internal`（无客户端授权、非 definer；只被两个 definer 函数调用），`append_settlement` 只转调，行为不变。
- **校准成员冻结**（计划审计 P1-10，规格第 7 稿 §5.5b/§5.6/§8.3）：`freeze_calibration_cohort` 用**一条** `insert … select` 把窗口内（按 `as_of`）全部非弃权登记连同该语句快照下的最新结算 id 写入 `judgment_calibration_cohort_members`（`ord = row_number() over (order by judgment_id)`），返回 `{status:'frozen', frozen_at: statement_timestamp(), n}`。**代际先认领**（计划审计 Q1-05）：函数第一条写是 `insert into judgment_job_state(job, state) values ('cohort:' || generation, {frozen_at, n:null, methodology, version, window}) on conflict (job) do nothing`；认领失败（该代际已冻结过，**含 0 成员的代际**；或并发的另一冻结已认领——唯一键让后到者等先到者提交）→ 不插成员，返回 `{status:'already_frozen', frozen_at, n}`（取自已存的标记）；认领成功 → 一条 `insert … select` 插成员，再把标记的 `n` 写成实际行数。标记键 `cohort:<generation>` 只由这两个 SQL 函数写 / 删，不经 TS 的 `jobKey`（它与 `produce:` / `calibrate:` / `calibrate_round` 命名空间不相交，`parseJobKey` 拒绝它；TS 不读它）。在快照之前开始、之后提交的事务**一致地**不在成员内（不会在游标之后"补进来"）。`calibration_cohort_members` 只读冻结集（keyset `judgment_id > p_after`）；结算取冻结时的 `settlement_id`，之后的结算不改变已冻结代际的内容。`clear_calibration_generation` 删除整代成员与 `cohort:<generation>` 标记，返回删除的成员行数（之后同一代际可重新冻结）。公共 `calibration_cohort` 保持时间戳截止语义，只给校准页用。
- **`judgment_envelope_by_id`**（计划审计 P2-01，公共读 invoker）：按 id 取一条信封，`latest` / `as_known` 语义同 `judgment_history`（`as_known` 要求 `registered_at ≤ cutoff` 且方法有 `≤ cutoff` 的事件）；RLS 照常生效，未发布 → 空。
- `apply_quarantine_override` 幂等：项已 `resolved_accept` 且队列 `override` 与本次完全相同 → 无操作返回 `'applied'`；否则 `'item_not_open'`。审计行写 `research_audit_log(user_id = override.resolved_by, actor='user', action='dq.quarantine_resolve', object_type='dq', object_id = 隔离项 id, detail = p_audit ∪ {judgment_id, override})`（列与 `src/lib/research/store.ts::audit()` 写的形状一致；`user_id` 外键到 `auth.users`，所以 `resolved_by` 必须是真实管理员 id）。
- `register_judgment` 的结算窗口在 UTC 日期上算（`date + grace` 再 `::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'`），不受会话时区影响；`next_attempt_at` 初值 = `settle_after`。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/rpc-inventory.ts
// The single inventory of F4 SQL functions (spec §5.6; plan audit Q1-06): name → argument signature as
// has_function_privilege spells it. PUBLIC_RPCS are security invoker and executable by anon / authenticated /
// service_role; SERVICE_RPCS are security definer and executable by service_role only; INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS have no
// client EXECUTE. judgments.integration.test.ts asserts the catalog against it, db.test.ts checks the supabase client
// split against it, rpc-inventory.test.ts (Task 22) checks the runbook lists every name. Add a function here first.
export const PUBLIC_RPCS={
 judgments_server_time:'()',
 judgment_envelope_of:'(public.judgments,text,timestamptz)',
 latest_judgment_cards:'(text,text,text[],text,timestamptz)',
 judgment_history:'(text,text,text,text,text,text,timestamptz,uuid,integer)',
 calibration_cohort:'(text,text,date,date,timestamptz,uuid,integer)',
 methodology_state_at:'(text,text,timestamptz)',
 judgment_envelope_by_id:'(uuid,text,timestamptz)',
} as const;
export const SERVICE_RPCS={
 calibration_cohort_internal:'(text,text,date,date,timestamptz,uuid,integer)',
 sync_methodology:'(jsonb,text,text)',
 register_judgment:'(jsonb,jsonb)',
 claim_due_judgments:'(integer,integer)',
 release_lease:'(uuid,uuid,jsonb)',
 append_settlement:'(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb)',
 quarantine_settlement:'(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb,jsonb,uuid)',
 apply_quarantine_override:'(uuid,jsonb,uuid,jsonb)',
 reject_quarantined_settlement:'(uuid,uuid,jsonb,text,jsonb,jsonb)',
 freeze_calibration_cohort:'(uuid,text,text,date,date)',
 calibration_cohort_members:'(uuid,uuid,integer)',
 clear_calibration_generation:'(uuid)',
 insert_calibration:'(jsonb,bigint)',
 set_job_state:'(text,timestamptz,jsonb)',
 repair_stale_batches:'(text,interval)',
} as const;
export const INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS={
 judgments_settle_after_date:'(jsonb)',
 judgments_grace_days:'(jsonb,jsonb)',
 judgment_operation_payload:'(uuid,jsonb)',
 judgment_settlement_payload:'(public.judgment_settlements)',
 judgment_replay_status:'(public.judgment_settlements,uuid,text,jsonb)',
 judgment_append_settlement_internal:'(uuid,uuid,text,jsonb)',
} as const;
export type PublicRpc=keyof typeof PUBLIC_RPCS;
export type ServiceRpc=keyof typeof SERVICE_RPCS;
export type InternalFunction=keyof typeof INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS;
export const PUBLIC_RPC_NAMES=Object.keys(PUBLIC_RPCS) as PublicRpc[];
export const SERVICE_RPC_NAMES=Object.keys(SERVICE_RPCS) as ServiceRpc[];
export const INTERNAL_FUNCTION_NAMES=Object.keys(INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS) as InternalFunction[];
/** Every F4 non-trigger function with its signature (trigger functions are Task 2's and listed there). */
export const F4_FUNCTIONS:Readonly<Record<string,string>>={...PUBLIC_RPCS,...SERVICE_RPCS,...INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS};
```

```ts
  const procs=await q(`select p.proname n,p.prosecdef d,p.proconfig c from pg_proc p join pg_namespace s on s.oid=p.pronamespace where s.nspname='public' and p.proname=any($1)`,[names]);
  expect(procs.map(p=>p.n).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
  for(const p of procs)expect({n:p.n,d:p.d,c:p.c}).toEqual({n:p.n,d:WRITES.includes(p.n),c:['search_path=""']});
  const fn=(role:string,name:string)=>one(`select has_function_privilege($1,$2,'EXECUTE') v`,[role,`public.${name}${SIG[name]}`]);
  for(const n of READS)for(const role of ROLES)expect({n,role,ok:await fn(role,n)}).toEqual({n,role,ok:true});
  for(const n of WRITES){for(const role of ['anon','authenticated'])expect({n,role,ok:await fn(role,n)}).toEqual({n,role,ok:false});expect({n,ok:await fn('service_role',n)}).toEqual({n,ok:true});}
  for(const n of INTERNAL)for(const role of ROLES)expect({n,role,ok:await fn(role,n)}).toEqual({n,role,ok:false});
  expect(await fails(asRole(admin,'anon',c=>c.query(`select public.set_job_state('x',null,'{}')`)))).toMatchObject({code:'42501'});
  expect(await one(`select public.judgments_server_time() = now() v`)).toBe(true);
  await expect(replayMigration(admin,readFileSync(MIGRATION,'utf8'))).resolves.toBeUndefined();
 },30000);

 it('sync_methodology: registered, resynced, status_changed, publishable_changed (two events when both change); created_at fixed; formula_hash_drift; methodology_state_at',async()=>{
  const row=methodologyRow({status:'draft'});const m=String(row.methodology_id);

  const first=(await q(`select created_at,synced_at from public.judgment_methodologies where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))[0];

  expect(await sync({...row,status:'retired',code_version:'fedcba9'})).toEqual({changed:false,seq:7});   // code_version is run metadata
  expect((await q(`select seq,event,status,publishable from public.judgment_methodology_events where methodology_id=$1 order by seq`,[m])).map(r=>`${r.seq}:${r.event}:${r.status}:${r.publishable}`)).toEqual(
   ['1:registered:draft:false','2:resynced:draft:false','3:status_changed:active:false','4:publishable_changed:active:true','5:status_changed:retired:true','6:publishable_changed:retired:false','7:resynced:retired:false']);
  expect((await q(`select status,publishable,code_version from public.judgment_methodologies where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))[0]).toEqual({status:'retired',publishable:false,code_version:'fedcba9'});
  expect(await fails(sync({...row,status:'retired',formula_hash:H('f')}))).toMatchObject({code:'P0001',message:expect.stringMatching(/^formula_hash_drift/)});
  expect(await fails(sync({...row,status:'retired',title_en:'Renamed'}))).toMatchObject({code:'P0001',message:expect.stringMatching(/^formula_hash_drift/)});
  expect(await fails(sync(row,'cron'))).toMatchObject({code:'23514'});   // event actor check; nothing changes
  expect((await q(`select status from public.judgment_methodologies where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))[0].status).toBe('retired');
  const at=async(cutoff:string)=>(await q(`select (public.methodology_state_at($1,'v1',$2::timestamptz)).*`,[m,cutoff]))[0];
  expect(await at('2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z')).toMatchObject({event_id:null});
  expect(await at(new Date(Date.now()+60_000).toISOString())).toMatchObject({seq:7,event:'resynced',status:'retired'});
 });

 it('register_judgment: judgment and queue row in one transaction as service_role, server registered_at, the three retrospective rules, abstained without queue, 23505 unchanged (acceptance 7, RPC half)',async()=>{
  const m=await syncNew();const b=await batch();
  const today=String(await one(`select ((now() at time zone 'UTC')::date)::text v`));
  const p=judgmentRow(m,b,{asOf:today});
  const before=await serverNow();
  const res=await asService(async c=>(await c.query(`select public.register_judgment($1::jsonb,$2::jsonb) v`,[JSON.stringify(p.row),JSON.stringify(p.queue)])).rows[0].v);
  expect(res).toMatchObject({judgment_id:p.row.judgment_id,retrospective:false});
  expect(Date.parse(res.registered_at)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(Date.parse(before));
  const stored=(await q(`select registered_at,retrospective from public.judgments where judgment_id=$1`,[p.row.judgment_id]))[0];
  expect(stored.registered_at.getTime()).toBe(Date.parse(res.registered_at));
  const qr=(await q(`select settle_after,settle_by,label_policy,next_attempt_at,attempts,closed_at,lease_token,last_status from public.judgment_settle_queue where judgment_id=$1`,[p.row.judgment_id]))[0];
  expect({...qr,settle_after:qr.settle_after.toISOString(),settle_by:qr.settle_by.toISOString(),next_attempt_at:qr.next_attempt_at.toISOString()}).toEqual({settle_after:'2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2099-01-31T00:00:00.000Z',label_policy:'first_observed',next_attempt_at:'2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts:0,closed_at:null,lease_token:null,last_status:null});
  expect(await fails(register(p))).toMatchObject({code:'23505'});
  const retro=async(o:JOpts)=>(await register(judgmentRow(m,b,o))).retrospective;
  expect(await retro({asOf:'2026-01-02'})).toBe(true);                                    // as_of before the registration date
  expect(await retro({asOf:today,hint:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(true);           // label already available
  expect(await retro({asOf:today,hint:'2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(false);
  await withClaimLock(async()=>{
   const r=judgmentRow(m,b,{asOf:today,target:{kind:'date',date:today}});                // settle_after (today 00:00Z) <= registered_at
   expect((await register(r)).retrospective).toBe(true);
   const mine=(await claim()).find(x=>x.judgment_id===r.row.judgment_id)!;
   await park(String(r.row.judgment_id),String(mine.lease_token));
  });
  const ab=judgmentRow(m,b,{abstained:true});
  expect(await register(ab)).toMatchObject({judgment_id:ab.row.judgment_id,retrospective:true});
  expect(await q(`select 1 from public.judgment_settle_queue where judgment_id=$1`,[ab.row.judgment_id])).toHaveLength(0);
 });

 it('register_judgment refuses: unavailable methodology, row/methodology mismatches, non-public subject, input kinds, settle window or queue mismatch, abstained with a queue — and writes nothing',async()=>{
  const m=await syncNew();const draft=await syncNew({status:'draft'});const retired=await syncNew({status:'retired'});const b=await batch();
  const reg=(r:{row:Record<string,unknown>;queue:unknown})=>fails(register(r));
  for(const mm of [draft,retired,mid()])expect({mm,e:await reg(judgmentRow(mm,b))}).toMatchObject({mm,e:{code:'P0001',message:expect.stringMatching(/^methodology_unavailable/)}});
  const ok=judgmentRow(m,b);
  for(const row of [{...ok.row,kind:'score'},{...ok.row,judgment_type:'macro_regime'},{...ok.row,subject_type:'industry',subject_key:'sw2021:2021:801010'},{...ok.row,producer_kind:'model'},{...ok.row,horizon:{unit:'calendar_days',n:31}}])
   expect(await reg({row,queue:ok.queue})).toMatchObject({code:'22023',message:expect.stringMatching(/^methodology_mismatch/)});
  expect(await reg({row:{...ok.row,subject_type:'security',subject_key:'US:AAPL'},queue:ok.queue})).toMatchObject({code:'22023',message:expect.stringMatching(/^subject_type_not_public/)});
  for(const kind of ['document_span','legacy_fill','price_bar'])
   expect({kind,e:await reg({row:{...ok.row,inputs:[{...INPUT,kind}]},queue:ok.queue})}).toMatchObject({kind,e:{code:'22023',message:expect.stringMatching(/^input_not_allowed/)}});
  const windows=[{row:{...ok.row,settle_after:'2099-01-02T00:00:00.000Z'},queue:ok.queue},{row:{...ok.row,settle_by:'2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z'},queue:ok.queue},{row:ok.row,queue:{...ok.queue!,settle_by:'2099-02-01T00:00:00.000Z'}},
   {row:ok.row,queue:{...ok.queue!,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'}},{row:ok.row,queue:null},{row:{...ok.row,target:{kind:'date',date:'2099-01-02'}},queue:ok.queue}];
  for(const r of windows)expect(await reg(r)).toMatchObject({code:'22023',message:expect.stringMatching(/^settle_window_mismatch/)});
  const ab=judgmentRow(m,b,{abstained:true});
  expect(await reg({row:ab.row,queue:{settle_after:'2099-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2099-01-31T00:00:00.000Z',label_policy:'first_observed'}})).toMatchObject({code:'22023',message:expect.stringMatching(/^settle_window_mismatch/)});
  expect(Number(await one(`select count(*) v from public.judgments where methodology_id=$1`,[m]))).toBe(0);
  expect(await register(ok)).toMatchObject({judgment_id:ok.row.judgment_id});
 });
```
