```ts
// src/lib/judgments/db.test.ts
// memoryJudgmentsDb against the shared contract, memory-only behaviour (injectable clock, lease
// expiry, serialised operations), and the supabaseJudgmentsDb wiring over stub clients: which client
// (anon vs admin) each method uses, RPC names and argument names, request_digest from
// operationDigest, row normalisation, error mapping.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {calibrationFixture,judgmentFixture,judgmentsDbContract,methodologyFixture,settlementFixture} from './db-contract';
import {envelopeFromRpc,supabaseJudgmentsDb,toJudgmentError,transitionAllowed} from './db';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {memoryJudgmentsDb} from './memory-judgments-db';
import {PUBLIC_RPC_NAMES,SERVICE_RPC_NAMES} from './rpc-inventory';
import {operationDigest} from './settlement-digest';

judgmentsDbContract('memoryJudgmentsDb contract',async()=>{
 const db=memoryJudgmentsDb();
 return {db,tables:db.tables,
  batch:async()=>(await startBatch(db.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.ztest'})).batchId,
  issuer:async(o={})=>{const id=randomUUID();db.addIssuer(id,o.status??'active',o.mergedInto??null);return id;},
  industry:async()=>{const code=randomUUID().slice(0,8);db.addIndustry('custom','ztest',code);return `custom:ztest:${code}`;},
  adminUser:async()=>randomUUID(),
  exclusiveClaims:fn=>fn()};
});

describe('memoryJudgmentsDb specifics',()=>{
 it('uses the injected clock for registered_at, due-ness and leases; expireLease frees a lease without changing its token',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentsDb();const m=methodologyFixture();
  db.setNow('2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  await db.syncMethodology(m,'script',null);
  const {batchId:b}=await startBatch(db.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.ztest'});
  const f=judgmentFixture(m,b,{as_of:'2026-03-01',target:{kind:'date',date:'2026-03-10'}});
  expect(await db.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue)).toEqual({registered_at:'2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z',retrospective:false});
  expect(await db.claimDue(10,600)).toEqual([]);
  db.setNow('2026-03-10T00:00:00.000Z');
  const [q]=await db.claimDue(10,600);
  expect(q).toMatchObject({judgment_id:f.row.judgment_id,leased_until:'2026-03-10T00:10:00.000Z'});
  expect(await db.claimDue(10,600)).toEqual([]);
  db.expireLease(f.row.judgment_id);
  const [q2]=await db.claimDue(10,600);
  expect(q2.lease_token).not.toBe(q.lease_token);
  await expect(db.releaseLease(f.row.judgment_id,q.lease_token!,{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{},next_attempt_at:'2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts_increment:0})).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'lease_lost'});
  await db.releaseLease(f.row.judgment_id,q2.lease_token!,{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{},next_attempt_at:'2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts_increment:0});
  expect((await db.queueRow(f.row.judgment_id))!.next_attempt_at).toBe('2026-03-10T00:00:00.000Z');   // clamped to the clock
  expect(db.snapshot().judgments.map(j=>j.judgment_id)).toEqual([f.row.judgment_id]);
 });
 it('serialises operations like row locks: two concurrent settlements of one judgment give applied + already_final',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentsDb();const m=methodologyFixture();await db.syncMethodology(m,'script',null);
  const {batchId:b}=await startBatch(db.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.ztest'});
  const f=judgmentFixture(m,b,{target:{kind:'date',date:'2026-01-10'}});await db.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue);
  const [q]=await db.claimDue(10,600);const row=settlementFixture(b);
  const out=await Promise.all([db.appendSettlement(q.judgment_id,q.lease_token,'key-aaaaaaaa',row),db.appendSettlement(q.judgment_id,q.lease_token,'key-bbbbbbbb',row)]);
  expect(out.map(o=>o.status).sort()).toEqual(['already_final','applied']);
  expect((await db.settlementsOf([q.judgment_id])).length).toBe(1);
 });
 it('refuses table-constraint violations the database would refuse (unknown + constraint name)',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentsDb();const m=methodologyFixture();await db.syncMethodology(m,'script',null);
  const {batchId:b}=await startBatch(db.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.ztest'});
  const f=judgmentFixture(m,b);
  await expect(db.registerJudgment({...f.row,batch_id:randomUUID()},f.queue)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unknown',message:'judgments_batch_id_fkey'});
  await expect(db.registerJudgment({...f.row,code_version:'abc'},f.queue)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unknown',message:'judgments_code_version_check'});
  await expect(db.registerJudgment({...f.row,claim:null},f.queue)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unknown',message:'judgments_active_shape'});
  await expect(db.insertCalibration({...calibrationFixture(m,b,1),kind:'score',state:'calibrated'},1)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unknown',message:'judgment_calibrations_state_by_kind'});
  await expect(db.syncMethodology({...methodologyFixture(),methodology_id:'Bad-Id'},'script',null)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unknown',message:'judgment_methodologies_methodology_id_check'});
  await expect(db.syncMethodology(methodologyFixture(),'cron',null)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unknown',message:'judgment_methodology_events_actor_check'});
 });
});

describe('transitionAllowed (settlement_sequence twin)',()=>{
 it('matches the trigger table of spec §5.3',()=>{
  const A='admin:00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const ok:[string|null,string,string][]=[[null,'settled','cron'],[null,'void','script'],['void','reopened',A],['reopened','settled','cron'],['reopened','void','cron'],['settled','withdrawn',A],['withdrawn','reopened',A]];
  const no:[string|null,string,string][]=[[null,'withdrawn',A],[null,'reopened',A],['void','reopened','cron'],['void','settled','cron'],['settled','settled','cron'],['settled','withdrawn','cron'],['withdrawn','settled',A],['withdrawn','reopened','script'],['reopened','withdrawn',A]];
  for(const [p,n,a] of ok)expect({p,n,a,r:transitionAllowed(p as never,n as never,a)}).toEqual({p,n,a,r:true});
  for(const [p,n,a] of no)expect({p,n,a,r:transitionAllowed(p as never,n as never,a)}).toEqual({p,n,a,r:false});
 });
});

type Call={fn:string;args:Record<string,unknown>};
/** A stub SupabaseClient: rpc answers from `rpc` (an Error answers as a PostgREST error); from() is a chainable builder recording its calls. */
function stub(rpc:Record<string,unknown>={},tables:Record<string,unknown[]>={}){
 const calls:Call[]=[];const reads:{table:string;ops:string[]}[]=[];
 const builder=(table:string)=>{
  const rec={table,ops:[] as string[]};reads.push(rec);
  const handler:ProxyHandler<object>={get:(_t,p)=>p==='then'
   ?(ok:(v:unknown)=>unknown,ko:(e:unknown)=>unknown)=>Promise.resolve({data:tables[table]??[],error:null}).then(ok,ko)
   :(...a:unknown[])=>{rec.ops.push(`${String(p)}(${a.map(x=>JSON.stringify(x)).join(',')})`);return proxy;}};
  const proxy:object=new Proxy({},handler);
  return proxy;
 };
 const client={
  rpc:(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>{calls.push({fn,args});const r=rpc[fn];return Promise.resolve(r instanceof Error?{data:null,error:{message:r.message,code:(r as Error&{code?:string}).code??null}}:{data:r===undefined?null:r,error:null});},
  from:builder,
 };
 return {client:client as unknown as SupabaseClient,calls,reads};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/judgments-db.integration.test.ts
// F4 Task 4 (spec §5.7, §14.2): pgJudgmentsDb against the shared JudgmentsDb contract on real
// PostgreSQL (public reads under `set local role anon`, the rest under service_role), plus
// concurrency through two independent pools: appendSettlement on one judgment (applied +
// already_final; same request_key → applied + already_applied; never 23505), claimDue never hands a
// row out twice, registerJudgment races on one id, quarantine acceptance vs rejection on one item (P1-04/05),
// setJobState races on one expectation. The two-connection MVCC cohort freeze test is SQL-level (Task 3).
// Claims run under F4_CLAIM_LOCK (db-contract.ts) like every other judgments suite.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {quarantine} from '../dq/quarantine';
import {judgmentFixture,judgmentsDbContract,methodologyFixture,settlementFixture,withClaimLock} from './db-contract';
import type {JudgmentsContractHarness} from './db-contract';
import {jobKey} from './job-keys';
import {pgJudgmentsDb} from './pg-judgments-db';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const adminUrl=()=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8')).adminUrl as string;

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('pgJudgmentsDb on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 judgmentsDbContract('pgJudgmentsDb contract',async():Promise<JudgmentsContractHarness>=>{
  const pool=new Pool({connectionString:adminUrl(),max:8});const tables=pgTableClient(pool);
  return {db:pgJudgmentsDb(pool),tables,
   batch:async()=>(await startBatch(tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.ztest'})).batchId,
   issuer:async(o={})=>{const id=randomUUID();await pool.query(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en,status,merged_into) values($1,'ZZ Judgments Contract',$2,$3)`,[id,o.status??'active',o.mergedInto??null]);return id;},
   industry:async()=>{const code=randomUUID().slice(0,8);await pool.query(`insert into public.industry_classifications(scheme,version,code,level,name_en) values('custom','ztest',$1,1,'ZZ test industry')`,[code]);return `custom:ztest:${code}`;},
   adminUser:async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await pool.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email) values($1,$2)`,[id,`${id}@judgments.test`]);return id;},
   exclusiveClaims:fn=>withClaimLock(pool,fn),
   close:()=>pool.end()};
 });

 describe('concurrency through two pools',()=>{
  let p1:Pool,p2:Pool;
  beforeAll(()=>{p1=new Pool({connectionString:adminUrl(),max:4});p2=new Pool({connectionString:adminUrl(),max:4});});
  afterAll(async()=>{await p1?.end();await p2?.end();});
  const setup=async()=>{
   const d1=pgJudgmentsDb(p1),d2=pgJudgmentsDb(p2);const m=methodologyFixture();await d1.syncMethodology(m,'script',null);
   const {batchId:b}=await startBatch(pgTableClient(p1),{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.ztest'});
   return {d1,d2,m,b};
  };
  it('appendSettlement on one judgment from two pools: applied + already_final with different keys, applied + already_applied with one key; never 23505',async()=>{
   const {d1,d2,m,b}=await setup();
   await withClaimLock(p1,async()=>{
    for(const sameKey of [false,true]){
     const f=judgmentFixture(m,b,{target:{kind:'date',date:'2026-01-10'}});await d1.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue);const j=f.row.judgment_id;
     const t=(await d1.claimDue(100,600)).find(r=>r.judgment_id===j)!.lease_token!;
     const row=settlementFixture(b);
     const out=await Promise.all([d1.appendSettlement(j,t,`${b}:${j}:A`,row),d2.appendSettlement(j,t,sameKey?`${b}:${j}:A`:`${b}:${j}:B`,row)]);
     expect(out.map(o=>o.status).sort()).toEqual(sameKey?['already_applied','applied']:['already_final','applied']);
     expect(out.every(o=>o.seq===1)).toBe(true);
     expect(await d2.settlementsOf([j])).toHaveLength(1);
    }
   });
  });
  it('claimDue from two pools at once never hands out the same row twice',async()=>{
   const {d1,d2,m,b}=await setup();
   await withClaimLock(p1,async()=>{
    const ids:string[]=[];
    for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const f=judgmentFixture(m,b,{target:{kind:'date',date:'2026-01-10'}});await d1.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue);ids.push(f.row.judgment_id);}
    const [x,y]=await Promise.all([d1.claimDue(3,600),d2.claimDue(3,600)]);
    const got=[...x,...y].filter(r=>ids.includes(r.judgment_id));
    expect(got).toHaveLength(6);expect(new Set(got.map(r=>r.judgment_id)).size).toBe(6);
    for(const r of got)await d1.releaseLease(r.judgment_id,r.lease_token!,{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{},next_attempt_at:'2099-06-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts_increment:0});
   });
  });
  it('registerJudgment racing on one id: one succeeds, the other gets duplicate_key',async()=>{
   const {d1,d2,m,b}=await setup();const f=judgmentFixture(m,b);
   const out=await Promise.allSettled([d1.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue),d2.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue)]);
   expect(out.filter(o=>o.status==='fulfilled')).toHaveLength(1);
   expect(out.find(o=>o.status==='rejected')).toMatchObject({reason:{code:'duplicate_key'}});
  });
  it('applyQuarantineOverride vs rejectQuarantinedSettlement on one item from two pools: exactly one wins, the other writes nothing (P1-04, P1-05)',async()=>{
   const {d1,d2,m,b}=await setup();
   const tables=pgTableClient(p1);
   const by=randomUUID();await p1.query(`insert into auth.users(id,email) values($1,$2)`,[by,`${by}@judgments.test`]);
   await withClaimLock(p1,async()=>{
    for(let round=0;round<3;round++){
     const f=judgmentFixture(m,b,{target:{kind:'date',date:'2026-01-10'}});await d1.registerJudgment(f.row,f.queue);const j=f.row.judgment_id;
     const H='e'.repeat(64),cutoff='2026-03-02T04:00:00.000Z';
     const item=await quarantine(tables,{dataset:'judgments',table:'judgment_settlements',naturalKey:j,reasonCode:'settlement_basis_mismatch',batchId:b,payload:{evidence_hash:H,cutoff,judgment_id:j}});
     const t=(await d1.claimDue(100,600)).find(r=>r.judgment_id===j)!.lease_token!;
     await d1.releaseLease(j,t,{last_status:'inconsistent',last_detail:{reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch',evidence_hash:H,cutoff,quarantine_id:item},next_attempt_at:'2099-06-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts_increment:0});
     const override={reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch',resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched' as const,evidence_hash:H,evidence:{}},evidence_hash:H,resolved_by:by,at:new Date().toISOString(),cutoff};
     const row=settlementFixture(b,{kind:'void',outcome:null,realized:null,reason:'quarantine_rejected',actor:`admin:${by}`});
     const [acc,rej]=await Promise.all([d1.applyQuarantineOverride(j,override,item,{}),d2.rejectQuarantinedSettlement(j,item,{evidence_hash:H,cutoff},`adm:${randomUUID()}`,row,{})]);
     expect([acc==='applied',rej.status==='applied'].filter(Boolean)).toHaveLength(1);
     const [it]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:item});
     const q=(await d1.queueRow(j))!;
     if(acc==='applied'){expect(rej.status).toBe('item_not_open');expect(it.status).toBe('resolved_accept');expect(await d1.settlementsOf([j])).toEqual([]);
      const mine=(await d1.claimDue(100,600)).find(r=>r.judgment_id===j)!;await d1.releaseLease(j,mine.lease_token!,{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{},next_attempt_at:'2099-06-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts_increment:0});}
     else{expect(acc).toBe('item_not_open');expect(it.status).toBe('resolved_reject');expect(q.override).toBeNull();expect(q.closed_at).not.toBeNull();}
    }
   });
  });
  it('setJobState racing on one expectation: exactly one writer wins',async()=>{
   const {d1,d2}=await setup();
   const job=jobKey('produce',`ztest_${randomUUID().replaceAll('-','').slice(0,16)}`,'v1');
   expect(await d1.setJobState(job,null,{marker:0})).toBe(true);
   const s=(await d1.jobState(job))!;
   const out=await Promise.all([d1.setJobState(job,s.updated_at,{marker:1}),d2.setJobState(job,s.updated_at,{marker:2})]);
   expect(out.filter(Boolean)).toHaveLength(1);
  });
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/db.ts
// JudgmentsDb (spec §5.7): the only data access of the judgment layer. supabaseJudgmentsDb takes
// two clients (plan 契约补充): `anon` for the public reads — serverTime, latestCards, historyOf,
// calibrationCohort, methodologyStateAt, listMethodologies, latestCalibration — so the RLS
// publishable gate applies exactly as on the public routes, and `admin` (service_role) for every
// other method. Writes are RPCs only (no role has direct write grants, §5.6). New RPCs are not
// registered in database.types.ts: calls go through the narrowed RpcFn. Rows are normalised here so
// the three implementations (this, memory, pg) return identical shapes: timestamps toISOString()
// (PostgREST sends microseconds and +00:00), dates 'YYYY-MM-DD', bigint/numeric → number, jsonb
// parsed, absent composites → null. SQL functions raise with the code as the message head;
// toJudgmentError maps that (55P03 → lease_lost, 23505 → duplicate_key, the rest → unknown).
// Also hosts the rules the memory twin shares with the SQL: transitionAllowed (the
// settlement_sequence trigger), subjectStatus, calibrationIsValid, limits.
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {validateSubject} from './contract';
import {JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES,JudgmentError} from './errors';
import type {JudgmentErrorCode} from './errors';
import {operationDigest} from './settlement-digest';
import {PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS} from './types';
import type {AppendStatus,CalibrationRow,Envelope,JudgmentRow,JudgmentsDb,MethodologyEvent,MethodologyRow,QueueRow,SettlementInsert,SettlementKind,SettlementRow,Subject} from './types';
export type {JudgmentsDb} from './types';

export const CLAIM_LIMIT_MAX=100;
export const HISTORY_LIMIT_MAX=500;
export const COHORT_PAGE_MAX=1000;
export const QUEUE_LIST_MAX=500;
/** Page size of complete-set table reads (= PostgREST max_rows). */
export const READ_PAGE=1000;
/** ids per `.in()` filter (URL length). */
export const IN_CHUNK=200;
export const PUBLIC_INPUT_KIND_SET:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set<string>(PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS);
export const ADMIN_ACTOR=/^admin:[0-9a-f-]{36}$/;
export const SETTLEMENT_ACTOR=/^(cron|script|admin:[0-9a-f-]{36})$/;
export const isAutomaticActor=(actor:string)=>actor==='cron'||actor==='script';

/** The transition table of the settlement_sequence trigger (spec §5.3); admin = actor 'admin:…'. */
export function transitionAllowed(prev:SettlementKind|null,next:SettlementKind,actor:string):boolean{
 const admin=actor.startsWith('admin:');
 if(prev===null)return next==='settled'||next==='void';
 if(prev==='void')return next==='reopened'&&admin;
 if(prev==='reopened')return next==='settled'||next==='void';
 if(prev==='settled')return next==='withdrawn'&&admin;
 if(prev==='withdrawn')return next==='reopened'&&admin;
 return false;
}

export interface PgErrorLike{message?:string;code?:string|null;details?:string|null;hint?:string|null}
const CODES:readonly string[]=JUDGMENT_ERROR_CODES;
/** PostgreSQL / PostgREST error (or anything thrown) → JudgmentError. */
export function toJudgmentError(e:unknown):JudgmentError{
 if(e instanceof JudgmentError)return e;
 const p=(e!==null&&typeof e==='object'?e:{}) as PgErrorLike;
 const message=p.message??String(e);
 const head=message.split(/[\s:]/,1)[0];
 if(p.code==='55P03'||head==='lease_lost')return new JudgmentError('lease_lost',message);
 if(CODES.includes(head))return new JudgmentError(head as JudgmentErrorCode,message);
 if(p.code==='23505')return new JudgmentError('duplicate_key',message);
 return new JudgmentError('unknown',message);
}
export function assertLimit(n:number,max:number):void{
 if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>max)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`limit:${String(n)}`);
}

type Row=Record<string,unknown>;
export const isoTs=(v:unknown):string=>new Date(v instanceof Date?v.getTime():String(v)).toISOString();
const isoOrNull=(v:unknown):string|null=>v===null||v===undefined?null:isoTs(v);
const dateOf=(v:unknown):string=>v instanceof Date?v.toISOString().slice(0,10):String(v).slice(0,10);
const json=<T>(v:unknown,fallback:T):T=>(v===null||v===undefined?fallback:v) as T;
const jopt=<T>(v:unknown):T|null=>(v===null||v===undefined?null:v) as T|null;
const nullable=<T>(v:unknown):T|null=>(v===null||v===undefined?null:v) as T|null;
const strArr=(v:unknown):string[]=>json<unknown[]>(v,[]).map(String);
const present=(v:unknown,key:string):v is Row=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&(v as Row)[key]!==null&&(v as Row)[key]!==undefined;
type M=MethodologyRow;type J=JudgmentRow;type S=SettlementRow;type Q=QueueRow;type C=CalibrationRow;

export function methodologyFromTable(r:Row):MethodologyRow{
 return {methodology_id:String(r.methodology_id),version:String(r.version),judgment_type:r.judgment_type as M['judgment_type'],kind:r.kind as M['kind'],producer_kind:r.producer_kind as M['producer_kind'],
  subject_types:strArr(r.subject_types) as M['subject_types'],input_kinds:strArr(r.input_kinds) as M['input_kinds'],markets:r.markets===null||r.markets===undefined?null:strArr(r.markets) as M['markets'],
  title_zh:String(r.title_zh),title_en:String(r.title_en),doc_path:String(r.doc_path),doc_sha256:String(r.doc_sha256),implementation_sha256:String(r.implementation_sha256),
  params:json<M['params']>(r.params,{}),params_json:json<M['params_json']>(r.params_json,{}),horizon:json<M['horizon']>(r.horizon,{unit:'calendar_days',n:0}),upstream:json<M['upstream']>(r.upstream,{}),
  deps_sha256:String(r.deps_sha256),formula_hash:String(r.formula_hash),status:r.status as M['status'],publishable:r.publishable===true,code_version:String(r.code_version),created_at:isoTs(r.created_at),synced_at:isoTs(r.synced_at)};
}
export function eventFromTable(r:Row):MethodologyEvent{
 return {event_id:String(r.event_id),methodology_id:String(r.methodology_id),version:String(r.version),seq:Number(r.seq),event:r.event as MethodologyEvent['event'],status:r.status as MethodologyEvent['status'],
  publishable:r.publishable===true,formula_hash:String(r.formula_hash),code_version:String(r.code_version),actor:String(r.actor),reason:nullable<string>(r.reason),occurred_at:isoTs(r.occurred_at)};
}
export function judgmentFromTable(r:Row):JudgmentRow{
 return {judgment_id:String(r.judgment_id),subject_type:r.subject_type as J['subject_type'],subject_key:String(r.subject_key),judgment_type:r.judgment_type as J['judgment_type'],
  methodology_id:String(r.methodology_id),methodology_version:String(r.methodology_version),kind:r.kind as J['kind'],producer_kind:r.producer_kind as J['producer_kind'],
  producer_ref:json<J['producer_ref']>(r.producer_ref,{}),producer_nonce:String(r.producer_nonce??''),as_of:dateOf(r.as_of),registered_at:isoTs(r.registered_at),retrospective:r.retrospective===true,
  inputs:json<J['inputs']>(r.inputs,[]),inputs_hash:String(r.inputs_hash),abstained:r.abstained===true,abstain_reason:nullable<string>(r.abstain_reason),
  claim:jopt<NonNullable<J['claim']>>(r.claim),condition:jopt<NonNullable<J['condition']>>(r.condition),horizon:jopt<NonNullable<J['horizon']>>(r.horizon),target:jopt<NonNullable<J['target']>>(r.target),
  label_policy:nullable<NonNullable<J['label_policy']>>(r.label_policy),settle_after:isoOrNull(r.settle_after),settle_by:isoOrNull(r.settle_by),code_version:String(r.code_version),batch_id:String(r.batch_id),created_at:isoTs(r.created_at)};
}
export function settlementFromTable(r:Row):SettlementRow{
 return {settlement_id:String(r.settlement_id),judgment_id:String(r.judgment_id),seq:Number(r.seq),kind:r.kind as SettlementKind,outcome:nullable<NonNullable<S['outcome']>>(r.outcome),realized:jopt<NonNullable<S['realized']>>(r.realized),
  evidence:json<S['evidence']>(r.evidence,{}),resolver:String(r.resolver),resolver_version:String(r.resolver_version),reason:nullable<string>(r.reason),actor:String(r.actor),settled_at:isoTs(r.settled_at),
  request_key:String(r.request_key),request_digest:String(r.request_digest),code_version:String(r.code_version),batch_id:String(r.batch_id)};
}
export function queueFromTable(r:Row):QueueRow{
 return {judgment_id:String(r.judgment_id),settle_after:isoTs(r.settle_after),settle_by:isoTs(r.settle_by),label_policy:r.label_policy as Q['label_policy'],next_attempt_at:isoTs(r.next_attempt_at),
  attempts:Number(r.attempts),last_status:nullable<NonNullable<Q['last_status']>>(r.last_status),last_detail:json<Q['last_detail']>(r.last_detail,{}),leased_until:isoOrNull(r.leased_until),
  lease_token:r.lease_token===null||r.lease_token===undefined?null:String(r.lease_token),override:jopt<NonNullable<Q['override']>>(r.override),closed_at:isoOrNull(r.closed_at),updated_at:isoTs(r.updated_at)};
}
export function calibrationFromTable(r:Row):CalibrationRow{
 return {calibration_id:String(r.calibration_id),methodology_id:String(r.methodology_id),methodology_version:String(r.methodology_version),scope_type:r.scope_type as C['scope_type'],scope_key:String(r.scope_key??''),
  window_from:dateOf(r.window_from),window_to:dateOf(r.window_to),n_registered:Number(r.n_registered),n_settled:Number(r.n_settled),n_independent:Number(r.n_independent),n_void:Number(r.n_void),
  n_retrospective_excluded:Number(r.n_retrospective_excluded),threshold_n:Number(r.threshold_n),ece_max:Number(r.ece_max),kind:r.kind as C['kind'],state:r.state as C['state'],
  valid_until:isoTs(r.valid_until),validity_revision:Number(r.validity_revision),metrics:json<C['metrics']>(r.metrics,{}),reliability:json<C['reliability']>(r.reliability,[]),isotonic_segments:jopt<NonNullable<C['isotonic_segments']>>(r.isotonic_segments),
  cohort_path:String(r.cohort_path),cohort_sha256:String(r.cohort_sha256),query_bounds:json<C['query_bounds']>(r.query_bounds,{window_from:'',window_to:'',registered_at_lte:'',settled_at_lte:'',frozen_at:'',n:0}),fingerprint:String(r.fingerprint),
  algorithm_version:String(r.algorithm_version),code_version:String(r.code_version),computed_at:isoTs(r.computed_at),batch_id:String(r.batch_id)};
}
/** One judgment_envelope row (PostgREST JSON or pg to_jsonb) → Envelope; an all-null composite is null. */
export function envelopeFromRpc(r:Row):Envelope{
 return {judgment:judgmentFromTable(r.judgment as Row),settlement:present(r.settlement,'settlement_id')?settlementFromTable(r.settlement):null,
  calibration:present(r.calibration,'calibration_id')?calibrationFromTable(r.calibration):null,calibration_valid:r.calibration_valid===true,
  methodology_state:present(r.methodology_state,'event_id')?eventFromTable(r.methodology_state):null};
}
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
export const byQueueOrder=(a:QueueRow,b:QueueRow)=>Date.parse(a.next_attempt_at)-Date.parse(b.next_attempt_at)||cmp(a.judgment_id,b.judgment_id);
export const bySettlementOrder=(a:SettlementRow,b:SettlementRow)=>cmp(a.judgment_id,b.judgment_id)||a.seq-b.seq;
export const calibrationIsValid=(row:CalibrationRow,revision:number|null,now:string)=>revision!==null&&row.validity_revision===revision&&Date.parse(row.valid_until)>Date.parse(now);

export interface SubjectLookup{issuerStatus(id:string):Promise<string|null>;industryExists(scheme:string,version:string,code:string):Promise<boolean>}
/** spec §3.1: format first (a malformed key is missing without a query); macro_series has no table yet. */
export async function subjectStatus(subject:Subject,lookup:SubjectLookup):Promise<'active'|'inactive'|'missing'>{
 let s:Subject;
 try{s=validateSubject(subject,{publicOnly:false});}catch{return 'missing';}
 if(s.type==='issuer'){const st=await lookup.issuerStatus(s.key);return st===null?'missing':st==='active'?'active':'inactive';}
 if(s.type==='industry'){const [scheme,version,code]=s.key.split(':');return (await lookup.industryExists(scheme,version,code))?'active':'missing';}
 if(s.type==='macro_region')return 'active';
 return 'missing';
}
/** The append_settlement row: the SettlementInsert plus request_digest from the single implementation (S02). */
export const settlementArgs=(judgmentId:string,row:SettlementInsert)=>({...row,request_digest:operationDigest(judgmentId,row)});
const QUEUE_FILTERS=['due','backoff','leased','all'];

interface RpcResult{data:unknown;error:PgErrorLike|null}
export type RpcFn=(fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>PromiseLike<RpcResult>;
// The query builder is left untyped on purpose (same as table-client.ts / facts db.ts).
interface NarrowClient{rpc:RpcFn;from:(table:string)=>any}
type Query=PromiseLike<RpcResult>&{range:(from:number,to:number)=>Query};

export function supabaseJudgmentsDb(clients:{anon:SupabaseClient;admin:SupabaseClient}):JudgmentsDb{
 const anon=clients.anon as unknown as NarrowClient;const admin=clients.admin as unknown as NarrowClient;
 const call=async<T>(c:NarrowClient,fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<T>=>{const {data,error}=await c.rpc(fn,args);if(error)throw toJudgmentError(error);return data as T;};
 const rows=async(q:PromiseLike<RpcResult>):Promise<Row[]>=>{const {data,error}=await q;if(error)throw toJudgmentError(error);return (data??[]) as Row[];};
 /** Complete-set read: pages by range() in a fixed order until an EMPTY page, advancing by the rows actually
  *  returned — a PostgREST max-rows cap below READ_PAGE yields short pages that are not exhaustion
  *  (src/lib/db/table-client.ts pagination contract; plan audit P1-02). */
 const pageAll=async(make:()=>Query):Promise<Row[]>=>{
  const out:Row[]=[];
  for(let from=0;;){const part=await rows(make().range(from,from+READ_PAGE-1));if(part.length===0)return out;out.push(...part);from+=part.length;}
 };
 const envelopes=async(c:NarrowClient,fn:string,args:Record<string,unknown>)=>((await call<Row[]|null>(c,fn,args))??[]).map(envelopeFromRpc);
 const serverTime=async()=>isoTs(await call<string>(anon,'judgments_server_time',{}));
 return {
  serverTime,
  async methodology(id,version){const [r]=await rows(admin.from('judgment_methodologies').select('*').eq('methodology_id',id).eq('version',version).limit(1));return r?methodologyFromTable(r):null;},
  subjectExists:subject=>subjectStatus(subject,{
   async issuerStatus(id){const [r]=await rows(admin.from('issuers').select('status').eq('issuer_id',id).limit(1));return r?String(r.status):null;},
   async industryExists(scheme,version,code){return (await rows(admin.from('industry_classifications').select('code').eq('scheme',scheme).eq('version',version).eq('code',code).limit(1))).length>0;},
  }),
  async getJudgment(id){const [r]=await rows(admin.from('judgments').select('*').eq('judgment_id',id).limit(1));return r?judgmentFromTable(r):null;},
  async judgmentsBySnapshot(snapshotId){
   return (await pageAll(()=>admin.from('judgments').select('judgment_id').contains('inputs',[{kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:snapshotId}}]).order('judgment_id'))).map(r=>String(r.judgment_id));
  },
  async registerJudgment(row,queue){
   const r=await call<{registered_at:string;retrospective:boolean}>(admin,'register_judgment',{p_row:row,p_queue:queue});
   return {registered_at:isoTs(r.registered_at),retrospective:r.retrospective===true};
  },
  latestCards:(subject,o)=>envelopes(anon,'latest_judgment_cards',{p_subject_type:subject.type,p_subject_key:subject.key,p_types:o.types??null,p_view:o.view,p_cutoff:o.cutoff??null}),
  historyOf:(subject,type,m,o)=>envelopes(anon,'judgment_history',{p_subject_type:subject.type,p_subject_key:subject.key,p_type:type,p_methodology:m.id,p_version:m.version,p_view:o.view,p_cutoff:o.cutoff??null,p_before:o.before??null,p_limit:o.limit}),
  async claimDue(limit,leaseSeconds){return ((await call<Row[]|null>(admin,'claim_due_judgments',{p_limit:limit,p_lease_seconds:leaseSeconds}))??[]).map(queueFromTable).sort(byQueueOrder);},
  async releaseLease(judgmentId,leaseToken,patch){await call(admin,'release_lease',{p_judgment_id:judgmentId,p_lease_token:leaseToken,p_patch:patch});},
  async queueRow(id){const [r]=await rows(admin.from('judgment_settle_queue').select('*').eq('judgment_id',id).limit(1));return r?queueFromTable(r):null;},
  async queueList(o){
   if(!QUEUE_FILTERS.includes(o.filter))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`filter:${String(o.filter)}`);
   assertLimit(o.limit,QUEUE_LIST_MAX);
   const now=await serverTime();const free=`leased_until.is.null,leased_until.lt."${now}"`;
   let q=admin.from('judgment_settle_queue').select('*');
   if(o.filter==='due')q=q.is('closed_at',null).lte('next_attempt_at',now).or(free);
   else if(o.filter==='backoff')q=q.is('closed_at',null).gt('next_attempt_at',now).or(free);
   else if(o.filter==='leased')q=q.is('closed_at',null).gte('leased_until',now);
   if(o.after!==undefined)q=q.gt('judgment_id',o.after);
   return (await rows(q.order('judgment_id').limit(o.limit))).map(queueFromTable);
  },
  async settlementsOf(ids){
   const unique=[...new Set(ids)];const out:SettlementRow[]=[];
   for(let i=0;i<unique.length;i+=IN_CHUNK){const part=unique.slice(i,i+IN_CHUNK);out.push(...(await pageAll(()=>admin.from('judgment_settlements').select('*').in('judgment_id',part).order('judgment_id').order('seq'))).map(settlementFromTable));}
   return out.sort(bySettlementOrder);
  },
  async appendSettlement(judgmentId,leaseToken,requestKey,row){
   const r=await call<{seq:number;status:AppendStatus}>(admin,'append_settlement',{p_judgment_id:judgmentId,p_lease_token:leaseToken,p_request_key:requestKey,p_row:settlementArgs(judgmentId,row)});
   return {seq:Number(r.seq),status:r.status};
  },
  async quarantineSettlement(judgmentId,leaseToken,reasonCode,payload,patch,batchId){
   const r=await call<{status:'quarantined'|'lease_lost';quarantine_id:string|null}>(admin,'quarantine_settlement',{p_judgment_id:judgmentId,p_lease_token:leaseToken,p_reason_code:reasonCode,p_payload:payload,p_patch:patch,p_batch_id:batchId});
   return {status:r.status,quarantine_id:r.quarantine_id??null};
  },
  async applyQuarantineOverride(judgmentId,override,quarantineId,audit){return await call<'applied'|'stale'|'closed'|'item_not_open'>(admin,'apply_quarantine_override',{p_judgment_id:judgmentId,p_override:override,p_quarantine_id:quarantineId,p_audit:audit});},
  async rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgmentId,quarantineId,expected,requestKey,row,audit){
   const r=await call<{seq:number;status:AppendStatus|'stale'|'item_not_open'}>(admin,'reject_quarantined_settlement',{p_judgment_id:judgmentId,p_quarantine_id:quarantineId,p_expected:expected,p_request_key:requestKey,p_row:settlementArgs(judgmentId,row),p_audit:audit});
   return {seq:Number(r.seq),status:r.status};
  },
  async envelopeById(id,o){const [e]=await envelopes(anon,'judgment_envelope_by_id',{p_id:id,p_view:o.view,p_cutoff:o.cutoff??null});return e??null;},
  calibrationCohort:(m,v,w,cutoff,after,limit)=>envelopes(anon,'calibration_cohort',{p_methodology:m,p_version:v,p_window_from:w.from,p_window_to:w.to,p_cutoff:cutoff,p_after:after,p_limit:limit}),
  calibrationCohortInternal:(m,v,w,cutoff,after,limit)=>envelopes(admin,'calibration_cohort_internal',{p_methodology:m,p_version:v,p_window_from:w.from,p_window_to:w.to,p_cutoff:cutoff,p_after:after,p_limit:limit}),
  async freezeCalibrationCohort(generation,m,v,w){
   const r=await call<{status:'frozen'|'already_frozen';frozen_at:string;n:number}>(admin,'freeze_calibration_cohort',{p_generation:generation,p_methodology:m,p_version:v,p_window_from:w.from,p_window_to:w.to});
   return {status:r.status,frozen_at:isoTs(r.frozen_at),n:Number(r.n)};
  },
  cohortMembers:(generation,after,limit)=>envelopes(admin,'calibration_cohort_members',{p_generation:generation,p_after:after,p_limit:limit}),
  async clearCalibrationGeneration(generation){return Number(await call<unknown>(admin,'clear_calibration_generation',{p_generation:generation}));},
  async latestCalibration(m,v,scope){
   const [r]=await rows(anon.from('judgment_calibrations').select('*').eq('methodology_id',m).eq('methodology_version',v).eq('scope_type',scope.scope_type).eq('scope_key',scope.scope_key).order('computed_at',{ascending:false}).order('calibration_id').limit(1));
   if(!r)return null;
   const row=calibrationFromTable(r);
   const [x]=await rows(anon.from('judgment_calibration_validity').select('revision').eq('methodology_id',m).eq('version',v).limit(1));
   return {row,valid:calibrationIsValid(row,x?Number(x.revision):null,await serverTime())};
  },
  async calibrationValidity(m,v){
   const [x]=await rows(admin.from('judgment_calibration_validity').select('revision').eq('methodology_id',m).eq('version',v).limit(1));
   if(!x)throw new JudgmentError('unknown_methodology',`${m}@${v}`);
   return {revision:Number(x.revision)};
  },
  async insertCalibration(row,expectedRevision){return await call<'inserted'|'duplicate'|'stale_revision'>(admin,'insert_calibration',{p_row:row,p_expected_revision:expectedRevision});},
  async syncMethodology(row,actor,reason){const r=await call<{changed:boolean;seq:number}>(admin,'sync_methodology',{p_row:row,p_actor:actor,p_reason:reason});return {changed:r.changed===true,seq:Number(r.seq)};},
  async listMethodologies(status){
   return (await pageAll(()=>{let q=anon.from('judgment_methodologies').select('*');if(status!==undefined)q=q.eq('status',status);return q.order('methodology_id').order('version');})).map(methodologyFromTable);
  },
  async methodologyStateAt(id,version,cutoff){
   const r=await call<unknown>(anon,'methodology_state_at',{p_methodology:id,p_version:version,p_cutoff:cutoff});
   const x=Array.isArray(r)?r[0]:r;
   return present(x,'event_id')?eventFromTable(x):null;
  },
  async jobState(job){const [r]=await rows(admin.from('judgment_job_state').select('state,updated_at').eq('job',job).limit(1));return r?{state:json(r.state,{}),updated_at:isoTs(r.updated_at)}:null;},
  async setJobState(job,expectedUpdatedAt,state){return (await call<unknown>(admin,'set_job_state',{p_job:job,p_expected_updated_at:expectedUpdatedAt,p_state:state}))===true;},
  async repairStaleBatches(dataset,olderThanSeconds){return Number(await call<unknown>(admin,'repair_stale_batches',{p_dataset:dataset,p_older_than:`${olderThanSeconds} seconds`}));},
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/memory-judgments-db.ts
// In-memory JudgmentsDb for unit tests (spec §5.7, §14.1). It reproduces the migration so judgment-
// layer unit tests see what the database does: the triggers (append-only rows — nothing here
// mutates a judgment, settlement, event or calibration; the methodology row changes only through
// syncMethodology; settlement seq = 1 + max with the transition table, admin-only transitions by
// actor), the table constraints a caller can hit (thrown as JudgmentError('unknown', <constraint
// name>)), every §5.6 RPC — sync events and formula_hash_drift; register_judgment validations, settle
// window recompute (time.ts settleWindowOf on the methodology's params/horizon), retrospective,
// queue insert, duplicate id → duplicate_key; claim order and fresh lease tokens; release fencing
// and the next_attempt_at clamp; append_settlement in the R06 order (request_key first, then queue,
// already_final for cron/script on a closed queue, lease, transition, validity +1 on
// withdrawn/reopened); insert_calibration's revision check; set_job_state's optimistic lock with a
// strictly increasing millisecond updated_at; repair_stale_batches, quarantine_settlement (lease-checked item
// upsert + queue publish, Q1-02), apply_quarantine_override (statuses, lease revocation) and
// reject_quarantined_settlement (expected evidence identity, Q1-03) on the shared TableClient; the frozen calibration
// cohorts (claim marker / freeze / members / clear, Q1-05) — and the RLS publishable gate on the public reads (latestCards,
// historyOf, envelopeById, calibrationCohort, latestCalibration; listMethodologies and methodologyStateAt are open
// like their tables). Replays compare digest + judgment id: the digest is computed from the same
// nine fields the SQL rebuilds, so digest equality is payload equality here. Operations run one at a
// time (a promise chain), like row locks; the clock is injectable (setNow).
// ingest_batches / dq_quarantine / research_audit_log live in the TableClient passed in (default: a
// fresh memoryTableClient) so plan-1 startBatch / quarantine() and this db share rows.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';

const HEX64=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

 title_zh:r.title_zh,title_en:r.title_en,doc_path:r.doc_path,doc_sha256:r.doc_sha256,implementation_sha256:r.implementation_sha256,params:r.params,params_json:r.params_json,horizon:r.horizon,upstream:r.upstream,deps_sha256:r.deps_sha256,formula_hash:r.formula_hash});

 if(!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$/.test(r.methodology_id))fail('unknown','judgment_methodologies_methodology_id_check');
 if(!/^v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$/.test(r.version))fail('unknown','judgment_methodologies_version_check');
 for(const k of ['doc_sha256','implementation_sha256','deps_sha256','formula_hash'] as const)if(!HEX64.test(r[k]))fail('unknown',`judgment_methodologies_${k}_check`);

export function memoryJudgmentsDb(opts:{tables?:TableClient}={}):MemoryJudgmentsDb{

  const cal=calibrations.filter(x=>x.methodology_id===j.methodology_id&&x.methodology_version===j.methodology_version&&x.scope_type==='all'&&x.scope_key===''&&(c===null||ms(x.computed_at)<=ms(c)))

   const at=now();
   const key={dataset:'judgments',table_name:'judgment_settlements',natural_key:judgmentId,reason_code:reasonCode};
   const [open]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{...key,status:'open'},{limit:1});
   let id:string;
   if(open){id=String(open.id);await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id,status:'open'},{payload:clone(payload)});}
   else{id=randomUUID();await tables.insert('dq_quarantine',{id,...key,detail:{},payload:clone(payload),batch_id:batchId,status:'open',resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:at});}
   const kept=q.last_status==='inconsistent'&&typeof q.last_detail.quarantined_at==='string'?{quarantined_at:q.last_detail.quarantined_at}:{};
   Object.assign(q,{last_status:'inconsistent',last_detail:{...clone(d!),...kept,quarantine_id:id},next_attempt_at:new Date(Math.max(ms(patch.next_attempt_at),ms(at))).toISOString(),leased_until:null,lease_token:null,updated_at:at});
   return {status:'quarantined',quarantine_id:id};
  },
  async applyQuarantineOverride(judgmentId,override,quarantineId,audit){
   const o=override as unknown as Record<string,unknown>;
   if(!isObj(o)||!isObj(o.resolution)||typeof o.reason_code!=='string'||o.reason_code===''||typeof o.evidence_hash!=='string'||!HEX64.test(o.evidence_hash)
    ||typeof o.resolved_by!=='string'||!UUID.test(o.resolved_by)||typeof o.at!=='string'||typeof o.cutoff!=='string'||!isObj(audit))fail('invalid_parameter','override');
   const q=queue.get(judgmentId);
   if(!q)return fail('unknown_judgment');
   const [item]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:quarantineId},{limit:1});
   if(!item||item.dataset!=='judgments'||item.natural_key!==judgmentId)return 'item_not_open';
   if(item.status!=='open')return item.status==='resolved_accept'&&same(q.override,override)?'applied':'item_not_open';
   if(q.closed_at!==null)return 'closed';
   const payload=(isObj(item.payload)?item.payload:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
   if(q.last_status!=='inconsistent'||q.last_detail.evidence_hash!==override.evidence_hash||q.last_detail.cutoff!==override.cutoff||payload.evidence_hash!==override.evidence_hash||payload.cutoff!==override.cutoff)return 'stale';
   const at=now();
   Object.assign(q,{override:clone(override),next_attempt_at:at,leased_until:null,lease_token:null,updated_at:at});   // the lease is revoked (P1-04)
   await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:quarantineId,status:'open'},{status:'resolved_accept',resolved_by:override.resolved_by,resolved_at:at,detail:{...(item.detail as Record<string,unknown>??{}),override}});
   await tables.insert('research_audit_log',{id:randomUUID(),user_id:override.resolved_by,actor:'user',action:'dq.quarantine_resolve',object_type:'dq',object_id:quarantineId,detail:{...audit,judgment_id:judgmentId,override},created_at:at});
   return 'applied';
  },
  async rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgmentId,quarantineId,expected,requestKey,row,audit){
   if(!isObj(row)||row.kind!=='void'||typeof row.actor!=='string'||!/^admin:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(row.actor)||typeof requestKey!=='string'||!isObj(audit)
    ||!isObj(expected)||typeof expected.evidence_hash!=='string'||!HEX64.test(expected.evidence_hash)||typeof expected.cutoff!=='string')fail('invalid_parameter','rejection');
   const digest=operationDigest(judgmentId,row);
   const hit=settlements.find(s=>s.request_key===requestKey);
   if(hit)return {seq:hit.seq,status:hit.judgment_id===judgmentId&&hit.request_digest===digest?'already_applied':'request_key_conflict'};
   const q=queue.get(judgmentId);
   if(!q)return fail('unknown_judgment');
   const [item]=await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:quarantineId},{limit:1});
   const seq=historyOfJ(judgmentId).at(-1)?.seq??0;
   if(!item||item.dataset!=='judgments'||item.natural_key!==judgmentId||item.status!=='open')return {seq,status:'item_not_open'};
   const payload=(isObj(item.payload)?item.payload:{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
   // Q1-03: the identity the hook read must still be the locked queue's AND the locked item's.
   if(q.closed_at!==null||q.last_status!=='inconsistent'||q.last_detail.evidence_hash!==expected.evidence_hash||q.last_detail.cutoff!==expected.cutoff
    ||payload.evidence_hash!==expected.evidence_hash||payload.cutoff!==expected.cutoff)return {seq,status:'stale'};
   const res=await appendCore(judgmentId,null,requestKey,row);
   if(res.status!=='applied')return res;
   const at=now();const by=row.actor.slice('admin:'.length);
   await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:quarantineId,status:'open'},{status:'resolved_reject',resolved_by:by,resolved_at:at,detail:{...(item.detail as Record<string,unknown>??{}),rejected_settlement_seq:res.seq}});
   await tables.insert('research_audit_log',{id:randomUUID(),user_id:by,actor:'user',action:'dq.quarantine_resolve',object_type:'dq',object_id:quarantineId,detail:{...audit,judgment_id:judgmentId,decision:'reject',seq:res.seq},created_at:at});
   return res;
  },
  async envelopeById(id,o){
   assertView(o.view,o.cutoff);
   const j=judgments.get(id);
   if(!j||!publishable(j.methodology_id,j.methodology_version)||(o.view==='as_known'&&!knownAt(j,o.cutoff!)))return null;
   return envelope(j,o.view,o.cutoff??null);
  },
  async freezeCalibrationCohort(generation,m,v,w){
   if(typeof generation!=='string'||!UUID.test(generation)||!w.from||!w.to||w.from>w.to)fail('invalid_parameter','window');
   // Q1-05: claim the generation first (marker cohort:<generation> in the job-state map, like the SQL); a claimed one — even empty — is reported, not refrozen.
   const marker=`cohort:${generation}`;const claimed=jobs.get(marker);
   if(claimed)return {status:'already_frozen',frozen_at:String(claimed.state.frozen_at),n:Number(claimed.state.n??0)};
   const at=now();
   const list=[...judgments.values()].filter(j=>j.methodology_id===m&&j.methodology_version===v&&!j.abstained&&j.as_of>=w.from&&j.as_of<=w.to)
    .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.judgment_id,b.judgment_id)).map((j,i)=>({judgment_id:j.judgment_id,settlement_id:historyOfJ(j.judgment_id).at(-1)?.settlement_id??null,ord:i+1}));
   members.set(generation,list);
   jobs.set(marker,{state:{frozen_at:at,n:list.length,methodology:m,version:v,window:{from:w.from,to:w.to}},updated_at:at});
   return {status:'frozen',frozen_at:at,n:list.length};
  },
  async cohortMembers(generation,after,limit){
   if(typeof generation!=='string'||!UUID.test(generation))fail('invalid_parameter','generation');
   assertLimit(limit,COHORT_PAGE_MAX);
   return (members.get(generation)??[]).filter(x=>after===null||x.judgment_id>after).slice(0,limit)
    .map(x=>clone({judgment:judgments.get(x.judgment_id)!,settlement:x.settlement_id===null?null:settlements.find(s=>s.settlement_id===x.settlement_id)??null,calibration:null,calibration_valid:false,methodology_state:null}));
  },
  async clearCalibrationGeneration(generation){
   if(typeof generation!=='string'||!UUID.test(generation))fail('invalid_parameter','generation');
   const n=members.get(generation)?.length??0;members.delete(generation);jobs.delete(`cohort:${generation}`);return n;
  },
  calibrationCohort:cohort(true),
  calibrationCohortInternal:cohort(false),
  async latestCalibration(m,v,scope){
   if(!publishable(m,v))return null;
   const row=calibrations.filter(c=>c.methodology_id===m&&c.methodology_version===v&&c.scope_type===scope.scope_type&&c.scope_key===scope.scope_key).sort((a,b)=>ms(b.computed_at)-ms(a.computed_at)||cmp(a.calibration_id,b.calibration_id))[0];
   if(!row)return null;
   const x=validity.get(mk(m,v));
   return {row:clone(row),valid:calibrationIsValid(row,x?x.revision:null,now())};
  },
  async calibrationValidity(m,v){const x=validity.get(mk(m,v));if(!x)return fail('unknown_methodology',`${m}@${v}`);return {revision:x.revision};},
  async insertCalibration(row,expectedRevision){
   const v=validity.get(mk(row.methodology_id,row.methodology_version));
   if(!v)return fail('unknown_methodology',`${row.methodology_id}@${row.methodology_version}`);
   if(row.validity_revision!==expectedRevision||expectedRevision!==v.revision)return 'stale_revision';
   if(calibrations.some(c=>c.fingerprint===row.fingerprint))return 'duplicate';
   const okState=row.kind==='score'?['insufficient','evaluated'].includes(row.state):['insufficient','failed','calibrated'].includes(row.state);
   if(!okState)fail('unknown','judgment_calibrations_state_by_kind');
   if(!(await batchExists(row.batch_id)))fail('unknown','judgment_calibrations_batch_id_fkey');
   calibrations.push(jsonClean(clone(row)));
   return 'inserted';
  },
  async syncMethodology(row,actor,reason){
   if(!/^(script|admin:[0-9a-f-]{36})$/.test(actor))fail('unknown','judgment_methodology_events_actor_check');
   checkMethodology(row);
   const k=mk(row.methodology_id,row.version);const old=meth.get(k);const at=now();const pub=row.publishable??false;
   if(!old){
    meth.set(k,jsonClean(clone({...row,markets:row.markets??null,publishable:pub,created_at:at,synced_at:at})));
    if(!validity.has(k))validity.set(k,{methodology_id:row.methodology_id,version:row.version,revision:1,bumped_at:at,reason:'initial'});
    addEvent(row,1,'registered',row.status,pub,actor,reason,at);
    return {changed:true,seq:1};
   }
   if(!same(immutableOf(row),immutableOf(old)))fail('formula_hash_drift',`formula_hash_drift: ${row.methodology_id}@${row.version} stored ${old.formula_hash}`);
   let seq=Math.max(0,...events.filter(e=>e.methodology_id===row.methodology_id&&e.version===row.version).map(e=>e.seq));let changed=false;
   if(row.status!==old.status){addEvent(row,++seq,'status_changed',row.status,old.publishable,actor,reason,at);changed=true;}
   if(pub!==old.publishable){addEvent(row,++seq,'publishable_changed',row.status,pub,actor,reason,at);changed=true;}
   if(!changed)addEvent(row,++seq,'resynced',row.status,pub,actor,reason,at);
   meth.set(k,{...old,status:row.status,publishable:pub,code_version:row.code_version,synced_at:at});
   return {changed,seq};
  },
  async listMethodologies(status){return clone([...meth.values()].filter(r=>status===undefined||r.status===status).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.methodology_id,b.methodology_id)||cmp(a.version,b.version)));},
  async methodologyStateAt(id,version,cutoff){const e=lastEvent(id,version,cutoff);return e?clone(e):null;},
  async jobState(job){const r=jobs.get(job);return r?clone({state:r.state,updated_at:r.updated_at}):null;},
  async setJobState(job,expectedUpdatedAt,state){
   if(!isObj(state))fail('invalid_parameter','job_state');
   if(typeof job!=='string'||job.length<1||job.length>512)fail('unknown','judgment_job_state_job_check');
   const t=ms(now());const r=jobs.get(job);
   if(expectedUpdatedAt===null){if(r)return false;jobs.set(job,{state:clone(state),updated_at:new Date(t).toISOString()});return true;}
   if(!r||ms(r.updated_at)!==ms(expectedUpdatedAt))return false;
   jobs.set(job,{state:clone(state),updated_at:new Date(Math.max(t,ms(r.updated_at)+1)).toISOString()});
   return true;
  },
  async repairStaleBatches(dataset,olderThanSeconds){
   if(typeof dataset!=='string'||!/^judgments\.[a-z0-9_.]{1,54}$/.test(dataset)||!Number.isFinite(olderThanSeconds)||olderThanSeconds<60)fail('invalid_parameter','repair_stale_batches');
   const t=ms(now());let n=0;
   for(const b of await tables.select('ingest_batches',{dataset,status:'running'})){
    const started=ms(String(b.started_at));
    if(!(started<t-olderThanSeconds*1000))continue;
    const errors=Array.isArray(b.errors)?b.errors:[];
    n+=await tables.update('ingest_batches',{batch_id:b.batch_id,status:'running'},{status:'failed',finished_at:new Date(Math.max(t,started)).toISOString(),
     errors:[...errors,{code:'stale_running',message:`running since ${String(b.started_at)}, repaired after ${olderThanSeconds} seconds`}]});
   }
   return n;
  },
 };

 let chain:Promise<unknown>=Promise.resolve();
 const serial=<T>(f:()=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>=>{const p=chain.then(f,f);chain=p.then(()=>undefined,()=>undefined);return p;};
 const wrapped=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(impl).map(([k,f])=>[k,(...a:unknown[])=>serial(()=>(f as (...x:unknown[])=>Promise<unknown>)(...a))])) as unknown as JudgmentsDb;
 return {
  ...wrapped,
  tables,
  setNow(iso){fixed=iso===null?null:isoTs(iso);},
  addIssuer(id,status='active',mergedInto=null){issuers.set(id,{status,merged_into:mergedInto});},
  addIndustry(scheme,version,code){industries.add(`${scheme}:${version}:${code}`);},
  expireLease(judgmentId){const q=queue.get(judgmentId);if(q&&q.leased_until!==null)q.leased_until=new Date(ms(now())-1).toISOString();},
  snapshot(){return clone({methodologies:[...meth.values()],events,judgments:[...judgments.values()],settlements,queue:[...queue.values()],calibrations,validity:[...validity.values()],jobs:[...jobs.entries()].map(([job,r])=>({job,...r}))});},
 };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 `pg-judgments-db.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/pg-judgments-db.ts
// TEST-ONLY JudgmentsDb over node-postgres calling the same SQL functions supabaseJudgmentsDb calls
// through PostgREST, so the shared contract and the concurrency tests exercise the real schema.
// Every call runs in its own transaction under the role the production client uses: the public
// reads `set local role anon` (RLS and grants apply exactly as through the anon key); every other
// method `set local role service_role` (proving its grants: select on the nine tables, execute on
// the write RPCs, nothing else). Rows come back as to_jsonb(...) so the db.ts normalisers see the
// JSON shapes PostgREST returns; set-returning functions are read `with ordinality` to keep their
// order. Nothing in src/app imports this.
import type {Pool} from 'pg';
import {byQueueOrder,calibrationFromTable,calibrationIsValid,envelopeFromRpc,eventFromTable,isoTs,judgmentFromTable,methodologyFromTable,queueFromTable,settlementArgs,settlementFromTable,subjectStatus,toJudgmentError,assertLimit,QUEUE_LIST_MAX} from './db';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import type {AppendStatus,JudgmentsDb} from './types';

type Row=Record<string,unknown>;
const QUEUE_WHERE:Record<string,string>={
 due:`q.closed_at is null and q.next_attempt_at <= now() and (q.leased_until is null or q.leased_until < now())`,
 backoff:`q.closed_at is null and q.next_attempt_at > now() and (q.leased_until is null or q.leased_until < now())`,
 leased:`q.closed_at is null and q.leased_until >= now()`,
 all:'true',
};

export function pgJudgmentsDb(pool:Pool):JudgmentsDb{
 const run=async(role:'anon'|'service_role',text:string,values:unknown[]=[]):Promise<unknown[]>=>{
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{
   await c.query('begin');await c.query(`set local role ${role}`);
   const r=await c.query(text,values);
   await c.query('commit');
   return r.rows.map(x=>(x as {v:unknown}).v);
  }catch(e){await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});throw toJudgmentError(e);}
  finally{c.release();}
 };
 const pub=(t:string,v:unknown[]=[])=>run('anon',t,v);
 const svc=(t:string,v:unknown[]=[])=>run('service_role',t,v);
 const first=async(p:Promise<unknown[]>)=>(await p)[0];
 const j=(v:unknown)=>v===null||v===undefined?null:JSON.stringify(v);
 const serverTime=async()=>isoTs(await first(pub(`select to_jsonb(public.judgments_server_time()) v`)));
 const srf=(fn:string,args:string)=>`select to_jsonb(e) - 'ordinality' v from public.${fn}(${args}) with ordinality e order by e.ordinality`;
 return {
  serverTime,
  async methodology(id,version){const r=await first(svc(`select to_jsonb(t) v from public.judgment_methodologies t where t.methodology_id=$1 and t.version=$2`,[id,version]));return r?methodologyFromTable(r as Row):null;},
  subjectExists:subject=>subjectStatus(subject,{
   async issuerStatus(id){const r=await first(svc(`select to_jsonb(i.status) v from public.issuers i where i.issuer_id=$1::uuid`,[id]));return r===undefined?null:String(r);},
   async industryExists(scheme,version,code){return (await svc(`select to_jsonb(true) v from public.industry_classifications t where t.scheme=$1 and t.version=$2 and t.code=$3`,[scheme,version,code])).length>0;},
  }),
  async getJudgment(id){const r=await first(svc(`select to_jsonb(t) v from public.judgments t where t.judgment_id=$1::uuid`,[id]));return r?judgmentFromTable(r as Row):null;},
  async judgmentsBySnapshot(snapshotId){return (await svc(`select to_jsonb(t.judgment_id) v from public.judgments t where t.inputs @> $1::jsonb order by t.judgment_id`,[JSON.stringify([{kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:snapshotId}}])])).map(String);},
  async registerJudgment(row,queue){
   const r=await first(svc(`select public.register_judgment($1::jsonb,$2::jsonb) v`,[JSON.stringify(row),j(queue)])) as {registered_at:string;retrospective:boolean};
   return {registered_at:isoTs(r.registered_at),retrospective:r.retrospective===true};
  },
  async latestCards(subject,o){return (await pub(srf('latest_judgment_cards','$1,$2,$3::text[],$4,$5::timestamptz'),[subject.type,subject.key,o.types??null,o.view,o.cutoff??null])).map(x=>envelopeFromRpc(x as Row));},
  async historyOf(subject,type,m,o){return (await pub(srf('judgment_history','$1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::timestamptz,$8::uuid,$9'),[subject.type,subject.key,type,m.id,m.version,o.view,o.cutoff??null,o.before??null,o.limit])).map(x=>envelopeFromRpc(x as Row));},
  async claimDue(limit,leaseSeconds){return (await svc(`select to_jsonb(q) v from public.claim_due_judgments($1,$2) q`,[limit,leaseSeconds])).map(x=>queueFromTable(x as Row)).sort(byQueueOrder);},
  async releaseLease(judgmentId,leaseToken,patch){await svc(`select public.release_lease($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::jsonb) v`,[judgmentId,leaseToken,JSON.stringify(patch)]);},
  async queueRow(id){const r=await first(svc(`select to_jsonb(q) v from public.judgment_settle_queue q where q.judgment_id=$1::uuid`,[id]));return r?queueFromTable(r as Row):null;},
  async queueList(o){
   const where=QUEUE_WHERE[o.filter];
   if(where===undefined)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`filter:${String(o.filter)}`);
   assertLimit(o.limit,QUEUE_LIST_MAX);
   return (await svc(`select to_jsonb(q) v from public.judgment_settle_queue q where ${where} and ($1::uuid is null or q.judgment_id > $1::uuid) order by q.judgment_id limit $2`,[o.after??null,o.limit])).map(x=>queueFromTable(x as Row));
  },
  async settlementsOf(ids){return (await svc(`select to_jsonb(s) v from public.judgment_settlements s where s.judgment_id = any($1::uuid[]) order by s.judgment_id, s.seq`,[[...new Set(ids)]])).map(x=>settlementFromTable(x as Row));},
  async appendSettlement(judgmentId,leaseToken,requestKey,row){
   const r=await first(svc(`select public.append_settlement($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3,$4::jsonb) v`,[judgmentId,leaseToken,requestKey,JSON.stringify(settlementArgs(judgmentId,row))])) as {seq:number;status:AppendStatus};
   return {seq:Number(r.seq),status:r.status};
  },
  async quarantineSettlement(judgmentId,leaseToken,reasonCode,payload,patch,batchId){
   const r=await first(svc(`select public.quarantine_settlement($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3,$4::jsonb,$5::jsonb,$6::uuid) v`,[judgmentId,leaseToken,reasonCode,JSON.stringify(payload),JSON.stringify(patch),batchId])) as {status:'quarantined'|'lease_lost';quarantine_id:string|null};
   return {status:r.status,quarantine_id:r.quarantine_id??null};
  },
  async applyQuarantineOverride(judgmentId,override,quarantineId,audit){return await first(svc(`select public.apply_quarantine_override($1::uuid,$2::jsonb,$3::uuid,$4::jsonb) v`,[judgmentId,JSON.stringify(override),quarantineId,JSON.stringify(audit)])) as 'applied'|'stale'|'closed'|'item_not_open';},
  async rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgmentId,quarantineId,expected,requestKey,row,audit){
   const r=await first(svc(`select public.reject_quarantined_settlement($1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3::jsonb,$4,$5::jsonb,$6::jsonb) v`,[judgmentId,quarantineId,JSON.stringify(expected),requestKey,JSON.stringify(settlementArgs(judgmentId,row)),JSON.stringify(audit)])) as {seq:number;status:AppendStatus|'stale'|'item_not_open'};
   return {seq:Number(r.seq),status:r.status};
  },
  async envelopeById(id,o){const [x]=await pub(srf('judgment_envelope_by_id','$1::uuid,$2,$3::timestamptz'),[id,o.view,o.cutoff??null]);return x?envelopeFromRpc(x as Row):null;},
  async freezeCalibrationCohort(generation,m,v,w){
   const r=await first(svc(`select public.freeze_calibration_cohort($1::uuid,$2,$3,$4::date,$5::date) v`,[generation,m,v,w.from,w.to])) as {status:'frozen'|'already_frozen';frozen_at:string;n:number};
   return {status:r.status,frozen_at:isoTs(r.frozen_at),n:Number(r.n)};
  },
  async cohortMembers(generation,after,limit){return (await svc(srf('calibration_cohort_members','$1::uuid,$2::uuid,$3'),[generation,after,limit])).map(x=>envelopeFromRpc(x as Row));},
  async clearCalibrationGeneration(generation){return Number(await first(svc(`select public.clear_calibration_generation($1::uuid) v`,[generation])));},
  async calibrationCohort(m,v,w,cutoff,after,limit){return (await pub(srf('calibration_cohort','$1,$2,$3::date,$4::date,$5::timestamptz,$6::uuid,$7'),[m,v,w.from,w.to,cutoff,after,limit])).map(x=>envelopeFromRpc(x as Row));},
  async calibrationCohortInternal(m,v,w,cutoff,after,limit){return (await svc(srf('calibration_cohort_internal','$1,$2,$3::date,$4::date,$5::timestamptz,$6::uuid,$7'),[m,v,w.from,w.to,cutoff,after,limit])).map(x=>envelopeFromRpc(x as Row));},
  async latestCalibration(m,v,scope){
   const r=await first(pub(`select to_jsonb(c) v from public.judgment_calibrations c where c.methodology_id=$1 and c.methodology_version=$2 and c.scope_type=$3 and c.scope_key=$4 order by c.computed_at desc, c.calibration_id limit 1`,[m,v,scope.scope_type,scope.scope_key]));
   if(!r)return null;
   const row=calibrationFromTable(r as Row);
   const rev=await first(pub(`select to_jsonb(x.revision) v from public.judgment_calibration_validity x where x.methodology_id=$1 and x.version=$2`,[m,v]));
   return {row,valid:calibrationIsValid(row,rev===undefined?null:Number(rev),await serverTime())};
  },
  async calibrationValidity(m,v){
   const rev=await first(svc(`select to_jsonb(x.revision) v from public.judgment_calibration_validity x where x.methodology_id=$1 and x.version=$2`,[m,v]));
   if(rev===undefined)throw new JudgmentError('unknown_methodology',`${m}@${v}`);
   return {revision:Number(rev)};
  },
  async insertCalibration(row,expectedRevision){return await first(svc(`select public.insert_calibration($1::jsonb,$2) v`,[JSON.stringify(row),expectedRevision])) as 'inserted'|'duplicate'|'stale_revision';},
  async syncMethodology(row,actor,reason){const r=await first(svc(`select public.sync_methodology($1::jsonb,$2,$3) v`,[JSON.stringify(row),actor,reason])) as {changed:boolean;seq:number};return {changed:r.changed===true,seq:Number(r.seq)};},
  async listMethodologies(status){return (await pub(`select to_jsonb(t) v from public.judgment_methodologies t where ($1::text is null or t.status=$1) order by t.methodology_id, t.version`,[status??null])).map(x=>methodologyFromTable(x as Row));},
  async methodologyStateAt(id,version,cutoff){
   const r=await first(pub(`select to_jsonb(e) v from public.methodology_state_at($1,$2,$3::timestamptz) e`,[id,version,cutoff])) as Row|undefined;
   return r&&r.event_id!==null&&r.event_id!==undefined?eventFromTable(r):null;
  },
  async jobState(job){const r=await first(svc(`select jsonb_build_object('state',t.state,'updated_at',t.updated_at) v from public.judgment_job_state t where t.job=$1`,[job])) as Row|undefined;return r?{state:r.state as Record<string,unknown>,updated_at:isoTs(r.updated_at)}:null;},
  async setJobState(job,expectedUpdatedAt,state){return (await first(svc(`select public.set_job_state($1,$2::timestamptz,$3::jsonb) v`,[job,expectedUpdatedAt,JSON.stringify(state)])))===true;},
  async repairStaleBatches(dataset,olderThanSeconds){return Number(await first(svc(`select public.repair_stale_batches($1,$2::interval) v`,[dataset,`${olderThanSeconds} seconds`])));},
 };
}
```

```ts
const COUNTERS:readonly ('fetched'|'inserted'|'duplicates'|'versioned'|'quarantined'|'failed')[]=['fetched','inserted','duplicates','versioned','quarantined','failed'];
```

```ts
function assertCounts(counts:BatchCounts):void{
 if(!counts||COUNTERS.some(k=>!Number.isSafeInteger(counts[k])||counts[k]<0))throw new Error('invalid_counts');
 // F4
 if(counts.deferred!==undefined&&(!Number.isSafeInteger(counts.deferred)||counts.deferred<0))throw new Error('invalid_counts');
 // /F4
}
// F4
/** Every counter present, deferred absent → 0 (reading receipts written before F4, spec §7.5). */
export function normalizeCounts(c:BatchCounts):Required<BatchCounts>{
 assertCounts(c);
 return {fetched:c.fetched,inserted:c.inserted,duplicates:c.duplicates,versioned:c.versioned,quarantined:c.quarantined,failed:c.failed,deferred:c.deferred??0};
}
```

```ts
import {snapshotOf} from '@/lib/facts/providers/shared';
import type {Duration,FactCandidate,FactInsert,FilingCandidate,FormType,ParseResult,Statement} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {uuidV8} from '@/lib/judgments/uuid-v8';
import type {FactsMarket} from '../types';

export const AAPL_ISSUER='00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000320193';
export const FIXED_NOW='2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z';
const hex=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
export const seedFilingId=(issuer:string,sourceRef:string)=>uuidV8(hex(`filing:${issuer}:${sourceRef}`));
export const seedFactId=(issuer:string,filingRef:string,rawHash:string)=>uuidV8(hex(`fact:${issuer}:${filingRef}:${rawHash}`));

export function filingCandidate(o:{sourceRef:string;availableDate:string;periodEnd:string|null;market?:FactsMarket;formType?:FormType;fiscalYear?:number|null;fiscalPeriod?:FilingCandidate['fiscalPeriod']}):FilingCandidate{
 const market=o.market??'US';
 return {sourceRef:o.sourceRef,market,source:market==='US'?'edgar':'tushare',origin:market==='US'?'sec':'sse',formType:o.formType??(market==='US'?'10-Q':'q1'),fiscalYear:o.fiscalYear??null,fiscalPeriod:o.fiscalPeriod??null,periodEnd:o.periodEnd,availableDate:o.availableDate,url:null};
}
export function factCandidate(o:{filingRef:string;concept:string;periodStart:string|null;periodEnd:string;duration:Duration;value:string;unit?:string;statement?:Statement;rawHash?:string}):FactCandidate{
 return {concept:o.concept,sourceConcept:`test:${o.concept}`,statement:o.statement??(o.duration==='INSTANT'?'BS':'IS'),periodStart:o.periodStart,periodEnd:o.periodEnd,duration:o.duration,value:o.value,unit:o.unit??'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',filingRef:o.filingRef,rawHash:o.rawHash??`${o.filingRef}|${o.concept}|${o.periodStart??''}|${o.periodEnd}|${o.value}`};
}
export interface PublishInput{issuer:string;market:FactsMarket;filings:FilingCandidate[];facts:FactCandidate[];quarantineRawHashes?:string[];publish?:boolean}
/** One run for the issuer. publish:false leaves the run staged (its facts stay non-ok); a later publishFacts call for the same issuer abandons it (beginRun). */
export async function publishFacts(db:MemoryFactsDb,o:PublishInput):Promise<{runId:string;filingIds:Map<string,string>;factIds:Map<string,string>}>{
 await db.reconcileScope(o.market,[{issuer_id:o.issuer,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:o.issuer}]);
 const batch=randomUUID();
 if(!await db.claimLease(o.issuer,o.market,batch,3600))throw new Error(`seed_lease_busy:${o.issuer}`);
 const runId=await db.beginRun(o.issuer,o.market,batch,1);
 const filingIds=await db.stageFilings(runId,o.filings.map(f=>({...f,filing_id:seedFilingId(o.issuer,f.sourceRef),issuer_id:o.issuer})));
 const byRef=new Map(o.filings.map(f=>[f.sourceRef,f] as const));
 const factIds=new Map<string,string>();
 const rows:FactInsert[]=o.facts.map(c=>{
  const filingId=filingIds.get(c.filingRef);const f=byRef.get(c.filingRef);
  if(!filingId||!f)throw new Error(`seed_unknown_filing:${c.filingRef}`);
  const fact_id=seedFactId(o.issuer,c.filingRef,c.rawHash);factIds.set(c.rawHash,fact_id);
  return {fact_id,issuer_id:o.issuer,market:o.market,filing_id:filingId,concept:c.concept,source_concept:c.sourceConcept,statement:c.statement,period_start:c.periodStart,period_end:c.periodEnd,duration:c.duration,value:c.value,unit:c.unit,consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:f.availableDate,mapping_gen:1,mapping_version:MAPPING_VERSION,raw_hash:c.rawHash};
 });
 await db.stageFacts(runId,rows);
 if(o.quarantineRawHashes&&o.quarantineRawHashes.length>0){
  const item=await quarantine(db.tables,{dataset:`facts.${o.market.toLowerCase()}`,table:'financial_facts',naturalKey:`${o.issuer}:seed:${runId}`,reasonCode:'identity_bs',batchId:batch});
  await db.quarantineFacts(runId,o.quarantineRawHashes.map(h=>{const id=factIds.get(h);if(!id)throw new Error(`seed_unknown_raw_hash:${h}`);return id;}),item);
 }
 if(o.publish!==false)await db.publishRun(runId,[...new Set(filingIds.values())]);
 await db.releaseLease(o.issuer,o.market,batch,'success','2100-01-01T00:00:00.000Z');
 return {runId,filingIds,factIds};
}
export function aaplParse(sinceYear=2022):ParseResult{
 const bytes=new Uint8Array(readFileSync(new URL('../../facts/fixtures/edgar/CIK0000320193.trimmed.json',import.meta.url)));
 return parseCompanyFacts(snapshotOf(bytes,{source:'edgar'}),{sinceYear,today:new Date(FIXED_NOW)});
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/origins.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {ORIGINS,originFor,originKey,originKnown} from './origins';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS} from './types';
import type {Origin} from './types';

const code=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();return 'ok';}catch(e){return e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:'other';}};
describe('ORIGINS (spec §3.5: origin is a frozen table, not free text)',()=>{
 it('is frozen, keyed kind×adapter, covers every public kind, and every row is unverified',()=>{
  expect(Object.isFrozen(ORIGINS)).toBe(true);
  for(const [k,t] of Object.entries(ORIGINS)){expect(Object.isFrozen(t)).toBe(true);expect(k).toBe(originKey(k.split('×')[0] as never,t.adapter));expect('license_status' in t).toBe(false);}
  for(const kind of PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS)expect(Object.keys(ORIGINS).some(k=>k.startsWith(`${kind}×`))).toBe(true);
  expect(Object.keys(ORIGINS).some(k=>k.startsWith('document_span×'))).toBe(false);
  expect(ORIGINS['legacy_fill×eastmoney']).toBeDefined();   // spec §11.2: the private adapter's origin row
 });
 it('originFor fills the locator template and the fixed / optional transform',()=>{
  expect(originFor('price_bar','eastmoney',{market:'A',ticker:'600519.SH',date:'2024-06-19',adjustment:'qfq'})).toEqual({publisher:'交易所行情（经东方财富转发）',adapter:'eastmoney',locator:'eastmoney:kline:A:600519.SH:2024-06-19:qfq'});
  expect(originFor('financial_metric','edgar',{issuer_id:'i',metric:'ttm_revenue',period_start:'2023-10-01',period_end:'2024-09-28',formula_version:'facts-derive/1.0'}).transform).toBe('derive:facts-derive/1.0');
  expect(originFor('price_bar','datagateway',{market:'US',ticker:'NVDA',date:'2024-06-10',adjustment:'qfq'},{transform:'close_only'}).transform).toBe('close_only');
  expect('transform' in originFor('price_bar','datagateway',{market:'US',ticker:'NVDA',date:'2024-06-10',adjustment:'qfq'})).toBe(false);
 });
 it('unknown key, missing variable and a disallowed transform → input_origin_unknown',()=>{
  expect(code(()=>originFor('price_bar','sina',{}))).toBe('input_origin_unknown');
  expect(code(()=>originFor('document_span','f3',{}))).toBe('input_origin_unknown');
  expect(code(()=>originFor('judgment','judgments',{}))).toBe('input_origin_unknown');
  expect(code(()=>originFor('price_bar','eastmoney',{market:'A',ticker:'x',date:'d',adjustment:'qfq'},{transform:'close_only'}))).toBe('input_origin_unknown');
  expect(code(()=>originFor('financial_metric','edgar',{issuer_id:'i',metric:'m',period_start:'s',period_end:'e',formula_version:'f'},{transform:'other'}))).toBe('input_origin_unknown');
 });
 it('originKnown accepts built origins and rejects edited ones',()=>{
  const o=originFor('judgment','judgments',{judgment_id:'00000000-0000-8000-8000-000000000001'});
  expect(originKnown('judgment',o)).toBe(true);
  expect(originKnown('judgment',{...o,publisher:'x'})).toBe(false);
  expect(originKnown('judgment',{...o,license_status:'confirmed'} as never)).toBe(false);   // D3: a licence field is an unknown key
  expect(originKnown('judgment',{...o,locator:'elsewhere'})).toBe(false);
  expect(originKnown('judgment',{...o,transform:'x'})).toBe(false);
  expect(originKnown('macro_snapshot',o)).toBe(false);
  expect(originKnown('judgment',{...o,extra:1} as unknown as Origin)).toBe(false);
  const m=originFor('financial_metric','tushare',{issuer_id:'i',metric:'roe',period_start:'2023-01-01',period_end:'2023-12-31',formula_version:'facts-derive/1.0'});
  expect(originKnown('financial_metric',m)).toBe(true);
  expect(originKnown('financial_metric',{...m,transform:undefined} as unknown as Origin)).toBe(false);
  const c=originFor('price_bar','datagateway',{market:'HK',ticker:'00700.HK',date:'2024-05-17',adjustment:'qfq'},{transform:'close_only'});
  expect(originKnown('price_bar',c)).toBe(true);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/facts-derive.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {DERIVE_CONCEPTS,FORMULA_VERSION,deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import type {FactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {deriveMetricsAsOf} from './facts-derive';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {FIXED_NOW,factCandidate,filingCandidate,publishFacts} from './testing/facts-fixture';

const ISSUER='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1';
async function seeded(){
 const db=memoryFactsDb();db.setNow(FIXED_NOW);
 await publishFacts(db,{issuer:ISSUER,market:'US',filings:[filingCandidate({sourceRef:'q1',availableDate:'2024-05-01',periodEnd:'2024-03-31'}),filingCandidate({sourceRef:'q2',availableDate:'2024-08-01',periodEnd:'2024-06-30'})],facts:[
  factCandidate({filingRef:'q1',concept:'revenue',periodStart:'2024-01-01',periodEnd:'2024-03-31',duration:'3M',value:'1000'}),
  factCandidate({filingRef:'q1',concept:'gross_profit',periodStart:'2024-01-01',periodEnd:'2024-03-31',duration:'3M',value:'400'}),
  factCandidate({filingRef:'q2',concept:'revenue',periodStart:'2024-04-01',periodEnd:'2024-06-30',duration:'3M',value:'1200'}),
  factCandidate({filingRef:'q2',concept:'gross_profit',periodStart:'2024-04-01',periodEnd:'2024-06-30',duration:'3M',value:'600'})]});
 return db;
}
describe('deriveMetricsAsOf (spec §12.2 S03: composed like GET /api/facts/[ticker]/metrics?asOf=)',()=>{
 it('derives over the cutoff envelope with basedOnRev = state_rev and returns the envelope',async()=>{
  const db=await seeded();
  const r=await deriveMetricsAsOf(db,ISSUER,'US','2024-06-30',FORMULA_VERSION);
  expect(r.metrics.filter(m=>m.metric==='gross_margin').map(m=>[m.period_end,m.value])).toEqual([['2024-03-31','0.4']]);
  const env=await db.readFacts(ISSUER,'US',{concepts:[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS.US],asOf:'2024-06-30',history:true});
  expect(r.envelope).toEqual(env);
  expect(r.metrics).toEqual(deriveMetrics(env.rows,{market:'US',asOf:'2024-06-30',basedOnRev:env.stateRev}));
  expect(r.metrics.every(m=>m.based_on_rev===env.stateRev&&m.as_of==='2024-06-30')).toBe(true);
  const later=await deriveMetricsAsOf(db,ISSUER,'US','2024-08-01',FORMULA_VERSION);
  expect(later.metrics.filter(m=>m.metric==='gross_margin').map(m=>m.period_end)).toEqual(['2024-03-31','2024-06-30']);
 });
 it('refuses another formula version, a truncated envelope and a malformed date',async()=>{
  const db=await seeded();
  await expect(deriveMetricsAsOf(db,ISSUER,'US','2024-08-01','facts-derive/0.9')).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'unsupported_formula_version'});
  const truncated:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'>={readFacts:async()=>({stateRev:3,rows:[],truncated:true})};
  const e=await deriveMetricsAsOf(truncated,ISSUER,'US','2024-08-01',FORMULA_VERSION).catch(x=>x);
  expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(JudgmentError);expect(e.code).toBe('read_truncated');
  await expect(deriveMetricsAsOf(db,ISSUER,'US','2024/08/01',FORMULA_VERSION)).rejects.toThrow(/YYYY-MM-DD/);
 });
});
```
