```ts
// src/lib/judgments/inputs.test.ts
// spec §14.1 inputs.test.ts: every builder is stable on fixtures and independent of field order;
// financial_fact from the plan-2 EDGAR fixture (CIK0000320193.trimmed.json via the real parser);
// quarantined / non-ok rows → input_not_public; price_bar close-only fields are null; origin keys
// are table rows; inputs_hash ignores array order; the whitelist rejects document_span / legacy_fill.
import {beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import {FORMULA_VERSION} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import type {MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {canonicalize,digest} from './canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {memoryJudgmentInputsDb} from './inputs-db';
import {buildInput,buildOrAbstain,inputLabel,inputsHashOf,rebuildAndCompare,sortInputs} from './inputs';
import type {InputRequest} from './inputs';
import type {KlineRange} from './kline';
import {fixtureMacroReadApi,observationIdOf} from './macro-api';
import type {MacroFixture} from './macro-api';
import {originKnown} from './origins';
import {closeInstantUtc} from './time';
import type {Input,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentRow,KlineRangeRequest,MetricKey} from './types';
import {AAPL_ISSUER,FIXED_NOW,aaplParse,factCandidate,filingCandidate,publishFacts,seedFactId} from './testing/facts-fixture';

const code=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>'ok',(e:unknown)=>e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:`other:${String(e)}`);
const reversed=<T extends object>(o:T)=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).reverse());
let aapl:JudgmentInputsDb;let fy23RevenueId:string;
beforeAll(async()=>{
 const facts=memoryFactsDb();facts.setNow(FIXED_NOW);
 const p=aaplParse(2022);
 await publishFacts(facts,{issuer:AAPL_ISSUER,market:'US',filings:p.filings,facts:p.candidates});
 const c=p.candidates.find(x=>x.concept==='revenue'&&x.periodEnd==='2023-09-30'&&x.duration==='12M'&&x.filingRef==='0000320193-23-000106')!;
 fy23RevenueId=seedFactId(AAPL_ISSUER,c.filingRef,c.rawHash);
 aapl=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({facts});
},60_000);

describe('financial_fact (spec §3.5, §3.7)',()=>{
 it('projects the AAPL FY2023 revenue row from the recorded EDGAR fixture, stably',async()=>{
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:fy23RevenueId}},aapl,'2023-12-31');
  expect(a.snapshot).toMatchObject({fact_id:fy23RevenueId,issuer_id:AAPL_ISSUER,market:'US',concept:'revenue',period_start:'2022-09-25',period_end:'2023-09-30',duration:'12M',value_text:'383285000000',unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:'2023-11-03',mapping_gen:1});
  expect(Object.keys(a.snapshot).sort()).toEqual(['available_date','concept','consolidation','duration','fact_id','filing_id','issuer_id','market','mapping_gen','period_end','period_start','unit','value_text']);
  expect(a.available_at).toBe('2023-11-03T23:59:59.999Z');
  expect(a.hash).toBe(digest(a.snapshot));
  expect(digest(reversed(a.snapshot))).toBe(a.hash);   // field order is irrelevant (RFC 8785)
  expect(a.origin).toMatchObject({adapter:'edgar'});expect('license_status' in a.origin).toBe(false);expect(originKnown('financial_fact',a.origin)).toBe(true);
  expect(await buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:fy23RevenueId}},aapl,'2023-12-31')).toEqual(a);
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare(a,aapl,'2023-12-31')).toEqual({status:'ok'});
 });
 it('a row not yet available at as_of, quarantined, staged or unknown → input_not_public',async()=>{
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:fy23RevenueId}},aapl,'2023-11-02'))).toBe('input_not_public');
  const facts=memoryFactsDb();facts.setNow(FIXED_NOW);
  const I='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000d1';
  const k=filingCandidate({sourceRef:'k1',availableDate:'2024-02-01',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',formType:'10-K'});
  const ok=factCandidate({filingRef:'k1',concept:'revenue',periodStart:'2023-01-01',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',duration:'12M',value:'10'});
  const q=factCandidate({filingRef:'k1',concept:'net_income_parent',periodStart:'2023-01-01',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',duration:'12M',value:'1'});
  const r1=await publishFacts(facts,{issuer:I,market:'US',filings:[k],facts:[ok,q],quarantineRawHashes:[q.rawHash]});
  const k2=filingCandidate({sourceRef:'k2',availableDate:'2024-03-01',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',formType:'10-K/A'});
  const staged=factCandidate({filingRef:'k2',concept:'gross_profit',periodStart:'2023-01-01',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',duration:'12M',value:'4'});
  const r2=await publishFacts(facts,{issuer:I,market:'US',filings:[k2],facts:[staged],publish:false});
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({facts});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:r1.factIds.get(ok.rawHash)!}},db,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('ok');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:r1.factIds.get(q.rawHash)!}},db,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('input_not_public');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:r2.factIds.get(staged.rawHash)!}},db,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('input_not_public');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:'00000000-0000-8000-8000-00000000dead'}},db,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('input_not_public');
 });
});

describe('financial_metric (spec §3.5 S04/S05)',()=>{
 const latestTtm=async(asOf:string):Promise<MetricRow>=>{
  const {metrics}=await aapl.deriveMetricsAsOf(AAPL_ISSUER,'US',asOf,FORMULA_VERSION);
  return metrics.filter(m=>m.metric==='ttm_revenue').sort((a,b)=>a.period_end<b.period_end?-1:1).at(-1)!;
 };
 const keyOf=(m:MetricRow):MetricKey=>({issuer_id:m.issuer_id,market:m.market,metric:m.metric,period_start:m.period_start,period_end:m.period_end,input_unit:m.input_unit,basis:m.basis,formula_version:m.formula_version});
 it('freezes value, lineage and the derivation rows; re-deriving from them alone reproduces the metric',async()=>{
  const m=await latestTtm('2024-12-31');
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'financial_metric',ref:keyOf(m)},aapl,'2024-12-31');
  if(a.kind!=='financial_metric')throw new Error('kind');
  expect(a.ref).toEqual(keyOf(m));
  expect(a.snapshot).toMatchObject({...keyOf(m),value_text:m.value,unit:m.unit,duration:'TTM',as_of:'2024-12-31',based_on_rev:m.based_on_rev,lineage:m.inputs});
  expect(a.snapshot.derivation).toMatchObject({formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,as_of:'2024-12-31',state_rev:m.based_on_rev});
  const ids=new Set(a.snapshot.derivation.rows.map(r=>r.fact_id));
  for(const i of m.inputs)expect(ids.has(i.fact_id)).toBe(true);
  const concepts=new Set(m.inputs.map(i=>i.concept));
  for(const r of a.snapshot.derivation.rows){expect(concepts.has(r.concept)).toBe(true);expect(r.period_end<=m.period_end).toBe(true);expect(Object.values(r).includes(undefined as never)).toBe(false);}
  expect(a.available_at).toBe(`${m.inputs.map(i=>i.available_date).sort().at(-1)}T23:59:59.999Z`);
  expect(a.origin.transform).toBe(`derive:${FORMULA_VERSION}`);
  expect(await buildInput({kind:'financial_metric',ref:reversed(keyOf(m)) as MetricKey},aapl,'2024-12-31')).toEqual(a);
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare(a,aapl,'2024-12-31')).toEqual({status:'ok'});
 });
 it('metric_not_reproducible when the frozen subset cannot reproduce it; other formula → unsupported; absent key → not public',async()=>{
  const m=await latestTtm('2024-12-31');
  const broken:JudgmentInputsDb={...aapl,deriveMetricsAsOf:async(...a)=>{const r=await aapl.deriveMetricsAsOf(...a);return {...r,envelope:{...r.envelope,rows:[]}};}};
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_metric',ref:keyOf(m)},broken,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('metric_not_reproducible');
  expect(await buildOrAbstain({kind:'financial_metric',ref:keyOf(m)},broken,'2024-12-31')).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'metric_not_reproducible',missing:[inputLabel({kind:'financial_metric',ref:keyOf(m)})]});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_metric',ref:{...keyOf(m),formula_version:'facts-derive/0.9'}},aapl,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('unsupported_formula_version');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'financial_metric',ref:{...keyOf(m),period_end:'2030-12-31'}},aapl,'2024-12-31'))).toBe('input_not_public');
 });
});

const bar=(time:string,close:number)=>({time,open:close-1,high:close+1,low:close-2,close,volume:1000,amount:close*1000});
const klineOf=(series:Partial<KlineRange>|{failure:string})=>async(r:KlineRangeRequest)=>('failure' in series?series:{source:r.source,adjustment:r.adjustment,volumeUnit:'shares',close_only:false,from:r.from,to:r.to,bars:[],...series}) as never;
const VERIFIED={capability:()=>({status:'verified' as const})};
const BAR_REF={ticker:'600519.SH',market:'A' as const,date:'2024-06-19',source:'eastmoney' as const,adjustment:'qfq' as const};
describe('price_bar (spec §3.5, §7.4 G27)',()=>{
 it('OHLCV bar: every field, available_at = exchange close in UTC, origin from the table',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({kline:klineOf({bars:[bar('2024-06-19',1500)]})});
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'price_bar',ref:BAR_REF},db,'2024-06-19',VERIFIED);
  expect(a.snapshot).toEqual({...BAR_REF,open:1499,high:1501,low:1498,close:1500,volume:1000,amount:1500000,fields_present:['open','high','low','close','volume','amount']});
  expect(a.available_at).toBe(closeInstantUtc('2024-06-19','A'));
  expect(a.origin.locator).toBe('eastmoney:kline:A:600519.SH:2024-06-19:qfq');expect('transform' in a.origin).toBe(false);
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare(a,db,'2024-06-19',VERIFIED)).toEqual({status:'ok'});
 });
 it('close-only bar: open/high/low/volume/amount are null, fields_present = [close], transform close_only',async()=>{
  const ref={...BAR_REF,source:'datagateway' as const,ticker:'NVDA',market:'US' as const,date:'2024-06-10'};
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({kline:klineOf({close_only:true,bars:[{time:'2024-06-10',open:121.79,high:121.79,low:121.79,close:121.79,volume:0}]})});
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'price_bar',ref},db,'2024-06-10',VERIFIED);
  expect(a.snapshot).toEqual({...ref,open:null,high:null,low:null,close:121.79,volume:null,amount:null,fields_present:['close']});
  expect(a.origin.transform).toBe('close_only');expect(originKnown('price_bar',a.origin)).toBe(true);
 });
 it('unverified capability → market_unsupported; empty / missing date → not public; transient → input_unavailable',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({kline:klineOf({bars:[bar('2024-06-19',1500)]})});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'price_bar',ref:{...BAR_REF,source:'sina'}},db,'2024-06-19'))).toBe('market_unsupported');
  expect(await buildOrAbstain({kind:'price_bar',ref:{...BAR_REF,source:'sina'}},db,'2024-06-19')).toMatchObject({abstained:true,reason:'market_unsupported'});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'price_bar',ref:{...BAR_REF,date:'2024-06-18'}},db,'2024-06-19',VERIFIED))).toBe('input_not_public');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'price_bar',ref:BAR_REF},memoryJudgmentInputsDb({kline:klineOf({failure:'empty'})}),'2024-06-19',VERIFIED))).toBe('input_not_public');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'price_bar',ref:BAR_REF},memoryJudgmentInputsDb({kline:klineOf({failure:'transient'})}),'2024-06-19',VERIFIED))).toBe('input_unavailable');
 });
});

const obs=(series_id:string,value:number,available_at:string)=>({observation_id:observationIdOf({series_id,period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id:'v1'}),series_id,period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id:'v1',value,unit:'pct',available_at});
const O1=obs('us_ism_pmi',49.1,'2026-10-01T14:00:00.000Z'),O2=obs('us_cpi_yoy',2.9,'2026-10-15T12:30:00.000Z');
const NORM={recovery:0.4,overheat:0.3,stagflation:0.2,recession:0.1};
const MACRO:MacroFixture={fixture_version:'macro-fixture/1',observations:[O1,O2],classifications:[],series_catalog:{US:[{id:'us_cpi_yoy',weight:0.25,created_at:'2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z',updated_at:'2026-10-01T08:00:00.000Z'},{id:'us_ism_pmi',weight:0.25,created_at:'2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z'}]},snapshots:[
 {snapshot_id:'s-ok',region:'US',as_of:'2026-10-16',methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'cat-1',observation_ids:[O1.observation_id,O2.observation_id],regime:{primary_state:'recovery',secondary_state:'overheat',scores:NORM,norm:NORM,coverage:0.8,margin_pp:10,growth_axis:0.5,inflation_axis:-0.2},created_at:'2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',status:'active'},
 {snapshot_id:'s-none',region:'US',as_of:'2026-10-16',methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'cat-1',observation_ids:[O1.observation_id],regime:null,created_at:'2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z',status:'active'},
 {snapshot_id:'s-failed',region:'US',as_of:'2026-10-16',methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'cat-1',observation_ids:[O1.observation_id],regime:null,created_at:'2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z',status:'failed'}]};
describe('macro_observation / macro_snapshot (spec §3.7, audit F10)',()=>{
 const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi(MACRO)});
 it('observation: frozen value / vintage / available_at',async()=>{
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:'us_cpi_yoy',period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id:'v1'}},db,'2026-10-16');
  expect(a.snapshot).toEqual({series_id:'us_cpi_yoy',period_end:'2026-09-30',value:2.9,unit:'pct',vintage_id:'v1',available_at:'2026-10-15T12:30:00.000Z'});
  expect(a.available_at).toBe('2026-10-15T12:30:00.000Z');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:'us_cpi_yoy',period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id:'v9'}},db,'2026-10-16'))).toBe('input_not_public');
 });
 it('snapshot: available_at is the max of its observations, not created_at; unclassified / failed / unavailable',async()=>{
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-ok'}},db,'2026-10-16');
  expect(a.available_at).toBe('2026-10-15T12:30:00.000Z');
  expect(a.snapshot).toEqual({snapshot_id:'s-ok',region:'US',as_of:'2026-10-16',methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'cat-1',observation_ids:[O1.observation_id,O2.observation_id],primary_state:'recovery',secondary_state:'overheat',scores:NORM,norm:NORM,coverage:0.8,margin_pp:10,growth_axis:0.5,inflation_axis:-0.2});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-none'}},db,'2026-10-16'))).toBe('snapshot_unclassified');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-failed'}},db,'2026-10-16'))).toBe('input_not_public');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-ok'}},memoryJudgmentInputsDb(),'2026-10-16'))).toBe('input_unavailable');
 });
});

describe('table_rows and judgment (spec §3.5, §3.7)',()=>{
 const I='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1';
 it('table_rows: available_at = max system timestamp of the rows; rows without one → input_unavailable (abstain), never as_of; future valid_from dropped (P1-08)',async()=>{
  const t=memoryTableClient();
  // The landed schema (20261105091000_issuers.sql) gives neither table a created_at / updated_at.
  await t.insert('issuer_industry_memberships',{issuer_id:I,scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:'801010',valid_from:'2024-01-01',valid_to:null,source:'test',provenance:{}});
  await t.insert('issuer_industry_memberships',{issuer_id:I,scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:'801020',valid_from:'2027-01-01',valid_to:null,source:'test',provenance:{}});
  await t.insert('industry_classifications',{scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:'801010',level:1,name_zh:'农林牧渔',name_en:null,parent_code:null});
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({tables:t});
  const mem={kind:'table_rows' as const,ref:{table:'issuer_industry_memberships' as const,natural_key:`${I}:sw2021:2021`}};
  const cls={kind:'table_rows' as const,ref:{table:'industry_classifications' as const,natural_key:'sw2021:2021:801010'}};
  expect(await code(buildInput(mem,db,'2026-11-01'))).toBe('input_unavailable');            // valid_from is an effective date, not availability
  expect(await code(buildInput(cls,db,'2026-11-01'))).toBe('input_unavailable');            // no timestamp at all: never as_of end of day
  expect(await buildOrAbstain(cls,db,'2026-11-01')).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'input_unavailable',missing:['table_rows:industry_classifications:sw2021:2021:801010']});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'table_rows',ref:{table:'industry_classifications',natural_key:'sw2021:2021:999999'}},db,'2026-11-01'))).toBe('input_not_public');
  // macro_series rows carry system timestamps: available_at = max(updated_at ?? created_at) over the rows
  const mdb=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi(MACRO)});
  const macro=await buildInput({kind:'table_rows',ref:{table:'macro_series',natural_key:'US'}},mdb,'2026-11-01');
  if(macro.kind!=='table_rows')throw new Error('kind');
  expect(macro.available_at).toBe('2026-10-01T08:00:00.000Z');expect(macro.origin.adapter).toBe('macro_workbench');
  // …so a historical as_of before the rows were known cannot use them (registration's lookahead bound is as_of end of day)
  expect(Date.parse(macro.available_at)>Date.parse('2026-09-15T23:59:59.999Z')).toBe(true);
  // one row without a system timestamp makes the whole input unevidenced
  const bare=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi({...MACRO,series_catalog:{US:[...MACRO.series_catalog.US!,{id:'us_unrate',weight:0.1}]}})});
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'table_rows',ref:{table:'macro_series',natural_key:'US'}},bare,'2026-11-01'))).toBe('input_unavailable');
  // a future-effective row is dropped before the timestamp rule applies
  const t2=memoryTableClient();
  await t2.insert('issuer_industry_memberships',{issuer_id:I,scheme:'sw2021',version:'2021',code:'801020',valid_from:'2027-01-01',valid_to:null,source:'test',provenance:{}});
  expect(await code(buildInput(mem,memoryJudgmentInputsDb({tables:t2}),'2026-11-01'))).toBe('input_not_public');
 });
 it('judgment: public, active rows only; available_at = registered_at',async()=>{
  const base={subject_type:'macro_region',subject_key:'US',judgment_type:'macro_regime',methodology_id:'m',methodology_version:'v1',kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',producer_ref:{},producer_nonce:'',as_of:'2026-10-16',registered_at:'2026-10-16T02:00:00.000Z',retrospective:false,inputs:[],inputs_hash:'0'.repeat(64),code_version:'abcdef0',batch_id:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e2',created_at:'2026-10-16T02:00:00.000Z',horizon:null,target:null,label_policy:null,settle_after:null,settle_by:null,condition:null} as const;
  const active={...base,judgment_id:'00000000-0000-8000-8000-0000000000e3',abstained:false,abstain_reason:null,claim:{selected:'recovery',classes:['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'],scores_are_not_probabilities:true}} as unknown as JudgmentRow;
  const abstained={...base,judgment_id:'00000000-0000-8000-8000-0000000000e4',abstained:true,abstain_reason:'x',claim:null} as unknown as JudgmentRow;
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({judgments:[active,abstained]});
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'judgment',ref:{judgment_id:active.judgment_id}},db,'2026-10-17');
  expect(a.snapshot).toEqual({judgment_id:active.judgment_id,claim:active.claim,as_of:'2026-10-16'});
  expect(a.available_at).toBe('2026-10-16T02:00:00.000Z');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'judgment',ref:{judgment_id:abstained.judgment_id}},db,'2026-10-17'))).toBe('input_not_public');
 });
});

describe('whitelist, hashing and rebuild (spec §3.5, §6.2 step 1)',()=>{
 it('legacy_fill and document_span are never public inputs',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb();
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'legacy_fill',ref:{recommendation_id:'r'}} as unknown as InputRequest,db,'2026-01-01'))).toBe('input_not_allowed');
  expect(await code(buildInput({kind:'document_span',ref:{doc:'d'}} as unknown as InputRequest,db,'2026-01-01'))).toBe('input_not_allowed');
  const fake={kind:'legacy_fill',ref:{recommendation_id:'r'},snapshot:{},hash:digest({}),available_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',origin:{publisher:'p',adapter:'eastmoney',locator:'l'}} as unknown as Input;
  expect(await code(rebuildAndCompare(fake,db,'2026-01-01'))).toBe('input_not_allowed');
 });
 it('inputs_hash and sortInputs ignore array order',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi(MACRO)});
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-ok'}},db,'2026-10-16');
  const b=await buildInput({kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:'us_ism_pmi',period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id:'v1'}},db,'2026-10-16');
  const c=await buildInput({kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:'us_cpi_yoy',period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id:'v1'}},db,'2026-10-16');
  expect(inputsHashOf([a,b,c])).toBe(inputsHashOf([c,a,b]));
  expect(sortInputs([c,a,b]).map(x=>inputLabel(x))).toEqual(sortInputs([a,b,c]).map(x=>inputLabel(x)));
  expect(sortInputs([c,a,b]).map(x=>x.kind)).toEqual(['macro_observation','macro_observation','macro_snapshot']);
 });
 it('rebuildAndCompare names the mismatching field; a vanished row is input_not_public',async()=>{
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi(MACRO)});
  const a=await buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-ok'}},db,'2026-10-16');
  if(a.kind!=='macro_snapshot')throw new Error('kind');
  const tampered={...a,snapshot:{...a.snapshot,coverage:0.9}};
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare({...tampered,hash:digest(tampered.snapshot)},db,'2026-10-16')).toEqual({status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'snapshot'});
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare(tampered,db,'2026-10-16')).toEqual({status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'hash'});
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare({...a,available_at:'2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z'},db,'2026-10-16')).toEqual({status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'available_at'});
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare({...a,origin:{...a.origin,locator:'macro_snapshots:other'}},db,'2026-10-16')).toEqual({status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'origin'});
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare({...a,ref:{...a.ref,extra:'x'} as never},db,'2026-10-16')).toEqual({status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'ref'});
  expect(await rebuildAndCompare(a,memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi({...MACRO,snapshots:[]})}),'2026-10-16')).toEqual({status:'input_not_public',code:'input_not_public'});
  expect(canonicalize(a.ref)).toBe('{"snapshot_id":"s-ok"}');
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/inputs.ts
// Fixed input builders (spec §3.5, audit G03). buildInput(request, inputsDb, asOf) is the ONLY way an
// Input is made — snapshot (frozen projection), hash = digest(snapshot), available_at (§3.7),
// origin (origins.ts) — and it reads only through JudgmentInputsDb's public (anon) paths, so a
// quarantined / unpublished / non-ok row never becomes a public input (input_not_public).
// rebuildAndCompare re-runs the builder at registration and demands byte equality (§6.2 step 1).
// Kinds: financial_fact — factsByIds locates the (ok) row, readFacts(asOf, history) proves it is
// visible at as_of on its published generation; financial_metric — S04/S05: cutoff derivation via
// deriveMetricsAsOf (never the materialised cache); the frozen derivation rows are every envelope
// row whose concept is in the lineage and whose period_end ∈ [period_start − 400 d, period_end],
// sorted (concept, period_start, period_end, unit, disclosure_seq, fact_id); self-check: deriving
// from those rows alone must give exactly one row with the same key, value and inputs, else
// metric_not_reproducible (so a too-narrow subset fails at registration, not at replay);
// macro_observation; macro_snapshot — available_at = max of its observations' available_at, never
// created_at (audit F10); a snapshot without a regime is snapshot_unclassified; price_bar — only
// verified capability rows (else market_unsupported), close-only bars keep only close (G27);
// table_rows — rows with valid_from after as_of are dropped; available_at = max over the rows of their SYSTEM
// timestamp (updated_at, else created_at); a row with neither → input_unavailable (availability cannot be
// evidenced; never substituted by as_of — plan audit P1-08; buildOrAbstain abstains on it for table_rows);
// judgment — public table only, not abstained, available_at = registered_at. legacy_fill / document_span:
// input_not_allowed.
// Snapshots never contain undefined (canonicalize rejects it): optional values become null.
import {FORMULA_VERSION,deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {KlineSourceName} from '@/lib/data/kline/types';
import type {FactRow,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {Abstained,Adjustment,DerivationRow,FactProjection,FactsMarket,Input,InputKind,JudgmentInputsDb,MacroSnapshotSnapshot,MetricKey,MetricSnapshot,PriceBarSnapshot,PriceMarket,PublicTable,Regime} from './types';
import {PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS,PUBLIC_TABLES} from './types';
import {canonicalize,digest} from './canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {closeOnlyOf} from './kline';
import {MacroUnavailable,observationIdOf} from './macro-api';
import {originFor} from './origins';
import {capabilityOf} from './resolvers/price-capabilities';
import type {CapabilityStatus} from './resolvers/price-capabilities';
import {addDaysIso,closeInstantUtc,endOfUtcDay} from './time';
export {inputsHash as inputsHashOf} from './canonical';

export type PublicInputKind=typeof PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS[number];
type RefOf<K extends InputKind>=Extract<Input,{kind:K}>['ref'];
export type InputRequest={[K in PublicInputKind]:{kind:K;ref:RefOf<K>}}[PublicInputKind];
export interface BuildOptions{capability?:(source:KlineSourceName,market:PriceMarket,adjustment:Adjustment)=>{status:CapabilityStatus};signal?:AbortSignal;klineTimeoutMs?:number}
/** Builder codes that mean "this input is missing" at gather time: produce / buildOrAbstain turn them into Abstained. */
export const ABSTAIN_CODES=['input_not_public','market_unsupported','metric_not_reproducible','unsupported_formula_version','snapshot_unclassified','target_unresolvable'] as const;
const NOT_PUBLIC_ON_REBUILD=new Set<string>(['input_not_public','market_unsupported','metric_not_reproducible','unsupported_formula_version','snapshot_unclassified']);
const REGIMES:readonly Regime[]=['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'];
const DAY=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const iso=(v:string)=>new Date(v).toISOString();
const isoMax=(xs:string[])=>xs.reduce((m,x)=>Date.parse(x)>Date.parse(m)?x:m);
const factsAdapter=(m:FactsMarket)=>m==='US'?'edgar':'tushare';
const notPublic=(what:string)=>new JudgmentError('input_not_public',what);

export function inputLabel(x:{kind:InputKind;ref:unknown}):string{
 const r=(x.ref??{}) as Record<string,string>;
 switch(x.kind){
  case 'financial_fact':return `financial_fact:${r.fact_id}`;
  case 'financial_metric':return `financial_metric:${r.metric}@${r.period_start}..${r.period_end}`;
  case 'macro_observation':return `macro_observation:${r.series_id}@${r.period_end}#${r.vintage_id}`;
  case 'macro_snapshot':return `macro_snapshot:${r.snapshot_id}`;
  case 'price_bar':return `price_bar:${r.source}:${r.market}:${r.ticker}@${r.date}/${r.adjustment}`;
  case 'table_rows':return `table_rows:${r.table}:${r.natural_key}`;
  case 'judgment':return `judgment:${r.judgment_id}`;
  case 'legacy_fill':return `legacy_fill:${r.recommendation_id}`;
  default:return `${x.kind}:${canonicalize(x.ref)}`;
 }
}
export function sortInputs<T extends {kind:InputKind;ref:unknown}>(inputs:readonly T[]):T[]{
 return inputs.map(x=>({x,k:`${x.kind}\u0000${canonicalize(x.ref)}`})).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.k,b.k)).map(e=>e.x);
}
export function factProjection(r:FactRow):FactProjection{
 return {fact_id:r.fact_id,issuer_id:r.issuer_id,market:r.market,concept:r.concept,period_start:r.period_start,period_end:r.period_end,duration:r.duration,value_text:r.value_text,unit:r.unit,consolidation:r.consolidation,available_date:r.available_date,filing_id:r.filing_id,mapping_gen:r.mapping_gen};
}
export function derivationRowOf(r:FactRow):DerivationRow{
 return {...factProjection(r),status:r.status,created_at:r.created_at,disclosure_seq:r.disclosure_seq??null,is_current:r.is_current??null,is_revision:r.is_revision??null};
}
/** Snapshot → kernel row: value restored from value_text; run_id/source_concept/statement/mapping_version/raw_hash are never read by deriveMetrics. */
export function factRowOfDerivation(d:DerivationRow):FactRow{
 return {fact_id:d.fact_id,issuer_id:d.issuer_id,market:d.market,filing_id:d.filing_id,run_id:'',concept:d.concept,source_concept:'',statement:'IS',period_start:d.period_start,period_end:d.period_end,duration:d.duration as FactRow['duration'],value:d.value_text,value_text:d.value_text,unit:d.unit,consolidation:d.consolidation,available_date:d.available_date,mapping_gen:d.mapping_gen,mapping_version:'',status:d.status as FactRow['status'],raw_hash:'',created_at:d.created_at,
  ...(d.disclosure_seq!==null?{disclosure_seq:d.disclosure_seq}:{}),...(d.is_current!==null?{is_current:d.is_current}:{}),...(d.is_revision!==null?{is_revision:d.is_revision}:{})};
}
export function derivationRowsFor(rows:readonly FactRow[],m:Pick<MetricRow,'inputs'|'period_start'|'period_end'>):DerivationRow[]{
 const concepts=new Set(m.inputs.map(i=>i.concept));
 const lo=addDaysIso(m.period_start,-400);
 return rows.filter(r=>concepts.has(r.concept)&&r.period_end>=lo&&r.period_end<=m.period_end).map(derivationRowOf)
  .sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.concept,b.concept)||cmp(a.period_start??'',b.period_start??'')||cmp(a.period_end,b.period_end)||cmp(a.unit,b.unit)||((a.disclosure_seq??0)-(b.disclosure_seq??0))||cmp(a.fact_id,b.fact_id));
}
const metricKeyOf=(k:MetricKey):MetricKey=>({issuer_id:k.issuer_id,market:k.market,metric:k.metric,period_start:k.period_start,period_end:k.period_end,input_unit:k.input_unit,basis:k.basis,formula_version:k.formula_version});
const sameKey=(m:MetricRow,k:MetricKey)=>m.issuer_id===k.issuer_id&&m.market===k.market&&m.metric===k.metric&&m.period_start===k.period_start&&m.period_end===k.period_end&&m.input_unit===k.input_unit&&m.basis===k.basis&&m.formula_version===k.formula_version;
async function viaMacro<T>(f:()=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>{
 try{return await f();}catch(e){if(e instanceof MacroUnavailable)throw new JudgmentError('input_unavailable',e.message);throw e;}
}

async function buildFact(ref:{fact_id:string},db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string):Promise<Input>{
 const [row]=await db.facts.factsByIds([ref.fact_id]);
 if(!row||row.fact_id!==ref.fact_id)throw notPublic(`financial_fact ${ref.fact_id}`);
 const env=await db.facts.readFacts(row.issuer_id,row.market,{concepts:[row.concept],asOf,history:true});
 if(env.truncated)throw new JudgmentError('read_truncated',`financial_fact ${ref.fact_id}`);
 const r=env.rows.find(x=>x.fact_id===ref.fact_id&&x.status==='ok');
 if(!r)throw notPublic(`financial_fact ${ref.fact_id} is not visible at ${asOf}`);
 const snapshot=factProjection(r);
 return {kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:ref.fact_id},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:endOfUtcDay(r.available_date),origin:originFor('financial_fact',factsAdapter(r.market),{fact_id:r.fact_id,filing_id:r.filing_id})};
}
async function buildMetric(raw:MetricKey,db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string):Promise<Input>{
 const key=metricKeyOf(raw);const label=inputLabel({kind:'financial_metric',ref:key});
 if(key.formula_version!==FORMULA_VERSION)throw new JudgmentError('unsupported_formula_version',`${label}: ${key.formula_version}`);
 const {metrics,envelope}=await db.deriveMetricsAsOf(key.issuer_id,key.market,asOf,key.formula_version);
 const hits=metrics.filter(m=>sameKey(m,key));
 if(hits.length===0)throw notPublic(`${label} is not derivable at ${asOf}`);
 if(hits.length>1||hits[0].inputs.length===0)throw new JudgmentError('metric_not_reproducible',`${label}: ${hits.length} rows`);
 const m=hits[0];
 const rows=derivationRowsFor(envelope.rows,m);
 const again=deriveMetrics(rows.map(factRowOfDerivation),{market:key.market,asOf,basedOnRev:envelope.stateRev}).filter(x=>sameKey(x,key));
 if(again.length!==1||again[0].value!==m.value||canonicalize(again[0].inputs)!==canonicalize(m.inputs))throw new JudgmentError('metric_not_reproducible',`${label}: the frozen derivation rows do not reproduce it`);
 const snapshot:MetricSnapshot={...key,value_text:m.value,unit:m.unit,duration:m.duration,as_of:asOf,based_on_rev:m.based_on_rev,lineage:m.inputs,derivation:{formula_version:key.formula_version,as_of:asOf,state_rev:envelope.stateRev,rows}};
 const latest=m.inputs.map(i=>i.available_date).sort().at(-1)!;
 return {kind:'financial_metric',ref:key,snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:endOfUtcDay(latest),
  origin:originFor('financial_metric',factsAdapter(key.market),{issuer_id:key.issuer_id,metric:key.metric,period_start:key.period_start,period_end:key.period_end,formula_version:key.formula_version})};
}
async function buildObservation(ref:{series_id:string;period_end:string;vintage_id:string},db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Input>{
 const r={series_id:ref.series_id,period_end:ref.period_end,vintage_id:ref.vintage_id};
 const o=await viaMacro(()=>db.macro.observation(observationIdOf(r)));
 if(!o||o.series_id!==r.series_id||o.period_end!==r.period_end||o.vintage_id!==r.vintage_id)throw notPublic(inputLabel({kind:'macro_observation',ref:r}));
 const snapshot={series_id:o.series_id,period_end:o.period_end,value:o.value,unit:o.unit,vintage_id:o.vintage_id,available_at:iso(o.available_at)};
 return {kind:'macro_observation',ref:r,snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:snapshot.available_at,origin:originFor('macro_observation','macro_workbench',r)};
}
async function buildSnapshot(ref:{snapshot_id:string},db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Input>{
 const label=inputLabel({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref});
 const s=await viaMacro(()=>db.macro.snapshot(ref.snapshot_id));
 if(!s||s.status==='failed'||s.snapshot_id!==ref.snapshot_id)throw notPublic(label);
 if(!s.regime)throw new JudgmentError('snapshot_unclassified',label);
 if(s.observation_ids.length===0)throw notPublic(`${label} has no observations`);
 const stamps:string[]=[];
 for(const id of s.observation_ids){const o=await viaMacro(()=>db.macro.observation(id));if(!o)throw notPublic(`${label}: observation ${id}`);stamps.push(iso(o.available_at));}
 const g=s.regime;const pick=(x:Record<Regime,number>)=>Object.fromEntries(REGIMES.map(k=>[k,x[k]])) as Record<Regime,number>;
 const snapshot:MacroSnapshotSnapshot={snapshot_id:s.snapshot_id,region:s.region,as_of:s.as_of,methodology_version:s.methodology_version,catalog_version:s.catalog_version,observation_ids:[...s.observation_ids],primary_state:g.primary_state,secondary_state:g.secondary_state,scores:pick(g.scores),norm:pick(g.norm),coverage:g.coverage,margin_pp:g.margin_pp,growth_axis:g.growth_axis,inflation_axis:g.inflation_axis};
 return {kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:s.snapshot_id},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:isoMax(stamps),origin:originFor('macro_snapshot','macro_workbench',{snapshot_id:s.snapshot_id})};
}
async function buildBar(raw:{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket;date:string;source:KlineSourceName;adjustment:Adjustment},db:JudgmentInputsDb,opts:BuildOptions):Promise<Input>{
 const ref={ticker:raw.ticker,market:raw.market,date:raw.date,source:raw.source,adjustment:raw.adjustment};const label=inputLabel({kind:'price_bar',ref});
 if(!DAY.test(ref.date))throw new JudgmentError('input_not_allowed',`${label}: date`);
 const cap=(opts.capability??capabilityOf)(ref.source,ref.market,ref.adjustment);
 if(cap.status!=='verified')throw new JudgmentError('market_unsupported',`${label}: capability ${cap.status}`);
 const signal=opts.signal??AbortSignal.timeout(opts.klineTimeoutMs??20_000);
 const s=await db.kline({ticker:ref.ticker,market:ref.market,adjustment:ref.adjustment,source:ref.source,from:ref.date,to:ref.date,signal});
 if('failure' in s){if(s.failure==='empty'||s.failure==='not_found')throw notPublic(`${label}: ${s.failure}`);throw new JudgmentError('input_unavailable',`${label}: ${s.failure}`);}
 const b=s.bars.find(x=>x.time===ref.date);
 if(!b)throw notPublic(`${label}: no bar on that date`);
 const closeOnly=closeOnlyOf(s);
 const snapshot:PriceBarSnapshot=closeOnly
  ?{...ref,open:null,high:null,low:null,close:b.close,volume:null,amount:null,fields_present:['close']}
  :{...ref,open:b.open,high:b.high,low:b.low,close:b.close,volume:b.volume,amount:b.amount??null,fields_present:b.amount===undefined?['open','high','low','close','volume']:['open','high','low','close','volume','amount']};
 return {kind:'price_bar',ref,snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:closeInstantUtc(ref.date,ref.market),
  origin:originFor('price_bar',ref.source,{market:ref.market,ticker:ref.ticker,date:ref.date,adjustment:ref.adjustment},closeOnly?{transform:'close_only'}:{})};
}
async function buildTable(raw:{table:PublicTable;natural_key:string},db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string):Promise<Input>{
 const ref={table:raw.table,natural_key:raw.natural_key};const label=inputLabel({kind:'table_rows',ref});
 if(!(PUBLIC_TABLES as readonly string[]).includes(ref.table))throw new JudgmentError('input_not_allowed',label);
 const all=await viaMacro(()=>db.tableRows(ref.table,ref.natural_key));
 const rows=all.filter(r=>typeof r.valid_from!=='string'||r.valid_from<=asOf);
 if(rows.length===0)throw notPublic(`${label}: no rows visible at ${asOf}`);
 // P1-08: availability is the rows' system time (updated_at, else created_at) — valid_from is an effective date,
 // not a publication time, and the requested as_of is never a substitute.
 const stampOf=(r:Record<string,unknown>):string|null=>{const v=typeof r.updated_at==='string'?r.updated_at:typeof r.created_at==='string'?r.created_at:null;return v!==null&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(v))?iso(v):null;};
 const stamps=rows.map(stampOf);
 if(stamps.some(s=>s===null))throw new JudgmentError('input_unavailable',`${label}: a row has no system timestamp (updated_at / created_at), so its availability at ${asOf} cannot be evidenced`);
 const snapshot={table:ref.table,natural_key:ref.natural_key,rows};
 return {kind:'table_rows',ref,snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:isoMax(stamps as string[]),
  origin:originFor('table_rows',ref.table==='macro_series'?'macro_workbench':'supabase_public',{table:ref.table,natural_key:ref.natural_key})};
}
async function buildJudgment(ref:{judgment_id:string},db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Input>{
 const j=await db.publicJudgment(ref.judgment_id);
 if(!j||j.abstained||j.claim===null)throw notPublic(inputLabel({kind:'judgment',ref}));
 const snapshot={judgment_id:j.judgment_id,claim:j.claim,as_of:j.as_of};
 return {kind:'judgment',ref:{judgment_id:j.judgment_id},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:j.registered_at,origin:originFor('judgment','judgments',{judgment_id:j.judgment_id})};
}

export async function buildInput(req:InputRequest,db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string,opts:BuildOptions={}):Promise<Input>{
 if(!DAY.test(asOf))throw new RangeError(`asOf must be YYYY-MM-DD, got ${asOf}`);
 if(!(PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(req.kind))throw new JudgmentError('input_not_allowed',`${req.kind} is not a public input kind`);
 switch(req.kind){
  case 'financial_fact':return buildFact(req.ref,db,asOf);
  case 'financial_metric':return buildMetric(req.ref,db,asOf);
  case 'macro_observation':return buildObservation(req.ref,db);
  case 'macro_snapshot':return buildSnapshot(req.ref,db);
  case 'price_bar':return buildBar(req.ref,db,opts);
  case 'table_rows':return buildTable(req.ref,db,asOf);
  case 'judgment':return buildJudgment(req.ref,db);
 }
}
export async function buildOrAbstain(req:InputRequest,db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string,opts:BuildOptions={}):Promise<Input|Abstained>{
 try{return await buildInput(req,db,asOf,opts);}
 catch(e){
  if(e instanceof JudgmentError&&(ABSTAIN_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(e.code))return {abstained:true,reason:e.code,missing:[inputLabel(req)]};
  // P1-08: a table_rows input whose rows carry no system timestamp is permanently unevidenced → abstain (for the other
  // kinds input_unavailable is a transient provider failure and stays an error).
  if(e instanceof JudgmentError&&e.code==='input_unavailable'&&req.kind==='table_rows')return {abstained:true,reason:'input_unavailable',missing:[inputLabel(req)]};
  throw e;
 }
}
export type RebuildResult={status:'ok'}|{status:'input_snapshot_mismatch';field:'hash'|'ref'|'snapshot'|'available_at'|'origin'}|{status:'input_not_public';code:string};
export async function rebuildAndCompare(input:Input,db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string,opts:BuildOptions={}):Promise<RebuildResult>{
 if(!(PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(input.kind))throw new JudgmentError('input_not_allowed',`${input.kind} is not a public input kind`);
 if(input.hash!==digest(input.snapshot))return {status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'hash'};
 let fresh:Input;
 try{fresh=await buildInput({kind:input.kind,ref:input.ref} as InputRequest,db,asOf,opts);}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof JudgmentError&&NOT_PUBLIC_ON_REBUILD.has(e.code))return {status:'input_not_public',code:e.code};throw e;}
 if(canonicalize(fresh.ref)!==canonicalize(input.ref))return {status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'ref'};
 if(fresh.hash!==input.hash)return {status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'snapshot'};
 if(fresh.available_at!==input.available_at)return {status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'available_at'};
 if(canonicalize(fresh.origin)!==canonicalize(input.origin))return {status:'input_snapshot_mismatch',field:'origin'};
 return {status:'ok'};
}
```

（核对：`ref` 多出 `extra` 键的用例——`buildSnapshot` 只读 `ref.snapshot_id`，重建出的 `ref` 只有 `snapshot_id`，`canonicalize` 不等 → `field:'ref'`；但那条输入的 `hash` 仍等于 `digest(snapshot)`，所以先过了 `hash` 检查，结论正确。`buildInput` 的 `switch` 覆盖 `PublicInputKind` 全部 7 种，TypeScript 的穷尽检查让函数无隐式 `undefined` 返回。）

```ts
// methodologies/types.ts

export function resolveImport(repoRoot:string,fromAbs:string,spec:string):string|null;

export interface SyncOptions{repoRoot:string;codeVersion:string;only?:ReadonlySet<string>;publish?:ReadonlySet<string>;unpublish?:ReadonlySet<string>;ownerConfirmation?:string;licenses?:LicenseTable}

export function licenseProblems(m:Pick<Methodology,'input_kinds'>,licenses:LicenseTable):string[];   // 'license_unconfirmed:<key>' per reachable key not confirmed

export async function applyMethodologySync(plan:readonly SyncPlanItem[],db:Pick<JudgmentsDb,'syncMethodology'>):Promise<{key:string;changed:boolean;seq:number}[]>;
```

**import 发现方式的选择**：用 TypeScript 编译器的 `ts.preProcessFile(source, readImportFiles=true, detectJavaScriptImports=true)`（`typescript` 已是 devDependency）。它是真正的词法扫描：静态 `import`、`import type`、`export … from`、动态 `import()`、`require()` 全部识别，注释与字符串里的 "import" 不会误报；不做类型检查，所以快。正则做不到"注释 / 字符串不误报"，而误报会让无关文件进闭包、漏报会让实现改动逃过 `formula_hash`——这正是审计 G20 要堵的洞。代价：`formula-hash.ts` 依赖 `typescript`，所以它（和 `methodology-sync.ts`）只能被脚本与测试 import；`register.ts / produce.ts / replay.ts` 都不 import 它（登记只核对 DB 方法行，不重算哈希）。

规格偏差：`methodologyRowOf` 比 BRIEF 多一个 `meta:{publishable, code_version}` 参数（行的这两列不来自模块）。**许可状态不进哈希闭包（决策 D3）**：规格 §3.5 的 `origin` 带 `license_status`、§4.1 说许可确认后才 `publishable`；本计划从契约 `Origin` 与 `origins.ts` 删去 `license_status`（`origins.ts` 在每个方法的 import 闭包里，确认许可若改它会让所有已同步方法 `formula_hash_drift`），改为 `docs/methodologies/licenses.json`（`{"<kind>×<adapter>": {status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, evidence}}`），只由 `scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts` 读取（不被任何方法 import、不进任何 `deps`）；`publishable=true` 只在显式 `--publishable <id@version>` + `--owner-confirmation` **且**方法 `input_kinds` 可达的每个 origin 键都 `confirmed` 时成立；`publishable` 的变化从不重算 `formula_hash`。`fiscal_period.extrapolated`：按规格"已知序列覆盖时为 false"实现为"目标 `period_end` 恰是某个已发布 filing 的 `period_end`"；因锚点取的是已发布序列的最大 `period_end`、目标严格晚于 `as_of`，实际上恒为 `true`——如实保留该字段（52/53 周财年的期末日会与 3 个月外推相差 1–2 天，`extrapolated=true` 提醒 `fact_metric` 的结算方注意，Part C 处理）。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/target.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {memoryJudgmentInputsDb} from './inputs-db';
import {DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS,defaultResolveTarget,graceDaysOf,labelPolicyOf,nthQuarterEndAfter,retrospectiveOf,settleWindow,stepQuarter,targetConsistent} from './target';
import type {Horizon,Input,Target} from './types';
import {FIXED_NOW,filingCandidate,publishFacts} from './testing/facts-fixture';

const codeOf=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();return 'ok';}catch(e){return e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:'other';}};
const bar=(date:string)=>({kind:'price_bar',ref:{ticker:'X',market:'US',date,source:'eastmoney',adjustment:'qfq'},snapshot:{ticker:'X',market:'US',date,source:'eastmoney',adjustment:'qfq',open:null,high:null,low:null,close:1,volume:null,amount:null,fields_present:['close']},hash:'h',available_at:`${date}T20:00:00.000Z`,origin:{publisher:'p',adapter:'eastmoney',locator:'l'}}) as Input;
const H=(unit:Horizon['unit'],n:number):Horizon=>({unit,n});
const I='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f1';

describe('defaultResolveTarget (spec §3.4)',()=>{
 const empty=memoryJudgmentInputsDb();
 it('session_index from the latest price_bar input; no bar → target_unresolvable',async()=>{
  const item={subject:{type:'issuer' as const,key:I},asOf:'2024-06-12'};
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('trading_sessions',5),item,[bar('2024-06-10'),bar('2024-06-12')],empty)).toEqual({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2024-06-12',n:5});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('trading_sessions',5),item,[],empty)).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'target_unresolvable',missing:['price_bar']});
 });
 it('date = as_of + n days (leap day); period = month(as_of) + n, n = 0 is the as_of month',async()=>{
  const item={subject:{type:'macro_region' as const,key:'US'},asOf:'2024-02-28'};
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('calendar_days',1),item,[],empty)).toEqual({kind:'date',date:'2024-02-29'});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('calendar_months',3),{...item,asOf:'2024-11-15'},[],empty)).toEqual({kind:'period',period:'2025-02'});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('calendar_months',0),{...item,asOf:'2024-11-15'},[],empty)).toEqual({kind:'period',period:'2024-11'});
 });
 it('fiscal_period: anchor = latest published filing period_end with available_date ≤ as_of, multi-quarter extrapolation, frozen calendar',async()=>{
  const facts=memoryFactsDb();facts.setNow(FIXED_NOW);
  await publishFacts(facts,{issuer:I,market:'US',facts:[],filings:[
   filingCandidate({sourceRef:'k23',availableDate:'2024-02-01',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',formType:'10-K'}),
   filingCandidate({sourceRef:'q124',availableDate:'2024-05-01',periodEnd:'2024-03-31'}),
   filingCandidate({sourceRef:'q224-late',availableDate:'2024-08-01',periodEnd:'2024-06-30'})]});
  await publishFacts(facts,{issuer:I,market:'US',facts:[],publish:false,filings:[filingCandidate({sourceRef:'staged',availableDate:'2024-07-10',periodEnd:'2024-06-30'})]});
  const tables=memoryTableClient();
  await tables.insert('stocks_universe',{ticker:'XYZ',name:'XYZ',market:'US'});
  await tables.insert('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:I,ticker:'XYZ',valid_from:'2000-01-01',valid_to:null,is_primary:true});
  const db=memoryJudgmentInputsDb({facts,tables});
  const item={subject:{type:'issuer' as const,key:I},asOf:'2024-07-20'};
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('fiscal_quarters',1),item,[],db)).toEqual({kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:'2024-09-30',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2024-03-31',months:3},extrapolated:true});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('fiscal_quarters',3),item,[],db)).toMatchObject({period_end:'2025-03-31',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2024-03-31',months:3}});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('fiscal_quarters',1),{...item,asOf:'2024-08-02'},[],db)).toMatchObject({period_end:'2024-09-30',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2024-06-30',months:3}});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('fiscal_quarters',1),{...item,asOf:'2024-01-15'},[],db)).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'target_unresolvable',missing:['published_filing']});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('fiscal_quarters',1),{subject:{type:'macro_region',key:'US'},asOf:'2024-07-20'},[],db)).toMatchObject({reason:'target_unresolvable',missing:['issuer_subject']});
  expect(await defaultResolveTarget(H('fiscal_quarters',1),{subject:{type:'issuer',key:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000f9'},asOf:'2024-07-20'},[],db)).toMatchObject({missing:['facts_market']});
 });
 it('stepQuarter keeps month ends on month ends and clamps other days; nthQuarterEndAfter counts strictly after as_of',()=>{
  expect(stepQuarter('2023-11-30',1)).toBe('2024-02-29');
  expect(stepQuarter('2024-08-31',2)).toBe('2025-02-28');
  expect(stepQuarter('2024-03-30',1)).toBe('2024-06-30');
  expect(stepQuarter('2023-12-30',1)).toBe('2024-03-30');
  expect(nthQuarterEndAfter('2024-03-31','2024-06-30',1)).toBe('2024-09-30');
  expect(nthQuarterEndAfter('2024-03-31','2024-06-29',1)).toBe('2024-06-30');
 });
});

describe('settleWindow (plan 契约补充：must equal the SQL recomputation)',()=>{
 it('settle_after per target kind at 00:00Z; settle_by = + grace_days (defaults per unit, leap years, month ends)',()=>{
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2024-02-27',n:5},H('trading_sessions',5),{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2024-03-03T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2024-05-02T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'date',date:'2024-12-31'},H('calendar_days',30),{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2024-12-31T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2025-01-30T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'period',period:'2024-02'},H('calendar_months',3),{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2024-03-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2024-03-31T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'period',period:'2023-02'},H('calendar_months',3),{})).toMatchObject({settle_after:'2023-03-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'period',period:'2024-12'},H('calendar_months',3),{})).toMatchObject({settle_after:'2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:'2024-09-30',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2024-06-30',months:3},extrapolated:true},H('fiscal_quarters',1),{})).toEqual({settle_after:'2024-10-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2025-01-29T00:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(settleWindow({kind:'date',date:'2024-12-31'},H('calendar_days',30),{grace_days:7}).settle_by).toBe('2025-01-07T00:00:00.000Z');
  expect(DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS).toEqual({trading_sessions:60,calendar_days:30,calendar_months:30,fiscal_quarters:120});
 });
 it('grace_days follows time.ts graceDaysOf (integer >= 1, number or digit string; SQL twin); label_policy must be one of the two policies',()=>{
  for(const g of [0,1.5,'x'])expect(codeOf(()=>graceDaysOf({grace_days:g},H('calendar_days',1)))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(graceDaysOf({grace_days:'10'},H('calendar_days',1))).toBe(10);
  expect(labelPolicyOf({label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'})).toBe('cutoff_vintage');
  expect(codeOf(()=>labelPolicyOf({}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
  expect(codeOf(()=>labelPolicyOf({label_policy:'latest'}))).toBe('invalid_parameter');
 });
});

describe('targetConsistent and retrospectiveOf (spec §3.4, §6.2 step 2)',()=>{
 it('a target must match the horizon unit, n and as_of; session_index needs the price_bar it is based on',()=>{
  expect(targetConsistent({kind:'date',date:'2024-03-01'},H('calendar_days',1),'2024-02-29',[])).toBe(true);
  expect(targetConsistent({kind:'date',date:'2024-03-02'},H('calendar_days',1),'2024-02-29',[])).toBe(false);
  expect(targetConsistent({kind:'period',period:'2025-02'},H('calendar_months',3),'2024-11-30',[])).toBe(true);
  expect(targetConsistent({kind:'period',period:'2025-02'},H('calendar_days',3),'2024-11-30',[])).toBe(false);
  expect(targetConsistent({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2024-06-12',n:5},H('trading_sessions',5),'2024-06-12',[bar('2024-06-12')])).toBe(true);
  expect(targetConsistent({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2024-06-12',n:5},H('trading_sessions',5),'2024-06-12',[bar('2024-06-11')])).toBe(false);
  const fp:Target={kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:'2024-09-30',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2024-03-31',months:3},extrapolated:true};
  expect(targetConsistent(fp,H('fiscal_quarters',1),'2024-07-20',[])).toBe(true);
  expect(targetConsistent(fp,H('fiscal_quarters',2),'2024-07-20',[])).toBe(false);
 });
 it('retrospective iff as_of < registered_at date, or the earliest due instant ≤ registered_at, or the label was already available',()=>{
  const base={as_of:'2026-11-05',registered_at:'2026-11-05T23:00:00.000Z',settle_after:'2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z',label_available_at:null};
  expect(retrospectiveOf(base)).toBe(false);
  expect(retrospectiveOf({...base,registered_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(true);
  expect(retrospectiveOf({...base,settle_after:'2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(true);
  expect(retrospectiveOf({...base,label_available_at:'2026-11-05T22:59:59.999Z'})).toBe(true);
  expect(retrospectiveOf({...base,label_available_at:'2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(false);
  expect(retrospectiveOf({...base,settle_after:null})).toBe(false);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/formula-hash.test.ts
import {mkdirSync,mkdtempSync,rmSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {dirname,join} from 'node:path';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {depsSha256,formulaHashOf,implementationSha256,importClosure,importSpecifiers} from './formula-hash';
import type {Methodology} from './types';

let root:string;
const put=(rel:string,text:string)=>{mkdirSync(dirname(join(root,rel)),{recursive:true});writeFileSync(join(root,rel),text);};
const method=(o:Partial<Methodology>={}):Methodology=>({id:'fh_test',version:'v1',judgment_type:'macro_regime',kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',subject_types:['macro_region'],input_kinds:['macro_snapshot'],title:{zh:'测试',en:'test'},doc:'docs/m.md',params:{grace_days:30,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'},horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:3},deps:['data/rules.json'],module:'src/lib/x/method.ts',status:'draft',
 gather:async()=>[],resolveTarget:async()=>({kind:'period',period:'2026-01'}),compute:()=>({abstained:true,reason:'test'}),condition:()=>{throw new Error('unused');},...o});
beforeAll(()=>{
 root=mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'f4-formula-hash-'));
 put('src/lib/x/method.ts',[
  "import {a} from './a';",
  "import type {T} from '@/lib/y/types';",
  "export * from '../z/re';",
  "import d from './dir';",
  "// import {nope} from './commented';",
  "const s=\"import('./in-string')\";",
  "export const lazy=()=>import('./lazy');",
  "import fs from 'node:fs';",
  "export const m=(t:T)=>[a,d,s,fs,t];",
 ].join('\n'));
 put('src/lib/x/a.ts',"import {b} from './b.js';\nexport const a=b;\n");
 put('src/lib/x/b.ts','export const b=1;\n');
 put('src/lib/x/dir/index.ts','export default 2;\n');
 put('src/lib/x/lazy.ts','export const l=3;\n');
 put('src/lib/y/types.ts','export type T=number;\n');
 put('src/lib/z/re.ts',"export {cfg} from './cfg.json';\n");
 put('src/lib/z/cfg.json','{"cfg":1}\n');
 put('src/lib/unrelated.ts','export const u=0;\n');
 put('data/rules.json','{"rule":1}\n');
 put('docs/m.md','# m\n');
});
afterAll(()=>{rmSync(root,{recursive:true,force:true});});

describe('formula_hash (spec §4.1, audit G20)',()=>{
 it('importSpecifiers is a scanner: comments and strings are not imports; dynamic import and export-from are',()=>{
  expect(importSpecifiers("// import x from './c'\nconst s='import(\"./s\")';\nexport * from './e';\nconst l=()=>import('./l');\nimport type {T} from './t';").sort()).toEqual(['./e','./l','./t']);
 });
 it('the closure follows relative and @/ imports (type-only, export-from, dynamic, .js→.ts, dir/index, json) and stops at packages',()=>{
  expect(importClosure(root,'src/lib/x/method.ts')).toEqual(['src/lib/x/a.ts','src/lib/x/b.ts','src/lib/x/dir/index.ts','src/lib/x/lazy.ts','src/lib/x/method.ts','src/lib/y/types.ts','src/lib/z/cfg.json','src/lib/z/re.ts']);
 });
 it('implementation hash changes with any closure file, not with unrelated files; deps hash covers listed data files',()=>{
  const h0=implementationSha256(root,'src/lib/x/method.ts').sha256;
  put('src/lib/unrelated.ts','export const u=1;\n');
  expect(implementationSha256(root,'src/lib/x/method.ts').sha256).toBe(h0);
  put('src/lib/x/b.ts','export const b=2;\n');
  expect(implementationSha256(root,'src/lib/x/method.ts').sha256).not.toBe(h0);
  put('src/lib/x/b.ts','export const b=1;\n');
  expect(implementationSha256(root,'src/lib/x/method.ts').sha256).toBe(h0);
  const d0=depsSha256(root,['data/rules.json']);
  expect(depsSha256(root,['data/rules.json','data/rules.json'])).toBe(d0);
  put('data/rules.json','{"rule":2}\n');
  expect(depsSha256(root,['data/rules.json'])).not.toBe(d0);
  put('data/rules.json','{"rule":1}\n');
  expect(()=>depsSha256(root,['data/missing.json'])).toThrow(/formula_hash_missing_dep/);
 });
 it('formula_hash covers params, horizon, upstream, doc, implementation and deps; unresolved imports fail loudly',()=>{
  const a=formulaHashOf(method(),root);
  expect(a.formula_hash).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);expect(a.closure).toContain('src/lib/x/b.ts');
  expect(formulaHashOf(method(),root).formula_hash).toBe(a.formula_hash);
  expect(formulaHashOf(method({params:{grace_days:31,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'}}),root).formula_hash).not.toBe(a.formula_hash);
  expect(formulaHashOf(method({horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:4}}),root).formula_hash).not.toBe(a.formula_hash);
  expect(formulaHashOf(method({upstream:{macro_methodology_version:'v1.0'}}),root).formula_hash).not.toBe(a.formula_hash);
  expect(formulaHashOf(method({status:'active'}),root).formula_hash).toBe(a.formula_hash);   // status is not part of the formula
  put('docs/m.md','# m (edited)\n');
  expect(formulaHashOf(method(),root).formula_hash).not.toBe(a.formula_hash);
  put('docs/m.md','# m\n');
  put('src/lib/x/broken.ts',"import {q} from './missing';\nexport const z=q;\n");
  expect(()=>importClosure(root,'src/lib/x/broken.ts')).toThrow(/formula_hash_unresolved_import:src\/lib\/x\/broken\.ts:\.\/missing/);
  expect(()=>formulaHashOf(method({doc:'docs/none.md'}),root)).toThrow(/formula_hash_missing_doc/);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/methodology-sync.test.ts
import {mkdirSync,mkdtempSync,rmSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {dirname,join} from 'node:path';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryJudgmentsDb} from './memory-judgments-db';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {LICENSES_PATH,applyMethodologySync,horizonCalendarDays,licenseProblems,planExitCode,planMethodologySync,reachableOriginKeys,validateLicenseTable,validateMethodology} from './methodology-sync';
import type {LicenseTable} from './methodology-sync';
import {ORIGINS} from './origins';
import type {Methodology} from './types';

let root:string;
const put=(rel:string,text:string)=>{mkdirSync(dirname(join(root,rel)),{recursive:true});writeFileSync(join(root,rel),text);};
const method=(o:Partial<Methodology>={}):Methodology=>({id:'sync_test',version:'v1',judgment_type:'macro_regime',kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',subject_types:['macro_region'],input_kinds:['macro_snapshot'],title:{zh:'同步测试',en:'sync test'},doc:'docs/m.md',params:{grace_days:30,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'},horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:3},deps:['data/rules.json'],module:'src/lib/m/method.ts',status:'active',
 gather:async()=>[],resolveTarget:async()=>({kind:'period',period:'2026-01'}),compute:()=>({abstained:true,reason:'test'}),condition:()=>{throw new Error('unused');},...o});

  expect(ok[0].row!.formula_hash).toBe(unlicensed[0].row!.formula_hash);   // D3: publishable never changes formula_hash
  expect(ok[0]).toMatchObject({action:'update',reason:'owner_confirmed:owner 2026-11-20: all inputs licensed'});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/target.ts
// Target, settlement window and retrospective rules (spec §3.4; plan 契约补充 "结算窗口算术").
// defaultResolveTarget fixes the target at registration from the method's horizon: trading_sessions
// → session_index on the latest price_bar input date (n ≥ 1); calendar_days → date = as_of + n
// (n ≥ 1); calendar_months → period = month(as_of) + n (n = 0 is the as_of month); fiscal_quarters →
// fiscal_period: anchor = the latest period_end among the issuer's PUBLISHED filings (mapping_gen > 0,
// the landed isPublished rule) with available_date ≤ as_of (S05), stepped by 3 months to the n-th
// quarter end strictly after as_of (n ≥ 1; a month-end anchor stays on month ends, any other day is
// clamped to the month length); the calendar {anchor_period_end, months: 3} is frozen in the target
// so replay never reads later filings; extrapolated = false only when that period_end is itself a
// published period_end. The facts market comes from the fact / metric inputs, else from the issuer's
// primary security (factsMarketOf). Unresolvable → Abstained{reason:'target_unresolvable', missing}.
// settleWindow is time.ts settleWindowOf (Task 1, the TS twin of register_judgment's SQL recomputation,
// pinned by Task 3's cross-check): this file adds no window arithmetic of its own. DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS,
// graceDaysOf, settleAfterDate (time.ts) and retrospectiveOf (= contract.ts isRetrospective) are
// re-exported so callers of target.ts see one set of names.
import type {Abstained,FactsMarket,Horizon,Input,JudgmentInputsDb,LabelPolicy,Target,WorkItem} from './types';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {factsMarketOf} from './markets';
import {addDaysIso,addMonthsPeriod,monthEndIso,settleWindowOf} from './time';
export {DEFAULT_GRACE_DAYS,graceDaysOf,settleAfterDate} from './time';
export {isRetrospective as retrospectiveOf} from './contract';

const DAY=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const unresolvable=(why:string):Abstained=>({abstained:true,reason:'target_unresolvable',missing:[why]});
export function stepQuarter(anchor:string,k:number):string{
 const period=anchor.slice(0,7);const day=Number(anchor.slice(8,10));
 const isEnd=anchor===monthEndIso(period);
 const p=addMonthsPeriod(period,3*k);const end=monthEndIso(p);
 if(isEnd)return end;
 return `${p}-${String(Math.min(day,Number(end.slice(8,10)))).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}
export function nthQuarterEndAfter(anchor:string,asOf:string,n:number):string{
 let seen=0;
 for(let k=1;k<=n+1000;k++){const d=stepQuarter(anchor,k);if(d>asOf&&++seen===n)return d;}
 throw new RangeError(`no quarter end ${n} after ${asOf} from ${anchor}`);
}
async function factsMarketFor(item:WorkItem,inputs:Input[],db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<FactsMarket|null>{
 const ms=new Set<FactsMarket>();
 for(const x of inputs)if(x.kind==='financial_fact'||x.kind==='financial_metric')ms.add(x.snapshot.market);
 if(ms.size>1)return null;
 if(ms.size===1)return [...ms][0];
 const sec=await db.issuerPrimarySecurity(item.subject.key,item.asOf);
 return sec?factsMarketOf(sec.market):null;
}
export async function defaultResolveTarget(horizon:Horizon,item:WorkItem,inputs:Input[],db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Target|Abstained>{
 const n=horizon.n;
 if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0)return unresolvable('horizon.n');
 switch(horizon.unit){
  case 'trading_sessions':{
   const dates=inputs.flatMap(x=>x.kind==='price_bar'?[x.snapshot.date]:[]).sort();
   if(dates.length===0)return unresolvable('price_bar');
   if(n<1)return unresolvable('horizon.n');
   return {kind:'session_index',base_date:dates[dates.length-1],n};
  }
  case 'calendar_days':
   if(n<1)return unresolvable('horizon.n');
   return {kind:'date',date:addDaysIso(item.asOf,n)};
  case 'calendar_months':return {kind:'period',period:addMonthsPeriod(item.asOf.slice(0,7),n)};
  case 'fiscal_quarters':{
   if(item.subject.type!=='issuer')return unresolvable('issuer_subject');
   if(n<1)return unresolvable('horizon.n');
   const market=await factsMarketFor(item,inputs,db);
   if(!market)return unresolvable('facts_market');
   const published=(await db.facts.filingsOfIssuer(item.subject.key,market,{to:item.asOf})).filter(f=>f.mapping_gen>0&&f.available_date<=item.asOf&&f.period_end!==null);
   if(published.length===0)return unresolvable('published_filing');
   const known=new Set(published.map(f=>f.period_end as string));
   const anchor=[...known].sort().at(-1)!;
   const period_end=nthQuarterEndAfter(anchor,item.asOf,n);
   return {kind:'fiscal_period',period_end,calendar:{anchor_period_end:anchor,months:3},extrapolated:!known.has(period_end)};
  }
 }
}
export const settleWindow=(t:Target,h:Horizon,params:Record<string,number|string>):{settle_after:string;settle_by:string}=>settleWindowOf(t,h,params);
export function labelPolicyOf(params:Record<string,number|string>):LabelPolicy{
 const p=params.label_policy;
 if(p!=='first_observed'&&p!=='cutoff_vintage')throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`label_policy ${String(p)}`);
 return p;
}
/** Registration-time check that a submitted target is the one the horizon defines (spec §6.2 step 2). */
export function targetConsistent(t:Target,h:Horizon,asOf:string,inputs:readonly Input[]):boolean{
 switch(t.kind){
  case 'session_index':return h.unit==='trading_sessions'&&t.n===h.n&&DAY.test(t.base_date)&&t.base_date<=asOf&&inputs.some(x=>x.kind==='price_bar'&&x.snapshot.date===t.base_date);
  case 'date':return h.unit==='calendar_days'&&t.date===addDaysIso(asOf,h.n);
  case 'period':return h.unit==='calendar_months'&&t.period===addMonthsPeriod(asOf.slice(0,7),h.n);
  case 'fiscal_period':
   if(h.unit!=='fiscal_quarters'||t.calendar.months!==3||!DAY.test(t.calendar.anchor_period_end)||t.calendar.anchor_period_end>asOf)return false;
   try{return t.period_end===nthQuarterEndAfter(t.calendar.anchor_period_end,asOf,h.n);}catch{return false;}
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/registry.ts
// The methodology registry (spec §4). REGISTRY lists every method module the system may register
// judgments with; Task 19 appends macroRegimeV1. Test-only methods (testing/*, e.g.
// synthetic_fact_metric@v1) are never listed. judgment_methodologies mirrors REGISTRY through
// scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts; methodologyRowOf maps a module + its hashes (formula-hash.ts)
// to the row sync_methodology writes. No fs / typescript imports here: app code may import this file.
import type {Methodology,MethodologyRow} from './types';

export const REGISTRY:readonly Methodology[]=[];
export interface MethodologyHashes{doc_sha256:string;implementation_sha256:string;deps_sha256:string;formula_hash:string}
export type MethodologySyncRow=Omit<MethodologyRow,'created_at'|'synced_at'>;
export function upstreamOf(m:Pick<Methodology,'upstream'>):Record<string,string>{
 return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(m.upstream??{}).filter((e):e is [string,string]=>typeof e[1]==='string'));
}
export function methodologyRowOf(m:Methodology,h:MethodologyHashes,meta:{publishable:boolean;code_version:string}):MethodologySyncRow{
 return {methodology_id:m.id,version:m.version,judgment_type:m.judgment_type,kind:m.kind,producer_kind:m.producer_kind,subject_types:[...m.subject_types],input_kinds:[...m.input_kinds],markets:m.markets?[...m.markets]:null,
  title_zh:m.title.zh,title_en:m.title.en,doc_path:m.doc,doc_sha256:h.doc_sha256,implementation_sha256:h.implementation_sha256,params:{...m.params},params_json:m.params_json?structuredClone(m.params_json):{},
  horizon:{...m.horizon},upstream:upstreamOf(m),deps_sha256:h.deps_sha256,formula_hash:h.formula_hash,status:m.status,publishable:meta.publishable,code_version:meta.code_version};
}
export function findMethodology(registry:readonly Methodology[],id:string,version:string):Methodology|null{
 return registry.find(m=>m.id===id&&m.version===version)??null;
}
```
