```ts
// src/lib/judgments/formula-hash.ts
// formula_hash (spec §4.1, audits G20 / F22). implementation_sha256 = digest of [[repo path, sha256]]
// over the method module's LOCAL import closure: every relative or '@/' specifier (static import,
// import type, export … from, dynamic import(), require) reachable from Methodology.module, whether or
// not it lives under src/lib/judgments/, resolved like the bundler (exact file; .ts / .tsx / .d.ts /
// .js / .mjs / .json; a .js specifier naming a .ts file; dir/index.*). Bare specifiers (packages,
// node:*) are excluded. Discovery uses the TypeScript compiler's preProcessFile scanner — comments
// and string literals can neither add nor hide an import, which a regex cannot guarantee; no type
// checking. An unresolvable local specifier throws (a silently dropped file would escape the hash).
// deps_sha256 = digest over Methodology.deps (non-import files: data, rule tables, catalogue
// snapshots). formula_hash = digest({id, version, params, params_json, horizon, upstream,
// doc_sha256, implementation_sha256, deps_sha256}); status and publishable are not part of it.
// Paths are repo-relative POSIX and sorted; bytes are hashed raw. Node-only (fs + typescript): the
// sync script and tests use it, app code never imports it.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {existsSync,readFileSync,statSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname,join,relative,resolve,sep} from 'node:path';
import ts from 'typescript';
import type {Methodology} from './types';
import {digest} from './canonical';
import {upstreamOf} from './registry';
import type {MethodologyHashes} from './registry';

export interface FormulaHashes extends MethodologyHashes{closure:string[]}
const EXT=['.ts','.tsx','.d.ts','.js','.mjs','.json'];
const INDEX=['index.ts','index.tsx','index.js'];
const isFile=(p:string)=>existsSync(p)&&statSync(p).isFile();
const posix=(root:string,abs:string)=>relative(root,abs).split(sep).join('/');
export const fileSha256=(repoRoot:string,path:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(repoRoot,path))).digest('hex');
export function importSpecifiers(source:string):string[]{return ts.preProcessFile(source,true,true).importedFiles.map(f=>f.fileName);}
export function resolveImport(repoRoot:string,fromAbs:string,spec:string):string|null{
 let base:string;
 if(spec.startsWith('@/'))base=join(repoRoot,'src',spec.slice(2));
 else if(spec==='.'||spec==='..'||spec.startsWith('./')||spec.startsWith('../'))base=resolve(dirname(fromAbs),spec);
 else return null;
 if(isFile(base))return base;
 if(/\.m?js$/.test(base)){const t=base.replace(/\.m?js$/,'.ts');if(isFile(t))return t;}
 for(const e of EXT)if(isFile(base+e))return base+e;
 for(const i of INDEX)if(isFile(join(base,i)))return join(base,i);
 throw new Error(`formula_hash_unresolved_import:${posix(repoRoot,fromAbs)}:${spec}`);
}
export function importClosure(repoRoot:string,entry:string):string[]{
 const root=resolve(repoRoot);const start=resolve(root,entry);
 if(!isFile(start))throw new Error(`formula_hash_missing_module:${entry}`);
 const seen=new Set<string>([start]);const stack=[start];
 while(stack.length>0){
  const file=stack.pop()!;
  if(file.endsWith('.json'))continue;
  for(const spec of importSpecifiers(readFileSync(file,'utf8'))){
   const dep=resolveImport(root,file,spec);
   if(dep&&!seen.has(dep)){seen.add(dep);stack.push(dep);}
  }
 }
 return [...seen].map(f=>posix(root,f)).sort();
}
export function implementationSha256(repoRoot:string,entry:string):{sha256:string;files:string[]}{
 const files=importClosure(repoRoot,entry);
 return {sha256:digest(files.map(f=>[f,fileSha256(repoRoot,f)])),files};
}
export function depsSha256(repoRoot:string,deps:readonly string[]):string{
 return digest([...new Set(deps)].sort().map(f=>{if(!isFile(join(repoRoot,f)))throw new Error(`formula_hash_missing_dep:${f}`);return [f,fileSha256(repoRoot,f)];}));
}
export function formulaHashOf(m:Methodology,repoRoot:string=process.cwd()):FormulaHashes{
 if(!isFile(join(repoRoot,m.doc)))throw new Error(`formula_hash_missing_doc:${m.doc}`);
 const doc_sha256=fileSha256(repoRoot,m.doc);
 const impl=implementationSha256(repoRoot,m.module);
 const deps_sha256=depsSha256(repoRoot,m.deps);
 const formula_hash=digest({id:m.id,version:m.version,params:m.params,params_json:m.params_json??{},horizon:m.horizon,upstream:upstreamOf(m),doc_sha256,implementation_sha256:impl.sha256,deps_sha256});
 return {doc_sha256,implementation_sha256:impl.sha256,deps_sha256,formula_hash,closure:impl.files};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/methodology-sync.ts
// Core of scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts (spec §4.1, §5.1 / §5.1b, §8.2). For each registry
// module: validate, hash (formula-hash.ts), compare with judgment_methodologies, and plan one action —
// register (new row), update (status / publishable changed), resync (unchanged; the RPC only bumps
// synced_at), drift (formula_hash or any immutable column differs from the stored row: the code or
// document changed without a new version — refused) or invalid (validation problems — refused). If
// any item is drift / invalid nothing is written and the script exits 2 (spec §13 formula_hash_drift).
// publishable becomes true only through --publishable <id@version> with an owner confirmation text
// (≥ 10 chars), recorded as the event reason, AND every origin key reachable from the method's
// input_kinds confirmed in docs/methodologies/licenses.json (commander decision D3: licences live
// outside every import closure; the script reads the file and passes it as o.licenses); without a
// flag the stored value is kept and a new method starts false (spec §4.1, §17). publishable is a
// metadata column: it never changes formula_hash. Validation: id / version patterns, public producer / subject / input
// kinds, markets ⊆ {A, HK, US}, label_policy, grace_days, horizon.n, window_years × 365 ≥ 3 × the
// horizon's calendar-day upper bound (§8.2; trading sessions × 1.52 as in §7.3, months × 31, quarters
// × 92), module / doc / deps exist, and no deps entry is already in the import closure (deps lists only
// what the import graph cannot see). Node-only (uses formula-hash.ts).
import {existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import type {Horizon,JudgmentsDb,Methodology,MethodologyRow} from './types';
import {PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS,PUBLIC_PRODUCER_KINDS,PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES} from './types';
import {canonicalize} from './canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {formulaHashOf} from './formula-hash';
import type {FormulaHashes} from './formula-hash';
import {methodologyRowOf} from './registry';
import type {MethodologySyncRow} from './registry';
import {ORIGINS} from './origins';
import {labelPolicyOf} from './target';
import {graceDaysOf} from './time';

export type SyncAction='register'|'update'|'resync'|'drift'|'invalid';
export interface SyncPlanItem{key:string;action:SyncAction;problems:string[];row:MethodologySyncRow|null;existing:MethodologyRow|null;closure:string[];reason:string|null}
export const LICENSES_PATH='docs/methodologies/licenses.json';
export interface LicenseEntry{status:'unverified'|'confirmed';confirmed_by:string|null;confirmed_at:string|null;evidence:string|null}
export type LicenseTable=Readonly<Record<string,LicenseEntry>>;
export interface SyncOptions{repoRoot:string;codeVersion:string;only?:ReadonlySet<string>;publish?:ReadonlySet<string>;unpublish?:ReadonlySet<string>;ownerConfirmation?:string;licenses?:LicenseTable}
export const methodologyKey=(m:{id:string;version:string})=>`${m.id}@${m.version}`;
/** licenses.json: exactly the ORIGINS keys, each {status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, evidence}; a confirmed row names who, when and the evidence. */
export function validateLicenseTable(raw:unknown):LicenseTable{
 const bad=(why:string):never=>{throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`${LICENSES_PATH}: ${why}`);};
 if(raw===null||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return bad('not an object');
 const t=raw as Record<string,unknown>;
 for(const k of Object.keys(ORIGINS))if(!(k in t))bad(`missing ${k}`);
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(t)){
  if(!(k in ORIGINS))bad(`unknown origin key ${k}`);
  const e=v as Record<string,unknown>|null;
  if(!e||typeof e!=='object'||Object.keys(e).sort().join(',')!=='confirmed_at,confirmed_by,evidence,status')bad(`${k}: fields must be status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, evidence`);
  if(e!.status!=='unverified'&&e!.status!=='confirmed')bad(`${k}: status`);
  const str=(x:unknown)=>typeof x==='string'&&x.trim().length>0;
  if(e!.status==='confirmed'&&!(str(e!.confirmed_by)&&str(e!.confirmed_at)&&str(e!.evidence)))bad(`${k}: a confirmed licence needs confirmed_by, confirmed_at and evidence`);
 }
 return t as unknown as LicenseTable;
}
export const reachableOriginKeys=(m:Pick<Methodology,'input_kinds'>):string[]=>Object.keys(ORIGINS).filter(k=>(m.input_kinds as readonly string[]).includes(k.split('×')[0])).sort();
export const licenseProblems=(m:Pick<Methodology,'input_kinds'>,licenses:LicenseTable):string[]=>reachableOriginKeys(m).filter(k=>licenses[k]?.status!=='confirmed').map(k=>`license_unconfirmed:${k}`);
const IMMUTABLE=['judgment_type','kind','producer_kind','subject_types','input_kinds','markets','title_zh','title_en','doc_path','doc_sha256','implementation_sha256','params','params_json','horizon','upstream','deps_sha256'] as const;
export function horizonCalendarDays(h:Horizon):number{
 switch(h.unit){
  case 'trading_sessions':return Math.ceil(h.n*1.52);
  case 'calendar_days':return h.n;
  case 'calendar_months':return h.n*31;
  case 'fiscal_quarters':return h.n*92;
 }
}
export function validateMethodology(m:Methodology,repoRoot:string,closure:readonly string[]=[]):string[]{
 const p:string[]=[];
 if(!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$/.test(m.id))p.push('id_pattern');
 if(!/^v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$/.test(m.version))p.push('version_pattern');
 if(!(PUBLIC_PRODUCER_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(m.producer_kind))p.push(`producer_kind_not_public:${m.producer_kind}`);
 if(m.subject_types.length===0)p.push('subject_types_empty');
 for(const s of m.subject_types)if(!(PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(s))p.push(`subject_type_not_public:${s}`);
 if(m.input_kinds.length===0)p.push('input_kinds_empty');
 for(const k of m.input_kinds)if(!(PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(k))p.push(`input_kind_not_public:${k}`);
 for(const mk of m.markets??[])if(!['A','HK','US'].includes(mk))p.push(`market:${mk}`);
 try{labelPolicyOf(m.params);}catch{p.push('label_policy');}
 try{graceDaysOf(m.params,m.horizon);}catch{p.push('grace_days');}
 if(!Number.isInteger(m.horizon.n)||m.horizon.n<0)p.push('horizon_n');
 const wy=m.params.window_years??3;
 if(typeof wy!=='number'||!(wy>0))p.push('window_years');
 else if(wy*365<3*horizonCalendarDays(m.horizon))p.push(`window_years_too_short:${wy}y<3x${horizonCalendarDays(m.horizon)}d`);
 if(!existsSync(join(repoRoot,m.module)))p.push(`module_missing:${m.module}`);
 if(!existsSync(join(repoRoot,m.doc)))p.push(`doc_missing:${m.doc}`);
 for(const d of m.deps){if(!existsSync(join(repoRoot,d)))p.push(`dep_missing:${d}`);if(closure.includes(d))p.push(`dep_in_import_closure:${d}`);if(d===LICENSES_PATH)p.push('licenses_in_deps');}
 return p;
}
export async function planMethodologySync(registry:readonly Methodology[],db:Pick<JudgmentsDb,'methodology'>,o:SyncOptions,hash:(m:Methodology,root:string)=>FormulaHashes=formulaHashOf):Promise<SyncPlanItem[]>{
 const seen=new Set<string>();const out:SyncPlanItem[]=[];
 for(const m of registry){
  const key=methodologyKey(m);
  if(o.only&&!o.only.has(key))continue;
  const problems:string[]=[];
  if(seen.has(key))problems.push('duplicate_in_registry');
  seen.add(key);
  const publish=o.publish?.has(key)===true,unpublish=o.unpublish?.has(key)===true;
  if(publish&&unpublish)problems.push('publish_and_unpublish');
  const confirmation=(o.ownerConfirmation??'').trim();
  if(publish&&confirmation.length<10)problems.push('owner_confirmation_required');
  if(publish)problems.push(...licenseProblems(m,o.licenses??{}));
  let h:FormulaHashes|null=null;
  try{h=hash(m,o.repoRoot);}catch(e){problems.push(`hash:${e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)}`);}
  problems.push(...validateMethodology(m,o.repoRoot,h?.closure??[]));
  const existing=await db.methodology(m.id,m.version);
  const publishable=publish?true:unpublish?false:(existing?.publishable??false);
  const row=h?methodologyRowOf(m,h,{publishable,code_version:o.codeVersion}):null;
  const reason=publish?`owner_confirmed:${confirmation}`:unpublish?'unpublished_by_script':null;
  let action:SyncAction;
  if(problems.length>0||!row)action='invalid';
  else if(!existing)action='register';
  else{
   const changed=IMMUTABLE.filter(c=>canonicalize(existing[c]??null)!==canonicalize(row[c]??null));
   if(existing.formula_hash!==row.formula_hash||changed.length>0){action='drift';if(changed.length>0&&existing.formula_hash===row.formula_hash)problems.push(`immutable_columns_changed:${changed.join(',')}`);}
   else action=existing.status!==row.status||existing.publishable!==row.publishable?'update':'resync';
  }
  out.push({key,action,problems,row,existing,closure:h?.closure??[],reason});
 }
 return out;
}
export const planExitCode=(plan:readonly SyncPlanItem[]):0|2=>plan.some(p=>p.action==='drift'||p.action==='invalid')?2:0;
export async function applyMethodologySync(plan:readonly SyncPlanItem[],db:Pick<JudgmentsDb,'syncMethodology'>):Promise<{key:string;changed:boolean;seq:number}[]>{
 if(planExitCode(plan)!==0)throw new JudgmentError('formula_hash_drift','refusing to sync: the plan contains drift or invalid items');
 const out:{key:string;changed:boolean;seq:number}[]=[];
 for(const p of plan){const r=await db.syncMethodology(p.row!,'script',p.reason);out.push({key:p.key,...r});}
 return out;
}
```

（核对 `title` 用例：标题不进 `formula_hash`，所以 `formula_hash` 相同而 `title_zh,title_en` 变化 → `drift` 且 `problems=['immutable_columns_changed:title_zh,title_en']`（`IMMUTABLE` 的列顺序决定输出顺序）。`existing[c]` 来自内存库 / PostgREST 的行，`markets` 为 `null` 时两侧都 `canonicalize(null)`。）

- [ ] **Step 5: 写同步脚本与文档模板**

```ts
/**
 * Mirror the methodology registry into judgment_methodologies (spec §4.1, §5.1 / §5.1b).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts [--dry-run] [--only <id>@<version>]...
 *        [--publishable <id>@<version>]... [--owner-confirmation "<who, when, which licences were confirmed>"] [--unpublish <id>@<version>]...
 *
 * Plans every REGISTRY method (src/lib/judgments/methodology-sync.ts) and prints one JSON line per
 * method {key, action, problems, formula_hash, stored_formula_hash, closure_files} then a summary.
 * Any drift (formula_hash or an immutable column changed without a new version) or invalid item →
 * nothing is written, exit 2. --dry-run reads the database and prints the plan without writing.
 * publishable becomes true only with --publishable plus --owner-confirmation (≥ 10 characters; it is
 * stored as the methodology event reason) AND every origin key reachable from the method's input_kinds
 * marked "confirmed" in docs/methodologies/licenses.json (commander decision D3: this script is the
 * file's only reader; no method imports it). publishable never changes formula_hash.
 * Exit 0 ok, 1 runtime error, 2 drift / invalid / bad arguments.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/sync';
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from '../../src/lib/judgments/db';
import {LICENSES_PATH,applyMethodologySync,planExitCode,planMethodologySync,validateLicenseTable} from '../../src/lib/judgments/methodology-sync';
import {REGISTRY} from '../../src/lib/judgments/registry';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/anon';

const USAGE='usage: sync-methodologies.ts [--dry-run] [--only id@vN]... [--publishable id@vN]... [--owner-confirmation "<text>"] [--unpublish id@vN]...';
const KEY=/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}@v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$/;
async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let dryRun=false;let confirmation:string|undefined;
 const only=new Set<string>(),publish=new Set<string>(),unpublish=new Set<string>();
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(x==='--dry-run')dryRun=true;
  else if((x==='--only'||x==='--publishable'||x==='--unpublish')&&v&&KEY.test(v)){(x==='--only'?only:x==='--publishable'?publish:unpublish).add(v);i++;}
  else if(x==='--owner-confirmation'&&v){confirmation=v;i++;}
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion();
 if(!codeVersion){console.error('code_version_missing: set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside the git checkout');process.exit(1);}
 const licenses=validateLicenseTable(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),LICENSES_PATH),'utf8')));
 const db=supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon:getAnonSupabase(),admin:getAdminSupabase()});
 const plan=await planMethodologySync(REGISTRY,db,{repoRoot:process.cwd(),codeVersion,only:only.size?only:undefined,publish,unpublish,ownerConfirmation:confirmation,licenses});
 for(const p of plan)console.log(JSON.stringify({key:p.key,action:p.action,problems:p.problems,formula_hash:p.row?.formula_hash??null,stored_formula_hash:p.existing?.formula_hash??null,publishable:p.row?.publishable??null,closure_files:p.closure.length}));
 const exit=planExitCode(plan);
 if(exit!==0){console.log(JSON.stringify({synced:0,refused:true,reason:'drift_or_invalid'}));process.exit(2);}
 if(dryRun){console.log(JSON.stringify({synced:0,dry_run:true,planned:plan.length}));return;}
 const done=await applyMethodologySync(plan,db);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({synced:done.length,changed:done.filter(d=>d.changed).length}));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

`docs/methodologies/README.md` 全文：

````markdown
# 方法文档模板（规格 §4.2）

每个方法版本一份文档：`docs/methodologies/<methodology_id>/<version>.md`（例：`docs/methodologies/macro_regime/v1.md`）。文档的 sha256 进 `formula_hash`（规格 §4.1）：改文档 = 改公式，必须升版本，否则 `scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts` 报 `formula_hash_drift` 并拒绝同步。下面七个章节**固定、按序、不可省略**；不适用的章节写"不适用"并说明原因。

## 1 回答什么问题

一句话陈述判断回答的问题、判断类型（`judgment_type`）、种类（`kind`：probability / categorical / score / interval）与生产者（`producer_kind`：v1 公共表只收 `rule` / `model`）。

## 2 主体与输入

- 主体类型（`subject_types` ⊆ `issuer / industry / macro_region / macro_series`）与主体键格式。
- 每种输入（`input_kinds` ⊆ 公共白名单）：来源表 / 接口、构造器（`src/lib/judgments/inputs.ts`）、`available_at` 口径（规格 §3.7）、`origin` 行（`src/lib/judgments/origins.ts` 的 `kind×adapter` 键）；许可状态不写在方法文档或代码里，见 `docs/methodologies/licenses.json`（同键，只由同步脚本读取，决策 D3）。
- 绑定（`WorkItem.binding`）：生产者绑定的上游对象及其如何出现在输入引用里（规格 §6.4）。

## 3 公式与参数

公式全文（与实现逐项对应）；`params` 每个键的取值、单位与**来源**（规格条款、上游规格、政策常量——政策常量要写明"政策常量，非推导"）；`params_json` 的 JSON Schema（如有）；`upstream` 绑定的上游方法版本；`deps` 列出的非 import 依赖文件。

## 4 可证伪条件、目标期与标签政策

`condition`（resolver、params、predicate）与它的文字；`horizon`；`target` 的解析规则（规格 §3.4 默认实现或本方法的覆盖）；`label_policy`（`first_observed` / `cutoff_vintage`）及理由；`grace_days`（默认值与理由）；`window_years`（须 ≥ 期限对应自然日的 3 倍）。

## 5 结算 resolver 与实现值定义

resolver 名称与版本；实现值的唯一定义（自然键、单位、覆盖要求、缺失时的处理）；`labelAvailableAt` 的估计规则；会导致 `void` / `Inconsistent` 的情形。

## 6 不适用情形（何时 abstain）

逐条列出 `abstain_reason` 及触发条件（缺输入、上游版本不匹配、市场无 verified 复权能力、目标不可解析……）。

## 7 版本历史

| 版本 | 日期 | 改动 | `formula_hash` 前 12 位 |
|---|---|---|---|
| v1 | YYYY-MM-DD | 初版 | 由 sync 脚本输出填写 |
````

```ts
export function fixtureInputsDb():JudgmentInputsDb;
```

登记流程（`registerJudgment`，顺序即实现顺序；每步失败抛 `JudgmentError(code)`，括号内为码）：
1. `code_version` 长度 7–64（`code_version_missing`）；`as_of` 是 `YYYY-MM-DD`（`invalid_parameter`）。
2. 方法行 `db.methodology(id, version)`：不存在 / `retired` / `draft` 且非 `dryRun` / 行的 `kind / producer_kind / judgment_type` 与模块不一致 / `producer_kind ∉ {rule, model}`（`methodology_unavailable`）。
3. `validateSubject`；类型 ∉ 公共四类或 ∉ 方法行 `subject_types`（`subject_type_not_public`）；`subjectExists` → `missing`（`subject_missing`）/ `inactive`（`subject_inactive`）。
4. `producer_nonce = nonceOf(producer_kind, producer_ref)`（§3.6）。
5. 输入按 `(kind, canonical(ref))` 排序后存储（所以打乱输入顺序得到同一载荷）；重复引用、`kind ∉ 公共白名单 ∩ 方法行 input_kinds`（`input_not_allowed`）；`originKnown`（`input_origin_unknown`）；`max(available_at) ≤ as_of 日终`（`lookahead`）；逐个 `rebuildAndCompare`（`input_snapshot_mismatch` / `input_not_public`）。
6. 活跃：至少一个输入、`validateClaim`、`validateHorizon` 且与方法行一致、`condition.resolver ∈ PUBLIC_RESOLVERS` 且 `resolverOf` 有实现且 `validateParams` 通过、谓词与 `kind` 相容（categorical `eq selected`；interval `between [low,high]`；数值谓词 rhs 有限）、`targetConsistent`（`invalid_condition`）；`label_policy = labelPolicyOf(params)`、`settleWindow`、`labelAvailableAt`。弃权：`reason` 非空，其余语义列全 `null`。
7. `judgment_id = judgmentIdOf({…, inputs_hash, producer_nonce})`；`getJudgment(id)` 存在 → 规范化载荷相同 → `duplicate`；不同 → `quarantine(dataset 'judgments', table 'judgments', natural_key id, 'idempotency_conflict', payload {registered, attempted})`（`dryRun` 不写隔离）+ `idempotency_conflict`。
8. `dryRun` → 返回 `dry_run:true`，不写。否则 RPC `registerJudgment(row, 活跃 ? {settle_after, settle_by, label_policy} : null)`；主键冲突（23505）→ 重读并回到第 7 步的比较。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/db-helpers.ts
// Test helpers (not a test file) around any JudgmentsDb. withSubjects overrides subjectExists (the
// memory db knows no issuers / regions); spyRegister counts successful registerJudgment RPCs (spec §15
// example 1: "行数不变" = no second insert); syncTestMethod syncs a test-only method into a db with
// placeholder hashes (FIXTURE_HASHES) so unit tests never run formula-hash.
import type {JudgmentsDb,Methodology,Subject} from '../types';
import {methodologyRowOf} from '../registry';
import type {MethodologyHashes} from '../registry';

export const FIXTURE_HASHES:MethodologyHashes={doc_sha256:'1'.repeat(64),implementation_sha256:'2'.repeat(64),deps_sha256:'3'.repeat(64),formula_hash:'4'.repeat(64)};
export function withSubjects(db:JudgmentsDb,status:(s:Subject)=>'active'|'inactive'|'missing'=()=>'active'):JudgmentsDb{
 return new Proxy(db,{get:(t,k,r)=>k==='subjectExists'?async(s:Subject)=>status(s):Reflect.get(t,k,r)});
}
export function spyRegister(db:JudgmentsDb):{db:JudgmentsDb;calls:()=>number}{
 let n=0;
 const proxy=new Proxy(db,{get:(t,k,r)=>k==='registerJudgment'?async(...a:Parameters<JudgmentsDb['registerJudgment']>)=>{const out=await t.registerJudgment(...a);n++;return out;}:Reflect.get(t,k,r)});
 return {db:proxy,calls:()=>n};
}
export async function syncTestMethod(db:JudgmentsDb,m:Methodology,o:{publishable?:boolean}={}):Promise<void>{
 await db.syncMethodology(methodologyRowOf(m,FIXTURE_HASHES,{publishable:o.publishable??false,code_version:'test0000'}),'script',null);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/fixture-methods.ts
// Test-only methods and fixtures (not a test file; never in REGISTRY). fixtureRegimeMethod has the
// shape of macro_regime@v1 (Task 19) over the fixture macro API: inputs = the bound macro_snapshot
// (binding.snapshot_id, spec §6.4) + each of its macro_observations; claim = categorical primary state,
// normalised scores as a non-probability distribution, margin_pp, catalog_version; condition =
// macro_regime_replay for the as_of month; horizon 3 calendar months; cutoff_vintage. FIXTURE_MACRO:
// s-a and s-b are two US snapshots on the same as_of (different judgments, spec §6.4 / G25), s-none is
// unclassified, s-late's last observation becomes available the day after its as_of (lookahead even
// though created_at is earlier — spec §3.7 / F10). FIXTURE_RESOLVERS stands in for Task 11's resolvers.
import type {CategoricalClaim,Input,JudgmentInputsDb,MacroSnapshotSnapshot,Methodology,Regime,RegimeResult} from '../types';
import {buildInput,buildOrAbstain} from '../inputs';
import {memoryJudgmentInputsDb} from '../inputs-db';
import {fixtureMacroReadApi,observationIdOf} from '../macro-api';
import type {MacroFixture} from '../macro-api';
import type {ResolverLookup} from '../register';
import {defaultResolveTarget} from '../target';

export const FIXTURE_ASOF='2026-10-16';
const REGIMES:Regime[]=['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'];
const obs=(series_id:string,vintage_id:string,value:number,available_at:string)=>({observation_id:observationIdOf({series_id,period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id}),series_id,period_end:'2026-09-30',vintage_id,value,unit:'pct',available_at});
const PMI=obs('us_ism_pmi','v1',49.1,'2026-10-01T14:00:00.000Z');
const CPI=obs('us_cpi_yoy','v1',2.9,'2026-10-15T12:30:00.000Z');
const CPI2=obs('us_cpi_yoy','v2',3.1,'2026-10-15T20:00:00.000Z');
const LATE=obs('us_payrolls','v1',150,'2026-10-17T12:30:00.000Z');
const regime=(primary:Regime,secondary:Regime,norm:Record<Regime,number>):RegimeResult=>({primary_state:primary,secondary_state:secondary,scores:{...norm},norm,coverage:0.8,margin_pp:Math.round((norm[primary]-norm[secondary])*1000)/10,growth_axis:0.4,inflation_axis:-0.1});
const R1=regime('recovery','overheat',{recovery:0.4,overheat:0.3,stagflation:0.2,recession:0.1});
const R2=regime('overheat','recovery',{recovery:0.3,overheat:0.4,stagflation:0.2,recession:0.1});
const snap=(snapshot_id:string,observation_ids:string[],regime_:RegimeResult|null,created_at:string)=>({snapshot_id,region:'US' as const,as_of:FIXTURE_ASOF,methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'cat-1',observation_ids,regime:regime_,created_at,status:'active' as const});
export const FIXTURE_MACRO:MacroFixture={fixture_version:'macro-fixture/1',observations:[PMI,CPI,CPI2,LATE],classifications:[],series_catalog:{US:[{id:'us_cpi_yoy',weight:0.25,created_at:'2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z'},{id:'us_ism_pmi',weight:0.25,created_at:'2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z'}]},snapshots:[
 snap('s-a',[PMI.observation_id,CPI.observation_id],R1,'2026-10-16T01:00:00.000Z'),
 snap('s-b',[PMI.observation_id,CPI2.observation_id],R2,'2026-10-16T02:00:00.000Z'),
 snap('s-none',[PMI.observation_id],null,'2026-10-16T03:00:00.000Z'),
 snap('s-late',[PMI.observation_id,LATE.observation_id],R1,'2026-10-16T20:00:00.000Z'),
]};
export const fixtureInputsDb=():JudgmentInputsDb=>memoryJudgmentInputsDb({macro:fixtureMacroReadApi(FIXTURE_MACRO)});
const snapshotOf=(inputs:readonly Input[])=>inputs.find(x=>x.kind==='macro_snapshot')?.snapshot as MacroSnapshotSnapshot|undefined;
export const fixtureRegimeMethod:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={
 id:'fixture_regime',version:'v1',judgment_type:'macro_regime',kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',
 subject_types:['macro_region'],input_kinds:['macro_snapshot','macro_observation'],upstream:{macro_methodology_version:'v1.0'},
 title:{zh:'测试用宏观象限',en:'Fixture macro regime'},doc:'docs/methodologies/README.md',params:{grace_days:30,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'},
 horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:3},deps:[],module:'src/lib/judgments/testing/fixture-methods.ts',status:'active',
 async gather(item,db){
  const id=item.binding?.snapshot_id;
  if(!id)return {abstained:true,reason:'binding_missing',missing:['snapshot_id']};
  const s=await buildOrAbstain({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:id}},db,item.asOf);
  if('abstained' in s)return s;
  if(s.kind!=='macro_snapshot')throw new Error('fixture_regime: unexpected input kind');
  const out:Input[]=[s];
  for(const oid of s.snapshot.observation_ids){
   const o=await db.macro.observation(oid);
   if(!o)return {abstained:true,reason:'input_not_public',missing:[oid]};
   out.push(await buildInput({kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:o.series_id,period_end:o.period_end,vintage_id:o.vintage_id}},db,item.asOf));
  }
  return out;
 },
 resolveTarget(item,inputs,db){return defaultResolveTarget(this.horizon,item,inputs,db);},
 compute(_subject,inputs){
  const s=snapshotOf(inputs);
  if(!s)return {abstained:true,reason:'snapshot_missing'};
  if(s.primary_state===null)return {abstained:true,reason:'snapshot_unclassified'};
  const claim:CategoricalClaim={selected:s.primary_state,classes:[...REGIMES],distribution:{...s.norm},scores_are_not_probabilities:true,...(s.margin_pp!==null?{margin_pp:s.margin_pp}:{}),catalog_version:s.catalog_version};
  return {abstained:false,claim};
 },
 condition(subject,inputs,claim){
  const s=snapshotOf(inputs)!;const period=s.as_of.slice(0,7);
  return {resolver:'macro_regime_replay',params:{region:subject.key as 'US'|'CN',reference_period:period,macro_methodology_version:s.methodology_version,catalog_version:s.catalog_version},predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:claim.selected as Regime},
   text:{zh:`${period} 的主判定在截止 vintage 下重算仍为 ${claim.selected}`,en:`The ${period} primary regime recomputed on the cutoff vintage is still ${claim.selected}`}};
 },
};
export const fixtureModelMethod:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={...fixtureRegimeMethod,id:'fixture_regime_model',producer_kind:'model',title:{zh:'测试用宏观象限（模型）',en:'Fixture macro regime (model)'}};
export const FIXTURE_RESOLVERS:ResolverLookup=name=>name==='macro_regime_replay'||name==='fact_metric'||name==='price_return'
 ?{name,version:'fixture',validateParams:(p:unknown)=>typeof p==='object'&&p!==null&&!Array.isArray(p),labelAvailableAt:()=>null}:null;
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/register.test.ts
// spec §14.1 register.test.ts: same input → same id; claim not in the id; duplicate vs
// idempotency_conflict on the FULL normalised payload (producer_ref / kind / target / horizon /
// label_policy); rebuilt snapshot mismatch; lookahead with the macro snapshot's available_at = max of
// its observations; abstained with empty inputs; nonce (human retry same id, model new run_id new id);
// 23505 reread; plus the seeded property test (200 runs).
import {existsSync,readFileSync,readdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';

import {canonicalize,digest,inputsHash} from './canonical';

import {REGISTRY} from './registry';

import {FIXTURE_ASOF,FIXTURE_RESOLVERS,fixtureInputsDb,fixtureModelMethod,fixtureRegimeMethod} from './testing/fixture-methods';
import {spyRegister,syncTestMethod,withSubjects} from './testing/db-helpers';

const BATCH='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000b001';
const US:Subject={type:'macro_region',key:'US'};
const ACTOR={actor:'test' as const};
const code=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>'ok',(e:unknown)=>e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:`other:${String(e)}`);
async function setup(o:{db?:JudgmentsDb}={}){
 const db=o.db??withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb());
 for(const m of [fixtureRegimeMethod,fixtureModelMethod,{...fixtureRegimeMethod,id:'fixture_draft',status:'draft' as const}])await syncTestMethod(db,m);
 const tables=memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id']});
 const deps:RegisterDeps={db,inputsDb:fixtureInputsDb(),tables,resolverOf:FIXTURE_RESOLVERS};

}
async function evaluated(m:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>,snapshotId:string,asOf=FIXTURE_ASOF){
 const db=fixtureInputsDb();const item={subject:US,asOf,binding:{snapshot_id:snapshotId}};
 const g=await m.gather(item,db);if(!Array.isArray(g))throw new Error(`gather abstained: ${g.reason}`);
 const target=await m.resolveTarget(item,g,db);if('abstained' in target)throw new Error('target abstained');
 const out=m.compute(US,g);if(out.abstained)throw new Error('compute abstained');

}
const req=(m:Methodology,e:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof evaluated>>,o:Partial<RegisterInput>={}):RegisterInput=>({methodology:m,subject:US,asOf:FIXTURE_ASOF,producerRef:{},inputs:e.inputs,outcome:e.outcome,condition:e.condition,target:e.target,codeVersion:'abcdef0',batchId:BATCH,...o});

describe('registerJudgment: identity, duplicate and conflict (spec §6.1, §6.2)',()=>{
 it('the same input twice → the same id; the second is a duplicate and does not reach the RPC',async()=>{
  const spy=spyRegister(withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb()));const {deps}=await setup({db:spy.db});

  expect(a.judgment_id).toBe(judgmentIdOf({subject_type:'macro_region',subject_key:'US',judgment_type:'macro_regime',methodology_id:'fixture_regime',methodology_version:'v1',as_of:FIXTURE_ASOF,inputs_hash:inputsHash(e.inputs),producer_nonce:''}));
  const row=(await deps.db.getJudgment(a.judgment_id))!;
  expect(row).toMatchObject({abstained:false,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage',target:{kind:'period',period:'2027-01'},settle_after:'2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2027-03-03T00:00:00.000Z',inputs_hash:inputsHash(e.inputs)});
  expect(row.inputs.map(x=>x.kind)).toEqual(['macro_observation','macro_observation','macro_snapshot']);   // stored sorted
  expect(await deps.db.queueRow(a.judgment_id)).toMatchObject({settle_after:'2027-02-01T00:00:00.000Z',label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'});
 });
 it('claim is not part of the id: a different claim on the same inputs → idempotency_conflict, quarantined under that id',async()=>{

  const driftedCondition:Condition={...mc,predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:'overheat'}};
  const drifted:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof evaluated>>={...e,outcome:{abstained:false,claim:{...e.outcome.claim,selected:'overheat'}},condition:driftedCondition};
  const err=await registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,drifted),deps).catch(x=>x);
  expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(JudgmentError);expect(err.code).toBe('idempotency_conflict');expect(err.message).toContain(a.judgment_id);
  const q=tables.rows('dq_quarantine');
  expect(q).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(q[0]).toMatchObject({dataset:'judgments',table_name:'judgments',natural_key:a.judgment_id,reason_code:'idempotency_conflict',status:'open',batch_id:BATCH});
  expect((q[0].payload as {registered:{claim:{selected:string}};attempted:{claim:{selected:string}}}).registered.claim.selected).toBe('recovery');
  expect((q[0].payload as {attempted:{claim:{selected:string}}}).attempted.claim.selected).toBe('overheat');
 });
 it('the comparison covers producer_ref and label_policy (via register) and kind / target / horizon (normalised payload)',async()=>{
  const {deps}=await setup();

  const a=await registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureModelMethod,e,{producerRef:ref1}),deps);
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureModelMethod,e,{producerRef:{...ref1,model:'m2'}}),deps))).toBe('idempotency_conflict');
  const r=await evaluated(fixtureRegimeMethod,'s-b');
  await registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,r),deps);
  const relabelled:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={...fixtureRegimeMethod,params:{grace_days:30,label_policy:'first_observed'}};
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(relabelled,r),deps))).toBe('idempotency_conflict');
  const row=a.row;
  expect(samePayload(row,{...row,code_version:'other00',batch_id:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000b002',retrospective_hint:{label_available_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'}})).toBe(true);
  expect(samePayload(row,{...row,kind:'probability'})).toBe(false);
  expect(samePayload(row,{...row,target:{kind:'period',period:'2027-02'}})).toBe(false);
  expect(samePayload(row,{...row,horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:4}})).toBe(false);
  expect(samePayload(row,{...row,label_policy:'first_observed'})).toBe(false);
  expect(samePayload(row,{...row,producer_ref:{}})).toBe(false);
  expect(Object.keys(normalizedPayload(row))).not.toContain('code_version');
 });
 it('23505 on insert → reread: the same payload is a duplicate, a different winner is idempotency_conflict',async()=>{
  const racing=(db:JudgmentsDb,mutate:(r:JudgmentInsert)=>JudgmentInsert):JudgmentsDb=>new Proxy(db,{get:(t,k,rcv)=>k==='registerJudgment'
   ?async(row:JudgmentInsert,q:Parameters<JudgmentsDb['registerJudgment']>[1])=>{await t.registerJudgment(mutate(row),q);throw Object.assign(new Error('duplicate key value violates unique constraint "judgments_pkey"'),{code:'23505'});}

  const other=await setup({db:racing(withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb()),r=>({...r,claim:{...(r.claim as CategoricalClaim),distribution:{recovery:0.41,overheat:0.29,stagflation:0.2,recession:0.1}}}))});
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e),other.deps))).toBe('idempotency_conflict');
  expect(other.tables.rows('dq_quarantine')).toHaveLength(1);
 });
});

describe('registerJudgment: inputs (spec §3.5, §3.7, §6.2 step 1)',()=>{

describe('registerJudgment: gates (spec §6.2, §13)',()=>{

  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(draft,e),deps))).toBe('methodology_unavailable');
  const dry=await registerJudgment({actor:'test',dryRun:true},req(draft,e),deps);
  expect(dry).toMatchObject({dry_run:true,duplicate:false});expect(await deps.db.getJudgment(dry.judgment_id)).toBeNull();
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e,{subject:{type:'issuer',key:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa'}}),deps))).toBe('subject_type_not_public');
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e,{subject:{type:'security',key:'US:AAPL'}}),deps))).toBe('subject_type_not_public');
  const missing=await setup({db:withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb(),()=> 'missing')});
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e),missing.deps))).toBe('subject_missing');
  const inactive=await setup({db:withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb(),()=> 'inactive')});
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e),inactive.deps))).toBe('subject_inactive');
 });
 it('claim, condition and target checks',async()=>{
  const {deps}=await setup();const e=await evaluated(fixtureRegimeMethod,'s-a');
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,{...e,outcome:{abstained:false,claim:{} as CategoricalClaim}}),deps))).toBe('invalid_claim');
  // Narrow the union before replacing the predicate: spreading a Condition union with a new predicate is not a Condition (TS2322).
  const mc=e.condition;if(mc.resolver!=='macro_regime_replay')throw new Error(`fixture condition is ${mc.resolver}, expected macro_regime_replay`);
  const wrongRhs:Condition={...mc,predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:'recession'}};
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,{...e,condition:wrongRhs}),deps))).toBe('invalid_condition');
  // Deliberately ill-typed fixture (macro params under a private resolver): the unsafe boundary is this one explicit cast.
  const wrongResolver=({...mc,resolver:'recommendation_hit'} as unknown) as Condition;
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,{...e,condition:wrongResolver}),deps))).toBe('invalid_condition');
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,{...e,target:{kind:'period',period:'2027-02'}}),deps))).toBe('invalid_condition');
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e,{condition:null}),deps))).toBe('invalid_condition');
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e),{...deps,resolverOf:()=>null}))).toBe('invalid_condition');
  expect(await code(registerJudgment(ACTOR,req(fixtureRegimeMethod,e),{...deps,resolverOf:n=>({...FIXTURE_RESOLVERS(n)!,validateParams:()=>false})}))).toBe('invalid_condition');
 });
});

  const idWith=(nonce:string)=>judgmentIdOf({subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa',judgment_type:'recommendation_call',methodology_id:'recommendation_call',methodology_version:'v1',as_of:'2026-11-01',inputs_hash:'0'.repeat(64),producer_nonce:nonce});

  expect(nonceOf('third_party',{institution:'x',document_id:'d1',version_hash:'h1'})).toBe('d1:h1');

// Seeded PRNG (mulberry32) + Fisher–Yates: deterministic shuffles for the property test.
const rng=(seed:number)=>()=>{seed=(seed+0x6D2B79F5)|0;let t=Math.imul(seed^(seed>>>15),1|seed);t=(t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),61|t))^t;return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};
const shuffle=<T>(xs:readonly T[],r:()=>number)=>{const a=[...xs];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(r()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;};
describe('property (spec §14.1): rule methods are deterministic and the id ignores input order',()=>{
 it('200 seeded shuffles per case: compute / condition byte-identical on repeat, id unchanged',async()=>{
  const cases:{m:Methodology;subject:Subject;inputs:Input[];asOf:string}[]=[];
  for(const s of ['s-a','s-b']){const e=await evaluated(fixtureRegimeMethod,s);cases.push({m:fixtureRegimeMethod,subject:US,inputs:e.inputs,asOf:FIXTURE_ASOF});}
  // Every REGISTRY rule method with a committed public replay fixture (Task 13 / 19 add files; this test picks them up).
  const dir='fixtures/judgments/replay';
  if(existsSync(dir))for(const f of readdirSync(dir).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json')).sort()){
   const fx=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir,f),'utf8')) as {judgment:{methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;subject_type:Subject['type'];subject_key:string;inputs:Input[];as_of:string;abstained:boolean}};
   const m=REGISTRY.find(x=>x.id===fx.judgment.methodology_id&&x.version===fx.judgment.methodology_version);
   if(m&&m.producer_kind==='rule'&&!fx.judgment.abstained)cases.push({m,subject:{type:fx.judgment.subject_type,key:fx.judgment.subject_key},inputs:fx.judgment.inputs,asOf:fx.judgment.as_of});
  }
  for(const c of cases){
   const base=c.m.compute(c.subject,c.inputs);if(base.abstained)throw new Error(`${c.m.id} abstains on its fixture`);
   const baseCond=canonicalize(c.m.condition(c.subject,c.inputs,base.claim));
   const idOf=(xs:Input[])=>judgmentIdOf({subject_type:c.subject.type,subject_key:c.subject.key,judgment_type:c.m.judgment_type,methodology_id:c.m.id,methodology_version:c.m.version,as_of:c.asOf,inputs_hash:inputsHash(xs),producer_nonce:''});
   const baseId=idOf(c.inputs);
   for(let seed=1;seed<=200;seed++){
    const perm=shuffle(c.inputs,rng(seed));
    const a=c.m.compute(c.subject,perm),b=c.m.compute(c.subject,perm);
    expect(canonicalize(a)).toBe(canonicalize(b));expect(canonicalize(a)).toBe(canonicalize(base));
    if(!a.abstained)expect(canonicalize(c.m.condition(c.subject,perm,a.claim))).toBe(baseCond);
    expect(idOf(perm)).toBe(baseId);
   }
  }
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/produce.test.ts
// spec §6.4 produce + §15 acceptance example 1 (same RegimeResult produced twice → duplicates = 1,

import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';

const BATCH='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000b101';
const item=(snapshot_id:string,asOf=FIXTURE_ASOF):WorkItem=>({subject:{type:'macro_region',key:'US'},asOf,binding:{snapshot_id}});
async function setup(db:JudgmentsDb=withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb()),methods:Methodology[]=[fixtureRegimeMethod]){
 for(const m of methods)await syncTestMethod(db,m);
 const tables=memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id']});
 const deps:ProduceDeps={db,inputsDb:fixtureInputsDb(),tables,resolverOf:FIXTURE_RESOLVERS,batchId:BATCH,codeVersion:'abcdef0'};
 return {db,tables,deps};
}

describe('produce (spec §6.4)',()=>{

  const spy=spyRegister(withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb()));const {deps}=await setup(spy.db);
  const first=await produce(fixtureRegimeMethod,[item('s-a')],deps);
  expect(first.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,inserted:1,duplicates:0,quarantined:0,failed:0});

  expect(second.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,inserted:0,duplicates:1,quarantined:0,failed:0});

  expect(spy.calls()).toBe(1);
  expect(batchStatusFromCounts(second.counts,second.errors)).toBe('success');
 });
 it('binding: two snapshots of the same region and day are two judgments; gather must reference the binding',async()=>{

  expect(r.counts.inserted).toBe(2);

  expect(bindingReferenced({snapshot_id:'s-a'},[{kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-a'}} as Input])).toBe(true);
  expect(bindingReferenced({snapshot_id:'s-a'},[{kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:'s-b'}} as Input])).toBe(false);
  const ignoresBinding:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={...fixtureRegimeMethod,id:'fixture_ignores_binding',gather:(w,db)=>fixtureRegimeMethod.gather({...w,binding:{snapshot_id:'s-a'}},db)};
  const s2=await setup(undefined,[ignoresBinding]);

  expect(bad.errors[0]).toMatchObject({code:'binding_not_referenced',key:'US'});
 });
 it('abstentions are inserted rows plus one abstained_summary info code; the batch stays success',async()=>{
  const {deps,db}=await setup();

  const r=await produce(fixtureRegimeMethod,[item('s-none'),{subject:{type:'macro_region',key:'US'},asOf:'2026-10-15'}],deps);
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:2,inserted:2,failed:0});
  expect(r.items.map(i=>i.abstained)).toEqual([true,true]);

  expect(await db.getJudgment(r.items[0].judgment_id!)).toMatchObject({abstained:true,abstain_reason:'snapshot_unclassified',inputs:[]});
  expect(batchStatusFromCounts(r.counts,r.errors)).toBe('success');
 });
 it('D1: a bound item that abstains in gather after its snapshot is readable keeps the snapshot input (distinct ids per snapshot, found by snapshot_id)',async()=>{
  const abstainsLate:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={...fixtureRegimeMethod,id:'fixture_abstains_late',gather:async()=>({abstained:true,reason:'observation_missing'})};
  const {deps,db}=await setup(undefined,[abstainsLate]);

 it('one failing item does not stop the others; the receipt carries code, key and binding',async()=>{

  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:2,inserted:1,failed:1});
  expect(r.items.map(i=>i.status)).toEqual(['failed','inserted']);
  expect(r.errors[0].code).toBe('lookahead');expect(r.errors[0].key).toBe('US');expect(r.errors[0].message).toContain('"snapshot_id":"s-late"');
  expect(batchStatusFromCounts(r.counts,r.errors)).toBe('partial');
 });
 it('an idempotency conflict counts as quarantined',async()=>{
  const {deps,tables}=await setup();
  await produce(fixtureRegimeMethod,[item('s-a')],deps);
  const drifted:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={...fixtureRegimeMethod,compute:(s,i)=>{const c=fixtureRegimeMethod.compute(s,i);return c.abstained?c:{abstained:false,claim:{...c.claim,distribution:{recovery:0.5,overheat:0.2,stagflation:0.2,recession:0.1}}};}};
  const r=await produce(drifted,[item('s-a')],deps);
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,quarantined:1,failed:0});
  expect(r.errors[0]).toMatchObject({code:'idempotency_conflict',key:'US'});
  expect(tables.rows('dq_quarantine')).toHaveLength(1);
 });
 it('an aborted signal stops before the next item: deadline_hit, the rest skipped and not fetched',async()=>{
  const {deps}=await setup();const ac=new AbortController();
  const slow:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={...fixtureRegimeMethod,gather:async(w,db)=>{const g=await fixtureRegimeMethod.gather(w,db);ac.abort();return g;}};
  const r=await produce(slow,[item('s-a'),item('s-b'),item('s-none')],{...deps,signal:ac.signal});
  expect(r.counts).toMatchObject({fetched:1,inserted:1});
  expect(r.items.map(i=>i.status)).toEqual(['inserted','skipped','skipped']);
  expect(r.errors).toEqual([{code:'deadline_hit',message:'2 work items not processed'}]);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/register.ts
// registerJudgment (spec §6.2). Validates everything the public table promises before the RPC —
// methodology active (draft only in dry runs) and consistent with the module; public subject type
// that exists and is active; producer nonce (§3.6); inputs: sorted by (kind, canonical ref), no
// duplicates, kind ∈ public whitelist ∩ the method row's input_kinds, origin from the frozen table,
// max(available_at) ≤ as_of end of day (lookahead), each rebuilt by its fixed builder byte for byte
// (§3.5); active outcomes: claim by kind, horizon = the synced row's, condition through a public
// resolver's validateParams with a predicate compatible with the kind, target consistent with the
// horizon; settle window (target.ts, mirrored by the RPC) and labelAvailableAt for retrospective. Then
// id = judgmentIdOf(...) (claim is not part of the id, §6.1); an existing id with the same normalised
// payload (all semantic columns, i.e. the row minus registered_at / retrospective / code_version /
// batch_id / created_at) is a duplicate, a different one is quarantined (dataset 'judgments',
// table 'judgments', natural_key = id, idempotency_conflict, {registered, attempted}) and refused.
// The RPC insert's unique violation (23505: a concurrent producer won) rereads and compares again.
// The caller owns the batch (produce.ts). Resolvers are injected (resolverOf) so this file does not
// depend on resolvers/index.ts (Task 11); Task 14's deps.ts wires the real table.
import type {TableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {quarantine} from '@/lib/dq/quarantine';
import type {Abstained,Active,CategoricalClaim,Claim,Condition,Horizon,Input,IntervalClaim,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentInsert,JudgmentRow,JudgmentsDb,Kind,LabelPolicy,Methodology,ProducerRef,PublicSubjectType,Resolver,ResolverName,Subject,Target} from './types';
import {PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS,PUBLIC_PRODUCER_KINDS,PUBLIC_RESOLVERS,PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES} from './types';
import {canonicalize,inputsHash} from './canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {judgmentIdOf,producerNonceOf,validateClaim,validateHorizon,validateSubject} from './contract';
import {inputLabel,rebuildAndCompare,sortInputs} from './inputs';
import type {BuildOptions} from './inputs';
import {originKnown} from './origins';
import {labelPolicyOf,settleWindow,targetConsistent} from './target';
import {endOfUtcDay} from './time';

export type ResolverLookup=(name:ResolverName)=>Pick<Resolver,'name'|'version'|'validateParams'|'labelAvailableAt'>|null;
export interface RegisterActor{actor:'cron'|'script'|'admin'|'test';dryRun?:boolean}
export interface RegisterInput{methodology:Methodology;subject:Subject;asOf:string;producerRef:ProducerRef;inputs:Input[];outcome:Active<Claim>|Abstained;condition:Condition|null;target:Target|null;codeVersion:string;batchId:string}
export interface RegisterDeps{db:JudgmentsDb;inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb;tables:TableClient;resolverOf:ResolverLookup;build?:BuildOptions}
export interface RegisterResult{judgment_id:string;duplicate:boolean;abstained:boolean;dry_run:boolean;row:JudgmentInsert;registered_at:string|null;retrospective:boolean|null}
export const PAYLOAD_FIELDS=['judgment_id','subject_type','subject_key','judgment_type','methodology_id','methodology_version','kind','producer_kind','producer_ref','producer_nonce','as_of','inputs','inputs_hash','abstained','abstain_reason','claim','condition','horizon','target','label_policy','settle_after','settle_by'] as const satisfies readonly (keyof JudgmentRow)[];
export function normalizedPayload(row:Partial<JudgmentRow>|JudgmentInsert):Record<string,unknown>{
 const r=row as Record<string,unknown>;
 return Object.fromEntries(PAYLOAD_FIELDS.map(k=>[k,r[k]??null]));
}
export const samePayload=(a:Partial<JudgmentRow>|JudgmentInsert,b:Partial<JudgmentRow>|JudgmentInsert)=>canonicalize(normalizedPayload(a))===canonicalize(normalizedPayload(b));
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>0;
/** The §3.6 nonce has one implementation (contract.ts, Task 1); the alias keeps this module's name. */
export const nonceOf=producerNonceOf;
/** Task 4 maps 23505 to JudgmentError('duplicate_key'); a raw pg/PostgREST error still carries '23505'. */
export const isUniqueViolation=(e:unknown)=>{const c=(e as {code?:unknown}|null)?.code;return c==='23505'||c==='duplicate_key';};
const NUM_OPS=new Set(['>','>=','<','<=','between']);
function checkPredicate(kind:Kind,claim:Claim,c:Condition):void{
 const bad=(why:string):never=>{throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition',why);};
 if(!c.text||!str(c.text.zh)||!str(c.text.en))bad('condition.text needs zh and en');
 const p=c.predicate as {op:string;rhs:unknown};
 if(kind==='categorical'){if(p.op!=='eq'||p.rhs!==(claim as CategoricalClaim).selected)bad('categorical predicate must be eq claim.selected');return;}
 if(kind==='interval'){const i=claim as IntervalClaim;if(p.op!=='between'||!Array.isArray(p.rhs)||p.rhs[0]!==i.low||p.rhs[1]!==i.high)bad('interval predicate must be between [low, high]');return;}
 if(p.op==='eq')return;
 if(!NUM_OPS.has(p.op))bad(`predicate op ${p.op}`);
 if(p.op==='between'){if(!Array.isArray(p.rhs)||p.rhs.length!==2||!p.rhs.every(x=>typeof x==='number'&&Number.isFinite(x))||!((p.rhs[0] as number)<(p.rhs[1] as number)))bad('between needs a finite [low, high] with low < high');}
 else if(typeof p.rhs!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(p.rhs))bad('numeric predicate needs a finite rhs');
}
interface Semantic{claim:Claim|null;condition:Condition|null;horizon:Horizon|null;target:Target|null;label_policy:LabelPolicy|null;settle_after:string|null;settle_by:string|null;abstain_reason:string|null}

export async function registerJudgment(actor:RegisterActor,input:RegisterInput,deps:RegisterDeps):Promise<RegisterResult>{
 const m=input.methodology;const {db}=deps;const s=input.subject;
 if(typeof input.codeVersion!=='string'||input.codeVersion.length<7||input.codeVersion.length>64)throw new JudgmentError('code_version_missing');
 if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(input.asOf))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`as_of ${input.asOf}`);
 // 1. methodology
 const mrow=await db.methodology(m.id,m.version);
 if(!mrow)throw new JudgmentError('methodology_unavailable',`${m.id}@${m.version} is not synced`);
 if(mrow.status==='retired'||(mrow.status==='draft'&&!actor.dryRun))throw new JudgmentError('methodology_unavailable',`${m.id}@${m.version} is ${mrow.status}`);
 if(mrow.kind!==m.kind||mrow.producer_kind!==m.producer_kind||mrow.judgment_type!==m.judgment_type)throw new JudgmentError('methodology_unavailable',`${m.id}@${m.version}: the synced row differs from the module`);
 if(!(PUBLIC_PRODUCER_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(m.producer_kind))throw new JudgmentError('methodology_unavailable',`producer_kind ${m.producer_kind} is not public`);
 // 2. subject
 validateSubject(s);
 if(!(PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(s.type)||!mrow.subject_types.includes(s.type))throw new JudgmentError('subject_type_not_public',`${s.type} for ${m.id}@${m.version}`);
 const exists=await db.subjectExists(s);
 if(exists==='missing')throw new JudgmentError('subject_missing',`${s.type}:${s.key}`);
 if(exists==='inactive')throw new JudgmentError('subject_inactive',`${s.type}:${s.key}`);
 // 3. producer
 const producer_nonce=nonceOf(m.producer_kind,input.producerRef);
 // 4. inputs
 const inputs=sortInputs(input.inputs);
 const seen=new Set<string>();
 for(const x of inputs){
  const k=`${x.kind}\u0000${canonicalize(x.ref)}`;
  if(seen.has(k))throw new JudgmentError('input_not_allowed',`duplicate input ${inputLabel(x)}`);
  seen.add(k);
  if(!(PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS as readonly string[]).includes(x.kind)||!mrow.input_kinds.includes(x.kind))throw new JudgmentError('input_not_allowed',inputLabel(x));
  if(!originKnown(x.kind,x.origin))throw new JudgmentError('input_origin_unknown',inputLabel(x));
 }
 const bound=Date.parse(endOfUtcDay(input.asOf));
 for(const x of inputs)if(!(Date.parse(x.available_at)<=bound))throw new JudgmentError('lookahead',`${inputLabel(x)} available_at ${x.available_at} > ${endOfUtcDay(input.asOf)}`);
 for(const x of inputs){
  const r=await rebuildAndCompare(x,deps.inputsDb,input.asOf,deps.build);
  if(r.status==='input_snapshot_mismatch')throw new JudgmentError('input_snapshot_mismatch',`${inputLabel(x)}: ${r.field}`);
  if(r.status==='input_not_public')throw new JudgmentError('input_not_public',`${inputLabel(x)}: ${r.code}`);
 }
 // 5. outcome
 const o=input.outcome;let sem:Semantic;let labelAvailableAt:string|null=null;
 if(o.abstained){
  if(!str(o.reason))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_claim','abstained without a reason');
  sem={claim:null,condition:null,horizon:null,target:null,label_policy:null,settle_after:null,settle_by:null,abstain_reason:o.reason};
 }else{
  if(inputs.length===0)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_claim','an active judgment needs inputs');
  validateClaim(m.kind,o.claim);
  validateHorizon(m.horizon);
  if(canonicalize(mrow.horizon)!==canonicalize(m.horizon))throw new JudgmentError('methodology_unavailable','horizon differs from the synced row');
  const c=input.condition,t=input.target;
  if(!c)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition','missing condition');
  if(!t)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition','missing target');
  if(!(PUBLIC_RESOLVERS as readonly string[]).includes(c.resolver))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition',`resolver ${c.resolver} is not public`);
  const res=deps.resolverOf(c.resolver);
  if(!res)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition',`no resolver ${c.resolver}`);
  if(!res.validateParams(c.params))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition',`params rejected by ${c.resolver}@${res.version}`);
  checkPredicate(m.kind,o.claim,c);
  if(!targetConsistent(t,m.horizon,input.asOf,inputs))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition','target does not match the horizon');
  const label_policy=labelPolicyOf(m.params);
  const w=settleWindow(t,m.horizon,m.params);
  labelAvailableAt=res.labelAvailableAt(c.params,t);
  sem={claim:o.claim,condition:c,horizon:m.horizon,target:t,label_policy,settle_after:w.settle_after,settle_by:w.settle_by,abstain_reason:null};
 }
 // 6. identity and duplicate / conflict
 const inputs_hash=inputsHash(inputs);
 const judgment_id=judgmentIdOf({subject_type:s.type,subject_key:s.key,judgment_type:m.judgment_type,methodology_id:m.id,methodology_version:m.version,as_of:input.asOf,inputs_hash,producer_nonce});
 const row:JudgmentInsert={judgment_id,subject_type:s.type as PublicSubjectType,subject_key:s.key,judgment_type:m.judgment_type,methodology_id:m.id,methodology_version:m.version,kind:m.kind,producer_kind:m.producer_kind as 'rule'|'model',
  producer_ref:input.producerRef,producer_nonce,as_of:input.asOf,inputs,inputs_hash,abstained:o.abstained,...sem,code_version:input.codeVersion,batch_id:input.batchId,retrospective_hint:{label_available_at:labelAvailableAt}};
 const dry=!!actor.dryRun;
 const settle=async(existing:JudgmentRow):Promise<RegisterResult>=>{
  if(samePayload(existing,row))return {judgment_id,duplicate:true,abstained:row.abstained,dry_run:dry,row,registered_at:existing.registered_at,retrospective:existing.retrospective};
  if(!dry)await quarantine(deps.tables,{dataset:'judgments',table:'judgments',naturalKey:judgment_id,reasonCode:'idempotency_conflict',batchId:input.batchId,payload:{registered:normalizedPayload(existing),attempted:normalizedPayload(row)}});
  throw new JudgmentError('idempotency_conflict',`${judgment_id}: same id, different payload`);
 };
 const existing=await db.getJudgment(judgment_id);
 if(existing)return settle(existing);
 if(dry)return {judgment_id,duplicate:false,abstained:row.abstained,dry_run:true,row,registered_at:null,retrospective:null};
 try{
  const r=await db.registerJudgment(row,row.abstained?null:{settle_after:row.settle_after!,settle_by:row.settle_by!,label_policy:row.label_policy!});
  return {judgment_id,duplicate:false,abstained:row.abstained,dry_run:false,row,registered_at:r.registered_at,retrospective:r.retrospective};
 }catch(e){
  if(!isUniqueViolation(e))throw e;
  const winner=await db.getJudgment(judgment_id);
  if(!winner)throw e;
  return settle(winner);
 }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 `produce.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/produce.ts
// The producer runner (spec §6.4). For each work item {subject, asOf, binding?}: gather → (binding
// must appear in some input ref: spec §6.4 / G25, so two snapshots of one region and day are two
// judgments and compensation can match by snapshot_id) → resolveTarget (Abstained →
// target_unresolvable abstention) → compute → condition → registerJudgment. Gather-time builder codes
// in ABSTAIN_CODES become abstentions. One item's failure never stops the others. Receipt for the
// caller's batch (dataset judgments.produce.<methodology_id>, plan conventions): fetched = items
// attempted; inserted = new rows (abstentions included); duplicates; quarantined (idempotency_conflict);
// failed (everything else); errors carry {code, key: subject_key, message incl. the binding} and one
// informational abstained_summary {reason: count}. An aborted signal stops before the next item
// (deadline_hit, the rest 'skipped' and not counted as fetched). The caller starts / finishes the batch.
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError} from '@/lib/dq/batches';
import {emptyCounts} from '@/lib/dq/batches';
import type {Abstained,Active,Claim,Condition,Input,Methodology,ProducerRef,Target,WorkItem} from './types';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {ABSTAIN_CODES,buildInput} from './inputs';
import {registerJudgment} from './register';
import type {RegisterActor,RegisterDeps} from './register';

export interface ProduceDeps extends RegisterDeps{batchId:string;codeVersion:string;signal?:AbortSignal;dryRun?:boolean;producerRef?:ProducerRef;actor?:RegisterActor['actor']}
export type ProduceItemStatus='inserted'|'duplicate'|'quarantined'|'failed'|'skipped';
export interface ProduceItemResult{key:string;as_of:string;binding:Record<string,string>|null;status:ProduceItemStatus;judgment_id:string|null;abstained:boolean;code:string|null}
export interface ProduceResult{counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];items:ProduceItemResult[]}
const isAbstention=(x:unknown):x is Abstained=>typeof x==='object'&&x!==null&&!Array.isArray(x)&&(x as {abstained?:unknown}).abstained===true;
export function bindingReferenced(binding:Record<string,string>,inputs:readonly Input[]):boolean{
 return Object.entries(binding).every(([k,v])=>inputs.some(x=>(x.ref as unknown as Record<string,unknown>)[k]===v));
}
interface Evaluated{inputs:Input[];outcome:Active<Claim>|Abstained;condition:Condition|null;target:Target|null}
/** Commander decision D1 (spec §6.4 / §7.1): a bound item that abstains in gather keeps its binding's own input
 *  (v1 bindings are {snapshot_id} → the macro_snapshot input) when that input can be built, so two snapshots of
 *  one region and day stay two judgments and the compensation scan finds the abstention by snapshot_id. When the
 *  binding itself cannot be built (unclassified / not public / unavailable), the abstention has inputs = []. */
async function bindingInputs(m:Methodology,item:WorkItem,deps:ProduceDeps):Promise<Input[]>{
 const id=item.binding?.snapshot_id;
 if(id===undefined||!m.input_kinds.includes('macro_snapshot'))return [];
 try{return [await buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:id}},deps.inputsDb,item.asOf,deps.build)];}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof JudgmentError)return [];throw e;}
}
async function evaluate(m:Methodology,item:WorkItem,deps:ProduceDeps):Promise<Evaluated>{
 let gathered:Input[]|Abstained;
 try{gathered=await m.gather(item,deps.inputsDb);}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof JudgmentError&&(ABSTAIN_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(e.code))gathered={abstained:true,reason:e.code};else throw e;}
 if(isAbstention(gathered))return {inputs:await bindingInputs(m,item,deps),outcome:gathered,condition:null,target:null};
 const inputs=gathered;
 if(item.binding&&!bindingReferenced(item.binding,inputs))throw new JudgmentError('binding_not_referenced',`binding ${JSON.stringify(item.binding)} is not an input ref`);
 const target=await m.resolveTarget(item,inputs,deps.inputsDb);
 if(isAbstention(target))return {inputs,outcome:target,condition:null,target:null};
 const outcome=m.compute(item.subject,inputs);
 if(outcome.abstained)return {inputs,outcome,condition:null,target:null};
 return {inputs,outcome,condition:m.condition(item.subject,inputs,outcome.claim),target};
}
export async function produce(m:Methodology,work:readonly WorkItem[],deps:ProduceDeps):Promise<ProduceResult>{
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const items:ProduceItemResult[]=[];const abstained=new Map<string,number>();
 for(let i=0;i<work.length;i++){
  const item=work[i];const key=item.subject.key;const binding=item.binding??null;
  if(deps.signal?.aborted){
   errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:`${work.length-i} work items not processed`});
   for(const w of work.slice(i))items.push({key:w.subject.key,as_of:w.asOf,binding:w.binding??null,status:'skipped',judgment_id:null,abstained:false,code:null});
   break;
  }
  counts.fetched++;
  try{
   const e=await evaluate(m,item,deps);
   const r=await registerJudgment({actor:deps.actor??'cron',dryRun:deps.dryRun},{methodology:m,subject:item.subject,asOf:item.asOf,producerRef:deps.producerRef??{},inputs:e.inputs,outcome:e.outcome,condition:e.condition,target:e.target,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,batchId:deps.batchId},deps);
   if(r.duplicate)counts.duplicates++;else counts.inserted++;
   if(e.outcome.abstained&&!r.duplicate)abstained.set(e.outcome.reason,(abstained.get(e.outcome.reason)??0)+1);
   items.push({key,as_of:item.asOf,binding,status:r.duplicate?'duplicate':'inserted',judgment_id:r.judgment_id,abstained:r.abstained,code:null});
  }catch(err){
   const code=err instanceof JudgmentError?err.code:'produce_error';
   if(code==='idempotency_conflict')counts.quarantined++;else counts.failed++;
   const message=`${err instanceof Error?err.message:String(err)}${binding?` binding=${JSON.stringify(binding)}`:''}`;
   errors.push({code,key,message});
   items.push({key,as_of:item.asOf,binding,status:code==='idempotency_conflict'?'quarantined':'failed',judgment_id:null,abstained:false,code});
  }
 }
 if(abstained.size>0)errors.push({code:'abstained_summary',message:JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries([...abstained].sort((a,b)=>a[0]<b[0]?-1:1)))});
 return {counts,errors,items};
}
```

（核对：`produce.test.ts` 的弃权用例两项——`s-none` 在 `gather` 里经 `buildOrAbstain` 得到 `snapshot_unclassified` 弃权（`inputs=[]`），无 binding 的工作项在 `gather` 里弃权 `binding_missing`；两者 `as_of` 不同，所以是两条不同 id 的弃权行，`abstained_summary` = `{"binding_missing":1,"snapshot_unclassified":1}`（键按字母序）。`lookahead` 用例：`s-late` 的 `gather` 成功（构造器不查前瞻），`registerJudgment` 在输入检查处抛 `lookahead`，回执 `message` 末尾带 `binding={"snapshot_id":"s-late"}`。）

规格偏差（记入实施记录）：
- **退市判定只在终点 bar 尚缺时做**（§12.4）：已能结算的判断不因之后的退市而作废；判定条件是 `issuerPrimarySecurity(subject, today)` 返回 `null`（发行人当日已无主证券）。主证券换成另一只票（双重上市）不当退市，因为方法冻结的 `ticker` 可以不是主证券。
- **`basis_mismatch` 只在终点 bar 已存在时判定**：这样隔离项保存的 `evidence` 就是完整的待结算证据（含 `result`），`accept_refetched` 裁决可以不重抓直接结算（§7.6"以隔离时保存的完整 evidence 结算"）；终点未到时先 `Pending`。
- **`yoy` 的上年同期**取与派生内核相同的定义：同 `(metric, duration, unit, input_unit, basis, formula_version)` 且 `period_end` 早 350–380 天的唯一一行（规格只写"上年同期同键"）。两侧都多候选 → `Unavailable(ambiguous_both)`（一个隔离项只能裁一侧；到期 `void`）；上年值为 0 → `Unavailable(prior_zero)`；缺上年 → `Unavailable(prior_missing)`。
- **`ambiguous_fact` 候选是规格 S04 形状的超集**：`{key, value_text, derivation}` 之外还带 `role / realized_value / label_available_at / lineage / counterpart`，使 `choose_fact` 裁决能"只从被选候选"构造 `Resolved`（不读事实层）。**每个算子都按 §3.5 `financial_metric` 快照同形冻结**（计划审计 P1-06）：`FactOperand{role, key, value_text, lineage, derivation{formula_version, as_of, state_rev, rows}}`；`yoy` 候选的 `counterpart` 是另一侧算子的完整冻结证据；普通结算的 `evidence.operands` 同样列出每个用到的算子。`fromOverride` 不信任候选里存的值：对每个算子用 `deriveMetrics` 在冻结行上重派生，必须得到同键、同 `value_text`、同 lineage，再按 `compare` 重算实现值，与候选的 `realized_value` 不等 → `override_mismatch`。
- **截止可得性**（计划审计 P1-07）：价格 bar 只有 `closeInstantUtc(bar.time, market) ≤ cutoff`（有基准时两个市场都已收盘）才可用；事实按 `endOfUtcDay(available_date) ≤ cutoff` 判可得，`deriveMetricsAsOf` 的截止日期 = `factsAsOfDate(cutoff)`（截止当日未过完 → 前一日），所以"今天才可得"的事实在日终前不可用。`evidence` 只放 `candidate_digests`，完整候选在 `detail.candidates`（结算把 `detail` 展开进隔离 `payload`，钩子读 `payload.candidates`）。
- **close-only 判定**：登记输入 `price_bar.snapshot.fields_present` 恰为 `['close']`，或 DataGateway 返回的 bar 满足 `open=high=low=close 且 volume=0`（适配器合成形状；`datagateway.ts` 不暴露分支标记，F4 不改它的返回类型）。

- [ ] **Step 2: 写测试专用构造器 `src/lib/judgments/testing/fixtures.ts`**

（不是 `.test.ts`，不含 `S4_TEST_STATE`；只被测试 import。Task 12、14 的测试复用它。）

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/fixtures.ts
// Test-only builders (plan F4 Tasks 11/12/14; production code must never import this file):
// - stubInputsDb(): a JudgmentInputsDb whose every method rejects with not_stubbed:<name> unless overridden, so a
//   resolver test proves exactly which reads it makes;
// - fixtureKline(): synthetic K-line fixtures served with readKlineRange's [from, to] inclusive semantics (spec
//   §7.4); requests are recorded and the fixture array is read at call time (a test swaps in "the 5th bar printed");
// - factsBackedDerive(): the §12.2 composition (readFacts history at asOf → deriveMetrics) over any readFacts, used
//   with plan 2's memoryFactsDb;
// - priceJudgment()/conditionJudgment(): registered judgment rows; testMethodologyRow(): an active synthetic
//   price_return methodology row (judgment_type reuses the test-only 'synthetic_fact_metric' member of JudgmentType);
// - stubResolver(): a Resolver whose resolve() the test scripts; withOverrides(): a delegating wrapper that replaces
//   single methods of a db object (prototype delegation, so closures and `this` keep working).
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import type {KlineSourceName,SourceKlineBar} from '@/lib/data/kline/types';
import {DERIVE_CONCEPTS,FORMULA_VERSION,deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {FactsDbError} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {FactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {digest,inputsHash} from '../canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from '../errors';
import type {CapabilityLookup} from '../resolvers/price';
import {addDaysIso,closeInstantUtc} from '../time';
import type {Adjustment,Condition,Input,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentInsert,JudgmentRow,KlineRangeRequest,LabelPolicy,MethodologyRow,NumPredicate,PriceBarSnapshot,PriceMarket,Resolver,Target} from '../types';

export interface KlineFixture{meta:{synthetic:true;ticker:string;market:PriceMarket;source:KlineSourceName;adjustment:Adjustment;note:string};bars:SourceKlineBar[]}
export const loadKlineFixture=(name:string):KlineFixture=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'fixtures/judgments/kline',name),'utf8')) as KlineFixture;
/** The fixture as it looked before `lastDate`'s later sessions printed. */
export const truncateFixture=(f:KlineFixture,lastDate:string):KlineFixture=>({...f,bars:f.bars.filter(b=>b.time<=lastDate)});

const no=(name:string)=>async():Promise<never>=>{throw new Error(`not_stubbed:${name}`);};
export function stubInputsDb(over:Partial<JudgmentInputsDb>={}):JudgmentInputsDb{
 return {
  facts:{readFacts:no('facts.readFacts'),factsByIds:no('facts.factsByIds'),filingsOfIssuer:no('facts.filingsOfIssuer')},
  deriveMetricsAsOf:no('deriveMetricsAsOf'),
  macro:{observation:no('macro.observation'),snapshot:no('macro.snapshot'),snapshotsSince:no('macro.snapshotsSince'),seriesCatalog:no('macro.seriesCatalog'),classifyAsOf:no('macro.classifyAsOf')},
  tableRows:no('tableRows'),publicJudgment:no('publicJudgment'),kline:no('kline'),issuerPrimarySecurity:no('issuerPrimarySecurity'),
  ...over,
 };
}

export function fixtureKline(fixtures:KlineFixture[],calls:KlineRangeRequest[]=[]):JudgmentInputsDb['kline']{
 return async req=>{
  calls.push(req);
  if(req.signal.aborted)return {failure:'timeout'};
  const f=fixtures.find(x=>x.meta.ticker===req.ticker&&x.meta.market===req.market&&x.meta.source===req.source&&x.meta.adjustment===req.adjustment);
  if(!f)return {failure:'not_found'};
  return {source:f.meta.source,adjustment:f.meta.adjustment,volumeUnit:'shares',bars:f.bars.filter(b=>b.time>=req.from&&b.time<=req.to).map(b=>({...b}))};
 };
}

export function factsBackedDerive(facts:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'>):JudgmentInputsDb['deriveMetricsAsOf']{
 return async(issuer,market,asOf,formulaVersion)=>{
  if(formulaVersion!==FORMULA_VERSION)throw new JudgmentError('unsupported_formula_version');
  const envelope=await facts.readFacts(issuer,market,{concepts:[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS[market]],asOf,history:true});
  if(envelope.truncated)throw new FactsDbError('read_truncated');
  return {metrics:deriveMetrics(envelope.rows,{market,asOf,basedOnRev:envelope.stateRev}),envelope};
 };
}

export const withOverrides=<T extends object>(base:T,over:Partial<T>):T=>Object.assign(Object.create(base) as T,over);

export const TEST_CODE_VERSION='test-code-version';
export const REGISTERED_AT='2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z';
export const TEST_METHOD={id:'synthetic_price_return',version:'v1'} as const;
export function testMethodologyRow(over:Partial<Omit<MethodologyRow,'created_at'|'synced_at'>>={}):Omit<MethodologyRow,'created_at'|'synced_at'>{
 return {methodology_id:TEST_METHOD.id,version:TEST_METHOD.version,judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',
  subject_types:['issuer'],input_kinds:['price_bar'],markets:['US','A'],title_zh:'合成价格回报（测试专用）',title_en:'Synthetic price return (test only)',
  doc_path:'docs/methodologies/README.md',doc_sha256:'0'.repeat(64),implementation_sha256:'1'.repeat(64),params:{grace_days:60},params_json:{},
  horizon:{unit:'trading_sessions',n:5},upstream:{},deps_sha256:'2'.repeat(64),formula_hash:'3'.repeat(64),status:'active',publishable:false,code_version:TEST_CODE_VERSION,...over};
}

export interface PriceJudgmentSpec{baseDate:string;registeredClose:number;batchId:string;n?:number;targetDate?:string;ticker?:string;market?:PriceMarket;source?:KlineSourceName;benchmark?:{ticker:string;market:PriceMarket};labelPolicy?:LabelPolicy;graceDays?:number;closeOnly?:boolean;predicate?:NumPredicate;subjectKey?:string}
const DAY_MS=86_400_000;
export function judgmentRowOf(insert:JudgmentInsert,registeredAt=REGISTERED_AT):JudgmentRow{
 const {retrospective_hint:_hint,...rest}=insert;
 return {...rest,registered_at:registeredAt,retrospective:true,created_at:registeredAt};
}
/** A registered price_return judgment over the synthetic fixtures; settle_after / settle_by follow the shared window arithmetic. */
export function priceJudgment(s:PriceJudgmentSpec):{insert:JudgmentInsert;queue:{settle_after:string;settle_by:string;label_policy:LabelPolicy};row:JudgmentRow}{
 const market=s.market??'US',ticker=s.ticker??'ZZA',source=s.source??'eastmoney',adjustment:Adjustment='qfq',c=s.registeredClose;
 const snapshot:PriceBarSnapshot=s.closeOnly
  ?{ticker,market,date:s.baseDate,source,adjustment,open:null,high:null,low:null,close:c,volume:null,amount:null,fields_present:['close']}
  :{ticker,market,date:s.baseDate,source,adjustment,open:c,high:c,low:c,close:c,volume:1000,amount:null,fields_present:['open','high','low','close','volume']};
 const input:Input={kind:'price_bar',ref:{ticker,market,date:s.baseDate,source,adjustment},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:closeInstantUtc(s.baseDate,market),
  origin:{publisher:'合成测试行情',adapter:source,locator:`fixture:${ticker}`,...(s.closeOnly?{transform:'close_only'}:{})}};
 const n=s.n??5;
 const target:Target=s.targetDate?{kind:'date',date:s.targetDate}:{kind:'session_index',base_date:s.baseDate,n};
 const settleAfter=`${s.targetDate??addDaysIso(s.baseDate,n)}T00:00:00.000Z`;
 const settleBy=new Date(Date.parse(settleAfter)+(s.graceDays??60)*DAY_MS).toISOString();
 const labelPolicy=s.labelPolicy??'first_observed';
 const condition:Condition={resolver:'price_return',params:{ticker,market,adjustment,source,base_date:s.baseDate,...(s.benchmark?{benchmark:s.benchmark}:{})},
  predicate:s.predicate??{op:'>',rhs:0},text:{zh:'目标日收盘高于基准日收盘',en:'Target close above the base close'}};
 const insert:JudgmentInsert={judgment_id:randomUUID(),subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:s.subjectKey??randomUUID(),judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',
  methodology_id:TEST_METHOD.id,methodology_version:TEST_METHOD.version,kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',producer_ref:{},producer_nonce:'',
  as_of:s.baseDate,inputs:[input],inputs_hash:inputsHash([input]),abstained:false,abstain_reason:null,claim:{p:0.6,event:{zh:'收盘上涨',en:'close rises'}},
  condition,horizon:s.targetDate?{unit:'calendar_days',n:Math.round((Date.parse(`${s.targetDate}T00:00:00Z`)-Date.parse(`${s.baseDate}T00:00:00Z`))/DAY_MS)}:{unit:'trading_sessions',n},
  target,label_policy:labelPolicy,settle_after:settleAfter,settle_by:settleBy,code_version:TEST_CODE_VERSION,batch_id:s.batchId,retrospective_hint:{label_available_at:null}};
 return {insert,queue:{settle_after:settleAfter,settle_by:settleBy,label_policy:labelPolicy},row:judgmentRowOf(insert)};
}
/** A judgment row around any condition (resolver unit tests; never written to a db). */
export function conditionJudgment(condition:Condition,target:Target,over:Partial<JudgmentRow>={}):JudgmentRow{
 return {judgment_id:randomUUID(),subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:randomUUID(),judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',methodology_id:'synthetic_fact_metric',methodology_version:'v1',
  kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',producer_ref:{},producer_nonce:'',as_of:'2026-01-02',registered_at:REGISTERED_AT,retrospective:true,inputs:[],inputs_hash:'0'.repeat(64),
  abstained:false,abstain_reason:null,claim:{p:0.5,event:{zh:'测试事件',en:'test event'}},condition,horizon:{unit:'fiscal_quarters',n:1},target,label_policy:'first_observed',
  settle_after:'2026-04-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2026-07-30T00:00:00.000Z',code_version:TEST_CODE_VERSION,batch_id:randomUUID(),created_at:REGISTERED_AT,...over};
}
export function stubResolver(resolve:Resolver['resolve'],over:Partial<Resolver>={}):Resolver{
 return {name:'price_return',version:'stub/1',validateParams:()=>true,labelAvailableAt:()=>null,maxFetchMs:1_000,resolve,
  fromOverride:()=>{throw new Error('stub resolver has no override path');},...over};
}
export const verifiedCapability=(()=>({status:'verified',evidence:'fixtures/judgments/kline/synthetic-us-zza.json',verified_at:'2026-11-06'})) as unknown as CapabilityLookup;
export const unverifiedCapability=(()=>({status:'unverified',evidence:null,verified_at:null})) as unknown as CapabilityLookup;
```
