```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/index.test.ts
// F4 Task 11 (spec §3.3): every public resolver validates its condition params with a strict ajv schema (plus a
// real-calendar date check), exposes labelAvailableAt for the §3.4 retrospective rule and a maxFetchMs for the
// §7.1 budget; resolverFor() refuses recommendation_hit (private adapter only) and unimplemented resolvers.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {FORMULA_VERSION} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {MAX_FETCH_MS,RESOLVERS,resolverFor} from './index';
import {factMetricResolver} from './facts';
import {macroRegimeReplayResolver} from './macro';
import {PRICE_MAX_FETCH_MS,priceReturnResolver} from './price';

const PRICE={ticker:'ZZA',market:'US',adjustment:'qfq',source:'eastmoney',base_date:'2026-01-12'};
const FACT={issuer_id:'11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',market:'US',metric:'q_single_revenue',period_start:'2025-07-01',period_end:'2025-09-30',duration:'3M',unit:'USD',input_unit:'USD',basis:'us_standard',formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,compare:'value'};
const MACRO={region:'US',reference_period:'2026-06',macro_methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'catalog/1'};
const codeOf=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();}catch(e){return (e as {code?:string}).code??null;}return 'no_throw';};

describe('resolver params and registry',()=>{
 it('price_return params: frozen source/adjustment, real dates, optional benchmark, nothing else',()=>{
  const v=(p:unknown)=>priceReturnResolver.validateParams(p);
  expect(v(PRICE)).toBe(true);
  expect(v({...PRICE,benchmark:{ticker:'ZZB',market:'US'}})).toBe(true);
  for(const bad of [{...PRICE,adjustment:'none'},{...PRICE,source:'yahoo'},{...PRICE,market:'JP'},{...PRICE,base_date:'2026-02-30'},{...PRICE,base_date:'2026-1-12'},
   {...PRICE,extra:1},{...PRICE,benchmark:{ticker:'ZZB'}},{...PRICE,benchmark:{ticker:'ZZB',market:'US',x:1}},{market:'US',adjustment:'qfq',source:'eastmoney',base_date:'2026-01-12'},null,'x'])
   expect({bad,ok:v(bad)}).toEqual({bad,ok:false});
 });
 it('fact_metric params: the full financial_metrics natural key and compare value|yoy',()=>{
  const v=(p:unknown)=>factMetricResolver.validateParams(p);
  expect(v(FACT)).toBe(true);expect(v({...FACT,compare:'yoy',duration:'TTM'})).toBe(true);
  for(const bad of [{...FACT,compare:'mom'},{...FACT,market:'HK'},{...FACT,issuer_id:'nope'},{...FACT,period_end:'2025-09-31'},{...FACT,duration:'2M'},{...FACT,basis:''},(({basis:_b,...rest})=>rest)(FACT),{...FACT,extra:true}])
   expect({bad,ok:v(bad)}).toEqual({bad,ok:false});
 });
 it('macro_regime_replay params: region, reference period YYYY-MM and both frozen versions',()=>{
  const v=(p:unknown)=>macroRegimeReplayResolver.validateParams(p);
  expect(v(MACRO)).toBe(true);
  for(const bad of [{...MACRO,region:'EU'},{...MACRO,reference_period:'2026-13'},{...MACRO,reference_period:'2026-06-01'},{...MACRO,catalog_version:''},{...MACRO,x:1}])
   expect({bad,ok:v(bad)}).toEqual({bad,ok:false});
 });
 it('labelAvailableAt per resolver (spec §3.4 retrospective rule 3)',()=>{
  expect(priceReturnResolver.labelAvailableAt(PRICE,{kind:'session_index',base_date:'2026-01-12',n:5})).toBe('2026-01-17T21:00:00.000Z');
  expect(priceReturnResolver.labelAvailableAt(PRICE,{kind:'date',date:'2026-07-06'})).toBe('2026-07-06T20:00:00.000Z');   // EDT
  expect(priceReturnResolver.labelAvailableAt({...PRICE,market:'A',ticker:'ZZ0001'},{kind:'session_index',base_date:'2026-01-12',n:5})).toBe('2026-01-17T07:00:00.000Z');
  expect(priceReturnResolver.labelAvailableAt(PRICE,{kind:'period',period:'2026-01'})).toBeNull();
  expect(priceReturnResolver.labelAvailableAt({bad:true},{kind:'date',date:'2026-01-20'})).toBeNull();
  expect(factMetricResolver.labelAvailableAt(FACT,{kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:'2025-09-30',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2025-06-30',months:3},extrapolated:false})).toBe('2025-09-30T23:59:59.999Z');
  expect(macroRegimeReplayResolver.labelAvailableAt(MACRO,{kind:'period',period:'2026-09'})).toBe('2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z');
  expect(macroRegimeReplayResolver.labelAvailableAt(MACRO,{kind:'date',date:'2026-09-30'})).toBeNull();
 });
 it('RESOLVERS: names match keys, versions are distinct, MAX_FETCH_MS is the slowest resolver',()=>{
  for(const [k,r] of Object.entries(RESOLVERS))expect(r.name).toBe(k);
  expect(new Set(Object.values(RESOLVERS).map(r=>r.version)).size).toBe(3);
  expect(MAX_FETCH_MS).toBe(PRICE_MAX_FETCH_MS);expect(MAX_FETCH_MS).toBe(30_000);
 });
 it('resolverFor: public resolvers by name; recommendation_hit, industry_aggregate and unknown names are invalid_condition',()=>{
  expect(resolverFor('price_return')).toBe(priceReturnResolver);
  expect(resolverFor('fact_metric')).toBe(factMetricResolver);
  expect(resolverFor('macro_regime_replay')).toBe(macroRegimeReplayResolver);
  for(const name of ['recommendation_hit','industry_aggregate','nope'])expect({name,code:codeOf(()=>resolverFor(name))}).toEqual({name,code:'invalid_condition'});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/schemas.ts
// Strict ajv 8 JSON Schemas for each public resolver's condition params (spec §3.3: every resolver exports
// validateParams()). Same Ajv usage as src/lib/research/s6/market-handoff.ts (strict, first error only).
// additionalProperties:false everywhere: a registered condition carries exactly the frozen fields the resolver
// reads. Date patterns are shape-only; resolvers add isRealDate() (2026-02-30 is rejected).
import Ajv from 'ajv';
import type {FactMetricParams,MacroRegimeReplayParams,PriceReturnParams} from '../types';

const ajv=new Ajv({strict:true,allErrors:false});
const DATE='^\\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])$';
const PERIOD='^\\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$';
const UUID='^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';
const TEXT={type:'string',minLength:1,maxLength:128};
const TICKER={type:'string',minLength:1,maxLength:24,pattern:'^[A-Za-z0-9.\\-]+$'};
const PRICE_MARKETS=['A','HK','US'];
export const KLINE_SOURCES=['datagateway','eastmoney','sina','tencent','twse','tpex'] as const;

export const isRealDate=(d:string)=>{const t=Date.parse(`${d}T00:00:00Z`);return Number.isFinite(t)&&new Date(t).toISOString().slice(0,10)===d;};

export const validatePriceReturnParams=ajv.compile({type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['ticker','market','adjustment','source','base_date'],properties:{
 ticker:TICKER,market:{type:'string',enum:PRICE_MARKETS},adjustment:{type:'string',enum:['qfq','hfq']},source:{type:'string',enum:[...KLINE_SOURCES]},
 base_date:{type:'string',pattern:DATE},
 benchmark:{type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['ticker','market'],properties:{ticker:TICKER,market:{type:'string',enum:PRICE_MARKETS}}},
}}) as unknown as (v:unknown)=>v is PriceReturnParams;

export const validateFactMetricParams=ajv.compile({type:'object',additionalProperties:false,
 required:['issuer_id','market','metric','period_start','period_end','duration','unit','input_unit','basis','formula_version','compare'],properties:{
 issuer_id:{type:'string',pattern:UUID},market:{type:'string',enum:['US','CN']},metric:{type:'string',pattern:'^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$'},
 period_start:{type:'string',pattern:DATE},period_end:{type:'string',pattern:DATE},duration:{type:'string',enum:['3M','6M','9M','12M','INSTANT','TTM']},
 unit:TEXT,input_unit:TEXT,basis:TEXT,formula_version:TEXT,compare:{type:'string',enum:['value','yoy']},
}}) as unknown as (v:unknown)=>v is FactMetricParams;

export const validateMacroRegimeReplayParams=ajv.compile({type:'object',additionalProperties:false,required:['region','reference_period','macro_methodology_version','catalog_version'],properties:{
 region:{type:'string',enum:['US','CN']},reference_period:{type:'string',pattern:PERIOD},macro_methodology_version:TEXT,catalog_version:TEXT,
}}) as unknown as (v:unknown)=>v is MacroRegimeReplayParams;
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/price.ts
// price_return resolver (spec §7.3 row 1, §7.4). r = close[end] / close[base] − 1 on the FROZEN source/adjustment
// (never the environment's provider choice, audit G16). Window [base_date − 10 d, to]: session_index to =
// base_date + ceil(n × 1.52) + 10 d, date to = target.date + 20 d. No bar on base_date → Inconsistent(base_bar_missing);
// fewer than 5 bars before base → one backward page of 20 d; session_index end = base + n (one forward page from
// `to`, still short → Pending); date end = first bar ≥ target.date (none → Pending, none after `to` has passed →
// Unavailable(empty)). A benchmark is read on the same window and aligned on the SAME bar dates (any missing →
// Inconsistent(benchmark_gap)), r_rel = (1 + r) / (1 + r_b) − 1. Registered vs refetched base close differing by
// more than 0.5 % → Inconsistent(basis_mismatch) whose evidence is the complete would-be settlement evidence
// (incl. `result`), so an accept_refetched override settles from it without refetching (§7.6). Capability entries
// not 'verified' → Unavailable(adjustment_unsupported) (O6); an issuer subject with no primary security while the
// end bar is still missing → Unavailable(delisted) (§12.4). Evidence bars: 5 before base through end (≥ n + 6 when
// the provider has them), bars_sha256 = digest(bars); DataGateway close-only bars keep close only (audit G27).
// Cutoff (plan audit P1-07): a bar exists for this resolution only once its session has closed at the cutoff —
// closeInstantUtc(bar.time, market) ≤ cutoff (with a benchmark: both markets closed) — so a provider's current,
// unfinished daily bar can never become a permanent end bar.
import type {KlineSourceName,SourceKlineBar,SourceKlineSeries} from '@/lib/data/kline/types';
import {digest} from '../canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from '../errors';
import {addDaysIso,closeInstantUtc} from '../time';
import type {Input,JudgmentRow,KlineFailure,PriceMarket,PriceReturnParams,QuarantineOverride,Resolver,ResolverResult,ResolveContext,Target} from '../types';
import {capabilityOf} from './price-capabilities';
import {isRealDate,validatePriceReturnParams} from './schemas';

export const PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION='price_return/1';
/** Policy constant (plan 1 identity tolerance): same source, same basis should agree almost exactly (spec §7.4). */
export const BASIS_TOLERANCE=0.005;
export const PRE_BASE_BARS=5;
/** Main + benchmark series, each bounded by the slowest provider path: Eastmoney US multi-prefix tries (3 × 5 s) vs DataGateway 7 s (spec §7.1). */
export const PRICE_MAX_FETCH_MS=2*15_000;
const SESSION_DAYS=1.52,LEAD_DAYS=10,TAIL_DAYS=10,DATE_TAIL_DAYS=20,BACK_PAGE_DAYS=20,NEAR_BASE_DAYS=5;
const FULL_FIELDS=['open','high','low','close','volume'];

export type CapabilityLookup=typeof capabilityOf;
export interface EvidenceBar{date:string;open:number|null;high:number|null;low:number|null;close:number;volume:number|null;amount:number|null;fields_present:string[]}
export interface PriceResult{value:number;r:number;r_benchmark:number|null;from:string;to:string;label_available_at:string}
type PriceBarInput=Extract<Input,{kind:'price_bar'}>;
type InconsistentCode=Extract<ResolverResult,{status:'inconsistent'}>['reason_code'];

const isFailure=(x:SourceKlineSeries|KlineFailure):x is KlineFailure=>'failure' in x;
const byTime=(a:SourceKlineBar,b:SourceKlineBar)=>a.time<b.time?-1:a.time>b.time?1:0;
const merge=(a:SourceKlineBar[],b:SourceKlineBar[])=>{const m=new Map<string,SourceKlineBar>();for(const x of [...a,...b])if(!m.has(x.time))m.set(x.time,x);return [...m.values()].sort(byTime);};
const maxIso=(xs:string[])=>xs.reduce((m,x)=>x>m?x:m);
const unavailable=(failure:string):ResolverResult=>({status:'unavailable',failure});
const inconsistent=(reason_code:InconsistentCode,detail:Record<string,unknown>,evidence:Record<string,unknown>):ResolverResult=>({status:'inconsistent',reason_code,detail,evidence,evidence_hash:digest(evidence)});
const validate=(p:unknown):p is PriceReturnParams=>validatePriceReturnParams(p)&&isRealDate(p.base_date);

/** Read window (spec §7.3); null for target kinds price_return does not settle. */
export function priceWindow(p:PriceReturnParams,t:Target):{from:string;to:string}|null{
 const from=addDaysIso(p.base_date,-LEAD_DAYS);
 if(t.kind==='session_index')return {from,to:addDaysIso(p.base_date,Math.ceil(t.n*SESSION_DAYS)+TAIL_DAYS)};
 if(t.kind==='date')return {from,to:addDaysIso(t.date,DATE_TAIL_DAYS)};
 return null;
}
/** The registered price_bar input of the base date (spec §7.4 basis check); null when the judgment froze none. */
export function registeredBase(j:JudgmentRow,p:PriceReturnParams):PriceBarInput|null{
 return j.inputs.find((i):i is PriceBarInput=>i.kind==='price_bar'&&i.ref.ticker===p.ticker&&i.ref.market===p.market&&i.ref.date===p.base_date)??null;
}
/** DataGateway's close-only branch synthesises open=high=low=close and volume=0. */
const closeOnlyBar=(source:KlineSourceName,b:SourceKlineBar)=>source==='datagateway'&&b.volume===0&&b.open===b.close&&b.high===b.close&&b.low===b.close;
export function evidenceBar(b:SourceKlineBar,closeOnly:boolean):EvidenceBar{
 if(closeOnly)return {date:b.time,open:null,high:null,low:null,close:b.close,volume:null,amount:null,fields_present:['close']};
 return {date:b.time,open:b.open,high:b.high,low:b.low,close:b.close,volume:b.volume,amount:b.amount??null,fields_present:b.amount===undefined?FULL_FIELDS:[...FULL_FIELDS,'amount']};
}

export function priceReturnResolverWith(opts:{capabilityOf:CapabilityLookup}):Resolver{
 const labelAvailableAt=(params:unknown,target:Target):string|null=>{
  if(!validate(params))return null;
  if(target.kind==='session_index')return closeInstantUtc(addDaysIso(params.base_date,target.n),params.market);
  if(target.kind==='date')return closeInstantUtc(target.date,params.market);
  return null;
 };
 async function resolve(ctx:ResolveContext):Promise<ResolverResult>{
  const j=ctx.judgment,c=j.condition,t=j.target;
  if(!c||c.resolver!=='price_return'||!t||!validate(c.params))return unavailable('invalid_condition');
  const p=c.params;
  if(t.kind==='session_index'&&t.base_date!==p.base_date)return unavailable('invalid_condition');
  const w=priceWindow(p,t);
  if(!w)return unavailable('invalid_condition');
  const capMain=opts.capabilityOf(p.source,p.market,p.adjustment);
  const capBench=p.benchmark?opts.capabilityOf(p.source,p.benchmark.market,p.adjustment):null;
  if(capMain?.status!=='verified'||(p.benchmark&&capBench?.status!=='verified'))return unavailable('adjustment_unsupported');
  // P1-07: only bars whose session has closed at the cutoff are eligible (both markets when there is a benchmark).
  const closedBy=(date:string)=>closeInstantUtc(date,p.market)<=ctx.cutoff&&(!p.benchmark||closeInstantUtc(date,p.benchmark.market)<=ctx.cutoff);
  const read=async(ticker:string,market:PriceMarket,from:string,to:string):Promise<SourceKlineBar[]|KlineFailure>=>{
   const r=await ctx.inputsDb.kline({ticker,market,adjustment:p.adjustment,source:p.source,from,to,signal:ctx.signal});
   return isFailure(r)?r:[...r.bars].filter(b=>closedBy(b.time)).sort(byTime);
  };
  let from=w.from,to=w.to;
  const first=await read(p.ticker,p.market,from,to);
  if(!Array.isArray(first))return unavailable(first.failure);
  let bars=first;
  if(bars.length===0)return unavailable('empty');
  const registered=registeredBase(j,p);
  const regCloseOnly=registered!==null&&registered.snapshot.fields_present.length===1&&registered.snapshot.fields_present[0]==='close';
  const closeOnly=(b:SourceKlineBar)=>regCloseOnly||closeOnlyBar(p.source,b);
  let baseIdx=bars.findIndex(b=>b.time===p.base_date);
  if(baseIdx<0){
   const near=bars.filter(b=>b.time>=addDaysIso(p.base_date,-NEAR_BASE_DAYS)&&b.time<=addDaysIso(p.base_date,NEAR_BASE_DAYS)).map(b=>evidenceBar(b,closeOnly(b)));
   return inconsistent('settlement_base_bar_missing',{base_date:p.base_date,series_from:bars[0].time,series_to:bars[bars.length-1].time,bars_near_base:near},
    {source:p.source,adjustment:p.adjustment,ticker:p.ticker,market:p.market,from,to,base_date:p.base_date,bars:bars.map(b=>evidenceBar(b,closeOnly(b))),fetched_at:ctx.now});
  }
  if(baseIdx<PRE_BASE_BARS){
   const backFrom=addDaysIso(from,-BACK_PAGE_DAYS);
   const back=await read(p.ticker,p.market,backFrom,addDaysIso(from,-1));
   if(!Array.isArray(back))return unavailable(back.failure);
   from=backFrom;bars=merge(back,bars);baseIdx=bars.findIndex(b=>b.time===p.base_date);
  }
  const endIdxOf=()=>t.kind==='session_index'?(baseIdx+t.n<bars.length?baseIdx+t.n:-1):t.kind==='date'?bars.findIndex(b=>b.time>=t.date):-1;
  let endIdx=endIdxOf();
  if(endIdx<0&&t.kind==='session_index'){
   const nextTo=addDaysIso(to,Math.ceil(t.n*SESSION_DAYS)+TAIL_DAYS);
   const fwd=await read(p.ticker,p.market,addDaysIso(to,1),nextTo);
   if(!Array.isArray(fwd))return unavailable(fwd.failure);
   to=nextTo;bars=merge(bars,fwd);endIdx=endIdxOf();
  }
  if(endIdx<0){
   if(j.subject_type==='issuer'&&(await ctx.inputsDb.issuerPrimarySecurity(j.subject_key,ctx.now.slice(0,10)))===null)return unavailable('delisted');
   if(t.kind==='date'&&ctx.now.slice(0,10)>to)return unavailable('empty');
   const est=labelAvailableAt(p,t);
   return est?{status:'pending',reason:'awaiting_bars',estimated_at:est}:{status:'pending',reason:'awaiting_bars'};
  }
  const baseBar=bars[baseIdx],endBar=bars[endIdx];
  if(!(baseBar.close>0)||!Number.isFinite(endBar.close))return unavailable('invalid_data');
  const slice=bars.slice(Math.max(0,baseIdx-PRE_BASE_BARS),endIdx+1);
  const evBars=slice.map(b=>evidenceBar(b,closeOnly(b)));
  const anyCloseOnly=evBars.some(b=>b.fields_present.length===1);
  const r=endBar.close/baseBar.close-1;
  let rb:number|null=null;let bench:Record<string,unknown>={};
  if(p.benchmark){
   const bb=await read(p.benchmark.ticker,p.benchmark.market,from,to);
   if(!Array.isArray(bb))return unavailable(bb.failure);
   const byDate=new Map(bb.map(b=>[b.time,b]));
   const missing=slice.filter(b=>!byDate.has(b.time)).map(b=>b.time);
   const bEv=slice.flatMap(b=>{const x=byDate.get(b.time);return x?[evidenceBar(x,closeOnlyBar(p.source,x))]:[];});
   bench={benchmark:p.benchmark,benchmark_bars:bEv,benchmark_bars_sha256:digest(bEv)};
   if(missing.length>0)return inconsistent('settlement_benchmark_gap',{missing_dates:missing},
    {source:p.source,adjustment:p.adjustment,ticker:p.ticker,market:p.market,from,to,base_date:p.base_date,end_date:endBar.time,bars:evBars,bars_sha256:digest(evBars),...bench,fetched_at:ctx.now});
   const b0=byDate.get(baseBar.time)!,b1=byDate.get(endBar.time)!;
   if(!(b0.close>0)||!Number.isFinite(b1.close))return unavailable('invalid_data');
   rb=b1.close/b0.close-1;
  }
  const value=rb===null?r:(1+r)/(1+rb)-1;
  const label=maxIso([closeInstantUtc(endBar.time,p.market),...(p.benchmark?[closeInstantUtc(endBar.time,p.benchmark.market)]:[])]);
  const result:PriceResult={value,r,r_benchmark:rb,from:p.base_date,to:endBar.time,label_available_at:label};
  const evidence:Record<string,unknown>={source:p.source,adjustment:p.adjustment,ticker:p.ticker,market:p.market,from,to,base_date:p.base_date,end_date:endBar.time,
   bars:evBars,bars_sha256:digest(evBars),...bench,fetched_at:ctx.now,
   origin:registered?(anyCloseOnly?{...registered.origin,transform:'close_only'}:registered.origin):null,
   capability:{main:capMain,benchmark:capBench},registered_bar:registered?registered.snapshot:null,result};
  if(registered&&Math.abs(registered.snapshot.close-baseBar.close)/registered.snapshot.close>BASIS_TOLERANCE)
   return inconsistent('settlement_basis_mismatch',{registered_bar:registered.snapshot,refetched_bar:evidenceBar(baseBar,closeOnly(baseBar)),source:p.source},evidence);
  return {status:'resolved',value,unit:'ratio',from:p.base_date,to:endBar.time,label_available_at:label,evidence};
 }
 function fromOverride(j:JudgmentRow,o:QuarantineOverride):ResolverResult{
  if(j.condition?.resolver!=='price_return'||o.reason_code!=='settlement_basis_mismatch'||o.resolution.kind!=='accept_refetched')
   throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch',`price_return cannot apply ${o.resolution.kind} for ${o.reason_code}`);
  const ev=o.resolution.evidence;
  if(digest(ev)!==o.resolution.evidence_hash)throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','evidence_hash');
  const r=ev.result as Partial<PriceResult>|undefined;
  if(!r||typeof r.value!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(r.value)||typeof r.from!=='string'||typeof r.to!=='string'||typeof r.label_available_at!=='string')throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','evidence_result');
  return {status:'resolved',value:r.value,unit:'ratio',from:r.from,to:r.to,label_available_at:r.label_available_at,
   evidence:{...ev,override:{reason_code:o.reason_code,evidence_hash:o.evidence_hash,resolved_by:o.resolved_by,at:o.at,cutoff:o.cutoff}}};
 }
 return {name:'price_return',version:PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION,validateParams:validate,labelAvailableAt,maxFetchMs:PRICE_MAX_FETCH_MS,resolve,fromOverride};
}

export const priceReturnResolver=priceReturnResolverWith({capabilityOf});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/price.test.ts
// F4 Task 11 (spec §7.3 row 1, §7.4, §14.1 price_return bullets) over the synthetic fixtures: session_index end and
// forward paging, date end, benchmark same-date alignment and benchmark_gap, base_bar_missing, basis_mismatch on
// both sides of 0.5 %, capability gate, delisted, close-only evidence, provider failure, evidence shape, and the
// accept_refetched override path.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {digest} from '../canonical';
import type {JudgmentRow,KlineRangeRequest,ResolveContext} from '../types';
import {fixtureKline,loadKlineFixture,priceJudgment,stubInputsDb,truncateFixture,unverifiedCapability,verifiedCapability} from '../testing/fixtures';
import type {KlineFixture,PriceJudgmentSpec} from '../testing/fixtures';
import {PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION,priceReturnResolverWith} from './price';
import type {CapabilityLookup} from './price';

const ZZA=loadKlineFixture('synthetic-us-zza.json'),ZZB=loadKlineFixture('synthetic-us-zzb.json'),ZZC=loadKlineFixture('synthetic-a-zz0001-close-only.json');
const NOW='2026-03-02T04:00:00.000Z';
const resolver=priceReturnResolverWith({capabilityOf:verifiedCapability});
const judgment=(s:Partial<PriceJudgmentSpec>={})=>priceJudgment({baseDate:'2026-01-12',registeredClose:106,batchId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',...s}).row;
function run(j:JudgmentRow,fixtures:KlineFixture[],o:{now?:string;primary?:{ticker:string;market:'US'|'A'|'HK'}|null}={}){
 const calls:KlineRangeRequest[]=[];
 const inputsDb=stubInputsDb({kline:fixtureKline(fixtures,calls),issuerPrimarySecurity:async()=>o.primary===undefined?{ticker:'ZZA',market:'US'}:o.primary});
 const now=o.now??NOW;
 const ctx:ResolveContext={judgment:j,cutoff:now,now,inputsDb,signal:new AbortController().signal};
 return {calls,result:resolver.resolve(ctx)};
}
type Ev={bars:{date:string;open:number|null;fields_present:string[]}[];bars_sha256:string;benchmark_bars?:unknown[];origin:{transform?:string}|null;capability:{main:unknown};result:{value:number};fetched_at:string;from:string;to:string};

describe('price_return resolver',()=>{
 it('session_index: end = base + n on the frozen source/adjustment, r = close[end]/close[base] − 1, evidence 5 bars before base through end',async()=>{
  const {calls,result}=run(judgment(),[ZZA]);
  const r=await result;
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  expect(r).toMatchObject({value:111/106-1,unit:'ratio',from:'2026-01-12',to:'2026-01-20',label_available_at:'2026-01-20T21:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(calls[0]).toMatchObject({ticker:'ZZA',market:'US',adjustment:'qfq',source:'eastmoney',from:'2026-01-02',to:'2026-01-30'});
  const ev=r.evidence as unknown as Ev;
  expect(ev.bars).toHaveLength(11);                                          // ≥ n + 6 (acceptance 3)
  expect(ev.bars[0].date).toBe('2026-01-05');expect(ev.bars[10].date).toBe('2026-01-20');
  expect(ev.bars_sha256).toBe(digest(ev.bars));
  expect(ev).toMatchObject({from:'2026-01-02',to:'2026-01-30',fetched_at:NOW,origin:{},capability:{main:{status:'verified'}},result:{value:111/106-1}});
  expect(ev.bars[0].fields_present).toEqual(['open','high','low','close','volume']);
 });
 it('session_index short of n bars: one forward page from `to`, then Pending with the label estimate',async()=>{
  const {calls,result}=run(judgment(),[truncateFixture(ZZA,'2026-01-16')]);
  expect(await result).toEqual({status:'pending',reason:'awaiting_bars',estimated_at:'2026-01-17T21:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(calls.map(c=>[c.from,c.to])).toEqual([['2026-01-02','2026-01-30'],['2026-01-31','2026-02-17']]);
 });
 it('fewer than 5 bars before base: one backward page of 20 days',async()=>{
  const {calls,result}=run(judgment({baseDate:'2026-01-07',registeredClose:103}),[ZZA]);
  const r=await result;
  expect(r.status).toBe('resolved');
  expect(calls.map(c=>[c.from,c.to])).toEqual([['2025-12-28','2026-01-25'],['2025-12-08','2025-12-27']]);
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  expect((r.evidence as unknown as Ev).from).toBe('2025-12-08');   // explicit unsafe boundary: evidence is Record<string,unknown>
 });
 it('a bar is eligible only once its session closed at the cutoff: intraday and midnight cutoffs never take the unfinished end bar (P1-07)',async()=>{
  // 2026-01-20 is the 5th session after base; the US close that day is 21:00Z (EST).
  for(const now of ['2026-01-20T00:00:00.000Z','2026-01-20T15:00:00.000Z','2026-01-20T20:59:59.999Z']){
   const r=await run(judgment(),[ZZA],{now}).result;
   expect({now,r}).toEqual({now,r:{status:'pending',reason:'awaiting_bars',estimated_at:'2026-01-17T21:00:00.000Z'}});
  }
  const closed=await run(judgment(),[ZZA],{now:'2026-01-20T21:00:00.000Z'}).result;
  expect(closed).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:111/106-1,to:'2026-01-20',label_available_at:'2026-01-20T21:00:00.000Z'});
  if(closed.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(closed.status);
  expect((closed.evidence as unknown as Ev).bars.at(-1)!.date).toBe('2026-01-20');               // nothing after the cutoff in the evidence
  // with a benchmark both closes must have passed
  const bench=judgment({benchmark:{ticker:'ZZB',market:'US'}});
  expect((await run(bench,[ZZA,ZZB],{now:'2026-01-20T15:00:00.000Z'}).result).status).toBe('pending');
 });
 it('date target: end = first bar on or after target.date (holiday → next session); window to = date + 20 d',async()=>{
  const {calls,result}=run(judgment({targetDate:'2026-01-19'}),[ZZA]);

  expect(calls[0]).toMatchObject({from:'2026-01-02',to:'2026-02-08'});

 it('date target without an end bar: Pending before `to`, Unavailable(empty) once `to` has passed',async()=>{

  expect(await run(judgment({targetDate:'2026-01-19'}),[short],{now:'2026-02-09T00:00:00.000Z'}).result).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'empty'});
 });
 it('no bar on base_date → Inconsistent(base_bar_missing) with the bars near base and a hash of the evidence',async()=>{
  const r=await run(judgment({baseDate:'2026-01-19',registeredClose:110}),[ZZA]).result;
  if(r.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(r.status);

  expect((r.detail.bars_near_base as {date:string}[]).map(b=>b.date)).toEqual(['2026-01-14','2026-01-15','2026-01-16','2026-01-20','2026-01-21','2026-01-22','2026-01-23']);
  expect(r.evidence_hash).toBe(digest(r.evidence));
 });
 it('basis check: 0.47 % passes, 0.93 % → Inconsistent(basis_mismatch) carrying the complete evidence and result',async()=>{
  expect((await run(judgment({registeredClose:106.5}),[ZZA]).result).status).toBe('resolved');
  const r=await run(judgment({registeredClose:107}),[ZZA]).result;
  if(r.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(r.status);

 });
 it('benchmark: aligned on the same bar dates, r_rel = (1 + r)/(1 + r_b) − 1; a missing benchmark date → Inconsistent(benchmark_gap)',async()=>{
  const r=await run(judgment({benchmark:{ticker:'ZZB',market:'US'}}),[ZZA,ZZB]).result;
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(r.status);

  if(g.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(g.status);
  expect(g).toMatchObject({reason_code:'settlement_benchmark_gap',detail:{missing_dates:['2026-01-14']}});
 });
 it('capability not verified (main or benchmark) → Unavailable(adjustment_unsupported) before any read',async()=>{
  const calls:KlineRangeRequest[]=[];

  expect(await priceReturnResolverWith({capabilityOf:unverifiedCapability}).resolve(ctx(false))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'adjustment_unsupported'});
  const hkUnverified=priceReturnResolverWith({capabilityOf:((_s:unknown,m:unknown)=>m==='HK'?null:{status:'verified',evidence:'fixtures/judgments/kline/synthetic-us-zzb.json',verified_at:'2026-11-06'}) as unknown as CapabilityLookup});
  expect(await hkUnverified.resolve(ctx(true))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'adjustment_unsupported'});
  expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
 });
 it('end bar missing and the issuer has no primary security any more → Unavailable(delisted)',async()=>{
  const short=truncateFixture(ZZA,'2026-01-16');
  expect(await run(judgment(),[short],{primary:null}).result).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'delisted'});
  expect((await run(judgment(),[ZZA],{primary:null}).result).status).toBe('resolved');   // a settleable judgment is never voided by a later delisting
 });
 it('DataGateway close-only: evidence keeps close only (others null, fields_present [close]) and origin.transform close_only',async()=>{
  const j=judgment({ticker:'ZZ0001',market:'A',source:'datagateway',registeredClose:10.5,closeOnly:true});
  const r=await run(j,[ZZC],{primary:{ticker:'ZZ0001',market:'A'}}).result;
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(r.status);
  expect(r).toMatchObject({to:'2026-01-19',label_available_at:'2026-01-19T07:00:00.000Z'});
  expect(r.value).toBeCloseTo(11/10.5-1,12);
  const ev=r.evidence as unknown as Ev;
  expect(ev.bars.every(b=>b.open===null&&b.fields_present.length===1&&b.fields_present[0]==='close')).toBe(true);
  expect(ev.origin?.transform).toBe('close_only');
 });
 it('provider failures surface as Unavailable(<failure>); an empty series is Unavailable(empty)',async()=>{
  const j=judgment();
  const ctx=(kline:ResolveContext['inputsDb']['kline']):ResolveContext=>({judgment:j,cutoff:NOW,now:NOW,inputsDb:stubInputsDb({kline}),signal:new AbortController().signal});
  expect(await resolver.resolve(ctx(async()=>({failure:'rate_limited'})))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'rate_limited'});
  expect(await resolver.resolve(ctx(async()=>({source:'eastmoney',adjustment:'qfq',volumeUnit:'shares',bars:[]})))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'empty'});
 });
 it('fromOverride(accept_refetched) settles from the frozen evidence without reads; tampered evidence or another verdict kind throws',async()=>{
  const j=judgment({registeredClose:107});
  const inc=await run(j,[ZZA]).result;
  if(inc.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(inc.status);
  const override={reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch',resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched' as const,evidence_hash:inc.evidence_hash,evidence:inc.evidence},evidence_hash:inc.evidence_hash,resolved_by:'9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d',at:NOW,cutoff:NOW};
  const r=resolver.fromOverride(j,override);
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:111/106-1,from:'2026-01-12',to:'2026-01-20',label_available_at:'2026-01-20T21:00:00.000Z',evidence:{override:{reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch',evidence_hash:inc.evidence_hash}}});
  const codeOf=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();}catch(e){return (e as {code?:string}).code;}return 'no_throw';};
  expect(codeOf(()=>resolver.fromOverride(j,{...override,resolution:{...override.resolution,evidence:{...inc.evidence,bars:[]}}}))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(codeOf(()=>resolver.fromOverride(j,{...override,resolution:{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:{}}}))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(resolver.version).toBe(PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION);
 });
});
```

> 断言里的日期按 `priceWindow` 实算：基准日 2026-01-19、`n=5` → 窗口 `[2026-01-09, 2026-02-06]`（`ceil(5 × 1.52) + 10 = 18` 天），夹具在窗口内第一根 2026-01-09、最后一根 2026-02-06；`bars_near_base` 取 `[01-14, 01-24]`。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/facts.test.ts
// F4 Task 11 (spec §7.3 row 2, §7.6 S04, §14.1 fact_metric bullets): plan 2's memoryFactsDb seeded through its
// public write path, the §12.2 derive composition at the cutoff, full natural-key match, yoy, cutoff visibility,
// truncated reads, ambiguous candidates with their derivation envelopes, and the choose_fact override.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {FORMULA_VERSION} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import type {MemoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import {FactsDbError} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {digest} from '../canonical';
import {conditionJudgment,factsBackedDerive,stubInputsDb} from '../testing/fixtures';
import type {FactMetricParams,JudgmentInputsDb,QuarantineOverride,ResolveContext} from '../types';
import {derivationRowOf,factMetricResolver,factsAsOfDate,operandReproduces} from './facts';
import type {FactCandidate,FactOperand} from './facts';

interface Seed{period_start:string;period_end:string;value:string;available_date:string}
/** One published run: a filing per available date, 3M consolidated USD revenue facts (plan 2 write path). */
async function seedFacts(facts:MemoryFactsDb,issuer:string,rows:Seed[]):Promise<void>{
 await facts.reconcileScope('US',[{issuer_id:issuer,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:'0000000001'}]);
 const batch=randomUUID();
 expect(await facts.claimLease(issuer,'US',batch,600)).toBe(true);
 const run=await facts.beginRun(issuer,'US',batch,1);
 const ref=(d:string)=>`zz-${issuer}-${d}`;
 const dates=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.available_date))];
 const ids=await facts.stageFilings(run,dates.map(d=>({filing_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,sourceRef:ref(d),market:'US',source:'edgar',origin:'sec',formType:'10-Q',fiscalYear:Number(d.slice(0,4)),fiscalPeriod:'Q3',periodEnd:null,availableDate:d,url:null})));
 await facts.stageFacts(run,rows.map(r=>({fact_id:randomUUID(),issuer_id:issuer,market:'US',filing_id:ids.get(ref(r.available_date))!,concept:'revenue',source_concept:'Revenues',statement:'IS',
  period_start:r.period_start,period_end:r.period_end,duration:'3M',value:r.value,unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:r.available_date,mapping_gen:1,mapping_version:'facts-map/1',raw_hash:'h'})));
 await facts.publishRun(run,[...ids.values()]);
}
const Q3={period_start:'2025-07-01',period_end:'2025-09-30'},PRIOR={period_start:'2024-07-01',period_end:'2024-09-30'};
const NOW='2026-03-02T04:00:00.000Z';
async function setup(rows:Seed[]=[{...Q3,value:'1000',available_date:'2025-10-30'},{...PRIOR,value:'800',available_date:'2024-10-30'}]){
 const facts=memoryFactsDb();const issuer=randomUUID();
 await seedFacts(facts,issuer,rows);
 const params=(over:Partial<FactMetricParams>={}):FactMetricParams=>({issuer_id:issuer,market:'US',metric:'q_single_revenue',...Q3,duration:'3M',unit:'USD',input_unit:'USD',basis:'us_standard',formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,compare:'value',...over});
 const derive=factsBackedDerive(facts);
 return {facts,issuer,params,derive,inputsDb:stubInputsDb({deriveMetricsAsOf:derive})};
}
const judgmentOf=(p:FactMetricParams)=>conditionJudgment({resolver:'fact_metric',params:p,predicate:{op:'>',rhs:900},text:{zh:'单季营收高于 900',en:'quarterly revenue above 900'}},
 {kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:p.period_end,calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2025-06-30',months:3},extrapolated:false});
const ctxOf=(p:FactMetricParams,inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb,cutoff=NOW):ResolveContext=>({judgment:judgmentOf(p),cutoff,now:NOW,inputsDb,signal:new AbortController().signal});
/** inputsDb whose derive result is the real one with `edit` applied (duplicate rows for the ambiguity cases). */
const edited=(derive:JudgmentInputsDb['deriveMetricsAsOf'],edit:(ms:MetricRow[])=>MetricRow[])=>stubInputsDb({deriveMetricsAsOf:async(...a)=>{const r=await derive(...a);return {...r,metrics:edit(r.metrics)};}});
const isQ=(m:MetricRow,end:string)=>m.metric==='q_single_revenue'&&m.period_end===end;

describe('fact_metric resolver',()=>{
 it('compare=value: derived at the cutoff and matched on the full natural key; evidence names facts, filings, dates, state_rev',async()=>{
  const {facts,issuer,params,inputsDb}=await setup();
  const r=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),inputsDb));
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(JSON.stringify(r));
  expect(r).toMatchObject({value:1000,unit:'USD',from:'2025-07-01',to:'2025-09-30',label_available_at:'2025-10-30T23:59:59.999Z'});
  const fact=facts.facts().find(f=>f.period_end==='2025-09-30')!;
  const env=await facts.readFacts(issuer,'US',{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:'2026-03-01',history:true});
  const key={issuer_id:issuer,market:'US',metric:'q_single_revenue',...Q3,duration:'3M',unit:'USD',input_unit:'USD',basis:'us_standard',formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION};
  const {operands,...rest}=r.evidence as Record<string,unknown>&{operands:FactOperand[]};
  // NOW is 04:00Z on 2026-03-02: that day has not ended, so the derive date is 2026-03-01 (P1-07).
  expect(rest).toEqual({metric_keys:[key],fact_ids:[fact.fact_id],filing_ids:[fact.filing_id],available_dates:['2025-10-30'],value_texts:['1000'],mapping_gen:[1],state_rev:env.stateRev,cutoff:NOW,as_of:'2026-03-01',formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,compare:'value'});
  // P1-06: the operand is frozen in the §3.5 financial_metric snapshot shape and replays from its own rows.
  expect(operands).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(operands[0]).toMatchObject({role:'current',key,value_text:'1000',derivation:{formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,as_of:'2026-03-01',state_rev:env.stateRev}});
  expect(operands[0].lineage.map(i=>i.fact_id)).toEqual([fact.fact_id]);
  expect(operands[0].derivation.rows.map(x=>x.period_end)).toEqual(['2024-09-30','2025-09-30']);
  expect(operandReproduces(operands[0])).toBe(true);
  expect(operandReproduces({...operands[0],value_text:'1001'})).toBe(false);
  expect(operandReproduces({...operands[0],derivation:{...operands[0].derivation,rows:operands[0].derivation.rows.filter(x=>x.period_end!=='2025-09-30')}})).toBe(false);
 });
 it('cutoff availability is end of the UTC day: a fact available today is not eligible before midnight (P1-07)',async()=>{
  expect(factsAsOfDate('2025-10-30T12:00:00.000Z')).toBe('2025-10-29');
  expect(factsAsOfDate('2025-10-30T23:59:59.998Z')).toBe('2025-10-29');
  expect(factsAsOfDate('2025-10-30T23:59:59.999Z')).toBe('2025-10-30');
  expect(factsAsOfDate('2025-10-31T00:00:00.000Z')).toBe('2025-10-30');
  const {params,inputsDb}=await setup();   // Q3 available_date 2025-10-30
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),inputsDb,'2025-10-30T12:00:00.000Z'))).toEqual({status:'pending',reason:'not_reported'});
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),inputsDb,'2025-10-30T23:59:59.998Z'))).toEqual({status:'pending',reason:'not_reported'});
  const atMidnight=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),inputsDb,'2025-10-31T00:00:00.000Z'));
  expect(atMidnight).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:1000,label_available_at:'2025-10-30T23:59:59.999Z',evidence:{as_of:'2025-10-30'}});
 });
 it('compare=yoy: (current − prior) / |prior| with prior = same key 350–380 days earlier; label = latest input availability',async()=>{
  const {params,inputsDb}=await setup();
  const r=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params({compare:'yoy'}),inputsDb));
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:0.25,unit:'ratio',label_available_at:'2025-10-30T23:59:59.999Z',evidence:{value_texts:['1000','800'],available_dates:['2024-10-30','2025-10-30'],compare:'yoy'}});
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error(r.status);
  const ops=(r.evidence as {operands:FactOperand[]}).operands;
  expect(ops.map(o=>[o.role,o.value_text,o.key.period_end])).toEqual([['current','1000','2025-09-30'],['prior','800','2024-09-30']]);   // BOTH yoy operands frozen (P1-06)
  expect(ops.every(operandReproduces)).toBe(true);
 });
 it('not visible at the cutoff or not reported yet → Pending(not_reported); a key differing in any field never matches',async()=>{
  const {params,inputsDb}=await setup();
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),inputsDb,'2025-10-29T12:00:00.000Z'))).toEqual({status:'pending',reason:'not_reported'});
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params({period_start:'2025-10-01',period_end:'2025-12-31'}),inputsDb))).toEqual({status:'pending',reason:'not_reported'});
  for(const over of [{basis:'cn_standard'},{input_unit:'CNY'},{duration:'TTM'},{unit:'pure'},{period_start:'2025-06-30'}] as Partial<FactMetricParams>[])
   expect({over,r:(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(over),inputsDb))).status}).toEqual({over,r:'pending'});
 });
 it('yoy without a prior year → Unavailable(prior_missing); a zero prior → Unavailable(prior_zero)',async()=>{
  const a=await setup([{...Q3,value:'1000',available_date:'2025-10-30'}]);
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(a.params({compare:'yoy'}),a.inputsDb))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'prior_missing'});
  const b=await setup([{...Q3,value:'1000',available_date:'2025-10-30'},{...PRIOR,value:'0',available_date:'2024-10-30'}]);
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(b.params({compare:'yoy'}),b.inputsDb))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'prior_zero'});
 });
 it('truncated read (thrown read_truncated or a truncated envelope) → Unavailable(truncated); another formula version → Unavailable(unsupported_formula_version)',async()=>{
  const {params,inputsDb,derive}=await setup();
  const thrown=stubInputsDb({deriveMetricsAsOf:async()=>{throw new FactsDbError('read_truncated');}});
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),thrown))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'truncated'});
  const flagged=stubInputsDb({deriveMetricsAsOf:async(...a)=>{const r=await derive(...a);return {...r,envelope:{...r.envelope,truncated:true}};}});
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),flagged))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'truncated'});
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params({formula_version:'facts-derive/0.9'}),inputsDb))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'unsupported_formula_version'});
  const boom=stubInputsDb({deriveMetricsAsOf:async()=>{throw new Error('db down');}});
  await expect(factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),boom))).rejects.toThrow('db down');
 });
 it('two rows for one key → Inconsistent(ambiguous_fact): candidates carry key, value_text, realised value, lineage and the §3.5 derivation envelope',async()=>{
  const {params,derive}=await setup();
  const dup=edited(derive,ms=>[...ms,{...ms.find(m=>isQ(m,'2025-09-30'))!,value:'1001'}]);
  const r=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params(),dup));
  if(r.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(r.status);
  expect(r.reason_code).toBe('settlement_ambiguous_fact');
  const cands=r.detail.candidates as FactCandidate[];
  expect(cands.map(c=>[c.role,c.value_text,c.realized_value])).toEqual([['current','1000',1000],['current','1001',1001]]);
  for(const c of cands){
   expect(c.counterpart).toBeNull();                                                      // compare=value: one operand
   expect(c.derivation).toMatchObject({formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION,as_of:'2026-03-01'});
   expect(c.derivation.rows.map(x=>x.period_end)).toEqual(['2024-09-30','2025-09-30']);   // [period_start − 400 d, period_end], sorted
   expect(Object.keys(c.derivation.rows[0]).sort()).toEqual(['available_date','concept','consolidation','created_at','disclosure_seq','duration','fact_id','filing_id','is_current','is_revision','issuer_id','mapping_gen','market','period_end','period_start','status','unit','value_text']);
   expect(c.label_available_at).toBe('2025-10-30T23:59:59.999Z');
  }
  expect(r.evidence).toMatchObject({role:'current',candidate_digests:cands.map(c=>digest(c)),cutoff:NOW,formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION});
  expect(r.evidence_hash).toBe(digest(r.evidence));
 });
 it('yoy: an ambiguous prior yields prior candidates with their own realised yoy; both sides ambiguous → Unavailable(ambiguous_both)',async()=>{
  const {params,derive}=await setup();

  const r=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params({compare:'yoy'}),dupPrior));

  expect(priorCands.map(c=>[c.role,c.realized_value])).toEqual([['prior',0.25],['prior',(1000-801)/801]]);
  // P1-06: each prior candidate carries the CURRENT operand fully frozen, so its ratio is replayable on its own.
  for(const c of priorCands){
   expect(c.counterpart).toMatchObject({role:'current',value_text:'1000',key:{period_end:'2025-09-30'}});
   expect(operandReproduces(c.counterpart!)).toBe(true);
  }
  const both=edited(derive,ms=>[...ms,{...ms.find(m=>isQ(m,'2024-09-30'))!,value:'801'},{...ms.find(m=>isQ(m,'2025-09-30'))!,value:'1001'}]);
  expect(await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(params({compare:'yoy'}),both))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'ambiguous_both'});
 });
 it('fromOverride(choose_fact) settles from the chosen candidate alone; other verdicts throw override_mismatch',async()=>{
  const {params,derive}=await setup();
  const p=params();
  const r=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(p,edited(derive,ms=>[...ms,{...ms.find(m=>isQ(m,'2025-09-30'))!,value:'1001'}])));
  if(r.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(r.status);
  const cands=r.detail.candidates as FactCandidate[];
  const asOverride=(chosen:FactCandidate):QuarantineOverride=>({reason_code:'settlement_ambiguous_fact',resolution:{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:chosen as unknown as Record<string,unknown>},evidence_hash:r.evidence_hash,resolved_by:'9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d',at:NOW,cutoff:NOW});

  expect(factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(p),o)).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:1000,unit:'USD',label_available_at:'2025-10-30T23:59:59.999Z',
   evidence:{chosen_digest:digest(cands[0]),cutoff:'2026-03-01',override:{reason_code:'settlement_ambiguous_fact',evidence_hash:r.evidence_hash}}});
  const codeOf=(f:()=>unknown)=>{try{f();}catch(e){return (e as {code?:string}).code;}return 'no_throw';};
  // P1-06: the stored value is never trusted. The injected '1001' row is not what deriveMetrics yields from its frozen rows.
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(p),asOverride(cands[1])))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(p),asOverride({...cands[0],realized_value:1001})))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(p),asOverride({...cands[0],derivation:{...cands[0].derivation,rows:[]}})))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(p),{...o,resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:'x',evidence:{}}}))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(p),{...o,resolution:{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:{value_text:'1'}}}))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  // yoy: a prior candidate settles from its own frozen operand + the frozen current counterpart; tampering the counterpart is caught.
  const py=params({compare:'yoy'});
  const ry=await factMetricResolver.resolve(ctxOf(py,edited(derive,ms=>[...ms,{...ms.find(m=>isQ(m,'2024-09-30'))!,value:'801'}])));
  if(ry.status!=='inconsistent')throw new Error(ry.status);
  const pc=(ry.detail.candidates as FactCandidate[])[0];
  expect(factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(py),asOverride(pc))).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:0.25,unit:'ratio'});
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(py),asOverride({...pc,counterpart:{...pc.counterpart!,value_text:'1100'}})))).toBe('override_mismatch');
  expect(codeOf(()=>factMetricResolver.fromOverride(judgmentOf(py),asOverride({...pc,counterpart:null})))).toBe('override_mismatch');
 });
 it('derivationRowOf keeps exactly the kernel-read fields (drops value, run_id, source_concept, statement, mapping_version, raw_hash)',async()=>{
  const {facts,issuer}=await setup();
  const env=await facts.readFacts(issuer,'US',{concepts:['revenue'],asOf:'2026-03-02',history:true});
  const d=derivationRowOf(env.rows[0]);
  for(const k of ['value','run_id','source_concept','statement','mapping_version','raw_hash'])expect(k in d).toBe(false);
  expect(d).toMatchObject({fact_id:env.rows[0].fact_id,value_text:env.rows[0].value_text,disclosure_seq:1,is_current:true,is_revision:false});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/facts.ts
// fact_metric resolver (spec §7.3 row 2, §7.6 S04, §12.2). The realised value is derived AT THE CUTOFF through
// JudgmentInputsDb.deriveMetricsAsOf (anon readFacts history → deriveMetrics; never the materialised
// financial_metrics cache, audit G13 / S05) and matched on the FULL natural key (metric, period_start, period_end,
// duration, unit, input_unit, basis, formula_version). compare='value' → Number(value); compare='yoy' →
// (current − prior) / |prior|, prior = the same series ending 350–380 days earlier (the derive kernel's YoY window).
// Not visible at the cutoff → Pending(not_reported); truncated read → Unavailable(truncated) (incomplete data is
// never used); several rows for one key → Inconsistent(ambiguous_fact): each candidate carries key, value_text,
// the realised value it would settle, its lineage and the §3.5 derivation envelope (rows of the lineage concepts
// with period_end in [period_start − 400 d, period_end], every kernel-read field, sorted), so a choose_fact
// verdict settles from the chosen candidate alone (no reads). label_available_at = end of the UTC day of the
// latest input available_date. Every operand used (ordinary settlements, candidates, BOTH yoy sides) is frozen in
// the §3.5 financial_metric snapshot shape (FactOperand: key, value_text, lineage, derivation rows) and
// fromOverride re-derives each operand from its frozen rows before trusting a candidate (plan audit P1-06).
// Cutoff availability (P1-07): facts are available at endOfUtcDay(available_date), so the derive date is the latest
// UTC date that has fully elapsed by the cutoff (factsAsOfDate).
import {deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {MetricRow,ReadFactsResult} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {canonicalize,digest} from '../canonical';
import {JudgmentError} from '../errors';
import {derivationRowsFor,factRowOfDerivation} from '../inputs';
import {addDaysIso,endOfUtcDay} from '../time';
import type {DeriveAsOfResult,DerivationRow,FactMetricParams,JudgmentRow,MetricKey,QuarantineOverride,Resolver,ResolverResult,ResolveContext,Target} from '../types';
import {isRealDate,validateFactMetricParams} from './schemas';
// The FactRow → DerivationRow projection and the §3.5 envelope selection have ONE implementation, in
// inputs.ts (Task 8); the resolver re-exports it so settlement evidence and registered snapshots agree.
export {derivationRowOf} from '../inputs';

export const FACT_RESOLVER_VERSION='fact_metric/1';
export const FACT_MAX_FETCH_MS=10_000;
export const DERIVATION_LOOKBACK_DAYS=400;
const YOY_MIN_DAYS=350,YOY_MAX_DAYS=380,DAY_MS=86_400_000;
/** One operand of a fact settlement in the §3.5 financial_metric snapshot shape (P1-06). */
export interface FactOperand{role:'current'|'prior';key:MetricKey&{duration:string;unit:string};value_text:string;lineage:MetricRow['inputs'];derivation:{formula_version:string;as_of:string;state_rev:number;rows:DerivationRow[]}}
/** An ambiguous_fact candidate: the ambiguous operand itself + the realised value it would settle + (yoy) the other operand. */
export interface FactCandidate extends FactOperand{realized_value:number;label_available_at:string;counterpart:FactOperand|null}
/** Structural key shared by MetricRow and FactOperand['key'] (string-typed so a frozen key compares like a live row). */
type SeriesKey={issuer_id:string;market:string;metric:string;period_start:string;period_end:string;duration:string;unit:string;input_unit:string;basis:string;formula_version:string};

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const uniq=(xs:string[])=>[...new Set(xs)].sort(cmp);
const days=(from:string,to:string)=>Math.round((Date.parse(`${to}T00:00:00Z`)-Date.parse(`${from}T00:00:00Z`))/DAY_MS);
const unavailable=(failure:string):ResolverResult=>({status:'unavailable',failure});
const validate=(p:unknown):p is FactMetricParams=>validateFactMetricParams(p)&&isRealDate(p.period_start)&&isRealDate(p.period_end);

/** The §3.5 derivation envelope of one metric row: lineage concepts, period_end in [period_start − 400 d, period_end], all disclosures. */
export function derivationOf(env:ReadFactsResult,m:MetricRow,asOf:string):FactOperand['derivation']{
 const rows:DerivationRow[]=derivationRowsFor(env.rows,m);   // lineage concepts, period_end in [period_start − DERIVATION_LOOKBACK_DAYS, period_end], sorted
 return {formula_version:m.formula_version,as_of:asOf,state_rev:env.stateRev,rows};
}
/** Latest UTC date d with endOfUtcDay(d) ≤ cutoff: a fact available "today" is not eligible before the day ends (P1-07). */
export function factsAsOfDate(cutoff:string):string{
 const d=cutoff.slice(0,10);
 return endOfUtcDay(d)<=cutoff?d:addDaysIso(d,-1);
}
const keyOf=(m:MetricRow):FactOperand['key']=>({issuer_id:m.issuer_id,market:m.market,metric:m.metric,period_start:m.period_start,period_end:m.period_end,duration:m.duration,unit:m.unit,input_unit:m.input_unit,basis:m.basis,formula_version:m.formula_version});
const sameSeries=(m:SeriesKey,p:FactMetricParams)=>m.issuer_id===p.issuer_id&&m.market===p.market&&m.metric===p.metric&&m.duration===p.duration&&m.unit===p.unit&&m.input_unit===p.input_unit&&m.basis===p.basis&&m.formula_version===p.formula_version;
const isCurrent=(m:SeriesKey,p:FactMetricParams)=>sameSeries(m,p)&&m.period_start===p.period_start&&m.period_end===p.period_end;
const isPrior=(m:SeriesKey,p:FactMetricParams)=>{if(!sameSeries(m,p))return false;const d=days(m.period_end,p.period_end);return d>=YOY_MIN_DAYS&&d<=YOY_MAX_DAYS;};
const sameKey=(a:SeriesKey,b:SeriesKey)=>a.issuer_id===b.issuer_id&&a.market===b.market&&a.metric===b.metric&&a.period_start===b.period_start&&a.period_end===b.period_end&&a.duration===b.duration&&a.unit===b.unit&&a.input_unit===b.input_unit&&a.basis===b.basis&&a.formula_version===b.formula_version;
const labelOfLineage=(ls:MetricRow['inputs'][],floor:string)=>endOfUtcDay(ls.flat().map(i=>i.available_date).reduce((a,b)=>b>a?b:a,floor));
const labelOf=(ms:MetricRow[])=>labelOfLineage(ms.map(m=>m.inputs),ms[0].period_end);
const yoyOf=(cur:string,prior:string)=>(Number(cur)-Number(prior))/Math.abs(Number(prior));
const yoy=(c:MetricRow,pr:MetricRow)=>yoyOf(c.value,pr.value);
/** The operand of one metric row, frozen in the §3.5 financial_metric snapshot shape. */
export function operandOf(env:ReadFactsResult,m:MetricRow,role:FactOperand['role'],asOf:string):FactOperand{
 return {role,key:keyOf(m),value_text:m.value,lineage:m.inputs,derivation:derivationOf(env,m,asOf)};
}
/** Independent replay of one operand: deriveMetrics over its frozen rows at its frozen as_of / state_rev must yield a row
 *  with the same full key, the same value_text and the same lineage (the derive kernel, never the stored value). */
export function operandReproduces(op:FactOperand):boolean{
 const d=op.derivation;
 if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.rows)||typeof d.as_of!=='string'||d.formula_version!==op.key.formula_version)return false;
 let again:MetricRow[];
 try{again=deriveMetrics(d.rows.map(factRowOfDerivation),{market:op.key.market,asOf:d.as_of,basedOnRev:d.state_rev});}catch{return false;}
 return again.some(m=>sameKey(m,op.key)&&m.value===op.value_text&&canonicalize(m.inputs)===canonicalize(op.lineage));
}

export const factMetricResolver:Resolver={
 name:'fact_metric',version:FACT_RESOLVER_VERSION,maxFetchMs:FACT_MAX_FETCH_MS,
 validateParams:validate,
 /** Earliest instant the label can exist: the end of the period's last day (spec §3.4 rule 3; filings come later). */
 labelAvailableAt:(params:unknown,_target:Target)=>validate(params)?endOfUtcDay(params.period_end):null,
 async resolve(ctx:ResolveContext):Promise<ResolverResult>{
  const c=ctx.judgment.condition;
  if(!c||c.resolver!=='fact_metric'||!validate(c.params))return unavailable('invalid_condition');
  const p=c.params,asOf=factsAsOfDate(ctx.cutoff);
  let res:DeriveAsOfResult;
  try{res=await ctx.inputsDb.deriveMetricsAsOf(p.issuer_id,p.market,asOf,p.formula_version);}
  catch(e){
   const code=(e as {code?:unknown}).code;
   if(code==='read_truncated')return unavailable('truncated');
   if(code==='unsupported_formula_version')return unavailable('unsupported_formula_version');
   throw e;
  }
  const env=res.envelope;
  if(env.truncated)return unavailable('truncated');
  const cur=res.metrics.filter(m=>isCurrent(m,p));
  if(cur.length===0)return {status:'pending',reason:'not_reported'};
  const ambiguous=(list:MetricRow[],role:FactCandidate['role'],realized:(m:MetricRow)=>number,counterpart:MetricRow|null):ResolverResult=>{
   const other=counterpart?operandOf(env,counterpart,role==='current'?'prior':'current',asOf):null;
   const candidates:FactCandidate[]=list.map(m=>({...operandOf(env,m,role,asOf),realized_value:realized(m),label_available_at:labelOf(counterpart?[m,counterpart]:[m]),counterpart:other}));
   const evidence={role,candidate_digests:candidates.map(x=>digest(x)),state_rev:env.stateRev,cutoff:ctx.cutoff,as_of:asOf,formula_version:p.formula_version,compare:p.compare};
   return {status:'inconsistent',reason_code:'settlement_ambiguous_fact',detail:{candidates},evidence,evidence_hash:digest(evidence)};
  };
  const resolved=(used:MetricRow[],value:number):ResolverResult=>{
   const lineage=used.flatMap(m=>m.inputs),ids=new Set(lineage.map(i=>i.fact_id));
   const mappingGen=[...new Set(env.rows.filter(r=>ids.has(r.fact_id)).map(r=>r.mapping_gen))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
   // Every operand frozen with its full derivation (P1-06); one that its own frozen rows cannot reproduce is not settled on.
   const operands=used.map((m,i)=>operandOf(env,m,i===0?'current':'prior',asOf));
   if(!operands.every(operandReproduces))return unavailable('metric_not_reproducible');
   return {status:'resolved',value,unit:p.compare==='yoy'?'ratio':p.unit,from:p.period_start,to:p.period_end,label_available_at:labelOf(used),
    evidence:{metric_keys:used.map(keyOf),fact_ids:[...ids].sort(cmp),filing_ids:uniq(lineage.map(i=>i.filing_id)),available_dates:uniq(lineage.map(i=>i.available_date)),
     value_texts:used.map(m=>m.value),mapping_gen:mappingGen,state_rev:env.stateRev,cutoff:ctx.cutoff,as_of:asOf,formula_version:p.formula_version,compare:p.compare,operands}};
  };
  if(p.compare==='value')return cur.length>1?ambiguous(cur,'current',m=>Number(m.value),null):resolved(cur,Number(cur[0].value));
  const prior=res.metrics.filter(m=>isPrior(m,p));
  if(prior.length===0)return unavailable('prior_missing');
  if(cur.length>1&&prior.length>1)return unavailable('ambiguous_both');
  if(prior.some(m=>Number(m.value)===0))return unavailable('prior_zero');
  if(cur.length>1)return ambiguous(cur,'current',m=>yoy(m,prior[0]),prior[0]);
  if(prior.length>1)return ambiguous(prior,'prior',m=>yoy(cur[0],m),cur[0]);
  return resolved([cur[0],prior[0]],yoy(cur[0],prior[0]));
 },
 fromOverride(j:JudgmentRow,o:QuarantineOverride):ResolverResult{
  const c=j.condition;
  if(!c||c.resolver!=='fact_metric'||o.reason_code!=='settlement_ambiguous_fact'||o.resolution.kind!=='choose_fact')
   throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch',`fact_metric cannot apply ${o.resolution.kind} for ${o.reason_code}`);
  const ch=o.resolution.chosen as Partial<FactCandidate>;
  const isOperand=<T extends Partial<FactOperand>>(x:T|null|undefined):x is T&FactOperand=>!!x&&(x.role==='current'||x.role==='prior')&&!!x.key&&typeof x.key==='object'&&typeof x.value_text==='string'&&Array.isArray(x.lineage)&&!!x.derivation&&Array.isArray(x.derivation.rows);
  if(typeof ch.realized_value!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(ch.realized_value)||typeof ch.label_available_at!=='string'||!isOperand(ch)||(ch.counterpart!==null&&!isOperand(ch.counterpart)))
   throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','chosen_shape');
  const p=c.params;
  // Recompute, never trust: every operand must be reproduced by deriveMetrics from its own frozen rows (P1-06).
  const ops:FactOperand[]=[ch,...(ch.counterpart?[ch.counterpart]:[])];
  if(!ops.every(operandReproduces))throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','derivation_does_not_reproduce');
  const cur=ops.filter(x=>x.role==='current'),pr=ops.filter(x=>x.role==='prior');
  if(cur.length!==1||!isCurrent(cur[0].key,p))throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','current_key');
  let value:number;
  if(p.compare==='value'){if(pr.length!==0)throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','unexpected_counterpart');value=Number(cur[0].value_text);}
  else{
   if(pr.length!==1||!isPrior(pr[0].key,p))throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','prior_key');
   if(Number(pr[0].value_text)===0)throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','prior_zero');
   value=yoyOf(cur[0].value_text,pr[0].value_text);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(value)||value!==ch.realized_value)throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','realized_value');
  const label=labelOfLineage(ops.map(x=>x.lineage),ch.key.period_end);   // same floor as labelOf([chosen, counterpart])
  if(label!==ch.label_available_at)throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch','label_available_at');
  return {status:'resolved',value,unit:p.compare==='yoy'?'ratio':p.unit,from:p.period_start,to:p.period_end,label_available_at:label,
   evidence:{chosen:ch,chosen_digest:digest(ch),operands:ops,cutoff:ch.derivation.as_of,formula_version:p.formula_version,compare:p.compare,
    override:{reason_code:o.reason_code,evidence_hash:o.evidence_hash,resolved_by:o.resolved_by,at:o.at,cutoff:o.cutoff}}};
 },
};
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro.test.ts
// F4 Task 11 (spec §7.3 row 3, §11.1, §14.1 macro bullets): classifyAsOf at the cutoff; same vintage vs revised
// argmax (hit/miss is decided by settle's predicate on the returned class); coverage < 0.6, catalog drift,
// post-cutoff vintages, and the production MacroUnavailable path.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {unavailableMacroReadApi} from '../macro-api';
import {conditionJudgment,stubInputsDb} from '../testing/fixtures';
import type {MacroObservationRef,MacroReadApi,Regime,RegimeResult,ResolveContext} from '../types';
import {macroRegimeReplayResolver as resolver} from './macro';

const P={region:'US' as const,reference_period:'2026-06',macro_methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'catalog/1'};
const CUTOFF='2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z';
const regime=(primary:Regime,coverage=0.8):RegimeResult=>({primary_state:primary,secondary_state:'overheat',scores:{recovery:2,overheat:1,stagflation:0,recession:0},norm:{recovery:0.6,overheat:0.3,stagflation:0.05,recession:0.05},coverage,margin_pp:30,growth_axis:0.5,inflation_axis:-0.2});
const OBS:MacroObservationRef[]=[
 {series_id:'US.IP',period_end:'2026-06-30',vintage_id:'v1',value:101.2,unit:'index',available_at:'2026-07-17T13:15:00.000Z'},
 {series_id:'US.CPI',period_end:'2026-06-30',vintage_id:'v2',value:3.1,unit:'pct',available_at:'2026-07-15T12:30:00.000Z'},
];
const CATALOG={version:'catalog/1',weights:{'US.CPI':0.5,'US.IP':0.5},rules_version:'rules/1'};
const judgment=conditionJudgment({resolver:'macro_regime_replay',params:P,predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:'recovery'},text:{zh:'2026-06 处于复苏',en:'2026-06 is recovery'}},{kind:'period',period:'2026-09'},
 {subject_type:'macro_region',subject_key:'US',label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'});
function ctxWith(classifyAsOf:MacroReadApi['classifyAsOf'],macro?:MacroReadApi):ResolveContext{
 const base=stubInputsDb().macro;
 return {judgment,cutoff:CUTOFF,now:CUTOFF,inputsDb:stubInputsDb({macro:macro??{...base,classifyAsOf}}),signal:new AbortController().signal};
}

describe('macro_regime_replay resolver',()=>{

  const calls:unknown[][]=[];

  expect(calls).toEqual([['US','2026-06',CUTOFF,'v1.0']]);
  expect(r).toEqual({status:'resolved',value:'recovery',label:'recovery',unit:null,from:'2026-06-01',to:'2026-06-30',label_available_at:'2026-07-17T13:15:00.000Z',
   evidence:{observation_refs:[OBS[1],OBS[0]],catalog:CATALOG,regime_result:regime('recovery'),cutoff:CUTOFF,reference_period:'2026-06',macro_methodology_version:'v1.0'}});
 });

  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:'stagflation'});
 });

   expect(await resolver.resolve(ctxWith(async()=>out))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'coverage'});

  expect(await resolver.resolve(ctxWith(async()=>{throw new Error('unused');},unavailableMacroReadApi()))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'macro_unavailable'});
  await expect(resolver.resolve(ctxWith(async()=>{throw new Error('socket hang up');}))).rejects.toThrow('socket hang up');

  try{resolver.fromOverride(judgment,{reason_code:'settlement_ambiguous_fact',resolution:{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:{}},evidence_hash:'x',resolved_by:'a',at:CUTOFF,cutoff:CUTOFF});}catch(e){code=(e as {code?:string}).code;}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro.ts
// macro_regime_replay resolver (spec §7.3 row 3, §11.1). The label is the SAME macro classification function
// (macro regime.ts: same rules version, same catalog weights, same argmax) re-run for reference_period on the latest
// vintages with available_at ≤ cutoff, via MacroReadApi.classifyAsOf; settle passes cutoff = settle_by
// (label_policy cutoff_vintage). coverage < 0.6, no regime or no observations → Unavailable(coverage) (the macro
// spec's own rule; void at settle_by); catalog version other than the frozen one → Unavailable(catalog_version_mismatch);
// an observation newer than the cutoff (API contract breach) → Unavailable(vintage_after_cutoff); the macro module not
// landed yet (MacroUnavailable from unavailableMacroReadApi, production until WP-M3) → Unavailable(macro_unavailable).
// label_available_at = max available_at of the observations used. No inconsistency kinds exist here, so no override.
import {JudgmentError} from '../errors';
import {MacroUnavailable} from '../macro-api';
import {addDaysIso,monthEndIso} from '../time';
import type {JudgmentRow,MacroReadApi,QuarantineOverride,Resolver,ResolverResult,ResolveContext,Target} from '../types';
import {validateMacroRegimeReplayParams} from './schemas';

export const MACRO_RESOLVER_VERSION='macro_regime_replay/1';
export const MACRO_MAX_FETCH_MS=10_000;
export const MACRO_MIN_COVERAGE=0.6;
const unavailable=(failure:string):ResolverResult=>({status:'unavailable',failure});
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
type Classified=Awaited<ReturnType<MacroReadApi['classifyAsOf']>>;

export const macroRegimeReplayResolver:Resolver={
 name:'macro_regime_replay',version:MACRO_RESOLVER_VERSION,maxFetchMs:MACRO_MAX_FETCH_MS,
 validateParams:(p:unknown)=>validateMacroRegimeReplayParams(p),
 /** The label exists once the target month is over (spec §3.4 rule 3). */
 labelAvailableAt:(params:unknown,target:Target)=>validateMacroRegimeReplayParams(params)&&target.kind==='period'?`${addDaysIso(monthEndIso(target.period),1)}T00:00:00.000Z`:null,
 async resolve(ctx:ResolveContext):Promise<ResolverResult>{
  const c=ctx.judgment.condition;
  if(!c||c.resolver!=='macro_regime_replay'||!validateMacroRegimeReplayParams(c.params))return unavailable('invalid_condition');
  const p=c.params;
  let r:Classified;
  try{r=await ctx.inputsDb.macro.classifyAsOf(p.region,p.reference_period,ctx.cutoff,p.macro_methodology_version);}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof MacroUnavailable)return unavailable('macro_unavailable');throw e;}
  if(r.catalog.version!==p.catalog_version)return unavailable('catalog_version_mismatch');
  if(!r.regime||r.regime.coverage<MACRO_MIN_COVERAGE||r.observation_refs.length===0)return unavailable('coverage');
  if(r.observation_refs.some(o=>o.available_at>ctx.cutoff))return unavailable('vintage_after_cutoff');
  const refs=[...r.observation_refs].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.series_id,b.series_id)||cmp(a.period_end,b.period_end))
   .map(o=>({series_id:o.series_id,period_end:o.period_end,vintage_id:o.vintage_id,value:o.value,unit:o.unit,available_at:o.available_at}));
  const label=refs.reduce((m,o)=>o.available_at>m?o.available_at:m,refs[0].available_at);
  return {status:'resolved',value:r.regime.primary_state,label:r.regime.primary_state,unit:null,from:`${p.reference_period}-01`,to:monthEndIso(p.reference_period),label_available_at:label,
   evidence:{observation_refs:refs,catalog:r.catalog,regime_result:r.regime,cutoff:ctx.cutoff,reference_period:p.reference_period,macro_methodology_version:p.macro_methodology_version}};
 },
 fromOverride(j:JudgmentRow,o:QuarantineOverride):ResolverResult{
  throw new JudgmentError('override_mismatch',`macro_regime_replay has no quarantine verdicts (${o.reason_code} on ${j.judgment_id})`);
 },
};
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/index.ts
// The v1 resolver table (spec §7.3). resolverFor() is the single lookup used by settle, registration and the
// quarantine hook: recommendation_hit belongs to the private adapter (never public settlements, §11.2) and
// industry_aggregate is defined by the industry spec (not in v1); both, and unknown names, are invalid_condition.
// MAX_FETCH_MS feeds the settle cron's per-batch worst case (spec §7.1).
import {JudgmentError} from '../errors';
import type {Resolver} from '../types';
import {factMetricResolver} from './facts';
import {macroRegimeReplayResolver} from './macro';
import {priceReturnResolver} from './price';

export const RESOLVERS={price_return:priceReturnResolver,fact_metric:factMetricResolver,macro_regime_replay:macroRegimeReplayResolver} as const;
export type ImplementedResolver=keyof typeof RESOLVERS;
export const MAX_FETCH_MS=Math.max(...Object.values(RESOLVERS).map(r=>r.maxFetchMs));
export function resolverFor(name:string):Resolver{
 if(name==='recommendation_hit')throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition','resolver_not_public:recommendation_hit');
 const r=(RESOLVERS as Record<string,Resolver|undefined>)[name];
 if(!r)throw new JudgmentError('invalid_condition',`resolver_unavailable:${name}`);
 return r;
}
```


规格偏差（记入实施记录）：
- **`planOf` 与 `cutoff_vintage`**（规格第 7 稿 §7.2，计划审计 P1-03）：`cutoff_vintage` 在 `now < settle_by` 时**不调用 resolver**（也不用 override），直接 `defer` 到 `settle_by`；之后 `cutoff = settle_by`，队列 override 只在 `override.cutoff = settle_by` 时使用，否则丢弃并重新解析一次（重新解析仍不一致且已过 `settle_by` → `void(unresolved_inconsistency)`，不再开新的复核窗口）。override 只匹配它被接受时的那次不一致（`reason_code` 与 `evidence_hash` 都相同，P1-04）。**已知后果（交 owner）**：`cutoff_vintage` 的解析只在 `settle_by` 当时及之后发生，于是它的 `Inconsistent` 在下一次运行（`now > settle_by`）就会 `void(unresolved_inconsistency)`，管理员几乎没有复核窗口；v1 唯一的 `cutoff_vintage` resolver（`macro_regime_replay`）不返回 `Inconsistent`，所以 v1 不受影响；将来把 `cutoff_vintage` 与会返回 `Inconsistent` 的 resolver 组合的方法，需要在规格里另定复核窗口。
- **截止可得性**（计划审计 P1-07）：`Resolved` 还要求 `label_available_at ≤ cutoff`；否则 `defer(label_after_cutoff)`，按 `pending` 公式退避到标签时刻（`first_observed` 的 `cutoff = now`；`cutoff_vintage` 的 `cutoff = settle_by` 已被"晚于 `settle_by` → `void(no_data:late)`"覆盖）。
- **隔离发布 = 一次 `quarantineSettlement`**（计划审计 P1-04 → Q1-02）：不再 `quarantine()` + 刷新 payload + `releaseLease` 三次写；Task 3 的 `quarantine_settlement` 在一个事务里锁队列、校验租约、按 `quarantine()` 语义复用 / 新建 open 项并把 payload 刷新为本次不一致（含 `cutoff`）、发布队列状态。过期 worker 在替代者之后刷新 → `lease_lost`（计 `deferred`，什么都不写）；两次写之间崩溃的窗口不存在。`settle.ts` 不再 import `quarantine()`，也不直接写 `dq_quarantine`。
- **复核期从第一次隔离起算**（计划审计 Q1-01，指挥决策）：队列已是 `inconsistent` 时再次隔离（同一或不同证据）保留 `last_detail.quarantined_at`；只有 override 结算、拒绝作废或 `reopened` 清掉状态后才开始新事件。`reviewDeadline = max(settle_by, quarantined_at + 7 天)`，到期判定含边界（`now >= deadline`），`inconsistent` 退避 `min(deadline, now + 7 天)` 恰好落在截止、绝不晚于它。
- **退避不越过 `settle_by`**：`pending / unavailable / error` 的 §5.4 公式结果若晚于 `settle_by`（且 `settle_by` 仍在将来），夹紧到 `settle_by`，使 `cutoff_vintage` 的截止重取与 `void(no_data)` 准时发生；`inconsistent` 本来就是 `min(settle_by, now + 7 天)`。任何结果最后再 `max(·, now)`（"不设成过去的时刻"）。`unavailable` 的 `attempts` 取本次之后的值（第一次失败退 1 天）。
- **resolver 抛错**：队列 `last_status='error'`、`attempts + 1`、按 `unavailable` 公式退避；计 `failed`，`errors` 加非信息码 `resolver_failed`（全部抛错 → 批次 `failed`，连续两次 → `dq_freshness` `error`，验收样例 6）。
- **`lease_lost` 计入 `deferred`**：该条由别的 worker 持有、会被它处理，计数器需要一个"有去向"的格子（`accounted()` 计 `deferred`），否则全是 `lease_lost` 的运行会被判 `unaccounted`；信息码 `lease_lost` 带 `key`。
- **立即作废的 `reason`** 用失败码本身（`adjustment_unsupported` / `delisted`，与 O6 的 `void(adjustment_unsupported)` 一致）；超期作废用 `no_data:<failure 或 pending reason>`；迟到用 `no_data:late`。
- **同一运行内不重复处理**：被 RPC 抬到 `now()` 的行可能在同一运行的下一次 `claimDue` 里再出现；已处理过的行原样释放并结束领取循环（下一次 cron 再处理，例如 `settle_by` 已过的 `inconsistent` 行 → `unresolved_inconsistency`）。
- **补偿扫描预算**：步骤 0 自身最多用 `start + 60 s`（`COMPENSATION_BUDGET_MS`），之后让给结算；超时记信息码 `deadline_hit`，marker 停在最后完成的快照。补偿的 `produce` 计数进它自己的批次（`judgments.produce.macro_regime`），只有信息码（`macro_unavailable` / `job_state_conflict` / `deadline_hit`）并入结算回执。
- **admin "立即结算一条"（规格 §9.5，Task 18 的 `POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/settle`）= `settleNow`**（集成者补充）：不领取租约；队列行被 cron 租着 → `leased`、已关闭 / 弃权 → `closed`，都不写；否则跑同一 resolver 与 `decide()`：`append` 决定以 `actor='admin:<uuid>'`、租约 `null`（`append_settlement` 只允许 admin 无租约）、调用方给的 `request_key` 追加，记在自己的 `triggered_by='manual'` 的 `judgments.settle` 批次里；`defer` / `quarantine` 决定什么都不写（返回 `deferred` / `quarantine_pending`，cron 按时处理），因为它们改队列需要租约。
- **`preview=1`**：不修批次、不跑补偿、不领取（领取会写租约），改读 `queueList({filter:'due', limit:20})` 并对每条跑 resolver（只读外部取数）与 `decide()`，回执 `status='preview'`、`batchId=null`，无 `recordAttempt`。
