```ts
// src/lib/judgments/compensate.ts
// Settle cron step 0 (spec §7.1, audits F28/G25/N2): the macro producer's compensation scan. The marker
// judgment_job_state[jobKey('produce','macro_regime','v1')] = {marker_created_at, marker_snapshot_id} names the last
// macro snapshot handled; MacroReadApi.snapshotsSince(marker, 200) lists the later ones in (created_at, snapshot_id)
// order. A non-failed snapshot without a judgment (GIN inputs containment, abstentions included) is produced with
// binding {snapshot_id}; the marker advances after every finished snapshot (produced, already present, or failed
// upstream) through set_job_state's optimistic lock. A produce failure stops the scan WITHOUT advancing (the next
// cron starts from that snapshot); a lost CAS → info job_state_conflict, stop; the macro module not landed
// (MacroUnavailable) → skipped with info macro_unavailable; macro_regime@v1 not in REGISTRY yet → skipped silently.
// produce counts go to the produce batch (dataset judgments.produce.macro_regime); only info codes reach the
// settle receipt. Budget: deadlineAt (default start + 60 s) and the run signal.
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {jobKey} from './job-keys';
import {MacroUnavailable} from './macro-api';
import {produce as defaultProduce} from './produce';
import type {ProduceDeps,ProduceResult} from './produce';
import type {ResolverLookup} from './register';
import {REGISTRY} from './registry';
import {resolverFor} from './resolvers';
import type {JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentsDb,MacroSnapshotRow,Methodology,WorkItem} from './types';

export const MACRO_METHOD={id:'macro_regime',version:'v1'} as const;
export const SNAPSHOT_PAGE=200;
export const COMPENSATION_BUDGET_MS=60_000;
/** Same shape as Task 10 produce(m, work, deps) (tests inject a stub). */
export type ProduceFn=(m:Methodology,work:readonly WorkItem[],deps:ProduceDeps)=>Promise<Pick<ProduceResult,'counts'|'errors'>>;
export interface CompensateDeps{db:JudgmentsDb;inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb;tables:TableClient;codeVersion:string;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;signal:AbortSignal;clock?:()=>number;deadlineAt?:number;methodology?:Methodology|null;produce?:ProduceFn;resolverOf?:ResolverLookup}
/** registerJudgment's resolver lookup over the real table (Task 11); unknown / unimplemented → null. */
export const defaultResolverOf:ResolverLookup=name=>{try{return resolverFor(name);}catch{return null;}};
export interface CompensationReport{status:'done'|'skipped'|'stopped';reason:string|null;scanned:number;produced:number;existing:number;skippedFailed:number;stoppedAt:string|null;batchId:string|null;errors:BatchError[]}

function markerOf(s:Record<string,unknown>|undefined):{created_at:string;snapshot_id:string}|null{
 const c=s?.marker_created_at,i=s?.marker_snapshot_id;
 return typeof c==='string'&&typeof i==='string'?{created_at:c,snapshot_id:i}:null;
}
const messageOf=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,500);

export async function compensateMacro(deps:CompensateDeps):Promise<CompensationReport>{
 const report:CompensationReport={status:'done',reason:null,scanned:0,produced:0,existing:0,skippedFailed:0,stoppedAt:null,batchId:null,errors:[]};
 const m=deps.methodology!==undefined?deps.methodology:REGISTRY.find(x=>x.id===MACRO_METHOD.id&&x.version===MACRO_METHOD.version)??null;
 if(!m)return {...report,status:'skipped',reason:'methodology_missing'};
 const key=jobKey('produce',m.id,m.version);
 const clock=deps.clock??Date.now,deadlineAt=deps.deadlineAt??clock()+COMPENSATION_BUDGET_MS;
 let state=await deps.db.jobState(key);
 let snaps:MacroSnapshotRow[];
 try{snaps=await deps.inputsDb.macro.snapshotsSince(markerOf(state?.state),SNAPSHOT_PAGE);}
 catch(e){
  if(e instanceof MacroUnavailable)return {...report,status:'skipped',reason:'macro_unavailable',errors:[{code:'macro_unavailable',message:'macro read API unavailable; compensation scan skipped'}]};
  throw e;
 }
 const run=deps.produce??(defaultProduce as ProduceFn);
 const counts=emptyCounts(),produceErrors:BatchError[]=[];
 const stop=(reason:string,at:string)=>{report.status='stopped';report.reason=reason;report.stoppedAt=at;};
 try{
  for(const s of snaps){
   if(deps.signal.aborted||clock()>=deadlineAt){stop('deadline',s.snapshot_id);report.errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',key:s.snapshot_id,message:'compensation scan stopped at its budget'});break;}
   report.scanned++;
   if(s.status==='failed')report.skippedFailed++;
   else if((await deps.db.judgmentsBySnapshot(s.snapshot_id)).length>0)report.existing++;
   else{
    if(!report.batchId)report.batchId=(await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:`judgments.produce.${m.id}`,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:deps.triggeredBy})).batchId;
    let ok=false;
    try{
     const r=await run(m,[{subject:{type:'macro_region',key:s.region},asOf:s.as_of,binding:{snapshot_id:s.snapshot_id}}],{db:deps.db,inputsDb:deps.inputsDb,tables:deps.tables,resolverOf:deps.resolverOf??defaultResolverOf,batchId:report.batchId,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,signal:deps.signal,actor:'cron'});
     for(const k of Object.keys(counts) as (keyof BatchCounts)[])counts[k]+=r.counts[k]??0;
     produceErrors.push(...r.errors);
     // D1: a duplicate is done too — an abstention whose binding snapshot could not be built has inputs = [] and is
     // invisible to judgmentsBySnapshot, so every later scan re-produces it and gets `duplicate`; the marker advances.
     ok=r.counts.failed===0&&r.counts.quarantined===0&&r.counts.inserted+r.counts.duplicates>0;
    }catch(e){counts.failed++;produceErrors.push({code:'produce_failed',key:s.snapshot_id,message:messageOf(e)});}
    if(!ok){stop('produce_failed',s.snapshot_id);break;}
    report.produced++;
   }
   if(!(await deps.db.setJobState(key,state?.updated_at??null,{marker_created_at:s.created_at,marker_snapshot_id:s.snapshot_id}))){
    stop('job_state_conflict',s.snapshot_id);report.errors.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key});break;
   }
   state=await deps.db.jobState(key);
  }
 }finally{
  if(report.batchId)await finishBatch(deps.tables,report.batchId,{counts,errors:produceErrors});
 }
 return report;
}
```

```ts
 it('a quarantine is ONE quarantineSettlement call under the claimed lease — settle.ts writes no item and no separate release; lease_lost there is deferred (Q1-02)',async()=>{
  const h=await harness();const id=await h.register();

  expect(typeof token).toBe('string');

 it('an inconsistency quarantined past settle_by keeps a 7-day review window from its FIRST quarantine: repeats inside the window keep the deadline, the backoff lands on it, and the void happens exactly at it (Q1-01)',async()=>{
  const h=await harness();const id=await h.register();
  h.db.setNow(AFTER);                                   // first resolution happens past settle_by (e.g. cutoff_vintage)
  await runSettle(h.deps(stubResolver(scripted(INC))));
  expect(await h.settlements(id)).toEqual([]);          // quarantined, not voided

  const q1=(await h.queue(id))!;
  expect(q1).toMatchObject({last_status:'inconsistent',next_attempt_at:deadline,last_detail:{quarantined_at:AFTER}});
  expect(reviewDeadline(q1)).toBe(deadline);
  // Repeats inside the window — identical evidence or another inconsistency — keep quarantined_at and the deadline.
  const j=(await h.db.getJudgment(id))!;const meta={name:'price_return' as const,version:'stub/1'};
  const day6=at(AFTER,6*DAY_MS);
  for(const r of [INC,{...INC,evidence:{bars:[9]},evidence_hash:'d'.repeat(64)} as ResolverResult]){
   const d=decide({judgment:j,queue:q1,resolver:meta,result:r,now:day6,cutoff:day6,viaOverride:false});
   expect(d).toMatchObject({action:'quarantine',patch:{last_detail:{quarantined_at:AFTER,cutoff:day6},next_attempt_at:deadline}});
  }
  // A new incident (the queue left 'inconsistent', e.g. after a reopen) starts a fresh window.
  expect(decide({judgment:j,queue:{...q1,last_status:null,last_detail:{}},resolver:meta,result:INC,now:day6,cutoff:day6,viaOverride:false}))
   .toMatchObject({action:'quarantine',patch:{last_detail:{quarantined_at:day6},next_attempt_at:at(day6,7*DAY_MS)}});
  // The boundary is inclusive: 1 ms before → still reviewable; at the deadline → unresolved.
  const none={viaOverride:false,overrideDiscarded:false};
  expect(isUnresolvedInconsistency(q1,at(deadline,-1),none)).toBe(false);
  expect(isUnresolvedInconsistency(q1,deadline,none)).toBe(true);
  // The cron run scheduled at exactly the deadline voids without reading.
  h.db.setNow(deadline);
  const resolve=scripted(INC);
  await runSettle(h.deps(stubResolver(resolve)));
  expect(resolve).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect((await h.settlements(id))[0]).toMatchObject({kind:'void',reason:'unresolved_inconsistency'});
 });
});

describe('settle mechanics',()=>{
 it('§5.4 backoff formulas: clamped to settle_by, never in the past',()=>{

  expect(backoff('pending',{...x,estimatedAt:'2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(at(T0,DAY_MS));
  expect(backoff('pending',{...x,estimatedAt:null})).toBe(at(T0,(Date.parse(SETTLE_BY)-Date.parse(T0))/2));
  expect(backoff('pending',{...x,estimatedAt:'2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(SETTLE_BY);
  for(const [n,d] of [[1,1],[3,3],[7,7],[9,7]])expect(backoff('unavailable',{...x,attempts:n,settleBy:'2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(at(T0,d*DAY_MS));
  expect(backoff('error',{...x,attempts:2,settleBy:'2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(at(T0,2*DAY_MS));

  expect(backoff('inconsistent',{...x,settleBy:at(T0,2*DAY_MS)})).toBe(at(T0,2*DAY_MS));
  expect(backoff('inconsistent',{...x,settleBy:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(T0);
  expect(backoff('unavailable',{...x,settleBy:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'})).toBe(at(T0,DAY_MS));
 });
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 实现 `settle.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/settle.ts
// Settlement cron core (spec §7.1, §7.2, §5.4, §7.5). runSettle: repair_stale_batches('judgments.settle', 15 min)
// → step 0 compensation (compensateMacro; its info codes join this receipt) → startBatch(judgments.settle) → claim
// batches of 20 (600 s lease) while the budget allows: stop at start + 200 s, or when the remaining budget is under
// the batch worst case (ceil(20 / 4) × max resolver maxFetchMs) + 30 s, or once the run signal fired → each batch
// sorted by resolver and settled ≤ 4 at a time → finishBatch → recordAttempt('judgments.settle', daily). One
// AbortSignal (external abort ∪ the 280 s deadline) reaches every resolver / provider call.
// settleOne applies the §7.2 state machine through the pure decide(): exactly one of settle / void (append_settlement
// under the lease token, request_key `<batch_id>:<judgment_id>:<expected seq>`), defer (release_lease with the §5.4
// backoff, clamped to settle_by and never in the past) or quarantine (ONE lease-checked quarantine_settlement RPC: the
// dq_quarantine item with the full evidence and the inconsistent queue state in one transaction, plan audit Q1-02). A
// queued override matching the queued inconsistency (reason_code + evidence_hash; for cutoff_vintage also override.cutoff
// = settle_by) settles from resolver.fromOverride (no reads); cutoff_vintage rows never resolve before settle_by
// (planOf, P1-03); a row still inconsistent at its review deadline (max(settle_by, first quarantined_at + 7 d),
// inclusive; Q1-01) voids as unresolved_inconsistency. Counters (§7.5): fetched
// claimed, inserted settled, versioned void, duplicates already_final, quarantined, failed resolver errors, deferred
// pending / unavailable / lease_lost. preview=true lists the due queue without claiming and reports the decisions.
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {COMPENSATION_BUDGET_MS,compensateMacro} from './compensate';
import type {CompensateDeps,CompensationReport} from './compensate';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {MAX_FETCH_MS,resolverFor as defaultResolverFor} from './resolvers';
import type {Condition,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentRow,JudgmentsDb,QueuePatch,QueueRow,Realized,Resolver,ResolverResult,SettlementInsert} from './types';

export const SETTLE_DATASET='judgments.settle';
export const PRODUCER='ts-judgments';
export const DEADLINE_MS=280_000,STOP_CLAIM_MS=200_000,TAIL_MS=30_000,BATCH_SIZE=20,CONCURRENCY=4,LEASE_SECONDS=600,STALE_BATCH_SECONDS=900,DAY_MS=86_400_000;
/** Unavailable failures that can never become available: void at once (spec §7.2, O6, §12.4). */
export const IMMEDIATE_VOID:ReadonlySet<string>=new Set(['adjustment_unsupported','delisted']);

export interface SettleDeps{
 db:JudgmentsDb;inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb;tables:TableClient;codeVersion:string;
 actor:'cron'|'script';triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;
 /** Resolver lookup (default resolvers/index resolverFor); tests inject stubs. */
 resolverFor?:(name:string)=>Resolver;
 /** Worst-case fetch time per judgment for the claim budget (default MAX_FETCH_MS over RESOLVERS). */
 maxFetchMs?:number;
 /** Budget clock in ms (default Date.now). */
 clock?:()=>number;
 signal?:AbortSignal;
 /** Step 0 (spec §7.1); default compensateMacro; null skips it. */
 compensate?:((d:CompensateDeps)=>Promise<CompensationReport>)|null;
}
export interface SettleOptions{preview?:boolean;deadlineMs?:number;/** Decision instant override (tests / preview); default db.serverTime() per claimed batch. */now?:string}
export type SettleAction='settled'|'void'|'deferred'|'quarantined'|'duplicate'|'failed'|'lease_lost'|'conflict';
export interface SettleItem{judgment_id:string;action:SettleAction;reason:string|null;seq:number|null}
export interface SettleReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:BatchStatus|'preview';counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];idle:boolean;preview:boolean;
 detail:{repaired:number;batches:number;deadline_hit:boolean;compensation:CompensationReport|null};items:SettleItem[]}

type AppendRow=Pick<SettlementInsert,'kind'|'outcome'|'realized'|'evidence'|'resolver'|'resolver_version'|'reason'>;
export type Decision=
 |{action:'append';row:AppendRow}
 |{action:'defer';patch:QueuePatch;summary:'pending'|'unavailable';reason:string}
 |{action:'quarantine';reasonCode:string;payload:Record<string,unknown>;patch:QueuePatch};
export interface DecideInput{judgment:JudgmentRow;queue:QueueRow;resolver:Pick<Resolver,'name'|'version'>;result:ResolverResult|null;now:string;cutoff:string;viaOverride:boolean;overrideDiscarded?:boolean}
export interface SettlePlan{cutoff:string;early:boolean;viaOverride:boolean;overrideDiscarded:boolean}

/**
 * Which path settles a queue row now (spec §3.4, §7.2, §7.3; plan audit P1-03 / P1-04).
 * cutoff_vintage: the resolver never runs before settle_by (`early` → defer to settle_by, override or not); at or
 * after settle_by the cutoff is settle_by, and an override counts only if it was produced from a quarantine raised
 * by a resolution at that same cutoff (override.cutoff); any other override is discarded and the row re-resolves.
 * first_observed: cutoff = now and a matching override is used as before. An override matches only the queued
 * inconsistency it was accepted for: same reason_code AND same evidence_hash.
 */
export function planOf(q:QueueRow,now:string):SettlePlan{
 const vintage=q.label_policy==='cutoff_vintage';
 const cutoff=vintage?q.settle_by:now;
 const early=vintage&&now<q.settle_by;
 const o=q.override;
 const matches=o!==null&&q.last_status==='inconsistent'&&q.last_detail.reason_code===o.reason_code&&q.last_detail.evidence_hash===o.evidence_hash;
 const sameCutoff=!vintage||(o!==null&&o.cutoff===cutoff);
 return {cutoff,early,viaOverride:!early&&matches&&sameCutoff,overrideDiscarded:!early&&matches&&!sameCutoff};
}

/** §5.4 backoff. pending: now + max(1 d, (estimate − now) / 2); unavailable / error: now + 1 d × min(attempts, 7);
 * inconsistent: min(settle_by, now + 7 d). pending / unavailable / error are clamped to a future settle_by; the
 * result is never before now. */
export function backoff(kind:'pending'|'unavailable'|'inconsistent'|'error',x:{now:string;attempts:number;settleBy:string;estimatedAt?:string|null}):string{
 const now=Date.parse(x.now),by=Date.parse(x.settleBy);
 let t:number;
 if(kind==='pending'){const est=x.estimatedAt?Date.parse(x.estimatedAt):Number.NaN;t=now+Math.max(DAY_MS,((Number.isFinite(est)?est:by)-now)/2);}
 else if(kind==='inconsistent')t=Math.min(by,now+7*DAY_MS);
 else t=now+DAY_MS*Math.min(Math.max(x.attempts,1),7);
 if(kind!=='inconsistent'&&by>now)t=Math.min(t,by);
 return new Date(Math.max(Math.round(t),now)).toISOString();
}
export function predicateHolds(p:Condition['predicate'],v:number|string|boolean):boolean{
 if(p.op==='eq')return v===p.rhs;
 if(typeof v!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(v))return false;
 if(p.op==='between'){const [lo,hi]=p.rhs as [number,number];return v>=lo&&v<=hi;}
 const rhs=p.rhs as number;
 return p.op==='>'?v>rhs:p.op==='>='?v>=rhs:p.op==='<'?v<rhs:v<=rhs;
}
/** Commander decision (plan audit round 1 follow-up): a quarantined inconsistency always gets an admin review window of
 *  REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS after it was quarantined, even when quarantined at or near settle_by (cutoff_vintage resolves only at
 *  settle_by). The settlement cutoff is unchanged; only the void deadline moves. Spec 7th draft §5.4/§7.2.
 *  Plan audit Q1-01: quarantined_at is the FIRST quarantine of the unresolved incident (a repeat while the queue is still
 *  inconsistent keeps it; only an override / reject / reopen clearing the state starts a new incident), so the deadline
 *  cannot move; expiry is inclusive (now >= deadline) and the inconsistent backoff lands exactly on the deadline. */
export const REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS=7;
export function reviewDeadline(q:QueueRow):string{
 const at=typeof q.last_detail.quarantined_at==='string'?Date.parse(q.last_detail.quarantined_at):Number.NaN;
 const win=Number.isFinite(at)?at+REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS*DAY_MS:Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 return new Date(Math.max(Date.parse(q.settle_by),win)).toISOString();
}
/** A row still inconsistent past its review deadline with no usable override voids without a read; a discarded (wrong-cutoff) override re-resolves once instead. */
export const isUnresolvedInconsistency=(q:QueueRow,now:string,plan:Pick<SettlePlan,'viaOverride'|'overrideDiscarded'>)=>!plan.viaOverride&&!plan.overrideDiscarded&&q.last_status==='inconsistent'&&now>=reviewDeadline(q);

/** The §7.2 table as a pure function; result=null when the resolver was not called (cutoff_vintage before settle_by, or
 *  the unresolved-inconsistency row). */
export function decide(x:DecideInput):Decision{
 const {judgment:j,queue:q,result:r,now}=x,settleBy=q.settle_by;
 const meta={resolver:x.resolver.name,resolver_version:x.resolver.version};
 const voided=(reason:string,evidence:Record<string,unknown>):Decision=>({action:'append',row:{kind:'void',outcome:null,realized:null,evidence:{...evidence,observed_at:now},reason,...meta}});
 // P1-03: cutoff_vintage never settles (nor even resolves) before settle_by, whether or not an override is queued.
 if(q.label_policy==='cutoff_vintage'&&now<settleBy)
  return {action:'defer',summary:'pending',reason:'cutoff_vintage',patch:{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{reason:'cutoff_vintage',estimated_at:settleBy},next_attempt_at:settleBy,attempts_increment:0}};
 const plan={viaOverride:x.viaOverride,overrideDiscarded:x.overrideDiscarded===true};
 if(r===null||isUnresolvedInconsistency(q,now,plan))
  return voided('unresolved_inconsistency',{reason_code:q.last_detail.reason_code??null,quarantine_id:q.last_detail.quarantine_id??null,settle_by:settleBy});
 if(r.status==='resolved'){
  if(r.label_available_at>settleBy)return voided('no_data:late',{label_available_at:r.label_available_at,settle_by:settleBy});
  // P1-07: the label must also be available by the observation cutoff (now for first_observed, settle_by for
  // cutoff_vintage): a resolver that returns a later label has not observed it yet.
  if(r.label_available_at>x.cutoff)
   return {action:'defer',summary:'pending',reason:'label_after_cutoff',patch:{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{reason:'label_after_cutoff',estimated_at:r.label_available_at},
    next_attempt_at:backoff('pending',{now,attempts:q.attempts,settleBy,estimatedAt:r.label_available_at}),attempts_increment:0}};
  if(!j.condition)return voided('invalid_condition',{});
  const realized:Realized={value:r.value,...(r.label===undefined?{}:{label:r.label}),unit:r.unit,from:r.from,to:r.to,label_policy:q.label_policy};
  return {action:'append',row:{kind:'settled',outcome:predicateHolds(j.condition.predicate,r.value)?'hit':'miss',realized,
   evidence:{...r.evidence,observed_at:now,cutoff:x.cutoff,label_available_at:r.label_available_at},reason:null,...meta}};
 }
 if(r.status==='pending'){
  if(now>settleBy)return voided(`no_data:${r.reason}`,{pending_reason:r.reason,settle_by:settleBy});
  return {action:'defer',summary:'pending',reason:r.reason,patch:{last_status:'pending',last_detail:{reason:r.reason,...(r.estimated_at?{estimated_at:r.estimated_at}:{})},
   next_attempt_at:backoff('pending',{now,attempts:q.attempts,settleBy,estimatedAt:r.estimated_at??null}),attempts_increment:0}};
 }
 if(r.status==='unavailable'){
  if(IMMEDIATE_VOID.has(r.failure))return voided(r.failure,{failure:r.failure});
  if(now>settleBy)return voided(`no_data:${r.failure}`,{failure:r.failure,settle_by:settleBy});
  return {action:'defer',summary:'unavailable',reason:r.failure,patch:{last_status:'unavailable',last_detail:{failure:r.failure},
   next_attempt_at:backoff('unavailable',{now,attempts:q.attempts+1,settleBy}),attempts_increment:1}};
 }
 // A re-resolution after a discarded (wrong-cutoff) override that is inconsistent again past settle_by gets no new review window.
 if(x.overrideDiscarded===true&&now>=reviewDeadline(q))
  return voided('unresolved_inconsistency',{reason_code:r.reason_code,quarantine_id:q.last_detail.quarantine_id??null,settle_by:settleBy,override_discarded:true});
 // cutoff in the payload and last_detail: an acceptance is bound to the cutoff this evidence was resolved at (P1-03).
 // Q1-01: a repeat inside the unresolved incident keeps the first quarantined_at, so the deadline never moves; the
 // backoff is min(deadline, now + 7 d) — exactly the deadline at the latest.
 const quarantinedAt=q.last_status==='inconsistent'&&typeof q.last_detail.quarantined_at==='string'?q.last_detail.quarantined_at:now;
 const deadline=reviewDeadline({...q,last_detail:{...q.last_detail,quarantined_at:quarantinedAt}});
 return {action:'quarantine',reasonCode:r.reason_code,payload:{...r.detail,evidence:r.evidence,evidence_hash:r.evidence_hash,judgment_id:j.judgment_id,cutoff:x.cutoff},
  patch:{last_status:'inconsistent',last_detail:{reason_code:r.reason_code,evidence_hash:r.evidence_hash,cutoff:x.cutoff,quarantined_at:quarantinedAt},next_attempt_at:backoff('inconsistent',{now,attempts:q.attempts,settleBy:deadline}),attempts_increment:0}};
}

export interface SettleContext{deps:SettleDeps;batchId:string|null;now:string;signal:AbortSignal;preview:boolean}
export interface SettleOutcome{item:SettleItem;counter:keyof BatchCounts|null;summary:{kind:'pending'|'unavailable'|'voided';reason:string}|null;errors:BatchError[]}
const isLeaseLost=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof JudgmentError&&e.code==='lease_lost';
const messageOf=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,500);
const item=(judgment_id:string,action:SettleAction,reason:string|null=null,seq:number|null=null):SettleItem=>({judgment_id,action,reason,seq});
const leaseLost=(id:string):SettleOutcome=>({item:item(id,'lease_lost'),counter:'deferred',summary:null,errors:[{code:'lease_lost',key:id}]});

async function failed(ctx:SettleContext,q:QueueRow,code:string,message:string):Promise<SettleOutcome>{
 const error:BatchError={code,key:q.judgment_id,message};
 if(ctx.preview)return {item:item(q.judgment_id,'failed',code),counter:null,summary:null,errors:[error]};
 try{
  await ctx.deps.db.releaseLease(q.judgment_id,q.lease_token!,{last_status:'error',last_detail:{code,message},
   next_attempt_at:backoff('error',{now:ctx.now,attempts:q.attempts+1,settleBy:q.settle_by}),attempts_increment:1});
 }catch(e){if(!isLeaseLost(e))throw e;}
 return {item:item(q.judgment_id,'failed',code),counter:'failed',summary:null,errors:[error]};
}
function planned(id:string,d:Decision):SettleItem{
 if(d.action==='append')return item(id,d.row.kind==='settled'?'settled':'void',d.row.reason);
 return d.action==='defer'?item(id,'deferred',d.reason):item(id,'quarantined',d.reasonCode);
}
async function apply(ctx:SettleContext,j:JudgmentRow,q:QueueRow,d:Decision,latestSeq:number):Promise<SettleOutcome>{
 const {db}=ctx.deps,id=j.judgment_id;
 try{
  if(d.action==='append'){
   const res=await db.appendSettlement(id,q.lease_token,`${ctx.batchId}:${id}:${latestSeq+1}`,{...d.row,actor:ctx.deps.actor,code_version:ctx.deps.codeVersion,batch_id:ctx.batchId!});
   if(res.status==='already_final')return {item:item(id,'duplicate',null,res.seq),counter:'duplicates',summary:null,errors:[]};
   if(res.status==='request_key_conflict')return {item:item(id,'conflict',null,res.seq),counter:'failed',summary:null,errors:[{code:'request_key_conflict',key:id}]};
   if(d.row.kind==='settled')return {item:item(id,'settled',null,res.seq),counter:'inserted',summary:null,errors:[]};
   return {item:item(id,'void',d.row.reason,res.seq),counter:'versioned',summary:{kind:'voided',reason:d.row.reason??'void'},errors:[]};
  }
  if(d.action==='defer'){
   await db.releaseLease(id,q.lease_token!,d.patch);
   return {item:item(id,'deferred',d.reason),counter:'deferred',summary:{kind:d.summary,reason:d.reason},errors:[]};
  }
  // Q1-02: ONE lease-checked RPC upserts the open item (quarantine() semantics: same key + reason reused, payload refreshed
  // to THIS inconsistency) and publishes the queue state; a stale worker gets lease_lost and writes nothing, and there is
  // no second write to crash before.
  const r=await db.quarantineSettlement(id,q.lease_token!,d.reasonCode,d.payload,d.patch,ctx.batchId!);
  if(r.status==='lease_lost')return leaseLost(id);
  return {item:item(id,'quarantined',d.reasonCode),counter:'quarantined',summary:null,errors:[{code:d.reasonCode,key:id}]};
 }catch(e){
  if(isLeaseLost(e))return leaseLost(id);
  throw e;
 }
}

/** One claimed queue row through the §7.2 machine. */
export async function settleOne(ctx:SettleContext,q:QueueRow,j:JudgmentRow|null,latestSeq:number):Promise<SettleOutcome>{
 if(!j||j.abstained||!j.condition)return failed(ctx,q,'judgment_missing',`no active judgment for queue row ${q.judgment_id}`);
 let resolver:Resolver;
 try{resolver=(ctx.deps.resolverFor??defaultResolverFor)(j.condition.resolver);}catch(e){return failed(ctx,q,'resolver_unavailable',messageOf(e));}
 const plan=planOf(q,ctx.now);
 let result:ResolverResult|null=null;
 if(!plan.early&&!isUnresolvedInconsistency(q,ctx.now,plan)){
  try{
   result=plan.viaOverride&&q.override?resolver.fromOverride(j,q.override)
    :await resolver.resolve({judgment:j,cutoff:plan.cutoff,now:ctx.now,inputsDb:ctx.deps.inputsDb,signal:ctx.signal});
  }catch(e){return failed(ctx,q,'resolver_failed',messageOf(e));}
 }
 const d=decide({judgment:j,queue:q,resolver,result,now:ctx.now,cutoff:plan.cutoff,viaOverride:plan.viaOverride,overrideDiscarded:plan.overrideDiscarded});
 if(ctx.preview)return {item:planned(j.judgment_id,d),counter:null,summary:null,errors:[]};
 return apply(ctx,j,q,d,latestSeq);
}

export type SettleNowOutcome='settled'|'void'|'duplicate'|'conflict'|'deferred'|'quarantine_pending'|'leased'|'closed';
export interface SettleNowResult{outcome:SettleNowOutcome;seq:number|null;reason:string|null;batchId:string|null}
const ADMIN_ACTOR_RE=/^admin:[0-9a-f-]{36}$/;
/** Admin "settle one now" (spec §9.5): the same resolver + decide() as the cron, without a lease. Only an append decision
 *  writes (actor admin:<uuid>, null lease token, the caller's request_key, its own manual judgments.settle batch); a leased
 *  row, a closed queue, a defer or a quarantine decision writes nothing (the cron owns lease-bound queue changes). */
export async function settleNow(deps:SettleDeps,judgmentId:string,o:{actor:string;requestKey:string}):Promise<SettleNowResult>{
 if(!ADMIN_ACTOR_RE.test(o.actor))throw new JudgmentError('invalid_parameter',`settleNow needs an admin actor, got ${o.actor}`);
 const j=await deps.db.getJudgment(judgmentId);
 if(!j)throw new JudgmentError('unknown_judgment',judgmentId);
 const q=await deps.db.queueRow(judgmentId);
 const none=(outcome:SettleNowOutcome,reason:string|null):SettleNowResult=>({outcome,seq:null,reason,batchId:null});
 if(j.abstained||!j.condition||!q||q.closed_at!==null)return none('closed',j.abstained?'abstained':'queue_closed');
 const now=await deps.db.serverTime();
 if(q.leased_until!==null&&q.leased_until>now)return none('leased','lease_held');
 const resolver=(deps.resolverFor??defaultResolverFor)(j.condition.resolver);
 const plan=planOf(q,now);
 const result=plan.early||isUnresolvedInconsistency(q,now,plan)?null
  :plan.viaOverride&&q.override?resolver.fromOverride(j,q.override)
  :await resolver.resolve({judgment:j,cutoff:plan.cutoff,now,inputsDb:deps.inputsDb,signal:deps.signal??new AbortController().signal});
 const d=decide({judgment:j,queue:q,resolver,result,now,cutoff:plan.cutoff,viaOverride:plan.viaOverride,overrideDiscarded:plan.overrideDiscarded});
 if(d.action==='defer')return none('deferred',d.reason);
 if(d.action==='quarantine')return none('quarantine_pending',d.reasonCode);
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:PRODUCER,dataset:SETTLE_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:'manual'});
 const counts:Required<BatchCounts>={...emptyCounts(),fetched:1,deferred:0};
 try{
  const res=await deps.db.appendSettlement(judgmentId,null,o.requestKey,{...d.row,actor:o.actor,code_version:deps.codeVersion,batch_id:batchId});
  const errors:BatchError[]=res.status==='request_key_conflict'?[{code:'request_key_conflict',key:judgmentId}]:[];
  const outcome:SettleNowOutcome=res.status==='already_final'?'duplicate':res.status==='request_key_conflict'?'conflict':d.row.kind==='settled'?'settled':'void';
  if(outcome==='duplicate')counts.duplicates=1;else if(outcome==='conflict')counts.failed=1;else if(outcome==='settled')counts.inserted=1;else counts.versioned=1;
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors});
  return {outcome,seq:res.seq,reason:d.row.reason,batchId};
 }catch(e){
  counts.failed=1;
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:[{code:'append_failed',key:judgmentId,message:messageOf(e)}]}).catch(()=>undefined);
  throw e;
 }
}

async function mapLimit<T,R>(xs:T[],n:number,f:(x:T)=>Promise<R>):Promise<R[]>{
 const out=new Array<R>(xs.length);let next=0;
 await Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.min(n,xs.length)},async()=>{for(;;){const k=next++;if(k>=xs.length)return;out[k]=await f(xs[k]);}}));
 return out;
}
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
async function processRows(ctx:SettleContext,rows:QueueRow[]):Promise<SettleOutcome[]>{
 const ids=rows.map(r=>r.judgment_id);
 const [judgments,settlements]=await Promise.all([Promise.all(ids.map(id=>ctx.deps.db.getJudgment(id))),ctx.deps.db.settlementsOf(ids)]);
 const latest=new Map<string,number>();
 for(const s of settlements)latest.set(s.judgment_id,Math.max(latest.get(s.judgment_id)??0,s.seq));
 const work=rows.map((q,i)=>({q,j:judgments[i]})).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.j?.condition?.resolver??'',b.j?.condition?.resolver??'')||cmp(a.q.judgment_id,b.q.judgment_id));
 return mapLimit(work,CONCURRENCY,w=>settleOne(ctx,w.q,w.j,latest.get(w.q.judgment_id)??0));
}
async function releaseUntouched(db:JudgmentsDb,r:QueueRow):Promise<void>{
 try{await db.releaseLease(r.judgment_id,r.lease_token!,{last_status:r.last_status??'pending',last_detail:r.last_detail,next_attempt_at:r.next_attempt_at,attempts_increment:0});}
 catch(e){if(!isLeaseLost(e))throw e;}
}

export async function runSettle(deps:SettleDeps,opts:SettleOptions={}):Promise<SettleReceipt>{
 const clock=deps.clock??Date.now,t0=clock(),deadlineMs=opts.deadlineMs??DEADLINE_MS,preview=opts.preview===true;
 const ctl=new AbortController();
 const timer=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(new Error('deadline_hit')),Math.max(0,deadlineMs));
 const signal=deps.signal?AbortSignal.any([deps.signal,ctl.signal]):ctl.signal;
 // Task 5: deferred is optional on BatchCounts and absent from emptyCounts(); judgment-layer receipts always carry it.
 const counts:Required<BatchCounts>={...emptyCounts(),deferred:0},errors:BatchError[]=[],items:SettleItem[]=[];
 const summaries:Record<'pending'|'unavailable'|'voided',Map<string,number>>={pending:new Map(),unavailable:new Map(),voided:new Map()};
 const detail:SettleReceipt['detail']={repaired:0,batches:0,deadline_hit:false,compensation:null};
 let batchId:string|null=null;
 const absorb=(o:SettleOutcome)=>{
  items.push(o.item);errors.push(...o.errors);
  if(o.counter)counts[o.counter]++;
  if(o.summary){const m=summaries[o.summary.kind];m.set(o.summary.reason,(m.get(o.summary.reason)??0)+1);}
 };
 const receipt=(status:SettleReceipt['status']):SettleReceipt=>({batchId,status,counts,errors,idle:counts.fetched===0,preview,detail,items});
 try{
  if(preview){
   const rows=await deps.db.queueList({filter:'due',limit:BATCH_SIZE});
   counts.fetched=rows.length;
   const now=opts.now??await deps.db.serverTime();
   for(const o of await processRows({deps,batchId:null,now,signal,preview:true},rows)){items.push(o.item);errors.push(...o.errors);}
   return receipt('preview');
  }
  detail.repaired=await deps.db.repairStaleBatches(SETTLE_DATASET,STALE_BATCH_SECONDS);
  const compensate=deps.compensate===undefined?compensateMacro:deps.compensate;
  if(compensate){
   detail.compensation=await compensate({db:deps.db,inputsDb:deps.inputsDb,tables:deps.tables,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:deps.triggeredBy,signal,clock,deadlineAt:t0+COMPENSATION_BUDGET_MS});
   errors.push(...detail.compensation.errors);
  }
  ({batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:PRODUCER,dataset:SETTLE_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:deps.triggeredBy}));
  const worst=Math.ceil(BATCH_SIZE/CONCURRENCY)*(deps.maxFetchMs??MAX_FETCH_MS);
  const processed=new Set<string>();
  for(;;){
   const elapsed=clock()-t0;
   if(signal.aborted||elapsed>=STOP_CLAIM_MS||deadlineMs-elapsed<worst+TAIL_MS){detail.deadline_hit=true;break;}
   const rows=await deps.db.claimDue(BATCH_SIZE,LEASE_SECONDS);
   const fresh=rows.filter(r=>!processed.has(r.judgment_id));
   for(const r of rows)if(processed.has(r.judgment_id))await releaseUntouched(deps.db,r);
   if(fresh.length===0)break;
   detail.batches++;counts.fetched+=fresh.length;
   const now=opts.now??await deps.db.serverTime();
   for(const o of await processRows({deps,batchId,now,signal,preview:false},fresh)){processed.add(o.item.judgment_id);absorb(o);}
  }
  if(detail.deadline_hit)errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:`claiming stopped after ${detail.batches} batch(es)`});
  for(const k of ['pending','unavailable','voided'] as const)
   if(summaries[k].size>0)errors.push({code:`${k}_summary`,message:JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries([...summaries[k]].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a[0],b[0]))))});
  const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors});
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SETTLE_DATASET,{ok:status==='success'||status==='partial',cadence:'daily',detail:{batch_id:batchId,status,idle:counts.fetched===0}});
  return receipt(status);
 }catch(e){
  if(batchId){
   try{
    const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:[...errors,{code:'settle_aborted',message:messageOf(e)}]});
    await recordAttempt(deps.tables,SETTLE_DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:'daily',detail:{batch_id:batchId,status}});
   }catch{/* the original error is what the caller needs */}
  }
  throw e;
 }finally{clearTimeout(timer);}
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/synthetic-method.ts
// synthetic_fact_metric@v1 — a TEST-ONLY rule method (never in REGISTRY; spec §14.4 "合成 fact_metric
// 判断") for the golden replay fixture. One financial_metric input: the issuer's latest
// params.metric (ttm_revenue) derivable at as_of in the market given by binding.market (default US),
// frozen with its derivation rows by the fixed builder. Claim: probability p = params.p. Condition:
// fact_metric "next quarter's TTM value > this TTM value", the key being this metric's key stepped one
// quarter (stepQuarter). Horizon 1 fiscal quarter, target by defaultResolveTarget, first_observed.
// Its numbers carry no meaning; it only exercises frozen-input replay of a fact-based judgment.
import {FORMULA_VERSION} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {FactsMarket,Input,Methodology,MetricSnapshot,ProbabilityClaim} from '../types';
import {buildOrAbstain} from '../inputs';
import {defaultResolveTarget,stepQuarter} from '../target';

const snapshotOf=(inputs:readonly Input[])=>inputs.find(x=>x.kind==='financial_metric')?.snapshot as MetricSnapshot|undefined;
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
export const syntheticFactMetric:Methodology<ProbabilityClaim>={
 id:'synthetic_fact_metric',version:'v1',judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',
 subject_types:['issuer'],input_kinds:['financial_metric'],upstream:{facts_formula_version:FORMULA_VERSION},
 title:{zh:'合成事实指标（测试专用）',en:'Synthetic fact metric (test only)'},doc:'docs/methodologies/README.md',
 params:{grace_days:120,label_policy:'first_observed',p:0.6,metric:'ttm_revenue'},horizon:{unit:'fiscal_quarters',n:1},deps:[],
 module:'src/lib/judgments/testing/synthetic-method.ts',status:'active',
 async gather(item,db){
  if(item.subject.type!=='issuer')return {abstained:true,reason:'subject_not_issuer'};
  const market=(item.binding?.market??'US') as FactsMarket;const metric=String(this.params.metric);
  const {metrics}=await db.deriveMetricsAsOf(item.subject.key,market,item.asOf,FORMULA_VERSION);
  const m=metrics.filter(x=>x.metric===metric).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.period_end,b.period_end)).at(-1);
  if(!m)return {abstained:true,reason:'input_not_public',missing:[`${metric}@latest`]};
  const x=await buildOrAbstain({kind:'financial_metric',ref:{issuer_id:m.issuer_id,market:m.market,metric:m.metric,period_start:m.period_start,period_end:m.period_end,input_unit:m.input_unit,basis:m.basis,formula_version:m.formula_version}},db,item.asOf);
  return 'abstained' in x?x:[x];
 },
 resolveTarget(item,inputs,db){return defaultResolveTarget(this.horizon,item,inputs,db);},
 compute(_subject,inputs){
  if(!snapshotOf(inputs))return {abstained:true,reason:'metric_missing'};
  return {abstained:false,claim:{p:Number(this.params.p),event:{zh:'下一财季的 TTM 营收高于本期 TTM 营收',en:'Next fiscal quarter TTM revenue exceeds the current TTM revenue'}}};
 },
 condition(_subject,inputs){
  const s=snapshotOf(inputs)!;
  return {resolver:'fact_metric',params:{issuer_id:s.issuer_id,market:s.market,metric:s.metric,period_start:stepQuarter(s.period_start,1),period_end:stepQuarter(s.period_end,1),duration:s.duration,unit:s.unit,input_unit:s.input_unit,basis:s.basis,formula_version:s.formula_version,compare:'value'},
   predicate:{op:'>',rhs:Number(s.value_text)},
   text:{zh:`截至 ${stepQuarter(s.period_end,1)} 的 TTM 营收高于 ${s.value_text} ${s.unit}`,en:`TTM revenue to ${stepQuarter(s.period_end,1)} exceeds ${s.value_text} ${s.unit}`}};
 },
};
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/synthetic-fixture.ts
// Offline generator of the golden synthetic replay fixture (spec §14.4): AAPL facts from the plan-2
// EDGAR fixture (deterministic ids, FIXED_NOW clock) → memoryFactsDb → memory JudgmentInputsDb;
// synthetic_fact_metric@v1 synced into a memory JudgmentsDb; produce() registers one active judgment;
// the stored row is the fixture. registered_at / created_at come from the memory clock and are run
// metadata (replay and --check compare the normalised payload only).
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import {memoryJudgmentInputsDb} from '../inputs-db';
import {memoryJudgmentsDb} from '../memory-judgments-db';
import {produce} from '../produce';
import type {ReplayFixture} from '../replay';
import {syncTestMethod,withSubjects} from './db-helpers';
import {AAPL_ISSUER,FIXED_NOW,aaplParse,publishFacts} from './facts-fixture';
import {FIXTURE_RESOLVERS} from './fixture-methods';
import {syntheticFactMetric} from './synthetic-method';

export const SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH='fixtures/judgments/replay/synthetic-fact-metric.json';
export const SYNTHETIC_AS_OF='2024-12-31';
export const SYNTHETIC_BATCH='00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000f001';
/** The AAPL facts the fixture was built from, as a memory JudgmentInputsDb (also used to reconcile it). */
export async function aaplInputsDb(){
 const facts=memoryFactsDb();facts.setNow(FIXED_NOW);
 const p=aaplParse(2022);
 await publishFacts(facts,{issuer:AAPL_ISSUER,market:'US',filings:p.filings,facts:p.candidates});
 return memoryJudgmentInputsDb({facts});
}
export async function generateSyntheticReplayFixture(asOf=SYNTHETIC_AS_OF):Promise<ReplayFixture>{
 const inputsDb=await aaplInputsDb();
 const db=withSubjects(memoryJudgmentsDb());
 await syncTestMethod(db,syntheticFactMetric);
 const r=await produce(syntheticFactMetric,[{subject:{type:'issuer',key:AAPL_ISSUER},asOf}],{db,inputsDb,tables:memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id']}),resolverOf:FIXTURE_RESOLVERS,batchId:SYNTHETIC_BATCH,codeVersion:'fixture0'});
 const item=r.items[0];
 if(!item||item.status!=='inserted'||item.abstained||!item.judgment_id)throw new Error(`synthetic replay fixture: no active judgment registered: ${JSON.stringify({counts:r.counts,errors:r.errors,items:r.items})}`);
 const judgment=await db.getJudgment(item.judgment_id);
 if(!judgment)throw new Error('synthetic replay fixture: registered row not found');
 return {fixture_version:'judgment-replay/1',description:`synthetic_fact_metric@v1 on AAPL (plan-2 EDGAR fixture CIK0000320193.trimmed.json) as of ${asOf}: one financial_metric input frozen with its derivation rows`,expect:'exact',judgment};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/replay.test.ts
// spec §6.3 / §14.4 / §15 example 2. Golden loop: every JSON file in fixtures/judgments/replay replays
// to its `expect` verdict, and tampering one frozen projection → input_hash_mismatch naming the input
// (kind + key; for a macro observation the key contains its series_id). Tasks 19 (macro_regime@v1) and
// 20 (private recommendation) only add files. Unit cases on the synthetic fixture: diverged claim / id,
// inputs_only for model / abstained rows, unknown ids / methods, reconcile never changing the verdict,
// and that the committed synthetic fixture is what the generator produces today.
import {readFileSync,readdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {inputLabel} from './inputs';
import {memoryJudgmentInputsDb} from './inputs-db';
import {REGISTRY} from './registry';
import {samePayload} from './register';
import {fixtureJudgmentsDb,parseReplayFixture,replayExitCode,replayJudgment} from './replay';
import type {ReplayFixture} from './replay';
import type {InputKind,JudgmentRow,Methodology} from './types';
import {SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH,aaplInputsDb,generateSyntheticReplayFixture} from './testing/synthetic-fixture';
import {syntheticFactMetric} from './testing/synthetic-method';

const DIR='fixtures/judgments/replay';
const FILES=readdirSync(DIR).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.json')).sort();
const REPLAY_REGISTRY:readonly Methodology[]=[...REGISTRY,syntheticFactMetric];
const load=(path:string):ReplayFixture=>parseReplayFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync(path,'utf8')));
const TAMPER_ORDER:InputKind[]=['macro_observation','financial_metric','financial_fact','price_bar','legacy_fill','macro_snapshot','table_rows','judgment','document_span'];
/** Changes the first value-like leaf of the preferred input's snapshot, leaving its stored hash. */
function tamper(row:JudgmentRow):{row:JudgmentRow;kind:InputKind;label:string}{
 const idx=[...row.inputs.keys()].sort((a,b)=>TAMPER_ORDER.indexOf(row.inputs[a].kind)-TAMPER_ORDER.indexOf(row.inputs[b].kind))[0];
 const t=structuredClone(row);const s=t.inputs[idx].snapshot as Record<string,unknown>;
 if(typeof s.value==='number')s.value=s.value+1;
 else if(typeof s.value_text==='string')s.value_text=`${s.value_text}1`;
 else if(typeof s.close==='number')s.close=s.close+1;
 else if(typeof s.fill_price==='number')s.fill_price=s.fill_price+1;
 else s.tampered=true;
 return {row:t,kind:t.inputs[idx].kind,label:inputLabel(t.inputs[idx])};
}

describe('golden replay fixtures (spec §14.4)',()=>{
 it('the folder holds the synthetic fact_metric fixture',()=>{expect(FILES).toContain('synthetic-fact-metric.json');});
 describe.each(FILES)('%s',file=>{
  const fx=load(join(DIR,file));
  it('replays to its expected verdict with byte-identical claim / condition / id',async()=>{
   const r=await replayJudgment(fx.judgment.judgment_id,{db:fixtureJudgmentsDb([fx.judgment]),registry:REPLAY_REGISTRY});
   expect({status:r.status,diffs:r.diffs,hash_mismatches:r.hash_mismatches}).toEqual({status:fx.expect,diffs:[],hash_mismatches:[]});
   expect(replayExitCode(r)).toBe(0);
  });
  it.skipIf(fx.judgment.inputs.length===0)('tampering a frozen projection → input_hash_mismatch naming the input (exit 2)',async()=>{
   const t=tamper(fx.judgment);
   const r=await replayJudgment(t.row.judgment_id,{db:fixtureJudgmentsDb([t.row]),registry:REPLAY_REGISTRY});
   expect(r.status).toBe('input_hash_mismatch');
   expect(r.hash_mismatches).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({kind:t.kind,label:t.label})]);
   if(t.kind==='macro_observation')expect(t.label).toContain(String((t.row.inputs.find(x=>x.kind==='macro_observation')!.snapshot as {series_id:string}).series_id));
   expect(r.diffs).toEqual([]);
   expect(replayExitCode(r)).toBe(2);
  });
 });
});

describe('replayJudgment on the synthetic fixture (spec §6.3)',()=>{
 const fx=load(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH);const row=fx.judgment;
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `replay.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/replay.ts
// replayJudgment (spec §6.3). Never writes. 1) Integrity: every input's digest(snapshot) must equal its
// stored hash and inputsHash(inputs) the stored inputs_hash; otherwise the storage layer was altered →
// input_hash_mismatch naming each failing input by kind + key (inputLabel: series_id for macro
// observations, metric@period for metrics, …) and nothing else is evaluated (exit 2). 2) Public
// producers (rule / model): the id is recomputed from the stored fields (judgmentIdOf); a different id
// is a divergence. 3) rule: compute / condition re-run on the FROZEN snapshots — no reads, no vendor
// refetch (spec §1.1 point 3) — and compared byte for byte (canonical JSON) with the stored claim /
// condition → exact | diverged (field diffs, exit 2). model / human / third_party → inputs_only;
// abstained rows → inputs_only (gather / target abstentions are not reproducible from frozen inputs).
// Private (human) fixtures skip the id check: their ids are domain-separated (spec §11.2). 4) Optional
// reconcile: each input rebuilt from JudgmentInputsDb at the row's as_of → same | changed |
// unavailable — an upstream audit that never changes the verdict. The registry is passed in (REGISTRY
// in production; tests add test-only methods).
import type {InputKind,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentRow,JudgmentsDb,Methodology,Subject} from './types';
import {canonicalize,digest,inputsHash} from './canonical';
import {judgmentIdOf} from './contract';
import {JudgmentError} from './errors';
import {inputLabel,rebuildAndCompare} from './inputs';
import type {BuildOptions} from './inputs';
import {findMethodology} from './registry';

export type ReplayStatus='exact'|'diverged'|'inputs_only'|'input_hash_mismatch';
export interface HashMismatch{index:number;kind:InputKind|'inputs_hash';label:string;stored:string;computed:string}
export interface ReplayDiff{field:'judgment_id'|'claim'|'condition'|'abstained';registered:unknown;replayed:unknown}
export interface ReconcileEntry{kind:InputKind;ref:unknown;label:string;status:'same'|'changed'|'unavailable';detail?:string}
export interface ReplayReport{judgment_id:string;methodology:{id:string;version:string};producer_kind:string;status:ReplayStatus;hash_mismatches:HashMismatch[];diffs:ReplayDiff[];reconcile:ReconcileEntry[]|null}
export interface ReplayDeps{db:Pick<JudgmentsDb,'getJudgment'>;registry:readonly Methodology[];inputsDb?:JudgmentInputsDb;reconcile?:boolean;build?:BuildOptions}
export const REPLAY_FIXTURE_VERSION='judgment-replay/1';
export interface ReplayFixture{fixture_version:'judgment-replay/1';description:string;expect:'exact'|'inputs_only';judgment:JudgmentRow}
export function parseReplayFixture(raw:unknown):ReplayFixture{
 const bad=(why:string):never=>{throw new Error(`replay_fixture_invalid:${why}`);};
 const fx=raw as ReplayFixture;
 if(!fx||typeof fx!=='object'||fx.fixture_version!==REPLAY_FIXTURE_VERSION)bad('fixture_version');
 if(fx.expect!=='exact'&&fx.expect!=='inputs_only')bad('expect');
 if(typeof fx.description!=='string')bad('description');
 const j=fx.judgment;
 if(!j||typeof j.judgment_id!=='string'||!Array.isArray(j.inputs)||typeof j.inputs_hash!=='string'||typeof j.methodology_id!=='string')bad('judgment');
 return fx;
}
export function fixtureJudgmentsDb(rows:readonly JudgmentRow[]):Pick<JudgmentsDb,'getJudgment'>{
 const byId=new Map(rows.map(r=>[r.judgment_id,r] as const));
 return {getJudgment:async id=>{const r=byId.get(id);return r?structuredClone(r):null;}};
}
export function checkInputHashes(row:Pick<JudgmentRow,'inputs'|'inputs_hash'>):HashMismatch[]{
 const out:HashMismatch[]=[];
 row.inputs.forEach((x,index)=>{const computed=digest(x.snapshot);if(computed!==x.hash)out.push({index,kind:x.kind,label:inputLabel(x),stored:x.hash,computed});});
 const h=inputsHash(row.inputs);
 if(h!==row.inputs_hash)out.push({index:-1,kind:'inputs_hash',label:'inputs_hash',stored:row.inputs_hash,computed:h});
 return out;
}
const same=(a:unknown,b:unknown)=>canonicalize(a??null)===canonicalize(b??null);
async function reconcileInputs(row:JudgmentRow,deps:Omit<ReplayDeps,'db'>):Promise<ReconcileEntry[]>{
 const out:ReconcileEntry[]=[];
 for(const x of row.inputs){
  const base={kind:x.kind,ref:x.ref,label:inputLabel(x)};
  if(!deps.inputsDb){out.push({...base,status:'unavailable',detail:'no_inputs_db'});continue;}
  try{
   const r=await rebuildAndCompare(x,deps.inputsDb,row.as_of,deps.build);
   out.push(r.status==='ok'?{...base,status:'same'}:r.status==='input_not_public'?{...base,status:'unavailable',detail:r.code}:{...base,status:'changed',detail:r.field});
  }catch(e){out.push({...base,status:'unavailable',detail:e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)});}
 }
 return out;
}
export async function replayRow(row:JudgmentRow,deps:Omit<ReplayDeps,'db'>):Promise<ReplayReport>{
 const base={judgment_id:row.judgment_id,methodology:{id:row.methodology_id,version:row.methodology_version},producer_kind:String(row.producer_kind)};
 const reconcile=deps.reconcile?await reconcileInputs(row,deps):null;
 const hash_mismatches=checkInputHashes(row);
 if(hash_mismatches.length>0)return {...base,status:'input_hash_mismatch',hash_mismatches,diffs:[],reconcile};
 const diffs:ReplayDiff[]=[];
 const pk=String(row.producer_kind);
 if(pk==='rule'||pk==='model'){
  const id=judgmentIdOf({subject_type:row.subject_type,subject_key:row.subject_key,judgment_type:row.judgment_type,methodology_id:row.methodology_id,methodology_version:row.methodology_version,as_of:row.as_of,inputs_hash:row.inputs_hash,producer_nonce:row.producer_nonce});
  if(id!==row.judgment_id)diffs.push({field:'judgment_id',registered:row.judgment_id,replayed:id});
 }
 if(pk!=='rule'||row.abstained)return {...base,status:diffs.length>0?'diverged':'inputs_only',hash_mismatches,diffs,reconcile};
 const m=findMethodology(deps.registry,row.methodology_id,row.methodology_version);
 if(!m)throw new JudgmentError('unknown_methodology',`${row.methodology_id}@${row.methodology_version} is not in the replay registry`);
 const subject:Subject={type:row.subject_type,key:row.subject_key};
 const inputs=structuredClone(row.inputs);
 const out=m.compute(subject,inputs);
 if(out.abstained)diffs.push({field:'abstained',registered:false,replayed:out});
 else{
  if(!same(out.claim,row.claim))diffs.push({field:'claim',registered:row.claim,replayed:out.claim});
  const cond=m.condition(subject,inputs,out.claim);
  if(!same(cond,row.condition))diffs.push({field:'condition',registered:row.condition,replayed:cond});
 }
 return {...base,status:diffs.length>0?'diverged':'exact',hash_mismatches,diffs,reconcile};
}
export async function replayJudgment(id:string,deps:ReplayDeps):Promise<ReplayReport>{
 const row=await deps.db.getJudgment(id);
 if(!row)throw new JudgmentError('unknown_judgment',id);
 return replayRow(row,deps);
}
export const replayExitCode=(r:ReplayReport):0|2=>r.status==='input_hash_mismatch'||r.status==='diverged'?2:0;
```

（核对 `inputs_hash` 用例：篡改单个输入的 `snapshot` 不改它存储的 `hash`，所以 `inputsHash(inputs)`（由 `[kind, ref, hash]` 组成）不变，回放只报该输入一条；直接改 `inputs_hash` 则只报 `index:-1` 一条。`changed` 方法用例：`p` 从 0.6 变 0.7 只改 `claim`，`condition` 不依赖 `p`，所以 `diffs` 只有 `claim`。）

```ts
/**
 * Replay a registered judgment from its frozen inputs (spec §6.3).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/replay.ts --id <uuid> [--reconcile] [--json]
 *   node --import tsx scripts/judgments/replay.ts --fixture <path.json> [--json]        (offline; no database)
 *
 * --id reads the row with the service-role client (unpublished methods included) and, with --reconcile,
 * rebuilds each input through the anon JudgmentInputsDb. --fixture replays a golden fixture file
 * (fixtures/judgments/replay/*.json) against REGISTRY plus the test-only replay methods; --reconcile is
 * reported as unavailable offline. Never writes. Exit 0 exact / inputs_only, 2 input_hash_mismatch or
 * diverged, 1 bad arguments or runtime error.
 */
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from '../../src/lib/judgments/db';
import {anonJudgmentInputsDb} from '../../src/lib/judgments/inputs-db';
import {REGISTRY} from '../../src/lib/judgments/registry';
import {fixtureJudgmentsDb,parseReplayFixture,replayExitCode,replayJudgment} from '../../src/lib/judgments/replay';
import type {ReplayDeps,ReplayReport} from '../../src/lib/judgments/replay';
import {syntheticFactMetric} from '../../src/lib/judgments/testing/synthetic-method';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/anon';

const USAGE='usage: replay.ts (--id <uuid> | --fixture <path.json>) [--reconcile] [--json]';
const UUID=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
function print(r:ReplayReport,json:boolean){
 if(json){console.log(JSON.stringify(r));return;}
 console.log(`${r.judgment_id} ${r.methodology.id}@${r.methodology.version} (${r.producer_kind}): ${r.status}`);
 for(const m of r.hash_mismatches)console.log(`  input_hash_mismatch ${m.label} [index ${m.index}] stored ${m.stored.slice(0,12)} computed ${m.computed.slice(0,12)}`);
 for(const d of r.diffs)console.log(`  diverged ${d.field}: registered ${JSON.stringify(d.registered)} replayed ${JSON.stringify(d.replayed)}`);
 for(const c of r.reconcile??[])console.log(`  reconcile ${c.label}: ${c.status}${c.detail?` (${c.detail})`:''}`);
}
async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);let id:string|undefined,fixture:string|undefined,reconcile=false,json=false;
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i],v=argv[i+1];
  if(x==='--id'&&v&&UUID.test(v)){id=v;i++;}
  else if(x==='--fixture'&&v){fixture=v;i++;}
  else if(x==='--reconcile')reconcile=true;
  else if(x==='--json')json=true;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(1);}
 }
 if((id===undefined)===(fixture===undefined)){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(1);}
 let report:ReplayReport;
 if(fixture!==undefined){
  const fx=parseReplayFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync(fixture,'utf8')));
  const deps:ReplayDeps={db:fixtureJudgmentsDb([fx.judgment]),registry:[...REGISTRY,syntheticFactMetric],reconcile};
  report=await replayJudgment(fx.judgment.judgment_id,deps);
  if(report.status!==fx.expect&&report.status!=='input_hash_mismatch'&&report.status!=='diverged'){print(report,json);console.error(`fixture expects ${fx.expect}`);process.exit(2);}
 }else{
  const anon=getAnonSupabase();
  report=await replayJudgment(id!,{db:supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon,admin:getAdminSupabase()}),registry:REGISTRY,inputsDb:anonJudgmentInputsDb({anon}),reconcile});
 }
 print(report,json);
 process.exit(replayExitCode(report));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
/**
 * Regenerate the golden synthetic replay fixture (spec §14.4) offline from the plan-2 EDGAR fixture.
 *
 *   node --import tsx scripts/judgments/make-replay-fixture.ts [--check]
 *
 * Writes fixtures/judgments/replay/synthetic-fact-metric.json (generateSyntheticReplayFixture). --check
 * writes nothing and exits 2 when the committed file's normalised payload (id, inputs, claim,
 * condition, target, settle window …; not registered_at / created_at / batch_id / code_version)
 * differs from a fresh generation, 0 when it matches. Exit 1 on errors.
 */
import {existsSync,mkdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname} from 'node:path';
import {samePayload} from '../../src/lib/judgments/register';
import {parseReplayFixture} from '../../src/lib/judgments/replay';
import {SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH,generateSyntheticReplayFixture} from '../../src/lib/judgments/testing/synthetic-fixture';

async function main(){
 const argv=process.argv.slice(2);
 if(argv.some(a=>a!=='--check')){console.error('usage: make-replay-fixture.ts [--check]');process.exit(1);}
 const fresh=await generateSyntheticReplayFixture();
 if(argv.includes('--check')){
  if(!existsSync(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH)){console.error(`missing ${SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH}`);process.exit(2);}
  const committed=parseReplayFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH,'utf8')));
  const ok=samePayload(committed.judgment,fresh.judgment);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({fixture:SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH,matches:ok,judgment_id:fresh.judgment.judgment_id}));
  process.exit(ok?0:2);
 }
 mkdirSync(dirname(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH),{recursive:true});
 writeFileSync(SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH,`${JSON.stringify(fresh,null,1)}\n`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({wrote:SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PATH,judgment_id:fresh.judgment.judgment_id,inputs:fresh.judgment.inputs.length}));
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

规格偏差（记入实施记录）：
- **`code_version` 缺失**：规格 §13 的 `code_version_missing → rejected` 针对登记批次；结算 cron 沿用 facts-sync 先例在路由层拒绝（503 `code_version_unavailable`，不建批次）。`preview=1` 不写库，以 `'preview'` 作代码版本运行。
- **隔离钩子的 `reject`** 先看该判断最新结算：已是终态（例如到 `settle_by` 已被 `unresolved_inconsistency` 作废）就不再追加（`void → void` 是非法转移），只翻转隔离项（路由审计）；否则经**一个** RPC `rejectQuarantinedSettlement`（计划审计 P1-05：锁队列 → 锁隔离项 → 校验 → `void(quarantine_rejected)` → 项 `resolved_reject` → 审计，同一事务；`request_key = quarantine-reject:<item id>`，在一个 `triggered_by='manual'` 的 `judgments.settle` 批次里），不再"先追加、再翻转"。`accept` 经 `applyQuarantineOverride`（P1-04：同样锁队列再锁项，只接受队列**当前**那次不一致，并吊销在途租约）。两者都在 RPC 内写 `research_audit_log`，所以路由对它们不再审计（`audited=true`）；RPC 报 `stale`（队列已换成另一次不一致或已关闭）→ 结果 `stale`（409，不写任何行）、`item_not_open` → `already_resolved`。拒绝带钩子读到的 `payload.evidence_hash / cutoff` 作 `expected`（计划审计 Q1-03：读后 worker 刷新了队列与项 → RPC 报 `stale`），项缺任一 → `invalid_resolution`；接受的 `override.evidence_hash / cutoff` 本来就取自同一次读取。普通项由路由审计（与 facts 一致）。
- **`override.cutoff`**（计划审计 P1-03）取自隔离项 `payload.cutoff`（结算写入的解析截止）；缺失 → `invalid_resolution`。
- **离线集成用一个手建的方法行** `synthetic_price_return@v1`（`judgment_type` 借用测试专用的 `synthetic_fact_metric`）经 `syncMethodology` 登记——合成 `fact_metric` 方法（Task 13）只覆盖事实结算，本测试要的是 K 线夹具上的 `price_return` 生命周期；`acceptance 5` 的卡片 `lifecycle='withdrawn'` 由 Task 17/18 断言，这里断言证据序列与 `validity.revision` 两次 `+1`。
- **共享库隔离**：`test:db` 的库被多个套件共用，集成测试用包装的 `claimDue` 只处理本文件登记的判断，别的套件的到期行原样释放。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/deps.ts
// Production wiring of the judgment layer (plan F4 Task 14) shared by /api/cron/judgments-settle,
// scripts/judgments/settle.ts and the /api/admin/dq/quarantine judgments branch: the anon client for public reads
// (RLS on: public RPCs and the inputs db), the service-role client for RPC writes and the dq tables, the inputs db
// over anon reads + the frozen-source K-line reader, and MacroReadApi = unavailableMacroReadApi() until the macro
// workbench lands (macro_regime_replay → Unavailable(macro_unavailable); the compensation scan → skipped with
// info macro_unavailable). code_version = VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA (40 hex); scripts may fall back to
// `git rev-parse HEAD` (+ "-dirty"); null means "refuse to apply".
import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import type {TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from './db';
import {anonJudgmentInputsDb} from './inputs-db';
import {unavailableMacroReadApi} from './macro-api';
import type {SettleDeps} from './settle';
import type {JudgmentsDb} from './types';

type Exec=(cmd:string,args:string[])=>string;
const gitExec:Exec=(c,a)=>execFileSync(c,a,{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']});
const SHA_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/;

export function resolveCodeVersion(opts:{allowGit:boolean;env?:Record<string,string|undefined>;exec?:Exec}):string|null{
 const sha=(opts.env??process.env).VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA;
 if(sha!==undefined&&SHA_RE.test(sha))return sha;
 if(!opts.allowGit)return null;
 const exec=opts.exec??gitExec;
 try{
  const head=exec('git',['rev-parse','HEAD']).trim();
  if(!SHA_RE.test(head))return null;
  return exec('git',['status','--porcelain']).trim().length>0?`${head}-dirty`:head;
 }catch{return null;}
}

/** JudgmentsDb for admin routes: writes through service-role RPCs, public reads through anon (contract note). */
export function adminJudgmentsDb(admin:ReturnType<typeof getAdminSupabase>=getAdminSupabase()):JudgmentsDb{
 return supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon:getAnonSupabase(),admin});
}

export interface ProductionJudgmentDepsOptions{codeVersion:string;actor:'cron'|'script';triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;signal?:AbortSignal;admin?:ReturnType<typeof getAdminSupabase>}
export function productionJudgmentDeps(o:ProductionJudgmentDepsOptions):SettleDeps{
 const admin=o.admin??getAdminSupabase(),anon=getAnonSupabase();
 return {
  db:supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon,admin}),
  inputsDb:anonJudgmentInputsDb({anon,macro:unavailableMacroReadApi()}),
  tables:supabaseTableClient(admin),
  codeVersion:o.codeVersion,actor:o.actor,triggeredBy:o.triggeredBy,
  ...(o.signal?{signal:o.signal}:{}),
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dq/judgments-resolver.test.ts
// F4 Task 14 (spec §7.6): verdicts on dataset 'judgments' items. basis_mismatch accept = accept_refetched with the
// item's own evidence hash (integrity-checked); ambiguous_fact accept = choose_fact whose digest is one of the
// candidates; base_bar_missing / benchmark_gap accept → resolution_not_applicable; accept writes the override via
// one RPC (audited there; stale / closed → stale); reject is ONE rejectQuarantinedSettlement RPC (void + flip +
// audit) unless the judgment is already final (then a plain flip); idempotency_conflict items are a plain resolve;
// everything is idempotent.
import {beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../db/memory-table-client';
import {digest} from '../judgments/canonical';
import {memoryJudgmentsDb} from '../judgments/memory-judgments-db';

const ITEM='3f2b6c1e-8a4d-4f0e-9b7a-1c2d3e4f5a6b',ADMIN='9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d',SHA='a'.repeat(40);
const NOW=new Date('2026-03-05T10:00:00.000Z');
const {row:J}=priceJudgment({baseDate:'2026-01-12',registeredClose:107,batchId:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'});
const EVIDENCE={bars:[{date:'2026-01-12',close:106}],result:{value:111/106-1,from:'2026-01-12',to:'2026-01-20',label_available_at:'2026-01-20T21:00:00.000Z'}};
const H=digest(EVIDENCE);
const CANDS=[{key:{metric:'q_single_revenue'},value_text:'1000',realized_value:1000},{key:{metric:'q_single_revenue'},value_text:'1001',realized_value:1001}];
const CUTOFF='2026-03-02T04:00:00.000Z';
type Stubbed=JudgmentsDb&{getJudgment:ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;settlementsOf:ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;applyQuarantineOverride:ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;rejectQuarantinedSettlement:ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;appendSettlement:ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>};

let tables:ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>;let db:Stubbed;
beforeEach(()=>{
 tables=memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id'],ingest_batches:['batch_id']});
 db={getJudgment:vi.fn(async()=>J),settlementsOf:vi.fn(async()=>[]),applyQuarantineOverride:vi.fn(async()=>'applied'),rejectQuarantinedSettlement:vi.fn(async()=>({seq:1,status:'applied'})),appendSettlement:vi.fn(async()=>({seq:1,status:'applied'}))} as unknown as Stubbed;
});
async function item(reason:string,payload:Record<string,unknown>,table='judgment_settlements'){
 const row={id:ITEM,dataset:'judgments',table_name:table,natural_key:J.judgment_id,reason_code:reason,status:'open',payload,detail:{},batch_id:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',resolved_by:null,resolved_at:null,created_at:'2026-03-02T04:00:00.000Z'};
 await tables.insert('dq_quarantine',row);
 return row;
}
const run=(row:Record<string,unknown>,status:'resolved_accept'|'resolved_reject',resolution?:unknown,codeVersion:string|null=SHA)=>
 resolveJudgmentsItem({db,tables,codeVersion,now:()=>NOW},row,{status,resolution,resolvedBy:ADMIN});
const stored=async()=>(await tables.select('dq_quarantine',{id:ITEM},{limit:1}))[0];

describe('resolveJudgmentsItem',()=>{
 it('basis_mismatch accept_refetched with the item hash → one override RPC carrying the frozen evidence; audited by the RPC',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H,registered_bar:{close:107},cutoff:CUTOFF});
  const r=await run(row,'resolved_accept',{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H});
  expect(r).toEqual({outcome:'resolved',audited:true,judgmentId:J.judgment_id,resolution:'accept_refetched',seq:null});
  expect(db.applyQuarantineOverride).toHaveBeenCalledWith(J.judgment_id,
   {reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch',resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H,evidence:EVIDENCE},evidence_hash:H,resolved_by:ADMIN,at:NOW.toISOString(),cutoff:CUTOFF},
   ITEM,expect.objectContaining({action:'dq.quarantine_resolve',user_id:ADMIN,object_id:ITEM}));
  expect(db.appendSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('accept: an item without a resolution cutoff is refused; the RPC answering stale / closed → stale (409), item_not_open → already_resolved (P1-03, P1-04)',async()=>{
  const noCutoff=await item('settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H});
  expect((await run(noCutoff,'resolved_accept',{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H})).outcome).toBe('invalid_resolution');
  expect(db.applyQuarantineOverride).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  const row={...noCutoff,payload:{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF}};
  for(const [rpc,outcome] of [['stale','stale'],['closed','stale'],['item_not_open','already_resolved']] as const){
   db.applyQuarantineOverride.mockResolvedValueOnce(rpc);
   expect({rpc,o:(await run(row,'resolved_accept',{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H})).outcome}).toEqual({rpc,o:outcome});
  }
 });
 it('basis_mismatch: missing / wrong-kind / wrong-hash verdicts and tampered stored evidence → invalid_resolution, nothing written',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF});
  for(const res of [undefined,'x',{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:CANDS[0]},{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:'b'.repeat(64)},{kind:'accept_refetched'}])
   expect({res,o:(await run(row,'resolved_accept',res)).outcome}).toEqual({res,o:'invalid_resolution'});
  const tampered={...row,payload:{evidence:{...EVIDENCE,bars:[]},evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF}};
  expect((await run(tampered,'resolved_accept',{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H})).outcome).toBe('invalid_resolution');
  expect(db.applyQuarantineOverride).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('ambiguous_fact choose_fact: the chosen object must be one of the candidates (by digest)',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_ambiguous_fact',{candidates:CANDS,evidence_hash:'c'.repeat(64),cutoff:CUTOFF});
  expect((await run(row,'resolved_accept',{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:{...CANDS[1],value_text:'1002'}})).outcome).toBe('invalid_resolution');
  const r=await run(row,'resolved_accept',{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:CANDS[1]});
  expect(r).toMatchObject({outcome:'resolved',audited:true,resolution:'choose_fact'});
  expect(db.applyQuarantineOverride.mock.calls[0][1]).toEqual({reason_code:'settlement_ambiguous_fact',resolution:{kind:'choose_fact',chosen:CANDS[1]},evidence_hash:'c'.repeat(64),resolved_by:ADMIN,at:NOW.toISOString(),cutoff:CUTOFF});
 });
 it('base_bar_missing / benchmark_gap cannot be accepted → resolution_not_applicable',async()=>{
  for(const reason of ['settlement_base_bar_missing','settlement_benchmark_gap']){
   const row={...(await item(reason,{evidence_hash:H})),id:ITEM};
   expect((await run(row,'resolved_accept',{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H})).outcome).toBe('resolution_not_applicable');
   await tables.update('dq_quarantine',{id:ITEM},{id:'00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000dead'});
  }
  expect(db.applyQuarantineOverride).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('reject → ONE rejectQuarantinedSettlement RPC (void(quarantine_rejected) as admin:<id>, request_key quarantine-reject:<item>, bound to the evidence identity read from the item, item flip and audit in one transaction) in a manual judgments.settle batch (P1-05, Q1-03)',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_benchmark_gap',{missing_dates:['2026-01-14'],evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF});
  const r=await run(row,'resolved_reject');
  expect(r).toEqual({outcome:'resolved',audited:true,judgmentId:J.judgment_id,resolution:'quarantine_rejected',seq:1});
  expect(db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement).toHaveBeenCalledWith(J.judgment_id,ITEM,{evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF},`quarantine-reject:${ITEM}`,expect.objectContaining({
   kind:'void',outcome:null,realized:null,reason:'quarantine_rejected',actor:`admin:${ADMIN}`,resolver:'price_return',resolver_version:PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION,code_version:SHA,
   evidence:{quarantine_id:ITEM,reason_code:'settlement_benchmark_gap',evidence_hash:H}}),expect.objectContaining({action:'dq.quarantine_resolve',user_id:ADMIN,object_id:ITEM}));
  expect(db.appendSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  const batchId=db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement.mock.calls[0][4].batch_id;
  expect((await tables.select('ingest_batches',{batch_id:batchId},{limit:1}))[0]).toMatchObject({dataset:'judgments.settle',producer:'ts-judgments',triggered_by:'manual',status:'success',counts:expect.objectContaining({fetched:1,versioned:1})});
  expect((await stored()).status).toBe('open');                                              // the RPC flips the item; the hook never does it separately
 });
 it('reject: the RPC answering stale → stale (nothing written), item_not_open → already_resolved; an item without evidence_hash / cutoff → invalid_resolution (P1-05, Q1-03)',async()=>{
  const bare=await item('settlement_benchmark_gap',{missing_dates:['2026-01-14'],evidence_hash:H});
  expect((await run(bare,'resolved_reject')).outcome).toBe('invalid_resolution');
  expect(db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  const row={...bare,payload:{missing_dates:['2026-01-14'],evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF}};
  db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement.mockResolvedValueOnce({seq:0,status:'stale'});
  expect(await run(row,'resolved_reject')).toMatchObject({outcome:'stale',audited:false,seq:null});
  db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement.mockResolvedValueOnce({seq:0,status:'item_not_open'});
  expect((await run(row,'resolved_reject')).outcome).toBe('already_resolved');
  expect((await stored()).status).toBe('open');
 });
 it('reject of an already final judgment appends nothing and only flips the item',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H});
  db.settlementsOf.mockResolvedValue([{seq:1,kind:'void',judgment_id:J.judgment_id} as SettlementRow]);
  expect(await run(row,'resolved_reject')).toMatchObject({outcome:'resolved',resolution:'quarantine_rejected',seq:1});
  expect(db.appendSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect(db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect((await stored()).status).toBe('resolved_reject');
 });
 it('hook read → worker refresh → reject: the real RPC sees the refreshed queue and item and answers stale; nothing is written (Q1-03)',async()=>{
  const t=memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id'],ingest_batches:['batch_id'],research_audit_log:['id']});
  const mdb=memoryJudgmentsDb({tables:t});mdb.setNow(CUTOFF);
  await mdb.syncMethodology(testMethodologyRow(),'script',null);
  const {batchId}=await startBatch(t,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.settle',codeVersion:SHA});
  const {insert,queue}=priceJudgment({baseDate:'2026-01-12',registeredClose:107,batchId});await mdb.registerJudgment(insert,queue);
  const id=insert.judgment_id;
  const patch=(hash:string,cutoff:string)=>({last_status:'inconsistent' as const,last_detail:{reason_code:'settlement_basis_mismatch',evidence_hash:hash,cutoff,quarantined_at:cutoff},next_attempt_at:'2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',attempts_increment:0 as const});
  const lease=async()=>(await mdb.claimDue(10,600)).find(q=>q.judgment_id===id)!.lease_token!;
  const first=await mdb.quarantineSettlement(id,await lease(),'settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H,cutoff:CUTOFF,judgment_id:id},patch(H,CUTOFF),batchId);
  const read=(await t.select('dq_quarantine',{id:first.quarantine_id!},{limit:1}))[0];          // the route loads the item: (H, CUTOFF)
  const H2='f'.repeat(64),C2='2026-03-03T04:00:00.000Z';
  expect(await mdb.quarantineSettlement(id,await lease(),'settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:{bars:[]},evidence_hash:H2,cutoff:C2,judgment_id:id},patch(H2,C2),batchId)).toEqual({status:'quarantined',quarantine_id:first.quarantine_id});
  const r=await resolveJudgmentsItem({db:mdb,tables:t,codeVersion:SHA,now:()=>NOW},read,{status:'resolved_reject',resolvedBy:ADMIN});
  expect(r).toMatchObject({outcome:'stale',audited:false,seq:null});
  expect(await mdb.settlementsOf([id])).toEqual([]);
  expect((await t.select('dq_quarantine',{id:first.quarantine_id!},{limit:1}))[0].status).toBe('open');

 it('reject without a code version → code_version_unavailable, nothing written',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H});
  expect((await run(row,'resolved_reject',undefined,null)).outcome).toBe('code_version_unavailable');
  expect(db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect((await stored()).status).toBe('open');
 });
 it('idempotent: a resolved item answers already_resolved without writes; the RPC refusing a non-open item is already_resolved too',async()=>{
  const row=await item('settlement_basis_mismatch',{evidence:EVIDENCE,evidence_hash:H});
  expect((await run({...row,status:'resolved_reject'},'resolved_reject')).outcome).toBe('already_resolved');
  db.applyQuarantineOverride.mockResolvedValueOnce('item_not_open');
  expect((await run({...row,payload:{...row.payload,cutoff:CUTOFF}},'resolved_accept',{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:H})).outcome).toBe('already_resolved');
  expect(db.appendSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect(db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
```
