- [ ] **Step 7: 实现 `src/lib/dq/judgments-resolver.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/dq/judgments-resolver.ts
// Quarantine hook for dataset 'judgments' (spec §7.6), called by POST /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]. Accept verdicts
// per reason_code must determine one realised value (audit G12): settlement_basis_mismatch → {kind:'accept_refetched',
// evidence_hash} equal to the item's frozen evidence hash (re-checked against digest(payload.evidence)); the override
// carries that complete evidence so the next settle run never refetches. settlement_ambiguous_fact → {kind:'choose_fact',
// chosen} whose digest is one of payload.candidates. settlement_base_bar_missing / settlement_benchmark_gap → only
// reject (resolution_not_applicable). Accept = apply_quarantine_override: locks queue then item, accepts only the
// queue's CURRENT inconsistency, revokes any lease, flips the item and writes research_audit_log in ONE transaction
// (audited=true: the route must not audit again); override.cutoff = payload.cutoff (P1-03). Reject of a settlement
// item = reject_quarantined_settlement: void(quarantine_rejected) as admin:<id> (request_key quarantine-reject:<item
// id>, a manual judgments.settle batch) + item flip + audit in ONE transaction (plan audit P1-05), bound to the
// payload's evidence_hash / cutoff read here (Q1-03: a worker refresh in between → stale; an item without them →
// invalid_resolution), unless the judgment is already final (then a plain flip). RPC 'stale' / 'closed' → stale (nothing written); 'item_not_open' →
// already_resolved. Other judgments reasons (idempotency_conflict on table judgments) are a plain resolveQuarantine.
import type {Row,TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {digest} from '../judgments/canonical';
import {resolverFor} from '../judgments/resolvers';
import type {JudgmentsDb,QuarantineOverride} from '../judgments/types';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from './batches';
import {resolveQuarantine} from './quarantine';

export type JudgmentsResolveOutcome='resolved'|'already_resolved'|'stale'|'resolution_not_applicable'|'invalid_resolution'|'unknown_judgment'|'code_version_unavailable';
export interface JudgmentsResolveResult{outcome:JudgmentsResolveOutcome;audited:boolean;judgmentId:string|null;resolution:'accept_refetched'|'choose_fact'|'quarantine_rejected'|'plain'|null;seq:number|null}
export interface JudgmentsResolveDeps{db:JudgmentsDb;tables:TableClient;codeVersion:string|null;now?:()=>Date}

const SETTLEMENT_REASONS:readonly string[]=['settlement_basis_mismatch','settlement_ambiguous_fact','settlement_base_bar_missing','settlement_benchmark_gap'];
const REJECT_ONLY:readonly string[]=['settlement_base_bar_missing','settlement_benchmark_gap'];
const FINAL=new Set(['settled','void','withdrawn']);
const isObj=(v:unknown):v is Record<string,unknown>=>!!v&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);

export async function resolveJudgmentsItem(deps:JudgmentsResolveDeps,item:Row,input:{status:'resolved_accept'|'resolved_reject';resolution?:unknown;resolvedBy:string}):Promise<JudgmentsResolveResult>{
 const id=String(item.id),reason=String(item.reason_code);
 const judgmentId=typeof item.natural_key==='string'?item.natural_key:null;
 const result=(outcome:JudgmentsResolveOutcome,extra:Partial<JudgmentsResolveResult>={}):JudgmentsResolveResult=>({outcome,audited:false,judgmentId,resolution:null,seq:null,...extra});
 if(item.status!=='open')return result('already_resolved');
 if(item.table_name!=='judgment_settlements'||!SETTLEMENT_REASONS.includes(reason)){
  const o=await resolveQuarantine(deps.tables,id,{status:input.status,resolvedBy:input.resolvedBy});
  return result(o==='resolved'?'resolved':'already_resolved',{resolution:'plain'});
 }
 const judgment=judgmentId?await deps.db.getJudgment(judgmentId):null;
 if(!judgment||!judgment.condition)return result('unknown_judgment');
 const payload=isObj(item.payload)?item.payload:{};
 const evidenceHash=typeof payload.evidence_hash==='string'?payload.evidence_hash:null;
 const cutoff=typeof payload.cutoff==='string'?payload.cutoff:null;   // the resolution cutoff of this inconsistency (P1-03)
 const jid=judgment.judgment_id;
 const audit=(extra:Record<string,unknown>)=>({action:'dq.quarantine_resolve',user_id:input.resolvedBy,object_id:id,
  detail:{id,status:input.status,outcome:'resolved',reason_code:reason,judgment_id:jid,evidence_hash:evidenceHash,...extra}});
 if(input.status==='resolved_accept'){
  if(REJECT_ONLY.includes(reason))return result('resolution_not_applicable');
  const res=input.resolution;
  if(!isObj(res)||cutoff===null)return result('invalid_resolution');
  const at=(deps.now??(()=>new Date()))().toISOString();
  let override:QuarantineOverride;
  if(reason==='settlement_basis_mismatch'){
   if(res.kind!=='accept_refetched'||typeof res.evidence_hash!=='string'||evidenceHash===null||res.evidence_hash!==evidenceHash||!isObj(payload.evidence)||digest(payload.evidence)!==evidenceHash)return result('invalid_resolution');
   override={reason_code:reason,resolution:{kind:'accept_refetched',evidence_hash:evidenceHash,evidence:payload.evidence},evidence_hash:evidenceHash,resolved_by:input.resolvedBy,at,cutoff};
  }else{
   const candidates=Array.isArray(payload.candidates)?payload.candidates:[];
   const chosen=res.chosen;
   if(res.kind!=='choose_fact'||!isObj(chosen)||!candidates.some(c=>digest(c)===digest(chosen)))return result('invalid_resolution');
   override={reason_code:reason,resolution:{kind:'choose_fact',chosen},evidence_hash:evidenceHash??digest(candidates),resolved_by:input.resolvedBy,at,cutoff};
  }
  const status=await deps.db.applyQuarantineOverride(judgment.judgment_id,override,id,audit({resolution:override.resolution.kind,evidence_hash:override.evidence_hash}));
  if(status==='item_not_open')return result('already_resolved');
  if(status!=='applied')return result('stale');
  return result('resolved',{audited:true,resolution:override.resolution.kind});
 }
 if(!deps.codeVersion)return result('code_version_unavailable');
 const latest=(await deps.db.settlementsOf([judgment.judgment_id])).reduce<{seq:number;kind:string}|null>((m,s)=>!m||s.seq>m.seq?{seq:s.seq,kind:s.kind}:m,null);
 if(latest&&FINAL.has(latest.kind)){
  const flipped=await resolveQuarantine(deps.tables,id,{status:'resolved_reject',resolvedBy:input.resolvedBy});
  return result(flipped==='resolved'?'resolved':'already_resolved',{resolution:'quarantine_rejected',seq:latest.seq});
 }
 // Q1-03: the rejection is bound to the evidence identity read here; a worker refresh in between makes the RPC answer stale.
 if(evidenceHash===null||cutoff===null)return result('invalid_resolution');
 const resolver=resolverFor(judgment.condition.resolver);
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.settle',codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:'manual'});
 const counts={...emptyCounts(),fetched:1};
 try{
  // P1-05: void + item flip + audit in ONE transaction (locks queue then item; replay-safe on the request key).
  const r=await deps.db.rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgment.judgment_id,id,{evidence_hash:evidenceHash,cutoff},`quarantine-reject:${id}`,{kind:'void',outcome:null,realized:null,
   evidence:{quarantine_id:id,reason_code:reason,evidence_hash:evidenceHash},resolver:resolver.name,resolver_version:resolver.version,reason:'quarantine_rejected',
   actor:`admin:${input.resolvedBy}`,code_version:deps.codeVersion,batch_id:batchId},audit({resolution:'quarantine_rejected'}));
  if(r.status==='applied')counts.versioned=1;else counts.duplicates=1;
  const errors=r.status==='applied'||r.status==='already_applied'?[]:[{code:`quarantine_reject_${r.status}`,key:judgment.judgment_id}];
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors});
  if(r.status==='applied'||r.status==='already_applied')return result('resolved',{audited:true,resolution:'quarantine_rejected',seq:r.seq});
  if(r.status==='item_not_open')return result('already_resolved');
  if(r.status==='stale')return result('stale');
  throw new Error(`reject_quarantined_settlement: ${r.status} for ${judgment.judgment_id}`);
 }catch(e){
  counts.failed=1;
  await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:[{code:'reject_failed',key:judgment.judgment_id,message:e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)}]}).catch(()=>undefined);
  throw e;
 }
}
```

```ts
// F4
describe('POST /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id] — judgments items (F4, spec §7.6)', () => {
  const JUDGMENT = '7c1e2d3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-90a1b2c3d4e5';
  const H = 'e'.repeat(64);
  let client: ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    client = memoryTableClient({ dq_quarantine: ['id'] });
    mocks.client = client;
    await client.insert('dq_quarantine', { id: ID, dataset: 'judgments', table_name: 'judgment_settlements', natural_key: JUDGMENT, reason_code: 'settlement_basis_mismatch', status: 'open', payload: { evidence_hash: H }, detail: {} });
    mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue({ id: ADMIN });
    mocks.insert.mockResolvedValue({ error: null });
    mocks.from.mockReturnValue({ insert: mocks.insert });
    mocks.getAdmin.mockReturnValue({ from: mocks.from });
    f4.judgmentsDb.mockReturnValue({ judgments: 'db' });
    f4.codeVersion.mockReturnValue('a'.repeat(40));
  });

  it('routes judgments items to resolveJudgmentsItem with the resolution body; an accept audited by the RPC is not audited again', async () => {
```

- [ ] **Step 15: 实现 cron 路由**

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/judgments-settle/route.ts
// Judgment settlement trigger (spec §7.1): CRON_SECRET bearer (same constant-time check as facts-sync /
// securities-sync), GET|POST, force-dynamic, maxDuration 300 with the 280 s deadline handed to runSettle (which stops
// claiming at 200 s and aborts provider calls at the deadline). ?preview=1 runs the core read-only: no batch, no
// lease, no writes (code version 'preview' when VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA is absent); an applying run without
// VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA is refused. Vercel may deliver one cron event twice: leases and request keys make the
// duplicate harmless. The HTTP receipt carries codes, keys and counts only — never messages.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {productionJudgmentDeps,resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/judgments/deps';
import {JudgmentError} from '@/lib/judgments/errors';
import {runSettle} from '@/lib/judgments/settle';
import type {SettleReceipt} from '@/lib/judgments/settle';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEADLINE_MS=280_000;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}
/** Codes, keys and counts; never messages (summaries carry reason counts in their message and stay server-side). */
function publicReceipt(r:SettleReceipt){
 const c=r.detail.compensation;
 return {batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,idle:r.idle,preview:r.preview,
  errors:r.errors.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key}),
  detail:{repaired:r.detail.repaired,batches:r.detail.batches,deadline_hit:r.detail.deadline_hit,
   compensation:c?{status:c.status,reason:c.reason,scanned:c.scanned,produced:c.produced,existing:c.existing}:null},
  items:r.items};
}

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const previewRaw=new URL(request.url).searchParams.getAll('preview');
 if(previewRaw.length>1||(previewRaw.length===1&&previewRaw[0]!=='1'))return err('invalid_parameter:preview','preview must be 1, given at most once',400);
 const preview=previewRaw.length===1;
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false})??(preview?'preview':null);
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const receipt=await runSettle(productionJudgmentDeps({codeVersion,actor:'cron',triggeredBy:'cron'}),{preview,deadlineMs:DEADLINE_MS});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success'||receipt.status==='preview',preview,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){
  return err(e instanceof JudgmentError?e.code:'settle_failed','Judgment settlement failed',500);   // code only: no message leaves the server
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

- [ ] **Step 17: 写脚本 `scripts/judgments/settle.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Judgment settlement from the command line (spec §7.1); same core as /api/cron/judgments-settle.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/settle.ts [--apply] [--deadline-ms n]
 *
 * Default is a preview: reads the due queue (no claim, no lease, no batch, no writes), runs the resolvers and
 * prints the decisions it would take. --apply runs the real core (repair_stale_batches, compensation scan,
 * batch dataset judgments.settle with triggered_by script, settlements as actor 'script') and needs a code
 * version (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git checkout). --deadline-ms defaults to 280000 (the cron budget);
 * claiming stops at 200 s or when the remaining budget is under the batch worst case + 30 s.
 * Exit 0 on success or preview, 1 when the applied batch is not success, 2 on bad arguments.
 * tsx does NOT load .env.local: use node --env-file as above (never commit that file).
 */
import {productionJudgmentDeps,resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/judgments/deps';
import {DEADLINE_MS,runSettle} from '../../src/lib/judgments/settle';

const USAGE='usage: settle.ts [--apply] [--deadline-ms n]';
interface Args{apply:boolean;deadlineMs:number}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={apply:false,deadlineMs:DEADLINE_MS};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else if(x==='--deadline-ms'){const v=argv[++i];if(v===undefined||!/^\d{1,7}$/.test(v)){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}a.deadlineMs=Number(v);}
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(a.deadlineMs<1000){console.error('--deadline-ms must be at least 1000');process.exit(2);}
 return a;
}

async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})??(args.apply?null:'preview');
 if(!codeVersion){console.error('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');process.exit(2);}
 const receipt=await runSettle(productionJudgmentDeps({codeVersion,actor:'script',triggeredBy:'script'}),{preview:!args.apply,deadlineMs:args.deadlineMs});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:args.apply?'apply':'preview (nothing written; pass --apply to settle)',codeVersion,...receipt},null,1));
 process.exit(args.apply&&receipt.status!=='success'?1:0);
}

main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/settle.integration.test.ts
// F4 Task 14 (spec §14.3, acceptance 5) on real PostgreSQL: pgJudgmentsDb + pgTableClient, synthetic K-line
// fixtures served through a stub inputs db, the real price_return resolver with a verified capability stub, and a
// hand-built synthetic_price_return@v1 methodology synced through syncMethodology. Cases (in order; they share the
// fixture array and the methodology): two cron passes (inserted > 0, then an empty claim and an idle success);
// void(1) → admin reopened(2) → data arrives → settled(3); settled(1) → withdrawn(2) → reopened(3) → settled(4) with
// calibration validity revision + 1 at each admin transition and no claim while withdrawn (acceptance 5); an
// inconsistency quarantined on real dq tables and voided as unresolved_inconsistency on the next pass (settle_by
// is long past). The database is shared with other suites: every case registers its due judgments AND claims them
// inside withClaimLock (Task 4: pg_advisory_lock(F4_CLAIM_LOCK); Tasks 3/4/16 take the same lock), and claimDue is
// additionally wrapped so only this file's judgments are processed and any other due row is released untouched.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {withClaimLock} from './db-contract';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import {pgJudgmentsDb} from './pg-judgments-db';
import {resolverFor} from './resolvers';
import {PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION,priceReturnResolverWith} from './resolvers/price';
import {runSettle} from './settle';
import type {SettleReceipt} from './settle';
import {TEST_CODE_VERSION,TEST_METHOD,fixtureKline,loadKlineFixture,priceJudgment,stubInputsDb,testMethodologyRow,truncateFixture,verifiedCapability,withOverrides} from './testing/fixtures';
import type {KlineFixture,PriceJudgmentSpec} from './testing/fixtures';
import type {JudgmentsDb,QueueRow,SettlementKind} from './types';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const ADMIN=randomUUID();

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('F4 settlement core on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 let pool:Pool;let db:JudgmentsDb;let tables:TableClient;let batchId:string;
 const mine=new Set<string>();
 const full=loadKlineFixture('synthetic-us-zza.json');
 const fixtures:KlineFixture[]=[full];
 const inputsDb=stubInputsDb({kline:fixtureKline(fixtures),issuerPrimarySecurity:async()=>({ticker:'ZZA',market:'US'})});
 const price=priceReturnResolverWith({capabilityOf:verifiedCapability});
 /** Only this file's judgments are processed; other suites' due rows go back untouched. */
 const ownDb=()=>withOverrides<JudgmentsDb>(db,{async claimDue(limit:number,lease:number){
  const rows=await db.claimDue(limit,lease);const own:QueueRow[]=[];
  for(const r of rows){
   if(mine.has(r.judgment_id))own.push(r);
   else await db.releaseLease(r.judgment_id,r.lease_token!,{last_status:r.last_status??'pending',last_detail:r.last_detail,next_attempt_at:r.next_attempt_at,attempts_increment:0});
  }
  return own;
 }});
 const settle=():Promise<SettleReceipt>=>runSettle({db:ownDb(),inputsDb,tables,codeVersion:TEST_CODE_VERSION,actor:'script',triggeredBy:'script',compensate:null,
  resolverFor:name=>name==='price_return'?price:resolverFor(name)},{deadlineMs:280_000});
 const register=async(spec:Partial<PriceJudgmentSpec>={})=>{
  const {insert,queue}=priceJudgment({baseDate:'2026-01-12',registeredClose:106,batchId,...spec});
  await db.registerJudgment(insert,queue);mine.add(insert.judgment_id);return insert.judgment_id;
 };
 const history=async(id:string)=>(await db.settlementsOf([id])).sort((a,b)=>a.seq-b.seq).map(s=>[s.seq,s.kind,s.reason] as [number,SettlementKind,string|null]);
 const admin=(id:string,kind:'reopened'|'withdrawn',reason:string,seq:number)=>db.appendSettlement(id,null,`it-${kind}-${seq}-${id}`,{kind,outcome:null,realized:null,
  evidence:{note:'settle.integration'},resolver:'price_return',resolver_version:PRICE_RESOLVER_VERSION,reason,actor:`admin:${ADMIN}`,code_version:TEST_CODE_VERSION,batch_id:batchId});
 const revision=async()=>(await db.calibrationValidity(TEST_METHOD.id,TEST_METHOD.version)).revision;

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  pool=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl});
  db=pgJudgmentsDb(pool);tables=pgTableClient(pool);
  ({batchId}=await startBatch(tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.produce.synthetic_price_return',codeVersion:TEST_CODE_VERSION}));
  await db.syncMethodology(testMethodologyRow(),'script','settle.integration');
 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibration.ts
export const ALGORITHM_VERSION='judgments-calibration/1';
export const HOLDOUT_MIN=20, DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_N=100, DEFAULT_ECE_MAX=0.10, DEFAULT_WINDOW_YEARS=3, DEFAULT_EMBARGO_DAYS=0, RELIABILITY_BINS=10;
export const MARGIN_BINS:readonly (readonly [number,number])[];            // [[0,5],[5,15],[15,100]]
export type CohortLifecycle='open'|'settled'|'void'|'withdrawn';
export type Forecast={kind:'probability';p:number}|{kind:'categorical';selected:string;margin_pp:number|null}|{kind:'score';value:number}|{kind:'interval';low:number;high:number;nominal_coverage:number};
export interface CohortEntry{judgment_id:string;subject_type:string;subject_key:string;market:PriceMarket|null;as_of:string;window_end:string;retrospective:boolean;lifecycle:CohortLifecycle;settlement_id:string|null;forecast:Forecast;y:number|string|null}
export interface EvaluatedEntry extends CohortEntry{group:string;sample:boolean;selected_for_independent:boolean}
export interface CalibrationOptions{threshold_n:number;ece_max:number;embargo_days:number}
export interface Evaluation{state:Exclude<CalibrationState,'self_assessed'>;n_registered:number;n_settled:number;n_independent:number;n_void:number;n_retrospective_excluded:number;metrics:Record<string,unknown>;reliability:ReliabilityBin[];isotonic_segments:IsotonicSegment[]|null;entries:EvaluatedEntry[]}
export function addDays(iso:string,n:number):string;
export function windowEndOf(target:Target):string;
export function settledWindowEndOf(j:JudgmentRow,s:SettlementRow|null):string;
export function optionsOf(params:Record<string,number|string>):CalibrationOptions&{window_years:number};
export function entryOf(e:Envelope):CohortEntry|null;
export function groupOf(e:Pick<CohortEntry,'subject_type'|'subject_key'>):string;
export function selectIndependent(samples:CohortEntry[],embargoDays:number):Set<string>;
export function ece(pairs:{p:number;y:number}[]):number|null;
export function brierParts(pairs:{p:number;y:number}[]):{brier:number|null;climatology:number|null;skill:number|null};
export function reliabilityBins(pairs:{p:number;y:number}[]):ReliabilityBin[];
export function averageRanks(vals:number[]):number[];
export function spearman(xs:number[],ys:number[]):number|null;

// src/lib/judgments/testing/envelopes.ts (test-only)
export const uuidOf:(n:number)=>string; export const ISSUER:string; export const BATCH:string;
export function methodologyRow(p?:Partial<MethodologyRow>):MethodologyRow;
export function methodologyEvent(p?:Partial<MethodologyEvent>):MethodologyEvent;

export interface EnvelopeSpec{judgment?:Partial<JudgmentRow>&{n?:number};settlement?:Partial<SettlementRow>|null;calibration?:Partial<CalibrationRow>|null;calibration_valid?:boolean;methodology_state?:Partial<MethodologyEvent>|null}
export function envelope(p?:EnvelopeSpec):Envelope;
```

**度量与门控的精确定义**（实现与 Python 预言机逐条一致；`metrics` 的键集合由测试严格比对）：
- cohort = 传入的全部条目；`settled` = `lifecycle='settled'`；样本 = `settled ∧ ¬retrospective ∧ y≠null`；`n_total` = 样本数（只报告，不门控）。
- 独立样本：按 `groupOf = subject_type:subject_key` 分流，流内按 `(as_of, judgment_id)` 升序，取第一条，之后只取 `as_of > 上一条选中的 window_end + embargo_days` 的条目（贪心、确定性）。`window_end` 由 `settledWindowEndOf(judgment, settlement)`（计划审计 P1-09）：已结算的 `price_return` 判断取结算冻结证据的实际终点 bar 日期 `realized.to`（节假日 / 停牌使 n 个交易日超出任何自然日估计）；其余取 `windowEndOf(target)`：`date` → 该日；`period` → 月末；`fiscal_period` → `period_end`；`session_index` → `base_date + ceil(n×1.52)` 天（只是未结算判断的扫描窗口估计，不是上界；未结算判断不是样本，不参与抽样）。
- 所有指标只在独立样本上算（按 `(as_of, judgment_id)` 排序后从左到右求和），`correlated` 子对象给全体样本的参考值。
- probability：`brier = mean((p−y)²)`；`brier_climatology = mean((ȳ−y)²)`；`brier_skill = 1 − brier/climatology`，分母 0 → `null`；10 个等宽箱，箱号 `min(9, floor(p×10))`，每箱 `{bin_low:i/10, bin_high:(i+1)/10, n, mean_p, hit_rate, wilson_low, wilson_high}`（`wilson` 来自 fan-out，95%，结果已 round6；空箱 `mean_p/hit_rate/wilson_*` 为 `null`）；`ece_raw = Σ (n_b/n)|mean_p_b − hit_b|`。时间外留出：训练段 = 前 `floor(7n/10)` 条，其余为留出段；`boundary` = 训练段 `window_end` 最大值（跨主体）；留出段剔除 `as_of ≤ boundary` 的条目（`n_dropped_overlap`）；剔除后不足 `HOLDOUT_MIN=20` → `ece_raw_holdout / brier_holdout / brier_skill_holdout / ece_mapped_holdout` 全为 `null`；否则 `ece_mapped_holdout` = 用 `isotonicFit(训练段)` 经 `applyIsotonic` 映射留出段后的 ECE（只报告）。`isotonic_segments` = 训练段拟合（独立样本为 0 时 `null`）。状态：`n_independent < threshold_n` 或 `ece_raw_holdout = null` → `insufficient`；`ece_raw_holdout ≤ ece_max ∧ brier_skill_holdout > 0` → `calibrated`；否则 `failed`。
- categorical：`accuracy` = `selected = y` 的比例 + Wilson；`majority_class` = 独立样本实现类别中最多者（并列取字典序最小），`majority_rate` = 其占比；`confusion[selected][realized]`；`margin_bins`：`margin_pp` 非 null 时 `<5` 进 [0,5)、`5 ≤ m < 15` 进 [5,15)、`≥ 15` 进 [15,100]（含 >100）；`n_missing_margin`。状态：样本不足 → `insufficient`；`Wilson 下界 > majority_rate` → `calibrated`；否则 `failed`。`reliability = []`。
- score：`spearman`（平均秩处理并列；n<2 或零方差 → null）；三分位按 `(value, judgment_id)` 排序后 `floor(3i/n)` 分组，每组 `{tertile, n, value_min, value_max, realized_mean, hit_rate}`，实现指标全为 0/1 时 `hit_rate` 带 Wilson，否则 `null`。状态只有 `insufficient | evaluated`。
- interval：`coverage = mean(low ≤ y ≤ high)` + Wilson；`nominal_coverage` = 独立样本名义覆盖的均值；`coverage_gap = coverage − nominal`；`width_median`；基准宽度 = 每个主体（独立样本 ≥ 2 条）实现值的 type-7 分位区间 `q((1+c)/2) − q((1−c)/2)`，`baseline_width_median` = 各样本所属主体基准宽度的中位数；`width_ratio = width_median / baseline_width_median`（缺或为 0 → null）。状态：`|gap| ≤ ece_max ∧ width_ratio ≤ 1` → `calibrated`，否则 `failed`。

**规格偏差（记入实施记录）：**
1. 留出段的 `brier_skill_holdout` 用留出段自身的 ȳ 作气候基准（与 §8.1 `brier_climatology` 的"同一样本 ȳ"定义一致）。
2. 已结算 `price_return` 判断的目标窗口终点取结算 `realized.to`（冻结证据里的实际终点 bar 日期）；`ceil(n×1.52)` 只是扫描窗口（非上界），只用于没有实际终点的判断（规格第 7 稿 §8.2；计划审计 P1-09）。
3. 留出段边界取训练段全部样本 `window_end` 的最大值（跨主体，保守）。
4. interval 的 `scenarios` 逐情景 probability 评估 v1 不做：v1 没有 interval 方法，情景事件定义归公司规格；`metrics` 不含该键，公司规格登记首个 interval 方法时以新 `ALGORITHM_VERSION` 补。
5. §14.1 要求期望值"用 `sklearn.calibration.calibration_curve` + 手写 Brier 算出"：本机 `python3 -I -c "import sklearn"` 与 `import numpy` 均 `ModuleNotFoundError`（2026-11-06 实测），所以预言机是纯 Python，手写 Wilson、PAV、分箱并逐个注明对应的 fan-out 函数；没有 sklearn 交叉核对。降级路径：若日后环境有 sklearn，在 `expected.py` 末尾追加一个只打印到 stderr 的 `calibration_curve(y, p, n_bins=10, strategy='uniform')` 对照，不改 JSON。
6. `market` 维度只取 `price_return` 条件的 `params.market`（方法 `markets` 声明的是价格市场）；其他 resolver 的判断不进任何 `market` 分层。

- [ ] **Step 1: 写外部预言机 `expected.py`（原样，不得修改）**

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# fixtures/judgments/calibration/expected.py
# Independent oracle for src/lib/judgments/calibration.ts (spec §8.1, §8.2, §8.4, §8.5, §14.1).
# Plain Python 3 (no numpy / sklearn): run `python3 -I fixtures/judgments/calibration/expected.py`
# and it prints expected.json to stdout. The TypeScript test reads only the JSON; this script is the
# provenance of every expected number and was written and run by someone other than the implementer.
#
# Entry encoding (compact, shared with the test): [id, subject, as_of, window_end, lifecycle, retro, forecast, y]
#   id       int  -> judgment_id '00000000-0000-4000-8000-' + 12-digit zero-padded id
#   subject  str  -> '<subject_type>:<subject_key>'
#   as_of, window_end  int day offsets from 2024-01-01 (UTC dates)
#   lifecycle 's' settled | 'o' open | 'v' void | 'w' withdrawn
#   retro    0|1
#   forecast probability: p | categorical: [selected, margin_pp|None] | score: value | interval: [low, high, nominal]
#   y        probability: 0|1 | categorical: realized class | score/interval: realized number | None (not settled)
import datetime
import json
import math
import sys

BASE = datetime.date(2024, 1, 1)
def iso(d): return (BASE + datetime.timedelta(days=d)).isoformat()

def round6(v): return math.floor(v * 1e6 + 0.5) / 1e6          # JS Math.round(v*1e6)/1e6

def wilson(k, n):                                                # = src/lib/research/fanout/calibration.ts::wilson
    if n <= 0: return {'low': None, 'high': None}
    z = 1.959964; p = k / n; z2 = z * z
    centre = (p + z2 / (2 * n)) / (1 + z2 / n)
    half = (z * math.sqrt((p * (1 - p)) / n + z2 / (4 * n * n))) / (1 + z2 / n)
    return {'low': round6(max(0, centre - half)), 'high': round6(min(1, centre + half))}

def isotonic_fit(points):                                        # = fanout isotonicFit (PAV, equal scores pooled, round6, equal-p merge)
    by = {}
    for s, h in points:
        b = by.setdefault(s, [0, 0]); b[0] += h; b[1] += 1
    blocks = []
    for s in sorted(by):
        sm, n = by[s]; blocks.append([sm, n, s, s])
        while len(blocks) > 1:
            last, prev = blocks[-1], blocks[-2]
            if prev[0] / prev[1] <= last[0] / last[1]: break
            blocks[-2:] = [[prev[0] + last[0], prev[1] + last[1], prev[2], last[3]]]
    segs = []
    for sm, n, lo, hi in blocks:
        p = round6(sm / n)
        if segs and segs[-1]['p'] == p: segs[-1]['x_max'] = hi
        else: segs.append({'x_min': lo, 'x_max': hi, 'p': p})
    return segs

def apply_isotonic(segs, x):                                     # = fanout applyIsotonic
    if not segs: return None
    if x <= segs[0]['x_min']: return segs[0]['p']
    if x >= segs[-1]['x_max']: return segs[-1]['p']
    for i, s in enumerate(segs):
        if s['x_min'] <= x <= s['x_max']: return s['p']
        if i + 1 < len(segs) and s['x_max'] < x < segs[i + 1]['x_min']:
            t = (x - s['x_max']) / (segs[i + 1]['x_min'] - s['x_max'])
            return round6(s['p'] + t * (segs[i + 1]['p'] - s['p']))
    return segs[-1]['p']

def lsum(xs):
    """Left-to-right sum: the TypeScript reduce order, and independent of Python's float sum() algorithm (3.12+ compensates)."""
    t = 0
    for x in xs: t += x
    return t

def mean(xs): return None if not xs else lsum(xs) / len(xs)
def bin_of(p): return min(9, math.floor(p * 10))

def ece(pairs):
    if not pairs: return None
    bins = [[0, 0.0, 0] for _ in range(10)]
    for p, y in pairs:
        b = bins[bin_of(p)]; b[0] += 1; b[1] += p; b[2] += y
    total = 0.0
    for n, sp, sy in bins:
        if n: total += (n / len(pairs)) * abs(sp / n - sy / n)
    return total

def brier_parts(pairs):
    if not pairs: return None, None, None
    ys = [y for _, y in pairs]; ybar = mean(ys)
    brier = mean([(p - y) ** 2 for p, y in pairs])
    clim = mean([(ybar - y) ** 2 for y in ys])
    skill = None if clim == 0 else 1 - brier / clim
    return brier, clim, skill

def reliability(pairs):
    out = []
    for i in range(10):
        inb = [(p, y) for p, y in pairs if bin_of(p) == i]
        n = len(inb); k = lsum(y for _, y in inb); w = wilson(k, n)
        out.append({'bin_low': i / 10, 'bin_high': (i + 1) / 10, 'n': n,
                    'mean_p': None if n == 0 else lsum(p for p, _ in inb) / n,
                    'hit_rate': None if n == 0 else k / n, 'wilson_low': w['low'], 'wilson_high': w['high']})
    return out

def select_independent(samples, embargo):
    groups = {}
    for s in samples: groups.setdefault(s['subject'], []).append(s)
    chosen = set()
    for g in groups.values():
        last_end = None
        for s in sorted(g, key=lambda s: (s['as_of'], s['id'])):
            if last_end is None or s['as_of'] > last_end + embargo:
                chosen.add(s['id']); last_end = s['window_end']
    return chosen

def quantile7(xs, q):
    xs = sorted(xs); h = (len(xs) - 1) * q; lo = math.floor(h)
    if lo + 1 >= len(xs): return xs[lo]
    return xs[lo] + (h - lo) * (xs[lo + 1] - xs[lo])

def median(xs):
    if not xs: return None
    xs = sorted(xs); n = len(xs)
    return xs[n // 2] if n % 2 else (xs[n // 2 - 1] + xs[n // 2]) / 2

def avg_ranks(vals):
    order = sorted(range(len(vals)), key=lambda i: vals[i]); r = [0.0] * len(vals); i = 0
    while i < len(order):
        j = i
        while j + 1 < len(order) and vals[order[j + 1]] == vals[order[i]]: j += 1
        for t in range(i, j + 1): r[order[t]] = (i + j) / 2 + 1
        i = j + 1
    return r

def spearman(xs, ys):
    if len(xs) < 2: return None
    rx, ry = avg_ranks(xs), avg_ranks(ys); mx, my = mean(rx), mean(ry)
    num = lsum((a - mx) * (b - my) for a, b in zip(rx, ry))
    den = math.sqrt(lsum((a - mx) ** 2 for a in rx) * lsum((b - my) ** 2 for b in ry))
    return None if den == 0 else num / den

HOLDOUT_MIN = 20

def evaluate(kind, entries, opts):
    E = [dict(id=e[0], subject=e[1], as_of=e[2], window_end=e[3], life=e[4], retro=e[5], f=e[6], y=e[7]) for e in entries]
    settled = [e for e in E if e['life'] == 's']
    samples = [e for e in settled if not e['retro'] and e['y'] is not None]
    chosen = select_independent(samples, opts['embargo_days'])
    ind = sorted([s for s in samples if s['id'] in chosen], key=lambda s: (s['as_of'], s['id']))
    counts = {'n_registered': len(E), 'n_settled': len(settled), 'n_independent': len(ind),
              'n_void': lsum(1 for e in E if e['life'] == 'v'),
              'n_retrospective_excluded': lsum(1 for e in settled if e['retro'])}
    thr, emax = opts['threshold_n'], opts['ece_max']; n = len(ind)
    rel, iso_segs = [], None
    if kind == 'probability':
        pairs = [(s['f'], s['y']) for s in ind]
        b, c, sk = brier_parts(pairs); k = lsum(y for _, y in pairs); w = wilson(k, n)
        allp = [(s['f'], s['y']) for s in samples]; ab, _, _ = brier_parts(allp)
        ntr = (7 * n) // 10; train, hold_raw = ind[:ntr], ind[ntr:]
        boundary = max((s['window_end'] for s in train), default=None)
        hold = [s for s in hold_raw if boundary is None or s['as_of'] > boundary]
        hp = [(s['f'], s['y']) for s in hold]
        segs = isotonic_fit([(s['f'], s['y']) for s in train]) if train else None
        if len(hold) >= HOLDOUT_MIN:
            hb, _, hsk = brier_parts(hp); he = ece(hp)
            hm = ece([(apply_isotonic(segs, p), y) for p, y in hp]) if segs else None
        else:
            hb = hsk = he = hm = None
        metrics = {'n_total': len(samples), 'base_rate': None if n == 0 else k / n, 'brier': b, 'brier_climatology': c,
                   'brier_skill': sk, 'ece_raw': ece(pairs),
                   'hit_rate': None if n == 0 else {'rate': k / n, 'low': w['low'], 'high': w['high']},
                   'correlated': {'n': len(samples), 'brier': ab, 'ece_raw': ece(allp)},
                   'temporal_split': {'n_train': len(train), 'n_holdout': len(hold), 'n_dropped_overlap': len(hold_raw) - len(hold),
                                      'boundary': None if boundary is None else iso(boundary), 'ece_raw_holdout': he,
                                      'brier_holdout': hb, 'brier_skill_holdout': hsk, 'ece_mapped_holdout': hm}}
        rel = reliability(pairs); iso_segs = segs if n > 0 else None
        if n < thr or he is None: state = 'insufficient'
        elif he <= emax and hsk is not None and hsk > 0: state = 'calibrated'
        else: state = 'failed'
    elif kind == 'categorical':
        hits = [1 if s['f'][0] == s['y'] else 0 for s in ind]; k = lsum(hits); w = wilson(k, n)
        freq = {}
        for s in ind: freq[s['y']] = freq.get(s['y'], 0) + 1
        maj = min(freq, key=lambda c: (-freq[c], c)) if freq else None
        conf = {}
        for s in ind:
            row = conf.setdefault(s['f'][0], {}); row[s['y']] = row.get(s['y'], 0) + 1
        bins = []
        for lo, hi in [(0, 5), (5, 15), (15, 100)]:
            inb = [s for s in ind if s['f'][1] is not None and (lo == 0 or s['f'][1] >= lo) and (hi == 100 or s['f'][1] < hi)]
            kb = lsum(1 for s in inb if s['f'][0] == s['y']); wb = wilson(kb, len(inb))
            bins.append({'bin_low': lo, 'bin_high': hi, 'n': len(inb), 'accuracy': None if not inb else kb / len(inb),
                         'wilson_low': wb['low'], 'wilson_high': wb['high']})
        allhits = [1 if s['f'][0] == s['y'] else 0 for s in samples]
        metrics = {'n_total': len(samples), 'accuracy': None if n == 0 else k / n,
                   'accuracy_wilson': {'low': w['low'], 'high': w['high']}, 'majority_class': maj,
                   'majority_rate': None if n == 0 else freq[maj] / n, 'confusion': conf, 'margin_bins': bins,
                   'n_missing_margin': lsum(1 for s in ind if s['f'][1] is None),
                   'correlated': {'n': len(samples), 'accuracy': mean(allhits)}}
        if n < thr: state = 'insufficient'
        elif w['low'] is not None and w['low'] > metrics['majority_rate']: state = 'calibrated'
        else: state = 'failed'
    elif kind == 'score':
        xs = [s['f'] for s in ind]; ys = [s['y'] for s in ind]
        srt = sorted(ind, key=lambda s: (s['f'], s['id'])); terts = []
        binary = n > 0 and all(y in (0, 1) for y in ys)
        for t in range(3):
            g = [s for i, s in enumerate(srt) if (3 * i) // n == t] if n else []
            kk = lsum(s['y'] for s in g); ww = wilson(kk, len(g)) if binary else None
            terts.append({'tertile': t + 1, 'n': len(g), 'value_min': min((s['f'] for s in g), default=None),
                          'value_max': max((s['f'] for s in g), default=None), 'realized_mean': mean([s['y'] for s in g]),
                          'hit_rate': {'rate': kk / len(g), 'low': ww['low'], 'high': ww['high']} if binary and g else None})
        metrics = {'n_total': len(samples), 'spearman': spearman(xs, ys), 'tertiles': terts,
                   'correlated': {'n': len(samples), 'spearman': spearman([s['f'] for s in samples], [s['y'] for s in samples])}}
        state = 'insufficient' if n < thr else 'evaluated'
    else:
        cov = [1 if s['f'][0] <= s['y'] <= s['f'][1] else 0 for s in ind]; k = lsum(cov); w = wilson(k, n)
        nominal = mean([s['f'][2] for s in ind]); coverage = mean(cov)
        widths = [s['f'][1] - s['f'][0] for s in ind]
        groups = {}
        for s in ind: groups.setdefault(s['subject'], []).append(s['y'])
        base = {}
        if nominal is not None:
            for g, vals in groups.items():
                if len(vals) >= 2: base[g] = quantile7(vals, (1 + nominal) / 2) - quantile7(vals, (1 - nominal) / 2)
        bl = [base[s['subject']] for s in ind if s['subject'] in base]
        wm, bm = median(widths), median(bl)
        ratio = None if wm is None or bm is None or bm == 0 else wm / bm
        allcov = [1 if s['f'][0] <= s['y'] <= s['f'][1] else 0 for s in samples]
        metrics = {'n_total': len(samples), 'coverage': coverage, 'coverage_wilson': {'low': w['low'], 'high': w['high']},
                   'nominal_coverage': nominal, 'coverage_gap': None if coverage is None else coverage - nominal,
                   'width_median': wm, 'baseline_width_median': bm, 'width_ratio': ratio,
                   'correlated': {'n': len(samples), 'coverage': mean(allcov)}}
        if n < thr: state = 'insufficient'
        elif abs(metrics['coverage_gap']) <= emax and ratio is not None and ratio <= 1: state = 'calibrated'
        else: state = 'failed'
    return {'state': state, **counts, 'metrics': metrics, 'reliability': rel, 'isotonic_segments': iso_segs,
            'selected': sorted(s['id'] for s in ind)}

def lcg(seed):
    x = seed
    while True:
        x = (1103515245 * x + 12345) % 2147483648
        yield x / 2147483648

def seq(id0, subject, n, p_of, y_of, step=2, span=1, start=0):
    """Block of n settled, non-retrospective entries of one subject: id = id0 + i, as_of = start + step*i, window_end = as_of + span."""
    return {'seq': [id0, subject, start, step, span], 'f': [p_of(i) for i in range(n)], 'y': [y_of(i) for i in range(n)]}

def expand(blocks):
    out = []
    for b in blocks:
        if isinstance(b, dict):
            id0, subject, start, step, span = b['seq']
            out += [[id0 + i, subject, start + step * i, start + step * i + span, 's', 0, f, y] for i, (f, y) in enumerate(zip(b['f'], b['y']))]
        else: out.append(b)
    return out

O = lambda thr=100, emax=0.10, emb=0: {'threshold_n': thr, 'ece_max': emax, 'embargo_days': emb}
cases = []
def case(name, kind, blocks, opts, note):
    cases.append({'name': name, 'kind': kind, 'opts': opts, 'note': note, 'blocks': blocks, 'entries': expand(blocks)})
def derive(name, base, drop, opts, note):
    b = next(c for c in cases if c['name'] == base)
    cases.append({'name': name, 'kind': b['kind'], 'opts': opts, 'note': note, 'derive': {'from': base, 'drop': drop},
                  'entries': [e for e in b['entries'] if e[0] not in set(drop)]})

A8 = lambda i: 0.8 if i % 10 < 5 else 0.2                       # two groups, true hit rates 0.8 and 0.2
Y8 = lambda i: 1 if i % 10 < 4 or i % 10 == 5 else 0
case('perfect_forecast', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 10, lambda i: 1 - i % 2, lambda i: 1 - i % 2)], O(),
     'p equals the outcome: Brier 0, skill 1, ECE 0')
case('constant_half', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 10, lambda i: 0.5, lambda i: i % 2)], O(),
     'p = 0.5 with half hits: Brier 0.25 = climatology, skill 0')
case('constant_half_all_hits', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 10, lambda i: 0.5, lambda i: 1)], O(),
     'all hits: climatology 0, so skill is null (zero denominator)')
P = [0.05, 0.15, 0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.62, 0.78, 0.85, 0.97, 1.0]; r1 = lcg(7); U1 = [next(r1) for _ in range(50)]
case('skill_and_bins', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 50, lambda i: P[i % 10], lambda i: 1 if U1[i] < P[i % 10] else 0)], O(),
     'ten equal bins, p = 1.0 lands in the last bin, bin [0.2,0.3) stays empty (null hit rate), Wilson per bin')
case('ece_holdout', 'probability',
     [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 56, A8, Y8), seq(57, 'issuer:S1', 24, lambda i: 0.8 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.2, lambda i: 1 - i % 2, start=112)], O(50),
     'first 70% calibrated, last 30% under-confident: ece_raw differs from ece_raw_holdout 0.2 -> failed')
case('boundary_overlap', 'probability',
     [[1, 'issuer:B', 0, 220, 's', 0, 0.7, 1], seq(2, 'issuer:A', 100, A8, Y8, step=3)], O(),
     "holdout samples whose as_of falls inside a training target window (issuer B's ends on day 220) are dropped")
r2 = lcg(11); U2 = [next(r2) for _ in range(300)]
case('macro_daily_91', 'probability',
     [seq(1, 'macro_region:US', 200, lambda i: 0.6, lambda i: 1 if U2[i] < 0.6 else 0, step=1, span=90),
      seq(1001, 'macro_region:CN', 100, lambda i: 0.4, lambda i: 1 if U2[200 + i] < 0.4 else 0, step=1, span=90)], O(),
     'daily as_of with 91-day target windows: one independent sample per 91 days per region (US days 0/91/182, CN 0/91)')
case('same_stock_dedup', 'probability',
     [seq(1, 'issuer:X', 10, lambda i: 0.7, lambda i: 1 if i % 3 else 0, step=1, span=4),
      seq(101, 'issuer:Y', 10, lambda i: 0.3, lambda i: 1 if i == 4 else 0, step=1, span=0)], O(),
     'daily calls on one stock with 5-day windows keep days 0 and 5; same-day windows on another stock keep all ten')
case('embargo_0', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:Z', 10, lambda i: 0.5, lambda i: i % 2, step=11, span=9)], O(),
     'windows of 10 days every 11 days do not overlap: all ten independent')
derive('embargo_2', 'embargo_0', [], O(100, 0.10, 2), 'embargo_days = 2: the next as_of must be after window_end + 2 days, so every other one')
case('g01_counterexample', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 100, lambda i: 0.92 if i % 10 < 5 else 0.32, Y8)], O(),
     'raw p is 0.12 off in both groups: ece_raw_holdout 0.12 > 0.10 while the isotonic-mapped holdout ECE is ~0 -> failed (the gate tests raw p)')
extra = [[901, 'issuer:S1', 300, 301, 'o', 0, 0.8, None], [902, 'issuer:S1', 302, 303, 'o', 0, 0.2, None],
         [903, 'issuer:S1', 304, 305, 'v', 0, 0.8, None], [904, 'issuer:S1', 306, 307, 'v', 0, 0.2, None], [905, 'issuer:S1', 308, 309, 'v', 0, 0.8, None],
         [906, 'issuer:S1', 310, 311, 'w', 0, 0.8, None],
         [907, 'issuer:S1', 1, 1, 's', 1, 0.8, 0], [908, 'issuer:S1', 3, 3, 's', 1, 0.2, 1], [909, 'issuer:S1', 5, 5, 's', 1, 0.8, 0], [910, 'issuer:S1', 7, 7, 's', 1, 0.2, 1]]
case('acceptance4_100', 'probability', [seq(1, 'issuer:S1', 100, A8, Y8)] + extra, O(),
     'acceptance example 4: 100 independent samples, holdout raw ECE ~0 and skill > 0 -> calibrated; open/void/withdrawn/retrospective rows are only counted')
derive('acceptance4_99', 'acceptance4_100', [100], O(), 'acceptance example 4: the same cohort without its last sample: 99 independent -> insufficient')
C4 = ['recovery', 'overheat', 'stagflation', 'recession']; r3 = lcg(5); U3 = [next(r3) for _ in range(40)]
case('categorical_calibrated', 'categorical',
     [seq(1, 'macro_region:US', 40, lambda i: [C4[i % 4], [2.5, 7.0, 15.0, None, 30.0][i % 5]], lambda i: C4[i % 4] if U3[i] < 0.9 else C4[(i + 1) % 4])], O(20),
     'accuracy ~0.9 against a majority baseline ~0.3: Wilson low above majority_rate -> calibrated; margin_pp bins [0,5) [5,15) [15,100], one margin missing per 5')
case('categorical_failed', 'categorical',
     [seq(1, 'macro_region:US', 30, lambda i: ['recovery', 4.0], lambda i: 'recovery' if i % 10 < 7 else 'recession')], O(20),
     'always predicting the majority class: accuracy 0.7 = majority_rate, Wilson low below it -> failed')
r4 = lcg(3); RV = [round(next(r4) * 20 - 10, 3) for _ in range(30)]
case('interval_failed', 'interval',
     [seq(1, 'issuer:A', 15, lambda i: [RV[i] - 3 + (i % 3), RV[i] + 3 - (i % 2), 0.8], lambda i: RV[i] if i % 5 else RV[i] + 9),
      seq(101, 'issuer:B', 15, lambda i: [-4.0, 4.0, 0.8], lambda i: RV[15 + i])], O(20),
     'coverage 0.63 vs nominal 0.8 (gap > ece_max) -> failed; width_ratio against the per-subject empirical quantile width')
case('interval_calibrated', 'interval',
     [seq(1, 'issuer:A', 15, lambda i: [RV[i] - 1, RV[i] + 1, 0.8], lambda i: RV[i] if i % 5 else RV[i] + 5),
      seq(101, 'issuer:B', 15, lambda i: [RV[15 + i] - 1, RV[15 + i] + 1, 0.8], lambda i: RV[15 + i] if i % 5 else RV[15 + i] - 5)], O(20),
     'coverage 0.8 = nominal, narrow intervals (width_ratio < 1) -> calibrated')
case('score_ties', 'score', [seq(1, 'industry:sw:2021:801010', 30, lambda i: ((i * 7) % 10) * 10, lambda i: ((i * 3) % 7) - 3 + (i % 10) / 5)], O(20),
     'Spearman with average ranks over tied values; tertiles by value; evaluated')
derive('score_insufficient', 'score_ties', [], O(100), 'the same cohort under threshold_n = 100: insufficient')
case('score_binary', 'score', [seq(1, 'industry:sw:2021:801020', 12, lambda i: i * 5, lambda i: 1 if i >= 6 else 0)], O(5),
     'binary realized metric: tertile hit rates with Wilson')

out = {'generator': 'fixtures/judgments/calibration/expected.py', 'algorithm': 'judgments-calibration/1', 'holdout_min': HOLDOUT_MIN,
       'cases': []}
for c in cases:
    rec = {k: c[k] for k in ('name', 'kind', 'opts', 'note')}
    if 'derive' in c: rec['derive'] = c['derive']
    else: rec['blocks'] = c['blocks']
    rec['expected'] = evaluate(c['kind'], c['entries'], c['opts'])
    out['cases'].append(rec)
# One case per line so diffs stay readable; the JSON is still a single valid document.
head = json.dumps({k: out[k] for k in ('generator', 'algorithm', 'holdout_min')}, separators=(',', ':'))[:-1]
sys.stdout.write(head + ',"cases":[\n')
sys.stdout.write(',\n'.join(json.dumps(c, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) for c in out['cases']))
sys.stdout.write('\n]}\n')
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/envelopes.ts
// Test-only row builders (not imported by production code): a valid probability judgment of the
// synthetic method with every contract field set, its settlement, calibration and methodology rows,
// and the envelope that latest_judgment_cards / judgment_history / calibration_cohort* return.
// Each builder takes a partial override; ids are deterministic (uuidOf(n)).
import type {CalibrationRow,Envelope,JudgmentRow,MethodologyEvent,MethodologyRow,SettlementRow} from '../types';

export const uuidOf=(n:number)=>`00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12,'0')}`;
export const ISSUER='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
export const BATCH='22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
const HEX=(c:string)=>c.repeat(64);
const day=(iso:string,n:number)=>new Date(Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00.000Z`)+n*86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0,10);

export function methodologyRow(p:Partial<MethodologyRow>={}):MethodologyRow{
 return {methodology_id:'synthetic_fact_metric',version:'v1',judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',
  subject_types:['issuer'],input_kinds:['financial_fact'],markets:null,title_zh:'合成事实判断',title_en:'Synthetic fact judgment',
  doc_path:'docs/methodologies/synthetic_fact_metric/v1.md',doc_sha256:HEX('a'),implementation_sha256:HEX('b'),
  params:{grace_days:30,threshold_n:3,ece_max:0.1,window_years:3},params_json:{},horizon:{unit:'calendar_days',n:10},upstream:{},
  deps_sha256:HEX('c'),formula_hash:HEX('d'),status:'active',publishable:true,code_version:'abcdef1',
  created_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',synced_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',...p};
}
export function methodologyEvent(p:Partial<MethodologyEvent>={}):MethodologyEvent{
 return {event_id:uuidOf(990001),methodology_id:'synthetic_fact_metric',version:'v1',seq:1,event:'registered',status:'active',publishable:true,
  formula_hash:HEX('d'),code_version:'abcdef1',actor:'script',reason:null,occurred_at:'2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',...p};
}
/** n picks judgment_id = uuidOf(n); as_of defaults to 2026-01-01 + n days; target = as_of + 10 days. */
export function judgmentRow(p:Partial<JudgmentRow>&{n?:number}={}):JudgmentRow{
 const {n=1,...rest}=p;
 const as_of=rest.as_of??day('2026-01-01',n);
 const target=rest.target??{kind:'date' as const,date:day(as_of,10)};
 const settleAfter=`${target.kind==='date'?target.date:day(as_of,10)}T00:00:00.000Z`;
 return {judgment_id:uuidOf(n),subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:ISSUER,judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',methodology_id:'synthetic_fact_metric',methodology_version:'v1',
  kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',producer_ref:{},producer_nonce:'',as_of,registered_at:`${as_of}T12:00:00.000Z`,retrospective:false,
  inputs:[{kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:uuidOf(500000+n)},snapshot:{fact_id:uuidOf(500000+n),issuer_id:ISSUER,market:'US',concept:'revenue',period_start:'2025-07-01',period_end:'2025-09-30',duration:'3M',value_text:'100',unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:as_of,filing_id:uuidOf(600000+n),mapping_gen:1},hash:HEX('e'),available_at:`${as_of}T23:59:59.999Z`,origin:{publisher:'SEC',adapter:'edgar',locator:'companyfacts'}}],
  inputs_hash:HEX('f'),abstained:false,abstain_reason:null,claim:{p:0.7,event:{zh:'营收同比增长',en:'Revenue grows year over year'}},
  condition:{resolver:'fact_metric',params:{issuer_id:ISSUER,market:'US',metric:'revenue',period_start:'2025-10-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'3M',unit:'USD',input_unit:'USD',basis:'reported',formula_version:'metrics/1',compare:'yoy'},predicate:{op:'>',rhs:0},text:{zh:'2025Q4 营收同比 > 0',en:'2025Q4 revenue YoY > 0'}},
  horizon:{unit:'calendar_days',n:10},target,label_policy:'first_observed',settle_after:settleAfter,
  settle_by:new Date(Date.parse(settleAfter)+30*86_400_000).toISOString(),code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:BATCH,created_at:`${as_of}T12:00:00.000Z`,...rest};
}
export function settlementRow(p:Partial<SettlementRow>={}):SettlementRow{
 return {settlement_id:uuidOf(700001),judgment_id:uuidOf(1),seq:1,kind:'settled',outcome:'hit',
  realized:{value:0.12,unit:'ratio',from:'2024-10-01',to:'2025-12-31',label_policy:'first_observed'},evidence:{},resolver:'fact_metric',resolver_version:'1',
  reason:null,actor:'cron',settled_at:'2026-03-01T03:00:00.000Z',request_key:'cron:test-key-1',request_digest:HEX('1'),code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:BATCH,...p};
}
export function calibrationRow(p:Partial<CalibrationRow>={}):CalibrationRow{
 return {calibration_id:uuidOf(800001),methodology_id:'synthetic_fact_metric',methodology_version:'v1',scope_type:'all',scope_key:'',window_from:'2023-11-09',window_to:'2026-11-09',
  n_registered:140,n_settled:120,n_independent:110,n_void:5,n_retrospective_excluded:3,threshold_n:100,ece_max:0.1,kind:'probability',state:'calibrated',
  valid_until:'2026-11-23T04:00:00.000Z',validity_revision:1,
  metrics:{n_total:118,brier:0.18,brier_skill:0.21,ece_raw:0.05,hit_rate:{rate:0.64,low:0.55,high:0.72},temporal_split:{ece_raw_holdout:0.06,brier_skill_holdout:0.12}},
  reliability:[],isotonic_segments:null,cohort_path:`cohorts/${HEX('9')}.json`,cohort_sha256:HEX('9'),
  query_bounds:{window_from:'2023-11-09',window_to:'2026-11-09',registered_at_lte:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',settled_at_lte:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',frozen_at:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',n:140},
  fingerprint:HEX('8'),algorithm_version:'judgments-calibration/1',code_version:'abcdef1',computed_at:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',batch_id:BATCH,...p};
}
export interface EnvelopeSpec{judgment?:Partial<JudgmentRow>&{n?:number};settlement?:Partial<SettlementRow>|null;calibration?:Partial<CalibrationRow>|null;calibration_valid?:boolean;methodology_state?:Partial<MethodologyEvent>|null}
export function envelope(p:EnvelopeSpec={}):Envelope{
 const judgment=judgmentRow(p.judgment);
 return {judgment,
  settlement:p.settlement===null||p.settlement===undefined?null:settlementRow({judgment_id:judgment.judgment_id,...p.settlement}),
  calibration:p.calibration===null||p.calibration===undefined?null:calibrationRow(p.calibration),
  calibration_valid:p.calibration_valid??(p.calibration!==null&&p.calibration!==undefined),
  methodology_state:p.methodology_state===null?null:methodologyEvent(p.methodology_state??{})};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibration.test.ts
// spec §14.1 calibration bullets. Every expected number comes from
// fixtures/judgments/calibration/expected.json, produced by expected.py (independent plain-Python
// oracle, run by the plan author, not the implementer). The decoder below only re-expands the
// compact fixture encoding; it computes nothing.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {ALGORITHM_VERSION,HOLDOUT_MIN,addDays,averageRanks,entryOf,evaluateCohort,median,optionsOf,quantile7,selectIndependent,windowEndOf} from './calibration';
import type {CohortEntry,Forecast} from './calibration';
import {envelope,uuidOf} from './testing/envelopes';
import type {Kind} from './types';

type Raw=[number,string,number,number,'s'|'o'|'v'|'w',0|1,unknown,number|string|null];
type Block=Raw|{seq:[number,string,number,number,number];f:unknown[];y:(number|string|null)[]};
interface Case{name:string;kind:Kind;opts:{threshold_n:number;ece_max:number;embargo_days:number};note:string;blocks?:Block[];derive?:{from:string;drop:number[]};expected:Record<string,unknown>&{selected:number[]}}
const FIXTURE=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'fixtures/judgments/calibration/expected.json'),'utf8')) as {algorithm:string;holdout_min:number;cases:Case[]};
const dayOf=(d:number)=>new Date(Date.UTC(2024,0,1+d)).toISOString().slice(0,10);
const LIFE={s:'settled',o:'open',v:'void',w:'withdrawn'} as const;
const expand=(blocks:Block[]):Raw[]=>blocks.flatMap(b=>Array.isArray(b)?[b]:b.f.map((f,i):Raw=>[b.seq[0]+i,b.seq[1],b.seq[2]+b.seq[3]*i,b.seq[2]+b.seq[3]*i+b.seq[4],'s',0,f,b.y[i]]));
function forecast(kind:Kind,f:unknown):Forecast{
 if(kind==='probability')return {kind,p:f as number};
 if(kind==='categorical'){const [selected,margin]=f as [string,number|null];return {kind,selected,margin_pp:margin};}
 if(kind==='score')return {kind,value:f as number};
 const [low,high,nominal]=f as [number,number,number];return {kind,low,high,nominal_coverage:nominal};
}
function entriesOf(c:Case):CohortEntry[]{
 const raws=c.derive?expand(FIXTURE.cases.find(x=>x.name===c.derive!.from)!.blocks!).filter(r=>!c.derive!.drop.includes(r[0])):expand(c.blocks!);
 return raws.map(r=>{const i=r[1].indexOf(':');return {judgment_id:uuidOf(r[0]),subject_type:r[1].slice(0,i),subject_key:r[1].slice(i+1),market:null,as_of:dayOf(r[2]),window_end:dayOf(r[3]),retrospective:r[5]===1,lifecycle:LIFE[r[4]],settlement_id:null,forecast:forecast(c.kind,r[6]),y:r[7]};});
}
/** Numbers to 1e-9 (summation order may differ in the last bits); every other value and every key set exactly. */
function close(actual:unknown,expected:unknown,path:string):void{
 if(typeof expected==='number'){expect(typeof actual,path).toBe('number');expect(actual as number,path).toBeCloseTo(expected,9);return;}
 if(expected===null||typeof expected!=='object'){expect(actual,path).toEqual(expected);return;}
 if(Array.isArray(expected)){expect(Array.isArray(actual),path).toBe(true);expect((actual as unknown[]).length,path).toBe(expected.length);expected.forEach((v,i)=>close((actual as unknown[])[i],v,`${path}[${i}]`));return;}
 expect(actual!==null&&typeof actual==='object',path).toBe(true);
 expect(Object.keys(actual as object).sort(),path).toEqual(Object.keys(expected).sort());
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(expected))close((actual as Record<string,unknown>)[k],v,`${path}.${k}`);
}
const run=(name:string)=>{
 const c=FIXTURE.cases.find(x=>x.name===name);
 if(!c)throw new Error(`fixture case ${name} missing`);
 const ev=evaluateCohort(c.kind,entriesOf(c),c.opts);
 const {selected,...expected}=c.expected;
 const {entries,...actual}=ev;
 close(actual,expected,name);
 expect(entries.filter(e=>e.selected_for_independent).map(e=>Number(e.judgment_id.slice(24))).sort((a,b)=>a-b),`${name}.selected`).toEqual(selected);
 return ev;
};

describe('calibration fixture (independent Python oracle)',()=>{
 it('matches the algorithm version and the holdout minimum',()=>{
  expect(FIXTURE.algorithm).toBe(ALGORITHM_VERSION);
  expect(FIXTURE.holdout_min).toBe(HOLDOUT_MIN);
 });
 it('perfect forecast: Brier 0, skill 1, ECE 0',()=>{const ev=run('perfect_forecast');expect(ev.metrics.brier).toBe(0);});
 it('constant 0.5: Brier 0.25 = climatology, skill 0',()=>{const ev=run('constant_half');expect(ev.metrics.brier).toBeCloseTo(0.25,12);});
 it('zero climatology: skill is null, not a division by zero',()=>{const ev=run('constant_half_all_hits');expect(ev.metrics.brier_skill).toBeNull();});
 it('ten equal bins with Wilson intervals; an empty bin keeps null hit rate; p = 1 lands in the last bin',()=>{
  const ev=run('skill_and_bins');
  expect(ev.reliability).toHaveLength(10);
  expect(ev.reliability[2]).toMatchObject({n:0,mean_p:null,hit_rate:null,wilson_low:null,wilson_high:null});
  expect(ev.reliability[9].n).toBe(10);
 });
 it('ece_raw (all independent) differs from ece_raw_holdout (last 30%); holdout ECE 0.2 > 0.10 fails',()=>{const ev=run('ece_holdout');expect(ev.state).toBe('failed');});
 it('holdout samples overlapping a training target window are dropped',()=>{const ev=run('boundary_overlap');expect((ev.metrics.temporal_split as {n_dropped_overlap:number}).n_dropped_overlap).toBe(5);});
 it('macro daily with 91-day windows: one independent sample per 91 days per region',()=>{const ev=run('macro_daily_91');expect(ev.n_independent).toBe(5);});
 it('same-stock consecutive calls are deduplicated by window; another stock is a separate stream',()=>{run('same_stock_dedup');});
 it('embargo_days spaces the windows further',()=>{expect(run('embargo_0').n_independent).toBe(10);expect(run('embargo_2').n_independent).toBe(5);});
 it('G01 counterexample: raw holdout ECE 0.12, isotonic-mapped ≈ 0 → failed (the gate tests raw p)',()=>{
  const ev=run('g01_counterexample');
  expect(ev.state).toBe('failed');
  const t=ev.metrics.temporal_split as {ece_raw_holdout:number;ece_mapped_holdout:number};
  expect(t.ece_raw_holdout).toBeCloseTo(0.12,9);expect(t.ece_mapped_holdout).toBeLessThan(1e-9);
  expect(ev.isotonic_segments).not.toBeNull();
 });
 it('acceptance example 4: 99 independent → insufficient, 100 → calibrated; open/void/withdrawn/retrospective are counted, not sampled',()=>{
  expect(run('acceptance4_99').state).toBe('insufficient');
  const ev=run('acceptance4_100');
  expect(ev.state).toBe('calibrated');
  expect(ev).toMatchObject({n_registered:110,n_settled:104,n_independent:100,n_void:3,n_retrospective_excluded:4});
 });
 it('categorical: majority-class baseline, confusion matrix, margin_pp bins',()=>{
  expect(run('categorical_calibrated').state).toBe('calibrated');
  const failed=run('categorical_failed');
  expect(failed.state).toBe('failed');
  expect(failed.metrics.majority_rate).toBeCloseTo(0.7,12);
  expect(failed.reliability).toEqual([]);
 });
 it('interval: coverage vs nominal and width_ratio',()=>{expect(run('interval_failed').state).toBe('failed');expect(run('interval_calibrated').state).toBe('calibrated');});
 it('score: Spearman with tied ranks, tertiles, evaluated (never calibrated)',()=>{
  expect(run('score_ties').state).toBe('evaluated');
  expect(run('score_insufficient').state).toBe('insufficient');
  expect(run('score_binary').state).toBe('evaluated');
 });
 it('every fixture case is exercised by a test above',()=>{
  const used=['perfect_forecast','constant_half','constant_half_all_hits','skill_and_bins','ece_holdout','boundary_overlap','macro_daily_91','same_stock_dedup','embargo_0','embargo_2','g01_counterexample','acceptance4_99','acceptance4_100','categorical_calibrated','categorical_failed','interval_failed','interval_calibrated','score_ties','score_insufficient','score_binary'];
  expect(FIXTURE.cases.map(c=>c.name).sort()).toEqual([...used].sort());
 });
});

describe('helpers',()=>{
 it('windowEndOf per target kind (session_index uses ceil(n × 1.52) calendar days)',()=>{
  expect(windowEndOf({kind:'date',date:'2026-03-01'})).toBe('2026-03-01');
  expect(windowEndOf({kind:'period',period:'2024-02'})).toBe('2024-02-29');
  expect(windowEndOf({kind:'period',period:'2026-12'})).toBe('2026-12-31');
  expect(windowEndOf({kind:'fiscal_period',period_end:'2026-06-30',calendar:{anchor_period_end:'2026-03-31',months:3},extrapolated:true})).toBe('2026-06-30');
  expect(windowEndOf({kind:'session_index',base_date:'2026-01-02',n:5})).toBe('2026-01-10');
  expect(addDays('2024-02-28',1)).toBe('2024-02-29');
 });
 it('selectIndependent is greedy, per stream, and order-independent',()=>{
  const e=(id:number,as:string,end:string):CohortEntry=>({judgment_id:uuidOf(id),subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:'k',market:null,as_of:as,window_end:end,retrospective:false,lifecycle:'settled',settlement_id:null,forecast:{kind:'probability',p:0.5},y:1});
  const list=[e(3,'2026-01-05','2026-01-09'),e(1,'2026-01-01','2026-01-05'),e(2,'2026-01-05','2026-01-06'),e(4,'2026-01-06','2026-01-07')];
  expect([...selectIndependent(list,0)].sort()).toEqual([uuidOf(1),uuidOf(4)]);
  expect([...selectIndependent([...list].reverse(),0)].sort()).toEqual([uuidOf(1),uuidOf(4)]);
 });
 it('average ranks, type-7 quantile, median',()=>{
  expect(averageRanks([10,20,10,30])).toEqual([1.5,3,1.5,4]);
  expect(quantile7([1,2,3,4],0.9)).toBeCloseTo(3.7,12);
  expect(median([3,1,2])).toBe(2);expect(median([4,1,2,3])).toBe(2.5);expect(median([])).toBeNull();
 });
 it('optionsOf: §8.4 defaults, method overrides, invalid values rejected',()=>{
  expect(optionsOf({})).toEqual({threshold_n:100,ece_max:0.1,embargo_days:0,window_years:3});
  expect(optionsOf({threshold_n:50,ece_max:'0.05',embargo_days:7,window_years:5,grace_days:30})).toEqual({threshold_n:50,ece_max:0.05,embargo_days:7,window_years:5});
  for(const bad of [{threshold_n:0},{threshold_n:1.5},{ece_max:0},{ece_max:'x'},{embargo_days:-1},{window_years:0}] as Record<string,number|string>[])expect(()=>optionsOf(bad)).toThrow('invalid_calibration_params');
 });
 it('entryOf: abstained → null; lifecycle from the latest settlement (reopened → open); y per kind; market from price_return only',()=>{
  expect(entryOf(envelope({judgment:{abstained:true,abstain_reason:'missing_input',claim:null,condition:null,horizon:null,target:null,label_policy:null,settle_after:null,settle_by:null}}))).toBeNull();

  expect(entryOf(cat)).toMatchObject({forecast:{kind:'categorical',selected:'recovery',margin_pp:7.5},y:'overheat'});
  const price=envelope({judgment:{condition:{resolver:'price_return',params:{ticker:'600519',market:'A',adjustment:'qfq',source:'eastmoney',base_date:'2026-01-02'},predicate:{op:'>',rhs:0},text:{zh:'涨',en:'up'}}}});
  expect(entryOf(price)!.market).toBe('A');
 });

  const sess=(base:string)=>({kind:'session_index' as const,base_date:base,n:5});

  const next=envelope({judgment:{n:2,as_of:'2026-02-10',condition:cond('2026-02-10'),target:sess('2026-02-10')},settlement:{settlement_id:uuidOf(700002),resolver:'price_return',realized:realized('2026-02-10','2026-02-27')}});
  const entries=[holiday,next].map(x=>entryOf(x)!);
  expect([...selectIndependent(entries,0)]).toEqual([uuidOf(1)]);
 });
});
```
