```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibration.ts
// Calibration math (spec §8.1 metrics by kind, §8.2 cohort / samples / independent selection, §8.4
// gates, §8.5 isotonic in the report only). Pure: no I/O, no clock. Every metric is computed on the
// independent samples (greedy non-overlapping selection per subject); the full sample set only gives
// n_total and a `correlated` reference that never gates. Expected values come from
// fixtures/judgments/calibration/expected.py (an independent Python oracle), never from this file.
import {applyIsotonic,isotonicFit,wilson} from '../research/fanout/calibration';
import type {IsotonicSegment} from '../research/fanout/calibration';
import type {CalibrationState,Envelope,JudgmentRow,Kind,PriceMarket,ReliabilityBin,SettlementRow,Target,Claim,ProbabilityClaim,CategoricalClaim,ScoreClaim,IntervalClaim} from './types';

export const ALGORITHM_VERSION='judgments-calibration/1';
/** Holdout = the last 30% by as_of: train = floor(7n/10) (integer arithmetic, no float rounding). */
export const HOLDOUT_MIN=20;
export const DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_N=100,DEFAULT_ECE_MAX=0.10,DEFAULT_WINDOW_YEARS=3,DEFAULT_EMBARGO_DAYS=0;
export const MARGIN_BINS:readonly (readonly [number,number])[]=[[0,5],[5,15],[15,100]];
export const RELIABILITY_BINS=10;

export type CohortLifecycle='open'|'settled'|'void'|'withdrawn';
export type Forecast=
 |{kind:'probability';p:number}
 |{kind:'categorical';selected:string;margin_pp:number|null}
 |{kind:'score';value:number}
 |{kind:'interval';low:number;high:number;nominal_coverage:number};
/** One active registration of the cohort (spec §8.2). y: probability 0|1, categorical realized class, score/interval realized number; null unless settled. */
export interface CohortEntry{judgment_id:string;subject_type:string;subject_key:string;market:PriceMarket|null;as_of:string;window_end:string;retrospective:boolean;lifecycle:CohortLifecycle;settlement_id:string|null;forecast:Forecast;y:number|string|null}
export interface EvaluatedEntry extends CohortEntry{group:string;sample:boolean;selected_for_independent:boolean}
export interface CalibrationOptions{threshold_n:number;ece_max:number;embargo_days:number}
export interface Evaluation{
 state:Exclude<CalibrationState,'self_assessed'>;
 n_registered:number;n_settled:number;n_independent:number;n_void:number;n_retrospective_excluded:number;
 metrics:Record<string,unknown>;reliability:ReliabilityBin[];isotonic_segments:IsotonicSegment[]|null;
 /** Every cohort entry, sorted by judgment_id, with its stream and selection (the cohort file body, spec §5.5). */
 entries:EvaluatedEntry[];
}

const DAY=86_400_000;
export const addDays=(iso:string,n:number):string=>new Date(Date.parse(`${iso}T00:00:00.000Z`)+n*DAY).toISOString().slice(0,10);
const monthEnd=(period:string):string=>{const [y,m]=period.split('-').map(Number);return new Date(Date.UTC(y,m,0)).toISOString().slice(0,10);};
/** Target-derived last calendar day of the window [as_of, window_end] (spec §8.2). session_index uses the §7.3 scan
 *  window ceil(n × 1.52) — an estimate, NOT an upper bound (holidays / suspensions can exceed it). */
export function windowEndOf(target:Target):string{
 switch(target.kind){
  case 'date':return target.date;
  case 'period':return monthEnd(target.period);
  case 'fiscal_period':return target.period_end;
  case 'session_index':return addDays(target.base_date,Math.ceil(target.n*1.52));
 }
}

const num=(v:unknown,def:number,ok:(n:number)=>boolean):number=>{
 if(v===undefined)return def;
 const n=typeof v==='number'?v:typeof v==='string'&&v.trim()!==''?Number(v):NaN;
 if(!Number.isFinite(n)||!ok(n))throw new Error('invalid_calibration_params');
 return n;
};
/** Method params → gate options (spec §8.4 defaults; each value is written into the calibration row). */
export function optionsOf(params:Record<string,number|string>):CalibrationOptions&{window_years:number}{
 return {
  threshold_n:num(params.threshold_n,DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_N,n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=1),
  ece_max:num(params.ece_max,DEFAULT_ECE_MAX,n=>n>0&&n<1),
  embargo_days:num(params.embargo_days,DEFAULT_EMBARGO_DAYS,n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0),
  window_years:num(params.window_years,DEFAULT_WINDOW_YEARS,n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=1&&n<=50),
 };
}

function forecastOf(kind:Kind,claim:Claim):Forecast{
 switch(kind){
  case 'probability':return {kind,p:(claim as ProbabilityClaim).p};
  case 'categorical':{const c=claim as CategoricalClaim;return {kind,selected:c.selected,margin_pp:typeof c.margin_pp==='number'?c.margin_pp:null};}
  case 'score':return {kind,value:(claim as ScoreClaim).value};
  case 'interval':{const c=claim as IntervalClaim;return {kind,low:c.low,high:c.high,nominal_coverage:c.nominal_coverage};}
 }
}
function realizedY(kind:Kind,s:SettlementRow):number|string|null{
 if(kind==='probability')return s.outcome==='hit'?1:0;
 const v=s.realized?.value;
 if(kind==='categorical')return typeof v==='string'?v:s.realized?.label??null;
 if(typeof v==='boolean')return v?1:0;
 return typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v)?v:null;
}
const ISO_DATE=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
/** The actually settled window end (spec §8.2 第 7 稿; plan audit P1-09): a settled price_return judgment ends at its
 *  frozen end bar (realized.to, the date the resolver's evidence ends on); every other judgment — and any price
 *  settlement without a usable realized.to — uses the target-derived windowEndOf. */
export function settledWindowEndOf(j:JudgmentRow,s:SettlementRow|null):string{
 const to=s&&s.kind==='settled'&&j.condition?.resolver==='price_return'?s.realized?.to??null:null;
 return typeof to==='string'&&ISO_DATE.test(to)?to:windowEndOf(j.target!);
}
/** Envelope (calibration_cohort row) → cohort entry; abstained rows are not in the cohort (null). */
export function entryOf(e:Envelope):CohortEntry|null{
 const j=e.judgment;
 if(j.abstained||!j.claim||!j.target)return null;
 const s=e.settlement;
 const lifecycle:CohortLifecycle=!s||s.kind==='reopened'?'open':s.kind;
 const c=j.condition;
 return {
  judgment_id:j.judgment_id,subject_type:j.subject_type,subject_key:j.subject_key,
  market:c&&c.resolver==='price_return'?c.params.market:null,
  as_of:j.as_of,window_end:settledWindowEndOf(j,s),retrospective:j.retrospective,lifecycle,
  settlement_id:s?.settlement_id??null,forecast:forecastOf(j.kind,j.claim),
  y:lifecycle==='settled'&&s?realizedY(j.kind,s):null,
 };
}

export const groupOf=(e:Pick<CohortEntry,'subject_type'|'subject_key'>)=>`${e.subject_type}:${e.subject_key}`;
const byAsOf=(a:CohortEntry,b:CohortEntry)=>a.as_of<b.as_of?-1:a.as_of>b.as_of?1:a.judgment_id<b.judgment_id?-1:a.judgment_id>b.judgment_id?1:0;
/**
 * Greedy non-overlapping selection per subject stream (spec §8.2): scan by (as_of, judgment_id), take
 * the first, skip every judgment whose as_of is on or before the selected window_end + embargo_days.
 */
export function selectIndependent(samples:CohortEntry[],embargoDays:number):Set<string>{
 const groups=new Map<string,CohortEntry[]>();
 for(const s of samples){const g=groupOf(s);const list=groups.get(g);if(list)list.push(s);else groups.set(g,[s]);}
 const chosen=new Set<string>();
 for(const list of groups.values()){
  let lastEnd:string|null=null;
  for(const s of [...list].sort(byAsOf)){
   if(lastEnd===null||s.as_of>addDays(lastEnd,embargoDays)){chosen.add(s.judgment_id);lastEnd=s.window_end;}
  }
 }
 return chosen;
}

const sum=(xs:number[])=>xs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
const mean=(xs:number[]):number|null=>xs.length===0?null:sum(xs)/xs.length;
const binOf=(p:number)=>Math.min(RELIABILITY_BINS-1,Math.floor(p*RELIABILITY_BINS));
interface Pair{p:number;y:number}
const pairOf=(e:CohortEntry):Pair=>({p:(e.forecast as {p:number}).p,y:e.y as number});
/** ECE = Σ_b (n_b/n)·|mean_p_b − hit_rate_b| over 10 equal bins; null for no pairs. */
export function ece(pairs:Pair[]):number|null{
 if(pairs.length===0)return null;
 const bins=Array.from({length:RELIABILITY_BINS},()=>({n:0,sp:0,sy:0}));
 for(const x of pairs){const b=bins[binOf(x.p)];b.n++;b.sp+=x.p;b.sy+=x.y;}
 let total=0;
 for(const b of bins)if(b.n)total+=(b.n/pairs.length)*Math.abs(b.sp/b.n-b.sy/b.n);
 return total;
}
/** Brier, climatology (sample base rate) and skill = 1 − brier/climatology (null on a zero denominator). */
export function brierParts(pairs:Pair[]):{brier:number|null;climatology:number|null;skill:number|null}{
 if(pairs.length===0)return {brier:null,climatology:null,skill:null};
 const ybar=mean(pairs.map(x=>x.y)) as number;
 const brier=mean(pairs.map(x=>(x.p-x.y)**2)) as number;
 const climatology=mean(pairs.map(x=>(ybar-x.y)**2)) as number;
 return {brier,climatology,skill:climatology===0?null:1-brier/climatology};
}
export function reliabilityBins(pairs:Pair[]):ReliabilityBin[]{
 return Array.from({length:RELIABILITY_BINS},(_,i)=>{
  const inb=pairs.filter(x=>binOf(x.p)===i);const n=inb.length;const k=sum(inb.map(x=>x.y));const w=wilson(k,n);
  return {bin_low:i/RELIABILITY_BINS,bin_high:(i+1)/RELIABILITY_BINS,n,mean_p:n===0?null:sum(inb.map(x=>x.p))/n,hit_rate:n===0?null:k/n,wilson_low:w.low,wilson_high:w.high};
 });
}

type KindResult=Pick<Evaluation,'state'|'metrics'|'reliability'|'isotonic_segments'>;
function probability(ind:CohortEntry[],samples:CohortEntry[],o:CalibrationOptions):KindResult{
 const pairs=ind.map(pairOf),n=pairs.length,k=sum(pairs.map(x=>x.y));
 const all=samples.map(pairOf);
 const b=brierParts(pairs),w=wilson(k,n);
 const ntr=Math.floor((7*n)/10),train=ind.slice(0,ntr),holdRaw=ind.slice(ntr);
 const boundary=train.length===0?null:train.map(s=>s.window_end).reduce((a,c)=>(c>a?c:a));
 const hold=holdRaw.filter(s=>boundary===null||s.as_of>boundary);
 const fit=train.length===0?null:isotonicFit(train.map(s=>({score:pairOf(s).p,hit:pairOf(s).y})));
 let he:number|null=null,hb:number|null=null,hsk:number|null=null,hm:number|null=null;
 if(hold.length>=HOLDOUT_MIN){
  const hp=hold.map(pairOf);const hparts=brierParts(hp);
  he=ece(hp);hb=hparts.brier;hsk=hparts.skill;
  hm=fit&&fit.segments.length>0?ece(hp.map(x=>({p:applyIsotonic(fit,x.p) as number,y:x.y}))):null;
 }
 const metrics={
  n_total:samples.length,base_rate:n===0?null:k/n,brier:b.brier,brier_climatology:b.climatology,brier_skill:b.skill,ece_raw:ece(pairs),
  hit_rate:n===0?null:{rate:k/n,low:w.low,high:w.high},
  correlated:{n:samples.length,brier:brierParts(all).brier,ece_raw:ece(all)},
  temporal_split:{n_train:train.length,n_holdout:hold.length,n_dropped_overlap:holdRaw.length-hold.length,boundary,ece_raw_holdout:he,brier_holdout:hb,brier_skill_holdout:hsk,ece_mapped_holdout:hm},
 };
 // The gate tests the raw p on the time-out holdout — the predictor the page would show (spec §8.2, G01).
 const state=n<o.threshold_n||he===null?'insufficient':he<=o.ece_max&&hsk!==null&&hsk>0?'calibrated':'failed';
 return {state,metrics,reliability:reliabilityBins(pairs),isotonic_segments:n>0&&fit?fit.segments:null};
}

function categorical(ind:CohortEntry[],samples:CohortEntry[],o:CalibrationOptions):KindResult{
 const sel=(e:CohortEntry)=>(e.forecast as {selected:string}).selected;
 const margin=(e:CohortEntry)=>(e.forecast as {margin_pp:number|null}).margin_pp;
 const hit=(e:CohortEntry)=>sel(e)===e.y?1:0;
 const n=ind.length,k=sum(ind.map(hit)),w=wilson(k,n);
 const freq=new Map<string,number>();
 for(const e of ind)freq.set(e.y as string,(freq.get(e.y as string)??0)+1);
 let maj:string|null=null;
 for(const [c,cnt] of freq)if(maj===null||cnt>freq.get(maj)!||(cnt===freq.get(maj)&&c<maj))maj=c;
 const confusion:Record<string,Record<string,number>>={};
 for(const e of ind){const row=(confusion[sel(e)]??={});row[e.y as string]=(row[e.y as string]??0)+1;}
 const margin_bins=MARGIN_BINS.map(([lo,hi])=>{
  const inb=ind.filter(e=>{const m=margin(e);return m!==null&&(lo===0||m>=lo)&&(hi===100||m<hi);});
  const kb=sum(inb.map(hit)),wb=wilson(kb,inb.length);
  return {bin_low:lo,bin_high:hi,n:inb.length,accuracy:inb.length===0?null:kb/inb.length,wilson_low:wb.low,wilson_high:wb.high};
 });
 const majority_rate=n===0||maj===null?null:freq.get(maj)!/n;
 const metrics={
  n_total:samples.length,accuracy:n===0?null:k/n,accuracy_wilson:{low:w.low,high:w.high},majority_class:maj,majority_rate,confusion,margin_bins,
  n_missing_margin:ind.filter(e=>margin(e)===null).length,correlated:{n:samples.length,accuracy:mean(samples.map(hit))},
 };
 // Baseline = the majority realized class among the independent samples, not 1/|classes| (spec §8.1).
 const state=n<o.threshold_n?'insufficient':w.low!==null&&majority_rate!==null&&w.low>majority_rate?'calibrated':'failed';
 return {state,metrics,reliability:[],isotonic_segments:null};
}

/** Average ranks (1-based) with ties sharing the mean of their positions. */
export function averageRanks(vals:number[]):number[]{
 const order=vals.map((_,i)=>i).sort((a,b)=>vals[a]-vals[b]||a-b);
 const r=new Array<number>(vals.length).fill(0);
 for(let i=0;i<order.length;){
  let j=i;
  while(j+1<order.length&&vals[order[j+1]]===vals[order[i]])j++;
  for(let t=i;t<=j;t++)r[order[t]]=(i+j)/2+1;
  i=j+1;
 }
 return r;
}
export function spearman(xs:number[],ys:number[]):number|null{
 if(xs.length<2)return null;
 const rx=averageRanks(xs),ry=averageRanks(ys),mx=mean(rx) as number,my=mean(ry) as number;
 let numr=0,sx=0,sy=0;
 for(let i=0;i<rx.length;i++){numr+=(rx[i]-mx)*(ry[i]-my);}
 for(const a of rx)sx+=(a-mx)**2;
 for(const b of ry)sy+=(b-my)**2;
 const den=Math.sqrt(sx*sy);
 return den===0?null:numr/den;
}
function score(ind:CohortEntry[],samples:CohortEntry[],o:CalibrationOptions):KindResult{
 const v=(e:CohortEntry)=>(e.forecast as {value:number}).value;
 const n=ind.length,ys=ind.map(e=>e.y as number);
 const sorted=[...ind].sort((a,b)=>v(a)-v(b)||(a.judgment_id<b.judgment_id?-1:a.judgment_id>b.judgment_id?1:0));
 const binary=n>0&&ys.every(y=>y===0||y===1);
 const tertiles=[0,1,2].map(t=>{
  const g=n===0?[]:sorted.filter((_,i)=>Math.floor((3*i)/n)===t);
  const gy=g.map(e=>e.y as number),kk=sum(gy);
  const ww=binary&&g.length>0?wilson(kk,g.length):null;
  return {tertile:t+1,n:g.length,value_min:g.length?Math.min(...g.map(v)):null,value_max:g.length?Math.max(...g.map(v)):null,realized_mean:mean(gy),
   hit_rate:ww?{rate:kk/g.length,low:ww.low,high:ww.high}:null};
 });
 const metrics={n_total:samples.length,spearman:spearman(ind.map(v),ys),tertiles,correlated:{n:samples.length,spearman:spearman(samples.map(v),samples.map(e=>e.y as number))}};
 // Scores are not probabilities: there is no calibration, only an evaluation (spec §8.2).
 return {state:n<o.threshold_n?'insufficient':'evaluated',metrics,reliability:[],isotonic_segments:null};
}

/** Linear-interpolation quantile (type 7) of a non-empty list. */
export function quantile7(values:number[],q:number):number{
 const xs=[...values].sort((a,b)=>a-b),h=(xs.length-1)*q,lo=Math.floor(h);
 return lo+1>=xs.length?xs[lo]:xs[lo]+(h-lo)*(xs[lo+1]-xs[lo]);
}
export function median(values:number[]):number|null{
 if(values.length===0)return null;
 const xs=[...values].sort((a,b)=>a-b),m=Math.floor(xs.length/2);
 return xs.length%2?xs[m]:(xs[m-1]+xs[m])/2;
}
function interval(ind:CohortEntry[],samples:CohortEntry[],o:CalibrationOptions):KindResult{
 const f=(e:CohortEntry)=>e.forecast as {low:number;high:number;nominal_coverage:number};
 const covered=(e:CohortEntry)=>f(e).low<=(e.y as number)&&(e.y as number)<=f(e).high?1:0;
 const n=ind.length,k=sum(ind.map(covered)),w=wilson(k,n);
 const nominal=mean(ind.map(e=>f(e).nominal_coverage)),coverage=mean(ind.map(covered));
 const groups=new Map<string,number[]>();
 for(const e of ind){const g=groupOf(e);const list=groups.get(g);if(list)list.push(e.y as number);else groups.set(g,[e.y as number]);}
 const base=new Map<string,number>();
 if(nominal!==null)for(const [g,vals] of groups)if(vals.length>=2)base.set(g,quantile7(vals,(1+nominal)/2)-quantile7(vals,(1-nominal)/2));
 const wm=median(ind.map(e=>f(e).high-f(e).low));
 const bm=median(ind.filter(e=>base.has(groupOf(e))).map(e=>base.get(groupOf(e))!));
 const ratio=wm===null||bm===null||bm===0?null:wm/bm;
 const gap=coverage===null||nominal===null?null:coverage-nominal;
 const metrics={n_total:samples.length,coverage,coverage_wilson:{low:w.low,high:w.high},nominal_coverage:nominal,coverage_gap:gap,width_median:wm,baseline_width_median:bm,width_ratio:ratio,correlated:{n:samples.length,coverage:mean(samples.map(covered))}};
 const state=n<o.threshold_n?'insufficient':gap!==null&&Math.abs(gap)<=o.ece_max&&ratio!==null&&ratio<=1?'calibrated':'failed';
 return {state,metrics,reliability:[],isotonic_segments:null};
}

/** The whole report for one cohort (spec §8.1 + §8.2): counts, metrics, reliability, isotonic, state, entries. */
export function evaluateCohort(kind:Kind,entries:CohortEntry[],o:CalibrationOptions):Evaluation{
 const settled=entries.filter(e=>e.lifecycle==='settled');
 const samples=settled.filter(e=>!e.retrospective&&e.y!==null);
 const chosen=selectIndependent(samples,o.embargo_days);
 const ind=samples.filter(s=>chosen.has(s.judgment_id)).sort(byAsOf);
 const r=kind==='probability'?probability(ind,samples,o):kind==='categorical'?categorical(ind,samples,o):kind==='score'?score(ind,samples,o):interval(ind,samples,o);
 const sampleIds=new Set(samples.map(s=>s.judgment_id));
 return {
  ...r,
  n_registered:entries.length,n_settled:settled.length,n_independent:ind.length,
  n_void:entries.filter(e=>e.lifecycle==='void').length,n_retrospective_excluded:settled.filter(e=>e.retrospective).length,
  entries:[...entries].sort((a,b)=>a.judgment_id<b.judgment_id?-1:a.judgment_id>b.judgment_id?1:0)
   .map(e=>({...e,group:groupOf(e),sample:sampleIds.has(e.judgment_id),selected_for_independent:chosen.has(e.judgment_id)})),
 };
}
```

```ts
export const CALIBRATE_DATASET='judgments.calibrate';
export const PAGE_SIZE=500, RESERVE_MS=30_000, VALID_DAYS=14, STALE_BATCH_SECONDS=900, MAX_STEPS=10_000;

export function runUnit(ctx:StepContext,unit:Unit,outOfBudget:()=>boolean):Promise<{outcome:UnitOutcome;pages:number;calibration_id?:string;infos:BatchError[]}>;

export type RoundOutcome='completed'|'failed'|'in_progress';     // Q1-04

// src/lib/judgments/calibrate-deps.ts

// src/app/api/cron/judgments-calibrate/route.ts
export const dynamic='force-dynamic'; export const maxDuration=300; export function GET(r:Request); export function POST(r:Request);
```

**流程（规格 §8.3 逐条）**：工作单元 = `(方法@版本, scope)`，scope = `all` + 方法 `markets` 中每个价格市场 + 方法 `subject_types` 中每个公共主体类型；按 `REGISTRY` 顺序。单元状态存 `judgment_job_state[jobKey('calibrate',…)]`，空对象 `{}` = 空闲。`stepUnit` 每次重读已提交状态再做一步：
1. 空闲 → 读 `calibrationValidity().revision` 为 `expected_revision`，`cutoff = serverTime()`（只用于定窗口），`window = [cutoff 日期 − window_years 年, cutoff 日期]`，新 `generation`；**先** `freezeCalibrationCohort(generation, …, window)`（计划审计 P1-10：一条语句、一个 MVCC 快照冻结全部成员及其当时最新结算），`query_bounds = {window_from, window_to, registered_at_lte: frozen_at, settled_at_lte: frozen_at, frozen_at, n}` 一次固定；再 CAS 写入单元状态（失败 → `clearCalibrationGeneration(generation)` 删掉自己冻结的集合，`conflict`）。冻结后、CAS 前崩溃 → 该代际的成员行无人引用、永不被读（运行手册给出查询与清理语句）。
2. 分页 → `cohortMembers(generation, after, pageSize)`（service role，R04；读冻结集，keyset `judgment_id`）；本页（按 scope 过滤后的 `CohortEntry[]`）规范化为字节，上传到**每次上传唯一**的 `partial/<unitPath>/<generation>/<after|start>.<attempt_uuid>.json`（`upsert:false`；已存在 → `cohort_path_collision` 抛错，S01）；**一次** CAS 同时追加 manifest `{start_after, end_after, path, sha256, count}` 并推进 `after`。**只有空页才置 `done`**（计划审计 P1-02：短页不是耗尽，PostgREST 的行数上限可以小于 `pageSize`）。CAS 失败 → 只删除本次 attempt 的对象（`page_lost`），下一步重读 `after`。上传后、CAS 前崩溃 → 孤儿对象不在任何 manifest 里，永不被读；重试用新 attempt uuid。
3. 收尾 → 只读 manifest 列出的对象，逐个校验 `sha256`、`generation`、`start_after/end_after` 链与 `count`（任一不符 → 清空单元并以 `cohort_object_invalid` 失败，下次从头）；`evaluateCohort`；cohort 文件 `{algorithm_version, methodology_id, methodology_version, scope_type, scope_key, query_bounds, entries}` 内容寻址写到 `cohorts/<cohort_sha256>.json`；`fingerprint` 按 §5.5；`calibration_id = uuidV8(fingerprint)`；`computed_at = serverTime()`，`valid_until = computed_at + 14 天`；`insertCalibration(row{validity_revision: expected_revision}, expected_revision)`：`inserted | duplicate` → CAS 清空（清空失败 → 信息码 `job_state_conflict`，下次同指纹 `duplicate` 再清，R05）并删除本代际 manifest 对象；`stale_revision` → 清空，本次运行内以新代际重算一次（第二次仍 stale → `deferred` + `stale_revision`，下次运行重来）。单元状态被清空时同时 `clearCalibrationGeneration(generation)`（成员行随代际删除）。
4. 轮次（计划审计 P2-02、Q1-04）：`judgment_job_state[jobKey('calibrate_round')] = {round, outcomes: {job → 'completed'|'failed'|'in_progress'}}`。单元跑完后按结果记入本轮（乐观锁重试 3 次，失败只记信息码）：`failed` → `failed`；`paused / conflict` → `in_progress`；`inserted / duplicate / stale_revision / skipped` → 单元状态已清空则 `completed`，否则（例如插入成功但清空 CAS 失败）`in_progress`（下次恢复）。每次运行的工作单：先是**有未完成代际**（单元状态非空）且本轮不是 `failed` 的单元（可续跑的优先），再是本轮还没有结果或是 `in_progress`、且无未完成代际的单元；本轮 `failed` 的单元**整轮排除**（即使它还留着代际状态），直到开新一轮。本轮每个单元都是 `failed`，或是 `completed` 且无未完成代际 → 开新一轮 `{round+1, outcomes:{}}` 并从注册表头开始（新一轮里留着代际的失败单元又排在最前、续跑）。这样一个耗时的前排单元不会在每次运行都重开新代际，一个每次都耗尽预算再失败的前排单元也不会饿死后排单元。
5. 预算：`deadline − now < 30 s` 就不再做下一步（单元 `paused`，信息码 `deadline_hit`，下次从 `after` 续同一 generation / cutoff / bounds）；未开始的单元同样记 `deadline_hit`。
6. 批次：`startBatch({producer:'ts-judgments', dataset:'judgments.calibrate'})` 前先 `repairStaleBatches('judgments.calibrate', 900)`；计数：`fetched` = 开始处理的单元数，`inserted` / `duplicates` = 插入 / 重复的单元，`deferred` = paused / conflict / stale 的单元，`failed` = 抛错的单元（错误 `{code, key: job, message}`）；`finally` 里 `finishBatch` + `recordAttempt('judgments.calibrate', {ok: success|partial, cadence:'event'})`。

**规格偏差（记入实施记录）：**
1. `cohort_path` 用内容寻址 `cohorts/<cohort_sha256>.json`（§5.5 写的是 `<calibration_id>.json`）：`calibration_id = uuidV8(fingerprint)` 而 `fingerprint` 含 `cohort_sha256`，按 id 命名会循环依赖；内容寻址使崩溃后的重试写同一对象（`exists`）。
2. cohort 文件含 `query_bounds`，所以不同代际的 `cohort_sha256` 一定不同；R05"窗口外撤回不改 cohort"在测试里比对的是 `entries`。
3. 单元状态比 §8.3 多 `done` 与 manifest 条目的 `count`（收尾校验用）。
4. `stale_revision` 在同一次运行内最多重算一次（防活锁）。
5. 单元测试用为本任务写的 8 方法假库（`fakeDb`），不用 `memoryJudgmentsDb`：后者的 RPC 语义由 Task 4 的契约测试覆盖，SQL 侧由本任务的集成测试覆盖。
6. `CohortStore` 只有 `put / get / remove`（不列目录）：孤儿对象不会被自动删除；按前缀清理孤儿的脚本列入 Task 22 运行手册的待办（只删不被任何未清空 manifest 与任何 `cohort_path` 引用的对象）。
7. 新鲜度 cadence 用 `'event'`（`dq_freshness` 没有 weekly；daily 会让周跑每周报 stale）。
8. 集成测试的结算走正常路径（决策 D6）：在 `withClaimLock`（Task 4，`pg_advisory_lock(20261109)`）内把该判断的队列行设为到期、`claimDue` 领到它（同时领到的别的套件的行持有到结束再原样释放）、以 `actor='cron'` 与领到的 `lease_token` 调 `appendSettlement`；登记也在锁内进行，并立即把不结算的队列行 `next_attempt_at` 推到 `2099-01-01`（测试连接直接 `update`），使其永不被别的套件领取。撤回（`withdrawn`）仍是 admin 动作（`lease=null`、`actor='admin:<uuid>'`），这是它的正常路径。
9. 成员冻结（规格第 7 稿 §8.3，计划审计 P1-10）：时间戳截止不能冻结 MVCC 下的 cohort（`registered_at = now()` 是事务开始时刻，截止前开始、截止后提交的事务会在游标之后"补进来"），所以 cohort 由 `freeze_calibration_cohort` 一次物化；`calibration_cohort_internal` 仍保留（R04 测试与运维核对用），校准任务不再调用它。冻结成功但单元状态 CAS 之前崩溃的代际成员行无人引用：运行手册给出列出 / 清理它们的 SQL（`generation` 不出现在任何 `calibrate:*` 单元状态里的成员行）。
10. 轮次游标（计划审计 P2-02、Q1-04）：见流程第 4 点；`RoundState` 存在全局键 `calibrate_round`；失败的单元在本轮记 `failed` 并被排除到本轮结束（下一轮再试），避免一个持续失败的单元让本轮永远不结束、或每次运行都先耗尽预算（第一轮审计后的 `done` 列表会让留着代际的失败单元每次排在最前）。
11. 冻结返回 `already_frozen`（计划审计 Q1-05）：`stepUnit` 每次开始都用新的 `generation`（`uuid()`），所以正常不会遇到；遇到即说明 uuid 被复用（测试注入或缺陷）——该代际属于别人，不清它，抛 `CalibrateError('generation_reused')`（单元 `failed`）。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/cohort-store.ts
// Calibration cohort objects (spec §8.3, bucket judgments-calibration). Two kinds of path, both
// immutable: per-attempt partial pages `partial/<unit>/<generation>/<start_after|start>.<attempt>.json`
// (a fresh attempt uuid per upload, so a retried page never collides with an orphan; S01) and
// content-addressed final cohorts `cohorts/<cohort_sha256>.json`. put() always uses upsert:false:
// an existing path answers 'exists' and is never overwritten. get() answers null for a missing object.
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export const COHORT_BUCKET='judgments-calibration';
export interface CohortStore{
 put(path:string,bytes:Uint8Array,opts:{upsert:false}):Promise<'stored'|'exists'>;
 get(path:string):Promise<Uint8Array|null>;
 remove(path:string):Promise<void>;
}
const UUID='[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}';
const UNIT='[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}@v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}\\.(all|market\\.[A-Z]{1,3}|subject_type\\.[a-z_]{1,32})';
const PATH=new RegExp(`^(partial/${UNIT}/${UUID}/(start|${UUID})\\.${UUID}\\.json|cohorts/[0-9a-f]{64}\\.json)$`);
export const isCohortPath=(path:string)=>PATH.test(path);
const assertPath=(path:string)=>{if(!PATH.test(path))throw new Error(`cohort_path_invalid:${path.slice(0,120)}`);};

interface StorageError{message:string;statusCode?:string|number;status?:number}
const statusOf=(e:StorageError)=>String(e.statusCode??e.status??'');
const isExists=(e:StorageError)=>statusOf(e)==='409'||/already exists|duplicate/i.test(e.message);
const isMissing=(e:StorageError)=>statusOf(e)==='404'||/not.?found|does not exist/i.test(e.message);

export function supabaseCohortStore(admin:SupabaseClient):CohortStore{
 const bucket=()=>admin.storage.from(COHORT_BUCKET);
 return {
  async put(path,bytes,opts){
   assertPath(path);
   if(opts.upsert!==false)throw new Error('cohort_upsert_forbidden');
   const {error}=await bucket().upload(path,bytes,{contentType:'application/json',upsert:false});
   if(!error)return 'stored';
   if(isExists(error as StorageError))return 'exists';
   throw new Error(`cohort_upload_failed:${(error as StorageError).message}`);
  },
  async get(path){
   assertPath(path);
   const {data,error}=await bucket().download(path);
   if(error){if(isMissing(error as StorageError))return null;throw new Error(`cohort_download_failed:${(error as StorageError).message}`);}
   return new Uint8Array(await (data as Blob).arrayBuffer());
  },
  async remove(path){
   assertPath(path);
   const {error}=await bucket().remove([path]);
   if(error)throw new Error(`cohort_remove_failed:${(error as StorageError).message}`);
  },
 };
}

/** In-memory store for unit and integration tests; bytes are copied in and out. */
export function memoryCohortStore():CohortStore&{objects:Map<string,Uint8Array>}{
 const objects=new Map<string,Uint8Array>();
 return {
  objects,
  async put(path,bytes,opts){
   assertPath(path);
   if(opts.upsert!==false)throw new Error('cohort_upsert_forbidden');
   if(objects.has(path))return 'exists';
   objects.set(path,new Uint8Array(bytes));return 'stored';
  },
  async get(path){assertPath(path);const v=objects.get(path);return v?new Uint8Array(v):null;},
  async remove(path){assertPath(path);objects.delete(path);},
 };
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibrate.test.ts
// runCalibrate / stepUnit over a purpose-built fake of the ten JudgmentsDb methods the job calls
// (cohort freeze = a copy of the visible set at that instant, frozen-member keyset paging, generation clear,
// validity revision, insert_calibration semantics, optimistic job state incl. the round cursor) and
// memoryCohortStore. The SQL side of the same flows is calibrate.integration.test.ts.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '../db/memory-table-client';
import {CalibrateError,PAGE_SIZE,ROUND_JOB,fingerprintOf,inScope,previewCalibrate,runCalibrate,stepUnit,unitPath,unitsOf,windowOf} from './calibrate';
import type {CalibrateDeps,RoundState,StepContext,UnitState} from './calibrate';
import {memoryCohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import type {CohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import {sha256} from './canonical';
import {envelope,methodologyRow,uuidOf} from './testing/envelopes';
import type {CalibrationRow,Envelope,JudgmentsDb,MethodologyRow} from './types';

const T0=Date.parse('2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z');
const dec=new TextDecoder();

function fakeDb(rows:MethodologyRow[],envelopes:Envelope[]){
 let clock=T0,revision=1,failClears=0,failPageCas=0;
 const jobs=new Map<string,{state:Record<string,unknown>;updated_at:string}>();
 const calibrations:CalibrationRow[]=[];const fingerprints=new Set<string>();
 const hooks:{onCohort?:(call:number)=>void}={};let cohortCalls=0;
 const tick=()=>new Date(clock+=1000).toISOString();
 /** generation → the members frozen at freeze time (a later push into `envelopes` never reaches a frozen set: MVCC). */
 const frozen=new Map<string,Envelope[]>();
 /** generation → its claim marker (the SQL's judgment_job_state['cohort:<generation>'], Q1-05). */
 const markers=new Map<string,{frozen_at:string;n:number}>();
 const db={
  async serverTime(){return tick();},
  async methodology(id:string,v:string){return rows.find(r=>r.methodology_id===id&&r.version===v)??null;},
  async calibrationValidity(){return {revision};},
  async freezeCalibrationCohort(generation:string,id:string,v:string,w:{from:string;to:string}){
   const claimed=markers.get(generation);                                                        // Q1-05: claimed once, even when empty
   if(claimed)return {status:'already_frozen' as const,...claimed};
   const at=tick();
   const set=envelopes.filter(e=>e.judgment.methodology_id===id&&e.judgment.methodology_version===v&&!e.judgment.abstained&&e.judgment.as_of>=w.from&&e.judgment.as_of<=w.to&&e.judgment.registered_at<=at)
    .sort((a,b)=>a.judgment.judgment_id<b.judgment.judgment_id?-1:1)
    .map(e=>({...e,settlement:e.settlement&&e.settlement.settled_at<=at?e.settlement:null}));
   frozen.set(generation,structuredClone(set));markers.set(generation,{frozen_at:at,n:set.length});
   return {status:'frozen' as const,frozen_at:at,n:set.length};
  },
  async cohortMembers(generation:string,after:string|null,limit:number){
   hooks.onCohort?.(++cohortCalls);
   return structuredClone((frozen.get(generation)??[]).filter(e=>after===null||e.judgment.judgment_id>after).slice(0,limit));
  },
  async clearCalibrationGeneration(generation:string){const n=frozen.get(generation)?.length??0;frozen.delete(generation);markers.delete(generation);return n;},
  async insertCalibration(row:CalibrationRow,expected:number){
   if(row.validity_revision!==expected||expected!==revision)return 'stale_revision' as const;
   if(fingerprints.has(row.fingerprint))return 'duplicate' as const;
   fingerprints.add(row.fingerprint);calibrations.push(structuredClone(row));return 'inserted' as const;
  },
  async jobState(job:string){const j=jobs.get(job);return j?structuredClone(j):null;},
  async setJobState(job:string,expected:string|null,state:Record<string,unknown>){
   const cur=jobs.get(job);
   if((cur?.updated_at??null)!==expected)return false;
   const clearing=Object.keys(state).length===0;
   if(clearing&&failClears>0){failClears--;return false;}
   if(!clearing&&(state as unknown as UnitState).manifest?.length&&failPageCas>0){failPageCas--;throw new Error('connection reset');}
   jobs.set(job,{state:structuredClone(state),updated_at:tick()});return true;
  },
  async repairStaleBatches(){return 0;},
 };
 return {db:db as unknown as JudgmentsDb,jobs,calibrations,hooks,frozen,
  bump(){revision++;},failNextClear(n=1){failClears=n;},crashNextPageCas(n=1){failPageCas=n;},advance(ms:number){clock+=ms;},get now(){return clock;},
  round(){return jobs.get(ROUND_JOB)?.state as unknown as RoundState|undefined;}};
}

/** subject_types holds no public type, so the method has exactly one unit ('all'). */
const METHOD=methodologyRow({subject_types:['security']});
/** n settled judgments, ids uuidOf(1..n), as_of 2026-01-02.., registered the same day, settled before the cutoff. */
const cohort=(n:number,extra:Partial<Parameters<typeof envelope>[0]>={})=>Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>envelope({judgment:{n:i+1},settlement:{settlement_id:uuidOf(700000+i+1),outcome:i%3===0?'miss':'hit'},...extra}));
function deps(db:JudgmentsDb,store:CohortStore,over:Partial<CalibrateDeps>={}):CalibrateDeps{
 let u=0;
 return {db,tables:memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_freshness:['dataset']}),store,methods:[{id:METHOD.methodology_id,version:'v1'}],
  codeVersion:'abcdef1',deadline:null,uuid:()=>`aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-${String(++u).padStart(12,'0')}`,pageSize:3,...over};
}
const ctxOf=(db:JudgmentsDb,store:CohortStore,prefix:string):StepContext=>{let u=0;return {db,store,codeVersion:'abcdef1',batchId:uuidOf(424242),uuid:()=>`${prefix}-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-${String(++u).padStart(12,'0')}`,pageSize:3};};
const unitAll=unitsOf(METHOD)[0];
const stateOf=(f:ReturnType<typeof fakeDb>)=>f.jobs.get(unitAll.job)?.state as unknown as UnitState|undefined;

describe('units, windows, fingerprints',()=>{

  expect(units.map(u=>u.job)).toEqual(['calibrate:synthetic_fact_metric@v1:all:','calibrate:synthetic_fact_metric@v1:market:A','calibrate:synthetic_fact_metric@v1:market:US','calibrate:synthetic_fact_metric@v1:subject_type:issuer']);
  expect(units.map(unitPath)).toEqual(['synthetic_fact_metric@v1.all','synthetic_fact_metric@v1.market.A','synthetic_fact_metric@v1.market.US','synthetic_fact_metric@v1.subject_type.issuer']);

   query_bounds:{window_from:'2023-11-09',window_to:'2026-11-09',registered_at_lte:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',settled_at_lte:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',frozen_at:'2026-11-09T04:00:00.000Z',n:0}};

  const run=async()=>{let now=T0;f.hooks.onCohort=()=>{now+=10_000;};return runCalibrate(deps(f.db,store,{methods:[{id:m.methodology_id,version:'v1'}],deadline:new Date(T0+55_000),now:()=>new Date(now)}));};

  const store:CohortStore={put:async(path,bytes,o)=>{if(path.includes('.all/')){failing++;now+=30_000;throw new Error('storage down');}return inner.put(path,bytes,o);},get:p=>inner.get(p),remove:p=>inner.remove(p)};
  const run=()=>{now=T0;return runCalibrate(deps(f.db,store,{methods:[{id:m.methodology_id,version:'v1'}],deadline:new Date(T0+55_000),now:()=>new Date(now)}));};

  const r3=await run();                                                                          // round complete → round 2 resumes the failed unit first
  expect(r3.units[0]).toMatchObject({scope:{scope_type:'all'},outcome:'failed'});
  expect(failing).toBe(2);

 });

describe('stepUnit concurrency',()=>{
 it('two workers on one page: only the CAS winner\'s object enters the manifest; the loser deletes its own object (R02)',async()=>{
  const f=fakeDb([METHOD],cohort(5));const shared=memoryCohortStore();
  let reached!:()=>void;const atPut=new Promise<void>(r=>{reached=r;});
  let release!:()=>void;const gate=new Promise<void>(r=>{release=r;});
  const gated:CohortStore={...shared,async put(path,bytes,o){const r=await shared.put(path,bytes,o);reached();await gate;return r;},get:shared.get,remove:shared.remove};
  const a=ctxOf(f.db,gated,'aaaaaaaa'),b=ctxOf(f.db,shared,'bbbbbbbb');
  expect((await stepUnit(b,unitAll)).kind).toBe('started');
  const pa=stepUnit(a,unitAll);
  await atPut;
  const rb=await stepUnit(b,unitAll);
  expect(rb.kind).toBe('paged');
  release();
  const ra=await pa;
  expect(ra.kind).toBe('page_lost');
  const st=stateOf(f)!;
  expect(st.manifest.map(m=>m.path)).toEqual([(rb as {path:string}).path]);
  expect(shared.objects.has((ra as {path:string}).path)).toBe(false);
  expect(st.after).toBe(uuidOf(3));
 });
 it('rejects a second writer on start: only one generation wins',async()=>{
  const f=fakeDb([METHOD],cohort(1));const store=memoryCohortStore();
  const results=await Promise.all([stepUnit(ctxOf(f.db,store,'aaaaaaaa'),unitAll),stepUnit(ctxOf(f.db,store,'bbbbbbbb'),unitAll)]);
  expect(results.map(r=>r.kind).sort()).toEqual(['conflict','started']);
  expect(f.frozen.size).toBe(1);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibrate.ts
// Calibration job (spec §8.3): one work unit = (methodology@version, scope); units run in registry
// order under the cron budget and resume across runs from judgment_job_state[jobKey('calibrate',…)]
// = {generation, cutoff, expected_revision, query_bounds, after, done, manifest}. A unit fixes its
// generation, validity revision and window once at start and FREEZES its cohort in one statement
// (freeze_calibration_cohort: one MVCC snapshot of the members and their latest settlements; plan audit
// P1-10; query_bounds records frozen_at and n), pages the frozen set through the service-role
// calibration_cohort_members (R04: unpublished methods calibrate too) until an EMPTY page (P1-02), uploads
// each page to a fresh per-attempt object with upsert:false, then appends the manifest entry and advances
// `after` in ONE optimistic set_job_state (S01, R02). Clearing a unit also clears its generation's members.
// Units run in a persisted round (judgment_job_state['calibrate_round'] = {round, outcomes}, P2-02 / Q1-04): resumable
// unfinished generations first, then units without a final outcome this round; a unit that FAILED this round is
// excluded until the round advances, so neither an expensive nor a consistently failing early unit can starve the
// later ones. A lost CAS removes only this attempt's object;
// a crash between upload and CAS leaves an orphan that no manifest names. Finalisation reads only
// the manifest's objects (sha256-checked), evaluates (calibration.ts), writes the content-addressed
// cohort file, and calls insert_calibration: inserted | duplicate → CAS-clear the unit (R05),
// stale_revision → clear and restart with a new generation (acceptance example 10).
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '../dq/freshness';
import {uuidV8} from './uuid-v8';
import {ALGORITHM_VERSION,entryOf,evaluateCohort,optionsOf} from './calibration';
import type {CohortEntry} from './calibration';
import {canonicalize,digest,sha256} from './canonical';
import type {CohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import {jobKey} from './job-keys';
import {PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES} from './types';
import type {CalibrationRow,CalibrationScope,JudgmentsDb,MethodologyRow,QueryBounds} from './types';

export const CALIBRATE_DATASET='judgments.calibrate';
/** The calibration cron's persisted round cursor (plan audit P2-02); per-unit outcome of the current round (Q1-04). */
export const ROUND_JOB=jobKey('calibrate_round');
export type RoundOutcome='completed'|'failed'|'in_progress';
export interface RoundState{round:number;outcomes:Record<string,RoundOutcome>}
export const PAGE_SIZE=500,RESERVE_MS=30_000,VALID_DAYS=14,STALE_BATCH_SECONDS=900,MAX_STEPS=10_000;

export interface ManifestEntry{start_after:string|null;end_after:string;path:string;sha256:string;count:number}
export interface UnitState{generation:string;cutoff:string;expected_revision:number;query_bounds:QueryBounds;after:string|null;done:boolean;manifest:ManifestEntry[]}
export interface Unit{methodology:MethodologyRow;scope:CalibrationScope;job:string}
export type UnitOutcome='inserted'|'duplicate'|'paused'|'stale_revision'|'conflict'|'failed'|'skipped';
export interface UnitReceipt{job:string;methodology_id:string;version:string;scope:CalibrationScope;outcome:UnitOutcome;calibration_id?:string;pages:number;code?:string}
export interface CalibrateReceipt{batchId:string;status:BatchStatus;counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];units:UnitReceipt[]}
export interface CalibrateDeps{
 db:JudgmentsDb;tables:TableClient;store:CohortStore;
 /** Registry order (REGISTRY in production). A method without a synced row is skipped. */
 methods:readonly {id:string;version:string}[];
 codeVersion:string;deadline:Date|null;triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy;
 now?:()=>Date;uuid?:()=>string;pageSize?:number;
}
export interface StepContext{db:JudgmentsDb;store:CohortStore;codeVersion:string;batchId:string;uuid:()=>string;pageSize:number}
export type StepOutcome=
 |{kind:'started';generation:string}
 |{kind:'paged';path:string;count:number}
 |{kind:'paging_done'}
 |{kind:'page_lost';path:string}
 |{kind:'conflict'}
 |{kind:'finalized';status:'inserted'|'duplicate';calibration_id:string;cleared:boolean}
 |{kind:'stale';cleared:boolean}
 |{kind:'reset';reason:'invalid_state'|'cohort_object_invalid';cleared:boolean};

export class CalibrateError extends Error{constructor(readonly code:string,detail?:string){super(detail?`${code}: ${detail}`:code);this.name='CalibrateError';}}

const enc=new TextEncoder(),dec=new TextDecoder();
const isPublic=(t:string)=>(PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(t);
/** 'all' first, then one row per declared price market and per public subject type (spec §5.5 scope_type). */
export function unitsOf(row:MethodologyRow):Unit[]{
 const scopes:CalibrationScope[]=[{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''},
  ...[...new Set(row.markets??[])].map(m=>({scope_type:'market' as const,scope_key:m})),
  ...[...new Set(row.subject_types)].filter(isPublic).map(t=>({scope_type:'subject_type' as const,scope_key:t}))];
 return scopes.map(scope=>({methodology:row,scope,job:jobKey('calibrate',row.methodology_id,row.version,scope)}));
}
export const inScope=(e:CohortEntry,s:CalibrationScope)=>s.scope_type==='all'||(s.scope_type==='market'?e.market===s.scope_key:e.subject_type===s.scope_key);
/** Storage-safe unit segment: id and version match the methodology checks; scope keys are markets or subject types. */
export const unitPath=(u:Unit)=>`${u.methodology.methodology_id}@${u.methodology.version}.${u.scope.scope_type}${u.scope.scope_key?`.${u.scope.scope_key}`:''}`;
/** [cutoff date − window_years, cutoff date] by as_of (spec §8.2); Feb 29 maps to Feb 28. */
export function windowOf(cutoff:string,years:number):{from:string;to:string}{
 const to=cutoff.slice(0,10);const [y,m,d]=to.split('-');
 return {from:`${String(Number(y)-years).padStart(4,'0')}-${m}-${m==='02'&&d==='29'?'28':d}`,to};
}
/** spec §5.5: digest({methodology, version, scope, window, threshold_n, ece_max, algorithm_version, cohort_sha256, validity_revision, query_bounds}). */
export function fingerprintOf(x:{methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;scope_type:string;scope_key:string;window_from:string;window_to:string;threshold_n:number;ece_max:number;algorithm_version:string;cohort_sha256:string;validity_revision:number;query_bounds:QueryBounds}):string{
 return digest({methodology_id:x.methodology_id,methodology_version:x.methodology_version,scope_type:x.scope_type,scope_key:x.scope_key,window_from:x.window_from,window_to:x.window_to,threshold_n:x.threshold_n,ece_max:x.ece_max,algorithm_version:x.algorithm_version,cohort_sha256:x.cohort_sha256,validity_revision:x.validity_revision,query_bounds:x.query_bounds});
}

const str=(v:unknown):v is string=>typeof v==='string'&&v.length>0;
function isUnitState(s:Record<string,unknown>):s is Record<string,unknown>&UnitState{
 const q=s.query_bounds as Record<string,unknown>|null;
 return str(s.generation)&&str(s.cutoff)&&Number.isSafeInteger(s.expected_revision)&&(s.after===null||str(s.after))&&typeof s.done==='boolean'&&
  !!q&&typeof q==='object'&&str(q.window_from)&&str(q.window_to)&&str(q.registered_at_lte)&&str(q.settled_at_lte)&&str(q.frozen_at)&&Number.isSafeInteger(q.n)&&
  Array.isArray(s.manifest)&&(s.manifest as unknown[]).every(m=>{const e=m as Record<string,unknown>;return !!e&&(e.start_after===null||str(e.start_after))&&str(e.end_after)&&str(e.path)&&str(e.sha256)&&Number.isSafeInteger(e.count);});
}

/** Clears a unit's state; when the CAS wins, also drops the generation's frozen members (best effort). */
async function clearUnit(ctx:StepContext,unit:Unit,updatedAt:string,generation:unknown):Promise<boolean>{
 const cleared=await ctx.db.setJobState(unit.job,updatedAt,{});
 if(cleared&&typeof generation==='string')await ctx.db.clearCalibrationGeneration(generation).catch(()=>0);
 return cleared;
}

/** One action on one unit: start | page | mark paging done | finalize. Re-reads the committed state every call. */
export async function stepUnit(ctx:StepContext,unit:Unit):Promise<StepOutcome>{
 const m=unit.methodology;
 const cur=await ctx.db.jobState(unit.job);
 const st=cur?.state??{};
 if(Object.keys(st).length===0){
  const {revision}=await ctx.db.calibrationValidity(m.methodology_id,m.version);
  const cutoff=await ctx.db.serverTime();
  const w=windowOf(cutoff,optionsOf(m.params).window_years);
  const generation=ctx.uuid();
  // P1-10: one statement freezes every member and its latest settlement (one MVCC snapshot); the generation is
  // recorded only afterwards, and a lost start race drops the loser's frozen set.
  const frozen=await ctx.db.freezeCalibrationCohort(generation,m.methodology_id,m.version,w);
  // Q1-05: a fresh uuid can only be already frozen if it was reused; that generation is someone else's — never clear it.
  if(frozen.status==='already_frozen')throw new CalibrateError('generation_reused',generation);
  const next:UnitState={generation,cutoff,expected_revision:Number(revision),
   query_bounds:{window_from:w.from,window_to:w.to,registered_at_lte:frozen.frozen_at,settled_at_lte:frozen.frozen_at,frozen_at:frozen.frozen_at,n:frozen.n},after:null,done:false,manifest:[]};
  if(await ctx.db.setJobState(unit.job,cur?.updated_at??null,next as unknown as Record<string,unknown>))return {kind:'started',generation};
  await ctx.db.clearCalibrationGeneration(generation).catch(()=>0);
  return {kind:'conflict'};
 }
 if(!isUnitState(st))return {kind:'reset',reason:'invalid_state',cleared:await clearUnit(ctx,unit,cur!.updated_at,(st as {generation?:unknown}).generation)};
 return st.done?finalize(ctx,unit,st,cur!.updated_at):page(ctx,unit,st,cur!.updated_at);
}

async function page(ctx:StepContext,unit:Unit,st:UnitState,updatedAt:string):Promise<StepOutcome>{
 // The frozen members of this generation, keyset on judgment_id; ONLY an empty page ends paging (P1-02: a server
 // row cap below pageSize returns short pages that are not exhaustion).
 const rows=await ctx.db.cohortMembers(st.generation,st.after,ctx.pageSize);
 if(rows.length===0)return await ctx.db.setJobState(unit.job,updatedAt,{...st,done:true} as unknown as Record<string,unknown>)?{kind:'paging_done'}:{kind:'conflict'};
 const endAfter=rows[rows.length-1].judgment.judgment_id;
 const entries=rows.map(entryOf).filter((e):e is CohortEntry=>e!==null&&inScope(e,unit.scope));
 const bytes=enc.encode(canonicalize({job:unit.job,generation:st.generation,start_after:st.after,end_after:endAfter,entries}));
 const hash=sha256(bytes);
 const path=`partial/${unitPath(unit)}/${st.generation}/${st.after??'start'}.${ctx.uuid()}.json`;
 if(await ctx.store.put(path,bytes,{upsert:false})!=='stored')throw new CalibrateError('cohort_path_collision',path);
 const next:UnitState={...st,after:endAfter,done:false,manifest:[...st.manifest,{start_after:st.after,end_after:endAfter,path,sha256:hash,count:entries.length}]};
 if(await ctx.db.setJobState(unit.job,updatedAt,next as unknown as Record<string,unknown>))return {kind:'paged',path,count:entries.length};
 // Another worker advanced the unit: drop only this attempt's object; the next step re-reads `after`.
 await ctx.store.remove(path).catch(()=>{});
 return {kind:'page_lost',path};
}

async function readManifest(ctx:StepContext,st:UnitState):Promise<CohortEntry[]|null>{
 const out:CohortEntry[]=[];const seen=new Set<string>();let prev:string|null=null;
 for(const e of st.manifest){
  if(e.start_after!==prev)return null;
  const bytes=await ctx.store.get(e.path);
  if(!bytes||sha256(bytes)!==e.sha256)return null;
  const body=JSON.parse(dec.decode(bytes)) as {generation:string;start_after:string|null;end_after:string;entries:CohortEntry[]};
  if(body.generation!==st.generation||body.start_after!==e.start_after||body.end_after!==e.end_after||!Array.isArray(body.entries)||body.entries.length!==e.count)return null;
  for(const x of body.entries)if(!seen.has(x.judgment_id)){seen.add(x.judgment_id);out.push(x);}
  prev=e.end_after;
 }
 return prev===st.after?out:null;
}

async function finalize(ctx:StepContext,unit:Unit,st:UnitState,updatedAt:string):Promise<StepOutcome>{
 const m=unit.methodology,q=st.query_bounds;
 const entries=await readManifest(ctx,st);
 if(entries===null)return {kind:'reset',reason:'cohort_object_invalid',cleared:await clearUnit(ctx,unit,updatedAt,st.generation)};
 const opts=optionsOf(m.params);
 const ev=evaluateCohort(m.kind,entries,opts);
 const cohortBytes=enc.encode(canonicalize({algorithm_version:ALGORITHM_VERSION,methodology_id:m.methodology_id,methodology_version:m.version,scope_type:unit.scope.scope_type,scope_key:unit.scope.scope_key,query_bounds:q,entries:ev.entries}));
 const cohort_sha256=sha256(cohortBytes);
 const cohort_path=`cohorts/${cohort_sha256}.json`;
 await ctx.store.put(cohort_path,cohortBytes,{upsert:false});   // content-addressed: 'exists' is the same bytes
 const fingerprint=fingerprintOf({methodology_id:m.methodology_id,methodology_version:m.version,scope_type:unit.scope.scope_type,scope_key:unit.scope.scope_key,window_from:q.window_from,window_to:q.window_to,threshold_n:opts.threshold_n,ece_max:opts.ece_max,algorithm_version:ALGORITHM_VERSION,cohort_sha256,validity_revision:st.expected_revision,query_bounds:q});
 const calibration_id=uuidV8(fingerprint);
 const computed_at=await ctx.db.serverTime();
 const row:CalibrationRow={
  calibration_id,methodology_id:m.methodology_id,methodology_version:m.version,scope_type:unit.scope.scope_type,scope_key:unit.scope.scope_key,
  window_from:q.window_from,window_to:q.window_to,n_registered:ev.n_registered,n_settled:ev.n_settled,n_independent:ev.n_independent,n_void:ev.n_void,
  n_retrospective_excluded:ev.n_retrospective_excluded,threshold_n:opts.threshold_n,ece_max:opts.ece_max,kind:m.kind,state:ev.state,
  valid_until:new Date(Date.parse(computed_at)+VALID_DAYS*86_400_000).toISOString(),validity_revision:st.expected_revision,
  metrics:ev.metrics,reliability:ev.reliability,isotonic_segments:ev.isotonic_segments,cohort_path,cohort_sha256,query_bounds:q,fingerprint,
  algorithm_version:ALGORITHM_VERSION,code_version:ctx.codeVersion,computed_at,batch_id:ctx.batchId,
 };
 const status=await ctx.db.insertCalibration(row,st.expected_revision);
 const cleared=await clearUnit(ctx,unit,updatedAt,st.generation);
 if(status==='stale_revision')return {kind:'stale',cleared};
 if(cleared)for(const e of st.manifest)await ctx.store.remove(e.path).catch(()=>{});   // unreferenced now; the cohort file stays
 return {kind:'finalized',status,calibration_id,cleared};
}

/** Steps one unit until it finalizes, loses to another worker, or runs out of budget. One restart after stale_revision. */
export async function runUnit(ctx:StepContext,unit:Unit,outOfBudget:()=>boolean):Promise<{outcome:UnitOutcome;pages:number;calibration_id?:string;infos:BatchError[]}>{
 const infos:BatchError[]=[];let pages=0,restarts=0;
 for(let i=0;i<MAX_STEPS;i++){
  if(outOfBudget()){infos.push({code:'deadline_hit',key:unit.job});return {outcome:'paused',pages,infos};}
  const r=await stepUnit(ctx,unit);
  switch(r.kind){
   case 'started':case 'paging_done':break;
   case 'paged':pages++;break;
   case 'page_lost':infos.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key:unit.job});break;
   case 'conflict':infos.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key:unit.job});return {outcome:'conflict',pages,infos};
   case 'reset':
    if(!r.cleared){infos.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key:unit.job});return {outcome:'conflict',pages,infos};}
    if(r.reason==='cohort_object_invalid')throw new CalibrateError('cohort_object_invalid',unit.job);
    break;
   case 'stale':
    infos.push({code:'stale_revision',key:unit.job});
    if(!r.cleared){infos.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key:unit.job});return {outcome:'conflict',pages,infos};}
    if(++restarts>1)return {outcome:'stale_revision',pages,infos};
    break;
   case 'finalized':
    if(!r.cleared)infos.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key:unit.job});   // next run: same fingerprint → duplicate → clear again (R05)
    return {outcome:r.status,pages,calibration_id:r.calibration_id,infos};
  }
 }
 throw new CalibrateError('step_limit',unit.job);
}

const codeOf=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof CalibrateError?e.code:'calibrate_failed';
const messageOf=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,300);

const ROUND_OUTCOMES:readonly string[]=['completed','failed','in_progress'];
const isRoundState=(s:Record<string,unknown>):s is Record<string,unknown>&RoundState=>Number.isSafeInteger(s.round)&&(s.round as number)>=1&&
 !!s.outcomes&&typeof s.outcomes==='object'&&!Array.isArray(s.outcomes)&&Object.values(s.outcomes as Record<string,unknown>).every(v=>typeof v==='string'&&ROUND_OUTCOMES.includes(v));
async function readRound(db:JudgmentsDb):Promise<{state:RoundState;updatedAt:string|null}>{
 const cur=await db.jobState(ROUND_JOB);
 const s=cur?.state??{};
 return {state:isRoundState(s)?{round:s.round,outcomes:{...s.outcomes}}:{round:1,outcomes:{}},updatedAt:cur?.updated_at??null};
}
const hasGeneration=async(db:JudgmentsDb,job:string)=>Object.keys((await db.jobState(job))?.state??{}).length>0;
/** Q1-04: failed → failed (excluded until the round advances); paused / conflict → in_progress; a final outcome is completed
 *  only once the unit state is clear — an insert whose clear CAS lost stays in_progress so the next run recovers it. */
async function roundOutcomeOf(db:JudgmentsDb,job:string,outcome:UnitOutcome):Promise<RoundOutcome>{
 if(outcome==='failed')return 'failed';
 if(outcome==='paused'||outcome==='conflict')return 'in_progress';
 return await hasGeneration(db,job)?'in_progress':'completed';
}
/** Records `job`'s outcome in the round (optimistic, 3 tries); false when another run moved the round on or kept winning. */
async function markRound(db:JudgmentsDb,round:number,job:string,outcome:RoundOutcome):Promise<boolean>{
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
  const cur=await readRound(db);
  if(cur.state.round!==round)return false;
  if(cur.state.outcomes[job]===outcome)return true;
  if(await db.setJobState(ROUND_JOB,cur.updatedAt,{round,outcomes:{...cur.state.outcomes,[job]:outcome}}))return true;
 }
 return false;
}

interface Planned{job:string;row:MethodologyRow|null;unit:Unit|null;ref:{id:string;version:string}}
/**
 * The run's work list (plan audit P2-02, Q1-04): every unit with an unfinished generation that has not FAILED this round
 * first (registry order), then the units without an unfinished generation whose round outcome is absent or in_progress.
 * A unit failed this round is excluded until the round advances. When every unit is failed, or completed with no
 * unfinished generation, the next round opens (outcomes {}) and the list restarts at the registry head.
 */
async function planRound(db:JudgmentsDb,methods:CalibrateDeps['methods']):Promise<{round:number;list:Planned[]}>{
 const all:Planned[]=[];
 for(const ref of methods){
  const row=await db.methodology(ref.id,ref.version);
  if(!row){all.push({job:jobKey('calibrate',ref.id,ref.version,{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''}),row:null,unit:null,ref});continue;}
  for(const unit of unitsOf(row))all.push({job:unit.job,row,unit,ref});
 }
 const unfinished=new Set<string>();
 for(const p of all)if(p.unit&&await hasGeneration(db,p.job))unfinished.add(p.job);
 let {state,updatedAt}=await readRound(db);
 const resumable=(s:RoundState)=>all.filter(p=>unfinished.has(p.job)&&s.outcomes[p.job]!=='failed');
 const open=(s:RoundState)=>all.filter(p=>!unfinished.has(p.job)&&(s.outcomes[p.job]===undefined||s.outcomes[p.job]==='in_progress'));
 const finished=(s:RoundState)=>all.every(p=>s.outcomes[p.job]==='failed'||(s.outcomes[p.job]==='completed'&&!unfinished.has(p.job)));
 if(finished(state)){
  const next:RoundState={round:state.round+1,outcomes:{}};
  if(await db.setJobState(ROUND_JOB,updatedAt,next as unknown as Record<string,unknown>))state=next;else({state,updatedAt}=await readRound(db));
 }
 return {round:state.round,list:[...resumable(state),...open(state)]};
}

export async function runCalibrate(deps:CalibrateDeps):Promise<CalibrateReceipt>{
 const now=deps.now??(()=>new Date());
 const outOfBudget=()=>deps.deadline!==null&&deps.deadline.getTime()-now().getTime()<RESERVE_MS;
 await deps.db.repairStaleBatches(CALIBRATE_DATASET,STALE_BATCH_SECONDS);
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:CALIBRATE_DATASET,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,triggeredBy:deps.triggeredBy??'script'});
 const ctx:StepContext={db:deps.db,store:deps.store,codeVersion:deps.codeVersion,batchId,uuid:deps.uuid??randomUUID,pageSize:deps.pageSize??PAGE_SIZE};
 // Task 5: deferred is optional and absent from emptyCounts(); judgment-layer receipts always carry it.
 const counts:Required<BatchCounts>={...emptyCounts(),deferred:0};const errors:BatchError[]=[];const units:UnitReceipt[]=[];
 let status:BatchStatus='failed';
 try{
  const {round,list}=await planRound(deps.db,deps.methods);
  const finished=async(job:string,outcome:UnitOutcome)=>{if(!(await markRound(deps.db,round,job,await roundOutcomeOf(deps.db,job,outcome))))errors.push({code:'job_state_conflict',key:ROUND_JOB});};
  for(const p of list){
   if(!p.row||!p.unit){
    units.push({job:p.job,methodology_id:p.ref.id,version:p.ref.version,scope:{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''},outcome:'skipped',pages:0,code:'methodology_unsynced'});
    await finished(p.job,'skipped');continue;
   }
   const unit=p.unit,row=p.row;
   const base={job:unit.job,methodology_id:row.methodology_id,version:row.version,scope:unit.scope};
   if(outOfBudget()){counts.deferred++;errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',key:unit.job});units.push({...base,outcome:'paused',pages:0});continue;}
   counts.fetched++;
   let outcome:UnitOutcome;
   try{
    const r=await runUnit(ctx,unit,outOfBudget);
    errors.push(...r.infos);
    if(r.outcome==='inserted')counts.inserted++;
    else if(r.outcome==='duplicate')counts.duplicates++;
    else counts.deferred++;
    outcome=r.outcome;
    units.push({...base,outcome:r.outcome,pages:r.pages,...(r.calibration_id?{calibration_id:r.calibration_id}:{})});
   }catch(e){
    outcome='failed';
    counts.failed++;errors.push({code:codeOf(e),key:unit.job,message:messageOf(e)});units.push({...base,outcome:'failed',pages:0,code:codeOf(e)});
   }
   await finished(unit.job,outcome);
  }
 }finally{
  status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId,{counts,errors});
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,CALIBRATE_DATASET,{ok:status==='success'||status==='partial',cadence:'event',detail:{batch_id:batchId,units:units.length}});
 }
 return {batchId,status,counts,errors,units};
}

export interface UnitPreview{job:string;methodology_id:string;version:string;scope:CalibrationScope;state:'idle'|'paging'|'finalizing'|'invalid';generation:string|null;pages:number;expected_revision:number|null;current_revision:number;stale:boolean}
/** ?preview=1: reads unit states and validity revisions only; writes nothing (no batch). */
export async function previewCalibrate(deps:Pick<CalibrateDeps,'db'|'methods'>):Promise<UnitPreview[]>{
 const out:UnitPreview[]=[];
 for(const ref of deps.methods){
  const row=await deps.db.methodology(ref.id,ref.version);
  if(!row)continue;
  const {revision}=await deps.db.calibrationValidity(row.methodology_id,row.version);
  for(const unit of unitsOf(row)){
   const st=(await deps.db.jobState(unit.job))?.state??{};
   const base={job:unit.job,methodology_id:row.methodology_id,version:row.version,scope:unit.scope,current_revision:Number(revision)};
   if(Object.keys(st).length===0)out.push({...base,state:'idle',generation:null,pages:0,expected_revision:null,stale:false});
   else if(!isUnitState(st))out.push({...base,state:'invalid',generation:null,pages:0,expected_revision:null,stale:false});
   else out.push({...base,state:st.done?'finalizing':'paging',generation:st.generation,pages:st.manifest.length,expected_revision:st.expected_revision,stale:st.expected_revision!==Number(revision)});
  }
 }
 return out;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibrate-deps.ts
// Production wiring of CalibrateDeps (spec §8.3) shared by /api/cron/judgments-calibrate and
// scripts/judgments/calibrate.ts: supabaseJudgmentsDb (anon for public reads, service role for the
// internal cohort, validity, job state and insert RPCs), the service-role TableClient for batches and
// freshness, the judgments-calibration bucket, and the registry order.
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import type {TriggeredBy} from '../dq/batches';
import type {CalibrateDeps} from './calibrate';
import {supabaseCohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from './db';
import {REGISTRY} from './registry';

export function productionCalibrateDeps(opts:{deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy}):CalibrateDeps{
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 return {
  db:supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon:getAnonSupabase(),admin}),tables:supabaseTableClient(admin),store:supabaseCohortStore(admin),
  methods:REGISTRY.map(m=>({id:m.id,version:m.version})),
  codeVersion:opts.codeVersion,deadline:opts.deadline,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy,
 };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: 实现 cron 路由 `src/app/api/cron/judgments-calibrate/route.ts`**（鉴权与 `facts-sync` / Task 14 `judgments-settle` 同一 timing-safe Bearer 写法）

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/judgments-calibrate/route.ts
// Weekly calibration (spec §8.3; vercel.json "0 4 * * 1"): CRON_SECRET bearer (same timing-safe check
// as facts-sync and judgments-settle), maxDuration 300 with a 280 s deadline handed to the core, which
// stops starting pages when less than 30 s remain and resumes next run. ?preview=1 reads unit states
// only (no batch, no writes). A missing code version refuses the run. The HTTP receipt carries codes,
// keys and counts only — never error messages.
import {timingSafeEqual} from 'node:crypto';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {previewCalibrate,runCalibrate} from '@/lib/judgments/calibrate';
import type {CalibrateReceipt} from '@/lib/judgments/calibrate';
import {productionCalibrateDeps} from '@/lib/judgments/calibrate-deps';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/judgments/deps';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEADLINE_MS=280_000;
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});

function authorized(auth:string|null,secret:string):boolean{
 const expected=Buffer.from(`Bearer ${secret}`),actual=Buffer.from(auth??'');
 return actual.length===expected.length&&timingSafeEqual(actual,expected);
}
const publicReceipt=(r:CalibrateReceipt)=>({batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,
 errors:r.errors.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key}),
 units:r.units.map(u=>({job:u.job,outcome:u.outcome,pages:u.pages,...(u.calibration_id?{calibration_id:u.calibration_id}:{}),...(u.code?{code:u.code}:{})}))});

async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorized(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 const preview=url.searchParams.getAll('preview');
 if(preview.length>1||(preview.length===1&&preview[0]!=='1'))return err('invalid_parameter:preview','preview must be 1',400);
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const deps=productionCalibrateDeps({deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  if(preview.length===1)return NextResponse.json({ok:true,preview:true,started_at:started.toISOString(),units:await previewCalibrate(deps)},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
  const receipt=await runCalibrate(deps);
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success',started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch{
  return err('calibrate_failed','Judgments calibration failed',500);
 }
}

export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

- [ ] **Step 12: 写脚本 `scripts/judgments/calibrate.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Judgments calibration from the command line (spec §8.3). Preview by default.
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/calibrate.ts [--apply] [--json]
 *
 * Preview: unit states, page counts and validity revisions only (no batch, no writes). --apply runs
 * the job without a deadline (an ingest_batches receipt, dataset judgments.calibrate, triggered_by
 * script; units resume from judgment_job_state exactly like the cron) and needs a code version
 * (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git checkout). tsx does NOT load .env.local: use node --env-file.
 * Exit 0 on success or partial, 1 when the batch failed, 2 on bad arguments or no code version.
 */
import {previewCalibrate,runCalibrate} from '../../src/lib/judgments/calibrate';
import {productionCalibrateDeps} from '../../src/lib/judgments/calibrate-deps';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/judgments/deps';

const USAGE='usage: calibrate.ts [--apply] [--json]';

async function main(argv:string[]):Promise<number>{
 let apply=false,json=false;
 for(const a of argv){if(a==='--apply')apply=true;else if(a==='--json')json=true;else{console.error(USAGE);return 2;}}
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true});
 if(!codeVersion){console.error('no code version: set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run from a git checkout');return 2;}
 const deps=productionCalibrateDeps({deadline:null,codeVersion,triggeredBy:'script'});
 if(!apply){
  const units=await previewCalibrate(deps);
  if(json)console.log(JSON.stringify({preview:true,units},null,1));
  else for(const u of units)console.log(`${u.job}  ${u.state}${u.generation?`  gen=${u.generation} pages=${u.pages}`:''}  revision ${u.expected_revision??'-'}/${u.current_revision}${u.stale?'  (stale)':''}`);
  return 0;
 }
 const r=await runCalibrate(deps);
 if(json)console.log(JSON.stringify(r,null,1));
 else{
  console.log(`batch ${r.batchId} ${r.status} ${JSON.stringify(r.counts)}`);
  for(const u of r.units)console.log(`${u.job}  ${u.outcome}  pages=${u.pages}${u.calibration_id?`  ${u.calibration_id}`:''}${u.code?`  ${u.code}`:''}`);
  for(const e of r.errors)console.log(`  ${e.code}${e.key?` ${e.key}`:''}${e.message?`: ${e.message}`:''}`);
 }
 return r.status==='failed'||r.status==='rejected'?1:0;
}
main(process.argv.slice(2)).then(code=>process.exit(code),e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```
