```ts
// src/lib/judgments/calibrate.integration.test.ts
// spec §14.2 calibration resume on real PostgreSQL (pgJudgmentsDb over the F4 migration) with the
// in-memory CohortStore: R02/S01 (crash between upload and CAS → orphan never consumed, retry under
// a new attempt id; two concurrent workers → only the CAS winner's page in the manifest), R03
// (registrations on both sides of the cursor after the cutoff stay out), P1-10 (a registration open across the
// freeze stays out; members cleared with the unit), R04 (an unpublished method
// calibrates internally while the anon cohort is empty), R05 (an out-of-window withdrawal changes the
// fingerprint; duplicate clears the unit; a failed clear is retried), acceptance example 10
// (withdrawal during a run → stale_revision, the old report reads invalid). Rows are never cleaned
// up (append-only by design; test:db creates a fresh database per run); every test uses its own method.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {pgTableClient} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {uuidV8} from './uuid-v8';
import {addDays} from './calibration';
import {runCalibrate,stepUnit,unitsOf} from './calibrate';
import type {StepContext,StepOutcome,Unit,UnitState} from './calibrate';
import {digest,inputsHash} from './canonical';
import {memoryCohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import type {CohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import {withClaimLock} from './db-contract';
import {pgJudgmentsDb} from './pg-judgments-db';
import type {Input,JudgmentInsert,JudgmentsDb,MethodologyRow,QueueRow} from './types';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const ADMIN=`admin:${randomUUID()}`;
const HEX=(c:string)=>c.repeat(64);

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('F4 calibration job on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 let pool:Pool;let db:JudgmentsDb;
 const q=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await pool.query(text,values)).rows as Record<string,unknown>[];
 const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const batch=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset) values($1,'ts-judgments','judgments.calibrate')`,[id]);return id;};
 const issuer=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en) values($1,'ZZ Calibrate Test')`,[id]);return id;};
 async function method(publishable:boolean):Promise<MethodologyRow>{
  const id=`zz_cal_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g,'').slice(0,12)}`;
  await db.syncMethodology({methodology_id:id,version:'v1',judgment_type:'synthetic_fact_metric',kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',subject_types:['issuer'],input_kinds:['financial_fact'],markets:null,
   title_zh:'校准测试',title_en:'Calibration test',doc_path:`docs/methodologies/${id}/v1.md`,doc_sha256:HEX('a'),implementation_sha256:HEX('b'),
   params:{grace_days:30,threshold_n:3,ece_max:0.1,window_years:3},params_json:{},horizon:{unit:'calendar_days',n:10},upstream:{},deps_sha256:HEX('c'),formula_hash:HEX('d'),
   status:'active',publishable,code_version:'abcdef1'},'script',null);
  return (await db.methodology(id,'v1'))!;
 }
 /** The register_judgment payload of one active probability judgment of `m` on `subject` at `asOf`. */
 async function rowFor(m:MethodologyRow,subject:string,asOf:string):Promise<{row:JudgmentInsert;queue:{settle_after:string;settle_by:string;label_policy:'first_observed'}}>{
  const factId=randomUUID();
  const snapshot={fact_id:factId,issuer_id:subject,market:'US' as const,concept:'revenue',period_start:'2025-07-01',period_end:'2025-09-30',duration:'3M',value_text:'100',unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:asOf,filing_id:randomUUID(),mapping_gen:1};
  const inputs:Input[]=[{kind:'financial_fact',ref:{fact_id:factId},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:`${asOf}T00:00:00.000Z`,origin:{publisher:'SEC',adapter:'edgar',locator:'companyfacts'}}];
  const inputs_hash=inputsHash(inputs);
  const judgment_id=uuidV8(digest({subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:subject,judgment_type:m.judgment_type,methodology_id:m.methodology_id,methodology_version:m.version,as_of:asOf,inputs_hash,producer_nonce:''}));
  const date=addDays(asOf,10);
  const settle_after=`${date}T00:00:00.000Z`,settle_by=new Date(Date.parse(settle_after)+30*86_400_000).toISOString();
  const row:JudgmentInsert={judgment_id,subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:subject,judgment_type:m.judgment_type,methodology_id:m.methodology_id,methodology_version:m.version,kind:'probability',producer_kind:'rule',producer_ref:{},producer_nonce:'',
   as_of:asOf,inputs,inputs_hash,abstained:false,abstain_reason:null,claim:{p:0.7,event:{zh:'营收同比增长',en:'Revenue grows'}},
   condition:{resolver:'fact_metric',params:{issuer_id:subject,market:'US',metric:'revenue',period_start:'2025-10-01',period_end:'2025-12-31',duration:'3M',unit:'USD',input_unit:'USD',basis:'reported',formula_version:'metrics/1',compare:'yoy'},predicate:{op:'>',rhs:0},text:{zh:'营收同比 > 0',en:'Revenue YoY > 0'}},
   horizon:{unit:'calendar_days',n:10},target:{kind:'date',date},label_policy:'first_observed',settle_after,settle_by,code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:await batch(),retrospective_hint:{label_available_at:null}};
  return {row,queue:{settle_after,settle_by,label_policy:'first_observed'}};
 }
 /** One active probability judgment of `m` on `subject` at `asOf` (producer_nonce '' — ids differ by as_of / subject). */
 async function register(m:MethodologyRow,subject:string,asOf:string):Promise<string>{
  const {row,queue}=await rowFor(m,subject,asOf);const judgment_id=row.judgment_id;
  // D6 / Task 4 rule: a due row is registered under the claim lock and parked (next_attempt_at far future) before the
  // lock is released, so no other suite's claimDue ever sees it; settle() makes it due again under the lock.
  await withClaimLock(pool,async()=>{
   await db.registerJudgment(row,queue);
   await q(`update public.judgment_settle_queue set next_attempt_at='2099-01-01T00:00:00Z' where judgment_id=$1`,[judgment_id]);
  });
  return judgment_id;
 }
 /** Under the claim lock only: claim until `id` is held (foreign rows are held too, so claimDue moves on), run fn, then release every foreign row untouched. */
 async function withLease<T>(id:string,fn:(own:QueueRow)=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>{
  const foreign:QueueRow[]=[];let own:QueueRow|undefined;
  try{
   while(!own){
    const rows=await db.claimDue(100,600);
    if(rows.length===0)throw new Error(`queue row ${id} is not due`);
    for(const r of rows)if(r.judgment_id===id)own=r;else foreign.push(r);
   }
   return await fn(own);
  }finally{
   for(const r of foreign)await db.releaseLease(r.judgment_id,r.lease_token!,{last_status:r.last_status??'pending',last_detail:r.last_detail,next_attempt_at:r.next_attempt_at,attempts_increment:0});
  }
 }
 /** D6: settlements go through the cron path — due under the lock, claimDue, appendSettlement with the lease token as 'cron'. */
 async function settle(id:string,outcome:'hit'|'miss'){
  await withClaimLock(pool,async()=>{
   await q(`update public.judgment_settle_queue set next_attempt_at=now() where judgment_id=$1`,[id]);
   const r=await withLease(id,async own=>db.appendSettlement(id,own.lease_token,`it:${randomUUID()}`,{kind:'settled',outcome,realized:{value:outcome==='hit'?0.1:-0.1,unit:'ratio',from:null,to:null,label_policy:'first_observed'},evidence:{test:true},resolver:'fact_metric',resolver_version:'1',reason:null,actor:'cron',code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:await batch()}));
   expect(r.status).toBe('applied');
  });
 }
 async function withdraw(id:string){
  const r=await db.appendSettlement(id,null,`it:${randomUUID()}`,{kind:'withdrawn',outcome:null,realized:null,evidence:{test:true},resolver:'fact_metric',resolver_version:'1',reason:'test withdrawal',actor:ADMIN,code_version:'abcdef1',batch_id:await batch()});
  expect(r.status).toBe('applied');
 }
 /** n judgments on one issuer at as_of = today − 200 + 3i; the first `settled` of them settled hit/miss alternately. */
 async function cohort(m:MethodologyRow,n:number,settled:number){
  const subject=await issuer();const ids:string[]=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++)ids.push(await register(m,subject,addDays(today(),-200+3*i)));
  for(let i=0;i<settled;i++)await settle(ids[i],i%2?'miss':'hit');
  return {subject,ids};
 }
 const ctxOf=async(store:CohortStore,prefix:string,over:Partial<StepContext>={}):Promise<StepContext>=>{let u=0;return {db,store,codeVersion:'abcdef1',batchId:await batch(),uuid:()=>`${prefix}-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-${String(++u).padStart(12,'0')}`,pageSize:2,...over};};
 const allUnit=(m:MethodologyRow)=>unitsOf(m)[0];
 const stateOf=async(u:Unit)=>((await db.jobState(u.job))?.state??{}) as unknown as UnitState|Record<string,never>;
 const rowsOf=(m:MethodologyRow)=>q(`select calibration_id,scope_type,n_registered,n_settled,validity_revision,fingerprint,cohort_sha256,cohort_path from public.judgment_calibrations where methodology_id=$1 order by computed_at`,[m.methodology_id]);
 async function finish(ctx:StepContext,u:Unit):Promise<StepOutcome>{
  for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const r=await stepUnit(ctx,u);if(r.kind==='finalized'||r.kind==='stale'||r.kind==='conflict')return r;}
  throw new Error('unit did not finish');
 }
 /** Wraps setJobState once; everything else is the real pg db. */
 const withSetJobState=(impl:JudgmentsDb['setJobState']):JudgmentsDb=>new Proxy(db,{get:(t,p)=>{if(p==='setJobState')return impl;const v=(t as unknown as Record<string|symbol,unknown>)[p];return typeof v==='function'?v.bind(t):v;}}) as JudgmentsDb;

 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  pool=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl,statement_timeout:8000});
  db=pgJudgmentsDb(pool);
 });
 afterAll(async()=>{await pool?.end();});

 it('R04: an unpublished method calibrates through calibration_cohort_internal while the anon cohort is empty',async()=>{
  const m=await method(false);
  await cohort(m,5,3);
  const cutoff=await db.serverTime();
  const w={from:addDays(today(),-3*366),to:today()};
  expect(await db.calibrationCohort(m.methodology_id,'v1',w,cutoff,null,100)).toEqual([]);
  expect(await db.calibrationCohortInternal(m.methodology_id,'v1',w,cutoff,null,100)).toHaveLength(5);
  const store=memoryCohortStore();
  const r=await runCalibrate({db,tables:pgTableClient(pool),store,methods:[{id:m.methodology_id,version:'v1'}],codeVersion:'abcdef1',deadline:null,pageSize:2,uuid:(()=>{let u=0;return ()=>`dddddddd-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-${String(++u).padStart(12,'0')}`;})()});
  expect(r.units.map(u=>[u.scope.scope_type,u.outcome])).toEqual([['all','inserted'],['subject_type','inserted']]);
  const rows=await rowsOf(m);
  expect(rows.map(x=>[x.scope_type,x.n_registered,x.n_settled])).toEqual([['all',5,3],['subject_type',5,3]]);
  expect(await db.latestCalibration(m.methodology_id,'v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''})).toBeNull();   // anon: unpublished
  expect(store.objects.has(String(rows[0].cohort_path))).toBe(true);
  expect(await stateOf(allUnit(m))).toEqual({});
 },60000);

 it('R02/S01: a crash between upload and CAS leaves an orphan no manifest names; the retry uses a new attempt id',async()=>{
  const m=await method(false);
  await cohort(m,5,2);
  const store=memoryCohortStore();const u=allUnit(m);
  let crashed=false;
  const crashing=withSetJobState(async(job,expected,state)=>{
   if(!crashed&&Array.isArray((state as {manifest?:unknown[]}).manifest)&&(state as {manifest:unknown[]}).manifest.length>0){crashed=true;throw new Error('process killed');}
   return db.setJobState(job,expected,state);
  });
  const a=await ctxOf(store,'aaaaaaaa',{db:crashing});
  expect((await stepUnit(a,u)).kind).toBe('started');
  await expect(stepUnit(a,u)).rejects.toThrow('process killed');
  const orphans=[...store.objects.keys()].filter(k=>k.startsWith('partial/'));
  expect(orphans).toHaveLength(1);
  store.objects.set(orphans[0],new TextEncoder().encode('{"tampered":true}'));
  const b=await ctxOf(store,'bbbbbbbb');
  const paged=await stepUnit(b,u);
  expect(paged.kind).toBe('paged');
  expect((paged as {path:string}).path).not.toBe(orphans[0]);
  const st=await stateOf(u) as UnitState;
  expect(st.manifest.map(x=>x.path)).not.toContain(orphans[0]);
  const done=await finish(b,u);
  expect(done).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted',cleared:true});
  expect((await rowsOf(m))[0]).toMatchObject({n_registered:5,n_settled:2});
  expect(store.objects.has(orphans[0])).toBe(true);
 },60000);

 it('R02: two concurrent workers on the same page — only the CAS winner\'s object enters the manifest',async()=>{
  const m=await method(false);
  await cohort(m,4,0);
  const shared=memoryCohortStore();const u=allUnit(m);
  let reached!:()=>void;const atPut=new Promise<void>(r=>{reached=r;});
  let release!:()=>void;const gate=new Promise<void>(r=>{release=r;});
  const gated:CohortStore={async put(p,bytes,o){const r=await shared.put(p,bytes,o);reached();await gate;return r;},get:p=>shared.get(p),remove:p=>shared.remove(p)};
  const a=await ctxOf(gated,'aaaaaaaa'),b=await ctxOf(shared,'bbbbbbbb');
  expect((await stepUnit(b,u)).kind).toBe('started');
  const pa=stepUnit(a,u);
  await atPut;
  const rb=await stepUnit(b,u);
  expect(rb.kind).toBe('paged');
  release();
  const ra=await pa;
  expect(ra.kind).toBe('page_lost');
  const st=await stateOf(u) as UnitState;
  expect(st.manifest.map(x=>x.path)).toEqual([(rb as {path:string}).path]);
  expect(shared.objects.has((ra as {path:string}).path)).toBe(false);
  expect((await finish(b,u))).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted'});
  expect((await rowsOf(m))[0].n_registered).toBe(4);
 },60000);

 it('R03: registrations after the cutoff on both sides of the cursor, and a settlement after it, stay out of the cohort',async()=>{
  const m=await method(false);
  const {subject,ids}=await cohort(m,4,2);
  const store=memoryCohortStore();const u=allUnit(m);
  const ctx=await ctxOf(store,'cccccccc');
  expect((await stepUnit(ctx,u)).kind).toBe('started');
  expect((await stepUnit(ctx,u)).kind).toBe('paged');
  const after=(await stateOf(u) as UnitState).after!;
  const sides={lt:0,gt:0};
  for(let i=0;i<60&&(sides.lt===0||sides.gt===0);i++){
   const id=await register(m,subject,addDays(today(),-100-i));   // inside the window, registered after the cutoff
   if(id<after)sides.lt++;else sides.gt++;
  }
  expect(sides.lt).toBeGreaterThan(0);expect(sides.gt).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  await settle(ids[3],'hit');                                       // settled after the cutoff
  expect(await finish(ctx,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted'});
  expect((await rowsOf(m))[0]).toMatchObject({n_registered:4,n_settled:2});
 },60000);

 it('P1-10: a registration whose transaction is open across the freeze stays out of the generation on every page; the members are cleared with the unit',async()=>{
  const m=await method(false);
  const {subject}=await cohort(m,3,1);
  const store=memoryCohortStore();const u=allUnit(m);
  const ctx=await ctxOf(store,'cdcdcdcd');
  const late=await rowFor(m,subject,addDays(today(),-50));
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{
   await c.query('begin');
   await c.query(`select public.register_judgment($1::jsonb,$2::jsonb)`,[JSON.stringify(late.row),JSON.stringify(late.queue)]);
   await c.query(`update public.judgment_settle_queue set next_attempt_at='2099-01-01T00:00:00Z' where judgment_id=$1`,[late.row.judgment_id]);   // parked before it is ever visible (D6)
   expect((await stepUnit(ctx,u)).kind).toBe('started');                                     // freezes while that registration is uncommitted
   await c.query('commit');
  }finally{c.release();}
  const st=await stateOf(u) as UnitState;
  expect(st.query_bounds).toMatchObject({n:3,frozen_at:st.query_bounds.registered_at_lte});
  expect(await finish(ctx,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted',cleared:true});
  expect((await rowsOf(m))[0]).toMatchObject({n_registered:3,n_settled:1});                  // committed after the snapshot: consistently out
  expect(await q(`select count(*)::int n from public.judgment_calibration_cohort_members where generation=$1`,[st.generation])).toEqual([{n:0}]);
  // the next generation sees it
  expect(await finish(ctx,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted'});
  expect((await rowsOf(m))[1]).toMatchObject({n_registered:4});
 },60000);

 it('R05: duplicate clears the unit after a failed clear; an out-of-window withdrawal changes the fingerprint, not the cohort',async()=>{
  const m=await method(true);
  const subject=await issuer();
  const old=await register(m,subject,addDays(today(),-4*366));      // outside the 3-year window
  await settle(old,'hit');
  await cohort(m,3,2);
  const store=memoryCohortStore();const u=allUnit(m);
  let failClear=true;
  const flaky=withSetJobState(async(job,expected,state)=>{if(failClear&&Object.keys(state).length===0){failClear=false;return false;}return db.setJobState(job,expected,state);});
  const c1=await ctxOf(store,'eeeeeeee',{db:flaky});
  expect(await finish(c1,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted',cleared:false});
  expect((await stateOf(u) as UnitState).done).toBe(true);
  const c2=await ctxOf(store,'ffffffff');
  expect(await stepUnit(c2,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'duplicate',cleared:true});
  expect(await stateOf(u)).toEqual({});
  const [first]=await rowsOf(m);
  expect(first.n_registered).toBe(3);
  expect((await db.latestCalibration(m.methodology_id,'v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''}))?.valid).toBe(true);
  await withdraw(old);                                               // revision + 1; the cohort does not contain `old`
  expect((await db.latestCalibration(m.methodology_id,'v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''}))?.valid).toBe(false);
  expect(await finish(c2,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted'});
  const rows=await rowsOf(m);
  expect(rows).toHaveLength(2);
  expect(rows[1].n_registered).toBe(rows[0].n_registered);
  expect(Number(rows[1].validity_revision)).toBe(Number(rows[0].validity_revision)+1);
  expect(rows[1].fingerprint).not.toBe(rows[0].fingerprint);
  const entries=async(path:unknown)=>JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode((await store.get(String(path)))!)).entries;
  expect(await entries(rows[1].cohort_path)).toEqual(await entries(rows[0].cohort_path));
 },60000);

 it('acceptance example 10: a withdrawal during the run → stale_revision, no new report, the old report reads invalid',async()=>{
  const m=await method(true);
  const {ids}=await cohort(m,3,3);
  const store=memoryCohortStore();const u=allUnit(m);
  const c=await ctxOf(store,'abababab');
  expect(await finish(c,u)).toMatchObject({kind:'finalized',status:'inserted'});
  expect((await db.latestCalibration(m.methodology_id,'v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''}))?.valid).toBe(true);
  expect((await stepUnit(c,u)).kind).toBe('started');
  expect((await stepUnit(c,u)).kind).toBe('paged');
  await withdraw(ids[0]);
  expect(await finish(c,u)).toEqual({kind:'stale',cleared:true});
  expect(await rowsOf(m)).toHaveLength(1);
  const latest=await db.latestCalibration(m.methodology_id,'v1',{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''});
  expect(latest?.valid).toBe(false);
  expect(await stateOf(u)).toEqual({});
 },60000);
});
```

`messages/{zh,en}/judgments.json` 的顶层键（Task 18/20/21 只用这些）：`lifecycle`、`calibration`、`calibrationDetail`、`kind`、`band`、`outcome`、`card`、`target`、`horizon`、`labelPolicy`、`inputs`（含 `inputs.kind.*`）、`timeline`、`methods`（含 `methods.columns.*`、`methods.status.*`、`methods.publishable.*`、`methods.detail.*`）、`admin`（含 `admin.filters.*`、`admin.columns.*`）、`derived`（含 `derived.reasons.*` = `derivedOdds` 的全部原因码）、`errors`。顶层键 `analyst`（Task 20）与 `ui`（Task 21）保留给后续任务：本任务不建它们，后续任务只在顶层对象里**追加**这两个子树（zh/en 同时），`messages.test.ts` 会拦截不对称。

**渲染规则（§9.3）**：`percent = round(p×100)` 只在 `kind='probability' ∧ calibration='calibrated'`；其余 probability 状态给 `band`（`[0,1/3)` low、`[1/3,2/3)` mid、`[2/3,1]` high），`display.value=null`（登记的 `p` 只在 `/api/judgments/[id]` 的 `judgment.claim` 里，卡片上没有）；categorical 只给 `selected`，`distribution` 永不进卡片；score 给分值、刻度、维度（缺维度 `value=null, coverage=false`），状态只有 `evaluated | insufficient`；interval 给 `[low, high]` 与名义覆盖。`calibration` 维度：只认 `scope_type='all'`、同方法同版本同 kind、`calibration_valid=true` 且（给了 `now` 时）`valid_until > now` 的行，否则 `insufficient`；`self_assessed` 只来自私有适配器（Task 20）。结算叠加：settled 追加"结果：命中 / 未命中"（categorical 追加实现类别），void / withdrawn 追加原因。

**规格偏差（记入实施记录）：**
1. §1.1 "方法未 calibrated 时响应里没有 percent 字段"：契约 `display.percent: number|null` 在内存里是必有字段（`toCard` 返回 `null`）；HTTP 层由 Task 18 `route-utils.ts::serializeBody` 在序列化时删去值为 `null` 的 `percent` 键（决策 D2，所有判断路由经 `okResponse / privateResponse` 统一施加），所以响应里没有 `percent` 字段；同时保证卡片上任何字段都不含登记的 `p`（测试断言 `display` 序列化后不含 `0.7` / `70`）。
2. `toCard` 需要方法标题（信封里没有方法行），调用方从 `listMethodologies()` 传 `title`；`cardsOf` 在 RLS 之外再按方法行 `publishable` 过滤一次（纵深防御）。
3. 维度标签 v1 两语都用维度 `id`（还没有维度目录）；`evidence_summary` 是通用的 `resolver@version · 原因`。
4. §9.5 说 `messages-parity.test.ts` "自动覆盖"：该测试只遍历它自己的固定域列表，且不在 F4 可改文件内；F4 用自己的 `messages.test.ts` 做键与占位符对称检查。
5. §9.4 "同 `unit`" 解释为两个判断的 `horizon.unit` 相同；`k` 由调用方传入（公司规格参数），要求 `0 < k ≤ 1`。

```ts
describe('derivedOdds (spec §9.4)',()=>{
 // Narrow member type (not the Condition union) so a predicate-replaced copy below is still a valid price_return condition (plan audit P1-01).
 const condition:Extract<Condition,{resolver:'price_return'}>={resolver:'price_return',params:{ticker:'AAPL',market:'US',adjustment:'qfq',source:'eastmoney',base_date:'2026-01-02'},predicate:{op:'>',rhs:0.1},text:{zh:'12 个月涨超 10%',en:'up >10% in 12 months'}};
 const target={kind:'date' as const,date:'2027-01-02'};
 const win=(p=0.6,over:EnvelopeSpec['judgment']={})=>envelope({judgment:{n:1,as_of:'2026-01-02',judgment_type:'thesis_win_rate',claim:{p,event:{zh:'涨超 10%',en:'up >10%'}},condition,target,...over},calibration:CAL});
 const range=(claim:Partial<IntervalClaim>={},over:EnvelopeSpec['judgment']={},cal:EnvelopeSpec['calibration']={kind:'interval',state:'calibrated'})=>envelope({judgment:{n:2,as_of:'2026-01-02',judgment_type:'return_range',kind:'interval',
  claim:{metric:'return_12m',low:-0.2,high:0.4,unit:'ratio',nominal_coverage:0.8,scenarios:[{label:'up',p:0.6,value:0.3},{label:'down',p:0.4,value:-0.15}],scenario_event_hash:digest(condition),...claim},condition,target,...over},calibration:cal});
 it('computes b and fractional Kelly when every gate passes',()=>{
  const r=derivedOdds(win(),range(),{k:0.5});
  expect(r.status).toBe('computed');
  if(r.status==='computed'){expect(r.b).toBeCloseTo(2,12);expect(r.f).toBeCloseTo(0.5*(0.6*2-0.4)/2,12);}
 });
 it('|p_up − p| ≤ 0.01 passes at the boundary and fails beyond it',()=>{
  expect(derivedOdds(win(0.61),range(),{k:0.5}).status).toBe('computed');
  expect(derivedOdds(win(0.62),range(),{k:0.5})).toEqual({status:'not_computed',reasons:['inputs_inconsistent']});
 });
 it('every precondition failure is a reason',()=>{
  const reasonsOf=(a:Envelope,b:Envelope,k=0.5)=>{const r=derivedOdds(a,b,{k});return r.status==='not_computed'?r.reasons:[];};
  expect(reasonsOf(win(0.6,{}),range({},{},{kind:'interval',state:'failed'}))).toEqual(['not_calibrated']);
  expect(reasonsOf(envelope({judgment:{n:1,as_of:'2026-01-02',judgment_type:'thesis_win_rate',claim:{p:0.6,event:{zh:'涨',en:'up'}},condition,target},calibration:CAL,settlement:{}}),range())).toEqual(['not_open']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({scenarios:undefined}))).toEqual(['scenarios_missing']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({scenarios:[{label:'up',p:0.6,value:0.3},{label:'down',p:0.5,value:-0.15}]}))).toEqual(['scenarios_not_normalized']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({scenarios:[{label:'up',p:0.6,value:-0.1},{label:'down',p:0.4,value:-0.15}]}))).toEqual(['scenario_values_invalid']);
  const otherEvent:Condition={...condition,predicate:{op:'>',rhs:0}};
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({scenario_event_hash:digest(otherEvent)}))).toEqual(['event_mismatch']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({},{as_of:'2026-01-05'}))).toContain('as_of_mismatch');
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({},{subject_key:'55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555'}))).toEqual(['subject_mismatch']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({},{target:{kind:'date',date:'2027-01-03'}}))).toEqual(['target_mismatch']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range({},{horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:12}}))).toEqual(['unit_mismatch']);
  expect(reasonsOf(win(),range(),0)).toEqual(['invalid_k']);
  expect(reasonsOf(range(),win())).toContain('wrong_type');
 });
 it('uses calibrationRow defaults from the shared builder',()=>{expect(calibrationRow().state).toBe('calibrated');});
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/band.ts
// Tercile band of a probability (spec §9.2 / §9.3): [0, 1/3) low, [1/3, 2/3) mid, [2/3, 1] high. Import-free so client
// components can use it (display.ts imports canonical.ts → node crypto); display.ts and the private adapter (Task 20)
// re-export this one definition.
export type Band='low'|'mid'|'high';
export const bandOf=(p:number):Band=>p<1/3?'low':p<2/3?'mid':'high';
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/display.ts
// Display contract (spec §9.1–§9.4): two independent dimensions — lifecycle (one judgment: latest
// settlement row) and calibration (method level: the scope='all' row, only while calibration_valid,
// i.e. same validity revision and not expired) — decide what a card may show. A percent appears only
// for probability × calibrated; uncalibrated probabilities show a tertile band; categorical
// distributions never appear on the card; scores are evaluated, never calibrated. Headlines are
// built here in both languages (locale-independent; the UI picks one). derivedOdds() is the §9.4 gate
// for odds / Kelly: every precondition failure is returned as a reason, nothing is computed.
import {bandOf} from './band';
import type {Band} from './band';
import {canonicalize,digest} from './canonical';
import type {Bilingual,CalibrationRow,CalibrationState,CategoricalClaim,Envelope,Input,IntervalClaim,JudgmentCard,Kind,Lifecycle,MethodologyRow,ProbabilityClaim,ScoreClaim} from './types';

export const KINDS:readonly Kind[]=['probability','categorical','score','interval'];
export const PUBLIC_LIFECYCLES=['abstained','open','settled','void','withdrawn'] as const satisfies readonly Lifecycle[];
/** recommendation_call@v1 private cards (spec §11.2): no void; pending_fill before the fill is known. */
export const PRIVATE_LIFECYCLES=['abstained','pending_fill','open','settled','withdrawn'] as const satisfies readonly Lifecycle[];
export const CALIBRATION_STATES_BY_KIND:Readonly<Record<Kind,readonly CalibrationState[]>>={
 probability:['insufficient','failed','calibrated'],categorical:['insufficient','failed','calibrated'],
 score:['insufficient','evaluated'],interval:['insufficient','failed','calibrated'],
};
export interface CardCombination{source:'public'|'recommendation';kind:Kind;lifecycle:Lifecycle;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;calibration:CalibrationState;percent:boolean;band:boolean}
/** Every combination a card can reach (spec §9.6 item 1); the Claude Design canvas draws exactly these. */
export function reachableCombinations():CardCombination[]{
 const out:CardCombination[]=[];
 const push=(source:CardCombination['source'],kind:Kind,lifecycle:Lifecycle,calibration:CalibrationState)=>{
  for(const outcome of lifecycle==='settled'?(['hit','miss'] as const):[null]){
   const shown=lifecycle!=='abstained'&&lifecycle!=='pending_fill';
   out.push({source,kind,lifecycle,outcome,calibration,percent:shown&&kind==='probability'&&calibration==='calibrated',band:shown&&kind==='probability'&&calibration!=='calibrated'});
  }
 };
 for(const kind of KINDS)for(const lifecycle of PUBLIC_LIFECYCLES)for(const c of CALIBRATION_STATES_BY_KIND[kind])push('public',kind,lifecycle,c);
 for(const lifecycle of PRIVATE_LIFECYCLES)push('recommendation','probability',lifecycle,'self_assessed');
 return out;
}
export const REACHABLE_COMBINATIONS:readonly CardCombination[]=reachableCombinations();

/** spec §9.1: abstained | open | settled | void | withdrawn; a reopened judgment is open again. */
export function lifecycleOf(e:Envelope):Lifecycle{
 if(e.judgment.abstained)return 'abstained';
 const s=e.settlement;
 if(!s||s.kind==='reopened')return 'open';
 return s.kind;
}
/** The calibration row that may speak for the method: scope 'all', same method and kind, calibration_valid, not expired at `now`. */
export function validCalibration(e:Envelope,kind:Kind,now?:string):CalibrationRow|null{
 const c=e.calibration;
 if(!c||!e.calibration_valid)return null;
 if(c.scope_type!=='all'||c.kind!==kind||c.methodology_id!==e.judgment.methodology_id||c.methodology_version!==e.judgment.methodology_version)return null;
 if(now!==undefined&&!(Date.parse(c.valid_until)>Date.parse(now)))return null;
 return c;
}
/** spec §9.1: invalid, expired or missing → insufficient; score rows say evaluated or insufficient; never calibrated without a valid row. */
export function calibrationStateOf(e:Envelope,kind:Kind,now?:string):CalibrationState{
 const c=validCalibration(e,kind,now);
 if(!c)return 'insufficient';
 if(kind==='score')return c.state==='evaluated'?'evaluated':'insufficient';
 return c.state==='calibrated'||c.state==='failed'?c.state:'insufficient';
}
export {bandOf};export type {Band};

const BAND:Record<Band,Bilingual>={low:{zh:'低',en:'low'},mid:{zh:'中',en:'medium'},high:{zh:'高',en:'high'}};
const CLASS_LABELS:Record<string,Bilingual>={recovery:{zh:'复苏',en:'recovery'},overheat:{zh:'过热',en:'overheat'},stagflation:{zh:'滞胀',en:'stagflation'},recession:{zh:'衰退',en:'recession'}};
export const classLabel=(c:string):Bilingual=>CLASS_LABELS[c]??{zh:c,en:c};
const fmt=(x:number,d=2)=>String(Number(x.toFixed(d)));
const pct=(x:number)=>String(Math.round(x*100));
const numOr=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v)?v:null;
const both=(zh:string,en:string):Bilingual=>({zh,en});
const join=(a:Bilingual,b:Bilingual):Bilingual=>({zh:a.zh+b.zh,en:a.en+b.en});

type Summary=NonNullable<JudgmentCard['calibration_summary']>;
function summaryOf(c:CalibrationRow,kind:Kind):Summary{
 const m=c.metrics as Record<string,unknown>;
 const t=(m.temporal_split??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;
 const h=m.hit_rate as {rate?:unknown;low?:unknown;high?:unknown}|null|undefined;
 const s:Summary={n_independent:c.n_independent,n_total:numOr(m.n_total)??c.n_settled,threshold_n:c.threshold_n,brier:numOr(m.brier),brier_skill:numOr(m.brier_skill),
  ece_raw_holdout:numOr(t.ece_raw_holdout),valid_until:c.valid_until,
  hit_rate:h&&numOr(h.rate)!==null?{rate:numOr(h.rate)!,low:numOr(h.low),high:numOr(h.high)}:null,
  href:`/intel/methods/${c.methodology_id}/${c.methodology_version}#calibration`};
 if(kind==='categorical')s.accuracy=numOr(m.accuracy);
 if(kind==='interval')s.coverage=numOr(m.coverage);
 if(kind==='score')s.spearman=numOr(m.spearman);
 return s;
}
function tagOf(state:CalibrationState,s:Summary|null):Bilingual{
 switch(state){
  case 'calibrated':return both('','');
  case 'failed':return s&&s.ece_raw_holdout!==null?both(`（校准未通过：ECE ${fmt(s.ece_raw_holdout,3)}）`,` (calibration failed: ECE ${fmt(s.ece_raw_holdout,3)})`):both('（校准未通过）',' (calibration failed)');
  case 'self_assessed':return both('（自评，不可审计）',' (self-assessed, not auditable)');
  case 'evaluated':return both('','');
  default:return s?both(`（未校准：有效样本 ${s.n_independent}/${s.threshold_n}）`,` (uncalibrated: ${s.n_independent}/${s.threshold_n} independent samples)`):both('（未校准）',' (uncalibrated)');
 }
}

type Display=JudgmentCard['display'];
function displayOf(e:Envelope,state:CalibrationState,s:Summary|null):Display{
 const j=e.judgment;
 if(j.abstained||!j.claim)return {headline:both(`未判断：${j.abstain_reason??'—'}`,`No judgment: ${j.abstain_reason??'—'}`),percent:null,value:null};
 const tag=tagOf(state,s);
 switch(j.kind){
  case 'probability':{
   const c=j.claim as ProbabilityClaim;
   if(state==='calibrated'){const p=Math.round(c.p*100);return {headline:both(`${c.event.zh}：${p}%`,`${c.event.en}: ${p}%`),percent:p,value:null};}
   const band=bandOf(c.p);
   return {headline:join(both(`${c.event.zh}：信心${BAND[band].zh}`,`${c.event.en}: ${BAND[band].en} confidence`),tag),percent:null,value:null,band};
  }
  case 'categorical':{
   const c=j.claim as CategoricalClaim;const l=classLabel(c.selected);
   const acc=state==='calibrated'&&s?.accuracy!=null?both(` · 历史准确率 ${pct(s.accuracy)}%（n=${s.n_independent}）`,` · historical accuracy ${pct(s.accuracy)}% (n=${s.n_independent})`):tag;
   return {headline:join(both(`判定：${l.zh}`,`Call: ${l.en}`),acc),percent:null,value:c.selected};
  }
  case 'score':{
   const c=j.claim as ScoreClaim;
   const ev=state==='evaluated'&&s?.spearman!=null?both(` · Spearman ${fmt(s.spearman)}（n=${s.n_independent}）`,` · Spearman ${fmt(s.spearman)} (n=${s.n_independent})`):both(' · 样本不足',' · insufficient samples');
   return {headline:join(both(`分值 ${fmt(c.value)}（${c.scale.min}–${c.scale.max}）`,`Score ${fmt(c.value)} (${c.scale.min}–${c.scale.max})`),ev),percent:null,value:c.value,scale:c.scale,
    dims:c.dims.map(d=>({id:d.id,label:both(d.id,d.id),value:d.value,coverage:d.coverage}))};
  }
  case 'interval':{
   const c=j.claim as IntervalClaim;
   const cov=state==='calibrated'&&s?.coverage!=null?both(` · 历史覆盖 ${pct(s.coverage)}%（名义 ${pct(c.nominal_coverage)}%）`,` · historical coverage ${pct(s.coverage)}% (nominal ${pct(c.nominal_coverage)}%)`):tag;
   return {headline:join(both(`${c.metric}：${fmt(c.low)} 至 ${fmt(c.high)} ${c.unit}（名义覆盖 ${pct(c.nominal_coverage)}%）`,`${c.metric}: ${fmt(c.low)} to ${fmt(c.high)} ${c.unit} (nominal coverage ${pct(c.nominal_coverage)}%)`),cov),percent:null,value:[c.low,c.high],nominal_coverage:c.nominal_coverage};
  }
 }
}
function overlay(e:Envelope,lifecycle:Lifecycle):Bilingual{
 const s=e.settlement;
 if(lifecycle==='settled'&&s){
  if(e.judgment.kind==='categorical'&&s.realized){const r=classLabel(String(s.realized.label??s.realized.value));return both(` · 实现：${r.zh}（${s.outcome==='hit'?'命中':'未命中'}）`,` · realized: ${r.en} (${s.outcome})`);}
  return both(` · 结果：${s.outcome==='hit'?'命中':'未命中'}`,` · result: ${s.outcome}`);
 }
 if(lifecycle==='void'&&s)return both(` · 作废：${s.reason??'—'}`,` · void: ${s.reason??'—'}`);
 if(lifecycle==='withdrawn'&&s)return both(` · 已撤回：${s.reason??'—'}`,` · withdrawn: ${s.reason??'—'}`);
 return both('','');
}
const inputHref=(i:Input):string|null=>i.kind==='judgment'?`/api/judgments/${i.ref.judgment_id}`:null;

export interface ToCardOptions{title:Bilingual;now?:string;merged_from?:string}
/** Envelope → JudgmentCard (spec §9.2, §9.3). Pure; `now` only tightens expiry (the SQL already applied it). */
export function toCard(e:Envelope,opts:ToCardOptions):JudgmentCard{
 const j=e.judgment;const lifecycle=lifecycleOf(e);
 const calibration=calibrationStateOf(e,j.kind,opts.now);
 const vc=validCalibration(e,j.kind,opts.now);
 const summary=vc?summaryOf(vc,j.kind):null;
 const display=displayOf(e,calibration,summary);
 display.headline=join(display.headline,overlay(e,lifecycle));
 const s=e.settlement;
 const card:JudgmentCard={
  judgment_id:j.judgment_id,subject:{type:j.subject_type,key:j.subject_key},judgment_type:j.judgment_type,kind:j.kind,
  lifecycle,outcome:lifecycle==='settled'&&s?s.outcome:null,calibration,retrospective:j.retrospective,as_of:j.as_of,registered_at:j.registered_at,
  methodology:{id:j.methodology_id,version:j.methodology_version,title:opts.title,href:`/intel/methods/${j.methodology_id}/${j.methodology_version}`},
  display,
  condition:j.abstained||!j.condition||!j.horizon||!j.target||!j.label_policy||!j.settle_after||!j.settle_by?null:{text:j.condition.text,horizon:j.horizon,target:j.target,label_policy:j.label_policy,settle_after:j.settle_after,settle_by:j.settle_by},
  settlement:s?{kind:s.kind,outcome:s.outcome,realized:s.realized,settled_at:s.settled_at,evidence_summary:both(`${s.resolver}@${s.resolver_version}${s.reason?` · 原因：${s.reason}`:''}`,`${s.resolver}@${s.resolver_version}${s.reason?` · reason: ${s.reason}`:''}`)}:null,
  calibration_summary:summary,
  inputs:j.inputs.map(i=>({kind:i.kind,ref:i.ref,available_at:i.available_at,origin:i.origin,href:inputHref(i)})),
 };
 if(j.abstained){card.abstain_reason=j.abstain_reason??undefined;}
 if(opts.merged_from!==undefined)card.merged_from=opts.merged_from;
 return card;
}

export interface CardsOptions{now?:string;includeAbstained:boolean;requestedKey?:string}
/**
 * Envelopes → cards with the publication gate applied a second time (defence in depth over RLS,
 * spec §4.1): a method missing from `methods` or with publishable=false yields no card. Abstained
 * cards only when asked. A card whose subject_key differs from the requested issuer came through
 * the merged-issuer lookup (spec §12.4) and is marked merged_from.
 */
export function cardsOf(envelopes:Envelope[],methods:ReadonlyMap<string,MethodologyRow>,o:CardsOptions):JudgmentCard[]{
 const out:JudgmentCard[]=[];
 for(const e of envelopes){
  const m=methods.get(`${e.judgment.methodology_id}@${e.judgment.methodology_version}`);
  if(!m||!m.publishable)continue;
  if(e.judgment.abstained&&!o.includeAbstained)continue;
  const merged=o.requestedKey!==undefined&&e.judgment.subject_type==='issuer'&&e.judgment.subject_key!==o.requestedKey?e.judgment.subject_key:undefined;
  out.push(toCard(e,{title:{zh:m.title_zh,en:m.title_en},now:o.now,merged_from:merged}));
 }
 return out;
}
export const methodKey=(m:Pick<MethodologyRow,'methodology_id'|'version'>)=>`${m.methodology_id}@${m.version}`;

export type DerivedOdds={status:'not_computed';reasons:string[]}|{status:'computed';b:number;f:number};
const P_TOLERANCE=0.01,EPS=1e-9;
/**
 * spec §9.4: odds b = value_up / |value_down| and fractional Kelly f = k·(p·b − (1 − p)) / b, only when
 * both judgments are open and calibrated, the scenarios are the conditional distribution of the SAME
 * condition (scenario_event_hash = digest(winRate.condition)), Σp = 1, value_up > 0 > value_down, same
 * as_of / subject / target / horizon unit, |p_up − p| ≤ 0.01, and 0 < k ≤ 1. Otherwise every failed
 * precondition is listed and nothing is computed.
 */
export function derivedOdds(winRate:Envelope,returnRange:Envelope,opts:{k:number;now?:string}):DerivedOdds{
 const reasons:string[]=[];
 const w=winRate.judgment,r=returnRange.judgment;
 if(w.judgment_type!=='thesis_win_rate'||w.kind!=='probability'||r.judgment_type!=='return_range'||r.kind!=='interval')reasons.push('wrong_type');
 if(lifecycleOf(winRate)!=='open'||lifecycleOf(returnRange)!=='open')reasons.push('not_open');
 if(calibrationStateOf(winRate,w.kind,opts.now)!=='calibrated'||calibrationStateOf(returnRange,r.kind,opts.now)!=='calibrated')reasons.push('not_calibrated');
 if(!(Number.isFinite(opts.k)&&opts.k>0&&opts.k<=1))reasons.push('invalid_k');
 const claim=r.claim as IntervalClaim|null;const p=(w.claim as ProbabilityClaim|null)?.p;
 const sc=claim?.scenarios;
 const up=sc?.find(s=>s.label==='up'),down=sc?.find(s=>s.label==='down');
 if(!sc||sc.length!==2||!up||!down)reasons.push('scenarios_missing');
 else{
  if(!sc.every(s=>Number.isFinite(s.p)&&s.p>=0&&s.p<=1&&Number.isFinite(s.value)))reasons.push('scenario_values_invalid');
  else{
   if(Math.abs(up.p+down.p-1)>EPS)reasons.push('scenarios_not_normalized');
   if(!(up.value>0&&down.value<0))reasons.push('scenario_values_invalid');
   if(typeof p!=='number'||Math.abs(up.p-p)>P_TOLERANCE+EPS)reasons.push('inputs_inconsistent');
  }
 }
 if(!w.condition||!claim||claim.scenario_event_hash!==digest(w.condition))reasons.push('event_mismatch');
 if(w.as_of!==r.as_of)reasons.push('as_of_mismatch');
 if(w.subject_type!==r.subject_type||w.subject_key!==r.subject_key)reasons.push('subject_mismatch');
 if(!w.target||!r.target||canonicalize(w.target)!==canonicalize(r.target))reasons.push('target_mismatch');
 if(!w.horizon||!r.horizon||w.horizon.unit!==r.horizon.unit)reasons.push('unit_mismatch');
 if(reasons.length>0||!up||!down||typeof p!=='number')return {status:'not_computed',reasons:[...new Set(reasons)]};
 const b=up.value/Math.abs(down.value);
 return {status:'computed',b,f:opts.k*(p*b-(1-p))/b};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 写文案测试 `src/lib/judgments/messages.test.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/messages.test.ts
// messages/{zh,en}/judgments.json: key parity, placeholder parity, and a label for every enum value
// the display layer emits (src/i18n/messages-parity.test.ts only covers its own fixed domain list).
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {CALIBRATION_STATES_BY_KIND,KINDS,PRIVATE_LIFECYCLES,PUBLIC_LIFECYCLES} from './display';
import {PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS} from './types';

const load=(l:'zh'|'en')=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'messages',l,'judgments.json'),'utf8')) as Record<string,unknown>;
const leaves=(v:unknown,prefix=''):[string,string][]=>typeof v==='string'?[[prefix,v]]:Object.entries(v as Record<string,unknown>).flatMap(([k,c])=>leaves(c,prefix?`${prefix}.${k}`:k));
const placeholders=(s:string)=>[...s.matchAll(/\{([^}]+)\}/g)].map(m=>m[1]).sort();

describe('judgments messages',()=>{
 const zh=new Map(leaves(load('zh'))),en=new Map(leaves(load('en')));
 it('zh and en have the same keys, all non-empty strings',()=>{
  expect([...zh.keys()].sort()).toEqual([...en.keys()].sort());
  for(const [k,v] of [...zh,...en])expect(v.trim().length,k).toBeGreaterThan(0);
 });
 it('zh and en use the same placeholders per key',()=>{
  for(const [k,v] of zh)expect(placeholders(v),k).toEqual(placeholders(en.get(k)!));
 });
 it('every lifecycle, calibration state, kind, input kind and derived-odds reason has a label',()=>{
  const need=[
   ...[...new Set([...PUBLIC_LIFECYCLES,...PRIVATE_LIFECYCLES])].map(l=>`lifecycle.${l}`),
   ...[...new Set([...Object.values(CALIBRATION_STATES_BY_KIND).flat(),'self_assessed'])].map(c=>`calibration.${c}`),
   ...KINDS.map(k=>`kind.${k}`),
   ...[...PUBLIC_INPUT_KINDS,'legacy_fill','document_span'].map(k=>`inputs.kind.${k}`),
   ...['wrong_type','not_open','not_calibrated','invalid_k','scenarios_missing','scenarios_not_normalized','scenario_values_invalid','inputs_inconsistent','event_mismatch','as_of_mismatch','subject_mismatch','target_mismatch','unit_mismatch'].map(r=>`derived.reasons.${r}`),
  ];
  for(const k of need)expect(zh.has(k),k).toBe(true);
 });
});
```

**路由一览（§10）**：

| 路径 | 参数 | 成功体（都含顶层 `codeVersion`） | 错误 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/judgments` | `subject_type`、`subject_key`（必填）、`types`、`asOf`、`view`、`include_abstained=1` | `{subject, asOf, view, cards}` | 400 `invalid_parameter:<name>` |
| `GET /api/judgments/[id]` | `view`、`asOf` | `{view, asOf, card, judgment, settlements, calibration:{row, valid}\|null}` | 400、404 `unknown_judgment` |
| `GET /api/judgments/[id]/history` | `limit`（1..500，默认 50）、`before`（uuid） | `{judgment_id, cards, next_before}` | 400、404 |
| `GET /api/methodologies` | `status` | `{status, methodologies:[{methodology, calibration:{state, valid, n_independent, threshold_n, computed_at, valid_until, metrics}\|null}]}` | 400 |
| `GET /api/methodologies/[id]/[version]` | — | `{row, doc_markdown, doc_sha256_matches, calibrations, recent_settlements}` | 400、404 `unknown_methodology` |
| `GET /api/methodologies/[id]/[version]/calibration` | `scope_type`、`scope_key`、`sample=1` | `{scope, calibration, valid, state, reliability, temporal_split, sample, sample_status}` | 400、404 |
| `POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/withdraw` / `reopen` | body `{reason, request_id}` | `{id, outcome, seq}` | 401、403、415、400、404、409 `settlement_sequence` / `request_key_conflict`、503 `code_version_unavailable` |
| `POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/settle` | body `{reason?, request_id}` | `{id, outcome, seq}` | 同上 |
| `GET /api/admin/judgments/queue` | `filter`（due\|backoff\|leased\|all）、`limit`（1..500，默认 100）、`after` | `{filter, rows:(QueueRow & {judgment:{subject_type,subject_key,methodology_id,methodology_version,target}\|null; latest_settlement:{kind,outcome,settled_at}\|null})[], next_after, counts:{due,backoff,leased}, now}` | 401、403、400 |

缓存：公共读成功 `public, max-age=300, s-maxage=600`；空结果（无卡片 / 无方法 / 无校准）与一切错误 `no-store`；admin 一律 `no-store`。`view`：缺省 `latest`；`asOf` 单独出现即 `as_known`；`view=as_known` 无 `asOf`、`view=latest` 带 `asOf`、`asOf` 晚于今天（UTC）都是 400 `invalid_parameter:asOf`；`cutoff = asOf + 'T23:59:59.999Z'`。

**规格偏差（记入实施记录）：**
1. `GET /api/judgments/[id]` 的信封取自 `JudgmentsDb.envelopeById`（RPC `judgment_envelope_by_id`，anon / invoker，计划审计 P2-01），与 `judgment_history` 同一 `latest / as_known` 语义，使截止规则（判断 `registered_at`、结算 `settled_at`、校准 `computed_at` 与当前 revision、方法事件史）全部由 SQL 施加，且不再翻历史页找 id（深历史或服务端行数上限不会让已发布判断 404）；结算全表走 anon 直接查表（RLS 门控），按 `seq` keyset 分页**直到空页**（不把短页当耗尽），因为契约的 `getJudgment / settlementsOf` 是 service-role 方法、会绕过发布门控。`judgmentLocator` 仍供 history 路由使用。
2. `recent_settlements` 用 PostgREST 内连接嵌入 `judgments!inner(...)`（anon，RLS 门控），不是契约方法。
3. admin `settle` 调 Task 12 的 `settleNow`（集成者补充的导出：不领租约，只有追加类决定写库；`deferred` / `quarantine_pending` / `closed` 返回 200 且不写，`leased` / `conflict` 返回 409）与 Task 14 的 `productionJudgmentDeps`。
4. `next.config.mjs` 不在骨架的共享文件清单里，本任务按同一围栏规则改动。
5. `GET /api/methodologies` 列出 `publishable=false` 方法的元数据（§5.6：方法元数据 `using (true)`），其校准摘要因 RLS 为 `null`。
6. admin withdraw / reopen 的操作载荷只由请求与不可变判断行构造（`evidence={admin_action}`、`resolver = condition.resolver`、`resolver_version='admin'`），所以同一 `request_id` 的重试字节一致 → `already_applied`。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/route-utils.ts
// Conventions of the judgment read and admin routes (spec §10): strict parameters (a repeated
// parameter → 400 invalid_parameter:<name>; unknown parameters are ignored), success
// `public, max-age=300, s-maxage=600`, errors and empty results `no-store`, a top-level codeVersion
// on every body, error bodies {error:{code,message}} that never carry internal messages, the two
// read views (latest | as_known with cutoff = asOf end of UTC day), and the admin preamble
// (requireAdminUser, JSON content type, same-origin check as /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]).
import type {User} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated,requireAdminUser} from '../admin/auth';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from './deps';
import {PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES} from './types';
import type {CardView,JudgmentType,PublicSubjectType,Subject} from './types';

export const UUID_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
export const METHOD_ID_RE=/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$/,VERSION_RE=/^v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$/;
export const SUCCESS_CACHE='public, max-age=300, s-maxage=600';
export const JUDGMENT_TYPES:readonly JudgmentType[]=['macro_regime','macro_regime_asset_pair','recommendation_call','industry_lifecycle_stage','industry_prosperity','valuation_verdict','thesis_win_rate','return_range','sellside_rating','sellside_target_price','synthetic_fact_metric'];

export class ParamError extends Error{constructor(readonly param:string){super(`invalid_parameter:${param}`);this.name='ParamError';}}
/** The allowed parameters, each at most once. */
export function readParams(url:URL,allowed:readonly string[]):Map<string,string>{
 const out=new Map<string,string>();
 for(const k of allowed){const all=url.searchParams.getAll(k);if(all.length>1)throw new ParamError(k);if(all.length===1)out.set(k,all[0]);}
 return out;
}
export function enumParam<T extends string>(p:Map<string,string>,name:string,allowed:readonly T[]):T|undefined{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return undefined;
 if(!(allowed as readonly string[]).includes(v))throw new ParamError(name);return v as T;
}
const isCalendarDate=(s:string)=>/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)&&new Date(`${s}T00:00:00.000Z`).toISOString().slice(0,10)===s;
export function dateParam(p:Map<string,string>,name:string):string|undefined{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return undefined;
 let ok=false;try{ok=isCalendarDate(v);}catch{ok=false;}
 if(!ok)throw new ParamError(name);return v;
}
export function intParam(p:Map<string,string>,name:string,def:number,max:number):number{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return def;
 if(!/^\d{1,5}$/.test(v)||Number(v)<1||Number(v)>max)throw new ParamError(name);return Number(v);
}
export function uuidParam(p:Map<string,string>,name:string):string|undefined{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return undefined;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(v))throw new ParamError(name);return v;
}
export function flagParam(p:Map<string,string>,name:string):boolean{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return false;
 if(v!=='1')throw new ParamError(name);return true;
}
/** Comma list: trimmed, non-empty, unique, each allowed, at most max. */
export function listParam<T extends string>(p:Map<string,string>,name:string,allowed:readonly T[],max:number):T[]|undefined{
 const v=p.get(name);if(v===undefined)return undefined;
 const items=v.split(',').map(s=>s.trim());
 if(items.length===0||items.length>max||new Set(items).size!==items.length||items.some(s=>!(allowed as readonly string[]).includes(s)))throw new ParamError(name);
 return items as T[];
}
export const endOfUtcDay=(d:string)=>`${d}T23:59:59.999Z`;
export interface ViewParams{view:CardView;asOf:string|null;cutoff:string|undefined}
/**
 * view=latest (default) | view=as_known&asOf=YYYY-MM-DD (cutoff = asOf 23:59:59.999Z, asOf ≤ today).
 * asOf alone implies as_known; view=as_known without asOf, or view=latest with asOf, is invalid.
 */
export function viewParams(p:Map<string,string>,today:string):ViewParams{
 const view=enumParam(p,'view',['latest','as_known'] as const);
 const asOf=dateParam(p,'asOf');
 if(asOf!==undefined&&asOf>today)throw new ParamError('asOf');
 if(view==='as_known'&&asOf===undefined)throw new ParamError('asOf');
 if(view==='latest'&&asOf!==undefined)throw new ParamError('asOf');
 return asOf===undefined?{view:'latest',asOf:null,cutoff:undefined}:{view:'as_known',asOf,cutoff:endOfUtcDay(asOf)};
}
const SUBJECT_KEY:Record<PublicSubjectType,RegExp>={
 issuer:UUID_RE,macro_region:/^(US|CN)$/,industry:/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}$/,macro_series:/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$/,
};
/** subject_type (public types only) + subject_key (format per type, ≤ 128 chars); both required. */
export function subjectParams(p:Map<string,string>):Subject&{type:PublicSubjectType}{
 const type=enumParam(p,'subject_type',PUBLIC_SUBJECT_TYPES);
 if(type===undefined)throw new ParamError('subject_type');
 const key=p.get('subject_key');
 if(key===undefined||key.length>128||!SUBJECT_KEY[type].test(key))throw new ParamError('subject_key');
 return {type,key};
}

export const codeVersionOf=()=>resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
/** 200 with codeVersion; shared cache unless empty. */
/** Commander decision D2 (spec §1.1 success criterion "响应里没有 percent 字段"): the one serializer of every judgments
 *  route. Any object member `display` whose `percent` is null is emitted WITHOUT the `percent` key (JudgmentCard keeps
 *  `percent:number|null` internally; clients treat it as optional). Everything else is copied as is. */
export function serializeBody<T>(body:T):T{
 if(Array.isArray(body))return body.map(x=>serializeBody(x)) as T;
 if(body===null||typeof body!=='object')return body;
 const out:Record<string,unknown>={};
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(body as Record<string,unknown>)){
  if(k==='display'&&v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)&&(v as {percent?:unknown}).percent===null){
   const {percent:_omit,...rest}=v as Record<string,unknown>;out[k]=serializeBody(rest);
  }else out[k]=serializeBody(v);
 }
 return out as T;
}
export function okResponse(body:Record<string,unknown>,opts:{empty:boolean}):NextResponse{
 return NextResponse.json(serializeBody({codeVersion:codeVersionOf(),...body}),{status:200,headers:{'Cache-Control':opts.empty?'no-store':SUCCESS_CACHE}});
}
/** Admin and other non-cacheable successes. */
export function privateResponse(body:Record<string,unknown>,status=200):NextResponse{
 return NextResponse.json(serializeBody({codeVersion:codeVersionOf(),...body}),{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
}
export function errorResponse(code:string,message:string,status:number):NextResponse{
 return NextResponse.json({codeVersion:codeVersionOf(),error:{code,message}},{status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
}
export const paramErrorResponse=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof ParamError?errorResponse(e.message,`invalid ${e.param}`,400):null;
/** Logged, code-only 500: no internal message leaves the server. */
export function internalErrorResponse(e:unknown,tag:string):NextResponse{
 console.error(`[${tag}]`,e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
 return errorResponse('internal','judgments read failed',500);
}
/** SQLSTATE-free error code of a db failure: `.code` when a string, else the first known code in the message. */
export function errorCodeOf(e:unknown):string{
 const c=(e as {code?:unknown})?.code;
 if(typeof c==='string'&&/^[a-z_:]+$/.test(c))return c;
 const m=e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e);
 for(const k of ['settlement_sequence','lease_lost','request_key_conflict','unknown_judgment'])if(m.includes(k))return k;
 return 'internal';
}

export type AdminGate={user:User}|{response:NextResponse};
/** requireAdminUser + (for POST) JSON content type and same-origin; 401 / 403 / 415 otherwise. */
export async function adminGate(request:Request,opts:{write:boolean}):Promise<AdminGate>{
 try{
  const user=await requireAdminUser();
  if(opts.write){
   if(!(request.headers.get('content-type')??'').toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json'))return {response:errorResponse('unsupported_media_type','JSON body required',415)};
   const origin=request.headers.get('origin');
   if(origin!==null&&origin!==new URL(request.url).origin)return {response:errorResponse('forbidden_origin','cross-origin request',403)};
  }
  return {user};
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return {response:errorResponse('unauthenticated','authentication required',401)};
  if(e instanceof AdminForbidden)return {response:errorResponse('forbidden','admin role required',403)};
  return {response:internalErrorResponse(e,'admin/judgments')};
 }
}
export interface AdminBody{reason:string|null;request_id:string}
/** {reason (1..500 chars; required unless optional), request_id (uuid, the idempotency key)}. */
export async function adminBody(request:Request,opts:{reasonRequired:boolean}):Promise<AdminBody|NextResponse>{
 const body=(await request.json().catch(()=>null)) as {reason?:unknown;request_id?:unknown}|null;
 if(!body||typeof body!=='object')return errorResponse('invalid_body','JSON object required',400);
 const reason=body.reason===undefined||body.reason===null?null:typeof body.reason==='string'?body.reason.trim():undefined;
 if(reason===undefined||(reason!==null&&(reason.length<1||reason.length>500))||(opts.reasonRequired&&reason===null))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:reason','reason required (1..500 chars)',400);
 if(typeof body.request_id!=='string'||!UUID_RE.test(body.request_id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:request_id','request_id must be a uuid',400);
 return {reason,request_id:body.request_id};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `src/lib/judgments/public-reads.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/public-reads.ts
// Read paths of the public judgment routes (spec §10). Everything goes through the anon client, so
// RLS applies the publication gate (spec §5.6, N1): JudgmentsDb public-read methods plus three direct
// table reads the contract does not cover (a judgment's locator, its settlement list, a method's
// recent settlements). Two reads are not database reads: the methodology document from disk
// (docs/methodologies/** is bundled via next.config outputFileTracingIncludes) and the calibration
// sample, read from the private bucket with the service role ONLY after the anon read of the
// calibration row proved the method publishable.
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '../supabase/anon';
import {sha256} from './canonical';
import {supabaseCohortStore} from './cohort-store';
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from './db';
import type {JudgmentType,JudgmentsDb,PublicSubjectType,SettlementRow} from './types';

type Result={data:unknown;error:{message:string}|null};
interface Query extends PromiseLike<Result>{select(columns:string):Query;eq(column:string,value:unknown):Query;gt(column:string,value:unknown):Query;order(column:string,o:{ascending:boolean}):Query;limit(n:number):Query;maybeSingle():PromiseLike<Result>}
/** Settlement history page size; the loop runs until an EMPTY page, so a server row cap below it is harmless (P2-01). */
export const SETTLEMENT_PAGE=500;
interface LooseClient{from(table:string):Query}

export interface JudgmentLocator{subject_type:PublicSubjectType;subject_key:string;judgment_type:JudgmentType;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string}
export type RecentSettlement=SettlementRow&{subject_type:string;subject_key:string;judgment_type:string};
export interface PublicReads{
 /** Public-read methods only (latestCards, historyOf, envelopeById, listMethodologies, latestCalibration, methodologyStateAt, calibrationCohort, serverTime). */
 db:JudgmentsDb;
 judgmentLocator(id:string):Promise<JudgmentLocator|null>;
 settlements(id:string):Promise<SettlementRow[]>;
 recentSettlements(methodology:string,version:string,limit:number):Promise<RecentSettlement[]>;
}

const iso=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'?new Date(v).toISOString():v;
/** PostgREST timestamptz text → toISOString() shape (contract: ms-precision UTC). */
export function settlementFromRow(r:Record<string,unknown>):SettlementRow{
 return {...(r as unknown as SettlementRow),seq:Number(r.seq),settled_at:iso(r.settled_at) as string};
}
const check=(r:Result,what:string)=>{if(r.error)throw new Error(`${what}_failed: ${r.error.message}`);return r.data;};

export function publicReads():PublicReads{
 const anon=getAnonSupabase();
 const sb=anon as unknown as LooseClient;
 // Public routes call only anon-routed JudgmentsDb methods; the admin slot also gets the anon client so
 // a mistaken admin-routed call is still RLS-bound instead of silently using the service role.
 const db=supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon,admin:anon});
 return {
  db,
  async judgmentLocator(id){
   const data=check(await sb.from('judgments').select('subject_type,subject_key,judgment_type,methodology_id,methodology_version').eq('judgment_id',id).maybeSingle(),'judgment_locator');
   return (data as JudgmentLocator|null)??null;
  },
  async settlements(id){
   // keyset on seq until an empty page (a short page is not exhaustion: PostgREST max-rows may be below the limit)
   const out:SettlementRow[]=[];
   for(let after=0;;){
    const data=check(await sb.from('judgment_settlements').select('*').eq('judgment_id',id).gt('seq',after).order('seq',{ascending:true}).limit(SETTLEMENT_PAGE),'settlements');
    const page=((data as Record<string,unknown>[]|null)??[]).map(settlementFromRow);
    if(page.length===0)return out;
    out.push(...page);after=page[page.length-1].seq;
   }
  },
  async recentSettlements(methodology,version,limit){
   const data=check(await sb.from('judgment_settlements').select('*,judgments!inner(subject_type,subject_key,judgment_type,methodology_id,methodology_version)')
    .eq('judgments.methodology_id',methodology).eq('judgments.methodology_version',version).order('settled_at',{ascending:false}).limit(limit),'recent_settlements');
   return ((data as (Record<string,unknown>&{judgments:Record<string,string>})[]|null)??[]).map(({judgments,...r})=>({...settlementFromRow(r),subject_type:judgments.subject_type,subject_key:judgments.subject_key,judgment_type:judgments.judgment_type}));
  },
 };
}

const DOC_PATH=/^docs\/methodologies\/[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}\/v[1-9][0-9]{0,3}\.md$/;
/** The registry's doc_path, read from the deployment bundle; never a path outside docs/methodologies. */
export async function readMethodologyDoc(docPath:string,expectedSha256:string):Promise<{markdown:string|null;sha256_matches:boolean}>{
 if(!DOC_PATH.test(docPath))return {markdown:null,sha256_matches:false};
 try{
  const bytes=await readFile(join(process.cwd(),docPath));
  return {markdown:bytes.toString('utf8'),sha256_matches:sha256(bytes)===expectedSha256};
 }catch{return {markdown:null,sha256_matches:false};}
}
export type CohortSample={status:'ok';entries:unknown[]}|{status:'missing'|'integrity_failed';entries:null};
/** Cohort file of a calibration row the caller already read through anon (so the method is publishable). */
export async function readCohortSample(cohortPath:string,cohortSha256:string):Promise<CohortSample>{
 const bytes=await supabaseCohortStore(getAdminSupabase()).get(cohortPath);
 if(!bytes)return {status:'missing',entries:null};
 if(sha256(bytes)!==cohortSha256)return {status:'integrity_failed',entries:null};
 const body=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes)) as {entries?:unknown};
 return Array.isArray(body.entries)?{status:'ok',entries:body.entries}:{status:'integrity_failed',entries:null};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/admin-actions.ts
// Admin settlement corrections (spec §5.3, §9.5, §10): withdrawn (settled → withdrawn) and reopened
// (void | withdrawn → reopened) through append_settlement with lease token null and actor
// admin:<uuid>. The request key is admin:<request_id> and the payload is built only from the request
// and the immutable judgment row, so a retried request is byte-identical and answers already_applied
// (R06) instead of request_key_conflict. Each call records an ingest_batches receipt (dataset
// judgments.settle, triggered_by manual); invalid transitions surface as settlement_sequence (409).
import type {TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '../dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts} from '../dq/batches';
import {errorCodeOf} from './route-utils';
import type {AppendStatus,JudgmentsDb,SettlementInsert} from './types';

export type AdminAction='withdrawn'|'reopened';
export interface AdminActionInput{db:JudgmentsDb;tables:TableClient;judgmentId:string;kind:AdminAction;reason:string;requestId:string;adminId:string;codeVersion:string}
export type AdminActionResult=
 |{outcome:'unknown_judgment'}
 |{outcome:AppendStatus;seq:number;batchId:string}
 |{outcome:'settlement_sequence';batchId:string};
export const HTTP_OF:Record<AdminActionResult['outcome'],number>={applied:200,already_applied:200,already_final:409,request_key_conflict:409,settlement_sequence:409,unknown_judgment:404};

export async function appendAdminSettlement(x:AdminActionInput):Promise<AdminActionResult>{
 const j=await x.db.getJudgment(x.judgmentId);
 if(!j)return {outcome:'unknown_judgment'};
 const {batchId}=await startBatch(x.tables,{producer:'ts-judgments',dataset:'judgments.settle',codeVersion:x.codeVersion,triggeredBy:'manual'});
 const row:SettlementInsert={kind:x.kind,outcome:null,realized:null,evidence:{admin_action:x.kind},resolver:j.condition?.resolver??'none',resolver_version:'admin',
  reason:x.reason,actor:`admin:${x.adminId}`,code_version:x.codeVersion,batch_id:batchId};
 const counts:BatchCounts={...emptyCounts(),fetched:1};
 try{
  const r=await x.db.appendSettlement(x.judgmentId,null,`admin:${x.requestId}`,row);
  if(r.status==='applied')counts.versioned=1;else if(r.status==='request_key_conflict')counts.failed=1;else counts.duplicates=1;
  await finishBatch(x.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:r.status==='request_key_conflict'?[{code:'request_key_conflict',key:x.judgmentId}]:[]});
  return {outcome:r.status,seq:r.seq,batchId};
 }catch(e){
  const code=errorCodeOf(e);
  counts.failed=1;
  await finishBatch(x.tables,batchId,{counts,errors:[{code,key:x.judgmentId}]});
  if(code==='settlement_sequence')return {outcome:'settlement_sequence',batchId};
  throw e;
 }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: 实现 `src/app/api/judgments/route.ts`**

```ts
// src/app/api/judgments/route.ts
// GET /api/judgments (spec §10): one card per (judgment_type, methodology) for a public subject.
// latest_judgment_cards through anon (RLS = publication gate), view=latest | as_known&asOf=,
// abstained cards only with include_abstained=1, issuer subjects include judgments registered on
// issuers merged into it (spec §12.4; marked merged_from), methods with publishable=false never yield a card.
import {cardsOf,methodKey} from '@/lib/judgments/display';
import {publicReads} from '@/lib/judgments/public-reads';
import {JUDGMENT_TYPES,flagParam,internalErrorResponse,listParam,okResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams,subjectParams,viewParams} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['subject_type','subject_key','types','asOf','view','include_abstained'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request){
 const now=new Date();const today=now.toISOString().slice(0,10);
 let q;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  q={subject:subjectParams(p),types:listParam(p,'types',JUDGMENT_TYPES,JUDGMENT_TYPES.length),view:viewParams(p,today),includeAbstained:flagParam(p,'include_abstained')};
 }catch(e){return paramErrorResponse(e)??internalErrorResponse(e,'judgments');}
 try{
  const r=publicReads();
  const [envelopes,methods]=await Promise.all([r.db.latestCards(q.subject,{types:q.types,view:q.view.view,cutoff:q.view.cutoff}),r.db.listMethodologies()]);
  const cards=cardsOf(envelopes,new Map(methods.map(m=>[methodKey(m),m])),{includeAbstained:q.includeAbstained,requestedKey:q.subject.type==='issuer'?q.subject.key:undefined,now:q.view.cutoff===undefined?now.toISOString():undefined});
  return okResponse({subject:q.subject,asOf:q.view.asOf,view:q.view.view,cards},{empty:cards.length===0});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'judgments');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/judgments/[id]/route.ts
// GET /api/judgments/[id] (spec §10): {card, judgment, settlements, calibration}. The envelope comes from
// envelopeById (RPC judgment_envelope_by_id through anon: RLS publishes published methods only; the
// judgment_history view semantics, so as_known applies the SQL cutoff rules to the judgment, settlement,
// calibration and method state alike) — no history scan, so a deep history or a small server cap can never
// 404 a published judgment (plan audit P2-01); settlements are the full public list (paged until empty), cut
// at the same cutoff.
import {cardsOf,methodKey} from '@/lib/judgments/display';
import {publicReads} from '@/lib/judgments/public-reads';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,internalErrorResponse,okResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams,viewParams} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['view','asOf'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();const today=now.toISOString().slice(0,10);
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 let v;
 try{v=viewParams(readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS),today);}catch(e){return paramErrorResponse(e)??internalErrorResponse(e,'judgments/id');}
 try{
  const r=publicReads();
  const found=await r.db.envelopeById(id,{view:v.view,cutoff:v.cutoff});
  if(!found)return errorResponse('unknown_judgment','no such judgment at this view',404);
  const methods=await r.db.listMethodologies();
  const [card]=cardsOf([found],new Map(methods.map(m=>[methodKey(m),m])),{includeAbstained:true,now:v.cutoff===undefined?now.toISOString():undefined});
  if(!card)return errorResponse('unknown_judgment','no such judgment',404);
  const settlements=(await r.settlements(id)).filter(s=>v.cutoff===undefined||s.settled_at<=v.cutoff);
  return okResponse({view:v.view,asOf:v.asOf,card,judgment:found.judgment,settlements,calibration:found.calibration?{row:found.calibration,valid:found.calibration_valid}:null},{empty:false});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'judgments/id');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/judgments/[id]/history/route.ts
// GET /api/judgments/[id]/history (spec §10): the same subject × type × method, as_of descending,
// keyset by `before` (a judgment_id from the previous page), limit 1..500 (default 50).
import {cardsOf,methodKey} from '@/lib/judgments/display';
import {publicReads} from '@/lib/judgments/public-reads';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,intParam,internalErrorResponse,okResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams,uuidParam} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['limit','before'] as const;

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const now=new Date();
 const {id}=await params;
 if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
 let q;
 try{const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);q={limit:intParam(p,'limit',50,500),before:uuidParam(p,'before')};}
 catch(e){return paramErrorResponse(e)??internalErrorResponse(e,'judgments/history');}
 try{
  const r=publicReads();
  const loc=await r.judgmentLocator(id);
  if(!loc)return errorResponse('unknown_judgment','no such judgment',404);
  const [envs,methods]=await Promise.all([
   r.db.historyOf({type:loc.subject_type,key:loc.subject_key},loc.judgment_type,{id:loc.methodology_id,version:loc.methodology_version},{view:'latest',before:q.before,limit:q.limit}),
   r.db.listMethodologies()]);
  const cards=cardsOf(envs,new Map(methods.map(m=>[methodKey(m),m])),{includeAbstained:true,now:now.toISOString()});
  return okResponse({judgment_id:id,cards,next_before:envs.length>0?envs[envs.length-1].judgment.judgment_id:null},{empty:cards.length===0});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'judgments/history');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/methodologies/route.ts
// GET /api/methodologies (spec §10): registry rows (method metadata is public, spec §5.6) with the
// latest scope='all' calibration summary; an unpublished method's calibration is invisible to anon
// (RLS) and reads as null.
import {publicReads} from '@/lib/judgments/public-reads';
import {enumParam,internalErrorResponse,okResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';
import type {MethodologyStatus} from '@/lib/judgments/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const STATUSES:readonly MethodologyStatus[]=['draft','active','retired'];

export async function GET(req:Request){
 let status:MethodologyStatus|undefined;
 try{status=enumParam(readParams(new URL(req.url),['status']),'status',STATUSES);}catch(e){return paramErrorResponse(e)??internalErrorResponse(e,'methodologies');}
 try{
  const r=publicReads();
  const rows=await r.db.listMethodologies(status);
  const methodologies=await Promise.all(rows.map(async row=>{
   const c=await r.db.latestCalibration(row.methodology_id,row.version,{scope_type:'all',scope_key:''});
   return {methodology:row,calibration:c?{state:c.valid?c.row.state:'insufficient',valid:c.valid,n_independent:c.row.n_independent,threshold_n:c.row.threshold_n,computed_at:c.row.computed_at,valid_until:c.row.valid_until,metrics:c.row.metrics}:null};
  }));
  return okResponse({status:status??null,methodologies},{empty:methodologies.length===0});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'methodologies');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/methodologies/[id]/[version]/route.ts
// GET /api/methodologies/[id]/[version] (spec §10): {row, doc_markdown, doc_sha256_matches,
// calibrations (latest per scope), recent_settlements}. The document is read from the deployment
// bundle (next.config outputFileTracingIncludes ships docs/methodologies/**) and checked against the
// registry's doc_sha256.
import {unitsOf} from '@/lib/judgments/calibrate';
import {publicReads,readMethodologyDoc} from '@/lib/judgments/public-reads';
import {METHOD_ID_RE,VERSION_RE,errorResponse,internalErrorResponse,okResponse} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const RECENT=20;

export async function GET(_req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;version:string}>}){
 const {id,version}=await params;
 if(!METHOD_ID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid methodology id',400);
 if(!VERSION_RE.test(version))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:version','invalid version',400);
 try{
  const r=publicReads();
  const row=(await r.db.listMethodologies()).find(m=>m.methodology_id===id&&m.version===version);
  if(!row)return errorResponse('unknown_methodology','no such methodology',404);
  const [doc,calibrations,recent]=await Promise.all([
   readMethodologyDoc(row.doc_path,row.doc_sha256),
   Promise.all(unitsOf(row).map(async u=>{const c=await r.db.latestCalibration(id,version,u.scope);return c?{scope:u.scope,row:c.row,valid:c.valid}:null;})),
   r.recentSettlements(id,version,RECENT)]);
  return okResponse({row,doc_markdown:doc.markdown,doc_sha256_matches:doc.sha256_matches,calibrations:calibrations.filter(c=>c!==null),recent_settlements:recent},{empty:false});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'methodologies/id');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/methodologies/[id]/[version]/calibration/route.ts
// GET …/calibration (spec §10): the latest calibration row of one scope with its reliability bins
// and temporal split; sample=1 adds the cohort entries, read from the private bucket server-side
// (service role) only after the anon read returned the row — i.e. only for a published method.
import {publicReads,readCohortSample} from '@/lib/judgments/public-reads';
import {METHOD_ID_RE,ParamError,VERSION_RE,enumParam,errorResponse,flagParam,internalErrorResponse,okResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';
import type {CalibrationScope,ScopeType} from '@/lib/judgments/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['scope_type','scope_key','sample'] as const;
const SCOPE_TYPES:readonly ScopeType[]=['all','market','subject_type'];

export async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string;version:string}>}){
 const {id,version}=await params;
 if(!METHOD_ID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid methodology id',400);
 if(!VERSION_RE.test(version))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:version','invalid version',400);
 let scope:CalibrationScope,sample:boolean;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(req.url),PARAMS);
  const type=enumParam(p,'scope_type',SCOPE_TYPES)??'all';
  const key=p.get('scope_key')??'';
  if(type==='all'?key!=='':!/^[A-Za-z_]{1,32}$/.test(key))throw new ParamError('scope_key');
  scope={scope_type:type,scope_key:key};sample=flagParam(p,'sample');
 }catch(e){return paramErrorResponse(e)??internalErrorResponse(e,'methodologies/calibration');}
 try{
  const r=publicReads();
  const row=(await r.db.listMethodologies()).find(m=>m.methodology_id===id&&m.version===version);
  if(!row)return errorResponse('unknown_methodology','no such methodology',404);
  const c=await r.db.latestCalibration(id,version,scope);
  if(!c)return okResponse({scope,calibration:null,valid:false,state:'insufficient',reliability:[],temporal_split:null,sample:null,sample_status:null},{empty:true});
  const s=sample?await readCohortSample(c.row.cohort_path,c.row.cohort_sha256):null;
  const metrics=c.row.metrics as Record<string,unknown>;
  return okResponse({scope,calibration:c.row,valid:c.valid,state:c.valid?c.row.state:'insufficient',reliability:c.row.reliability,temporal_split:metrics.temporal_split??null,
   sample:s?.entries??null,sample_status:s?.status??null},{empty:false});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'methodologies/calibration');}
}
```

```ts
vi.mock('@/lib/supabase/admin',()=>({getAdminSupabase:()=>({from:mocks.from})}));
```
