```ts
import {POST} from './route';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated} from '@/lib/admin/auth';

const ID=uuidOf(7),REQ='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa',ADMIN='9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-8c2d-1e0f9a8b7c6d';
const post=(body:unknown,headers:Record<string,string>={'content-type':'application/json'},id=ID)=>
 POST(new Request(`https://alpha.example/api/admin/judgments/${id}/withdraw`,{method:'POST',headers,body:JSON.stringify(body)}),{params:Promise.resolve({id})});

describe('POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/withdraw',()=>{
 beforeEach(()=>{
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  mocks.tables=memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id']});
  mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue({id:ADMIN});
  mocks.getJudgment.mockResolvedValue(judgmentRow({n:7}));
  mocks.append.mockResolvedValue({seq:2,status:'applied'});
  mocks.insert.mockResolvedValue({error:null});
  mocks.from.mockReturnValue({insert:mocks.insert});
 });
 it('appends withdrawn with lease null, actor admin:<uuid>, request key admin:<request_id>, a manual batch, and audits',async()=>{
  const res=await post({reason:'label error',request_id:REQ},{'content-type':'application/json',origin:'https://alpha.example'});
  expect(res.status).toBe(200);
  expect(res.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');
  expect(await res.json()).toEqual({codeVersion:'abc1234',id:ID,outcome:'applied',seq:2});
  const [jid,token,key,row]=mocks.append.mock.calls[0];
  expect([jid,token,key]).toEqual([ID,null,`admin:${REQ}`]);
  expect(row).toMatchObject({kind:'withdrawn',outcome:null,realized:null,evidence:{admin_action:'withdrawn'},resolver:'fact_metric',resolver_version:'admin',reason:'label error',actor:`admin:${ADMIN}`,code_version:'abc1234'});
  const [batch]=await (mocks.tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).select('ingest_batches',{batch_id:row.batch_id});
  expect(batch).toMatchObject({dataset:'judgments.settle',triggered_by:'manual',status:'success',counts:expect.objectContaining({fetched:1,versioned:1})});
  expect(mocks.from).toHaveBeenCalledWith('research_audit_log');
  expect(mocks.insert.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatchObject({user_id:ADMIN,action:'judgments.withdraw',object_type:'judgments',object_id:ID,detail:{kind:'withdrawn',reason:'label error',request_id:REQ,outcome:'applied',seq:2}});
 });
 it('a retried request with the same payload is already_applied (200); a conflicting one is 409',async()=>{
  mocks.append.mockResolvedValueOnce({seq:2,status:'already_applied'});
  const r1=await post({reason:'label error',request_id:REQ});
  expect(r1.status).toBe(200);expect((await r1.json()).outcome).toBe('already_applied');
  mocks.append.mockResolvedValueOnce({seq:2,status:'request_key_conflict'});
  const r2=await post({reason:'other',request_id:REQ});
  expect(r2.status).toBe(409);expect((await r2.json()).error.code).toBe('request_key_conflict');
 });
 it('an illegal transition is 409 settlement_sequence and the batch records the failure',async()=>{
  mocks.append.mockRejectedValueOnce(Object.assign(new Error('23514 settlement_sequence'),{code:'settlement_sequence'}));
  const res=await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ});
  expect(res.status).toBe(409);expect((await res.json()).error.code).toBe('settlement_sequence');
  const [batch]=await (mocks.tables as ReturnType<typeof memoryTableClient>).select('ingest_batches',{});
  expect(batch).toMatchObject({status:'failed',errors:[{code:'settlement_sequence',key:ID}]});
  expect(mocks.insert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('404 unknown_judgment; 400 for id, reason and request_id; 415 and 403 for the transport checks',async()=>{
  mocks.getJudgment.mockResolvedValueOnce(null);
  expect((await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ})).status).toBe(404);
  expect((await (await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ},undefined,'bad')).json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:id');
  expect((await (await post({request_id:REQ})).json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:reason');
  expect((await (await post({reason:' ',request_id:REQ})).json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:reason');
  expect((await (await post({reason:'x'.repeat(501),request_id:REQ})).json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:reason');
  expect((await (await post({reason:'x',request_id:'nope'})).json()).error.code).toBe('invalid_parameter:request_id');
  expect((await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ},{'content-type':'text/plain'})).status).toBe(415);
  expect((await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ},{'content-type':'application/json',origin:'https://evil.example'})).status).toBe(403);
  expect(mocks.append).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('401 / 403 from requireAdminUser before anything else',async()=>{
  mocks.requireAdmin.mockRejectedValueOnce(new AdminUnauthenticated('x'));
  expect((await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ})).status).toBe(401);
  mocks.requireAdmin.mockRejectedValueOnce(new AdminForbidden('x'));
  expect((await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ})).status).toBe(403);
  expect(mocks.getJudgment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('an audit failure is logged, not a 500',async()=>{
  const spy=vi.spyOn(console,'error').mockImplementation(()=>{});
  mocks.insert.mockResolvedValue({error:{message:'audit down'}});
  expect((await post({reason:'x',request_id:REQ})).status).toBe(200);
  expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('[admin/judgments] audit failed','audit down');
  spy.mockRestore();
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/judgments/[id]/withdraw/route.ts
// POST (spec §9.5, §10): admin settled → withdrawn. Body {reason (required), request_id (uuid)};
// requireAdminUser, JSON + same-origin, research_audit_log via the shared audit helper (an audit
// failure is logged, not turned into a 500 that would invite a retry). 409 settlement_sequence on an
// illegal transition, request_key_conflict on a reused request_id with a different payload.
import {appendAdminSettlement,HTTP_OF} from '@/lib/judgments/admin-actions';
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from '@/lib/judgments/db';
import {UUID_RE,adminBody,adminGate,codeVersionOf,errorResponse,internalErrorResponse,privateResponse} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {audit} from '@/lib/research/store';
import type {ResearchSupabase} from '@/lib/research/store';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const gate=await adminGate(request,{write:true});
 if('response' in gate)return gate.response;
 try{
  const {id}=await params;
  if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
  const body=await adminBody(request,{reasonRequired:true});
  if(body instanceof Response)return body;
  const codeVersion=codeVersionOf();
  if(!codeVersion)return errorResponse('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
  const admin=getAdminSupabase();
  const r=await appendAdminSettlement({db:supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon:getAnonSupabase(),admin}),tables:supabaseTableClient(admin),judgmentId:id,kind:'withdrawn',reason:body.reason!,requestId:body.request_id,adminId:gate.user.id,codeVersion});
  if(r.outcome==='applied'||r.outcome==='already_applied'){
   try{await audit({supabase:admin as unknown as ResearchSupabase,userId:gate.user.id},'judgments.withdraw',id,{id,kind:'withdrawn',reason:body.reason,request_id:body.request_id,outcome:r.outcome,seq:r.seq,batch_id:r.batchId});}
   catch(e){console.error('[admin/judgments] audit failed',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);}
  }
  if(r.outcome==='unknown_judgment')return errorResponse('unknown_judgment','no such judgment',404);
  if(r.outcome==='applied'||r.outcome==='already_applied')return privateResponse({id,outcome:r.outcome,seq:r.seq});
  return errorResponse(r.outcome,r.outcome==='settlement_sequence'?'transition not allowed':'request conflicts with an earlier one',HTTP_OF[r.outcome]);
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'admin/judgments');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/judgments/[id]/settle/route.ts
// POST (spec §9.5 "立即结算一条", §10): settle one judgment now through the settle core (Task 12
// settleNow: same resolver + decide() as the cron, actor admin:<uuid>, no lease); body {reason?, request_id}.
// Same gate, audit and error rules as withdraw / reopen. Only append decisions write; deferred /
// quarantine_pending / closed answer 200 with seq null (the cron handles them), leased / conflict 409.
import {productionJudgmentDeps} from '@/lib/judgments/deps';
import {settleNow} from '@/lib/judgments/settle';
import {UUID_RE,adminBody,adminGate,codeVersionOf,errorCodeOf,errorResponse,internalErrorResponse,privateResponse} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';
import {audit} from '@/lib/research/store';
import type {ResearchSupabase} from '@/lib/research/store';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=60;
const DEADLINE_MS=50_000;

export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{id:string}>}){
 const gate=await adminGate(request,{write:true});
 if('response' in gate)return gate.response;
 try{
  const {id}=await params;
  if(!UUID_RE.test(id))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:id','invalid id',400);
  const body=await adminBody(request,{reasonRequired:false});
  if(body instanceof Response)return body;
  const codeVersion=codeVersionOf();
  if(!codeVersion)return errorResponse('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
  let r;
  try{r=await settleNow(productionJudgmentDeps({codeVersion,actor:'script',triggeredBy:'manual',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(DEADLINE_MS)}),id,{actor:`admin:${gate.user.id}`,requestKey:`admin:${body.request_id}`});}
  catch(e){
   const code=errorCodeOf(e);
   if(code==='unknown_judgment')return errorResponse(code,'no such judgment',404);
   if(code==='settlement_sequence'||code==='lease_lost')return errorResponse(code,'judgment cannot be settled now',409);
   throw e;
  }
  try{await audit({supabase:getAdminSupabase() as unknown as ResearchSupabase,userId:gate.user.id},'judgments.settle',id,{id,reason:body.reason,request_id:body.request_id,outcome:r.outcome,seq:r.seq,detail:r.reason});}
  catch(e){console.error('[admin/judgments] audit failed',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);}
  if(r.outcome==='leased')return errorResponse('lease_lost','a settle run holds this judgment; retry later',409);
  if(r.outcome==='conflict')return errorResponse('request_key_conflict','request conflicts with an earlier one',409);
  return privateResponse({id,outcome:r.outcome,seq:r.seq});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'admin/judgments');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/judgments/queue/route.ts
// GET (spec §9.5 /admin/judgments): settle-queue rows for the admin page — filter due | backoff |
// leased | all (default due), limit 1..500 (default 100), keyset `after` (judgment_id). Each row is
// joined with its judgment summary and latest settlement (Task 21 api-types QueueItem); `counts` are
// the due / backoff / leased sizes capped at QUEUE_LIST_MAX (500); `now` is the database clock.
// Admin only, service role, never cached.
import {supabaseJudgmentsDb} from '@/lib/judgments/db';
import {adminGate,enumParam,intParam,internalErrorResponse,paramErrorResponse,privateResponse,readParams,uuidParam} from '@/lib/judgments/route-utils';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const FILTERS=['due','backoff','leased','all'] as const;

export async function GET(request:Request){
 const gate=await adminGate(request,{write:false});
 if('response' in gate)return gate.response;
 let q;
 try{const p=readParams(new URL(request.url),['filter','limit','after']);q={filter:enumParam(p,'filter',FILTERS)??'due',limit:intParam(p,'limit',100,500),after:uuidParam(p,'after')};}
 catch(e){return paramErrorResponse(e)??internalErrorResponse(e,'admin/judgments/queue');}
 try{
  const db=supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon:getAnonSupabase(),admin:getAdminSupabase()});
  const [rows,now,due,backoff,leased]=await Promise.all([db.queueList({filter:q.filter,limit:q.limit,after:q.after}),db.serverTime(),
   ...(['due','backoff','leased'] as const).map(f=>db.queueList({filter:f,limit:500}))]);
  const ids=rows.map(r=>r.judgment_id);
  const [judgments,settlements]=await Promise.all([Promise.all(ids.map(id=>db.getJudgment(id))),ids.length?db.settlementsOf(ids):Promise.resolve([])]);
  const latest=new Map<string,{seq:number;kind:string;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;settled_at:string}>();
  for(const x of settlements){const cur=latest.get(x.judgment_id);if(!cur||x.seq>cur.seq)latest.set(x.judgment_id,{seq:x.seq,kind:x.kind,outcome:x.outcome,settled_at:x.settled_at});}
  const items=rows.map((r,i)=>{
   const j=judgments[i];const l=latest.get(r.judgment_id);
   return {...r,judgment:j?{subject_type:j.subject_type,subject_key:j.subject_key,methodology_id:j.methodology_id,methodology_version:j.methodology_version,target:j.target}:null,
    latest_settlement:l?{kind:l.kind,outcome:l.outcome,settled_at:l.settled_at}:null};
  });
  return privateResponse({filter:q.filter,rows:items,next_after:rows.length>0?rows[rows.length-1].judgment_id:null,counts:{due:due.length,backoff:backoff.length,leased:leased.length},now});
 }catch(e){return internalErrorResponse(e,'admin/judgments/queue');}
}
```

**规格偏差（写进实施记录）：**
1. `settle_by`：规格 §11.1 写"target 月末 + 30 天"；契约"结算窗口算术"是 `settle_after = 目标月末 + 1 天`、`settle_by = settle_after + grace_days`，即月末 + 31 天。契约为准：as_of 2026-09-11 → target `2026-12` → `settle_after 2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`、`settle_by 2027-01-31T00:00:00.000Z`。
2. `deps`：规格 §11.1 要求 `deps` 含宏观 `regime.ts`、规则表与目录快照模块——这三者在仓库里都不存在。v1 的 `deps = ['src/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro.ts']`（resolver 不在方法模块的 import 闭包里，必须显式列入，§4.1）。宏观工作台落地后把 `regime.ts` 等加进 `deps` 会改变 `formula_hash`，按 §4.1 只能登记为新版本 `macro_regime@v2`（见 v1.md §7 与 Task 22 runbook §5）。
3. `status='draft'`（宏观工作台与 `regime.ts` 不存在，`classify` 由夹具替身表达）。后果：`draft` 只在测试与 `--dry-run` 下登记（§4.1）；生产 `deps.ts` 用 `unavailableMacroReadApi()`，补偿扫描在生产里**一条也不登记**（`snapshotsSince` 抛 `MacroUnavailable` → 跳过并写信息码；即便宏观接口可用，`draft` 行也让 `produce` 返回 `methodology_unavailable` 且 marker 不推进），直到晋级为 `active` 的版本同步上线。测试用"测试晋级"：在内存库里把同步行的 `status` 覆盖为 `'active'`（`macroDb('active')`），并有一条用例证明不晋级时什么都不登记。
4. 版本不匹配的弃权行带 `macro_snapshot` 一条输入（规格只说"abstain"）：让补偿扫描的 GIN 查询能按 `snapshot_id` 找到它，不会每轮重复处理。决策 D1 把这一点推广到 `produce`：任何在 `gather` 弃权、且 `binding.snapshot_id` 的快照可构造的工作项，登记的弃权行都带该快照输入（`binding_mismatch`、`observation_missing` 同样）；快照本身不可读 / 未分类时 `inputs=[]`，补偿扫描把重跑得到的 `duplicate` 视为完成并推进 marker。`binding` 缺失的弃权没有输入（调用方错误，不对应任何快照）。
5. 规格 §3.2 `categorical.claim` 写 `margin?`；契约是 `margin_pp?`（百分点，G28）。契约为准。

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/methodologies/macro-regime.v1.test.ts
// Task 19 (spec §11.1, §8.1 G28, §6.4, §7.1 step 0, §14.1, §15 #1): macro_regime@v1 on the 2026-09-11 US fixture
// (macro spec §14 acceptance example 9). The method is 'draft'; registration tests run through a "test promotion"
// (macroDb('active') overrides the synced row's status), and one test proves nothing registers without it.
import {existsSync,readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import type {CategoricalClaim,Input,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentRow,ResolverResult,Subject} from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import type {MacroFixture} from '@/lib/judgments/macro-api';
import {digest} from '@/lib/judgments/canonical';
import {formulaHashOf} from '@/lib/judgments/formula-hash';
import {REGISTRY,methodologyRowOf} from '@/lib/judgments/registry';
import {produce} from '@/lib/judgments/produce';
import {parseReplayFixture} from '@/lib/judgments/replay';
import {compensateMacro} from '@/lib/judgments/compensate';
import {macroRegimeReplayResolver} from '@/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro';
import {MACRO_REGIMES,MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION,macroRegimeV1,marginPp} from './macro-regime.v1';
import {MACRO_CODE_VERSION,MACRO_S1,MACRO_S2,buildMacroReplayFixture,compensateCtx,loadMacroFixture,macroDb,macroInputsDb,macroWork,mergeMacroFixtures,produceCtx} from '@/lib/judgments/testing/macro-fixture';

const US:Subject={type:'macro_region',key:'US'};
const base=()=>loadMacroFixture('us-2026-09-11');
const revised=()=>mergeMacroFixtures(base(),loadMacroFixture('us-2026-09-revised'));
const lowCoverage=()=>mergeMacroFixtures(base(),loadMacroFixture('us-2026-09-low-coverage'));
function patchSnapshots(fx:MacroFixture,patch:(s:MacroFixture['snapshots'][number])=>void):MacroFixture{for(const s of fx.snapshots)patch(s);return fx;}

async function registerS1(fx:MacroFixture=base()){
 const db=await macroDb('active');const inputsDb=macroInputsDb(fx);
 const res=await produce(macroRegimeV1,[macroWork(fx,MACRO_S1)],produceCtx(db,inputsDb));
 const ids=await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1);
 const row=ids.length===1?await db.getJudgment(ids[0]):null;
 return {db,inputsDb,res,ids,row:row as JudgmentRow};
}
const resolveCtx=(row:JudgmentRow,inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb,cutoff=row.settle_by!)=>({judgment:row,cutoff,now:'2027-02-01T03:00:00.000Z',inputsDb,signal:new AbortController().signal});
/** categorical outcome = predicate eq on the realized class (spec §3.3); settle.ts applies the same rule. */
function outcomeOf(row:JudgmentRow,r:ResolverResult):'hit'|'miss'|null{
 if(r.status!=='resolved'||row.condition?.resolver!=='macro_regime_replay')return null;
 return r.value===row.condition.predicate.rhs?'hit':'miss';
}
function rng(seed:number){let s=seed>>>0;return()=>{s=(s*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;return s/2**32;};}
function shuffled<T>(xs:T[],next:()=>number):T[]{const a=[...xs];for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(next()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;}

describe('macro_regime@v1 (Task 19)',()=>{
 it('is registered once in REGISTRY as a draft categorical rule method with the spec §11.1 parameters and a 7-section doc',async()=>{
  expect(REGISTRY.filter(m=>m.id==='macro_regime')).toEqual([macroRegimeV1]);
  const row=methodologyRowOf(macroRegimeV1,formulaHashOf(macroRegimeV1),{publishable:false,code_version:MACRO_CODE_VERSION});
  expect(row).toMatchObject({methodology_id:'macro_regime',version:'v1',judgment_type:'macro_regime',kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',
   subject_types:['macro_region'],input_kinds:['macro_snapshot','macro_observation','table_rows'],doc_path:'docs/methodologies/macro_regime/v1.md',
   params:{grace_days:30,threshold_n:100,ece_max:0.1,window_years:3,embargo_days:0,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'},
   horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:3},upstream:{macro_methodology_version:'v1.0'},status:'draft',publishable:false});
  expect(row.formula_hash).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  expect(methodologyRowOf(macroRegimeV1,formulaHashOf(macroRegimeV1),{publishable:false,code_version:'another-code-version'}).formula_hash).toBe(row.formula_hash);
  expect(MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION).toBe('v1.0');
  expect(MACRO_REGIMES).toEqual(['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession']);
  for(const p of [macroRegimeV1.module,...macroRegimeV1.deps])expect({p,exists:existsSync(p)}).toEqual({p,exists:true});
  const doc=readFileSync(macroRegimeV1.doc,'utf8');
  for(const h of ['## 1 回答什么问题','## 2 主体与输入','## 3 公式与参数','## 4 可证伪条件、目标期与标签政策','## 5 结算 resolver 与实现值定义','## 6 不适用情形（何时 abstain）','## 7 版本历史'])expect({h,found:doc.includes(h)}).toEqual({h,found:true});
 });

 it('registers snapshot s1: categorical claim (norm is not a probability), margin_pp in percentage points, frozen catalog_version, 3-month period target',async()=>{
  const {res,ids,row}=await registerS1();
  expect(res.counts).toMatchObject({inserted:1,duplicates:0,quarantined:0,failed:0});
  expect(ids).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(row.claim).toEqual({selected:'recovery',classes:['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'],
   distribution:{recovery:0.32575757575757575,overheat:0.23484848484848486,stagflation:0.2196969696969697,recession:0.2196969696969697},
   scores_are_not_probabilities:true,margin_pp:9.090909,catalog_version:'us-catalog-2026-09-01'});
  const claim=row.claim as CategoricalClaim;
  expect(claim.margin_pp!).toBeCloseTo((claim.distribution!.recovery-claim.distribution!.overheat)*100,5);
  expect(claim.margin_pp!).toBeGreaterThan(1);   // percentage points, not a fraction (G28)
  expect(row).toMatchObject({subject_type:'macro_region',subject_key:'US',judgment_type:'macro_regime',methodology_id:'macro_regime',methodology_version:'v1',
   kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',producer_nonce:'',as_of:'2026-09-11',abstained:false,abstain_reason:null,
   horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:3},target:{kind:'period',period:'2026-12'},label_policy:'cutoff_vintage',
   settle_after:'2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',settle_by:'2027-01-31T00:00:00.000Z',code_version:MACRO_CODE_VERSION});
  expect(row.condition).toEqual({resolver:'macro_regime_replay',
   params:{region:'US',reference_period:'2026-09',macro_methodology_version:'v1.0',catalog_version:'us-catalog-2026-09-01'},
   predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:'recovery'},
   text:{zh:'US 2026-09 当期象限为“复苏”（同一分类函数在截止 vintage 下对同一参考期重算）',en:'US 2026-09 regime is "recovery" (same classifier re-run for the same reference month on the cutoff vintage)'}});
  const kinds=row.inputs.map(i=>i.kind);
  expect({snapshot:kinds.filter(k=>k==='macro_snapshot').length,observations:kinds.filter(k=>k==='macro_observation').length,tables:kinds.filter(k=>k==='table_rows').length}).toEqual({snapshot:1,observations:11,tables:1});
  const snap=row.inputs.find(i=>i.kind==='macro_snapshot')!;
  expect(snap.ref).toEqual({snapshot_id:MACRO_S1});
  expect(snap.available_at).toBe('2026-09-11T12:30:00.000Z');   // max of its observations' available_at (spec §3.7), not created_at
  expect(row.inputs.find(i=>i.kind==='table_rows')!.ref).toEqual({table:'macro_series',natural_key:'US'});
  const cpi=row.inputs.find((i):i is Extract<Input,{kind:'macro_observation'}>=>i.kind==='macro_observation'&&i.ref.series_id==='US_CPI_YOY')!;
  expect(cpi.snapshot).toMatchObject({series_id:'US_CPI_YOY',period_end:'2026-08-31',value:2.9,vintage_id:'bls-2026-09-11'});
  for(const i of row.inputs)expect(i.hash).toBe(digest(i.snapshot));
 });

 it('margin_pp is percentage points: marginPp scales by 100, and a snapshot that stored the margin as a fraction abstains (G28)',async()=>{
  expect(marginPp({recovery:0.4,overheat:0.35,stagflation:0.15,recession:0.1},'recovery','overheat')).toBe(5);
  const fx=patchSnapshots(base(),s=>{if(s.regime)s.regime.margin_pp=0.090909;});
  const {res,row}=await registerS1(fx);
  expect(res.counts.inserted).toBe(1);
  expect(row).toMatchObject({abstained:true,abstain_reason:'margin_unit_mismatch',claim:null,condition:null,target:null,horizon:null,label_policy:null,settle_after:null,settle_by:null});
 });

 it('freezes the catalog: compute on the frozen inputs reproduces the claim; another catalog for the same snapshot is another judgment',async()=>{
  const {db,row}=await registerS1();
  expect(macroRegimeV1.compute(US,row.inputs)).toEqual({abstained:false,claim:row.claim});
  const edited=base();
  edited.series_catalog.US=edited.series_catalog.US!.map(r=>r.id==='US_VIX'?{...r,weight:6,definition_version:2}:r);
  const again=await produce(macroRegimeV1,[macroWork(edited,MACRO_S1)],produceCtx(db,macroInputsDb(edited)));
  expect(again.counts).toMatchObject({inserted:1,duplicates:0,quarantined:0});
  const ids=await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1);
  expect(ids).toHaveLength(2);
  const other=(await db.getJudgment(ids.find(i=>i!==row.judgment_id)!))!;
  expect(other.inputs_hash).not.toBe(row.inputs_hash);
  expect((other.claim as CategoricalClaim).catalog_version).toBe('us-catalog-2026-09-01');   // from the snapshot, frozen
 });

 it('macro_regime_replay on the same vintage → recovery → hit',async()=>{
  const {row,inputsDb}=await registerS1();
  expect(macroRegimeReplayResolver.validateParams(row.condition!.params)).toBe(true);
  const r=await macroRegimeReplayResolver.resolve(resolveCtx(row,inputsDb));
  expect(r).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:'recovery',label_available_at:'2026-09-11T12:30:00.000Z'});
  if(r.status!=='resolved')throw new Error('unreachable');
  expect(r.evidence).toMatchObject({catalog:{version:'us-catalog-2026-09-01',rules_version:'v1.0'},regime_result:{primary_state:'recovery',coverage:0.8}});
  expect((r.evidence.observation_refs as unknown[]).length).toBe(11);
  expect(outcomeOf(row,r)).toBe('hit');
 });

 it('macro_regime_replay after the September data moves the argmax → overheat → miss; an earlier cutoff still sees the old vintage',async()=>{
  const {row,inputsDb}=await registerS1(revised());
  const late=await macroRegimeReplayResolver.resolve(resolveCtx(row,inputsDb));
  expect(late).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:'overheat',label_available_at:'2026-10-15T12:30:00.000Z'});
  expect(outcomeOf(row,late)).toBe('miss');
  const early=await macroRegimeReplayResolver.resolve(resolveCtx(row,inputsDb,'2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z'));
  expect(early).toMatchObject({status:'resolved',value:'recovery'});
 });

 it('macro_regime_replay with coverage < 0.6 on the cutoff vintage → Unavailable(coverage)',async()=>{
  const {row,inputsDb}=await registerS1(lowCoverage());
  expect(await macroRegimeReplayResolver.resolve(resolveCtx(row,inputsDb))).toEqual({status:'unavailable',failure:'coverage'});
 });

 it('an upstream macro methodology_version other than v1.0 abstains upstream_version_mismatch, keeping only the snapshot input',async()=>{
  const {res,ids,row}=await registerS1(patchSnapshots(base(),s=>{s.methodology_version='v1.1';}));
  expect(res.counts.inserted).toBe(1);
  expect(ids).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(row).toMatchObject({abstained:true,abstain_reason:'upstream_version_mismatch',claim:null,condition:null});
  expect(row.inputs.map(i=>i.kind)).toEqual(['macro_snapshot']);
 });

 it('acceptance example 1: the same snapshot produced twice → second run duplicates=1 and the row count is unchanged',async()=>{
  const {db,inputsDb,res}=await registerS1();
  const again=await produce(macroRegimeV1,[macroWork(base(),MACRO_S1)],produceCtx(db,inputsDb));
  expect(again.counts).toMatchObject({inserted:0,duplicates:1,quarantined:0,failed:0});
  expect(again.items[0]).toMatchObject({judgment_id:res.items[0].judgment_id,status:'duplicate'});
  expect(await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1)).toHaveLength(1);
 });

 it('draft consequence: without the test promotion nothing registers; --dry-run yields the same id and writes nothing',async()=>{
  const {ids}=await registerS1();
  const fx=base();const draft=await macroDb('draft');
  const live=await produce(macroRegimeV1,[macroWork(fx,MACRO_S1)],produceCtx(draft,macroInputsDb(fx)));
  expect(live.items[0]).toMatchObject({status:'failed',code:'methodology_unavailable'});
  expect(await draft.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1)).toEqual([]);
  const dry=await produce(macroRegimeV1,[macroWork(fx,MACRO_S1)],produceCtx(draft,macroInputsDb(fx),{dryRun:true}));
  expect(dry.items[0].judgment_id).toBe(ids[0]);
  expect(await draft.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1)).toEqual([]);
 });

 it('compensation end to end: both same-day snapshots get distinct judgments, the marker advances to s2, a rerun adds nothing, a draft row adds nothing',async()=>{
  const fx=base();const db=await macroDb('active');const inputsDb=macroInputsDb(fx);
  await compensateMacro(compensateCtx(db,inputsDb));
  const a=await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1);const b=await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S2);
  expect(a).toHaveLength(1);expect(b).toHaveLength(1);expect(a[0]).not.toBe(b[0]);
  const s2=fx.snapshots.find(s=>s.snapshot_id===MACRO_S2)!;
  const marker=await db.jobState('produce:macro_regime@v1');
  expect(marker?.state).toEqual({marker_created_at:s2.created_at,marker_snapshot_id:MACRO_S2});
  await compensateMacro(compensateCtx(db,inputsDb));
  expect(await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1)).toEqual(a);
  expect(await db.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S2)).toEqual(b);
  expect((await db.jobState('produce:macro_regime@v1'))?.state).toEqual(marker?.state);
  const draft=await macroDb('draft');
  await compensateMacro(compensateCtx(draft,inputsDb));
  expect([...await draft.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S1),...await draft.judgmentsBySnapshot(MACRO_S2)]).toEqual([]);
 });

 it('binding: a missing snapshot_id or a snapshot of another region / date abstains in gather',async()=>{
  const inputsDb=macroInputsDb(base());
  expect(await macroRegimeV1.gather({subject:US,asOf:'2026-09-11'},inputsDb)).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'binding_missing',missing:['snapshot_id']});
  expect(await macroRegimeV1.gather({subject:{type:'macro_region',key:'CN'},asOf:'2026-09-11',binding:{snapshot_id:MACRO_S1}},inputsDb)).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'binding_mismatch'});
  expect(await macroRegimeV1.gather({subject:US,asOf:'2026-09-12',binding:{snapshot_id:MACRO_S1}},inputsDb)).toEqual({abstained:true,reason:'binding_mismatch'});
 });

 it('compute / condition are byte-identical across 200 seeded input shuffles (spec §14.1 property)',async()=>{
  const {row}=await registerS1();
  const next=rng(20261106);
  const claim=digest(row.claim);const cond=digest(row.condition);
  for(let k=0;k<200;k++){
   const inputs=shuffled(row.inputs,next);
   const c=macroRegimeV1.compute(US,inputs);
   if(c.abstained)throw new Error(`abstained on shuffle ${k}: ${c.reason}`);
   expect(digest(c.claim)).toBe(claim);
   expect(digest(macroRegimeV1.condition(US,inputs,c.claim))).toBe(cond);
  }
 });

 it('the committed replay fixture (Task 13 format judgment-replay/1) is exactly what the builder produces; tampering CPI breaks its hash',async()=>{
  const committed=parseReplayFixture(JSON.parse(readFileSync('fixtures/judgments/replay/macro-regime.json','utf8')));
  expect(committed).toEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(await buildMacroReplayFixture())));
  expect(committed).toMatchObject({fixture_version:'judgment-replay/1',expect:'exact'});
  const inputs=committed.judgment.inputs as Input[];
  for(const i of inputs)expect(digest(i.snapshot)).toBe(i.hash);
  const cpi=inputs.findIndex(i=>i.kind==='macro_observation'&&i.ref.series_id==='US_CPI_YOY');
  expect(cpi).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  const tampered=structuredClone(inputs[cpi]) as Extract<Input,{kind:'macro_observation'}>;
  tampered.snapshot.value=3.4;
  expect(digest(tampered.snapshot)).not.toBe(tampered.hash);
  // replay.test.ts (Task 13) iterates this file too: exact replay, and its generic tamper hits a macro_observation (label has the series_id).
 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/methodologies/macro-regime.v1.ts
// macro_regime@v1 (spec §11.1, §8.1 G28; doc docs/methodologies/macro_regime/v1.md): current-period nowcast of the US/CN
// growth–inflation regime, bound to one published macro snapshot (binding.snapshot_id, spec §6.4). The claim restates the
// snapshot's primary state as a categorical claim: distribution = norm flagged scores_are_not_probabilities, margin_pp in
// percentage points, catalog_version frozen. The label is the same classifier re-run for the same reference month on the
// cutoff vintage (resolver macro_regime_replay, label_policy cutoff_vintage, horizon 3 calendar months).
// status 'draft': the macro workbench (regime.ts, macro_snapshots) does not exist yet; draft registers only in tests and
// --dry-run (spec §4.1), so production registers nothing until a promoted version ships (v1.md §7).
import type {Abstained,Active,CategoricalClaim,Condition,Input,JudgmentInputsDb,MacroSnapshotSnapshot,Methodology,Regime,Subject,Target,WorkItem} from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import {buildInput} from '@/lib/judgments/inputs';
import {addMonthsPeriod} from '@/lib/judgments/time';

export const MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION='v1.0' as const;
export const MACRO_REGIMES:readonly Regime[]=['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'];
/** Allowed gap (pp) between the snapshot's stored margin and the one recomputed from norm; a fraction-valued margin fails it (G28). */
export const MARGIN_UNIT_TOLERANCE_PP=0.01;
/** Macro spec §5.3 classifies nothing below this coverage; re-checked because compute never trusts the snapshot status. */
const MIN_COVERAGE=0.6;
const ZH:Record<Regime,string>={recovery:'复苏',overheat:'过热',stagflation:'滞胀',recession:'衰退'};
type SnapshotInput=Extract<Input,{kind:'macro_snapshot'}>;

const abstain=(reason:string,missing?:string[]):Abstained=>missing?{abstained:true,reason,missing}:{abstained:true,reason};
const snapshotOf=(inputs:Input[]):MacroSnapshotSnapshot|null=>inputs.find((i):i is SnapshotInput=>i.kind==='macro_snapshot')?.snapshot??null;
/** (norm[primary] − norm[secondary]) × 100, rounded to 6 decimals: percentage points (spec §8.1). */
export const marginPp=(norm:Record<Regime,number>,primary:Regime,secondary:Regime)=>Math.round((norm[primary]-norm[secondary])*1e8)/1e6;

async function gather(item:WorkItem,db:JudgmentInputsDb):Promise<Input[]|Abstained>{
 const snapshotId=item.binding?.snapshot_id;
 if(!snapshotId)return abstain('binding_missing',['snapshot_id']);
 const snap=await buildInput({kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id:snapshotId}},db,item.asOf);
 if(snap.kind!=='macro_snapshot')throw new Error(`buildInput returned ${snap.kind} for a macro_snapshot ref`);
 const s=snap.snapshot;
 if(s.region!==item.subject.key||s.as_of!==item.asOf)return abstain('binding_mismatch');
 // A foreign upstream version is not computed on; the snapshot alone is frozen so the abstention stays findable by snapshot_id.
 if(s.methodology_version!==MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION)return [snap];
 const inputs:Input[]=[snap];
 for(const id of s.observation_ids){
  const o=await db.macro.observation(id);   // locator lookup only; every frozen value comes from buildInput
  if(!o)return abstain('observation_missing',[id]);
  inputs.push(await buildInput({kind:'macro_observation',ref:{series_id:o.series_id,period_end:o.period_end,vintage_id:o.vintage_id}},db,item.asOf));
 }
 inputs.push(await buildInput({kind:'table_rows',ref:{table:'macro_series',natural_key:s.region}},db,item.asOf));
 return inputs;
}

async function resolveTarget(item:WorkItem):Promise<Target>{
 return {kind:'period',period:addMonthsPeriod(item.asOf.slice(0,7),3)};
}

function compute(subject:Subject,inputs:Input[]):Active<CategoricalClaim>|Abstained{
 const s=snapshotOf(inputs);
 if(!s)return abstain('input_missing',['macro_snapshot']);
 if(s.methodology_version!==MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION)return abstain('upstream_version_mismatch');
 if(s.region!==subject.key)return abstain('binding_mismatch');
 if(s.primary_state===null||s.secondary_state===null)return abstain('regime_unavailable');
 if(s.coverage<MIN_COVERAGE)return abstain('coverage_below_threshold');
 if(inputs.filter(i=>i.kind==='macro_observation').length!==s.observation_ids.length)return abstain('observation_missing');
 if(!inputs.some(i=>i.kind==='table_rows'&&i.ref.table==='macro_series'&&i.ref.natural_key===s.region))return abstain('input_missing',['table_rows:macro_series']);
 const margin=marginPp(s.norm,s.primary_state,s.secondary_state);
 if(s.margin_pp!==null&&Math.abs(s.margin_pp-margin)>MARGIN_UNIT_TOLERANCE_PP)return abstain('margin_unit_mismatch');
 return {abstained:false,claim:{selected:s.primary_state,classes:[...MACRO_REGIMES],distribution:Object.fromEntries(MACRO_REGIMES.map(r=>[r,s.norm[r]])),
  scores_are_not_probabilities:true,margin_pp:margin,catalog_version:s.catalog_version}};
}

function condition(subject:Subject,inputs:Input[],claim:CategoricalClaim):Condition{
 const s=snapshotOf(inputs);
 if(!s)throw new Error('macro_regime@v1 condition() needs the macro_snapshot input');
 const period=s.as_of.slice(0,7);const sel=claim.selected as Regime;
 return {resolver:'macro_regime_replay',
  params:{region:s.region,reference_period:period,macro_methodology_version:MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION,catalog_version:s.catalog_version},
  predicate:{op:'eq',rhs:sel},
  text:{zh:`${s.region} ${period} 当期象限为“${ZH[sel]}”（同一分类函数在截止 vintage 下对同一参考期重算）`,
   en:`${s.region} ${period} regime is "${sel}" (same classifier re-run for the same reference month on the cutoff vintage)`}};
}

export const macroRegimeV1:Methodology<CategoricalClaim>={
 id:'macro_regime',version:'v1',judgment_type:'macro_regime',kind:'categorical',producer_kind:'rule',
 subject_types:['macro_region'],input_kinds:['macro_snapshot','macro_observation','table_rows'],
 upstream:{macro_methodology_version:MACRO_UPSTREAM_VERSION},
 title:{zh:'宏观象限（当期 nowcast）',en:'Macro regime (current-period nowcast)'},
 doc:'docs/methodologies/macro_regime/v1.md',
 params:{grace_days:30,threshold_n:100,ece_max:0.1,window_years:3,embargo_days:0,label_policy:'cutoff_vintage'},
 horizon:{unit:'calendar_months',n:3},
 deps:['src/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro.ts'],
 module:'src/lib/judgments/methodologies/macro-regime.v1.ts',
 status:'draft',
 gather,resolveTarget,compute,condition,
};
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/testing/macro-fixture.ts
// Test / script helpers for macro_regime@v1 (Task 19). Loads fixtures/judgments/macro/*.json, serves them through
// fixtureMacroReadApi (macro side) and the frozen macro_series catalog (table_rows side), syncs the methodology row into a
// memory JudgmentsDb — "test promotion": status overridden to 'active' (spec §4.1 allows draft only in tests / dry-run) —
// and builds the golden replay fixture (spec §14.4). Production code never imports this file.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import type {Input,JudgmentInputsDb,JudgmentRow,JudgmentsDb,PublicTable,WorkItem} from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import {fixtureMacroReadApi,type MacroFixture} from '@/lib/judgments/macro-api';
import {memoryJudgmentsDb} from '@/lib/judgments/memory-judgments-db';
import {formulaHashOf} from '@/lib/judgments/formula-hash';
import {methodologyRowOf} from '@/lib/judgments/registry';
import {produce,type ProduceDeps} from '@/lib/judgments/produce';
import {defaultResolverOf,type CompensateDeps} from '@/lib/judgments/compensate';
import {REPLAY_FIXTURE_VERSION,type ReplayFixture} from '@/lib/judgments/replay';
import {macroRegimeV1} from '@/lib/judgments/methodologies/macro-regime.v1';

export const MACRO_S1='6f1d2c3a-0b5e-4c47-9a51-2f0d7e9c1a01';
export const MACRO_S2='6f1d2c3a-0b5e-4c47-9a51-2f0d7e9c1a02';
export const MACRO_CODE_VERSION='f4-fixture-code-version';
export const MACRO_BATCH_ID='00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000019b1';
/** Normalised run metadata of the golden fixture: excluded from the id and from replay (spec §6.2, §6.3). */
export const REPLAY_REGISTERED_AT='2026-09-11T23:00:00.000Z';
export type MacroFixtureName='us-2026-09-11'|'us-2026-09-revised'|'us-2026-09-low-coverage';

export function loadMacroFixture(name:MacroFixtureName):MacroFixture{
 return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'fixtures/judgments/macro',`${name}.json`),'utf8')) as MacroFixture;
}
export function mergeMacroFixtures(base:MacroFixture,...more:MacroFixture[]):MacroFixture{
 const out:MacroFixture=structuredClone(base);
 for(const m of more){
  out.observations.push(...m.observations);out.snapshots.push(...m.snapshots);out.classifications.push(...m.classifications);
  for(const r of ['US','CN'] as const)out.series_catalog[r]=[...(out.series_catalog[r]??[]),...(m.series_catalog[r]??[])];
 }
 return out;
}
const notInFixture=(what:string)=>async():Promise<never>=>{throw new Error(`${what} is not part of the macro fixture`);};
export function macroInputsDb(fx:MacroFixture):JudgmentInputsDb{
 return {
  facts:{readFacts:notInFixture('facts.readFacts'),factsByIds:notInFixture('facts.factsByIds'),filingsOfIssuer:notInFixture('facts.filingsOfIssuer')},
  deriveMetricsAsOf:notInFixture('deriveMetricsAsOf'),
  macro:fixtureMacroReadApi(fx),
  async tableRows(table:PublicTable,naturalKey:string){return table==='macro_series'&&(naturalKey==='US'||naturalKey==='CN')?(fx.series_catalog[naturalKey]??[]):[];},
  async publicJudgment(){return null;},
  async kline(){return {failure:'unsupported' as const};},
  async issuerPrimarySecurity(){return null;},
 };
}
export async function macroDb(status:'active'|'draft'):Promise<JudgmentsDb>{
 const db=memoryJudgmentsDb();
 const row=methodologyRowOf(macroRegimeV1,formulaHashOf(macroRegimeV1),{publishable:false,code_version:MACRO_CODE_VERSION});
 await db.syncMethodology({...row,status},'script',status==='active'?'test promotion of draft macro_regime@v1 (Task 19)':null);
 return db;
}
export function macroWork(fx:MacroFixture,snapshotId:string):WorkItem{
 const s=fx.snapshots.find(x=>x.snapshot_id===snapshotId);
 if(!s)throw new Error(`snapshot ${snapshotId} is not in the fixture`);
 return {subject:{type:'macro_region',key:s.region},asOf:s.as_of,binding:{snapshot_id:s.snapshot_id}};
}
const testTables=()=>memoryTableClient({ingest_batches:['batch_id'],dq_quarantine:['id']});
/** Task 10 ProduceDeps over the real resolver table (Task 11 via compensate.ts defaultResolverOf). */
export const produceCtx=(db:JudgmentsDb,inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb,opts:{dryRun?:boolean}={}):ProduceDeps=>
 ({db,inputsDb,tables:testTables(),resolverOf:defaultResolverOf,batchId:MACRO_BATCH_ID,codeVersion:MACRO_CODE_VERSION,signal:new AbortController().signal,dryRun:opts.dryRun??false,actor:'test'});
/** Task 12 CompensateDeps: the scan opens its own produce batch in `tables`. */
export const compensateCtx=(db:JudgmentsDb,inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb):CompensateDeps=>
 ({db,inputsDb,tables:testTables(),codeVersion:MACRO_CODE_VERSION,triggeredBy:'cron',signal:new AbortController().signal,methodology:macroRegimeV1});

/** Frozen inputs of snapshot s1, for REGISTRY-wide property tests (spec §14.1). */
export async function macroSampleInputs():Promise<Input[]>{
 const fx=loadMacroFixture('us-2026-09-11');
 const g=await macroRegimeV1.gather(macroWork(fx,MACRO_S1),macroInputsDb(fx));
 if(!Array.isArray(g))throw new Error(`macro sample gather abstained: ${g.reason}`);
 return g;
}

export async function buildMacroReplayFixture():Promise<ReplayFixture>{
 const fx=loadMacroFixture('us-2026-09-11');const db=await macroDb('active');
 const res=await produce(macroRegimeV1,[macroWork(fx,MACRO_S1)],produceCtx(db,macroInputsDb(fx)));
 const item=res.items[0];
 if(!item?.judgment_id||item.status!=='inserted')throw new Error(`macro replay fixture: produce failed ${JSON.stringify(item)}`);
 const row=await db.getJudgment(item.judgment_id);
 if(!row)throw new Error('macro replay fixture: registered row not found');
 const judgment:JudgmentRow={...row,registered_at:REPLAY_REGISTERED_AT,created_at:REPLAY_REGISTERED_AT,retrospective:false};
 return {fixture_version:REPLAY_FIXTURE_VERSION,description:'macro_regime@v1 · US · 2026-09-11 · snapshot s1 (acceptance example 2: tamper a macro_observation → input_hash_mismatch naming its series_id)',expect:'exact',judgment};
}
```

````markdown
# macro_regime@v1 · 宏观象限（当期 nowcast）

> 状态：**draft**。宏观工作台（`macro_snapshots`、`macro_observations`、`src/lib/macro/regime.ts`）尚未落地，本方法的分类函数由 `MacroReadApi.classifyAsOf` 的夹具实现替身表达；`draft` 只在测试与 `--dry-run` 下登记（规格 §4.1），生产环境不登记任何 `macro_regime@v1` 判断。晋级路径见 §7。
> `publishable=false`：本方法可达的 origin 键（`macro_observation×macro_workbench`、`macro_snapshot×macro_workbench`、`table_rows×macro_workbench`）在 `docs/methodologies/licenses.json` 里都是 `unverified`，owner 确认许可前读接口不返回本方法的卡片（规格 §4.1、§17；许可表不进 `formula_hash`，决策 D3）。

## 1 回答什么问题

"截至 `as_of`（日期）可见的宏观观测，判定区域 `US` / `CN` 在**参考期 = `as_of` 所在月**处于美林时钟四象限中的哪一个？"这是**当期 nowcast**，不是对未来状态的预测：判断说的是"用当时能看到的数据，2026-09 处于复苏"，而检验它的是"数据补全与修订之后，同一个分类函数对 2026-09 是否仍给出复苏"。它检验时效与修订风险；**不**检验资产表现（那是 `macro_regime_asset_pair`，未实现，规格 §11.1、§18.1），也**不**检验 3 个月后的状态。

## 2 主体与输入

主体：`{type:'macro_region', key:'US'|'CN'}`。生产者绑定：`binding = {snapshot_id}`（宏观 WP-M3 发布的一个快照；同区域同日两个快照 = 两条不同判断，规格 §6.4）。

| `kind` | 来源 | 冻结的投影 | `available_at` | `origin`（`src/lib/judgments/origins.ts`） |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `macro_snapshot` | `MacroReadApi.snapshot(snapshot_id)`（将来：anon 读 `macro_snapshots` ⋈ `macro_regime_results`） | `snapshot_id, region, as_of, methodology_version, catalog_version, observation_ids, primary_state, secondary_state, scores, norm, coverage, margin_pp, growth_axis, inflation_axis` | 其 `observation_ids` 各观测 `available_at` 的**最大值**（不是快照 `created_at`，规格 §3.7） | `macro_snapshot × macro` |
| `macro_observation`（每个 `observation_id` 一条） | `MacroReadApi.observation(id)`（将来：anon 读 `macro_observations where status='ok'`） | `series_id, period_end, value, unit, vintage_id, available_at` | 观测自身的 `available_at` | `macro_observation × macro` |
| `table_rows{table:'macro_series', natural_key: region}` | `JudgmentInputsDb.tableRows('macro_series', region)` | 该区域目录的全部行（含 `weight`、`definition_version`） | 行 `updated_at` 最大值的 UTC 日终 | `table_rows × supabase` |

登记校验 `max(available_at) ≤ as_of 23:59:59.999Z`（否则 `lookahead`）。目录行冻结进输入，回放与证据不依赖目录表的后续改动；目录不同 → `inputs_hash` 不同 → 不同判断（不是幂等冲突）。

## 3 公式与参数

分类函数**不在 F4 里**：它就是宏观规格 §5 的 `regime.ts`（v1.0 规则表 §5.2、输出公式 §5.3），F4 只把快照的结果重述为一条类别型主张：

```
selected               = snapshot.primary_state
classes                = [recovery, overheat, stagflation, recession]
distribution           = snapshot.norm                       (score[s] / Σ score；不是概率)
scores_are_not_probabilities = true
margin_pp              = round((norm[primary] − norm[secondary]) × 100, 6)   百分点（规格 §8.1 G28）
catalog_version        = snapshot.catalog_version
```

单位核对：若快照自带 `margin_pp` 且与上式差 > 0.01 个百分点（例如宏观侧误存为比例 0.0909），弃权 `margin_unit_mismatch`。

| 参数 | 值 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `grace_days` | 30 | 规格 §3.4：`calendar_months` 类一个月度发布周期（政策常量） |
| `label_policy` | `cutoff_vintage` | 规格 §3.4：宏观修订频繁，只在 `settle_by` 当天用当时可见的 vintage 结算 |
| `threshold_n` | 100 | 规格 §8.4 / owner 决策 O2 默认（运营门槛，不是统计保证） |
| `ece_max` | 0.10 | 同上（categorical 不用 ECE 门控，只写进校准行） |
| `window_years` | 3 | 规格 §8.2 默认；≥ 期限 3 个月的 3 倍 |
| `embargo_days` | 0 | 规格 §8.2 默认 |
| `horizon` | `{calendar_months, 3}` | 规格 §11.1：给迟到发布与修订留 3 个月，取宏观规格 §5.2 Δ(3M) 的同一时间尺度 |
| `upstream.macro_methodology_version` | `v1.0` | 宏观规格 §5.2 |

算例（`fixtures/judgments/macro/us-2026-09-11.json`，美国 2026-09-11，宏观规格 §14 验收样例 9 的输入；权重来自宏观规格 §4.2 目录）：

| 序列（权重） | 值 / Δ | 命中规则（v1.0） | 复苏 | 过热 | 滞胀 | 衰退 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| US_DFF（25） | 3.75 | policy_rate `2.5 ≤ v < 4.5` | 7.5 | 5 | 2.5 | 2.5 |
| US_DGS10（15） | Δ(3M) +18bp | bond_yield 其他 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| US_DTWEXBGS（10） | 3M +1.34% | 不命中（fx 只在 ±2% 外命中；不命中利率 / PMI 规则） | — | — | — | — |
| US_CPI_YOY（15） | 2.9 | inflation_yoy `2 ≤ v ≤ 3` | 6 | 4.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 |
| US_UNRATE（10） | Δ(3M) +0.1pp | 不命中 | — | — | — | — |
| US_ISM_PMI（15） | 48.7 | pmi `47 ≤ v < 50` | 1.5 | — | 6 | 6 |
| US_PPI_FD_YOY（5） | 2.5 | inflation_yoy `2 ≤ v ≤ 3` | 2 | 1.5 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| US_VIX（5） | 17.8 | risk_index `15 ≤ v < 25` | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1 | 1 |
| 合计 | | coverage = 80 / 100 = 0.8 | **21.5** | 15.5 | 14.5 | 14.5 |

`norm = (0.3258, 0.2348, 0.2197, 0.2197)`，`selected = recovery`，次判定 overheat，`margin_pp = 9.090909`（宏观规格 §5.3 文案档："5–15：相邻象限可能漂移"）。

## 4 可证伪条件、目标期与标签政策

```
condition = { resolver: 'macro_regime_replay',
              params: { region, reference_period: as_of 所在月 (YYYY-MM), macro_methodology_version: 'v1.0', catalog_version },
              predicate: { op: 'eq', rhs: selected } }
target    = { kind: 'period', period: reference_period + 3 个月 }
settle_after = target 月末 + 1 天（00:00:00.000Z）；settle_by = settle_after + 30 天
label_policy = cutoff_vintage
```

算例：`as_of 2026-09-11` → `reference_period 2026-09` → `target 2026-12` → `settle_after 2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`、`settle_by 2027-01-31T00:00:00.000Z`。条件文案（中文）：`US 2026-09 当期象限为“复苏”（同一分类函数在截止 vintage 下对同一参考期重算）`。

## 5 结算 resolver 与实现值定义

`macro_regime_replay`（`src/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro.ts`，进本方法 `deps`）：在 `cutoff = settle_by` 调 `MacroReadApi.classifyAsOf(region, reference_period, cutoff, 'v1.0')`——**同一个** `regime.ts` 函数（同版本规则表、同 `catalog_version` 权重、同 argmax），输入换成"`period_end ≤ reference_period` 月末且 `available_at ≤ cutoff` 的最新 vintage"。实现值 = 重算的 `primary_state`；`hit ⇔ 实现值 = selected`。`label_available_at` = 所用观测 `available_at` 的最大值；证据 `{observation_refs: [{series_id, period_end, vintage_id, value, available_at}], catalog: {version, weights, rules_version}, regime_result}`。重算时 `coverage < 0.6` → `Unavailable(coverage)` → 到 `settle_by` 后 `void(no_data:coverage)`。混频（CN GDP 季度）、未匹配规则、缺失观测的处理完全沿用 `regime.ts`，F4 不另写轴规则。

夹具算例：同 vintage → `recovery` → 命中；9 月数据到齐（DGS10 Δ(3M) +30bp、CPI 3.1、ISM 49.2、PPI 2.7、VIX 19.5）→ 得分 12.5 / 24.5 / 19 / 10 → `overheat` → 未命中（`fixtures/judgments/macro/us-2026-09-revised.json`）。

## 6 不适用情形（何时 abstain）

| 情形 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 没有 `binding.snapshot_id` | 弃权 `binding_missing`（无输入） |
| 快照的区域或 `as_of` 与主体 / 工作项不符 | 弃权 `binding_mismatch`（无输入） |
| 快照 `methodology_version ≠ 'v1.0'` | 弃权 `upstream_version_mismatch`（只冻结快照一条输入）；需要登记新的 F4 方法版本 |
| 快照没有主 / 次判定 | 弃权 `regime_unavailable` |
| 快照 `coverage < 0.6` | 弃权 `coverage_below_threshold`（正常情况下这种快照是 `failed`，不会被发布） |
| 快照引用的观测读不到 | 弃权 `observation_missing`（`missing` = 观测 id） |
| 目录行缺失 | 弃权 `input_missing`（`table_rows:macro_series`） |
| `margin_pp` 单位不符 | 弃权 `margin_unit_mismatch` |
| 任一输入不在公共读路径（隔离、不公开） | 登记拒绝 `input_not_public`（不是弃权） |
````

```ts
/**
 * Build the golden replay fixtures (spec §14.4) from code, so the committed JSON is reproducible byte for byte.
 *
 *   npx tsx scripts/judgments/build-replay-fixture.ts macro [--check]
 *
 * Writes fixtures/judgments/replay/<name>.json (JSON.stringify(…, null, 1) + newline). --check compares instead of writing:
 * exit 0 when identical, 1 when different or missing. Exit 2 on bad arguments.
 */
import {existsSync,mkdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname} from 'node:path';
import {buildMacroReplayFixture} from '../../src/lib/judgments/testing/macro-fixture';

const BUILDERS:Record<string,{path:string;build:()=>Promise<unknown>}>={
 macro:{path:'fixtures/judgments/replay/macro-regime.json',build:buildMacroReplayFixture},
};

async function main(){
 const [which,...rest]=process.argv.slice(2);
 const b=which?BUILDERS[which]:undefined;
 if(!b||rest.some(a=>a!=='--check')){console.error(`usage: build-replay-fixture.ts ${Object.keys(BUILDERS).join('|')} [--check]`);process.exitCode=2;return;}
 const text=JSON.stringify(await b.build(),null,1)+'\n';
 if(rest.includes('--check')){
  const same=existsSync(b.path)&&readFileSync(b.path,'utf8')===text;
  console.log(same?`${b.path}: up to date`:`${b.path}: differs from the builder (run without --check to rewrite)`);
  process.exitCode=same?0:1;return;
 }
 mkdirSync(dirname(b.path),{recursive:true});
 writeFileSync(b.path,text);
 console.log(`wrote ${b.path} (${Buffer.byteLength(text)} bytes)`);
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1;});
```

**规格偏差（写进实施记录）：**
1. `pending_fill` 卡的 `condition` 为 `null`：规格 §11.2 说"`condition` 仍给出（文案）、`target=null`"，但契约 `JudgmentCard.condition` 的 `target` 是非空 `Target`。契约为准；事件只在 `display.headline`（"买入 600519 · 5 个交易日方向"）里表达，定价后（有 `fill_date`）才有 `condition`。
2. `toJudgmentCard(rec, score, ctx)` 多一个 `ctx`（规格写 `toJudgmentCard(rec, score)`）：发行人反查是 I/O，放在路由里批量做（`loadIssuerIndex`），适配器保持纯函数；缺省 `NO_ISSUERS` → `security` 主体。
3. 状态优先级补全：`withdrawn` > `abstained`（`no_confidence` > `no_direction` > `market_unsupported`）> `pending_fill` > `settled` > `open`。`no_direction` 按 `callDirection(action) === 0`（即只有 `hold`；`pass` 的方向是 −1，与 `scoreForward` 一致）。`market_unsupported`（非 A/HK/US）是规格没列的弃权码。
4. 自评的独立抽样按 `market:ticker` 分流（不是卡片 `subject`），窗口 = `[as_of, settle_after]`；`retrospective`（`as_of` 早于 `created_at` 的 UTC 日期）不计入，与 §8.2 一致。
5. `display.value` 携带登记的 `p`（小数），只在行展开里以 `p = 0.72` 显示；`methodology.href = '/analyst'`（私有适配器不是注册表行，没有方法页）。

```ts
 it('hit=true → settled hit, hit=false → settled miss; realized is the self-reported hit flag',()=>{
  const hit=toJudgmentCard(rec(),score());
  expect(hit).toMatchObject({lifecycle:'settled',outcome:'hit',settlement:{kind:'settled',outcome:'hit',settled_at:'2026-09-22T09:00:00.000Z',
   realized:{value:true,label:'+2.31%',unit:null,from:'2026-09-14',to:null,label_policy:'first_observed'}}});
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec(),score({hit:false,forward_5d_pct:-1.2}))).toMatchObject({lifecycle:'settled',outcome:'miss',settlement:{realized:{value:false,label:'-1.20%'}}});
 });

 it('withdrawn takes priority over everything, including a hit and a missing confidence',()=>{
  const w=toJudgmentCard(rec({withdrawn_at:'2026-09-20T02:00:00.000Z',withdraw_reason:'thesis broken'}),score());
  expect(w).toMatchObject({lifecycle:'withdrawn',outcome:null,settlement:{kind:'withdrawn',outcome:null,realized:null,settled_at:'2026-09-20T02:00:00.000Z',evidence_summary:{zh:'thesis broken',en:'thesis broken'}}});
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec({withdrawn_at:'2026-09-20T02:00:00.000Z',confidence:null}),null).lifecycle).toBe('withdrawn');
 });

 it('abstains no_confidence before no_direction; hold has no direction; pass is a short call; non-A/HK/US markets abstain',()=>{
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec({confidence:null}),score())).toMatchObject({lifecycle:'abstained',abstain_reason:'no_confidence',condition:null,inputs:[],display:{percent:null,value:null}});
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec({confidence:null,action:'hold'}),null).abstain_reason).toBe('no_confidence');
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec({action:'hold'}),score({hit:null}))).toMatchObject({lifecycle:'abstained',abstain_reason:'no_direction'});
  const pass=toJudgmentCard(rec({action:'pass'}),null);
  expect(pass.lifecycle).toBe('open');
  expect(pass.condition?.text.zh).toBe('第 5 个后续交易日收盘价低于基准日收盘（看空）');
  expect(toJudgmentCard(unfilled({market:'JP',ticker:'7203'}),null)).toMatchObject({lifecycle:'abstained',abstain_reason:'market_unsupported'});
 });

 it('subject: issuer from issuer_securities ⋈ stocks_universe on the recommendation date, else security',async()=>{
  const open=await loadIssuerIndex(fakeClient({issuer_securities:[{issuer_id:'iss-1',ticker:'600519',valid_from:'2001-08-27',valid_to:null}],stocks_universe:[{ticker:'600519',market:'A'}]}),[rec()]);
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec(),null,open).subject).toEqual({type:'issuer',key:'iss-1'});
  const ended=await loadIssuerIndex(fakeClient({issuer_securities:[{issuer_id:'iss-1',ticker:'600519',valid_from:'2001-08-27',valid_to:'2026-09-14'}],stocks_universe:[{ticker:'600519',market:'A'}]}),[rec()]);
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec(),null,ended).subject).toEqual({type:'security',key:'A:600519'});   // valid_to is exclusive
  const other=await loadIssuerIndex(fakeClient({issuer_securities:[{issuer_id:'iss-1',ticker:'600519',valid_from:'2001-08-27',valid_to:null}],stocks_universe:[{ticker:'600519',market:'HK'}]}),[rec()]);
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec(),null,other).subject).toEqual({type:'security',key:'A:600519'});
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec(),null,NO_ISSUERS).subject).toEqual({type:'security',key:'A:600519'});
  await expect(loadIssuerIndex(fakeClient({},true),[rec()])).rejects.toThrow('boom');
  expect(await loadIssuerIndex(fakeClient({},true),[])).toBe(NO_ISSUERS);
 });

 it('id is domain separated: uuidV8(sha256("recommendation:"+id)), a v8 uuid, not the bare-id hash',()=>{
  const id=toJudgmentCard(rec(),null).judgment_id;
  expect(id).toBe(uuidV8(sha256(`recommendation:${FIXTURE_REC_ID}`)));
  expect(id).toBe(recommendationCardId(FIXTURE_REC_ID));
  expect(id).not.toBe(uuidV8(sha256(FIXTURE_REC_ID)));
  expect(id).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-8[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/);
 });

 it('never unlocks a percent: every state is self_assessed with percent null',()=>{
  const variants:Array<[Recommendation,RecommendationScore|null]>=[[unfilled(),null],[rec(),null],[rec(),score()],[rec({confidence:99}),score()],[rec({withdrawn_at:'2026-09-20T02:00:00.000Z'}),score()],[rec({action:'hold'}),null],[rec({confidence:null}),null]];
  for(const [r,s] of variants){const c=toJudgmentCard(r,s);expect({calibration:c.calibration,percent:c.display.percent,summary:c.calibration_summary}).toEqual({calibration:'self_assessed',percent:null,summary:null});}
 });

 it('bands are terciles: [0,1/3) low, [1/3,2/3) mid, [2/3,1] high',()=>{
  expect([0,0.333,1/3,0.5,0.666,2/3,0.67,1].map(bandOf)).toEqual(['low','low','mid','mid','mid','high','high','high']);
 });

 it('flags back-dated recommendations as retrospective (as_of before the registration date)',()=>{
  const c=toJudgmentCard(rec({recommended_at:'2026-09-01T01:30:00.000Z',fill_date:'2026-09-01'}),null);
  expect({as_of:c.as_of,retrospective:c.retrospective}).toEqual({as_of:'2026-09-01',retrospective:true});
  expect(toJudgmentCard(rec(),null).retrospective).toBe(false);
 });

 it('selfAssessment: settled, non-retrospective, independent calls only; Brier, hit rate and bands; state self_assessed, not auditable',()=>{
  const at=(d:string)=>`${d}T01:30:00.000Z`;
  const row=(id:string,p:Partial<Recommendation>,s:Partial<RecommendationScore>|null)=>({recommendation:rec({id,...p}),score:s===null?null:score({recommendation_id:id,...s})});
  const sa=selfAssessment([
   row('a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',{confidence:80},{hit:true}),
   row('a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002',{confidence:90,recommended_at:at('2026-09-15'),created_at:at('2026-09-15'),fill_date:'2026-09-15'},{hit:false}),
   row('a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003',{confidence:40,ticker:'000001'},{hit:false}),
   row('a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004',{withdrawn_at:'2026-09-16T00:00:00.000Z'},{hit:true}),
   row('a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005',{ticker:'000002'},null),
   row('a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006',{ticker:'000003',recommended_at:at('2026-08-03'),fill_date:'2026-08-03'},{hit:true}),
  ]);
  expect(sa).toMatchObject({state:'self_assessed',auditable:false,n_total:3,n_independent:2,hit_rate:{rate:0.5}});
  expect(sa.brier!).toBeCloseTo(0.1,10);   // ((0.8−1)² + (0.4−0)²) / 2; the overlapping 600519 call of 09-15 is not independent
  expect(sa.bands.map(b=>({band:b.band,n:b.n,hits:b.hits}))).toEqual([{band:'high',n:1,hits:1},{band:'mid',n:1,hits:0},{band:'low',n:0,hits:0}]);
  expect(sa.bands[2]).toMatchObject({rate:null,low:null,high:null});
  expect(JSON.stringify(sa)).not.toContain('percent');
 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/adapters/recommendation.ts
// recommendation_call@v1 (spec §11.2, §8.6): read-only private adapter. Maps one recommendations row (+ its
// recommendation_scores row) to a PrivateJudgmentCard and never writes judgments. Card id = uuidV8(sha256('recommendation:'+id)):
// a domain-separated content id, not an authorization boundary — private cards are only read through the user's session (G31).
// recommendation_scores is owner-writable, so calibration is fixed 'self_assessed': percent is always null, and selfAssessment()
// (same §8.1 math) is labelled "not auditable" and never enters judgment_calibrations.
import type {Market,Recommendation,RecommendationScore} from '@/lib/supabase/database.types';
import type {Bilingual,Horizon,Input,PrivateJudgmentCard,ReliabilityBin,Subject,Target} from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import {digest,sha256} from '@/lib/judgments/canonical';
import {uuidV8} from '@/lib/judgments/uuid-v8';
import {closeInstantUtc} from '@/lib/judgments/time';
import {settleWindow} from '@/lib/judgments/target';
import {originFor} from '@/lib/judgments/origins';
import {isPriceMarket} from '@/lib/judgments/markets';
import {brierParts,ece,reliabilityBins,selectIndependent} from '@/lib/judgments/calibration';
import type {CohortEntry} from '@/lib/judgments/calibration';
import {bandOf,type Band} from '@/lib/judgments/band';
import {callDirection,exchangeDate} from '@/lib/scoring/forward';
import {wilson} from '@/lib/research/fanout/calibration';

export {bandOf};
export const RECOMMENDATION_METHOD={id:'recommendation_call',version:'v1',title:{zh:'分析师建议（私有）',en:'Analyst call (private)'},href:'/analyst'} as const;
export const RECOMMENDATION_HORIZON:Horizon={unit:'trading_sessions',n:5};
/** trading_sessions default grace (contract 结算窗口算术, spec §3.4). */
export const RECOMMENDATION_GRACE_DAYS=60;
type LegacyFill=Extract<Input,{kind:'legacy_fill'}>;
type CardCondition=NonNullable<PrivateJudgmentCard['condition']>;
export interface RecommendationCardContext{issuerOf(ticker:string,market:Market,on:string):string|null}
export const NO_ISSUERS:RecommendationCardContext={issuerOf:()=>null};

const ACTION:Record<Recommendation['action'],Bilingual>={buy:{zh:'买入',en:'Buy'},add:{zh:'加仓',en:'Add'},sell:{zh:'卖出',en:'Sell'},trim:{zh:'减仓',en:'Trim'},hold:{zh:'持有',en:'Hold'},pass:{zh:'回避',en:'Pass'}};
const SELF_REPORT:Bilingual={zh:'分析师评分层自评（recommendation_scores 可被改写，不可审计）',en:'Analyst scoring layer self-report (recommendation_scores is owner-writable; not auditable)'};
const WITHDRAWN:Bilingual={zh:'分析师撤回',en:'Withdrawn by the analyst'};

export const recommendationCardId=(recommendationId:string)=>uuidV8(sha256(`recommendation:${recommendationId}`));

/** The one frozen price fact of the analyst scoring layer: the fill close (spec §11.2; legacy_fill, not price_bar). */
export function legacyFillInput(rec:Recommendation):LegacyFill|null{
 if(rec.fill_price===null||rec.fill_date===null||!isPriceMarket(rec.market))return null;
 const snapshot={recommendation_id:rec.id,fill_price:rec.fill_price,fill_date:rec.fill_date,market:rec.market,ticker:rec.ticker};
 return {kind:'legacy_fill',ref:{recommendation_id:rec.id},snapshot,hash:digest(snapshot),available_at:closeInstantUtc(rec.fill_date,rec.market),
  origin:originFor('legacy_fill','eastmoney',{recommendation_id:rec.id})};   // ORIGINS locator 'recommendations:{recommendation_id}' (Task 6)
}

const eventText=(dir:1|-1):Bilingual=>dir===1
 ?{zh:'第 5 个后续交易日收盘价高于基准日收盘（看多）',en:'Close on the 5th following session above the base-date close (long)'}
 :{zh:'第 5 个后续交易日收盘价低于基准日收盘（看空）',en:'Close on the 5th following session below the base-date close (short)'};
const headlineOf=(rec:Recommendation):Bilingual=>({zh:`${ACTION[rec.action].zh} ${rec.ticker} · 5 个交易日方向`,en:`${ACTION[rec.action].en} ${rec.ticker} · 5-session direction`});
const pctLabel=(v:number)=>`${v>0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(2)}%`;
function conditionOf(fill:LegacyFill,dir:1|-1):CardCondition{
 const target:Target={kind:'session_index',base_date:fill.snapshot.fill_date,n:RECOMMENDATION_HORIZON.n};
 const w=settleWindow(target,RECOMMENDATION_HORIZON,{grace_days:RECOMMENDATION_GRACE_DAYS});   // target.ts = time.ts settleWindowOf (Task 1)
 return {text:eventText(dir),horizon:RECOMMENDATION_HORIZON,target,label_policy:'first_observed',settle_after:w.settle_after,settle_by:w.settle_by};
}

/** State priority (spec §11.2): withdrawn > abstained(no_confidence > no_direction > market_unsupported) > pending_fill > settled > open. */
export function toJudgmentCard(rec:Recommendation,score:RecommendationScore|null,ctx:RecommendationCardContext=NO_ISSUERS):PrivateJudgmentCard{
 const asOf=exchangeDate(rec.recommended_at,rec.market);
 const issuer=ctx.issuerOf(rec.ticker,rec.market,asOf);
 const subject:Subject=issuer?{type:'issuer',key:issuer}:{type:'security',key:`${rec.market}:${rec.ticker}`};
 const p=rec.confidence===null?null:rec.confidence/100;
 const dir=callDirection(rec.action);
 const fill=legacyFillInput(rec);
 const condition=fill&&dir!==0?conditionOf(fill,dir):null;
 const inputs=fill?[{kind:fill.kind,ref:fill.ref,available_at:fill.available_at,origin:fill.origin,href:null}]:[];
 const base={judgment_id:recommendationCardId(rec.id),subject,judgment_type:'recommendation_call' as const,kind:'probability' as const,
  calibration:'self_assessed' as const,retrospective:asOf<rec.created_at.slice(0,10),as_of:asOf,registered_at:rec.created_at,
  methodology:{id:RECOMMENDATION_METHOD.id,version:RECOMMENDATION_METHOD.version,title:RECOMMENDATION_METHOD.title,href:RECOMMENDATION_METHOD.href},
  display:{headline:headlineOf(rec),percent:null,value:p,...(p===null?{}:{band:bandOf(p)})},
  calibration_summary:null,source:'recommendation' as const};
 if(rec.withdrawn_at!==null)return {...base,lifecycle:'withdrawn',outcome:null,condition,inputs,
  settlement:{kind:'withdrawn',outcome:null,realized:null,settled_at:rec.withdrawn_at,evidence_summary:rec.withdraw_reason?{zh:rec.withdraw_reason,en:rec.withdraw_reason}:WITHDRAWN}};
 const abstained=(reason:string):PrivateJudgmentCard=>({...base,display:{headline:base.display.headline,percent:null,value:null},
  lifecycle:'abstained',outcome:null,condition:null,settlement:null,inputs:[],abstain_reason:reason});
 if(p===null)return abstained('no_confidence');
 if(dir===0)return abstained('no_direction');
 if(!isPriceMarket(rec.market))return abstained('market_unsupported');
 if(!fill||!condition)return {...base,lifecycle:'pending_fill',outcome:null,condition:null,settlement:null,inputs:[]};
 if(score&&score.hit!==null){
  const outcome=score.hit?'hit' as const:'miss' as const;
  return {...base,lifecycle:'settled',outcome,condition,inputs,
   settlement:{kind:'settled',outcome,settled_at:score.scored_at,evidence_summary:SELF_REPORT,
    realized:{value:score.hit,...(score.forward_5d_pct===null?{}:{label:pctLabel(score.forward_5d_pct)}),unit:null,from:fill.snapshot.fill_date,to:null,label_policy:'first_observed'}}};
 }
 return {...base,lifecycle:'open',outcome:null,condition,inputs,settlement:null};
}

export interface SelfAssessmentBand{band:Band;n:number;hits:number;rate:number|null;low:number|null;high:number|null}
export interface SelfAssessment{state:'self_assessed';auditable:false;n_total:number;n_independent:number;brier:number|null;brier_skill:number|null;ece_raw:number|null;
 hit_rate:{rate:number;low:number|null;high:number|null}|null;reliability:ReliabilityBin[];bands:SelfAssessmentBand[]}

/** Spec §8.6: settled, non-retrospective calls → §8.2 independent sample (per security key) → §8.1 probability metrics. */
export function selfAssessment(rows:ReadonlyArray<{recommendation:Recommendation;score:RecommendationScore|null}>):SelfAssessment{
 const settled=rows.map(({recommendation:r,score})=>({r,card:toJudgmentCard(r,score)})).filter(x=>x.card.lifecycle==='settled'&&!x.card.retrospective);
 // Task 15 primitives (one §8.1/§8.2 implementation): entries stream per security key, window [as_of, settle_after date].
 const entries:CohortEntry[]=settled.map(({r,card})=>({judgment_id:card.judgment_id,subject_type:'security',subject_key:`${r.market}:${r.ticker}`,market:null,as_of:card.as_of,
  window_end:card.condition!.settle_after.slice(0,10),retrospective:false,lifecycle:'settled',settlement_id:null,forecast:{kind:'probability',p:r.confidence!/100},y:card.outcome==='hit'?1:0}));
 const chosen=selectIndependent(entries,0);
 const sample=entries.filter(e=>chosen.has(e.judgment_id)).sort((a,b)=>a.as_of<b.as_of?-1:a.as_of>b.as_of?1:a.judgment_id<b.judgment_id?-1:a.judgment_id>b.judgment_id?1:0)
  .map(e=>({p:(e.forecast as {p:number}).p,y:e.y as 0|1}));
 const bp=brierParts(sample);const hitsAll=sample.filter(s=>s.y===1).length;const wAll=wilson(hitsAll,sample.length);
 const m={brier:bp.brier,brier_skill:bp.skill,ece_raw:ece(sample),reliability:reliabilityBins(sample),
  hit_rate:sample.length?{rate:hitsAll/sample.length,low:wAll.low,high:wAll.high}:null};
 const bands=(['high','mid','low'] as const).map(band=>{
  const xs=sample.filter(s=>bandOf(s.p)===band);const hits=xs.filter(s=>s.y===1).length;const w=wilson(hits,xs.length);
  return {band,n:xs.length,hits,rate:xs.length?hits/xs.length:null,low:w.low,high:w.high};
 });
 return {state:'self_assessed',auditable:false,n_total:settled.length,n_independent:sample.length,brier:m.brier,brier_skill:m.brier_skill,ece_raw:m.ece_raw,hit_rate:m.hit_rate,reliability:m.reliability,bands};
}

type Rows={data:unknown;error:{message:string}|null};
/** Minimal read surface of the session Supabase client for the issuer lookup (issuer_securities and stocks_universe are public read). */
export interface IssuerLookupClient{from(table:'issuer_securities'|'stocks_universe'):{select(columns:string):{in(column:string,values:string[]):PromiseLike<Rows>}}}
const LOOKUP_CHUNK=200;
/** issuer_securities ⋈ stocks_universe(market): the issuer holding (ticker, market) on the recommendation's exchange date (spec §11.2). */
export async function loadIssuerIndex(client:IssuerLookupClient,recs:ReadonlyArray<Pick<Recommendation,'ticker'|'market'>>):Promise<RecommendationCardContext>{
 const tickers=[...new Set(recs.map(r=>r.ticker))];
 if(!tickers.length)return NO_ISSUERS;
 type Window={issuer_id:string;ticker:string;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null};
 const windows:Window[]=[];const marketOf=new Map<string,string>();
 for(let i=0;i<tickers.length;i+=LOOKUP_CHUNK){
  const part=tickers.slice(i,i+LOOKUP_CHUNK);
  const [sec,uni]=await Promise.all([client.from('issuer_securities').select('issuer_id,ticker,valid_from,valid_to').in('ticker',part),client.from('stocks_universe').select('ticker,market').in('ticker',part)]);
  if(sec.error)throw new Error(sec.error.message);
  if(uni.error)throw new Error(uni.error.message);
  windows.push(...((sec.data??[]) as Window[]));
  for(const u of (uni.data??[]) as {ticker:string;market:string}[])marketOf.set(u.ticker,u.market);
 }
 return {issuerOf(ticker,market,on){
  if(marketOf.get(ticker)!==market)return null;
  return windows.find(w=>w.ticker===ticker&&w.valid_from<=on&&(w.valid_to===null||on<w.valid_to))?.issuer_id??null;
 }};
}
```

```ts
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createRecommendation, listRecommendations } from '@/lib/analyst/store';
import { parseRecommendationInput, RECOMMENDATION_SOURCES } from '@/lib/analyst/validate';
import { analystError } from '@/lib/analyst/http';
import { isUuid } from '@/lib/portfolio/validate';
import type { RecommendationSource } from '@/lib/supabase/database.types';
// F4: spec §11.2 — every row carries a PrivateJudgmentCard (judgment_card); issuer subjects via issuer_securities ⋈ stocks_universe
import type { RecommendationView } from '@/lib/analyst/store';
import { getServerSupabase } from '@/lib/supabase/server';
import { NO_ISSUERS, loadIssuerIndex, toJudgmentCard, type IssuerLookupClient, type RecommendationCardContext } from '@/lib/judgments/adapters/recommendation';

/** Issuer lookup failures degrade to security subjects; they never fail the request. */
async function issuerIndexFor(recs: RecommendationView[]): Promise<RecommendationCardContext> {
  if (recs.length === 0) return NO_ISSUERS;
  try {
    return await loadIssuerIndex((await getServerSupabase()) as unknown as IssuerLookupClient, recs);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[analyst/recommendations] issuer lookup', e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    return NO_ISSUERS;
  }
}
// /F4

// GET ?analyst=<uuid>&ticker=<code>&open=1&source=<RecommendationSource> → { recommendations: RecommendationView[] }
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const url = new URL(req.url);
  const analyst = url.searchParams.get('analyst');
  if (analyst !== null && !isUuid(analyst)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'analyst must be a uuid' }, { status: 400 });
  const source = url.searchParams.get('source');
  if (source !== null && !RECOMMENDATION_SOURCES.includes(source as RecommendationSource)) return NextResponse.json({ error: `source must be one of ${RECOMMENDATION_SOURCES.join('|')}` }, { status: 400 });
  try {
    const recommendations = await listRecommendations({
      analystId: analyst ?? undefined,
      ticker: url.searchParams.get('ticker') ?? undefined,
      openOnly: url.searchParams.get('open') === '1',
      sourceType: (source as RecommendationSource | null) ?? undefined,
    });
    // F4: + judgment_card per row (spec §11.2); every other field unchanged
    const issuers = await issuerIndexFor(recommendations);
    return NextResponse.json({ recommendations: recommendations.map((r) => ({ ...r, judgment_card: toJudgmentCard(r, r.score, issuers) })) });
    // /F4
  } catch (e) {
    return analystError(e);
  }
}

// POST RecommendationInput → 201 { recommendation }; 404 analyst not found; 409 analyst archived
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const parsed = parseRecommendationInput(await req.json().catch(() => ({})));
  if (!parsed.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error }, { status: 400 });
  try {
    const recommendation = await createRecommendation(parsed.value);
    return NextResponse.json({ recommendation }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (e) {
    return analystError(e);
  }
}
```
