```ts
// src/components/judgments/analyst-view.ts
// Pure view logic for the /analyst confidence column and self-assessment block (spec §11.2, §8.6; canvas board 6).
// Confidence renders as a tercile band + "uncalibrated"; the registered p is a decimal shown only in the row expansion and is
// never formatted as a percent. Type-only imports, so this file is safe in client bundles.
import type {PrivateJudgmentCard} from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import type {SelfAssessment} from '@/lib/judgments/adapters/recommendation';
import type {Band} from '@/lib/judgments/band';

export const BANDS:readonly Band[]=['low','mid','high'];
export interface ConfidenceView{band:Band|null;registered:string|null;lifecycle:PrivateJudgmentCard['lifecycle']|null;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;
 abstainReason:string|null;condition:PrivateJudgmentCard['condition'];headline:PrivateJudgmentCard['display']['headline']|null}
export function confidenceView(card:PrivateJudgmentCard|null):ConfidenceView{
 if(!card)return {band:null,registered:null,lifecycle:null,outcome:null,abstainReason:null,condition:null,headline:null};
 const v=card.display.value;
 return {band:card.display.band??null,registered:typeof v==='number'?v.toFixed(2):null,lifecycle:card.lifecycle,outcome:card.outcome,
  abstainReason:card.abstain_reason??null,condition:card.condition,headline:card.display.headline};
}
/** One lit segment per band position (low | mid | high), as on the canvas. */
export const bandSegments=(band:Band|null)=>BANDS.map(b=>b===band);
const ratio=(v:number|null,d=3)=>v===null?'—':v.toFixed(d);
/** Hit rates are settlement statistics (spec §9.3 "命中率"), not the registered p, so they may be shown as a share. */
const share=(v:number|null)=>v===null?'—':`${Math.round(v*100)}%`;
const interval=(lo:number|null,hi:number|null)=>lo===null||hi===null?null:`${Math.round(lo*100)}–${Math.round(hi*100)}%`;
export interface SelfAssessmentView{empty:boolean;settled:number;independent:number;hitRate:string;interval:string|null;brier:string;brierSkill:string;
 bands:Array<{band:Band;n:number;hits:number;rate:string;interval:string|null}>}
export function selfAssessmentView(sa:SelfAssessment):SelfAssessmentView{
 return {empty:sa.n_independent===0,settled:sa.n_total,independent:sa.n_independent,hitRate:share(sa.hit_rate?.rate??null),
  interval:sa.hit_rate?interval(sa.hit_rate.low,sa.hit_rate.high):null,brier:ratio(sa.brier),
  brierSkill:sa.brier_skill===null?'—':`${sa.brier_skill>0?'+':''}${sa.brier_skill.toFixed(2)}`,
  bands:sa.bands.map(b=>({band:b.band,n:b.n,hits:b.hits,rate:share(b.rate),interval:interval(b.low,b.high)}))};
}
```

`src/components/judgments/ConfidenceCell.tsx`：

```tsx
'use client';

// /analyst "信心" column (spec §11.2, owner decision O5, canvas board 6): tercile band + "uncalibrated", never a percent;
// the registered value is shown in the row expansion (ConfidenceDetail).
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { PrivateJudgmentCard } from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import { bandSegments, confidenceView } from './analyst-view';

export function ConfidenceCell({ card, expanded, controls, onToggle }: { card: PrivateJudgmentCard | null; expanded: boolean; controls: string; onToggle: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const v = confidenceView(card);
  if (!v.band) return <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">--</span>;
  const label = t(`analyst.band.${v.band}`);
  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid w-9 grid-cols-3 gap-[2px]">
        {bandSegments(v.band).map((on, i) => <span key={i} className={`h-1.5 rounded-sm ${on ? 'bg-[var(--text-dim)]' : 'bg-[var(--border)]'}`} />)}
      </span>
      <span>{label}</span>
      <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('analyst.uncalibrated')}</span>
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-expanded={expanded}
        aria-controls={expanded ? controls : undefined}
        aria-label={t('analyst.toggleAria', { band: label })}
        onClick={onToggle}
        className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1 text-[10px] text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)]"
      >
        {expanded ? t('analyst.hideRegistered') : t('analyst.showRegistered')}
      </button>
    </span>
  );
}

export function ConfidenceDetail({ card }: { card: PrivateJudgmentCard | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const v = confidenceView(card);
  if (!v.lifecycle) return null;
  const target = v.condition?.target;
  return (
    <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs">
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.registeredLabel')}</dt>
      <dd><span className="num">{v.registered === null ? '--' : `p = ${v.registered}`}</span> <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('analyst.registeredNote')}</span></dd>
      <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.lifecycleLabel')}</dt>
      <dd>{t(`analyst.lifecycle.${v.lifecycle}`)}{v.outcome ? ` · ${t(`analyst.outcome.${v.outcome}`)}` : ''}</dd>
      {v.abstainReason && (
        <>
          <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.abstainLabel')}</dt>
          <dd>{t(`analyst.abstain.${v.abstainReason}`)}</dd>
        </>
      )}
      {v.condition && (
        <>
          <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.conditionLabel')}</dt>
          <dd>{v.condition.text[locale]}</dd>
          <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.targetLabel')}</dt>
          <dd className="num">
            {target?.kind === 'session_index' ? t('analyst.target', { base: target.base_date, n: target.n }) : '--'}
            {' · '}{t('analyst.settleBy', { date: v.condition.settle_by.slice(0, 10) })}
          </dd>
        </>
      )}
    </dl>
  );
}
```

`src/components/judgments/SelfAssessmentPanel.tsx`：

```tsx
// /analyst self-assessment block (spec §8.6, §11.2, canvas board 6): the §8.1 math on owner-writable scores, labelled
// "self-assessed, not auditable"; it never unlocks a percent and never enters judgment_calibrations.
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Metric, Panel } from '@/components/ui';
import type { SelfAssessment } from '@/lib/judgments/adapters/recommendation';
import { selfAssessmentView } from './analyst-view';

export function SelfAssessmentPanel({ assessment }: { assessment: SelfAssessment }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const v = selfAssessmentView(assessment);
  const th = 'pb-1 font-normal';
  return (
    <Panel title={t('analyst.selfAssessment.title')}>
      {v.empty ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.selfAssessment.empty')}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
            <Metric label={t('analyst.selfAssessment.settled')} value={String(v.settled)} />
            <Metric label={t('analyst.selfAssessment.independent')} value={String(v.independent)} />
            <Metric label={t('analyst.selfAssessment.hitRate')} value={v.interval ? `${v.hitRate} (${v.interval})` : v.hitRate} />
            <Metric label={t('analyst.selfAssessment.brier')} value={v.brier} />
            <Metric label={t('analyst.selfAssessment.brierSkill')} value={v.brierSkill} />
          </div>
          <table className="num mt-3 w-full max-w-sm text-left text-xs">
            <caption className="sr-only">{t('analyst.selfAssessment.bandTable')}</caption>
            <thead>
              <tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('analyst.selfAssessment.columns.band')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('analyst.selfAssessment.columns.n')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('analyst.selfAssessment.columns.hits')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('analyst.selfAssessment.columns.rate')}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {v.bands.map((b) => (
                <tr key={b.band} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                  <td className="py-1">{t(`analyst.band.${b.band}`)}</td>
                  <td className="py-1">{b.n}</td>
                  <td className="py-1">{b.hits}</td>
                  <td className="py-1">{b.interval ? `${b.rate} (${b.interval})` : b.rate}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </>
      )}
      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('analyst.selfAssessment.note')}</p>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

### Task 21: 判断层 UI（按 Claude Design 画布）：五个组件、`/intel/methods*`、`/admin/judgments`

规格：§9.1–§9.6、§10（只消费）、§8.1 / §8.2 的展示、§4.1（`publishable` / `draft`）。owner 规则：页面 UI 以画布为准——画布文件 `.claude/scratch/canvas/project/{Main,Cards2,Inputs,Timeline,Methods,MethodDetail,Admin,Analyst,M-Cards,M-Drawer}.dc.html`（`canvas.json` 板名：1 JudgmentCard ×2、2 InputsDrawer、3 SettlementTimeline、4a 注册表、4b 方法详情、5 /admin/judgments、6 /analyst（Task 20 已做）、7 移动 ×2）。动手前把十个画板全部读一遍；画布数值是版式示意，**与规格冲突处以规格为准**（下表）。`DESIGN.md`：单一黄铜强调色（`--accent`），本任务只用于 `calibrated` 徽章与选中态；数字 `num` 类（Geist Mono、tabular）；无渐变 / 紫色；命中 / 未命中 `--up` / `--down`。

**画布 → 规格偏差（全部写进实施记录与 Task 22 的 §19 表）：**

| # | 画布 | 规格 / 契约 | 实现 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 板 1、7：`macro_regime` 画成 probability，"62%""57%"，"该方法历史命中 58%" | §11.1：categorical，`distribution` 不是概率，永不显示 % | 宏观卡按 categorical 渲染：主判定类别 + "历史准确率 x%（n）"（仅 calibrated）；得分只在抽屉里以三位小数显示 |
| 2 | 类别"放缓 Slowdown" | 契约 `Regime = recovery / overheat / stagflation / recession` | 只用四个契约类名（`ui.classes.*`） |
| 3 | "未来 3 个月处于复苏"、目标 2027-02-01 | §11.1：当期 nowcast，参考期 = `as_of` 所在月，`target = 参考期 + 3` | 标题 / 条件文案取服务端 `display.headline` 与 `condition.text` |
| 4 | 门槛"有效样本 12/30"、"ECE ≤ 0.08" | §8.4 默认 `threshold_n = 100`、`ece_max = 0.10` | 一律显示校准行 / 摘要里的实际 `threshold_n`、`ece_max` |
| 5 | calibrated 卡整张卡黄铜描边 | §9.5：黄铜只用于 calibrated 徽章与选中态 | 卡片边框中性；只有徽章是黄铜 |
| 6 | 混淆矩阵对角线黄铜字色 | 同上 | 对角线 `font-semibold` + 主文字色 |
| 7 | 抽屉"6 / 6 哈希校验通过"、"回放 replayJudgment"按钮、"param"输入行 | 契约 `JudgmentCard.inputs` 不带 `snapshot / hash`；回放是脚本（§6.3）；`param` 不是 `InputKind` | 抽屉显示"投影冻结在登记行里，哈希校验用 `scripts/judgments/replay.ts`"；无回放按钮；参数在方法页 |
| 8 | 时间顺序验证 4 折 | §8.1：单次 70/30 时间外留出 | 表两行：全部独立样本 / 时间外留出（后 30%） |
| 9 | 公式文档画成键值列表 | §10：`doc_markdown` 原文 | 以预排版文本显示 Markdown 原文（仓库没有 Markdown 渲染依赖） |
| 10 | 版本历史含"publishable 2026-09-02"事件 | §10 方法详情不含事件史 | 版本列表取自 `/api/methodologies`（版本、状态、首次同步日）；`events` 字段可选，v1 不渲染 |
| 11 | /admin 瓦片"open 隔离项 2""校准有效性 5/6"；隔离码 `input_hash_mismatch` / `resolver_error` | 隔离项在 `/admin/dq`；§7.6 的码是 `settlement_*`；没有"有效性汇总"接口 | 瓦片：到期 / 退避 / 租约 + "隔离项 → /admin/dq"链接 |
| 12 | 注册表"draft 只对管理员可见" | §4.1：`draft` 行照常同步；`publishable` 只控制判断是否公开 | 注册表列出 `/api/methodologies` 返回的全部行，状态列显示 `草案 / 生效 / 退役 · 公开 / 未公开` |
| 13 | 可靠性：桌面默认"图 + 表" | §9.3：图必须有表格等价视图 | 默认"只看表"，图由按钮打开（服务端渲染与水合一致；表格始终在） |
| 14 | 命中红 `#e11d48`、未命中绿 `#16a34a` 写死 | §9.5：`--up` / `--down` | 用 token（随用户的涨跌配色翻转） |
| 15 | 三级文字 `#8b8b94`（画布注明"偏差待 owner 确认"） | DESIGN.md `#52525b` | 用现有 `--text-muted` token，不改全局 token |
| 16 | "研究员信心 / 模型信心" | 契约卡片没有 `producer_kind` | 统一"信心（档位）" |

```ts
// src/components/judgments/api-types.ts
// Response shapes of the Task 18 read routes as the judgment UI consumes them (spec §10). This is the one file to edit if the
// routes' JSON differs; every page and component reads the routes only through these types. (Integrator: aligned with the
// Task 18 route bodies; every body also carries codeVersion; `display.percent` is ABSENT when null — decision D2.)
import type {CalibrationRow,CalibrationState,JudgmentCard,JudgmentRow,MethodologyRow,QueueRow,SettlementKind,SettlementRow,Target} from '@/lib/judgments/types';

/** Over the wire `display.percent` is omitted when null (Task 18 serializeBody); read it as optional. */
export type WireCard=Omit<JudgmentCard,'display'>&{display:Omit<JudgmentCard['display'],'percent'>&{percent?:number|null}};
/** GET /api/methodologies[?status=] — registry rows with the latest scope='all' calibration summary (null when none / unpublished). */
export interface MethodologyCalibrationSummary{state:CalibrationState;valid:boolean;n_independent:number;threshold_n:number;computed_at:string;valid_until:string;metrics:Record<string,unknown>}
export interface MethodologyListItem{methodology:MethodologyRow;calibration:MethodologyCalibrationSummary|null}
export interface MethodologiesResponse{codeVersion:string;status:string|null;methodologies:MethodologyListItem[]}
/** GET /api/methodologies/[id]/[version]. recent_settlements are flat settlement rows with the judgment's subject. */
export type RecentSettlement=SettlementRow&{subject_type:string;subject_key:string;judgment_type:string};
export interface MethodologyDetailResponse{codeVersion:string;row:MethodologyRow;doc_markdown:string|null;doc_sha256_matches:boolean;
 calibrations:Array<{scope:{scope_type:string;scope_key:string};row:CalibrationRow;valid:boolean}>;recent_settlements:RecentSettlement[]}
/** GET /api/methodologies/[id]/[version]/calibration?scope_type=all. */
export interface CalibrationResponse{codeVersion:string;scope:{scope_type:string;scope_key:string};calibration:CalibrationRow|null;valid:boolean;state:CalibrationState;
 reliability:CalibrationRow['reliability'];temporal_split:unknown;sample:unknown[]|null;sample_status:string|null}
/** GET /api/judgments/[id]. */
export interface JudgmentDetailResponse{codeVersion:string;view:string;asOf:string|null;card:WireCard;judgment:JudgmentRow;settlements:SettlementRow[];calibration:{row:CalibrationRow;valid:boolean}|null}
/** GET /api/admin/judgments/queue?filter=due|backoff|leased|all&limit=&after= — queue rows joined with the judgment and its latest settlement. */
export interface QueueItem extends QueueRow{
 judgment:{subject_type:string;subject_key:string;methodology_id:string;methodology_version:string;target:Target|null}|null;
 latest_settlement:{kind:SettlementKind;outcome:'hit'|'miss'|null;settled_at:string}|null}
export interface QueueResponse{codeVersion:string;filter:string;rows:QueueItem[];next_after:string|null;counts:{due:number;backoff:number;leased:number};now:string}
/** POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/{withdraw,reopen,settle} body {reason, request_id} → {id, outcome, seq}. */
export interface AdminActionResponse{codeVersion:string;id:string;outcome:string;seq:number|null}
```

```ts
describe('methods and admin',()=>{
 const calSummary=(c:CalibrationRow,valid:boolean):MethodologyListItem['calibration']=>({state:valid?c.state:'insufficient',valid,n_independent:c.n_independent,threshold_n:c.threshold_n,computed_at:c.computed_at,valid_until:c.valid_until,metrics:c.metrics});
 const item=(p:Partial<MethodologyListItem['methodology']>,cal:MethodologyListItem['calibration']):MethodologyListItem=>({methodology:{methodology_id:'thesis_win_rate',version:'v1',judgment_type:'thesis_win_rate',kind:'probability',producer_kind:'model',subject_types:['issuer'],input_kinds:['financial_fact'],markets:null,title_zh:'论点胜率',title_en:'Thesis win rate',doc_path:'d',doc_sha256:'0'.repeat(64),implementation_sha256:'0'.repeat(64),params:{threshold_n:100},params_json:{},horizon:{unit:'fiscal_quarters',n:4},upstream:{},deps_sha256:'0'.repeat(64),formula_hash:'0'.repeat(64),status:'active',publishable:true,code_version:'abcdefg',created_at:'2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z',synced_at:'2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z',...p},calibration:cal});

  const items=[item({},calSummary(calRow(),true)),item({methodology_id:'macro_regime',kind:'categorical',subject_types:['macro_region'],title_zh:'宏观象限'},calSummary(calRow({kind:'categorical',state:'calibrated'}),false))];
  const rows=methodRows(items,'all','all');
  expect(rows.map(r=>[r.id,r.domain,r.state,r.brier,r.validUntil])).toEqual([['thesis_win_rate','company','calibrated',0.181,'2026-12-01'],['macro_regime','macro','insufficient',null,null]]);
  expect(methodRows(items,'categorical','all').map(r=>r.id)).toEqual(['macro_regime']);
  expect(methodRows(items,'all','macro').map(r=>r.href)).toEqual(['/intel/methods/macro_regime/v1']);
  expect(methodState(null)).toBe('insufficient');
 });
 it('gates: sample gate from n_independent ≥ threshold_n, calibration gate from the stored state, validity',()=>{
  expect(gatesView(calRow(),true)).toEqual({sample:{ok:true,n:214,threshold:100,total:486},
   calibration:{ok:true,metric:{key:'ui.method.gateEce',values:{ece:'0.05',max:'0.10',skill:'+0.10'}}},validity:{valid:true,validUntil:'2026-12-01',computedAt:'2026-11-01',revision:7}});
  expect(gatesView(calRow({n_independent:99,state:'insufficient'}),false)).toMatchObject({sample:{ok:false},calibration:{ok:null},validity:{valid:false}});
  expect(gatesView(calRow({state:'failed'}),true)?.calibration.ok).toBe(false);
  expect(gatesView(null,false)).toBeNull();

  expect(holdoutRows(calRow()).map(r=>[r.key,r.n,r.ece])).toEqual([['ui.method.splitAll',214,'0.050'],['ui.method.splitHoldout',64,'0.046']]);
  expect(holdoutRows(calRow({kind:'categorical'}))).toEqual([]);

 it('queue actions: due → settle; not yet due / leased / closed disable settle; withdraw after settled; reopen after void or withdrawn',()=>{

  expect(queueActions(q({closed_at:now,latest_settlement:{kind:'settled',outcome:'miss',settled_at:now}}),now)).toEqual({settle:'closed',withdraw:true,reopen:false});
  expect(queueActions(q({closed_at:now,latest_settlement:{kind:'withdrawn',outcome:null,settled_at:now}}),now)).toEqual({settle:'closed',withdraw:false,reopen:true});
```

```ts
// src/components/judgments/view-model.ts
// Pure view logic for the judgment UI (spec §9.3, §9.5, §9.6; canvas boards 1–7). Rules enforced here, tested in
// view-model.test.ts: a percent is rendered only for probability × calibrated; brass (the accent) is used only for the
// calibrated badge and the selected state, and every accent class of src/components/judgments lives in this file;
// hit / miss use --up / --down; charts have table equivalents. Components turn the returned message keys into text with
// useTranslations('judgments'). Type-only imports, so the file is safe in client bundles.
import type {CalibrationRow,CalibrationState,InputKind,JudgmentCard,Kind,Lifecycle,ReliabilityBin,SettlementRow,Target} from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import type {MethodologyListItem,QueueItem} from './api-types';

export type Locale='zh'|'en';
export type Msg={key:string;values?:Record<string,string|number>};
export type Tone='up'|'down'|'neutral';
export type AnyCard=JudgmentCard&{source?:'recommendation'};

// ── classes (the only accent usages of the judgment UI) ──
export const BRASS_BADGE='border-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--accent)_45%,transparent)] text-[var(--accent)]';
export const NEUTRAL_BADGE='border-[var(--border)] text-[var(--text-dim)]';
export const SELECTED='bg-[var(--accent-wash)] text-[var(--text)] shadow-[inset_0_-2px_0_var(--accent)]';
export const UNSELECTED='text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)]';
export const LINK='text-[var(--text)] underline decoration-[var(--border)] underline-offset-2 hover:decoration-[var(--text-dim)]';
export const TONE:Record<Tone,string>={up:'text-[var(--up)]',down:'text-[var(--down)]',neutral:'text-[var(--text-dim)]'};
export const badgeClass=(s:CalibrationState)=>s==='calibrated'?BRASS_BADGE:NEUTRAL_BADGE;
export const segmentClass=(selected:boolean)=>selected?SELECTED:UNSELECTED;

// ── numbers ──
export const fmt=(v:number|null|undefined,d=2)=>v===null||v===undefined||!Number.isFinite(v)?'—':v.toFixed(d);
/** Statistics (hit rate, accuracy, coverage) as a share; never used for a registered p. */
export const share=(v:number|null|undefined)=>v===null||v===undefined||!Number.isFinite(v)?'—':`${Math.round(v*100)}%`;
export const signed=(v:number|null|undefined,d=2)=>v===null||v===undefined||!Number.isFinite(v)?'—':`${v>0?'+':''}${v.toFixed(d)}`;
export const num=(m:Record<string,unknown>|null|undefined,k:string):number|null=>typeof m?.[k]==='number'&&Number.isFinite(m[k])?m[k] as number:null;
export const day=(iso:string|null|undefined)=>iso?iso.slice(0,10):'—';
export const minute=(iso:string|null|undefined)=>iso?`${iso.slice(0,10)} ${iso.slice(11,16)}`:'—';

// ── badges and states ──
export function calibrationMsg(state:CalibrationState,s:JudgmentCard['calibration_summary']):Msg{
 switch(state){
  case 'calibrated':return {key:'ui.calibration.calibrated'};
  case 'insufficient':return s?{key:'ui.calibration.insufficientN',values:{n:s.n_independent,threshold:s.threshold_n}}:{key:'ui.calibration.insufficient'};
  case 'failed':return s&&s.ece_raw_holdout!==null?{key:'ui.calibration.failedEce',values:{ece:fmt(s.ece_raw_holdout)}}:{key:'ui.calibration.failed'};
  case 'evaluated':return s&&typeof s.spearman==='number'?{key:'ui.calibration.evaluatedSpearman',values:{rho:fmt(s.spearman),n:s.n_independent}}:{key:'ui.calibration.evaluated'};
  case 'self_assessed':return {key:'ui.calibration.selfAssessed'};
 }
}
export function lifecycleView(c:Pick<JudgmentCard,'lifecycle'|'outcome'>):{msg:Msg;tone:Tone}{
 if(c.lifecycle==='settled'&&c.outcome)return {msg:{key:`ui.lifecycle.${c.outcome}`},tone:c.outcome==='hit'?'up':'down'};
 return {msg:{key:`ui.lifecycle.${c.lifecycle}`},tone:'neutral'};
}
/** Spec §9.3: a percent only for probability × calibrated; whatever else the server sends is not rendered. */
export function visiblePercent(c:Pick<JudgmentCard,'kind'|'calibration'|'display'>):number|null{
 return c.kind==='probability'&&c.calibration==='calibrated'&&typeof c.display.percent==='number'?c.display.percent:null;
}
export function targetText(t:Target):string{
 switch(t.kind){
  case 'session_index':return `${t.base_date} +${t.n}`;
  case 'date':return t.date;
  case 'period':return t.period;
  case 'fiscal_period':return t.extrapolated?`${t.period_end}*`:t.period_end;
 }
}

// ── card body ──
export type CardBody=
 |{type:'percent';text:string;hitRate:Msg|null}
 |{type:'band';band:'low'|'mid'|'high'|null;note:Msg}
 |{type:'category';selected:string;realized:string|null;accuracy:Msg|null}
 |{type:'score';value:string;scale:string;dims:Array<{id:string;label:string;value:string;width:number;missing:boolean}>;evaluation:Msg}
 |{type:'interval';range:string;nominal:string|null;realized:string|null;coverage:Msg|null}
 |{type:'abstained';reason:string;missing:string[]};
const realizedText=(c:JudgmentCard)=>c.settlement?.realized?String(c.settlement.realized.label??c.settlement.realized.value):null;
export function cardBody(c:JudgmentCard,locale:Locale):CardBody{
 const s=c.calibration_summary;
 if(c.lifecycle==='abstained')return {type:'abstained',reason:c.abstain_reason??'',missing:c.missing??[]};
 switch(c.kind){
  case 'probability':{
   const pct=visiblePercent(c);
   if(pct!==null)return {type:'percent',text:`${pct}%`,hitRate:s?.hit_rate?{key:'ui.card.hitRate',values:{rate:share(s.hit_rate.rate),low:share(s.hit_rate.low),high:share(s.hit_rate.high),n:s.n_independent}}:null};
   return {type:'band',band:c.display.band??null,note:calibrationMsg(c.calibration,s)};
  }
  case 'categorical':
   return {type:'category',selected:String(c.display.value??''),realized:c.lifecycle==='settled'?realizedText(c):null,
    accuracy:c.calibration==='calibrated'&&typeof s?.accuracy==='number'?{key:'ui.card.accuracy',values:{rate:share(s.accuracy),n:s.n_independent}}:null};
  case 'score':{
   const scale=c.display.scale??{min:0,max:100};const span=scale.max-scale.min||1;
   return {type:'score',value:typeof c.display.value==='number'?fmt(c.display.value,0):'—',scale:`${scale.min}–${scale.max}`,
    dims:(c.display.dims??[]).map(d=>({id:d.id,label:d.label[locale],value:d.value===null?'—':fmt(d.value,0),width:d.value===null?0:Math.max(0,Math.min(100,((d.value-scale.min)/span)*100)),missing:!d.coverage||d.value===null})),
    evaluation:calibrationMsg(c.calibration,s)};
  }
  case 'interval':{
   const v=c.display.value;const range=Array.isArray(v)?`${signed(v[0])} ~ ${signed(v[1])}`:'—';
   return {type:'interval',range,nominal:typeof c.display.nominal_coverage==='number'?share(c.display.nominal_coverage):null,realized:c.lifecycle==='settled'?realizedText(c):null,
    coverage:c.calibration==='calibrated'&&typeof s?.coverage==='number'?{key:'ui.card.coverage',values:{rate:share(s.coverage),nominal:share(c.display.nominal_coverage)}}:null};
  }
 }
}
/** Mobile collapsed row (canvas board 7): title, type + calibration line, and a right-hand value (percent, band or lifecycle). */
export function collapsedView(c:JudgmentCard,locale:Locale):{title:string;type:Msg;calibration:Msg;percent:string|null;band:'low'|'mid'|'high'|null;lifecycle:Msg}{
 const pct=visiblePercent(c);
 return {title:c.display.headline[locale],type:{key:`ui.type.${c.judgment_type}`},calibration:calibrationMsg(c.calibration,c.calibration_summary),
  percent:pct===null?null:`${pct}%`,band:c.kind==='probability'&&pct===null?c.display.band??null:null,lifecycle:lifecycleView(c).msg};
}
/** Card foot line (spec §9.3 "方法 id@version · 截至 as_of · 条件 · 目标 · 结算"). */
export function footerView(c:JudgmentCard,locale:Locale):{method:string;asOf:string;condition:string|null;target:string|null}{
 return {method:`${c.methodology.id}@${c.methodology.version}`,asOf:c.as_of,condition:c.condition?c.condition.text[locale]:null,target:c.condition?targetText(c.condition.target):null};
}

// ── inputs drawer ──
export function refText(kind:InputKind,ref:unknown):string{
 const r=(ref??{}) as Record<string,unknown>;const s=(k:string)=>String(r[k]??'');
 switch(kind){
  case 'financial_fact':return s('fact_id');
  case 'financial_metric':return `${s('metric')} ${s('period_start')}–${s('period_end')}`;
  case 'macro_observation':return `${s('series_id')} ${s('period_end')} (${s('vintage_id')})`;
  case 'macro_snapshot':return s('snapshot_id');
  case 'price_bar':return `${s('market')}:${s('ticker')} ${s('date')} ${s('adjustment')}`;
  case 'table_rows':return `${s('table')} ${s('natural_key')}`;
  case 'judgment':return s('judgment_id');
  case 'legacy_fill':return s('recommendation_id');
  default:return JSON.stringify(ref);
 }
}
export function inputRows(c:JudgmentCard){
 return c.inputs.map((i,idx)=>({key:`${i.kind}:${idx}`,kind:i.kind,ref:refText(i.kind,i.ref),date:day(i.available_at),origin:`${i.origin.publisher} · ${i.origin.adapter}${i.origin.transform?` · ${i.origin.transform}`:''}`,href:i.href}));
}
/** Registered value shown only in the drawer (spec §9.3): p as a decimal while uncalibrated; categorical scores without %. */
export function registeredValue(c:JudgmentCard,judgment:{claim:unknown}|null):{type:'p';text:string}|{type:'scores';rows:Array<{cls:string;score:string}>}|null{
 if(c.kind==='probability'&&visiblePercent(c)===null&&typeof c.display.value==='number')return {type:'p',text:c.display.value.toFixed(2)};
 const claim=judgment?.claim as {classes?:string[];distribution?:Record<string,number>}|null|undefined;
 if(c.kind==='categorical'&&claim?.distribution){const order=claim.classes??Object.keys(claim.distribution);return {type:'scores',rows:order.filter(k=>k in claim.distribution!).map(k=>({cls:k,score:fmt(claim.distribution![k],3)}))};}
 return null;
}

// ── settlement timeline ──
export interface Step{key:string;at:string|null;detail:string|null;tone:Tone;done:boolean}
const SETTLEMENT_KEY=(s:Pick<SettlementRow,'kind'|'outcome'>)=>s.kind==='settled'?(s.outcome==='miss'?'ui.timeline.settledMiss':'ui.timeline.settledHit'):`ui.timeline.${s.kind}`;
export function timelineSteps(c:JudgmentCard,settlements:SettlementRow[]|undefined,locale:Locale):Step[]{
 const steps:Step[]=[{key:'ui.timeline.registered',at:c.registered_at,detail:`${c.methodology.id}@${c.methodology.version} · ${c.inputs.length}`,tone:'neutral',done:true}];
 if(c.lifecycle==='abstained')return [...steps,{key:'ui.timeline.abstained',at:null,detail:c.abstain_reason??null,tone:'neutral',done:true}];
 if(c.condition)steps.push({key:'ui.timeline.target',at:c.condition.settle_after,detail:`${targetText(c.condition.target)} · settle_by ${day(c.condition.settle_by)}`,tone:'neutral',done:false});
 const rows=settlements&&settlements.length?[...settlements].sort((a,b)=>a.seq-b.seq).map(s=>({kind:s.kind,outcome:s.outcome,at:s.settled_at,detail:s.realized?String(s.realized.label??s.realized.value):s.reason}))
  :c.settlement?[{kind:c.settlement.kind,outcome:c.settlement.outcome,at:c.settlement.settled_at,detail:c.settlement.evidence_summary[locale]}]:[];
 for(const r of rows)steps.push({key:SETTLEMENT_KEY(r),at:r.at,detail:r.detail,tone:r.kind==='settled'?(r.outcome==='miss'?'down':'up'):'neutral',done:true});
 const last=rows.at(-1)?.kind;
 if(c.lifecycle==='open'||c.lifecycle==='pending_fill'||last==='reopened')steps.push({key:c.lifecycle==='pending_fill'?'ui.timeline.pendingFill':'ui.timeline.pending',at:null,detail:null,tone:'neutral',done:false});
 return steps;
}

// ── reliability (table equivalent of the chart) ──
export function reliabilityRows(bins:ReliabilityBin[]){
 return bins.map(b=>({range:`${b.bin_low.toFixed(1)}–${b.bin_high.toFixed(1)}`,n:b.n,meanP:fmt(b.mean_p),hitRate:fmt(b.hit_rate),
  wilson:b.wilson_low===null||b.wilson_high===null?'—':`${fmt(b.wilson_low)}–${fmt(b.wilson_high)}`}));
}
export const reliabilityPoints=(bins:ReliabilityBin[])=>bins.filter(b=>b.n>0&&b.mean_p!==null&&b.hit_rate!==null).map(b=>({x:b.mean_p!,y:b.hit_rate!,n:b.n}));

// ── methods registry and detail ──
export type Domain='all'|'macro'|'industry'|'company';
export const DOMAINS:readonly Domain[]=['all','macro','industry','company'];
export const KINDS:readonly (Kind|'all')[]=['all','probability','categorical','score','interval'];
export const domainOf=(subjectTypes:readonly string[]):Exclude<Domain,'all'>=>subjectTypes.some(s=>s.startsWith('macro'))?'macro':subjectTypes.includes('industry')?'industry':'company';
/** Spec §9.1: only a valid scope='all' report counts; otherwise the method shows as insufficient. */
export const methodState=(cal:{state:CalibrationState;valid:boolean}|null):CalibrationState=>cal&&cal.valid?cal.state:'insufficient';
export const methodHref=(id:string,version:string)=>`/intel/methods/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${encodeURIComponent(version)}`;
export function methodRows(items:MethodologyListItem[],kind:Kind|'all',domain:Domain){
 return items.filter(({methodology:row})=>(kind==='all'||row.kind===kind)&&(domain==='all'||domainOf(row.subject_types)===domain)).map(({methodology:row,calibration})=>({
  id:row.methodology_id,version:row.version,href:methodHref(row.methodology_id,row.version),title:{zh:row.title_zh,en:row.title_en},kind:row.kind,
  domain:domainOf(row.subject_types),status:row.status,publishable:row.publishable,state:methodState(calibration),
  nIndependent:calibration?calibration.n_independent:0,thresholdN:calibration?calibration.threshold_n:Number(row.params.threshold_n??100),
  brier:row.kind==='probability'?num(calibration?.metrics,'brier'):null,validUntil:calibration?.valid?day(calibration.valid_until):null}));
}
/** Two gates of spec §8.2 / §8.4 as displayed on the method page (gate 2's verdict is the stored state, not recomputed). */
export function gatesView(cal:CalibrationRow|null,valid:boolean){
 if(!cal)return null;
 const m=cal.metrics;
 const metric:Msg=cal.kind==='probability'?{key:'ui.method.gateEce',values:{ece:fmt(num(m,'ece_raw_holdout')),max:fmt(cal.ece_max),skill:signed(num(m,'brier_skill_holdout'))}}
  :cal.kind==='categorical'?{key:'ui.method.gateAccuracy',values:{low:share(num(m,'accuracy_low')),base:share(num(m,'majority_rate'))}}
  :cal.kind==='interval'?{key:'ui.method.gateCoverage',values:{coverage:share(num(m,'coverage')),nominal:share(num(m,'nominal_coverage')),ratio:fmt(num(m,'width_ratio'))}}
  :{key:'ui.method.gateSpearman',values:{rho:fmt(num(m,'spearman'))}};
 return {sample:{ok:cal.n_independent>=cal.threshold_n,n:cal.n_independent,threshold:cal.threshold_n,total:cal.n_settled},
  calibration:{ok:cal.state==='calibrated'?true:cal.state==='failed'?false:null,metric},
  validity:{valid,validUntil:day(cal.valid_until),computedAt:day(cal.computed_at),revision:cal.validity_revision}};
}
export function confusionView(cal:CalibrationRow|null){
 const raw=cal?.metrics.confusion;
 if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object')return null;
 const conf=raw as Record<string,Record<string,number>>;
 const classes=[...new Set([...Object.keys(conf),...Object.values(conf).flatMap(r=>Object.keys(r))])];
 return {classes,rows:classes.map(sel=>({cls:sel,cells:classes.map(real=>({n:conf[sel]?.[real]??0,diagonal:sel===real}))}))};
}
export function holdoutRows(cal:CalibrationRow|null){
 if(!cal||cal.kind!=='probability')return [];
 const m=cal.metrics;
 return [{key:'ui.method.splitAll',n:cal.n_independent,brier:fmt(num(m,'brier'),3),skill:signed(num(m,'brier_skill')),ece:fmt(num(m,'ece_raw'),3)},
  {key:'ui.method.splitHoldout',n:num(m,'n_holdout')??0,brier:fmt(num(m,'brier_holdout'),3),skill:signed(num(m,'brier_skill_holdout')),ece:fmt(num(m,'ece_raw_holdout'),3)}];
}

// ── admin queue ──
export type SettleAction='enabled'|'not_due'|'leased'|'closed';
export function queueActions(q:QueueItem,now:string):{settle:SettleAction;withdraw:boolean;reopen:boolean}{
 const leased=q.leased_until!==null&&q.leased_until>now;
 const last=q.latest_settlement?.kind??null;
 return {settle:leased?'leased':q.closed_at!==null?'closed':q.settle_after>now?'not_due':'enabled',
  withdraw:!leased&&last==='settled',reopen:!leased&&(last==='void'||last==='withdrawn')};
}
export const LIFECYCLES:readonly Lifecycle[]=['abstained','open','settled','void','withdrawn','pending_fill'];
```

```ts
// src/components/judgments/ui-source.test.ts
// Task 21 (spec §9.5, DESIGN.md): source-level guards for the judgment UI files that the node-env vitest cannot render
// (the repo's tsconfig keeps jsx: preserve): real buttons with an explicit type, no click handlers on non-interactive
// elements, accessible dialogs / svgs / tables, no gradients or purple, brass only through view-model.ts, the admin page
// gate, and every judgments message key used by these files present in zh and en with matching placeholders.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const C='src/components/judgments/';
const FILES=[`${C}JudgmentCard.tsx`,`${C}InputsDrawer.tsx`,`${C}SettlementTimeline.tsx`,`${C}CalibrationBadge.tsx`,`${C}ReliabilityTable.tsx`,`${C}ConfidenceCell.tsx`,`${C}SelfAssessmentPanel.tsx`,
 'src/app/(app)/intel/methods/page.tsx','src/app/(app)/intel/methods/[id]/[version]/page.tsx','src/app/(app)/admin/judgments/page.tsx','src/app/(app)/admin/judgments/AdminJudgmentsClient.tsx'];
const ALL=[...FILES,`${C}view-model.ts`,`${C}analyst-view.ts`,`${C}api-types.ts`];
const src=(f:string)=>readFileSync(f,'utf8');
const messages=(l:'zh'|'en')=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(`messages/${l}/judgments.json`,'utf8')) as Record<string,unknown>;
const get=(o:unknown,path:string)=>path.split('.').reduce<unknown>((a,k)=>a&&typeof a==='object'?(a as Record<string,unknown>)[k]:undefined,o);
function keys(v:unknown,prefix=''):string[]{if(typeof v!=='object'||v===null||Array.isArray(v))return [prefix];return Object.entries(v).flatMap(([k,c])=>keys(c,prefix?`${prefix}.${k}`:k));}
const placeholders=(s:string)=>[...s.matchAll(/\{([^}]+)\}/g)].map(m=>m[1]).sort();
const TYPES=['macro_regime','macro_regime_asset_pair','recommendation_call','industry_lifecycle_stage','industry_prosperity','valuation_verdict','thesis_win_rate','return_range','sellside_rating','sellside_target_price','synthetic_fact_metric'];
const DYNAMIC=[
 ...TYPES.map(t=>`ui.type.${t}`),...['all','probability','categorical','score','interval'].map(k=>`ui.kind.${k}`),...['all','macro','industry','company','private'].map(d=>`ui.domain.${d}`),
 ...['draft','active','retired'].map(s=>`ui.status.${s}`),...['low','mid','high'].map(b=>`ui.band.${b}`),...['recovery','overheat','stagflation','recession'].map(c=>`ui.classes.${c}`),
 ...['abstained','open','settled','void','withdrawn','pending_fill','hit','miss'].map(l=>`ui.lifecycle.${l}`),
 ...['financial_fact','financial_metric','macro_observation','macro_snapshot','price_bar','table_rows','judgment','legacy_fill','document_span'].map(k=>`ui.inputKind.${k}`),
 ...['void','withdrawn','reopened'].flatMap(k=>[`ui.card.reason.${k}`,`ui.timeline.${k}`]),
 ...['due','backoff','leased','all'].map(f=>`ui.admin.filters.${f}`),...['pending','unavailable','inconsistent','error'].map(s=>`ui.admin.lastStatus.${s}`),
 ...['not_due','leased','closed'].map(s=>`ui.admin.settleDisabled.${s}`),...['settle','withdraw','reopen','withdrawTitle','reopenTitle'].map(s=>`ui.admin.${s}`),
];

describe('judgment UI source guards (Task 21)',()=>{
 it('every <button> declares its type first; no click handlers on non-interactive elements',()=>{
  for(const f of FILES){

   expect({f,untyped:(s.match(/<button(?!\s+type=)/g)??[]).length}).toEqual({f,untyped:0});
   expect({f,clickable:/<(div|span|li|tr|td|section|article|p|ul|ol|dl)\b[^>]*\bonClick=/.test(s)}).toEqual({f,clickable:false});
  }
 });
 it('dialogs are modal and labelled; svgs are images with labels or hidden; tables have captions and scoped headers',()=>{

   const s=src(f);
   for(const m of s.match(/<section role="dialog"[^>]*>/g)??[])expect({f,m,ok:/aria-modal="true"/.test(m)&&/aria-labelledby=/.test(m)}).toEqual({f,m,ok:true});
   for(const m of s.match(/<svg\b[^>]*>/g)??[])expect({f,m,ok:/role="img"[^>]*aria-label=|aria-hidden="true"/.test(m)}).toEqual({f,m,ok:true});
   expect({f,tables:(s.match(/<table\b/g)??[]).length,captions:(s.match(/<caption\b/g)??[]).length}).toEqual({f,tables:(s.match(/<table\b/g)??[]).length,captions:(s.match(/<table\b/g)??[]).length});
   expect({f,unscoped:(s.match(/<th(?![^>]*scope=)[ >]/g)??[]).length}).toEqual({f,unscoped:0});
  }
 });
 it('no gradients, no purple / violet / indigo; brass (accent) classes only in view-model.ts',()=>{

 it("'use client' exactly where hooks or handlers are used; the admin page is a gated, dynamic server component",()=>{

 });
 it('every ui.* key used (literal and enumerated dynamic) exists in zh and en; the ui subtree is in parity with matching placeholders',()=>{

  for(const k of [...literal,...DYNAMIC])expect({k,zh:typeof get(zh,k),en:typeof get(en,k)}).toEqual({k,zh:'string',en:'string'});
  expect(keys(zh.ui).sort()).toEqual(keys(en.ui).sort());
```

```tsx
// Method-level calibration badge (spec §9.1, §9.3; canvas legend). Brass only for 'calibrated'; every other state is neutral grey.
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { CalibrationState, JudgmentCard } from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import { badgeClass, calibrationMsg } from './view-model';

export function CalibrationBadge({ state, summary = null, className = '' }: { state: CalibrationState; summary?: JudgmentCard['calibration_summary']; className?: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const m = calibrationMsg(state, summary);
  return (
    <span data-calibration={state} className={`inline-flex items-center rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] leading-tight ${badgeClass(state)} ${className}`}>

    </span>
  );
```

```tsx
// Settlement timeline (spec §9.5, canvas board 3): registered → target → settled / void / withdrawn / reopened → pending.
// Evidence is append-only, so every settlement row is a step; the old rows of a reopened judgment stay visible.
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { JudgmentCard, SettlementRow } from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import { TONE, minute, timelineSteps } from './view-model';

export function SettlementTimeline({ card, settlements }: { card: JudgmentCard; settlements?: SettlementRow[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const steps = timelineSteps(card, settlements, locale);
  return (
    <ol className="space-y-3" aria-label={t('ui.timeline.title')}>
      {steps.map((s, i) => (
        <li key={`${s.key}:${i}`} className="flex gap-3">
          <span aria-hidden="true" className={`mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full ${s.done ? 'bg-[var(--text-dim)]' : 'border border-[var(--border)]'}`} />
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
              <strong className={`text-sm ${s.tone === 'neutral' ? '' : TONE[s.tone]}`}>{t(s.key)}</strong>
              {s.at && <time className="num text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]" dateTime={s.at}>{minute(s.at)}</time>}
            </div>
            {s.detail && <p className="break-words text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{s.detail}</p>}
          </div>
        </li>
      ))}
      <li className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.timeline.asKnownNote')}</li>
    </ol>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// Reliability bins (spec §8.1, §9.5; canvas boards 4b and 7): the table is always rendered (table equivalent of the chart);
// the chart is opt-in through a real toggle, so narrow screens show the table first (canvas: "< 640px 先显示分箱表").
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { ReliabilityBin } from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import { fmt, num, reliabilityPoints, reliabilityRows, segmentClass, signed } from './view-model';

function ReliabilityChart({ bins, label }: { bins: ReliabilityBin[]; label: string }) {
  const pts = reliabilityPoints(bins);
  const max = Math.max(1, ...pts.map((p) => p.n));
  const x = (v: number) => 20 + v * 170;
  const y = (v: number) => 190 - v * 170;
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" className="h-56 w-56" role="img" aria-label={label}>
      <rect x="20" y="20" width="170" height="170" fill="none" stroke="var(--border)" />
      <line x1={x(0)} y1={y(0)} x2={x(1)} y2={y(1)} stroke="var(--text-muted)" strokeDasharray="3 3" />
      {pts.map((p, i) => <circle key={i} cx={x(p.x)} cy={y(p.y)} r={2 + 4 * Math.sqrt(p.n / max)} fill="var(--text-dim)" />)}
      <text x="20" y="200" fontSize="8" fill="var(--text-muted)">0</text>
      <text x="184" y="200" fontSize="8" fill="var(--text-muted)">1</text>
    </svg>
  );
}

export function ReliabilityTable({ bins, metrics }: { bins: ReliabilityBin[]; metrics?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const [chart, setChart] = useState(false);
  const headingId = useId();
  const rows = reliabilityRows(bins);
  const th = 'px-2 py-1 font-normal';
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 id={headingId} className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('ui.reliability.title')}</h3>
        <div role="group" aria-label={t('ui.reliability.view')} className="flex overflow-hidden rounded border border-[var(--border)] text-xs">
          <button type="button" aria-pressed={!chart} className={`px-2 py-1 ${segmentClass(!chart)}`} onClick={() => setChart(false)}>{t('ui.reliability.tableOnly')}</button>
          <button type="button" aria-pressed={chart} className={`px-2 py-1 ${segmentClass(chart)}`} onClick={() => setChart(true)}>{t('ui.reliability.chartAndTable')}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {chart && <ReliabilityChart bins={bins} label={t('ui.reliability.chartLabel', { bins: rows.length })} />}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="num w-full min-w-[420px] text-left text-xs">
          <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.reliability.caption')}</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.reliability.columns.bin')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.reliability.columns.n')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.reliability.columns.meanP')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.reliability.columns.hitRate')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.reliability.columns.wilson')}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r) => (
              <tr key={r.range} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                <td className="px-2 py-1">{r.range}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{r.n}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{r.meanP}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{r.hitRate}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{r.wilson}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {metrics && (
        <p className="num text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">
          {t('ui.reliability.summary', { brier: fmt(num(metrics, 'brier'), 3), skill: signed(num(metrics, 'brier_skill')), ece: fmt(num(metrics, 'ece_raw_holdout'), 3) })}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// Inputs drawer (spec §9.5, canvas boards 2 and 7 "M-Drawer"): a modal dialog — right-hand drawer from 640px, bottom sheet
// below — with two tabs: frozen inputs (+ the registered value, shown only here) and the settlement timeline. Public cards
// load GET /api/judgments/[id] for the full settlement history and the claim; private cards use the card alone.
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { JudgmentCard } from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import type { JudgmentDetailResponse } from './api-types';
import { SettlementTimeline } from './SettlementTimeline';
import { LINK, inputRows, minute, registeredValue, segmentClass, type AnyCard } from './view-model';

export type DrawerTab = 'inputs' | 'timeline';

export function InputsDrawer({ card, initialTab = 'inputs', onClose }: { card: AnyCard; initialTab?: DrawerTab; onClose: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<DrawerTab>(initialTab);
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<JudgmentDetailResponse | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  const tabId = useId();
  const isPrivate = card.source === 'recommendation';

  useEffect(() => {
    closeRef.current?.focus();
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPrivate) return;
    let alive = true;
    fetch(`/api/judgments/${encodeURIComponent(card.judgment_id)}`)
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? (r.json() as Promise<JudgmentDetailResponse>) : Promise.reject(new Error(`http ${r.status}`))))
      .then((j) => { if (alive) setDetail(j); })
      .catch(() => { if (alive) setFailed(true); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [card.judgment_id, isPrivate]);

  const rows = inputRows(card as JudgmentCard);
  const registered = registeredValue(card as JudgmentCard, detail?.judgment ?? null);
  const th = 'px-2 py-1 font-normal';
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end justify-end sm:items-stretch">
      <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} aria-label={t('ui.drawer.close')} className="absolute inset-0 cursor-default bg-black/50" onClick={onClose} />
      <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} className="relative z-10 flex max-h-[85vh] w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-t-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] sm:h-full sm:max-h-none sm:w-[600px] sm:rounded-none">
        <header className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-[var(--border)] p-4">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h2 id={titleId} className="text-base font-semibold">{card.display.headline[locale]}</h2>
            <p className="num mt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{card.methodology.id}@{card.methodology.version} · {card.judgment_id.slice(0, 8)}… · {t('ui.drawer.registeredAt', { at: minute(card.registered_at) })}</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" ref={closeRef} aria-label={t('ui.drawer.close')} className="rounded p-1 text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)]" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
        </header>
        <div role="tablist" aria-label={t('ui.drawer.tabs')} className="flex gap-1 border-b border-[var(--border)] px-4 text-sm">
          <button type="button" role="tab" id={`${tabId}-inputs`} aria-selected={tab === 'inputs'} aria-controls={`${tabId}-inputs-panel`} className={`px-3 py-2 ${segmentClass(tab === 'inputs')}`} onClick={() => setTab('inputs')}>{t('ui.card.inputs', { count: rows.length })}</button>
          <button type="button" role="tab" id={`${tabId}-timeline`} aria-selected={tab === 'timeline'} aria-controls={`${tabId}-timeline-panel`} className={`px-3 py-2 ${segmentClass(tab === 'timeline')}`} onClick={() => setTab('timeline')}>{t('ui.card.timeline')}</button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          {tab === 'inputs' ? (
            <div role="tabpanel" id={`${tabId}-inputs-panel`} aria-labelledby={`${tabId}-inputs`} className="space-y-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.drawer.frozenNote')}</p>
              {rows.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.drawer.noInputs')}</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[480px] text-left text-xs">
                    <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.drawer.caption')}</caption>
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">
                        <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.drawer.columns.kind')}</th>
                        <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.drawer.columns.ref')}</th>
                        <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.drawer.columns.availableAt')}</th>
                        <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.drawer.columns.origin')}</th>
                        <th scope="col" className={th}><span className="sr-only">{t('ui.drawer.columns.source')}</span></th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {rows.map((r) => (
                        <tr key={r.key} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                          <td className="px-2 py-1 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(`ui.inputKind.${r.kind}`)}</td>
                          <td className="num break-all px-2 py-1">{r.ref}</td>
                          <td className="num px-2 py-1 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{r.date}</td>
                          <td className="px-2 py-1">{r.origin}</td>
                          <td className="px-2 py-1">{r.href ? <a className={LINK} href={r.href}>{t('ui.drawer.source')}</a> : <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)]">—</span>}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
              {registered?.type === 'p' && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] p-3">
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.drawer.registeredValue')}</div>
                  <div className="num mt-1 text-sm">p = {registered.text}</div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.drawer.registeredNote')}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {registered?.type === 'scores' && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] p-3">
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.drawer.scores')}</div>
                  <table className="num mt-1 text-xs">
                    <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.drawer.scores')}</caption>
                    <tbody>
                      {registered.rows.map((r) => (
                        <tr key={r.cls}><th scope="row" className="pr-3 text-left font-normal text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t.has(`ui.classes.${r.cls}`) ? t(`ui.classes.${r.cls}`) : r.cls}</th><td className="text-right">{r.score}</td></tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.drawer.scoresNote')}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {failed && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.drawer.detailUnavailable')}</p>}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div role="tabpanel" id={`${tabId}-timeline-panel`} aria-labelledby={`${tabId}-timeline`}>
              <SettlementTimeline card={card as JudgmentCard} settlements={detail?.settlements} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// Judgment card (spec §9.2–§9.3, §9.5; canvas boards 1, 1b and 7). Below 640px it starts collapsed: one real button with the
// headline, type, calibration and value; tapping expands the full card. Percent appears only for probability × calibrated
// (visiblePercent); uncalibrated probabilities show a tercile band; categorical scores never show %. Brass only on the
// calibrated badge (CalibrationBadge); hit / miss use --up / --down.
import { useCallback, useId, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { CalibrationBadge } from './CalibrationBadge';
import { InputsDrawer, type DrawerTab } from './InputsDrawer';
import { LINK, TONE, cardBody, collapsedView, footerView, lifecycleView, type AnyCard, type CardBody } from './view-model';

const BANDS = ['low', 'mid', 'high'] as const;

function Body({ body, href }: { body: CardBody; href: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  switch (body.type) {
    case 'percent':
      return (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="num text-[32px] font-medium leading-none">{body.text}</div>
          {body.hitRate && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(body.hitRate.key, body.hitRate.values)} · <Link className={LINK} href={href}>{t('ui.card.reliabilityLink')}</Link></p>}
        </div>
      );
    case 'band':
      return (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.card.confidence')}</span>
            <span className="text-[22px] font-semibold">{body.band ? t(`ui.band.${body.band}`) : '—'}</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(body.note.key, body.note.values)}</span>
          </div>
          <div role="img" aria-label={t('ui.card.bandAria', { band: body.band ? t(`ui.band.${body.band}`) : '—' })} className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-[3px]">
            {BANDS.map((b) => <span key={b} className={`h-1.5 rounded ${b === body.band ? 'bg-[var(--text-dim)]' : 'bg-[var(--border)]'}`} />)}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    case 'category':
      return body.realized !== null ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <div><div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.card.selected')}</div><div className="text-lg font-semibold">{t.has(`ui.classes.${body.selected}`) ? t(`ui.classes.${body.selected}`) : body.selected}</div></div>
          <div><div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.card.realized')}</div><div className="text-lg font-semibold">{t.has(`ui.classes.${body.realized}`) ? t(`ui.classes.${body.realized}`) : body.realized}</div></div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2"><span className="text-[22px] font-semibold">{t.has(`ui.classes.${body.selected}`) ? t(`ui.classes.${body.selected}`) : body.selected}</span><span className="num text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{body.selected}</span></div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{body.accuracy ? t(body.accuracy.key, body.accuracy.values) : t('ui.card.scoresInDrawer')}</p>
        </div>
      );
    case 'score':
      return (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2"><span className="num text-[28px] font-medium">{body.value}</span><span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">/ {body.scale}</span><span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(body.evaluation.key, body.evaluation.values)}</span></div>
          <ul className="space-y-1" aria-label={t('ui.card.dims')}>
            {body.dims.map((d) => (
              <li key={d.id} className="grid grid-cols-[6rem_1fr_2.5rem] items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
                <span className="truncate text-[var(--text-dim)]">{d.label}</span>
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="h-1.5 rounded bg-[var(--border)]"><span className="block h-1.5 rounded bg-[var(--text-dim)]" style={{ width: `${d.width}%` }} /></span>
                <span className="num text-right">{d.missing ? t('ui.card.dimMissing') : d.value}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      );
    case 'interval':
      return (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2"><span className="num text-[22px] font-medium">{body.range}</span>{body.realized !== null && <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.card.realizedValue', { value: body.realized })}</span>}</div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{body.coverage ? t(body.coverage.key, body.coverage.values) : t('ui.card.nominalCoverage', { nominal: body.nominal ?? '—' })}</p>
        </div>
      );
    case 'abstained':
      return (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-dashed border-[var(--border)] p-3 text-sm">
          <p>{t('ui.card.abstained', { reason: body.reason })}</p>
          {body.missing.length > 0 && <p className="num mt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.card.missing', { items: body.missing.join(', ') })}</p>}
        </div>
      );
  }
}

export function JudgmentCard({ card }: { card: AnyCard }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [drawer, setDrawer] = useState<DrawerTab | null>(null);
  const bodyId = useId();
  const closeDrawer = useCallback(() => setDrawer(null), []);
  const life = lifecycleView(card);
  const collapsed = collapsedView(card, locale);
  const foot = footerView(card, locale);
  const s = card.settlement;
  return (
    <article className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)]" aria-label={card.display.headline[locale]}>
      <button type="button" className="flex w-full items-center gap-3 p-3 text-left sm:hidden" aria-expanded={open} aria-controls={bodyId} onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold">{collapsed.title}</span>
          <span className="block truncate text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(collapsed.type.key)} · {t(collapsed.calibration.key, collapsed.calibration.values)}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="num shrink-0 text-base">{collapsed.percent ?? (collapsed.band ? t(`ui.band.${collapsed.band}`) : t(collapsed.lifecycle.key))}</span>
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{open ? '▴' : '▾'}</span>
      </button>
      <div id={bodyId} className={`${open ? 'flex' : 'hidden'} flex-col gap-3 p-4 sm:flex`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">
          <span>{t(`ui.type.${card.judgment_type}`)}</span>
          <span className="num rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5">{card.subject.key}</span>
          {card.retrospective && <span className="rounded border border-dashed border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5">{t('ui.card.retrospective')}</span>}
          {card.merged_from && <span>{t('ui.card.mergedFrom', { key: card.merged_from })}</span>}
          {card.source === 'recommendation' && <span>{t('ui.card.private')}</span>}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] ${TONE[life.tone]}`}>{t(life.msg.key)}</span>
          <CalibrationBadge state={card.calibration} summary={card.calibration_summary} />
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-base font-semibold">{card.display.headline[locale]}</h3>
        <Body body={cardBody(card, locale)} href={card.methodology.href} />
        {s && s.kind === 'settled' && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.card.result', { outcome: t(life.msg.key), value: s.realized ? String(s.realized.label ?? s.realized.value) : '—' })}</p>}
        {s && s.kind !== 'settled' && <p className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] p-2 text-xs">{t(`ui.card.reason.${s.kind}`, { reason: s.evidence_summary[locale] })}</p>}
        <p className="border-t border-[var(--border)] pt-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">
          {t('ui.card.method')} <Link className={`num ${LINK}`} href={card.methodology.href}>{foot.method}</Link>
          {' · '}{t('ui.card.asOf', { date: foot.asOf })}
          {foot.condition && <>{' · '}{t('ui.card.condition', { text: foot.condition })}</>}
          {foot.target && <>{' · '}{t('ui.card.target', { target: foot.target })}</>}
          {' · '}{t('ui.card.settlement', { state: t(life.msg.key) })}
        </p>
        {card.lifecycle !== 'abstained' && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button type="button" className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)]" onClick={() => setDrawer('inputs')}>{t('ui.card.inputs', { count: card.inputs.length })}</button>
            <button type="button" className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)]" onClick={() => setDrawer('timeline')}>{t('ui.card.timeline')}</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {drawer && <InputsDrawer card={card} initialTab={drawer} onClose={closeDrawer} />}
    </article>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// /intel/methods — methodology registry (spec §9.5, canvas board 4a). Lists every synced method with its latest valid
// scope='all' calibration (Task 18 GET /api/methodologies) plus the read-only private adapter recommendation_call@v1, which
// is not a registry row (spec §11.2). Filters are real buttons with aria-pressed; brass only on the selected filter.
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { Kind } from '@/lib/judgments/types';
import { CalibrationBadge } from '@/components/judgments/CalibrationBadge';
import type { MethodologiesResponse } from '@/components/judgments/api-types';
import { DOMAINS, KINDS, LINK, fmt, methodRows, segmentClass, type Domain } from '@/components/judgments/view-model';

export default function MethodsPage() {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const [data, setData] = useState<MethodologiesResponse | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<Kind | 'all'>('all');
  const [domain, setDomain] = useState<Domain>('all');

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetch('/api/methodologies')
      .then(async (r) => {
        const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error((j as { error?: { code?: string } }).error?.code ?? `http ${r.status}`);
        return j as MethodologiesResponse;
      })
      .then((j) => { if (alive) setData(j); })
      .catch((e) => { if (alive) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, []);

  const rows = data ? methodRows(data.methodologies, kind, domain) : [];
  const showAdapter = domain === 'all' && (kind === 'all' || kind === 'probability');
  const th = 'whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1.5 font-medium';
  const td = 'whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1.5';
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 p-4">
      <nav aria-label={t('ui.nav.breadcrumb')} className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]"><Link className={LINK} href="/intel">{t('ui.nav.intel')}</Link> / {t('ui.nav.methods')}</nav>
      <header>
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold">{t('ui.methods.title')}</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.methods.subtitle')}</p>
      </header>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div role="group" aria-label={t('ui.methods.filterDomain')} className="flex overflow-hidden rounded border border-[var(--border)] text-xs">
          {DOMAINS.map((d) => <button type="button" key={d} aria-pressed={domain === d} className={`px-2.5 py-1 ${segmentClass(domain === d)}`} onClick={() => setDomain(d)}>{t(`ui.domain.${d}`)}</button>)}
        </div>
        <div role="group" aria-label={t('ui.methods.filterKind')} className="flex overflow-hidden rounded border border-[var(--border)] text-xs">
          {KINDS.map((k) => <button type="button" key={k} aria-pressed={kind === k} className={`px-2.5 py-1 ${segmentClass(kind === k)}`} onClick={() => setKind(k)}>{t(`ui.kind.${k}`)}</button>)}
        </div>
      </div>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{t('ui.common.error', { message: error })}</p>}
      {!data && !error && <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.common.loading')}</p>}
      {data && (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-[var(--border)]">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[880px] text-left text-xs">
            <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.methods.caption')}</caption>
            <thead className="bg-[var(--bg-card)] text-[var(--text-dim)]">
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.method')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.version')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.kind')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.subject')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.status')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.calibration')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.methods.columns.samples')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.methods.columns.brier')}</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.methods.columns.validUntil')}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border)]">
              {rows.map((r) => (
                <tr key={`${r.id}@${r.version}`}>
                  <td className={td}><Link className={LINK} href={r.href}>{r.title[locale]}</Link> <span className="num text-[var(--text-muted)]">{r.id}</span></td>
                  <td className={`${td} num`}>{r.version}</td>
                  <td className={td}>{t(`ui.kind.${r.kind}`)}</td>
                  <td className={td}>{t(`ui.domain.${r.domain}`)}</td>
                  <td className={td}>{t(`ui.status.${r.status}`)} · {r.publishable ? t('ui.methods.publishable') : t('ui.methods.unpublished')}</td>
                  <td className={td}><CalibrationBadge state={r.state} /></td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-right`}>{r.kind === 'score' ? r.nIndependent : `${r.nIndependent} / ${r.thresholdN}`}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-right`}>{fmt(r.brier, 3)}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-[var(--text-dim)]`}>{r.validUntil ?? '—'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {showAdapter && (
                <tr>
                  <td className={td}><Link className={LINK} href="/analyst">{t('ui.methods.adapterTitle')}</Link> <span className="num text-[var(--text-muted)]">recommendation_call</span></td>
                  <td className={`${td} num`}>v1</td>
                  <td className={td}>{t('ui.kind.probability')}</td>
                  <td className={td}>{t('ui.domain.private')}</td>
                  <td className={td}>{t('ui.methods.adapterStatus')}</td>
                  <td className={td}><CalibrationBadge state="self_assessed" /></td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-right`}>—</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-right`}>—</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-[var(--text-dim)]`}>—</td>
                </tr>
              )}
              {rows.length === 0 && !showAdapter && <tr><td colSpan={9} className="px-2 py-3 text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.methods.empty')}</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.methods.note')}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
