`src/app/(app)/intel/methods/[id]/[version]/page.tsx`：

```tsx
'use client';

// /intel/methods/[id]/[version] — method detail (spec §9.5, canvas board 4b): the two gates (enough samples, calibration
// passes) and validity, reliability bins (+ optional chart), confusion matrix, holdout validation, formula document, params,
// versions and recent settlements. Every chart has a table equivalent; brass only on the calibrated badge and selected states.
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { CalibrationBadge } from '@/components/judgments/CalibrationBadge';
import { ReliabilityTable } from '@/components/judgments/ReliabilityTable';
import type { CalibrationResponse, MethodologiesResponse, MethodologyDetailResponse } from '@/components/judgments/api-types';
import { LINK, TONE, confusionView, day, gatesView, holdoutRows, methodHref, methodState, segmentClass } from '@/components/judgments/view-model';

interface Loaded { detail: MethodologyDetailResponse; calibration: CalibrationResponse; versions: MethodologiesResponse['methodologies'] }

async function getJson<T>(url: string): Promise<T> {
  const r = await fetch(url);
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error((j as { error?: { code?: string } }).error?.code ?? `http ${r.status}`);
  return j as T;
}

function Gate({ title, ok, children }: { title: string; ok: boolean | null; children: ReactNode }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] p-3">
      <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{title}</div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
        <span className={ok === null ? 'text-[var(--text-muted)]' : ok ? 'text-[var(--text)]' : 'text-[var(--danger)]'}>{ok === null ? t('ui.method.gateNa') : ok ? t('ui.method.gatePass') : t('ui.method.gateFail')}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="num mt-1 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function MethodDetailPage() {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const { id, version } = useParams<{ id: string; version: string }>();
  const [data, setData] = useState<Loaded | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const base = `/api/methodologies/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${encodeURIComponent(version)}`;
    Promise.all([
      getJson<MethodologyDetailResponse>(base),
      getJson<CalibrationResponse>(`${base}/calibration?scope_type=all`),
      getJson<MethodologiesResponse>('/api/methodologies'),
    ])
      .then(([detail, calibration, list]) => { if (alive) setData({ detail, calibration, versions: list.methodologies.filter((m) => m.methodology.methodology_id === id) }); })
      .catch((e) => { if (alive) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)); });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [id, version]);

  if (error) return <p role="alert" className="p-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{error === 'unknown_methodology' ? t('ui.method.unknown') : t('ui.common.error', { message: error })}</p>;
  if (!data) return <p className="p-4 text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.common.loading')}</p>;

  const { row, doc_markdown, recent_settlements } = data.detail;
  const cal = data.calibration.calibration;
  const state = methodState(cal ? { state: cal.state, valid: data.calibration.valid } : null);
  const gates = gatesView(cal, data.calibration.valid);
  const confusion = row.kind === 'categorical' ? confusionView(cal) : null;
  const split = holdoutRows(cal);
  const th = 'px-2 py-1 font-normal';
  const classLabel = (c: string) => (t.has(`ui.classes.${c}`) ? t(`ui.classes.${c}`) : c);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 p-4">
      <nav aria-label={t('ui.nav.breadcrumb')} className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">
        <Link className={LINK} href="/intel">{t('ui.nav.intel')}</Link> / <Link className={LINK} href="/intel/methods">{t('ui.nav.methods')}</Link> / <span className="num">{row.methodology_id} / {row.version}</span>
      </nav>
      <header className="space-y-2">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold">{locale === 'en' ? row.title_en : row.title_zh} <span className="num text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{row.methodology_id}@{row.version}</span></h1>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
          <span className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(`ui.kind.${row.kind}`)}</span>
          <span className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.method.producer', { kind: row.producer_kind })}</span>
          <span className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(`ui.status.${row.status}`)} · {row.publishable ? t('ui.methods.publishable') : t('ui.methods.unpublished')}</span>
          <CalibrationBadge state={state} />
        </div>
      </header>

      {gates ? (
        <section aria-label={t('ui.method.gates')} className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Gate title={t('ui.method.gateSample')} ok={gates.sample.ok}>{t('ui.method.gateSampleDetail', { n: gates.sample.n, threshold: gates.sample.threshold, total: gates.sample.total })}</Gate>
          <Gate title={t('ui.method.gateCalibration')} ok={gates.calibration.ok}>{t(gates.calibration.metric.key, gates.calibration.metric.values)}</Gate>
          <Gate title={t('ui.method.validity')} ok={gates.validity.valid}>{t('ui.method.validityDetail', { until: gates.validity.validUntil, computed: gates.validity.computedAt, revision: gates.validity.revision })}</Gate>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <p className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] p-3 text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.method.noCalibration')}</p>
      )}

      {cal && row.kind === 'probability' && <ReliabilityTable bins={cal.reliability} metrics={cal.metrics} />}

      {confusion && (
        <section className="space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('ui.method.confusion')}</h2>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="num text-xs">
              <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.method.confusionCaption')}</caption>
              <thead><tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]"><th scope="col" className={th}><span className="sr-only">{t('ui.method.confusionCorner')}</span></th>{confusion.classes.map((c) => <th key={c} scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{classLabel(c)}</th>)}</tr></thead>
              <tbody>
                {confusion.rows.map((r) => (
                  <tr key={r.cls} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                    <th scope="row" className={`${th} text-left`}>{classLabel(r.cls)}</th>
                    {r.cells.map((c, i) => <td key={i} className={`px-2 py-1 text-right ${c.diagonal ? 'font-semibold text-[var(--text)]' : 'text-[var(--text-dim)]'}`}>{c.n}</td>)}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      )}

      {split.length > 0 && (
        <section className="space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('ui.method.temporal')}</h2>
          <table className="num text-xs">
            <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.method.temporal')}</caption>
            <thead><tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]"><th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.method.splitColumns.segment')}</th><th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>n</th><th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>Brier</th><th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.method.splitColumns.skill')}</th><th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>ECE</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{split.map((s) => <tr key={s.key} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]"><th scope="row" className={`${th} text-left`}>{t(s.key)}</th><td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{s.n}</td><td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{s.brier}</td><td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{s.skill}</td><td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{s.ece}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('ui.method.doc')}</h2>
          <pre className="max-h-[480px] overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)] p-3 font-sans text-xs leading-relaxed">{doc_markdown ?? '—'}</pre>
          <table className="num text-xs">
            <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.method.params')}</caption>
            <thead><tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]"><th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.method.paramColumns.name')}</th><th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.method.paramColumns.value')}</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{Object.entries(row.params).map(([k, v]) => <tr key={k} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]"><th scope="row" className={`${th} text-left`}>{k}</th><td className="px-2 py-1 text-right">{String(v)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <section className="space-y-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('ui.method.versions')}</h2>
            <ul className="space-y-1 text-xs">
              {data.versions.map((v) => {
                const current = v.methodology.version === row.version;
                return (
                  <li key={v.methodology.version}>
                    <Link href={methodHref(v.methodology.methodology_id, v.methodology.version)} aria-current={current ? 'page' : undefined} className={`flex justify-between rounded px-2 py-1 ${segmentClass(current)}`}>
                      <span className="num">{v.methodology.version}</span><span>{t(`ui.status.${v.methodology.status}`)} · {day(v.methodology.created_at)}</span>
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </section>
          <section className="space-y-2">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('ui.method.recent')}</h2>
            {recent_settlements.length === 0 ? <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.method.noSettlements')}</p> : (
              <table className="text-xs">
                <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.method.recent')}</caption>
                <tbody>
                  {recent_settlements.map((s) => (
                    <tr key={s.settlement_id} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                      <td className="num px-2 py-1 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{day(s.settled_at)}</td>
                      <td className="px-2 py-1">{s.subject_key} · <span className="num">{s.judgment_id.slice(0, 8)}…</span></td>
                      <td className={`px-2 py-1 ${s.outcome === 'hit' ? TONE.up : s.outcome === 'miss' ? TONE.down : TONE.neutral}`}>{s.kind === 'settled' && s.outcome ? t(`ui.lifecycle.${s.outcome}`) : t(`ui.lifecycle.${s.kind === 'reopened' ? 'open' : s.kind}`)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`src/app/(app)/admin/judgments/page.tsx`（与 `src/app/(app)/admin/dq/page.tsx` 同一门禁写法）：

```tsx
// /admin/judgments (spec §9.5, canvas board 5): requireAdminUser gate (same pattern as /admin/dq); the queue client does the rest.
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { AdminForbidden, AdminUnauthenticated, requireAdminUser } from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import { AdminJudgmentsClient } from './AdminJudgmentsClient';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function AdminJudgmentsPage() {
  try {
    await requireAdminUser();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AdminForbidden) {
      const t = await getTranslations('judgments');
      return (
        <section className="border-y border-border py-8">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('ui.admin.deniedTitle')}</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-text-dim">{t('ui.admin.deniedBody')}</p>
        </section>
      );
    }
    if (error instanceof AdminUnauthenticated) redirect('/login?next=%2Fadmin%2Fjudgments');
    throw error;
  }
  return <AdminJudgmentsClient />;
}
```

`src/app/(app)/admin/judgments/AdminJudgmentsClient.tsx`：

```tsx
'use client';

// /admin/judgments client (spec §9.5, §10; canvas board 5): settle queue (due / backoff / leased / all) from
// GET /api/admin/judgments/queue, actions POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/{settle,withdraw,reopen} with {reason}. Withdraw and
// reopen require a reason in an accessible dialog; every action is audited server-side (research_audit_log). Quarantine
// items live in /admin/dq.
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { AdminActionResponse, QueueItem, QueueResponse } from '@/components/judgments/api-types';
import { LINK, minute, queueActions, segmentClass, targetText } from '@/components/judgments/view-model';

type Filter = 'due' | 'backoff' | 'leased' | 'all';
const FILTERS: Filter[] = ['due', 'backoff', 'leased', 'all'];
type Pending = { action: 'withdraw' | 'reopen'; item: QueueItem };

async function post(id: string, action: 'settle' | 'withdraw' | 'reopen', reason: string): Promise<AdminActionResponse> {
  // Task 18 adminBody: {reason (1..500 chars, required for withdraw / reopen, optional for settle → null), request_id (uuid; idempotency key)}
  const r = await fetch(`/api/admin/judgments/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/${action}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason.trim() || null, request_id: crypto.randomUUID() }) });
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error((j as { error?: { code?: string } }).error?.code ?? `http ${r.status}`);
  return j as AdminActionResponse;
}

function ReasonDialog({ pending, onCancel, onSubmit, busy }: { pending: Pending; onCancel: () => void; onSubmit: (reason: string) => void; busy: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const titleId = useId();
  const fieldId = useId();
  const fieldRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    fieldRef.current?.focus();
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') onCancel(); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [onCancel]);
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <button type="button" tabIndex={-1} aria-label={t('ui.admin.cancel')} className="absolute inset-0 cursor-default bg-black/50" onClick={onCancel} />
      <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-md space-y-3 rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] p-4">
        <h2 id={titleId} className="text-base font-semibold">{t(`ui.admin.${pending.action}Title`)}</h2>
        <p className="num text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{pending.item.judgment_id.slice(0, 8)}… · {pending.item.judgment?.subject_key ?? '—'} · {pending.item.judgment ? `${pending.item.judgment.methodology_id}@${pending.item.judgment.methodology_version}` : '—'}</p>
        <form className="space-y-3" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (reason.trim()) onSubmit(reason.trim()); }}>
          <label htmlFor={fieldId} className="block text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.admin.reasonLabel')}</label>
          <textarea id={fieldId} ref={fieldRef} required value={reason} onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)} rows={3} className="w-full rounded border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)] p-2 text-sm" />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.admin.appendOnlyNote')}</p>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <button type="button" className="rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)]" onClick={onCancel}>{t('ui.admin.cancel')}</button>
            <button type="submit" disabled={busy || !reason.trim()} className="rounded border border-[var(--down)] px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-[var(--down)] disabled:opacity-50">{t(`ui.admin.${pending.action}`)}</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

export function AdminJudgmentsClient() {
  const t = useTranslations('judgments');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('due');
  const [data, setData] = useState<QueueResponse | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<Pending | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async (f: Filter) => {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/admin/judgments/queue?filter=${f}&limit=50`);
      const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error((j as { error?: { code?: string } }).error?.code ?? `http ${r.status}`);
      setData(j as QueueResponse); setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { void load(filter); }, [load, filter]);

  async function run(item: QueueItem, action: 'settle' | 'withdraw' | 'reopen', reason: string) {
    setBusy(item.judgment_id); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const res = await post(item.judgment_id, action, reason);
      setNotice(t('ui.admin.done', { action: t(`ui.admin.${action}`), status: res.outcome }));
      setPending(null);
      await load(filter);
    } catch (e) {
      setNotice(t('ui.common.error', { message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }));
    } finally { setBusy(null); }
  }
  const cancel = useCallback(() => setPending(null), []);

  const th = 'whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1.5 font-medium';
  const td = 'whitespace-nowrap px-2 py-1.5';
  const now = data?.now ?? new Date().toISOString();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('ui.admin.title')}</h1>
      <section aria-label={t('ui.admin.summary')} className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
        {(['due', 'backoff', 'leased'] as const).map((k) => (
          <div key={k} className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] p-3">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t(`ui.admin.filters.${k}`)}</div>
            <div className="num mt-1 text-xl font-semibold">{data ? data.counts[k] : '—'}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] p-3">
          <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('ui.admin.quarantine')}</div>
          <Link className={`mt-1 inline-block text-sm ${LINK}`} href="/admin/dq">{t('ui.admin.quarantineLink')}</Link>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div role="group" aria-label={t('ui.admin.filterLabel')} className="inline-flex overflow-hidden rounded border border-[var(--border)] text-xs">
        {FILTERS.map((f) => <button type="button" key={f} aria-pressed={filter === f} className={`px-2.5 py-1 ${segmentClass(filter === f)}`} onClick={() => setFilter(f)}>{t(`ui.admin.filters.${f}`)}</button>)}
      </div>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-[var(--danger)]">{t('ui.common.error', { message: error })}</p>}
      {notice && <p role="status" className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{notice}</p>}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-[var(--border)]">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[960px] text-left text-xs">
          <caption className="sr-only">{t('ui.admin.caption')}</caption>
          <thead className="bg-[var(--bg-card)] text-[var(--text-dim)]">
            <tr>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.judgment')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.method')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.target')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.window')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={`${th} text-right`}>{t('ui.admin.columns.attempts')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.next')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.status')}</th>
              <th scope="col" className={th}>{t('ui.admin.columns.actions')}</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--border)]">
            {(data?.rows ?? []).map((q) => {
              const a = queueActions(q, now);
              const rowBusy = busy === q.judgment_id;
              return (
                <tr key={q.judgment_id}>
                  <td className={`${td} num`}>{q.judgment_id.slice(0, 8)}… {q.judgment?.subject_key ?? ''}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num`}>{q.judgment ? `${q.judgment.methodology_id}@${q.judgment.methodology_version}` : '—'}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-[var(--text-dim)]`}>{q.judgment?.target ? targetText(q.judgment.target) : '—'}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-[var(--text-dim)]`}>{minute(q.settle_after)} / {minute(q.settle_by)}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-right`}>{q.attempts}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} num text-[var(--text-dim)]`}>{q.closed_at ? '—' : minute(q.next_attempt_at)}</td>
                  <td className={td}>{q.latest_settlement ? t(`ui.timeline.${q.latest_settlement.kind === 'settled' ? (q.latest_settlement.outcome === 'miss' ? 'settledMiss' : 'settledHit') : q.latest_settlement.kind}`) : q.leased_until && q.leased_until > now ? t('ui.admin.leasedUntil', { at: minute(q.leased_until) }) : q.last_status ? t(`ui.admin.lastStatus.${q.last_status}`) : '—'}</td>
                  <td className={td}>
                    <span className="flex gap-1.5">
                      <button type="button" disabled={a.settle !== 'enabled' || rowBusy} title={a.settle === 'enabled' ? undefined : t(`ui.admin.settleDisabled.${a.settle}`)} className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-2 py-0.5 disabled:opacity-50" onClick={() => run(q, 'settle', 'manual settle from /admin/judgments')}>{a.settle === 'enabled' ? t('ui.admin.settle') : t(`ui.admin.settleDisabled.${a.settle}`)}</button>
                      {a.withdraw && <button type="button" disabled={rowBusy} className="rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--text)] disabled:opacity-50" onClick={() => setPending({ action: 'withdraw', item: q })}>{t('ui.admin.withdrawEllipsis')}</button>}
                      {a.reopen && <button type="button" disabled={rowBusy} className="rounded border border-[var(--border)] px-2 py-0.5 disabled:opacity-50" onClick={() => setPending({ action: 'reopen', item: q })}>{t('ui.admin.reopen')}</button>}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
            {data && data.rows.length === 0 && <tr><td colSpan={8} className="px-2 py-3 text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('ui.admin.empty')}</td></tr>}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {pending && <ReasonDialog pending={pending} busy={busy !== null} onCancel={cancel} onSubmit={(reason) => run(pending.item, pending.action, reason)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 写运行手册 `docs/runbooks/judgments.md`（全文）**

````markdown
# 判断层（F4）运行手册

规格：`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-judgment-framework-design.md`（第 7 稿）。计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-06-judgment-framework.md`。迁移：`supabase/migrations/20261109150000_judgments.sql`（九表 + 触发器 + RLS + 桶 + §5.6 函数）。代码：`src/lib/judgments/`、`src/app/api/{judgments,methodologies,admin/judgments,cron/judgments-*}/`、`src/components/judgments/`、`scripts/judgments/`。实施记录：`docs/audits/2026-11-06-judgment-framework/implementation-log.md`。

## 1. 表、函数与权限（摘要）

| 表 | anon / authenticated 读 | service_role | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `judgment_methodologies` | 全部行 | 只读；写只经 `sync_methodology` | 代码镜像；`update` 只允许 `status / publishable / synced_at / code_version` |
| `judgment_methodology_events` | 全部行 | 只读；只经 `sync_methodology` 追加 | 方法状态事件史（`as_known` 查询用） |
| `judgments` | 仅 `publishable` 方法的行 | 只读；只经 `register_judgment` | 只追加；没有状态列 |
| `judgment_settlements` | 仅 `publishable` 方法的行 | 只读；只经 `append_settlement` | 只追加；`settlement_sequence` 触发器管转移 |
| `judgment_settle_queue` | 无 | 只读；只经 `register_judgment / claim_due_judgments / release_lease / append_settlement / quarantine_settlement / apply_quarantine_override / reject_quarantined_settlement` | 可变调度状态（不是证据）；`last_detail.quarantined_at` = 未解决不一致事件的第一次隔离时刻 |
| `judgment_calibrations` | 仅 `publishable` 方法的行 | 只读；只经 `insert_calibration` | 只追加；`fingerprint` 唯一 |
| `judgment_calibration_validity` | 全部行 | 只读；`append_settlement`（撤回 / 重开 +1）、`sync_methodology`（首次 = 1） | 校准失效修订号 |
| `judgment_job_state` | 无 | 只读；只经 `set_job_state`（乐观锁）；`cohort:<generation>` 标记只经 `freeze_calibration_cohort` 写、`clear_calibration_generation` 删 | 补偿 marker、校准续跑状态、校准轮次游标 `calibrate_round = {round, outcomes}`、冻结代际认领标记 `cohort:<generation> = {frozen_at, n, methodology, version, window}` |
| `judgment_calibration_cohort_members` | 无 | 只读；只经 `freeze_calibration_cohort` 写、`clear_calibration_generation` 删 | 校准代际冻结的成员（一条语句一个快照）；不是只追加表 |

桶 `judgments-calibration`（私有）：`cohorts/<cohort_sha256>.json`（内容寻址的 cohort 清单）与 `partial/<unit>/<generation>/<start_after>.<attempt_uuid>.json`（续跑分页，`upsert:false`）。函数清单的唯一来源是 `src/lib/judgments/rpc-inventory.ts`（`judgments.integration.test.ts` 按它断言目录与授权，`rpc-inventory.test.ts` 断言本节与 §8 列全）：

公共读 RPC（`security invoker`，anon / authenticated / service_role 可执行）：`judgments_server_time`、`judgment_envelope_of`、`latest_judgment_cards`、`judgment_history`、`calibration_cohort`、`methodology_state_at`、`judgment_envelope_by_id`。

服务写 RPC（`security definer`，只 service_role）：`calibration_cohort_internal`（只读但不受发布门控）、`sync_methodology`、`register_judgment`、`claim_due_judgments`、`release_lease`、`append_settlement`、`quarantine_settlement`（结算发布不一致的唯一写路径：锁队列 → 校验租约 → upsert open 项 → 发布队列状态，一个事务；返回 `{status:'quarantined'|'lease_lost', quarantine_id}`）、`apply_quarantine_override`（返回 `'applied'|'stale'|'closed'|'item_not_open'`，不抛）、`reject_quarantined_settlement`（`p_expected = {evidence_hash, cutoff}`；返回 `{seq, status}`，`status ∈ AppendStatus ∪ {'stale','item_not_open'}`，不抛）、`freeze_calibration_cohort`（返回 `{status:'frozen'|'already_frozen', frozen_at, n}`）、`calibration_cohort_members`（只读）、`clear_calibration_generation`（删成员与认领标记）、`insert_calibration`、`set_job_state`、`repair_stale_batches`。

内部函数（无客户端 EXECUTE）：`judgments_settle_after_date`、`judgments_grace_days`、`judgment_operation_payload`、`judgment_settlement_payload`、`judgment_replay_status`、`judgment_append_settlement_internal`。触发器函数（Task 2，同样无客户端 EXECUTE）随表一起删（§8 步骤 4）。

RPC 不登记到 `database.types.ts` 的 `Functions`（调用处 `RpcFn` 断言，`src/lib/judgments/db.ts`）。

## 2. 部署步骤（owner，合并后按顺序；顺序错了会让 cron 打到不存在的函数）

1. **迁移**：按数据底座运行手册 8.11-2 的方式（Supabase Management API `POST /v1/projects/<ref>/database/query`，`postgres` 非超级用户；不 `alter function … owner`）执行 `supabase/migrations/20261109150000_judgments.sql`，并插入 `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` 的历史行（`version='20261109150000'`, `name='judgments'`），否则 `supabase db push` 会重跑它。执行前核对文件 sha256 与 `supabase/migrations.lock.json` 的条目一致：`shasum -a 256 supabase/migrations/20261109150000_judgments.sql`。
2. **核对权限**（同一 API，逐条应得括号里的结果）：
   ```sql
   select has_table_privilege('anon','public.judgments','INSERT');                         -- false
   select has_table_privilege('service_role','public.judgments','INSERT');                 -- false（只经 RPC）
   select has_function_privilege('anon','public.register_judgment(jsonb,jsonb)','EXECUTE'); -- false
   select has_function_privilege('anon','public.judgments_server_time()','EXECUTE');       -- true
   select id, public from storage.buckets where id='judgments-calibration';                -- 1 行，public = false
   ```
   `register_judgment` 的参数签名以迁移为准；不符时用 `select oid::regprocedure from pg_proc where proname='register_judgment'` 查出实际签名再核对。
3. **同步方法注册表**（本地，连生产库）：
   ```bash
   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts --dry-run  # 只读：每个 REGISTRY 方法一行 JSON
   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts            # 写 judgment_methodologies + 事件 + validity
   ```
   退出码 2 = `formula_hash_drift`：某个已同步的 `id@version` 的公式、参数、文档或实现被改了却没升版本——不要绕过，按 §5 / 方法文档 §7 登记新版本。首次同步后 `macro_regime@v1` 是 `status='draft'`、`publishable=false`。
4. **Vercel**：环境变量 `CRON_SECRET`（已有）、`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`、`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / ANON_KEY`；`vercel.json` 已含 `/api/cron/judgments-settle`（`0 3 * * *`）与 `/api/cron/judgments-calibrate`（`0 4 * * 1`）；两个路由 `maxDuration = 300`——**确认当前 Vercel 套餐允许 300 s**（规格 §17）。部署按 `docs/VERCEL_DATAGATEWAY_DEPLOYMENT.md` §5 的 CLI 方式（项目未接 Git，合并不会部署）。
5. **空转核对**：
   ```bash
   curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "https://osbornalpha.com/api/cron/judgments-settle?preview=1" | jq .
   curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET" "https://osbornalpha.com/api/cron/judgments-calibrate?preview=1" | jq .
   curl -s "https://osbornalpha.com/api/methodologies" | jq '.methodologies | length'
   ```
   预期：两个 cron 回执 `status:'success'`、`idle:true`（没有到期判断；补偿步骤因 `unavailableMacroReadApi()` 记信息码 `macro_unavailable`）；`/api/methodologies` 返回 REGISTRY 的方法数。`/admin/dq` 的新鲜度出现 `judgments.settle` / `judgments.calibrate` 行。

## 3. 发布准入（`publishable`）

`publishable=false` 的方法照常登记、结算、校准，但读接口与公共 RPC（RLS）一条都不返回（`/admin/judgments` 可见）。置 `true` 的流程（每个方法版本一次，owner）：

1. 列出该方法可达的 origin 键：`input_kinds` 里每个 kind 在 `src/lib/judgments/origins.ts` 的全部 `kind×adapter` 行（`methodology-sync.ts::reachableOriginKeys`）。
2. 对每个原发布方取得展示许可证据（合同、条款页 URL + 截图日期、书面确认），在 `docs/methodologies/licenses.json` 把对应键改成 `{"status":"confirmed","confirmed_by":"<owner>","confirmed_at":"YYYY-MM-DD","evidence":"<证据位置>"}`，作为普通评审提交合并（许可表不在任何方法的 import 闭包或 `deps` 里，改它**不**改任何 `formula_hash`；决策 D3）。
3. 合并后：
   ```bash
   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts --dry-run --publishable <id>@<version> --owner-confirmation "<who, when, which licences>"
   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts --publishable <id>@<version> --owner-confirmation "<who, when, which licences>"
   ```
   任一可达键不是 `confirmed` → 计划项 `invalid`（`license_unconfirmed:<key>`），退出码 2，什么都不写。成功时只翻转当前行并追加 `publishable_changed` 事件（事件 `reason` = `owner_confirmed:<文本>`），**不改** `formula_hash`。
4. 撤回许可：`--unpublish <id>@<version>`；卡片、结算、校准立即从公共读路径消失（RLS 按当前值）。把 `licenses.json` 对应行改回 `unverified` 防止再次发布。

| 方法 | 原发布方 | 证据 | 日期 | 确认人 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| （空：v1 两个方法都未确认） | | | | |

## 4. 复权能力验证（价格类方法的前提，规格 §7.4）

能力表 `src/lib/judgments/resolvers/price-capabilities.ts` 初始全部 `unverified`；只有 `verified` 条目可登记与结算。验证（有网络的机器）：`npx tsx scripts/judgments/verify-adjustment.ts --help` 查看参数，对每个 `(source, market)` 录制一只在窗口内有已知除权 / 拆股事件（事件日期与比例来自交易所公告，写进夹具头）的证券的 `qfq / hfq / none` 三份序列到 `fixtures/judgments/kline/`，判定 `verified / unsupported` 后把结果与夹具路径写进能力表并提交。能力表在价格方法的 `deps` 里：v1 没有价格类方法，所以本次改表不触发漂移；以后有价格方法时，改表 = 新方法版本。全部 `unsupported` 时按 owner 决策 O6 处理（HK / US 价格判断 `void(adjustment_unsupported)`）。

## 5. `macro_regime@v1` 是草案

宏观工作台（`macro_snapshots`、`macro_observations`、`src/lib/macro/regime.ts`）不存在，`classifyAsOf` 只有夹具实现，所以 `macro_regime@v1` 是 `status='draft'`：只在测试与 `--dry-run` 下登记。生产里 `deps.ts` 装配 `unavailableMacroReadApi()`，补偿扫描每次跳过并写 `macro_unavailable`；即使接口可用，`draft` 行也让 `produce` 返回 `methodology_unavailable`、marker 不推进。生产中 `macro_regime@v1` 判断数恒为 0。

晋级（WP-M3 合并后另立任务）：真实 `MacroReadApi`（anon 读 `macro_*` 表，`classifyAsOf` 调用与发布快照同一个 `regime.ts` 函数，`margin` 单位为百分点）接进 `deps.ts`；方法登记为 `macro_regime@v2`（`deps` 加 `regime.ts`、规则表、目录快照模块；`status:'active'`），v1 保持 `draft`。上线前在预览环境：`sync-methodologies --apply` → 触发一次 `judgments-settle?preview=1` 看补偿步骤的回执 → 再正式跑；核对 `judgment_job_state['produce:macro_regime@v2']` 的 marker 推进到最新快照。

## 6. `recommendation_call@v1`（私有只读适配器）

不写 `judgments`，不同步到注册表。`GET /api/analyst/recommendations` 每行带 `judgment_card`（`PrivateJudgmentCard`，`calibration='self_assessed'`，`percent` 永远为 null），`GET /api/analyst/book` 带 `self_assessment`（Brier、命中率、按档位表；"不可审计"）。`/analyst/[analystId]` 的"信心"列只显示档位 + 未校准，登记值在行展开里。可审计的私有结算证据表是 owner 决策 O5 的第二阶段，本期没有。

## 7. 日常运维

- **队列**：`/admin/judgments`（到期 / 退避 / 租约 / 全部）。"立即结算"把一条交给 `POST /api/admin/judgments/[id]/settle`；"撤回…"（`withdrawn`，原因必填）只对已 `settled` 的判断；"重开"只对 `void / withdrawn`。三者都写 `research_audit_log`；证据只追加，旧结算行保留。撤回 / 重开会让该方法的校准行立即失效（`judgment_calibration_validity.revision + 1`）。
- **隔离项**：`/admin/dq`，数据集 `judgments`；`settlement_basis_mismatch` 只能"接受重抓"（裁决携带隔离时的完整证据），`settlement_ambiguous_fact` 选一个候选，`settlement_base_bar_missing / settlement_benchmark_gap` 只能拒绝（→ `void(quarantine_rejected)`）。到复核截止（`max(settle_by, 第一次隔离 + 7 天)`，含边界；同一未解决事件里再次隔离不延后截止）仍未处理 → `void(unresolved_inconsistency)`。
- **悬空批次**：每次 cron 开头 `repair_stale_batches('judgments.settle' | 'judgments.calibrate', '15 minutes')` 自动把残留 `running` 标 `failed`（`errors += stale_running`），不需要手工 SQL。
- **无人引用的冻结代际**（校准单元冻结成员后、写单元状态前崩溃留下；只占空间，永不被读）：每个冻结过的代际都有认领标记 `cohort:<generation>`（成员与标记同一事务写入，0 成员的代际也有标记）。`select substr(s.job, 8) as generation, s.state->>'n' as n, s.state->>'frozen_at' as frozen_at from public.judgment_job_state s where s.job like 'cohort:%' and not exists (select 1 from public.judgment_job_state u where u.job like 'calibrate:%' and u.state->>'generation' = substr(s.job, 8));` 列出，逐个 `select public.clear_calibration_generation('<generation>');` 清理（service_role；成员与标记一起删）。
- **隔离裁决返回 409 `stale`**：队列在裁决期间已换成另一次不一致或已关闭，或裁决页读到该项之后结算又把同一项刷新成新的证据（拒绝与接受都绑定读到的 `evidence_hash / cutoff`），什么都没写；刷新 `/admin/dq` 看当前项再裁决。
- **隔离写入的原子性**：结算只经 `quarantine_settlement` 一次写隔离项与队列状态；过期 worker 的刷新得到 `lease_lost`（批次信息码 `lease_lost`，计 `deferred`），不会让项与队列指向不同证据。
- **回放**：`npx tsx scripts/judgments/replay.ts --id <judgment_id> [--reconcile] [--json]`；退出码 2 = `input_hash_mismatch`（存储被改动，输出指出输入定位，宏观观测为 `series_id`）。私有：`--recommendation <id>`（用户会话，只 `inputs_only`）。
- **校准**：每周一 04:00 UTC；`threshold_n=100`、`ece_max=0.10`、`window_years=3`（owner O2 默认）。宏观每区域每 91 天约 1 条独立样本，按默认阈值在可预见时间内一直"未校准"——这是正确结果（规格 §8.4），不要为此降阈值。

## 8. 回滚

先导出 `judgments`、`judgment_settlements`、`judgment_calibrations`、`judgment_methodology_events` 与 `dq_quarantine where dataset='judgments'`（审计证据）。然后（迁移角色执行）：

```sql
-- 1. every F4 function (client RPCs, internal helpers) — signatures read from the catalog
do $$ declare r record; begin
  for r in select p.oid::regprocedure as sig from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
            where n.nspname='public' and p.prorettype <> 'pg_catalog.trigger'::regtype
              and p.proname in ('judgments_server_time','judgment_envelope_of','latest_judgment_cards','judgment_history','calibration_cohort',
                                'methodology_state_at','judgment_envelope_by_id',
                                'calibration_cohort_internal','sync_methodology','register_judgment','claim_due_judgments','release_lease','append_settlement',
                                'quarantine_settlement','apply_quarantine_override','reject_quarantined_settlement','freeze_calibration_cohort',
                                'calibration_cohort_members','clear_calibration_generation','insert_calibration','set_job_state','repair_stale_batches',
                                'judgments_settle_after_date','judgments_grace_days','judgment_operation_payload','judgment_settlement_payload',
                                'judgment_replay_status','judgment_append_settlement_internal')
  loop execute 'drop function if exists '||r.sig; end loop;
end $$;
-- 2. the envelope composite type used by the read RPCs
drop type if exists public.judgment_envelope;
-- 3. tables, dependants first (row triggers go with them); the frozen members reference judgments and settlements
drop table if exists public.judgment_calibration_cohort_members;
drop table if exists public.judgment_settle_queue;
drop table if exists public.judgment_settlements;
drop table if exists public.judgment_calibrations;
drop table if exists public.judgments;
drop table if exists public.judgment_calibration_validity;
drop table if exists public.judgment_methodology_events;
drop table if exists public.judgment_job_state;
drop table if exists public.judgment_methodologies;
-- 4. trigger functions left without dependants
do $$ declare r record; begin
  for r in select p.oid::regprocedure as sig from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
            where n.nspname='public' and p.prorettype = 'pg_catalog.trigger'::regtype and (p.proname like 'judgment%' or p.proname like 'settlement%')
  loop execute 'drop function if exists '||r.sig; end loop;
end $$;
-- 5. bucket: empty it through the Storage API first, then
delete from storage.buckets where id='judgments-calibration';
-- 6. inventory: both must return 0 rows
select proname from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and (p.proname like 'judgment%' or p.proname in ('register_judgment','claim_due_judgments','release_lease','append_settlement','quarantine_settlement','apply_quarantine_override','reject_quarantined_settlement','freeze_calibration_cohort','calibration_cohort_members','clear_calibration_generation','insert_calibration','set_job_state','repair_stale_batches','sync_methodology','calibration_cohort','calibration_cohort_internal','methodology_state_at','latest_judgment_cards'));
select relname from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and relname like 'judgment%';
```

步骤 4 的触发器函数名以迁移为准（Task 2 的命名都以 `judgment` / `judgments` / `settlement` 开头）；若清单查询仍列出 F4 的函数，按名字补删。同时从 `vercel.json` 删除两个 `judgments-*` cron 条目并重新部署；`ingest_batches` 中 `dataset like 'judgments.%'` 的回执与 `dq_freshness` 的 `judgments.*` 行保留。演练：在 `test:db` 的临时库上应用全部迁移 → 执行本节 → 两个清单为空 → 重新应用 `20261109150000_judgments.sql` → `judgments.integration.test.ts` 通过。

## 9. 测试环境

- `npm test`（不要导出 `LC_ALL=C`）；`LC_ALL=C PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH npm run test:db` 与 `npm run test:migrations`；单个数据库文件：`LC_ALL=C PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH npx tsx .claude/scratch/db-one.ts <file>`（脚本不入库，内容见交接文档 §5）。
- F4 的 critical 套件：`src/lib/judgments/judgments.integration.test.ts`、`judgments-db.integration.test.ts`、`settle.integration.test.ts`、`calibrate.integration.test.ts`（都在 `scripts/ci/research-checks.ts::criticalSuites` 的 `// F4` 围栏内）。
- 本机负载高时全量 `test:db` 会在 5–6 个研究套件（`s6/store`、`s6/arm-lineage`、`fanout/run`、`s4/ledger`、`s4/checkpoint-registry`、`s4/anchor-two-phase`，偶尔 `weekly` 的跨套件死锁）出现 5 s 超时及其级联失败；单独重跑通过即为本地偶发，Linux CI 是门禁。**F4 的三个套件出现任何失败都不按偶发处理。**
````

再写运行手册与函数清单的一致性测试（计划审计 Q1-06：§1 与 §8 不得漏掉 `rpc-inventory.ts` 里的任何函数；新增 RPC 时这条测试逼着运行手册同步）：

```ts
// src/lib/judgments/rpc-inventory.test.ts
// F4 Task 22 (plan audit Q1-06): the runbook's function inventory (§1, by group) and rollback (§8) name every SQL
// function of rpc-inventory.ts — the same list judgments.integration.test.ts asserts against the catalog and grants.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {F4_FUNCTIONS,INTERNAL_FUNCTION_NAMES,PUBLIC_RPC_NAMES,SERVICE_RPC_NAMES} from './rpc-inventory';

const RUNBOOK=readFileSync('docs/runbooks/judgments.md','utf8');
const section=(n:number)=>{const start=RUNBOOK.indexOf(`\n## ${n}. `);const end=RUNBOOK.indexOf('\n## ',start+1);return RUNBOOK.slice(start,end===-1?undefined:end);};
/** Word boundaries: calibration_cohort is not satisfied by calibration_cohort_internal, append_settlement not by judgment_append_settlement_internal. */
const mentions=(text:string,name:string)=>new RegExp(`\\b${name}\\b`).test(text);
```

- P1-01 测试类型：并集 `Condition` 先按 `resolver` 收窄再换 `predicate`（`fixture_regime` 两处、显示测试 `otherEvent`），故意非法的夹具只经一次显式 `as unknown as Condition`；resolver 结果先 `status==='resolved'` 收窄再取 `evidence`（显式不安全边界）；全计划已 grep 两种模式无残留 → 改 10、11、17
- P1-02 分页：`supabaseJudgmentsDb.pageAll` 按实际返回行数推进、空页才停；队列测试助手、校准分页（只有空页置 `done`）、公共结算历史（`seq` keyset 至空页）、history / queue 路由的 `next_before / next_after`（非空页即给游标）一律"空页才是终点"；新增服务端行数上限测试（校准 2 行上限、结算历史 2 行上限）→ 改 4、16、18
- P1-03 cutoff_vintage：`settle.ts::planOf`——`settle_by` 前不运行 resolver（有无 override 都 `defer` 到 `settle_by`），之后 `cutoff = settle_by` 且 override 仅在 `override.cutoff = settle_by` 时使用、否则丢弃重解析；`QuarantineOverride.cutoff`（骨架与 Task 1 types 同步）、隔离 payload / `last_detail` 记 `cutoff`、钩子从 payload 取 `cutoff`；规格第 7 稿 §7.2/§7.6；已知后果（`cutoff_vintage` 的 `Inconsistent` 几无复核窗口，v1 不触发）记入 Task 12 偏差 → 改 1、3、4、11、12、14、规格
- P1-04 接受原子化：`apply_quarantine_override` 锁队列再锁项，要求队列未关、`inconsistent`、`last_detail.evidence_hash` 与项 `payload.evidence_hash / cutoff` 都等于 override，清空租约，返回 `'applied'|'stale'|'closed'|'item_not_open'`（不写即返回状态）；结算刷新复用项的 payload；`planOf` 的 override 匹配加 `evidence_hash`；契约 `applyQuarantineOverride` 返回状态；三实现 + SQL / 契约 / 两连接竞争测试 → 改 1、3、4、12、14
- P1-05 拒绝原子化：新 RPC `reject_quarantined_settlement`（request_key 重放 → 锁队列 → 锁项 → 校验 → 经 `judgment_append_settlement_internal` 追加 void → 项 `resolved_reject` → 审计，一个事务）；契约 `rejectQuarantinedSettlement`；三实现（内存抽出 `appendCore`）；钩子改为单次调用（`stale` → 409）；接受 vs 拒绝竞争测试（SQL 两连接 + pg 两连接池）→ 改 1、3、4、14
- P1-06 事实结算证据：`FactOperand`（§3.5 `financial_metric` 快照同形：key、value_text、lineage、derivation rows）冻结每个算子——普通结算 `evidence.operands`、候选含 `counterpart`（yoy 另一侧）；`operandReproduces` 用 `deriveMetrics` 在冻结行上重派生；`fromOverride` 重算值 / 比率并核对 `realized_value` 与 `label_available_at`，不符 → `override_mismatch` → 改 11

### 计划审计第二轮修复

2026-11-06，按 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-judgment-framework-plan/02-codex-plan-round2.md` 与指挥决策；一行一条：ID → 修复 → 改动的任务。共享契约两份（骨架 §共享契约、Task 1 `types.ts`）同步修改并逐字核对一致。
- Q1-01 复核期不可后移：`quarantined_at` = 未解决事件的第一次隔离（队列已 `inconsistent` 时再隔离保留原值，`decide()` 与 `quarantine_settlement` 两处都保证；override / 拒绝 / reopen 清掉状态后才是新事件）；`isUnresolvedInconsistency` 与丢弃 override 分支改 `now >= reviewDeadline(q)`（含边界）；`inconsistent` 退避 `min(deadline, now + 7 天)` 恰在截止；用例：截止前 1 ms / 恰在截止、窗口内重复（同 / 不同证据）保留截止、新事件重新起算、cron 恰在截止作废且不调 resolver，复用项用例补 `quarantined_at` 与退避断言；规格 §5.4 → 改 12、3、规格
- Q1-02 隔离发布原子化：新服务写 RPC `quarantine_settlement(p_judgment_id, p_lease_token, p_reason_code, p_payload, p_patch, p_batch_id) → {status:'quarantined'|'lease_lost', quarantine_id}`（锁队列 → 校验租约 → `on conflict … where status='open'` 复刻 `quarantine()` 的 open 键 upsert → 发布 `last_status / last_detail ∪ {quarantine_id} / next_attempt_at`，`attempts` 不变，清租约；`lease_lost` 不写）；契约 `JudgmentsDb.quarantineSettlement`（两份）、三实现（内存复刻）、`settle.ts::apply` 改为单次调用（删 `quarantine()` + payload 刷新 + `releaseLease`，`lease_lost` → `deferred`）；用例：SQL 与契约里过期 worker 在替代者之后刷新 → `lease_lost` 且项 / 队列不变、同键复用与另一原因码新项、参数校验；`settle.test` 断言只调一次且 `settle.ts` 不直接写 `dq_quarantine`；离线集成断言项与队列证据一致；契约与 Task 3 的 `inconsistent / quarantined` 夹具改走同一路径或补 `cutoff`；规格 §5.6 新行 → 改骨架、1、3、4、12、14、规格
- Q1-03 裁决绑定证据身份：`reject_quarantined_settlement` 增参 `p_expected jsonb {evidence_hash, cutoff}`（签名 `(uuid,uuid,jsonb,text,jsonb,jsonb)`），与锁住的队列 `last_detail` 和项 `payload` 都比较，不等 → `stale`；`apply_quarantine_override` 签名不变（`override.evidence_hash / cutoff` 本就取自钩子读到的项），SQL 与内存补比较队列 `last_detail.cutoff`；契约 `rejectQuarantinedSettlement(judgmentId, quarantineId, expected, requestKey, row, audit)`、三实现、Task 14 钩子（从 payload 取 `evidence_hash / cutoff`，缺 → `invalid_resolution`）、钩子桩用例参数位置；竞争用例"钩子读 → worker 经 `quarantine_settlement` 刷新 → 拒绝 / 接受 → `stale`、无写"在 SQL（Task 3 races 第 4 段）、契约（Task 4）与钩子（Task 14，真内存库）三层；规格 §5.6 两行 → 改骨架、1、3、4、14、规格
- Q1-04 校准轮次不再被失败单元饿死：`RoundState = {round, outcomes: Record<job, 'completed'|'failed'|'in_progress'>}`（`RoundOutcome` 新导出）；`failed` 整轮排除（即使留着代际），`paused / conflict` 与"插入成功但清空失败"（单元状态非空）记 `in_progress`、可续跑者优先；本轮全部 `failed` 或 `completed` 且无未完成代际才开新一轮；用例：每次都耗尽预算再失败的前排单元 + 后排单元每轮都完成、清空失败的插入下次恢复、原轮次用例改断言 `outcomes` → 改 16
- Q1-05 空代际也不可复用：`freeze_calibration_cohort` 先 `insert … on conflict do nothing` 认领 `judgment_job_state['cohort:<generation>'] = {frozen_at, n, methodology, version, window}`，认领失败返回 `{status:'already_frozen', frozen_at, n}` 且不插成员；`clear_calibration_generation` 同删标记；契约返回 `{status:'frozen'|'already_frozen',frozen_at,n}`（两份）、三实现、Task 16 假库与 `stepUnit`（`already_frozen` → `CalibrateError('generation_reused')`，不清别人的代际）；用例：空代际复用、两连接并发冻结同一代际（后到者等待后 `already_frozen`、成员只插一次）、清空后可再冻结；运行手册孤儿代际查询改按标记；规格 §5.6 两行 → 改骨架、1、3、4、16、22、规格
- Q1-06 文档与清单单一来源：Task 3 新建 `src/lib/judgments/rpc-inventory.ts`（`PUBLIC_RPCS / SERVICE_RPCS / INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS` 名字 → 签名），Task 3 权限用例的 READS / WRITES / INTERNAL / SIG 由它推导，Task 4 supabase 桩用例断言 admin 只调服务 RPC、anon 只调公共 RPC，Task 22 新建 `rpc-inventory.test.ts` 断言运行手册 §1（按组）与 §8 回滚列全；运行手册 §1 改为完整清单与返回状态契约（`apply_quarantine_override` / `reject_quarantined_settlement` / `quarantine_settlement` / `freeze_calibration_cohort` 返回状态、不抛），§8 回滚补全部函数与第九张表（先删 `judgment_calibration_cohort_members`），桶路径改 `cohorts/<cohort_sha256>.json`；附录 Part A / Part C 的 `item_not_open` 抛错说法改为返回状态 → 改骨架文件表、3、4、22、附录

- `src/lib/judgments/settlement-digest.ts`：`OPERATION_FIELDS`、`operationPayload(judgmentId,row)`、`operationDigest(judgmentId:string,row:SettlementInsert):string`。

#### 跨任务接口说明（本部分依赖的 Part A 语义，以及给 Part C/D/E 的接口）

依赖 Part A（名字按 BRIEF；语义是本部分的假设，集成者对齐）：
- `contract.ts`：`validateSubject(s:unknown,opts?):Subject`、`validateClaim(kind,claim):Claim`、`validateHorizon(h:unknown):Horizon`（Task 1 实际签名）失败时**抛** `JudgmentError`（`subject_missing`/`subject_type_not_public`/`invalid_claim`/`invalid_condition` 之一），成功返回校验后的值（本部分不使用返回值）；`judgmentIdOf(f:{subject_type,subject_key,judgment_type,methodology_id,methodology_version,as_of,inputs_hash,producer_nonce}):string`。本部分不调用 `isAbstained`（用本地类型守卫，避免对其参数类型的假设）。
- `canonical.ts`：`canonicalize(v):string`、`digest(v):string`、`inputsHash(inputs:Input[]):string`（与输入数组顺序无关）。文件哈希本部分直接用 `node:crypto`，不依赖 `sha256` 包装的参数类型。
- `time.ts`：`endOfUtcDay('YYYY-MM-DD')→'YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59.999Z'`、`closeInstantUtc(date,market)→ISO`、`addDaysIso(date,n)→'YYYY-MM-DD'`、`addMonthsPeriod('YYYY-MM',n)→'YYYY-MM'`、`monthEndIso('YYYY-MM')→'YYYY-MM-DD'`。
- `markets.ts`：`factsMarketOf(p:PriceMarket):FactsMarket|null`。
- `memory-judgments-db.ts::memoryJudgmentsDb():JudgmentsDb`：`syncMethodology` 首次插行；`registerJudgment` 复刻 RPC（方法 `active`、`kind/producer_kind/subject_types/input_kinds` 与方法行一致、按方法 `params.grace_days` 重算 `settle_after/by`）；`getJudgment` 返回 `toISOString()` 形状的时间戳。**主键冲突**（集成者核对 Task 4 后定稿）：三实现的 `registerJudgment` 在 `judgment_id` 已存在时抛 `JudgmentError('duplicate_key')`（`db.ts::toJudgmentError` 把 23505 映射成它；内存实现直接抛它）；`register.ts::isUniqueViolation` 接受 `duplicate_key` 与原始 `code==='23505'`（测试桩用后者）。`memoryJudgmentsDb(opts?:{tables?})` 返回带 `setNow` 等测试助手的 `MemoryJudgmentsDb`。
- `db.ts::supabaseJudgmentsDb({anon,admin}):JudgmentsDb`（规格契约补充"数据库角色与客户端"）。
- `@/lib/dq/batches`（Task 5 实际设计）：`BatchCounts.deferred` 可选、`emptyCounts()` **不含** `deferred`（判断层自己写 `{...emptyCounts(),deferred:0}`）；`abstained_summary` 在 `JUDGMENT_INFO_CODES`、`deadline_hit` 在 `INFO_CODES`，`isInfoError` 对两者都判信息码。

本部分给后续任务的接口（Exports 段逐任务列全）：
- **K 线**（Part C resolvers）：`kline.ts::readKlineRange(req,deps?)` 返回 `KlineRange|KlineFailure`；`KlineRange extends SourceKlineSeries{close_only:boolean;from:string;to:string}`。`JudgmentInputsDb.kline` 的契约类型仍是 `SourceKlineSeries|KlineFailure`，消费者用 `closeOnlyOf(series)` 读 close-only 标志（缺字段 = `false`），**不改契约**。能力表 `resolvers/price-capabilities.ts::capabilityOf(source,market,adjustment):PriceCapability`。
- **录制夹具格式**（Part C `settle.test.ts` 用）：`fixtures/judgments/kline/<source>-<market>-<ticker>-<ex_date>.json`，形状见 Task 7 `KlineAdjustFixture`。
- **宏观夹具格式**（Task 19 用）：`macro-api.ts::MacroFixture`（`fixture_version:'macro-fixture/1'`），观测 id 统一由 `observationIdOf({series_id,period_end,vintage_id})` 构造。
- **登记**（Part C settle/compensate、Task 19/20）：`register.ts::ResolverLookup`——`resolverOf` 由调用方注入（Task 14 `deps.ts` 用 Task 11 的 `resolverFor`），所以 Task 10 不 import 后建的 `resolvers/index.ts`。
- **回放夹具格式**（Task 19/20 只加文件）：`fixtures/judgments/replay/*.json` = `ReplayFixture`（Task 13）；私有适配器夹具（Task 20）用 `judgment.producer_kind:'human'`、`expect:'inputs_only'`，回放只校验输入哈希，不重算 id（私有 id 是域分离的 `uuidV8(sha256('recommendation:'+id))`）。
- **测试助手**（非测试文件，任何后续测试可 import）：`testing/facts-fixture.ts`（Task 6）、`testing/db-helpers.ts` 与 `testing/fixture-methods.ts`（Task 10）、`testing/synthetic-method.ts` 与 `testing/synthetic-fixture.ts`（Task 13）。
- **已知限制（交 Part C / Task 19 处理）**：弃权行的 `inputs=[]`，同一 `(subject, method, as_of)` 上两个不同快照都在 `gather` 弃权时得到同一 id（第二个记 `duplicates`，弃权原因不同则 `idempotency_conflict`）；补偿扫描按 `inputs @> [{kind:'macro_snapshot',ref:{snapshot_id}}]` 查不到弃权行，会对它每次重跑 `produce`（幂等、无害，但每次多一次 RPC 前的 `getJudgment`）。Task 19 的 `gather` 应尽量在拿到快照输入之后再弃权（例如把 `upstream_version_mismatch` 放在 `compute` 里判），使弃权行也带 `macro_snapshot` 输入。

规格偏差（逐任务也写在任务内）：
1. `table_rows{table:'macro_series'}`：宏观工作台尚未建 `macro_series` 表，`JudgmentInputsDb.tableRows('macro_series', region)` 经 `MacroReadApi.seriesCatalog(region)` 取行（`origin` 键 `table_rows×macro_workbench`）；宏观表落地后改为 anon 表读，origin 键不变。
2. `MacroReadApi.observation(observationId)` 的 id 由 F4 定义为 `observationIdOf(ref)`（`encodeURIComponent(series_id):period_end:encodeURIComponent(vintage_id)`）；宏观规格 §12.1 写的是 `(series_id, period_end, asOf)`——宏观工作台对接时按本格式暴露 id。
3. 价格 bar 的 close-only 标志通过 `KlineRange.close_only` 传递（契约 `SourceKlineSeries` 无此字段，见上）。

#### 跨任务接口说明

Part A–D 与本部分并行编写。下面是本部分**依赖**的签名与语义（集成者按这些名字对齐；若 Part A–D 的实际签名不同，改本部分的调用点，不改别人的文件）。所有路径相对仓库根。

```ts
// ── Part A ──
// src/lib/judgments/canonical.ts
export function digest(v:unknown):string;                 // sha256(canonicalize(v)) hex
export function sha256(text:string):string;               // hex of the UTF-8 bytes
// src/lib/judgments/uuid-v8.ts
export function uuidV8(hex64:string):string;
// src/lib/judgments/time.ts
export function addMonthsPeriod(period:string,n:number):string;          // 'YYYY-MM' + n months → 'YYYY-MM'
export function closeInstantUtc(date:string,market:PriceMarket):string;  // exchange close of a local trading date, ISO UTC ms
// src/lib/judgments/markets.ts
export function isPriceMarket(m:string):m is PriceMarket;
// src/lib/judgments/memory-judgments-db.ts
export function memoryJudgmentsDb():JudgmentsDb;   // no-arg; register path requires methodology status 'active' (= SQL register_judgment)

// ── Part B ──
// src/lib/judgments/macro-api.ts  (Task 6; integrator: Task 6's actual shape — this part's JSON files follow it)
export interface MacroFixture{fixture_version:'macro-fixture/1';
 observations:Array<MacroObservationRef&{observation_id:string}>;   // observation_id = observationIdOf(ref) = encodeURIComponent(series_id):period_end:encodeURIComponent(vintage_id)
 snapshots:MacroSnapshotRow[];
 series_catalog:{US?:Record<string,unknown>[];CN?:Record<string,unknown>[]};   // macro_series rows; served by seriesCatalog(region)
 classifications:Array<{region:'US'|'CN';reference_period:string;macro_methodology_version:string;visible_from:string;
  regime:RegimeResult|null;observation_ids:string[];catalog:{version:string;weights:Record<string,number>;rules_version:string}}>;
}
// validateMacroFixture refuses an observation_id ≠ observationIdOf, a snapshot / classification naming an unknown observation, and a
// classification whose observations become available after visible_from. classifyAsOf(region,period,cutoff,version) → the matching
// classification with the greatest visible_from ≤ cutoff (observation_refs resolved from observation_ids). Extra keys ("_source") ignored.
export function fixtureMacroReadApi(f:MacroFixture):MacroReadApi;
// src/lib/judgments/origins.ts  (Task 6) — the key legacy_fill × eastmoney must exist (spec §11.2)
export function originFor(kind:InputKind,adapter:string,vars:Record<string,string>,opts?:{transform?:string}):Origin;   // vars fill the ORIGINS locator template, e.g. legacy_fill×eastmoney → {recommendation_id}
// src/lib/judgments/inputs.ts  (Task 8)
export function buildInput(req:InputRequest,db:JudgmentInputsDb,asOf:string,opts?:BuildOptions):Promise<Input>;   // (integrator: Task 8 actual) throws JudgmentError('input_not_public' | 'snapshot_unclassified' | 'input_unavailable' …)
//  macro_snapshot: projection from macro.snapshot(id); available_at = max(available_at of macro.observation(id) for its observation_ids)
//  macro_observation: macro.observation(observationIdOf(ref))
//  table_rows: tableRows(table, natural_key); available_at = end of UTC day of max(updated_at)
// src/lib/judgments/registry.ts  (Task 9)
export const REGISTRY:readonly Methodology[];
export function methodologyRowOf(m:Methodology,h:MethodologyHashes,meta:{publishable:boolean;code_version:string}):MethodologySyncRow;   // (integrator: Task 9 actual; sync) h = formula-hash.ts formulaHashOf(m)
// src/lib/judgments/target.ts  (Task 9)
export function settleWindow(target:Target,horizon:Horizon,params:Record<string,number|string>):{settle_after:string;settle_by:string};   // (integrator: Task 9 actual) = time.ts settleWindowOf; grace from params.grace_days
// docs/methodologies/README.md (Task 9) fixed headings, used verbatim by Task 19's v1.md:
//  "## 1 回答什么问题" "## 2 主体与输入" "## 3 公式与参数" "## 4 可证伪条件、目标期与标签政策"
//  "## 5 结算 resolver 与实现值定义" "## 6 不适用情形（何时 abstain）" "## 7 版本历史"   (integrator: Task 9 README verbatim)
// scripts/judgments/sync-methodologies.ts (Task 9; integrator-confirmed CLI): writes by default; --dry-run plans without writing
//  (both read the database: one JSON line per REGISTRY method); --publishable <id>@<version> + --owner-confirmation "<text>"
//  (and every reachable origin key confirmed in docs/methodologies/licenses.json, decision D3); --unpublish <id>@<version>;
//  exit 2 on drift / invalid. A database-free plan: methodology-sync.ts planMethodologySync(REGISTRY, memoryJudgmentsDb(), …).
// src/lib/judgments/produce.ts  (Task 10; integrator: actual signatures)
export interface ProduceDeps extends RegisterDeps{batchId:string;codeVersion:string;signal?:AbortSignal;dryRun?:boolean;producerRef?:ProducerRef;actor?:'cron'|'script'|'admin'|'test'}
//   RegisterDeps={db:JudgmentsDb;inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb;tables:TableClient;resolverOf:ResolverLookup;build?:BuildOptions}
export interface ProduceItemResult{key:string;as_of:string;binding:Record<string,string>|null;status:'inserted'|'duplicate'|'quarantined'|'failed'|'skipped';judgment_id:string|null;abstained:boolean;code:string|null}
export interface ProduceResult{counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];items:ProduceItemResult[]}
export function produce(m:Methodology,work:readonly WorkItem[],deps:ProduceDeps):Promise<ProduceResult>;
//  label_policy / grace_days from m.params; abstained rows count as inserted; a bound item that abstains in gather keeps its snapshot
//  input when buildable (decision D1); methodology row 'draft' and !dryRun → item.status 'failed', item.code 'methodology_unavailable',
//  nothing written; dryRun → item.judgment_id is the id that would be registered, nothing written.
// src/lib/judgments/replay.ts + replay.test.ts (Task 13; integrator: Task 13's actual format) — every golden fixture is
type ReplayFixture={fixture_version:'judgment-replay/1';description:string;expect:'exact'|'inputs_only';judgment:JudgmentRow};
//  replay.test.ts iterates fixtures/judgments/replay/*.json: replayJudgment(judgment) must give `expect` (REGISTRY + the test-only
//  synthetic method); then it tampers the first value-like leaf of the preferred input (macro_observation first, legacy_fill.fill_price
//  for private rows) and expects input_hash_mismatch naming that input (inputLabel: series_id for macro observations). Public rule
//  rows → 'exact'; private (producer_kind 'human') rows → 'inputs_only' (id not recomputed: domain-separated). No extra fields.
//  Any REGISTRY-iterating property test (spec §14.1) obtains sample inputs for macro_regime@v1 from
//  src/lib/judgments/testing/macro-fixture.ts::macroSampleInputs() (Task 19).

// ── Part C ──
// src/lib/judgments/resolvers/macro.ts (Task 11): macroRegimeReplayResolver:Resolver, name 'macro_regime_replay';
//  resolve(ctx) calls ctx.inputsDb.macro.classifyAsOf(params.region, params.reference_period, ctx.cutoff, params.macro_methodology_version);
//  regime null → {status:'unavailable', failure:'coverage'}; else {status:'resolved', value:regime.primary_state, unit:null,
//  from:null, to:null, label_available_at:max(observation_refs[].available_at), evidence:{observation_refs, catalog, regime_result:regime}}.
// src/lib/judgments/compensate.ts (Task 12; integrator: actual signature)
export interface CompensateDeps{db:JudgmentsDb;inputsDb:JudgmentInputsDb;tables:TableClient;codeVersion:string;triggeredBy:TriggeredBy;signal:AbortSignal;clock?:()=>number;deadlineAt?:number;methodology?:Methodology|null;produce?:ProduceFn;resolverOf?:ResolverLookup}
export const defaultResolverOf:ResolverLookup;
export function compensateMacro(deps:CompensateDeps):Promise<CompensationReport>;   // starts its own produce batch in deps.tables (ingest_batches)
//  job key 'produce:macro_regime@v1'; state {marker_created_at, marker_snapshot_id}; a snapshot already covered (judgmentsBySnapshot
//  non-empty) is skipped; a produce item error (e.g. methodology_unavailable on a draft row) stops the scan without advancing the marker.

// ── Part D ──
// src/lib/judgments/calibration.ts (Task 15)
// (integrator: Task 15's actual names; the assumed computeProbabilityMetrics / independentSample do not exist)
export interface CohortEntry{judgment_id:string;subject_type:string;subject_key:string;market:PriceMarket|null;as_of:string;window_end:string;retrospective:boolean;lifecycle:'open'|'settled'|'void'|'withdrawn';settlement_id:string|null;forecast:{kind:'probability';p:number}|…;y:number|string|null}
export function selectIndependent(samples:CohortEntry[],embargoDays:number):Set<string>;   // §8.2 greedy per subject_type:subject_key on [as_of, window_end]; chosen judgment_ids
export function brierParts(pairs:{p:number;y:number}[]):{brier:number|null;climatology:number|null;skill:number|null};
export function ece(pairs:{p:number;y:number}[]):number|null;
export function reliabilityBins(pairs:{p:number;y:number}[]):ReliabilityBin[];
// src/lib/judgments/display.ts (Task 17) conventions the UI relies on: display.value = registered p (probability),
```
